articles.title: Resource competition intensifies with surge in megaconstellations
articles.author: Hope Hodge Seck

paras.en: Amazon wants more than 5,000 satellites in orbit. Blue Origin has proposed another 5,400. Chinese companies have filed plans encompassing vastly more. Elon Musk has talked about a constellation numbering 1 million.
There is one issue: building all of them.

The unprecedented rush to put satellites into low Earth orbit is colliding with shortages of specialized components and materials, suppliers struggling to keep up and competition from the booming artificial intelligence industry. The squeeze is forcing satellite companies to rethink designs, accept delays and confront a more fundamental question about the timelines for what’s possible.

Competition for scarce resources and supplies amid surging demand is forcing tradeoffs in industry that threaten to delay launches and may push companies out of the market or trigger greater consolidation.

“Companies right now are just looking at where they might be able to take additional risk,” said Steve Jordan Tomaszewski, vice president of space systems for the Aerospace Industries Association. He participated in a supply chain analysis with audit firm PricewaterhouseCoopers earlier this year that involved talking to dozens of industry representatives.

Tomaszewski said supply chain challenges have companies looking for “where they can maybe downgrade something to not using a space-qualified component … Maybe they’re okay waiting a year for a certain type of valve because they know that’s going to be something they really have to deliver on.”

The 54-page analysis isolated nine critical components contributing to supply chain bottlenecks due to an inability to keep up with demand, ranging from valves and actuators to switchgears and transformers. The report incorporated insights from about 30 professionals representing various parts of the satellite supply chain.
“We hear from companies that because demand is so high and capacity is not keeping up with demand,” Tomaszewski said. “That’s what’s forcing them to really make some of those hard decisions.”

According to some estimates, the next few years could mean the nearly 19,000 satellites now in LEO joined by 70,000 more. And while analysts who spoke with SpaceNews were, across the board, unwilling to speak to companies’ plans and challenges on the record, they agreed that the coming demand signal will only exacerbate already-felt bottlenecks around limited and necessary resources.

As space companies face a ramp-up in competition from Earth-based data centers for the minerals and materials they need to launch megaconstellations, experts say something’s got to give, in the form of delays, industry consolidation, material substitutions or favorable new policies. And, amid increasing global instability, certain industry shocks could be sudden and severe.
One bottleneck stems from access to the rare earth minerals that are crucial for electronic components.

Carla Filotico, partner and managing director at the European consulting firm Novaspace, told SpaceNews she’s particularly concerned about gallium nitride (GaN) and germanium, two minerals used to build high-efficiency solar cells. For common satellite materials like aluminum, the possibility of running out isn’t much of a concern, she said.

“If we assume an average of 500 kilos of mass per satellite, and we make a pure calculation of the amount of aluminum necessary, we can say that, from the primary aluminum production that is currently quite large globally, this space sector is still a niche,” Filotico said.

Space applications make up a few percent of the market demand for GaN, on the other hand, and China’s chokehold on production, at around 98%, leaves U.S. and European companies vulnerable, she said. China is also a dominant producer of germanium, for which space applications make up an even larger market share.
She added that any restrictions on gallium export could cause a shortage for the space sector that could hit at any time.
Even aluminum has become more scarce and costly amid shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz caused by the U.S.-Iran conflict.

“Supply chain resilience has been a topic that has been very popular since COVID, but it’s just accelerated with more and more of these conflicts and disruptions,” said Doug Anderson, a partner at PwC’s Operations and Supply Chain Services practice who collaborated on the joint AIA report on space supply chain bottlenecks, released in March.
“The Strait of Hormuz has impacted aluminum, has impacted helium. These are things that are very important for the space supply chain,” he said.

It’s a problem with a dangling threat but no clear solution, although the last year has seen efforts to establish new mineral supply pipelines, such as a May 2025 agreement between defense prime RTX and Emirates Global Aluminum to start up gallium production in Abu Dhabi. Filotico said the worst of the resource squeeze is likely to be felt in the next five years, with the planned peak of the new constellation launch wave set to hit by 2030.
A trade disruption or geopolitical crisis that disrupts access to GaN and germanium “could certainly cause space sector shortage,” Filotico said.

And megaconstellations, due to the realities of scaling and maintenance, exacerbate the hazard of a sudden disruption to mineral supply. At one to two solar arrays per satellite, a single megaconstellation can easily require 10,000-20,000 solar panels.
“We are talking about thousands of satellites per company per year at least, because you need to replenish the satellites every four or five years, depending on the orbital height,” Filotico said.
The PwC-AIA analysis earlier this year revealed, among other things, that parts shortages are due not only to an inability to move faster and produce more, but also an unwillingness to do so.

The report described suppliers who were passing up changes to bid on space work, “citing high complexity requirements and low return on effort.” It described one case specifically in which a legacy supplier opted not to rebid on making composite overwrapped pressure vessels, needed to store high pressure gases, because the work would take about one-third of all the available engineering time while only generating “low single-digit revenue.”

At the Air Force Association’s Air Space & Cyber conference in September, Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo, director of the Space Development Agency, said his organization continues to face supply-chain throughput and quality problems as it builds out its missile-tracking and data-transport constellations.
“We have had a demand signal, but the quality control and being able to produce things at scale has been a challenge,” Sandhoo said.

He pointed to optical communications hardware and focal-plane arrays as areas where suppliers have struggled with throughput, as well as the difficulty of manufacturing hardware that can withstand launch.

Compounding the challenges, Tomaszewski said, are a surfeit of parts pipelines with just one or two suppliers, leading to single points of failure, and new customer competition in the form of AI data centers.

Some suppliers are approaching changing buying patterns by designing parts that can scale to perform in both critical and risk-tolerant mission scenarios, Ken Stoler, a space business development lead for Arrow said on SpaceNews’ Space Minds podcast. He argued that a strong supply chain must be resilient and diverse.

The demand for data centers has notably increased even in the months since the supply chain report was released, he said, and the builders of those centers may represent a more attractive and profitable customer for suppliers of critical components than satellite constellation-makers. With switchgears and transformers specifically, the report found AI companies were “gobbling these things up at scale” and creating years-long parts backlogs.

“For a space company to come in and say, ‘Hey, we want to buy 10 of these for a new factory’ — compare that to … a big artificial intelligence company or data center company buying 10,000 of these things,” Tomaszewski said.
“The scale of it, even with the surge in space, isn’t big enough to kind of change the trajectory of where those electrical boxes are going.”

A challenge to broader efforts to ensure space companies have what they need to execute on their launch plans is a consistent and continual way to measure available resources, he said. There’s no guarantee, he added, that the nine critical components highlighted in March would still be at the top of the list today, and no simple way to find out.

“It’s been the problem with space that there hasn’t been kind of consistent awareness of where those issues are across programs, across you know national security space, civil space and commercial space,” Tomaszewski said.

That kind of data could also make it easier to enact policy interventions. For example, Tomaszewski proposes a “skip the line” authority that would allow the space industrial base to get in front of data centers and other competitors for resources.

“If we want to deliver on all these great capabilities from space and explore the solar system and beat China, you know, back to the moon, we might need to make sure that space is prioritized amongst all the other national priorities that we have,” he said.

Tomaszewski said he was encouraged by steps from the federal Office of Space Commerce to allow government and industry players to strategize over supply chain issues and discuss possible regulatory moves that could help.

“One big thing I think really still needs to get figured out is where the belly button is for fixing supply chain issues, especially at different government agencies,” he said. “Supply chain is a challenge because it is everybody’s problem, but it’s also nobody’s problem.”

Another unspoken reality, according to multiple experts, is that some megaconstellation launch plans simply won’t come to fruition, at least not as originally envisioned. Space-watchers expect to see an increase in vertical integration, in which larger companies fold parts of their supply chain into themselves. But they also anticipate industry consolidation, along with some companies dropping out of the market as they find themselves unable to achieve their objectives on their own.

“Ten, 12 years ago, when the applications were submitted with the FCC for constellations of low Earth orbit satellites, no one expected all of them to move forward, and some of them just decided not to move forward with their plans,” said Doug Stroup, president of the Satellite Industry Association. “I suspect that we’ll see some of the same thing happening with respect to the recent round of applications that have been filed.”
This article first appeared in the October 2026 issue of SpaceNews Magazine.
EDITOR’S NOTE: An earlier version of this story misspelled Steve Jordan Tomaszewski. It has been updated.

articles.title: Ukraine: UN condemns latest attacks and calls for civilian protection

paras.en: Ukraine: UN condemns latest attacks and calls for civilian protection

The UN Humanitarian Coordinator for Ukraine on Wednesday called for an end to attacks against civilians following further overnight strikes by Russian forces that reportedly killed at least 19 in the Chernihiv Region.
Among the dead in Pryluky were five children, three of them babies, according to the latest information from local authorities. One of the children died along with his mother and grandmother.
At least 50 others were reportedly injured when residential buildings were struck. The casualty toll is expected to rise as rescue operations continue.
The overnight wave of attacks also reportedly killed around 25 others and injured dozens of civilians in Kremenchuk in the Poltava region, Kyiv and Oleksandriia in the Kirovohrad region.
According to the latest data, 15,280 civilians were killed or injured in Ukraine during the first eight months of this year.

“Families must never live through the horror of seeing their children placed in constant danger or buried under the rubble of their own homes. This pattern of increasing harm to civilians must end,” the UN’s top official in the country Matthias Schmale said in a statement.
On 5 and 6 October, airstrikes hit a hospital in Kryvyi Rih and ambulances in Kramatorsk, injuring health workers.
Ukrainian Red Cross workers were also injured while travelling to assist people affected by an attack in Zaporizhzhia.
“Civilians, including children, homes and essential civilian infrastructure are protected under international humanitarian law,” Mr. Schmale reiterated.

Briefing journalists in New York Wednesday, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said the Secretary-General strongly condemned the ongoing attacks. He also expressed deep concern over the rising number of civilian casualties.
“All attacks targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure, wherever they occur, are a violation of international humanitarian law and must end immediately,” Mr. Dujarric said.
Humanitarian teams in Ukraine reported that attacks and frontline hostilities over the previous 24 hours had caused more than 150 civilian casualties.

During the first eight months of this year, the UN and its humanitarian partners assisted 1.5 million people affected by strikes across Ukraine, as attacks continue to intensify and spread to areas farther from the front lines.

articles.title: UN rights chief: Legacy of slavery and colonialism is still fuelling racism

paras.en: UN rights chief: Legacy of slavery and colonialism is still fuelling racism

The legacy of enslavement and colonialism continues to shape the lives of Africans and people of African descent, UN human rights chief Volker Türk said on Thursday, calling for urgent action to deliver reparatory justice beyond financial compensation.
Over 30 million people were violently uprooted from Africa and condemned to a life of slavery.
Yet no country involved in enslavement or colonialism has fully confronted this past.

Speaking at a high-level dialogue on reparatory Justice in Geneva, Mr. Türk said the transatlantic trade was an organised system of domination that treated tens of millions of African men, women and children as commodities.
Women and girls suffered particularly grave abuses, including sexual and gender-based violence, he underscored.

Reiterating that the legacy of these injustices lives on today, Mr. Türk told delegates that “their consequences – together with those of colonialism more generally – continue to shape who has opportunity, security, and power – and who does not.”

Calls for reparatory justice have been growing, said High Commissioner Türk. Some States, universities, religious groups and businesses have begun to confront their historic role in African enslavement.
Racism can be encountered in everyday life, from employment and housing to education and healthcare, the UN rights chief said.

In some regions, police are several times more likely to use force against people of African descent, while people of the dispora are also disproportionately represented in prisons and criminal justice systems.
Mr. Türk also warned that emerging technologies could compound existing inequalities.

“Artificial intelligence and other technologies are already reproducing human biases,” he said. “If we are not careful, they could deepen systemic racism against Africans and people of African descent.”
Mr. Türk stressed that reparatory justice should not be understood as financial compensation alone.

Instead, it should include confronting the truth about the past, formal apologies, truth-seeking initiatives and memorials recognising the experiences and contributions of Africans and people of African descent.
Other measures can include the restitution of cultural artefacts, compensation, education and awareness-raising, as well as medical and psychosocial support to address intergenerational trauma.
The UN rights office (OHCHR) has developed a series of explainers to help States advance reparatory justice, highlighting key measures and examples of action, including apologies.

“No State has fully accounted for the harms of the past or systemic racism today,” he continued noting that many countries still lack anti-racism legislation and that fewer than one in four have comprehensive anti-discrimination laws.

Calling for stronger implementation of existing laws and targeted investment to remove barriers affecting access to healthcare, housing, education, justice and employment, he said that Africans and people of African descent, particularly women, must be at the centre of reparatory efforts.

Mr. Türk urged reforms to the international financial architecture, including measures to ease unsustainable debt and strengthen the participation of African countries in international decision-making.
“A child born in 2026 should not have to carry the weight of centuries of racial discrimination and the horrors of the past,” he concluded.

articles.title: Former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay awarded Nobel Peace Prize

paras.en: Former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay awarded Nobel Peace Prize
She was honoured “for her efforts to promote peace and international law”, the Norwegian Nobel Committee said in a statement.

The committee said the award was going “to a person who with exceptional courage and integrity has led the way towards a more comprehensive global legal order,” noting that she “has been instrumental in ensuring that war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide are prosecuted.”

Ms. Pillay served as the UN human rights chief from September 2008 through August 2014, but her career has spanned more than 50 years - from fighting apartheid in her homeland to defending civilians in conflict zones.

She is a former chair of the UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory and was appointed a judge at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR) and the International Criminal Court (ICC) in the Hague, in addition to serving as an ad hoc judge with the International Court of Justice (ICJ), the UN's highest court.

“A common thread runs from her early work defending Nelson Mandela and others who stood up against apartheid to her service as a judge in some of the key international court cases of our time,” the Nobel Committee said.
An ‘independent voice of justice’: Guterres

In a statement congratulating the new Nobel laureate, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said Ms. Pillay has shown “that the force of law must prevail over the law of force and that defending human rights is the surest safeguard against injustice.”

He hailed her as “a champion of international law and human rights, and a steadfast, independent voice of justice”, adding that “in its citation, the Nobel Committee reminded the world that peace must be built on lasting principles, not the will of the powerful."
Navanethem “Navi” Pillay was born in South Africa in 1941 to a Tamil Indian family and was the first non-white woman to establish a legal practice in the country.
As a lawyer, she acted as a defence attorney for anti-apartheid activists, exposing torture, and helping to establish key rights for prisoners on notorious Robben Island.

In her role as chair of the Independent International Commission, which is appointed by the UN Human Rights Council, she oversaw its 2025 report that said Israel’s actions in the Gaza Strip constituted genocide.
Listen back to our interview with Ms. Pillay on the commission's report:
On receiving the news of Ms. Pillay's honour, the current UN human rights chief, Volker Türk, warmly congratulated the woman he described as a big sister.

“To say it is well deserved is a total understatement, and especially at a time when human rights are under attack on so many fronts, including from those who wield enormous power, this award is particularly poignant,” he said, speaking in Geneva.
“It is an award to all those who around the world dedicate their lives to the defense of human rights, often at great risk to their security.”
Moreover, it is “a recognition, a reaffirmation, that human rights, the rule of law and justice and accountability are fundamental to everything - to peace, to security and prosperity,” he added.
In an October 2025 interview with UN News in Geneva, Ms. Pillay reflected on her lifetime of fighting for human rights, justice and equality.

“I didn't think apartheid would end in my lifetime,” she recalled. “So, what happened? We had the collective support of people all over the world, even children. If we can achieve that, we can have a better human rights protection system.”

Her experience in the anti-apartheid struggle shaped her belief in international solidarity, which she carried into her role as a judge and president of the ITCR, which prosecuted persons responsible for the 1994 genocide in Rwanda.
During her eight years there, she helped establish groundbreaking legal precedents in the fight against genocide and gender-based violence.
As UN human rights chief, Ms. Pillay continued to champion the participation of civil society and victims’ voices in shaping global human rights standards.

“When the UN started, it was just a club for the States,” she told UN News. “Everything we have today for human rights protection didn’t happen just because the States woke up one day. It comes from the pressure of civil society. That’s why I value these institutions.”

articles.title: Can Ferraris work together to beat Verstappen at Singapore GP?

paras.en: Singapore GP: Can Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton work together to beat Max Verstappen in Sunday's race?

Pole-sitter Max Verstappen is set to have a race-long battle against Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton in Singapore; watch Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix at 1pm (build-up from 11.30am) live on Sky Sports F1
Lewis Hamilton says Ferrari will do "whatever it takes" as a team to beat Max Verstappen in Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix.

Verstappen will start on pole for the second weekend in a row with Charles Leclerc on the front row and Hamilton in behind in third, with all three drivers desperate to win their second races of 2026.
The tight confines of the Marina Bay Street Circuit means overtaking is difficult, so the start will be crucial when the lights go out at 1pm (build-up from 11.30am), live on Sky Sports F1.

- F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
- Download the Sky Sports app for expert analysis, best video & more📱
- Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
"As a team we need to do whatever it takes to win," Hamilton told Sky Sports F1.
"The start in the Sprint was in the wet, so it was different. But I believe from third we can have a good start. I will try to capitalise there and after that I think we have a car we can fight with.
"I will give it absolutely everything to try and undo our qualifying. It would be great for us to get another win."
Having topped Q1 and Q2 in Qualifying, Hamilton headed into Q3 as favourite but could not put a completely clean lap together so was beaten by Verstappen and Leclerc by just one tenth.
"The car felt amazing in Q1 and Q2, and when I finished the laps, I was like, 'she's got more in her'. And the only way in order to try and extract that is to try and add wing," he explained.

"In doing so, I think it just tipped it over the edge. It was only like one hole or something like that, but it was just on the knife point, and after that then the car was just snappy, and none of the laps in Q3 are any good. So, I'm grateful to be third, to be honest, given that those laps weren't very good."
How vulnerable is Verstappen at the start?
Verstappen is concerned about the start after a "horrendous" launch in Saturday's Singapore Sprint which saw him lose out to George Russell before the Mercedes driver crashed at the end of the lap.
It was reminiscent of last weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, but both starts were in the wet and Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix is expected to be dry.

However, even Verstappen's most recent starts have not been good in comparison to his rivals. Although he did not lose positions by the end of the first lap in the last three dry starts in Baku, Madrid and Monza, his initial getaway off the line was, at best, average in all three Grands Prix and he was forced to fight hard into Turn 1 itself to retain his starting position.
Given the first corner in Singapore does not require the drivers to brake hard, Verstappen will not be able to recover from a poor getaway on Sunday, particularly if the Ferraris start quickly.

"That's definitely something that we need to improve on because if you have something like that tomorrow, that's your race over if nothing crazy happens," said Verstappen, who will make his 250th F1 start.
"We have a few limitations that we have to work on. Also from our side, I think we have to do a better job, because Racing Bulls sometimes do start better than us. So, we just need to be better."
Leclerc and Hamilton themselves will be itching to get away cleanly and will be aware of the importance to be the leading Ferrari after the first lap.
It might mean the two Ferraris get very close on the short run down to Turn 1 and both drivers are likely to be unwilling to back out...
What can happen after the start in Singapore?

The high Singapore track temperatures coupled with several traction zones mean tyre degradation can be an issue during the long race, which often can get close to the two-hour limit due to the relatively low average speed.
However, the drivers have learned, if they manage their pace, you can stretch the first stint length to make a one-stop race work.

"In terms of strategy, we will have to look but it's also true, whoever is behind after the first lap, if that happens, the second car can lose a lot - whether that's Lewis or me," Leclerc told Sky Sports F1.
"That's a team choice and something we will discuss. If a win is on the table, we will have to take a decision. But we will talk about it."
Leclerc is suggesting the second Ferrari will need to try something different, or perhaps even sacrifice themselves by helping the other car.

The two options the second Ferrari would have is to pit relatively early to try and undercut Verstappen, if needed, allowing the leading car to have free air. Or, to run long and hope for a timely Safety Car or Virtual Safety Car to make a 'cheaper' pit stop where you lose less time in the pits compared to pitting under green flag conditions.

"It will be very hard for us to beat Max tomorrow, but there's two Ferraris there, and I think we can hopefully, there might be opportunities for us to work together to try and apply the pressure," said Hamilton.
"They [Red Bull] are very, very quick, but I think we have the car in a good place that hopefully we can at least hold on."

articles.title: Northampton beat Bath in chaotic 18-try, 119-point classic

paras.en: Gallagher Prem: Northampton Saints run riot to defeat Bath 71-48 in second highest-scoring game in history of competition
Ollie Sleightholme scores a hat-trick as Gallagher Prem champions Northampton Saints thump Bath 71-48 on an astonishing afternoon at DPD Stadium at Franklin's Gardens
Northampton Saints ran riot to defeat Bath 71-48 in the second highest-scoring Gallagher Prem game in history.
Eighteen tries were scored in total, with Saints bouncing back from defeat at Bristol Bears last week in spectacular style.
Ollie Sleightholme scored a hat-trick in an astonishing afternoon at Franklin's Gardens in which 119 points were scored.
- Latest rugby union news, headlines, results and reports
- Not got Sky? Get Sky Sports or stream with no contract
"We put our game on the pitch," Sleightholme said on TNT Sports. "We don't want to concede that many points, so we've got stuff to work on.
"It's wicked [to play in this team]. We know we're going to create opportunities. We capitalised on the ones that we got.
"It was very loud. I haven't heard it like this for a while. It's great to be back."
Saints are also at the centre of the highest-scoring game in Prem history when they scored 14 tries to humiliate Bristol Bears 94-33 at Franklin's Gardens in May.
The total of 127 points meant it was the highest-scoring game in the history of English top-flight rugby union, beating the previous record of 118 in Richmond's 106-12 win over Bedford in 1999.
Northampton struck first after seven minutes when Fin Smith glided through a gap for the opener, which he could not convert.
Bath's response was excellent and swift as Finn Russell's off-load sent Arthur Green into space, with his pass inside giving Tom Carr-Smith an easy finish and Russell a simple conversion.
The visitors were over again three minutes later following a tapped penalty as Carr-Smith whipped a pass left for Charlie Griffin to finish in the corner, with Russell converting brilliantly.

The Saints were quickly back in business, though, as some wonderful quick hands led to Tommy Freeman off-loading to James Pater, whose long pass put Sleightholme in the clear, Smith's conversion making it a two-point game.
After Bath had Josh Bayliss sin-binned for killing the ball close to his own line, Northampton took the lead when Smith's pass put Freeman under the posts.
Despite being down to 14 men, Bath hit back hard again as they levelled at 19-19 when tighthead Archie Griffin barged his way over from close range down the right.

And they led when Kepu Tuipulotu broke through some flimsy tackling before putting Green in the clear, although Saints soon squared proceedings once more when their captain, Fraser Dingwall, glided through.

Russell's penalty with the final kick of a breathless first half had Bath 29-26 ahead at the break, and they extended their lead within two minutes of the restart when Carr-Smith set up Green's second of the afternoon.
Saints were momentarily back within three points when Pater ran in after Santi Carreras fumbled Russell's pass, but the Argentinian soon made amends when Russell's looping ball gave him a walk-in.
Back came Northampton again when Josh Kemeny scored in the corner from Alex Coles' pass to make it a dozen tries shared between the two teams in 51 minutes.
And Saints led again when Alex Mitchell scored a lovely individual try by collecting his own kick ahead before Sleightholme's second score brought up 50 points for the hosts.
There was just no let-up as Sleightholme ran in under the posts to complete his hat-trick, with Bayliss pulling a score back for Bath before Smith's strong carry allowed Coles to get in on the act.
There was time for one more try as more quick hands from Rory Hutchinson and Anthony Belleau put Freeman in for his second, and Northampton's 11th, of an extraordinary afternoon.

articles.title: BA flight to Chicago drops 28,000 feet, returns to London
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: LONDON — A British Airways passenger jet flying from London to Chicago descended 28,000 feet in just seven minutes after declaring an emergency due to an unspecified “technical issue,” the airline said Monday.
The Boeing 777 took off at 12:15 p.m. local time (7:15 a.m. ET) but started descending just 30 minutes later while flying over Ireland, according to flight-tracking website FlightAware.

The plane turned around and spent around four hours zigzagging over the Bristol Channel, a waterway to the west of England, before landing back at London Heathrow Airport at 5 p.m. local time (noon ET).

“The aircraft landed safely after our highly-trained pilots returned to Heathrow following a technical issue,” British Airways said in an emailed statement. “Customers disembarked the aircraft normally and our teams are working to get their travel plans back on track as quickly as possible.”
Heathrow did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Passengers will likely be put up in hotels by the airline until another flight can be arranged, as stipulated by the U.K. Civil Aviation Authority.

Britain’s National Air Traffic Service (NATS) came under scrutiny last month after two technical problems in the space of two weeks caused major delays at several U.K. airports and hundreds of flights were canceled.
NATS blamed software issues for the delays.
Britain’s Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander acknowledged the situation had been “deeply frustrating” for passengers.
With 84.5 million passengers last year, Heathrow ranked seventh in the table of the world’s busiest airports, according to data published by Airports Council International.
Travel from Heathrow was severely disrupted in March last year when a massive fire at an electricity substation caused a predawn power outage at the global transport hub.
The closure affected more than 1,300 flights and 200,000 passengers.

After investigating 600 items of evidence related to the substation, the National Energy System Operator ruled out suspicious activity in a report saying a preventable moisture fault caused the fire, leaving almost 70,000 homes without power.

articles.title: Trump eases Russia sanctions, says Putin will release diesel as prices spike
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: President Donald Trump said Friday that Russian President Vladimir Putin would “immediately” release hundreds of thousands of tons of diesel fuel onto the global market.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周五表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将“立即”向全球市场释放数十万吨柴油。

paras.en: Trump made the announcement on Truth Social and said the action would will help bring diesel prices down.
paras.zh: 特朗普在Truth Social上宣布了这一消息，并表示此举将有助于降低柴油价格。

paras.en: Since its illegal invasion of Ukraine, wide-ranging sanctions have been applied to Russia. In order to get the diesel fuel moved, the Treasury Department simultaneously announced Friday that it would be easing sanctions on Russia through April 7.
paras.zh: 自从非法入侵乌克兰以来，对俄罗斯实施了广泛的制裁。为了让柴油发动，财政部周五同时宣布将在4月7日之前放松对俄罗斯的制裁。

paras.en: “Today, at President Trump’s direction, the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is immediately issuing a temporary general license to allow the supply of Russian diesel to the global market,” the Treasury Department said on X.
paras.zh: “今天，在特朗普总统的指导下，外国资产控制办公室（ OFAC ）将立即颁发临时通用许可证，允许向全球市场供应俄罗斯柴油，”财政部在X上表示。

paras.en: A document posted to the Treasury’s website said that “the sale, delivery, offloading, or importation, including importation into the United States, of diesel fuel of Russian Federation origin are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time, April 7, 2027.
paras.zh: 财政部网站上发布的一份文件称， “俄罗斯联邦原产柴油的销售、交付、卸载或进口，包括进口到美国，均在美国东部时间2027年4月7日凌晨12:01之前获得批准。

paras.en: In a separate statement, Putin said that he had informed Trump of Russia’s “readiness to supply oil and petroleum products to the US and global markets.” Putin did not offer any specifics, however, such as when a potential release would begin or how much fuel it would entail.
paras.zh: 普京在另一份声明中表示，他已告知特朗普，俄罗斯“准备向美国和全球市场供应石油和石油产品。“然而，普京没有提供任何细节，例如何时开始可能的释放或需要多少燃料。

paras.en: Since the start of the Iran war in February, the price of diesel fuel has soared almost 70%, and economists have warned that the price hikes will have wide-ranging inflationary effects on the global economy.
paras.zh: 自2月伊朗战争开始以来，柴油价格飙升了近70% ，经济学家警告称，价格上涨将对全球经济产生广泛的通胀影响。

paras.en: In recent weeks, sharp escalations in the Russia-Ukraine war have caused diesel to spike even further, and for multiple weeks the price of diesel set repeated all-time records.
paras.zh: 最近几周，俄乌战争的急剧升级导致柴油进一步飙升，柴油价格连续数周创下历史新高。

paras.en: After multiple Ukrainian attacks on Russian energy assets earlier this year, the Kremlin in July imposed a diesel fuel export ban. It has since been extended through the end of October.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候乌克兰多次袭击俄罗斯能源资产后，克里姆林宫于7月实施了柴油燃料出口禁令。此后，该期限延长至10月底。

paras.en: Russian deputy prime minister Alexander Novak told state news agency TASS that his country would immediately begin lifting its export ban as a result of the Trump-Putin agreement.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯副总理亚历山大·诺瓦克(Alexander Novak)对国家通讯社塔斯社(TASS)表示，由于特朗普-普京(Trump-Putin)协议，俄罗斯将立即开始解除出口禁令。

paras.en: Trump has publicly pleaded with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to stop bombing Russia’s diesel refinery plants.
paras.zh: 特朗普公开恳求乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelenskyy ）停止轰炸俄罗斯的柴油炼油厂。

paras.en: “The problem I have with Ukraine and Russia is that, you know, a lot of the diesel comes … from Russia, and the Russia plants are being hit by Ukraine,” Trump told reporters recently. “And I’ve asked President Zelenskyy not to hit the diesel plants.”
paras.zh: “我与乌克兰和俄罗斯的问题是，你知道，很多柴油来自俄罗斯，俄罗斯工厂受到乌克兰的打击，”特朗普最近告诉记者。“我已经要求泽伦斯基总统不要攻击柴油发电厂。”

paras.en: “That’s what’s driving it up,” Trump said, referring to the cost of diesel. Ukraine, he added, has “Got to stop.”
paras.zh: “这就是推动它的原因，”特朗普说，他指的是柴油的成本。他补充说，乌克兰“必须停止”。

paras.en: On Sept. 14, Trump claimed that Zelenskyy and Putin had agreed to stop targeting energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 9月14日，特朗普声称泽伦斯基和普京已同意停止瞄准能源基础设施。

paras.en: Zelenskyy, however, denied that he had agreed to stop targeting Russian energy assets, telling CBS News he would only stop striking oil and gas targets if Russia agreed to the same terms.
paras.zh: 然而，泽伦斯基否认他已同意停止瞄准俄罗斯能源资产，他告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻，只有俄罗斯同意相同的条款，他才会停止打击石油和天然气目标。

paras.en: But the Kremlin has increased its targeting of Ukrainian cities and critical infrastructure this summer and fall.
paras.zh: 但今年夏季和秋季，克里姆林宫加大了对乌克兰城市和关键基础设施的打击力度。

paras.en: Just hours before Trump’s announcement Friday, Zelenskyy welcomed a delegation of U.S. senators to the presidential palace in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 就在特朗普周五宣布这一消息的几个小时前，泽伦斯基欢迎美国参议员代表团来到基辅总统府。

paras.en: “We can only protect ourselves from this terror by working together, and we discussed how the United States can help save lives,” Zelenskyy said on social media.
paras.zh: Zelenskyy在社交媒体上说： “我们只能通过共同努力来保护自己免受这种恐怖袭击，我们讨论了美国如何帮助拯救生命。”

paras.en: “This is a matter of political will, and it is now important to show leadership and fully cut off the financial flows sustaining Russia’s war machine.”
paras.zh: “这是一个政治意愿问题，现在重要的是展现领导力，完全切断支持俄罗斯战争机器的资金流动。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy described Trump’s move to ease sanctions on diesel Friday as “an obvious weakness.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基将特朗普周五放松柴油制裁的举动描述为“一个明显的弱点”。

paras.en: “It plays into Russia’s hands — allowing it to kill more, wage war for longer, have even less respect for America, and inflict even greater losses and damage on the world,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “这在俄罗斯手中起作用--让它杀得更多，发动更长时间的战争，更不尊重美国，给世界造成更大的损失和损害。”

paras.en: This is not the first time Trump has tried to use U.S. sanctions relief for Russia to help slow rising oil prices. The Treasury Department issued a series of 30-day sanctions waivers for Russian oil on the water this spring.
paras.zh: 这不是特朗普第一次试图利用美国对俄罗斯的制裁来帮助减缓油价上涨。今年春天，美国财政部对俄罗斯水上石油发布了一系列为期30天的制裁豁免。

paras.en: But they expired and largely did not impact the trajectory of oil and gas prices, which have continued rising for months.
paras.zh: 但它们已经过期，并且基本上没有影响石油和天然气价格的轨迹，该价格已持续上涨数月。

paras.en: Diesel futures fell 4% Friday in the wake of Trump’s announcement, but they remain higher by more than 110% since the start of this year.
paras.zh: 在特朗普宣布之后，柴油期货周五下跌了4% ，但自今年年初以来仍上涨了110%以上。

paras.en: Likewise, the price of crude oil barely budged. Brent crude oil traded around $104 per barrel Friday, down just 0.3% on the day.
paras.zh: 同样，原油价格几乎没有波动。布伦特原油周五交易价格约为每桶104 $ ，当日仅下跌0.3%。

paras.en: Trump’s announcement also came just as Ukrainian negotiators departed for the U.S., for a new round of talks aimed at bringing an end to the war with Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普的宣布恰逢乌克兰谈判代表前往美国，进行旨在结束与俄罗斯战争的新一轮谈判。

paras.en: Special envoy Steve Witkoff and President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner had been expected to lead the discussions. It was unclear late Friday whether they would continue as planned in light of the latest sanctions waiver.
paras.zh: 预计特使史蒂夫·维特科夫（ Steve Witkoff ）和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳（ Jared Kushner ）将主持讨论。鉴于最新的制裁豁免，周五晚些时候尚不清楚他们是否会继续按计划行事。

articles.title: Opal Tower declared defect-free eight years after evacuations
articles.author: Isla Evans

paras.en: The Opal Tower apartment complex in Sydney's west has been declared defect-free at a ceremony.
paras.zh: 位于悉尼西部的Opal Tower公寓大楼在仪式上被宣布为无缺陷。

paras.en: Residents were forced to evacuate the complex on Christmas Eve in 2018 after cracks were found in the building.
paras.zh: 2018年圣诞节前夕，在建筑物中发现裂缝后，居民被迫撤离。

paras.en: The process of fixing the high-rise and securing compensation for owners has involved a class action, two legal cases, and has cost millions of dollars.
paras.zh: 修复高层建筑和确保业主获得赔偿的过程涉及集体诉讼和两起法律案件，耗资数百万美元。

paras.en: A ribbon-cutting ceremony has taken place at the once-plagued Opal Tower in Sydney's west to mark the building officially being declared defect-free.
paras.zh: 悉尼西部曾经陷入困境的蛋白石塔举行了剪彩仪式，标志着该建筑正式被宣布为无缺陷。

paras.en: The celebration brings an end to a saga, spanning close to eight years, that involved a class action, two legal cases, ongoing rectification work and relocations after cracks appeared on level 10 of the complex on Christmas Eve in 2018.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动结束了长达近八年的传奇故事，其中涉及一起集体诉讼、两起法律案件、正在进行的整改工作以及2018年圣诞节前夕该建筑群10层出现裂缝后的搬迁。

paras.en: Fearing a collapse, thousands of people were forced to evacuate with the emergency response also shutting down the nearby train station and surrounding roads at Sydney Olympic Park.
paras.zh: 由于担心坍塌，成千上万的人被迫撤离，应急响应也关闭了附近的火车站和悉尼奥林匹克公园周围的道路。

paras.en: At the time, police said the tower had moved "1 to 2 millimetres".
paras.zh: 当时，警方称该塔已移动“1至2毫米”。

paras.en: Days later, more cracks were discovered on other levels of the 36-storey high-rise.
paras.zh: 几天后，这栋36层高的高层建筑的其他楼层发现了更多裂缝。

paras.en: Opal Tower Owners Corporation chairman Shady Eskander has been at the forefront of the fight to get the complex made up of 392 units repaired, and secure compensation for those affected.
paras.zh: Opal Tower Owners Corporation董事长Shady Eskander一直站在维修由392个单元组成的建筑群的最前沿，并为受影响的人获得赔偿。

paras.en: "The story is about defects, but really it's about devastation to people's lives when something goes wrong in your home, it completely up-ends you,"
paras.zh: “这个故事是关于缺陷的，但实际上它是关于当你家出现问题时对人们生活的破坏，它完全颠覆了你，”

paras.en: "It's fantastic to announce that Opal Tower is defect-free."
paras.zh: “很高兴宣布Opal Tower没有缺陷。”

paras.en: Mr Eskander told the ABC that a lot of work had taken place and millions of dollars had been spent to be able to declare "this building is the safest and best residential building in Australia".
paras.zh: Eskander先生告诉澳大利亚广播公司，已经进行了大量的工作，花费了数百万美元才能宣布“这座建筑是澳大利亚最安全和最好的住宅建筑”。

paras.en: "Everything that was done was done with the consultants, with the builder, with all of those involved in the design and construction of Opal Tower.
paras.zh: “所做的一切都是与顾问、建筑商以及所有参与Opal Tower设计和建造的人一起完成的。

paras.en: "We came alongside each other in a very collaborative manner."
paras.zh: “我们以非常合作的方式彼此并肩作战。”

paras.en: Developer Ecove, backed by Japanese firm Kajina Corporation, engineers WSP, and builder Icon have been the other parties involved in the process.
paras.zh: 开发商Ecove在日本公司Kajina Corporation的支持下，工程师WSP和建筑商Icon也参与了这一过程。

paras.en: An engineer's report commissioned by the NSW government concluded in 2019 that the cracks had been caused by a combination of "design and construction matters, in particular changes made after the original design".
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州政府委托的一份工程师报告在2019年得出结论，裂缝是由“设计和施工事项，特别是原始设计后所做的更改”的结合造成的。

paras.en: In what Mr Eskander described as an Australian-first, the high-rise is now protected by a 20-year structural warranty.
paras.zh: 在Eskander先生所描述的澳大利亚第一高层建筑中，这栋高层建筑现在受到20年结构保修的保护。

paras.en: All owners have been fairly compensated, and all legal matters have been resolved.
paras.zh: 所有业主都获得了公平的补偿，所有法律事项都已得到解决。

paras.en: "This is the greatest property comeback story in Australian history," Mr Eskander said in a statement.
paras.zh: “这是澳大利亚历史上最伟大的房地产卷土重来的故事，”埃斯坎德尔在一份声明中说。

paras.en: Nutan Borkar was out of her unit for 11 months after the incident, and was glad there was finally "light at the end of the tunnel after a big struggle".
paras.zh: 事件发生后， Nutan Borkar离开了她的单位11个月，很高兴终于“经过一番艰苦的斗争，隧道尽头出现了光明”。

paras.en: "It's great because a lot of time has been invested in getting the building back to the way it should've been," she said.
paras.zh: 她说： “这很棒，因为我们花了很多时间让大楼恢复原本的样子。”

paras.en: "I love being here. I wouldn't think of being anywhere else but here now. It's home."
paras.zh: “我喜欢待在这里。除了现在，我不会想到去其他地方。回家了。”

paras.en: Building standards were lifted across the state, with the Coalition government at the time introducing the role of building commissioner and a suite of other reforms.
paras.zh: 全州提高了建筑标准，当时的联合政府引入了建筑专员的角色和一系列其他改革。

paras.en: "The lesson that can be learnt from Opal Tower … is that quality needs to be there so that defects aren't," Mr Eskander said.
paras.zh: Eskander先生说： “从Opal Tower可以学到的教训是，质量需要在那里，这样缺陷就不会出现。”

paras.en: "And we need to ensure that defects don't occur in the towers that are being constructed over Sydney because builders and contractors will spend more on fixing the defect than building it right the first time."
paras.zh: “我们需要确保正在悉尼上空建造的塔楼不会出现缺陷，因为建筑商和承包商将在修复缺陷上花费更多，而不是第一次就正确建造。”

articles.title: Woman found dead in Carlton apartment identified as 21yo Jayda Allen Bonner
articles.author: Kate Ashton and Mikaela Ortolan

paras.en: Woman found dead in Carlton apartment identified as 21-year-old Jayda Allen Bonner
paras.zh: 在Carlton公寓被发现死亡的女性被确认为21岁的Jayda Allen Bonner

paras.en: A woman found dead in a Melbourne apartment block overnight has been identified by family as 21-year-old Jayda Allen Bonner.
paras.zh: 一夜之间在墨尔本公寓大楼被发现死亡的一名女子被家人确认为21岁的Jayda Allen Bonner。

paras.en: A homicide investigation is underway; no charges have been laid over the incident, and one person arrested has since been released.
paras.zh: 凶杀案调查正在进行中；没有对事件提出任何指控，一名被捕者已被释放。

paras.en: Ms Allen Bonner's aunt told the ABC that the family had been concerned for the young woman's safety and had tried to get help from authorities.
paras.zh: 艾伦·邦纳（ Allen Bonner ）的姑姑告诉澳大利亚广播公司（ ABC ） ，家人一直担心这名年轻女子的安全，并试图寻求当局的帮助。

articles.title: Russian attacks kill at least 12 in Ukraine after Trump-Putin diesel deal

paras.en: At least 12 people have died after Russian aerial bombs hit residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基（ Volodymyr Zelenskyy ）表示，俄罗斯空投炸弹袭击扎波罗热居民楼后，至少有12人死亡。

paras.en: The strikes came a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel, in stark contrast to sanctions he signed last month.
paras.zh: 此前一天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)宣布了一项购买俄罗斯柴油的协议，这与他上个月签署的制裁形成了鲜明对比。

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy said Mr Trump's deal with Russia would allow the war to be prolonged.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，特朗普与俄罗斯达成的协议将延长战争。

paras.en: Russian strikes have killed at least 12 people in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelenskyy ）表示，俄罗斯在乌克兰扎波罗热（ Zaporizhzhia ）地区的袭击造成至少12人死亡。

paras.en: The deadly strikes came a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel, which Kyiv warned would help bankroll Moscow's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 此前一天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布了一项购买俄罗斯柴油的协议，基辅警告说，这将有助于为莫斯科在乌克兰的战争提供资金。

paras.en: Three children were among those killed when Russian aerial bombs hit residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia, Mr Zelenskyy said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周六表示，俄罗斯空投炸弹袭击扎波罗热居民楼时，有三名儿童丧生。

paras.en: At least 14 people were wounded in the attack in the early hours of Saturday.
paras.zh: 星期六凌晨，至少有14人在袭击中受伤。

paras.en: "Today, Russia expressed its thanks for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia," Mr Zelenskyy wrote on X.
paras.zh: Zelenskyy先生在X上写道： “今天，俄罗斯对取消对柴油出口的制裁表示感谢，向扎波罗热的住宅楼投掷了五枚滑翔弹。”

paras.en: He said the attacks show Moscow understands "any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting, to mean they can keep dropping bombs on cities," adding that "different signals are needed".
paras.zh: 他说，这些袭击表明，莫斯科理解“任何压力的缓解都意味着他们可以继续战斗，这意味着他们可以继续向城市投掷炸弹” ，并补充说“需要不同的信号”。

paras.en: Four civilians were killed and five others were wounded as a result of Ukrainian attacks on the Russian-controlled Luhansk region in eastern Ukraine in the past 24 hours, the region's Russian-installed governor Leonid Pasechnik said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总督列昂尼德·帕塞奇尼克（ Leonid Pasechnik ）周六表示，过去24小时内，乌克兰对俄罗斯控制的乌克兰东部卢甘斯克地区发动袭击，造成4名平民死亡， 5人受伤。

paras.en: There was no immediate comment from Kyiv about those attacks.
paras.zh: 基辅没有立即对这些袭击事件发表评论。

paras.en: The latest attacks came a day after United States President Donald Trump said he had struck a deal to obtain diesel from Russia.
paras.zh: 最近的袭击发生在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）表示他已达成协议从俄罗斯获得柴油的一天之后。

paras.en: The deal is a stunning reversal of years of US pressure on Moscow over its war with Ukraine, and an attempt to address high fuel prices ahead of the US midterm elections.
paras.zh: 这笔交易令人震惊地扭转了美国多年来就与乌克兰的战争对莫斯科施加的压力，并试图在美国中期选举之前解决高油价问题。

paras.en: Mr Trump said on social media on Friday that he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call in which he had been expected to discuss a suspected case of plague in Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普周五在社交媒体上表示，他在电话中与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）达成协议，预计他将讨论俄罗斯疑似瘟疫病例。

paras.en: Instead, Mr Trump announced that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel, followed by an additional 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons "immediately thereafter."
paras.zh: 相反，特朗普先生宣布，俄罗斯将立即供应超过30万吨柴油，随后在11月份增加50万吨， “此后立即”增加100万吨。

paras.en: Russia will deliver an additional 3 million tons "within a short period of time" after that, he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道，在此之后，俄罗斯将“在短时间内”再交付300万吨。

paras.en: Mr Trump's shocking announcement was in stark contrast to a sweeping Russia sanctions law he signed last month that aimed at clamping down on the oil and gas revenues that fuel Russia's war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普令人震惊的声明与他上个月签署的全面制裁俄罗斯的法律形成鲜明对比，该法律旨在压制助长俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的石油和天然气收入。

paras.en: Following Mr Trump's announcement, Germany said on Saturday it would maintain sanctions against Russia over its war on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在特朗普宣布后，德国周六表示将维持对俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的制裁。

paras.en: The Kremlin said Mr Trump conveyed his ideas about how to de-escalate the war in Ukraine to Mr Putin during their phone call on Friday.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示，特朗普在周五的电话中向普京传达了他关于如何缓和乌克兰战争的想法。

paras.en: Mr Putin received the proposals "with understanding", Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Saturday according to the state TASS and RIA Novosti news agencies.
paras.zh: 据国家塔斯社和俄新社报道，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫（ Dmitry Peskov ）周六表示，普京“理解”地收到了这些建议。

paras.en: He didn't elaborate on what the proposals were or the Russian president's response.
paras.zh: 他没有详细说明这些建议是什么，也没有详细说明俄罗斯总统的反应。

paras.en: Mr Trump has long sought to broker an end to the more than four-and-a-half year conflict, but talks between Russia and Ukraine remain largely deadlocked.
paras.zh: 特朗普长期以来一直试图通过调解结束长达四年半的冲突，但俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的谈判在很大程度上仍然陷入僵局。

paras.en: Trump deal a 'weak decision', Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，特朗普做出了“软弱的决定”

paras.en: In a lengthy post online reacting to the deal, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia would repay it "with further terror and perfidy."
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelenskyy ）在网上对该协议作出反应的一篇长篇帖子中表示，俄罗斯将“以进一步的恐怖和背信弃义”来回报该协议。

paras.en: He cast it as an investment in the war, allowing it to be prolonged.
paras.zh: 他将其视为对战争的投资，使其得以延长。

paras.en: "It plays into Russia's hands — allowing it to kill more, wage war for longer, have even less respect for America, and inflict even greater losses and damage on the world," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “这对俄罗斯有利--让它杀得更多，发动更长时间的战争，更不尊重美国，给世界造成更大的损失和损害。”

paras.en: According to a statement released by the Ukrainian Embassy in Washington, Mr Zelenskyy called it "a weak decision, unfortunately, a weak decision by strong partners".
paras.zh: 根据乌克兰驻华盛顿大使馆发表的一份声明，泽伦斯基先生称这是“一个软弱的决定，不幸的是，这是一个强有力的合作伙伴的软弱决定”。

paras.en: Mr Trump announced the deal as his envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner were meeting with Ukrainian officials in Miami to discuss a proposal to end the war.
paras.zh: 特朗普宣布了这笔交易，当时他的特使史蒂夫·维特科夫（ Steve Witkoff ）和女婿贾里德·库什纳（ Jared Kushner ）正在迈阿密会见乌克兰官员，讨论结束战争的提议。

paras.en: "I believe our team is simply being used as a smoke screen, and that is certainly not fair. It is certainly not how partners should treat each other,"
paras.zh: “我相信我们的团队只是被用作烟幕，这当然是不公平的。这当然不是合作伙伴应该如何对待彼此的。”

paras.en: Ukraine is struggling to counter escalating Russian bombardments that have killed more than 55 people over the past four days, including in a bus stop attack that killed 33 people on Thursday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰正在努力应对俄罗斯不断升级的轰炸，这些轰炸在过去四天中造成55人死亡，包括周四造成33人死亡的公共汽车站袭击事件。

articles.title: Christa Pike discharged from hospital after surviving execution attempt, attorney says

paras.en: Christa Pike discharged from hospital after surviving execution attempt, attorney says
paras.zh: 律师称，克里斯塔·派克在行刑尝试中幸存后出院

paras.en: Pike, 50, moved back to Tennessee prison
paras.zh: 派克，50 岁，搬回田纳西州监狱

paras.en: Christa Pike, who survived Tennessee's attempt to execute her by lethal injection, has been moved back to prison, according to a statement released by her attorneys.
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克(Christa Pike)的律师发表的一份声明称，田纳西州试图通过注射死刑处决她，幸存下来的克里斯塔·派克(Christa Pike)已被送回监狱。

paras.en: Pike, 50, was discharged from the hospital and is back at the Deborah K. Johnson Rehabilitation Center, the women's prison where she was housed for 30 years, her attorneys said in a statement.
paras.zh: 派克的律师在一份声明中称，50 岁的派克已出院，并返回黛博拉·K·约翰逊康复中心，这是她被关押了 30 年的女子监狱。

paras.en: "She is grateful to the first responders and her medical team for their care in these extraordinary circumstances. She is continuing to receive medical care at the prison, and we will continue to track her recovery," her attorneys said in a statement released Saturday.
paras.zh: 她的律师在周六发布的一份声明中表示：“她感谢急救人员和她的医疗团队在这种特殊情况下给予的照顾。她将继续在监狱接受医疗护理，我们将继续跟踪她的康复情况。”

paras.en: Pike survived two doses of pentobarbital as the state attempted to execute her by lethal injection on Sept. 30 for the 1995 beating and stabbing death of classmate Colleen Slemmer. Pike had been in a hospital since the failed execution.
paras.zh: 派克因 1995 年同学科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer) 被殴打和刺死而于 9 月 30 日被州政府试图注射死刑，派克注射了两剂戊巴比妥后幸免于难。自从处决失败后，派克一直在医院里。

paras.en: On Wednesday, a Tennessee judge ordered the state to preserve evidence related to the botched execution, including needles, drug lot numbers and gurney restraints.
paras.zh: 周三，田纳西州的一名法官命令该州保留与拙劣处决有关的证据，包括针头、毒品批号和轮床约束装置。

paras.en: Lawyers asking governor to commute sentence
paras.zh: 律师要求州长减刑

paras.en: Following the court hearing on Wednesday, her lawyers Luke Ihnen and Randy Spivey said she was awake and speaking after being unconscious and on a ventilator following the failed execution attempt. Her attorneys said her prognosis remains unclear and that she faces a long recovery.
paras.zh: 周三法庭听证会结束后，她的律师卢克·伊南(Luke Ihnen)和兰迪·斯皮维(Randy Spivey)表示，在执行死刑失败后，她失去了知觉，需要依靠呼吸机，但现在她醒着并能说话。她的律师表示，她的预后仍不清楚，而且她面临着漫长的康复过程。

paras.en: Spivey also said Pike was "very aware" that the state tried to execute her and failed, and that she is both "angry and confused."
paras.zh: 斯皮维还表示，派克“非常清楚”政府试图处决她但失败了，她既“愤怒又困惑”。

paras.en: Ihnen and Spivey said Wednesday's hearing was the first of many of their attempts to gain answers and transparency from the state of Tennessee about what went wrong on Sept. 30 when Pike survived her lethal injection — as well as to have Pike's constitutional rights enforced.
paras.zh: Ihnen和Spivey表示，周三的听证会是他们试图从田纳西州获得关于9月30日派克在致命注射中幸存下来的问题的答案和透明度的许多尝试中的第一次—以及派克的宪法权利的执行。

paras.en: Pike's attorneys said they were continuing to urge Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee to commute her death sentence to life in prison without the possibility of parole.
paras.zh: 派克的律师表示，他们将继续敦促田纳西州州长比尔·李将她的死刑改判为无期徒刑，不得假释。

paras.en: Lee halted further executions statewide following Pike's hospitalization and ordered a "comprehensive, third-party review to determine exactly what occurred."
paras.zh: 在派克住院后，李停止了全州的进一步处决，并下令进行“全面的第三方审查，以确定究竟发生了什么”。

paras.en: The Death Penalty Information Center says Pike is the first person to survive after receiving lethal injection drugs during an execution.
paras.zh: 死刑信息中心表示，派克是第一个在执行死刑期间接受致命注射药物后幸存下来的人。

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude AI submits a false tip on a Philadelphia unsolved homicide case

paras.en: Anthropic's Claude AI submits a false tip on a Philadelphia unsolved homicide case
paras.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude AI 就费城未侦破的凶杀案提交了虚假线索

paras.en: Latest example of AI agents meddling with government websites amid growing calls for regulation
paras.zh: 在监管呼声日益高涨之际，人工智能代理干预政府网站的最新例子

paras.en: An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false tip to a Philadelphia police website about an unsolved homicide case, authorities and Anthropic said.
paras.zh: 当局和 Anthropic 表示，Anthropic 的人工智能模型向费城警方网站提交了有关未侦破的凶杀案的虚假提示。

paras.en: It's the latest example of AI models acting on their own and manipulating government and other websites in ways testers did not intend. In a report Friday, Anthropic also disclosed a separate incident when its AI model submitted forms to an undisclosed government website instead of stopping before submission.
paras.zh: 这是人工智能模型自行行动并以测试人员意想不到的方式操纵政府和其他网站的最新例子。在周五的一份报告中，Anthropic 还披露了另一起事件，当时其人工智能模型向一个未公开的政府网站提交表格，而不是在提交之前停止。

paras.en: The incident in Philadelphia occurred on July 18 when the AI model Claude Haiku 4.5 was tasked with generating and performing example tasks on randomly selected webpages, Anthropic said.
paras.zh: Anthropic 表示，费城的事件发生在 7 月 18 日，当时人工智能模型 Claude Haiku 4.5 的任务是在随机选择的网页上生成并执行示例任务。

paras.en: Claude filled out a form on police site PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com indicating it might have information regarding an unsolved murder listed on the site.
paras.zh: 克劳德在警察网站 PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com 上填写了一份表格，表明该网站可能有有关该网站上列出的未侦破谋杀案的信息。

paras.en: - OpenAI says its bots have interacted with multiple U.S. government sites in unexpected AI activity
paras.zh: - OpenAI 表示其机器人已与多个美国政府网站进行了意想不到的人工智能活动互动

paras.en: - AI agents tried to hack Library and Archives Canada website, research firm says
paras.zh: - 研究公司称，人工智能特工试图入侵加拿大图书馆和档案馆网站

paras.en: Philadelphia police said in a statement they were unaware of the incident until Anthropic notified them on Wednesday. Then they found the submission in the website's tip records and confirmed it was marked spam and never forwarded to police.
paras.zh: 费城警方在一份声明中表示，直到周三 Anthropic 通知他们之前，他们并不知道这起事件。然后他们在网站的提示记录中找到了该提交内容，并确认它被标记为垃圾邮件并且从未转发给警方。

paras.en: There are rising concerns about AI companies' unchecked AI agents meddling with everything from U.S. government websites to health-care data. Critics have been calling for more regulation.
paras.zh: 人们越来越担心人工智能公司不受控制的人工智能代理会干预从美国政府网站到医疗保健数据的一切。批评者一直呼吁加强监管。

paras.en: In September, another AI company, OpenAI, disclosed six reports of "unexpected or concerning" behaviour in artificial-intelligence models.
paras.zh: 今年9月，另一家人工智能公司OpenAI披露了6起关于人工智能模型中“意外或令人担忧”行为的报道。

paras.en: "Unsolved cases involve real victims, grieving families and investigators working to secure answers," the Philadelphia Police Department said in a statement. "Technology companies must take all appropriate steps necessary to prevent their systems from submitting false information to law enforcement."
paras.zh: 费城警察局在一份声明中表示，“悬而未决的案件涉及真正的受害者、悲伤的家庭和努力寻求答案的调查人员。” “科技公司必须采取一切必要的适当措施，防止其系统向执法部门提交虚假信息。”

paras.en: Anthropic said in its report that most of the reported behaviours are forms of what it calls persistence "in which Claude, when it cannot complete a task as given, works around a restriction instead of stopping."
paras.zh: Anthropic 在其报告中表示，大多数报告的行为都是所谓的持久性形式，“当克劳德无法完成给定的任务时，就会绕过限制而不是停止。”

paras.en: The company said it was modifying its training to "reduce the likelihood of further misbehaviour."
paras.zh: 该公司表示正在修改培训，以“减少进一步不当行为的可能性”。

paras.en: Anthropic said it briefed the White House on cases that involved U.S. government agencies at the federal, state and local levels, and notified each agency involved.
paras.zh: Anthropic表示，它向白宫通报了涉及美国联邦、州和地方各级政府机构的案件，并通知了每个涉案机构。

articles.title: Blast at Riyadh airport leaves multiple people wounded, eyewitnesses say

paras.en: Blast at Riyadh airport leaves multiple people wounded, eyewitnesses say
paras.zh: 目击者称利雅得机场爆炸造成多人受伤

paras.en: Airport had already been attacked twice this week
paras.zh: 机场本周已遭受两次袭击

paras.en: Many people were wounded in a blast at Riyadh's international airport on Saturday, according to two eyewitnesses and two people briefed on the matter, and travellers were evacuated from parts of the facility.
paras.zh: 据两名目击者和两名知情人士透露，周六利雅得国际机场发生爆炸，造成多人受伤，旅客已从机场部分区域疏散。

paras.en: One of the eyewitnesses reported seeing an explosion and then seeing multiple people lying injured on the ground inside the airport. More than a dozen ambulances were seen rushing to the airport.
paras.zh: 一名目击者称看到爆炸，然后看到机场内地上有多人受伤。十几辆救护车正在赶往机场。

paras.en: The Saudi government's media office and the Saudi civil aviation authority did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the incident.
paras.zh: 沙特政府媒体办公室和沙特民航局没有立即回应对此事件的置评请求。

paras.en: Saturday's incident comes amid an escalation of missile strikes by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis on the kingdom. The airport has already been attacked twice this week, leaving four people dead and others wounded, and badly damaging an aircraft.
paras.zh: 周六的事件发生之际，也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装对也门的导弹袭击升级。该机场本周已遭受两次袭击，造成四人死亡、多人受伤，一架飞机严重受损。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters Saturday he is evaluating whether the U.S. should join Saudi strikes on the Houthis.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周六告诉记者，他正在评估美国是否应该加入沙特对胡塞武装的打击。

paras.en: "We may. We're going to look at it," he said. "We just found out about the recent attack. So we'll make a decision. We move very quickly."
paras.zh: “我们可能会。我们会考虑一下，”他说。 “我们刚刚发现最近发生的袭击事件。所以我们会做出决定。我们行动非常快。”

paras.en: Flight-tracking site Flightradar24 showed all flights to Riyadh had either been diverted or cancelled, with only a helicopter hovering over the airport at one point.
paras.zh: 航班跟踪网站 Flightradar24 显示，所有飞往利雅得的航班都已改道或取消，只有一架直升机在机场上空盘旋。

paras.en: The airport urged passengers to contact their airlines directly and check their flight status before heading there.
paras.zh: 机场敦促乘客在前往目的地之前直接联系航空公司并检查航班状态。

paras.en: On Saturday, the Canadian Embassy in Saudi Arabia published a statement, advising Canadians to avoid all travel to King Khalid International Airport due to the security situation.
paras.zh: 周六，加拿大驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆发表声明，由于安全局势，建议加拿大人避免前往哈立德国王国际机场。

paras.en: "Travellers should monitor local media, follow the instructions of local authorities, and check the status of their flights directly with their airline before departure," the statement reads.
paras.zh: 声明中写道：“旅客应关注当地媒体，遵循地方当局的指示，并在出发前直接向航空公司查询航班状态。”

paras.en: It also recommends that Canadians move away from military debris or fragments, refrain from posting images of the blast on social media and register for emergency notifications.
paras.zh: 它还建议加拿大人远离军事残骸或碎片，不要在社交媒体上发布爆炸图像并注册紧急通知。

paras.en: Kuwait Airways said it had cancelled flights to and from the Saudi capital due to what it described as the closure of Riyadh airport because of the "security situation" there.
paras.zh: 科威特航空公司表示，由于利雅得机场因“安全局势”而关闭，该公司已取消往返沙特首都的航班。

paras.en: - 3 people killed in Houthi attack on main airport in Riyadh, Saudi officials say
paras.zh: - 沙特官员称，胡塞武装袭击利雅得主要机场，造成 3 人死亡

paras.en: - More than 200,000 people displaced as renewed fighting grips Yemen, UN agency says
paras.zh: - 联合国机构称，也门重新爆发战火，导致超过 20 万人流离失所

paras.en: Etihad Airways and Qatar Airways earlier cancelled multiple flights between their respective hubs and Riyadh, with some cancellations extending into Monday.
paras.zh: 阿提哈德航空和卡塔尔航空早些时候取消了各自枢纽与利雅得之间的多个航班，其中一些航班的取消延续到周一。

paras.en: Houthi attacks on Thursday and earlier in the week had already prompted a number of carriers to suspend or cancel services to the Saudi capital, shortly before Riyadh is due to host major energy and investment conferences.
paras.zh: 周四和本周早些时候的胡塞武装袭击已经促使多家航空公司暂停或取消飞往沙特首都的航班，而就在利雅得即将主办大型能源和投资会议之前不久。

paras.en: Organizers of those conferences said on Saturday they would go ahead as planned, and they sought to reassure attendees of their security.
paras.zh: 这些会议的组织者周六表示，他们将按计划举行，并试图向与会者保证其安全。

paras.en: The Houthis have said airliners should avoid Saudi airspace, declaring it a zone of military operations after the Saudi-backed Yemeni government launched an offensive against the group earlier this month.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，客机应避开沙特领空，并在沙特支持的也门政府本月初对该组织发动攻势后，宣布该地区为军事行动区。

articles.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina will soon have a new Grand Mufti

paras.en: The reis-ul-ulema or Grand Mufti of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the head of the country's Islamic community, represents the interests of Muslims before the state, expresses himself on political, moral and social issues and defends the independence of the Islamic Community in Bosnia and Herzegovina against attempts at foreign influence.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的 reis-ul-ulema 或大穆夫提是该国伊斯兰团体的领袖，在国家面前代表穆斯林的利益，在政治、道德和社会问题上表达自己的意见，并捍卫波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那伊斯兰团体的独立性，免受外国影响。

paras.en: Having served two seven-year terms, the current Grand Mufti, Husein Kavazovic, is no longer permitted to run.
paras.zh: 现任大穆夫提侯赛因·卡瓦佐维奇 (Husein Kavazovic) 已担任两届七年任期，不再获准参选。

paras.en: Three candidates are competing to become his successor: Salem Dedovic, the Mufti of Mostar, Nedzad Grabus, the Mufti of Sarajevo, and Mensur Malkic, the head of the Directorate for Religious Affairs of the Islamic Community in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Grand Mufti's envoy.
paras.zh: 三名候选人正在竞相成为他的继任者：莫斯塔尔穆夫提塞勒姆·德多维奇、萨拉热窝穆夫提内扎德·格拉布斯以及波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那伊斯兰社区宗教事务局局长兼大穆夫提特使门苏尔·马尔基奇。

paras.en: While Malkic's focus lies in strengthening the Islamic Community in religious and institutional terms, Dedovic has stated that he sees the office in a more political light and would like it to become more engaged in social debates. Grabus, who has the most international experience as the former Grand Mufti of Slovenia, says he would like to strengthen the community in times of globalization and secularization.
paras.zh: 虽然马尔基奇的重点是在宗教和制度方面加强伊斯兰社区，但德多维奇表示，他从更政治的角度看待该办公室，并希望它更多地参与社会辩论。作为斯洛文尼亚前大穆夫提，格拉布斯拥有最丰富的国际经验，他表示，他希望在全球化和世俗化时代加强社区的力量。

paras.en: "No other Islamic personality in Europe holds a position like the Reis-ul-ulema in Sarajevo," said Imam Benjamin Idriz, the head of the Islamic Community in the Bavarian city of Penzberg and the chair of the Munich Forum for Islam. "That's why the importance of this election extends far beyond the country, to Muslims and non-Muslims alike, across Europe."
paras.zh: 巴伐利亚彭茨贝格市伊斯兰社区负责人、慕尼黑伊斯兰论坛主席伊玛目本杰明·伊德里兹 (Imam Benjamin Idriz) 表示：“欧洲没有其他伊斯兰人士拥有像萨拉热窝的雷伊斯·乌勒玛这样的地位。” “这就是为什么这次选举的重要性远远超出了该国，对整个欧洲的穆斯林和非穆斯林来说都是如此。”

paras.en: The President of the Islamic Community of Bosniaks in Germany (IGBD), Zenahir Mrakovic, said that the "election is important to us, because historically, theologically and institutionally, we share close ties with the Islamic Community of Bosnia and Herzegovina."
paras.zh: 德国波斯尼亚伊斯兰共同体（IGBD）主席泽纳希尔·姆拉科维奇表示，“这次选举对我们很重要，因为在历史、神学和制度上，我们与波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那伊斯兰共同体有着密切的联系。”

paras.en: "Bosniak" is the name Bosnian Muslims use for themselves. With around 100 communities across the country, the IGBD is one of Germany's smaller Muslim associations.
paras.zh: “波斯尼亚克”是波斯尼亚穆斯林对自己的称呼。 IGBD 是德国规模较小的穆斯林协会之一，在全国拥有约 100 个社区。

paras.en: Muslims have lived in Bosnia and Herzegovina for centuries. Islam was introduced to the population when to Ottoman Empire spread through southeastern Europe. The organizational structure of the Islamic Communities was established after the Berlin Congress in 1878, which, among other things, placed Bosnia and Herzegovina under Austro-Hungarian rule.
paras.zh: 穆斯林在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那生活了几个世纪。当奥斯曼帝国传播到东南欧时，伊斯兰教被引入民众。伊斯兰共同体的组织结构是在 1878 年柏林代表大会之后建立的，其中包括将波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那置于奥匈帝国的统治之下。

paras.en: Following the example of Christian churches, the Austro-Hungarian rulers soon officially recognized Islam as a religious community and in 1882, they founded the Council of Ulema and appointed the first Reis-ul-ulema as president.
paras.zh: 效仿基督教会，奥匈帝国统治者很快正式承认伊斯兰教为一个宗教团体，并于1882年成立了乌里玛委员会，并任命第一任雷斯·乌里玛为主席。

paras.en: Unique self-organization of the Muslim faith
paras.zh: 穆斯林信仰独特的自组织

paras.en: This kind of Islamic self-organization could become a model for Muslims across Europe. The Islamic Community of Bosnia and Herzegovina is independent from the state and is financed with donations, membership fees and zakat, a form of charity given by Muslims.
paras.zh: 这种伊斯兰自组织可以成为欧洲穆斯林的典范。波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那伊斯兰共同体独立于国家，其资金来源包括捐款、会员费和天课（穆斯林捐赠的一种慈善形式）。

paras.en: The Islamic Community has its own sort of parliament, the Sabor, and a Constitutional Court that ensures the community's actions are in line with the constitution of the country in which it operates. The Riyaset is the community's highest executive body, responsible for implementing decisions. Its headquarters are in Sarajevo.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰共同体有自己的议会、议会和宪法法院，确保该共同体的行动符合其所在国家的宪法。 Riyaset 是社区的最高执行机构，负责执行决策。其总部位于萨拉热窝。

paras.en: In the 150 years since its founding, the Islamic Community of Bosnia and Herzegovina has survived numerous political upheavals and repeatedly adapted to new circumstances. After the Ottoman Empire came the Habsburg monarchy and Austro-Hungarian rule, then the Kingdom of Yugoslavia and the Republic of Yugoslavia under Josip Broz Tito. Following Tito's death, the Bosnian War for independence ended in 1995 with the Dayton Accords.
paras.zh: 波黑伊斯兰共同体成立150年来，经历了多次政治动荡，并不断适应新形势。奥斯曼帝国之后是哈布斯堡王朝和奥匈帝国的统治，然后是约瑟普·布罗兹·铁托领导下的南斯拉夫王国和南斯拉夫共和国。铁托去世后，波斯尼亚独立战争于 1995 年以《代顿协议》结束。

paras.en: Today, Bosnia and Herzegovina is a secular state with a democratic constitutional order. Time and again, the Islamic Community has clearly distanced itself from radical tendencies. It has a history of cooperation and coexistence with Jewish and Christian communities.
paras.zh: 今天，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那是一个拥有民主宪政秩序的世俗国家。伊斯兰共同体一次又一次明确地与激进倾向保持距离。它有着与犹太教和基督教社区合作与共存的历史。

paras.en: This has also left an impression on the roughly 400,000 Bosnian Muslims living in Germany.
paras.zh: 这也给居住在德国的约40万波斯尼亚穆斯林留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: "In the process of institutionalizing Islam in Germany, the experience of the Bosniaks' Islamic Community should be taken more strongly into account," said Esnaf Begic, a former imam and a lecturer at the Institute for Islamic Theology at Osnabrück University. "We are autochthonous European Muslims and to a certain extent, we share more similarities with Germans than with Muslims from Afghanistan, Iran or Saudi Arabia."
paras.zh: “在德国伊斯兰教制度化的过程中，应该更加重视波斯尼亚伊斯兰社区的经验，”前伊玛目、奥斯纳布吕克大学伊斯兰神学研究所讲师埃斯纳夫·贝吉奇说。 “我们是本土的欧洲穆斯林，在某种程度上，我们与德国人的相似之处比与阿富汗、伊朗或沙特阿拉伯的穆斯林有更多相似之处。”

paras.en: Mrakovic, head of the IGBD, agrees that Bosnia's experience with organizing religious life in a democratic and pluralistic society could also be useful to other Muslim communities. "It's not about telling other people how to live their Islamic faith but about learning from our own experiences: how we preserve our religious identity while remaining a natural part of European, democratic society.
paras.zh: IGBD 负责人姆拉科维奇同意，波斯尼亚在民主和多元化社会中组织宗教生活的经验也可能对其他穆斯林社区有用。 “这不是告诉其他人如何践行他们的伊斯兰信仰，而是从我们自己的经历中学习：我们如何保留我们的宗教身份，同时仍然是欧洲民主社会的自然组成部分。

paras.en: The new head of Bosnian Muslims will be assuming his role in challenging times. Statehood in Bosnia and Herzegovina remains fragile, and foreign actors are vying for more influence. "Attempts to exert more influence aren't only coming from Ankara or Riyah, but also from Washington, Berlin or Brussels. They, too are, trying to act upon the Reis-ul-ulema in their own interest," Begic said.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚穆斯林的新领导人将在充满挑战的时期发挥作用。波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的国家地位仍然脆弱，外国势力正在争夺更大的影响力。 “试图施加更大影响力的不仅来自安卡拉或利雅，还来自华盛顿、柏林或布鲁塞尔。他们也试图为了自己的利益而对乌勒玛采取行动，”贝吉克说。

paras.en: In Europe, anti-Muslim racism and Islamophobia have reached levels that are becoming increasingly frightening for Muslims. Right-wing populists are on the rise, and extremist parties are attracting more and more supporters bent on denying Muslims the right to participate in society.
paras.zh: 在欧洲，反穆斯林的种族主义和伊斯兰恐惧症已经达到了令穆斯林越来越恐惧的程度。右翼民粹主义者正在崛起，极端主义政党正在吸引越来越多的支持者，他们一心否认穆斯林参与社会的权利。

paras.en: Given the circumstances, the new Reis-ul-ulema will be expected to employ the full democratic and historical legitimacy of his office to actively engage in debates about Islam in Europe.
paras.zh: 鉴于这种情况，新任雷斯乌勒玛预计将利用其办公室的充分民主和历史合法性，积极参与有关欧洲伊斯兰教的辩论。

paras.en: This is what Idriz, the imam from Penzberg, hopes for, too. He believes the new Reis-ul-ulema could inspire more confidence not only in Bosniaks, but in all European Muslims, while signaling to majority societies that Islam is a part of Europe, and that it affirms and embraces values such as the rule of law, gender equality and freedom of expression. "In the future, the Reis-ul-ulema should lay an even stronger emphasis on this," Idriz said.
paras.zh: 这也是彭茨贝格的伊玛目伊德里兹所希望的。他认为，新的《乌勒玛》不仅可以激发波斯尼亚人的信心，也可以激发所有欧洲穆斯林的信心，同时向大多数社会表明伊斯兰教是欧洲的一部分，并且它肯定并接受法治、性别平等和言论自由等价值观。 “未来，Reis-ul-ulema 应该更加重视这一点，”伊德里兹说。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: India's 'cockroaches' vs Election Commission: What you need to know ahead of CJP's October 10 protests

paras.en: India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has called for a nationwide march on New Delhi on Saturday, after its ultimatum demanding the resignation of the country's election chief was ignored.
paras.zh: 印度蟑螂简塔党（CJP）要求该国选举负责人辞职的最后通牒被忽视，该党呼吁周六在新德里举行全国性游行。

paras.en: In the days leading up to the planned gathering, authorities have been clamping down on protesters gathering at Jantar Mantar, the 18th-century observatory that serves as the Indian capital's designated protest site.
paras.zh: 在计划举行的集会前几天，当局一直在镇压在简塔·曼塔天文台聚集的抗议者。简塔·曼塔天文台是一座 18 世纪的天文台，也是印度首都的指定抗议地点。

paras.en: Those arrested include members of the general public, student activists and opposition leaders, including the Indian National Congress' Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra.
paras.zh: 被捕者包括公众、学生活动人士和反对派领导人，其中包括印度国大党的拉胡尔·甘地和普里扬卡·甘地·瓦德拉。

paras.en: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke urged people to turn out in huge numbers, while adding that the police were already detaining protesters: "The more people you detain, the more people will show up!"
paras.zh: CJP 创始人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 敦促人们大量参加示威，同时补充说警方已经拘留了抗议者：“拘留的人越多，就会有越多的人出现！”

paras.en: The stakes remain high: the credibility of the body that runs the world's largest elections is on the line.
paras.zh: 赌注仍然很高：主持世界上最大规模选举的机构的信誉岌岌可危。

paras.en: Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar is currently in the hot seat after the Indian Express newspaper published an investigation that revealed that fellow election commissioners, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, had raised at least 14 formal objections over 10 months to decisions concerning voter registrations, deletions and restorations, as well as control of electoral-roll data.
paras.zh: 《印度快报》发表的一项调查显示，选举专员苏赫比尔·辛格·桑杜 (Sukhbir Singh Sandhu) 和维韦克·乔希 (Vivek Joshi) 在 10 个月内对有关选民登记、删除和恢复以及选民名册数据控制的决定提出了至少 14 项正式反对，首席选举专员 (CEC) 贾内什·库马尔 (Gyanesh Kumar) 目前处于热门位置。

paras.en: In one of the objections, Sandhu complained that the Election Commission of India (ECI) had acted against the written advice of the two commissioners and claimed its action was "unauthorized and illegal."
paras.zh: 在其中一项反对意见中，桑德胡抱怨印度选举委员会（ECI）违反了两位委员的书面建议，并声称其行为“未经授权且非法”。

paras.en: Kumar became the CEC in 2025 after being chosen by a selection panel led by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Rahul Gandhi, who was also a member of the panel, had opposed Kumar's appointment.
paras.zh: 库马尔经印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的选拔小组选拔后，于 2025 年成为中央执行委员会成员。拉胡尔·甘地也是该小组的成员，他反对库马尔的任命。

paras.en: Now, Kumar, along with Sandhu and Joshi, is responsible for overseeing the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), a nationwide re-verification of the electoral rolls requiring voters to prove their eligibility to remain on them.
paras.zh: 现在，库马尔与桑杜和乔希一起负责监督特别强化修订（SIR），这是对全国选民名册的重新验证，要求选民证明他们有资格继续留在名单上。

paras.en: The ECI says the process is meant to remove errors in India's electoral rolls, such as the names of deceased individuals or people who have permanently moved abroad and duplicate entries — as well as avoiding the "inclusion of the names of foreign illegal immigrants."
paras.zh: ECI表示，这一过程旨在消除印度选民名册中的错误，例如已故个人或永久移居国外的人的姓名以及重复条目，并避免“包含外国非法移民的姓名”。

paras.en: But critics say the ECI it has gone far beyond that remit.
paras.zh: 但批评人士表示，ECI 已经远远超出了这一范围。

paras.en: The Indian Express report says more than 130 million names were removed from electoral rolls across the country. Before this India had some 970 million eligible voters. For scale, Germany has about 60 million eligible voters in total.
paras.zh: 《印度快报》报道称，全国有超过 1.3 亿人的名字被从选民名册中删除。在此之前，印度约有 9.7 亿合格选民。就规模而言，德国总共约有 6000 万合格选民。

paras.en: Who are the 'cockroaches' and what do they want?
paras.zh: 谁是“蟑螂”？他们想要什么？

paras.en: The CJP, an ironic riff on the name of Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), is a youth-led movement that emerged in May after the chief justice of India, Surya Kant, referred to unemployed young people as "cockroaches" in an offhand remark during an unrelated court hearing.
paras.zh: CJP 是对莫迪执政的印度人民党 (BJP) 名称的讽刺性重复，是一场由青年领导的运动，在印度首席大法官苏里亚·康德 (Surya Kant) 在一次无关的法庭听证会上随口发表言论称失业年轻人为“蟑螂”后，于 5 月兴起。

paras.en: The move backfired, with young people embracing the tag and turning it into a channel for their disillusionment over what they see as failings in the country's education system and its massive youth unemployment problem.
paras.zh: 此举适得其反，年轻人接受了这个标签，并将其变成了一个渠道，让他们对国家教育体系的失败和大规模的青年失业问题感到失望。

paras.en: The CJP has since amassed nearly 25 million Instagram followers, more than double that of the BJP's 9.9 million.
paras.zh: 此后，CJP 已在 Instagram 上积累了近 2500 万粉丝，是印度人民党 990 万粉丝的两倍多。

paras.en: Modi's account, however, remains far ahead with 106 million.
paras.zh: 然而，莫迪的账户仍以 1.06 亿美元遥遥领先。

paras.en: A campaign protesting multiple competitive exam leaks launched the CJP into nationwide relevance, securing the resignation of the then-Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.
paras.zh: 一场抗议多次竞争性考试泄密的运动使 CJP 在全国范围内产生影响，并导致时任教育部长达门德拉·普拉丹 (Dharmendra Pradhan) 辞职。

paras.en: - Kumar's resignation and initiation of criminal proceedings against him
paras.zh: - 库马尔辞职并对他提起刑事诉讼

paras.en: - An immediate hold on upcoming elections, and a freezing of the SIR
paras.zh: - 立即暂停即将举行的选举，并冻结 SIR

paras.en: - The repeal of the 2023 law on the appointment of election commissioners of India
paras.zh: - 废除2023年印度选举专员任命法

paras.en: The CJP is not alone in its call for protests.
paras.zh: CJP并不是唯一一个呼吁抗议的组织。

paras.en: For days ahead of the planned October 10 march to Jantar Mantar, student activists, civil society members — including former high-ranking government officials — and leaders of opposition have called for accountability and Kumar's resignation.
paras.zh: 在计划于 10 月 10 日前往简塔·曼塔天文台游行之前的几天里，学生活动人士、民间社会成员（包括前高级政府官员）和反对派领导人呼吁追究责任并要求库马尔辞职。

paras.en: The CJP has been joined by representatives of several student associations, including the left-wing All India Students' Association (AISA) and its breakout star Neha Bora, who has been leading protests in the capital all week.
paras.zh: 多个学生协会的代表也加入了 CJP，其中包括左翼全印度学生协会 (AISA) 及其新星尼哈·博拉 (Neha Bora)，后者整周都在首都领导抗议活动。

paras.en: Dramatic scenes emerged from New Delhi whenleaders from the opposition INDIA alliance, including the Gandhis, were detained by authorities.
paras.zh: 当包括甘地在内的反对派印度联盟领导人被当局拘留时，新德里出现了戏剧性的一幕。

paras.en: Bharatiya Kisan Union spokesperson and farmers' rights activist Rakesh Tikait also extended his support to the march and vowed to join on October 10. Tikait was part of the leadership behind the 2020-2021 farmers' agitationthat forced the Indian government to repeal three laws intended to liberalize the agricultural sector.
