paras.zh: Bharatiya Kisan Union 发言人兼农民权利活动家 Rakesh Tikait 也对游行表示支持，并誓言将于 10 月 10 日参加。Tikait 是 2020-2021 年农民骚动背后的领导者之一，这场骚动迫使印度政府废除了三项旨在开放农业部门的法律。

paras.en: Amid heavy police presence and barricading near the ECI offices in lush central Delhi, the electoral body has rejected any suggestion of a split and Kumar's overreach, maintaining that all decisions, including on the SIR, were unanimous.
paras.zh: 在郁郁葱葱的德里市中心 ECI 办公室附近有大量警察驻守和设置路障的情况下，选举机构拒绝了任何分裂和库马尔越权的建议，坚称所有决定，包括关于 SIR 的决定，都是一致通过的。

paras.en: It also addressed allegations that opposition parties had not been allowed to meet with its officials on Tuesday, saying that till "4.00 pm today, no political party, through its representatives, had sought an appointment for a meeting with the Election Commission."
paras.zh: 它还回应了反对党周二不被允许与其官员会面的指控，称“直到今天下午 4 点，没有任何政党通过其代表寻求与选举委员会会面的预约。”

paras.en: A day earlier, a delegation of retired senior bureaucrats had also attempted to approach the office of the ECI to submit a charge sheet and impeachment notice against Kumar on behalf of the public, but were unable to reach the premises.
paras.zh: 一天前，一个由退休高级官僚组成的代表团也试图代表公众向 ECI 办公室提交针对库马尔的指控单和弹劾通知，但未能到达现场。

paras.en: Delhi police said no permission has been given for the October 10 protests, calling them illegal.
paras.zh: 德里警方表示，10 月 10 日的抗议活动并未获得许可，称其为非法。

paras.en: "I request everyone to refrain from participating in this protest," Delhi's Deputy Commissioner of Police Shrishti Pandey told news agency ANI.
paras.zh: 德里警察局副局长施里什蒂·潘迪 (Shrishti Pandey) 告诉 ANI 通讯社：“我请求所有人不要参加这次抗议活动。”

paras.en: Some BJP politicians had previously referred to the CJP as a "cross-border influence operation" aimed at destabilizing India, with Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju accusing them of seeking social media followers from archenemy Pakistan and the "anti-India gang."
paras.zh: 印度人民党的一些政界人士此前曾将印度人民党称为旨在破坏印度稳定的“跨境影响力行动”，议会事务部长基伦·里吉朱指责他们从宿敌巴基斯坦和“反印度团伙”那里寻找社交媒体追随者。

paras.en: New Delhi has been turned into a fortress, with the government deploying close to 43,000 security personnel ahead of the protests, local media reported.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，新德里已变成一座堡垒，政府在抗议活动前部署了近 43,000 名安全人员。

paras.en: Several independent journalists and others associated with the last round of CJP protests have claimed that authorities have been using intimidation tactics to keep them from joining the march.
paras.zh: 几名独立记者和其他与上一轮人民党抗议活动有关的人声称，当局一直在使用恐吓策略来阻止他们参加游行。

paras.en: CJP national spokesperson Deepak Baliyan was taken into police custody on Thursday, but released hours later.
paras.zh: CJP 全国发言人 Deepak Baliyan 于周四被警方拘留，但数小时后获释。

paras.en: In the last round of CJP protests, the police used tear gas, sticks and pellet-firing shotguns to subdue the demonstrators.
paras.zh: 在CJP的最后一轮抗议活动中，警方使用催泪瓦斯、棍棒和散弹枪镇压示威者。

articles.title: US midterms: Women candidates could make history

paras.en: Around 51% of the population of the United States is female, but that is not reflected in the make-up of the US Congress, where only 28.4% of the members are women. Nevertheless, with 152 women in total sitting in the House of Representatives and Senate, the number is higher than it has ever been in the history of the United States. The number of female governors of the 50 US states is also currently higher than ever before: Some 14 of them — 28% — are women.
paras.zh: 美国约51%的人口是女性，但这并没有反映在美国国会的组成中，美国国会议员中只有28.4%是女性。尽管如此，众议院和参议院共有 152 名女性议员，这一数字高于美国历史上的任何一次。美国 50 个州的女性州长人数目前也比以往任何时候都多：其中约 14 个州（占 28%）是女性。

paras.en: There are a number of reasons why there are still comparatively few female representatives in the US Congress. "Some of them are structural: There are rules and processes in place in our political system that make it harder for any newcomers to break in," says Kelly Dittmar, director of research at the Center for American Women and Politics (CAWP) at Rutgers University. "Historically, women were newcomers."
paras.zh: 美国国会中女性代表仍然相对较少的原因有很多。罗格斯大学美国妇女与政治中心 (CAWP) 研究主任凯利·迪特玛 (Kelly Dittmar) 表示：“其中一些是结构性的：我们的政治体系中存在一些规则和流程，使任何新来者都更难闯入。” “从历史上看，女性是新来者。”

paras.en: Seats in the Senate only come up for election every six years. Members of the House of Representatives serve two-year terms, but there is no limit to the number of times they can stand for reelection, so in theory they can stay in office for decades.
paras.zh: 参议院席位每六年才进行一次选举。众议院议员任期两年，但连任次数没有限制，因此理论上可以连任数十年。

paras.en: Also, as Dittmar points out, election campaigns in the US are very expensive. Women have historically been less able to access networks of rich donors — who, like many party leaders, are still most likely to be men. Leading male politicians are also more likely to recruit men to stand as new candidates. Finally, cultural biases also play a role: "Stereotypes and expectations about what women can and should do."
paras.zh: 此外，正如迪特玛指出的那样，美国的竞选活动非常昂贵。从历史上看，女性不太能够接触富有的捐助者网络——像许多政党领导人一样，这些捐助者仍然最有可能是男性。领先的男性政治家也更有可能招募男性作为新候选人。最后，文化偏见也发挥了作用：“关于女性可以做什么和应该做什么的刻板印象和期望。”

paras.en: The elections on November 3 will decide whether more or fewer women will sit in the US Congress over the next two years. All 435 seats in the House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 seats in the Senate are up for election in the midterms. And in 36 states, the citizens will also decide who will move in to the governor's villa.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日的选举将决定未来两年美国国会中女性席位的增加还是减少。众议院全部435个席位和参议院100个席位中的35个席位将在中期选举中进行选举。在 36 个州，公民还将决定谁将入住州长别墅。

paras.en: House of Representatives: Female Democrats outnumber female Republicans three to one
paras.zh: 众议院：民主党女性人数与共和党女性人数三比一

paras.en: 125 of the 435 representatives in the House are women. As in the Senate, and also with the gubernatorial posts, they are not evenly distributed between the two parties: There are more women among the Democrats than among the Republicans. At present, there are 95 women sitting as representatives for the Democrats, and 30 for the Republicans.
paras.zh: 众议院 435 名代表中有 125 名是女性。与参议院和州长职位一样，两党之间的女性分布并不均匀：民主党中的女性人数多于共和党中的女性。目前，民主党有 95 名女性代表，共和党有 30 名女性代表。

paras.en: "There is a far less robust support infrastructure for women within the Republican Party," says Dittmar. She comments that organizations that specifically recruit, train, and fund women candidates are almost all either on the Democrat side, or non-partisan. Besides, she adds, "A lot of the [Republican] party leaders don't see an electoral incentive or pressure" to recruit more women. Diversity is more important to Democrat voters, who place greater value on seeing women among their elected representatives.
paras.zh: “共和党内部对女性的支持基础设施远没有那么健全，”迪特玛说。她评论说，专门招募、培训和资助女性候选人的组织几乎都属于民主党或无党派。此外，她补充道，“许多[共和党]领导人并没有看到选举激励或压力”来招募更多女性。多样性对民主党选民来说更为重要，他们更看重在当选代表中看到女性。

paras.en: The Republicans currently have a majority in the House of Representatives, which means that they also get to appoint the Speaker or majority leader. At the moment, the position is held by Mike Johnson. Only one woman has held this powerful post to date: Nancy Pelosi, who was the Democrats' Speaker from 2007 to 2011, and again from 2019 to 2023.
paras.zh: 共和党目前在众议院拥有多数席位，这意味着他们还可以任命议长或多数党领袖。目前，该职位由迈克·约翰逊担任。迄今为止，只有一位女性担任过这一重要职位：南希·佩洛西 (Nancy Pelosi)，她于 2007 年至 2011 年担任民主党议长，并于 2019 年至 2023 年再次担任民主党议长。

paras.en: Women currently constitute 27% of the US Senate – 16 Democrats and 11 Republicans. Each of the 50 states is represented by two senators. The term of office is longer in this chamber of the US Congress, and the majority of the officials here represent many more voters than the representatives in the lower house.
paras.zh: 目前，女性在美国参议院中占 27%，其中包括 16 名民主党议员和 11 名共和党议员。 50 个州每个州都有两名参议员。美国国会众议院的任期较长，而且这里的大多数官员所代表的选民比下议院的代表要多得多。

paras.en: According to Dittmar, it's even harder for women to win a seat in the Senate. "With the Senate, it's an opportunity and timing issue," she says. Each seat comes up for election every six years. There are 100 in total, and every two years only a third of them are available. Little opportunity, then, for women who have not previously sat in the Senate to advance. A state-wide senatorial election campaign is also more expensive than the equivalent campaign for a seat in the House of Representatives — and studies indicate that female candidates are generally less wealthy than their male counterparts.
paras.zh: 迪特玛表示，女性在参议院赢得席位更加困难。 “对于参议院来说，这是一个机会和时机问题，”她说。每个席位每六年进行一次选举。总共有 100 个，每两年只有三分之一可用。因此，对于之前没有在参议院任职过的女性来说，晋升的机会很小。全州范围内的参议员竞选活动也比众议院席位的同等竞选活动更加昂贵，而且研究表明，女性候选人通常不如男性候选人富有。

paras.en: For one senatorial candidate, the November midterms could prove historic. If the Democrat Peggy Flanagan wins in Minnesota, she will be the first Native American woman to sit in the US Senate. Flanagan is Ojibwe, otherwise known as Chippewa, an indigenous people from the Great Lakes region spanning the US and Canada.
paras.zh: 对于一位参议员候选人来说，11 月的中期选举可能具有历史意义。如果民主党人佩吉·弗拉纳根在明尼苏达州获胜，她将成为第一位进入美国参议院的美国原住民女性。弗拉纳根是奥及布威人，也称为齐佩瓦人，是来自美国和加拿大五大湖地区的土著人民。

paras.en: Flanagan currently holds the post of lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Polls suggest that her chances are good. She has a slight lead over her rival, the Republican Michele Tafoya, previously a sports reporter and advisor to conservative politicians.
paras.zh: 弗拉纳根目前担任明尼苏达州副州长。民意调查显示她的机会很大。她略微领先于她的竞争对手、共和党人米歇尔·塔福亚（Michele Tafoya），后者曾担任体育记者和保守派政客的顾问。

paras.en: Ten of the current 14 female governors are Democrats, while four are Republicans. Six of the 14 are standing again, including Sarah Huckabee Sanders, the governor of Arkansas, who was President Trump's press secretary during his first term in office.
paras.zh: 现任 14 名女州长中有 10 名是民主党人，4 名是共和党人。 14 人中的 6 人再次站立，其中包括阿肯色州州长萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯 (Sarah Huckabee Sanders)，她在特朗普总统第一个任期内担任新闻秘书。

paras.en: For the first time in US history, it is possible that a Black woman may be elected state governor. In Minnesota, the Democrat Tim Walz — Kamala Harris's vice-presidential candidate in the 2024 election — is not standing for reelection. The main rivals for his seat are the Democrat Amy Klobuchar and the (Black) Republican Lisa DeMuth. Meanwhile, the Black Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms is running for governor of the state of Georgia.
paras.zh: 美国历史上第一次，黑人女性有可能当选州长。在明尼苏达州，民主党人蒂姆·沃尔兹（卡马拉·哈里斯在 2024 年选举中的副总统候选人）不参加连任。他的席位的主要竞争对手是民主党人艾米·克洛布查尔和（黑人）共和党人丽莎·德穆斯。与此同时，黑人民主党人凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯正在竞选佐治亚州州长。

paras.en: Kelly Dittmar doesn't think DeMuth will win in Minnesota — the state is regarded as solidly Democrat. And Klobuchar is well known among the people there; she has represented Minnesota in the US Senate since 2007.
paras.zh: 凯利·迪特玛 (Kelly Dittmar) 认为德穆斯不会在明尼苏达州获胜——该州被认为是坚定的民主党人。克洛布查尔在当地人民中很有名。自 2007 年以来，她一直代表明尼苏达州进入美国参议院。

paras.en: But in Georgia, according to Dittmar, it's a different story: "That race is considered a toss-up, 50-50." Dittmar believes that Bottoms "absolutely has a chance to be the first Black woman governor." Former President Barack Obama is her most prominent supporter, while President Trump has declared his support for the Republican candidate, Rick Jackson.
paras.zh: 但根据迪特玛的说法，在佐治亚州，情况就不同了：“那场比赛被认为是一场势均力敌的比赛，50-50。”迪特玛认为博托姆斯“绝对有机会成为第一位黑人女州长”。前总统巴拉克·奥巴马是她最重要的支持者，而特朗普总统则宣布支持共和党候选人里克·杰克逊。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: With or without Hamas

paras.en: As we begin the fourth year of a war that has brought the near-total destruction of Gaza, calls for Hamas to surrender administrative authority and evacuate the Strip are intensifying. For Gaza to have any viable future, it is argued, the group’s political and military wings must be dismantled.
paras.zh: 随着加沙战争进入第四个年头，要求哈马斯交出行政权力并撤离加沙地带的呼声越来越高。有人认为，为了让加沙有任何可行的未来，必须解散该组织的政治和军事部门。

paras.en: While Hamas’s fate is a critical question, charting a meaningful path towards recovery is impossible without addressing the realities that gave rise to it in the first place.
paras.zh: 虽然哈马斯的命运是一个关键问题，但如果不首先解决导致其发生的现实，就不可能制定一条有意义的复苏之路。

paras.en: What is happening today in Gaza is directly related to the origins of the Palestinian-Israeli question, which has little to do with any particular armed group.
paras.zh: 今天加沙发生的事情与巴以问题的根源直接相关，与任何特定武装组织无关。

paras.en: Hamas did not exist in 1948, when hundreds of Palestinian villages, including Naj and Huj, were depopulated and destroyed during the Nakba – the Palestinian catastrophe that accompanied the creation of the State of Israel – to make way for the establishment of Sderot, Or HaNer and numerous other Israeli cities and villages built upon their ruins.
paras.zh: 1948 年，哈马斯还不存在，当时包括 Naj 和 Huj 在内的数百个巴勒斯坦村庄在大灾难（伴随以色列建国的巴勒斯坦灾难）期间人口减少并被摧毁，为斯德洛特、奥尔哈纳以及在其废墟上建立的许多其他以色列城市和村庄让路。

paras.en: The group had not yet been established in 1967, when the Arab-Israeli War took place and Israel initiated its military occupation of the Gaza Strip and the West Bank, while simultaneously seizing and unilaterally annexing East Jerusalem—actions that actively set the stage for the broader Israeli settlement project.
paras.zh: 1967 年，该组织尚未成立，当时阿以战争爆发，以色列开始对加沙地带和西岸进行军事占领，同时夺取并单方面吞并东耶路撒冷，这些行动为更广泛的以色列定居点项目积极奠定了基础。

paras.en: In the following decades, the occupation profoundly affected Palestinian society. That, combined with growing religious influence—as the number of local mosques tripled from 200 to 600 between 1967 and 1987 — and a vacuum left behind by a fading secular nationalist leadership, prepared the ground for the rise of faith-based nationalist factions. The outbreak of the First Intifada in 1987 was a political turning point that directly triggered the creation of Hamas.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几十年里，占领深刻影响了巴勒斯坦社会。再加上日益增长的宗教影响力——当地清真寺的数量在 1967 年至 1987 年间从 200 座增加到 600 座——以及世俗民族主义领导层的衰落留下的真空，为基于信仰的民族主义派别的崛起奠定了基础。 1987年第一次起义的爆发是一个政治转折点，直接引发了哈马斯的成立。

paras.en: The group was established by a group of Palestinian men, including three prominent figures. Ibrahim al-Yazouri, was born in Bait Daras, near today’s Ashdod, and was just eight years old when soldiers of the Haganah killed members of his family and expelled the survivors to Khan Younis, south of Gaza City.
paras.zh: 该组织由一群巴勒斯坦男子成立，其中包括三名知名人士。易卜拉欣·亚祖里 (Ibrahim al-Yazouri) 出生在今天阿什杜德 (Ashdod) 附近的拜特德拉斯 (Bait Daras)，当哈加纳 (Haganah) 士兵杀害他的家人并将幸存者驱逐到加沙城以南的汗尤尼斯 (Khan Younis) 时，他才八岁。

paras.en: Another founder, Abdulaziz al-Rantisi, was born in Yibna—a village near Jaffa whose ruins now sit beneath the Israeli city of Yavne. He was only a year old when Israeli forces expelled his family to Khan Younis.
paras.zh: 另一位创始人阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·兰蒂西 (Abdulaziz al-Rantisi) 出生于伊布纳 (Yibna)，这是雅法附近的一个村庄，其废墟现在位于以色列城市亚夫内 (Yavne) 下方。当以色列军队将他的家人驱逐到汗尤尼斯时，他只有一岁。

paras.en: Lastly, Ahmed Yassin, was born in al-Jura, a village near Ashkelon that was razed to the ground by the Israeli military. He was 12 years old, when he and his family had to flee their home and settle in al-Shati refugee camp on the Gaza coast.
paras.zh: 最后，艾哈迈德·亚辛出生于阿什凯隆附近的朱拉村，该村被以色列军队夷为平地。当他 12 岁时，他和家人不得不逃离家园，定居在加沙海岸的沙蒂难民营。

paras.en: Highlighting this history should not be misunderstood as an attempt to downplay Hamas’s responsibilities. However, the group’s actions cannot be separated from the historical context and the role the State of Israel has played throughout this process.
paras.zh: 强调这段历史不应被误解为试图淡化哈马斯的责任。然而，该组织的行为离不开历史背景以及以色列国在整个过程中所发挥的作用。

paras.en: Unlike the self-proclaimed ISIL (ISIS) and other groups that have emerged in recent years—which lack deep roots in local societies and rely on obsolete ideologies—Palestinian factions are deeply intertwined with local society and national identity.
paras.zh: 与近年来出现的自称“伊斯兰国”等组织不同，这些组织在当地社会缺乏深厚根基，依赖过时的意识形态，巴勒斯坦派系与当地社会和民族认同深深交织在一起。

paras.en: While Hamas’s trajectory is marked by several disastrous decisions—most notably its fatal decision to launch the assault on Israel on October 7, 2023—the group remains, above all, a symptom of a century of suffering, oppression and a relentless struggle for self-determination.
paras.zh: 尽管哈马斯的发展轨迹以多项灾难性决定为标志——最引人注目的是其于 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列发动袭击的致命决定——但该组织首先仍然是一个世纪以来遭受苦难、压迫和争取自决的不懈斗争的象征。

paras.en: Any proposed solution – with or without Hamas – to the war in Gaza that fails to address these underlying realities is bound to fail. It must be emphasised here that the widespread tendency in the West to frame the Palestinian people’s right to self-determination as a “reward for Hamas” is deeply flawed. It stems from a systemic prejudice that must not be normalised.
paras.zh: 任何针对加沙战争提出的解决方案——不管有没有哈马斯——如果不能解决这些根本现实，就注定会失败。这里必须强调的是，西方普遍将巴勒斯坦人民的自决权视为“对哈马斯的奖励”的倾向是有严重缺陷的。它源于一种不能正常化的系统性偏见。

paras.en: The right was enshrined in international law and supported by an overwhelming majority of nations long before Hamas’s attack.
paras.zh: 早在哈马斯发动袭击之前，这一权利就已载入国际法，并得到绝大多数国家的支持。

paras.en: It is also a mistake to equate Hamas’s actions with the will of the Palestinian people. Today, nearly 50 percent of the population of the Gaza Strip is under the age of 18; when Hamas won the elections in 2006, more than half of Gaza’s current residents had not even been born.
paras.zh: 将哈马斯的行动与巴勒斯坦人民的意愿等同起来也是错误的。如今，加沙地带近 50% 的人口年龄在 18 岁以下； 2006年哈马斯赢得选举时，加沙目前一半以上的居民甚至还没有出生。

paras.en: Furthermore, in an Arab Barometer survey conducted in the West Bank and Gaza between late September and early October 2023, only 29 percent of Gaza respondents said they trusted the Hamas-led government. The majority blamed poverty on internal factors; 31 percent directly pointed to the Hamas authorities as being responsible for the situation.
paras.zh: 此外，2023 年 9 月下旬至 10 月初在约旦河西岸和加沙进行的《阿拉伯晴雨表》调查显示，只有 29% 的加沙受访者表示信任哈马斯领导的政府。大多数人将贫困归咎于内部因素； 31％的人直接指出哈马斯当局应对这一情况负责。

paras.en: Crucially, a majority (54 percent) supported a two-state solution to the conflict; 73 percent favoured a peaceful resolution. Just 20 percent favoured military action.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，大多数人（54%）支持两国解决冲突； 73% 的人赞成和平解决。只有 20% 的人支持采取军事行动。

paras.en: The presence of Hamas in Gaza cannot justify the Strip’s wholesale destruction and the crimes committed against civilians that have resulted in Israeli officials facing accusations of war crimes and crimes against humanity. Hamas was not present at al-Nasr Hospital in November 2023, when the Israeli army left newborns to die in incubators after forcing their caregivers to evacuate and prevented their return. Hamas was not in the car with Hind Rajab, the young Palestinian girl, when Israeli forces fired 335 bullets into it in January 2024.
paras.zh: 哈马斯在加沙的存在不能成为大规模破坏加沙地带和对平民犯下的罪行的理由，这些罪行导致以色列官员面临战争罪和反人类罪的指控。 2023 年 11 月，以色列军队迫使新生儿的护理人员撤离并阻止他们返回，然后将新生儿留在保温箱中等死，哈马斯并未出现在纳斯尔医院。 2024 年 1 月，当以色列军队向哈马斯发射 335 发子弹时，哈马斯并不在巴勒斯坦女孩 Hind Rajab 的车内。

paras.en: Ironically and unsurprisingly, Hamas has long been viewed as useful by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to maintain the argument that there are no moderate Palestinian partners with whom to negotiate.
paras.zh: 具有讽刺意味且毫不奇怪的是，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡长期以来一直认为哈马斯有助于维持“没有温和的巴勒斯坦伙伴可以与之谈判”的论点。

paras.en: This strategy aligns closely with the 2017 Subjugation Plan—officially titled “Israel’s Decisive Plan”—a political and ideological framework presented by Israeli far-right politician Bezalel Smotrich in 2017, which explicitly advocated for disregarding Palestinian national aspirations.
paras.zh: 这一战略与 2017 年征服计划（官方名称为“以色列的决定性计划”）密切相关，该计划是以色列极右翼政治家贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇在 2017 年提出的政治和意识形态框架，明确主张无视巴勒斯坦民族愿望。

paras.en: This refusal to address the structural roots has frozen the contemporary diplomatic landscape. The Israeli unwillingness to engage in dialogue with Palestinian interlocutors contrasts sharply with the pragmatic realism historically articulated by Israeli General Moshe Dayan, who famously observed that peacemaking requires negotiating with enemies rather than friends.
paras.zh: 这种拒绝解决结构性根源的做法冻结了当代外交格局。以色列不愿与巴勒斯坦对话者进行对话，这与以色列将军摩西·达扬历史上所阐述的务实现实主义形成鲜明对比，后者有一句著名的言论，即缔造和平需要与敌人而不是朋友进行谈判。

paras.en: Today’s diplomatic landscape is defined by a deep imbalance in expectations. For many years, Palestinian factions have faced strict, non-negotiable prerequisites to attain international political legitimacy—such as the explicit recognition of Israel, the renunciation of violence and adherence to past accords.
paras.zh: 当今的外交格局是由期望的严重不平衡所决定的。多年来，巴勒斯坦各派别要想获得国际政治合法性，就面临着严格的、不容谈判的先决条件，例如明确承认以色列、放弃暴力以及遵守过去的协议。

paras.en: Conversely, no reciprocal demands have been placed on Israeli authorities, who face no requirement to recognise a sovereign Palestinian state, honour previous treaties, or renounce violence.
paras.zh: 相反，以色列当局没有提出任何互惠要求，以色列当局没有要求承认巴勒斯坦主权国家、遵守先前的条约或放弃暴力。

paras.en: In fact, Israel’s own political evolution is intertwined with factions that utilised political violence. Paramilitary organisations such as the Irgun, led by Menachem Begin, and the Lehi, led by Yitzhak Shamir, conducted operations that targeted civilians, yet both leaders eventually transitioned into mainstream politics and became prime ministers.
paras.zh: 事实上，以色列自身的政治演变与利用政治暴力的派系交织在一起。梅纳赫姆·贝京（Menachem Begin）领导的伊尔贡（Irgun）和伊扎克·沙米尔（Yitzhak Shamir）领导的李海（Lehi）等准军事组织开展了针对平民的行动，但两位领导人最终都转向主流政治并成为总理。

paras.en: This power imbalance directly manifests as a diplomatic asymmetry also in recent ceasefire negotiations, which remain deadlocked by Israel’s demand for the complete disarmament of Hamas. By establishing the eradication of the group’s military capabilities as a precondition for a permanent truce, Israel’s leadership sets a political threshold that effectively forecloses a negotiated settlement.
paras.zh: 这种权力不平衡直接表现为外交不对称，最近的停火谈判也因以色列要求哈马斯彻底解除武装而陷入僵局。通过将消灭该组织的军事能力作为永久停战的先决条件，以色列领导层设置了一个政治门槛，有效地阻止了谈判解决的可能性。

paras.en: This allows the Israeli government to perpetuate a status quo that yields significant strategic, territorial and political dividends.
paras.zh: 这使得以色列政府能够维持现状，从而产生重大的战略、领土和政治红利。

paras.en: Ultimately, doing away with Hamas will not do away with the Palestinian demand for freedom, nor will it satisfy Israel’s and Palestine’s legitimate right to security. The conflict did not begin with the rise of a militant faction and it will never end until all involved parties finally realise that, as Peruvian Indigenous jurist Dionisio Inca Yupanqui warned two centuries ago, “a nation that oppresses another ultimately forges its own chains”.
paras.zh: 最终，消灭哈马斯并不能消除巴勒斯坦人对自由的要求，也不能满足以色列和巴勒斯坦的合法安全权利。这场冲突并不是随着一个好战派系的崛起而开始的，除非所有相关方最终意识到，正如秘鲁土著法学家迪奥尼西奥·因卡·尤潘基在两个世纪前警告的那样，“一个压迫另一个国家的国家最终会打造自己的锁链”，否则冲突永远不会结束。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Hurricane Isaias leaves two dead and 800,000 without power in US Southeast

paras.en: Hurricane Isaias, the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season, has killed two people and left hundreds of thousands of customers without power across the southeastern United States.
paras.zh: 伊萨亚斯飓风是 2026 年大西洋季节的第一场飓风，已造成美国东南部地区两人死亡，数十万客户断电。

paras.en: The storm made landfall near Destin, Florida, on Friday evening as a Category 2 hurricane before weakening as it moved inland through Alabama overnight.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，这场风暴以2级飓风的形式在佛罗里达州德斯坦附近登陆，随后在夜间穿过阿拉巴马州向内陆移动，强度减弱。

paras.en: One person died in Birmingham, Alabama, when a tree fell on a house overnight, according to local emergency officials. A second person was killed in Escambia County, Florida, after a tree fell during the storm, according to local authorities.
paras.zh: 据当地紧急官员称，阿拉巴马州伯明翰市一棵树在一夜之间倒下砸在一座房屋上，造成一人死亡。据地方当局称，佛罗里达州埃斯坎比亚县有一棵树在风暴中倒下，造成第二人死亡。

paras.en: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said on Saturday that state officials had not confirmed any storm-related fatalities, including the report from Escambia County.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯周六表示，州官员尚未证实任何与风暴相关的死亡事件，包括埃斯坎比亚县的报告。

paras.en: Isaias hit land with sustained winds of 169km/h (105mph), bringing powerful gusts and heavy rain to the Florida Panhandle. By Saturday morning, the storm had weakened to a post-tropical cyclone with wind speeds of about 55km/h (35mph).
paras.zh: 伊萨亚斯以 169 公里/小时（105 英里/小时）的持续风速登陆，给佛罗里达狭长地带带来了强阵风和大雨。到周六早上，风暴已减弱为后热带气旋，风速约为 55 公里/小时（35 英里/小时）。

paras.en: More than 900,000 electricity customers in Florida, Alabama and Georgia were without power early Saturday morning. That number has since gone down to under 800,000, according to PowerOutage.us.
paras.zh: 周六凌晨，佛罗里达州、阿拉巴马州和佐治亚州超过 90 万电力用户停电。据 PowerOutage.us 称，此后这个数字已降至 800,000 以下。

paras.en: Fallen trees and downed power lines caused widespread disruption, while flooding forced road closures in parts of southern Alabama, including Houston County. Alabama Governor Kay Ivey said on Saturday morning that her team was concerned about “strong winds, heavy rain and possible spinoff tornadoes”.
paras.zh: 倒下的树木和倒塌的电线造成了大范围的破坏，洪水迫使包括休斯顿县在内的阿拉巴马州南部部分地区道路封闭。阿拉巴马州州长凯·艾维周六上午表示，她的团队担心“强风、大雨和可能引发的龙卷风”。

paras.en: Local officials in Pensacola, Florida reported strong winds that damaged an airport and tore the roof off a hotel. Trees and power lines also came down across the city, leaving some residents without electricity and roads blocked.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州彭萨科拉当地官员报告称，强风损坏了机场并掀掉了一家酒店的屋顶。整个城市的树木和电线也被倒塌，导致一些居民断电，道路被堵塞。

paras.en: Despite the storm’s weakening, officials warned that dangerous conditions could persist. Heavy rainfall threatened flash flooding across parts of the Southeast.
paras.zh: 尽管风暴减弱，但官员警告称，危险情况可能持续存在。强降雨威胁东南部部分地区发生山洪。

paras.en: “The flooding story is not over,” DeSantis said on Saturday, warning that saturated ground and continued rainfall could cause dangerous flooding a day or two after the storm passed. He said state search and rescue resources would remain available in case rapidly rising waters required emergency rescues.
paras.zh: 德桑蒂斯周六表示：“洪水的故事还没有结束。”他警告说，暴风雨过去一两天后，饱和的地面和持续的降雨可能会导致危险的洪水。他说，如果海平面迅速上升，需要紧急救援，州搜救资源将仍然可用。

paras.en: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier also warned residents to be alert for contractors seeking to exploit storm victims as homeowners begin repairing damaged properties.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州总检察长詹姆斯·尤斯迈尔还警告居民，在房主开始修复受损房产时，要警惕那些试图利用风暴受害者的承包商。

articles.title: Eritrea urges UN to intervene in standoff with Ethiopia

paras.en: Eritrea has asked the United Nations to take “deterrent measures” after what it called Ethiopia’s “declaration of war” in the conflict over the Tigray region.
paras.zh: 在埃塞俄比亚在提格雷地区冲突中“宣战”后，厄立特里亚要求联合国采取“威慑措施”。

paras.en: Eritrea’s request comes a day after Addis Ababa, in a letter to the Security Council, accused Asmara of launching an “all-out invasion”, saying Eritrean troops had advanced up to 60 kilometres (37 miles) into Ethiopia’s Tigray.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚提出请求的前一天，亚的斯亚贝巴在致安理会的一封信中指责阿斯马拉发动“全面入侵”，称厄立特里亚军队已向埃塞俄比亚提格雷推进了60公里（37英里）。

paras.en: In a separate letter to the council on Saturday, Eritrean Foreign Minister Osman Saleh said the claims of an Eritrean incursion were part of an Ethiopian plan to justify a war of aggression and urged the UN to intervene, invoking Chapter VII of the UN Charter, which allows measures from sanctions to military action.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚外交部长奥斯曼·萨利赫在周六致安理会的另一封信中表示，厄立特里亚入侵的说法是埃塞俄比亚为侵略战争辩护的计划的一部分，并敦促联合国援引《联合国宪章》第七章进行干预，该章允许采取从制裁到军事行动等措施。

paras.en: The neighbouring countries have accused each other of starting a war over Tigray, where Ethiopia says Eritrea is backing rebels.
paras.zh: 邻国互相指责对方在提格雷发动战争，埃塞俄比亚称厄立特里亚支持该地区的叛乱分子。

paras.en: An alliance of seven armed groups launched attacks against federal Ethiopian forces in the northern region last month, as they attempt to overthrow Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government.
paras.zh: 上个月，七个武装团体组成的联盟在北部地区对埃塞俄比亚联邦军队发动袭击，试图推翻总理阿比·艾哈迈德政府。

paras.en: Eritrean forces have since reportedly intruded into Ethiopian territory, with Addis Ababa accusing Asmara of backing the rebel Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF).
paras.zh: 据报道，厄立特里亚军队此后入侵埃塞俄比亚领土，亚的斯亚贝巴指责阿斯马拉支持叛军提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）。

paras.en: The Ethiopian army pushed TPLF rebels back this week and seized the region’s capital, Mekelle. It also said it launched drone strikes against Eritrean troops in the region.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚军队本周击退了特格雷人民解放阵线叛军，并占领了该地区首府默克莱。它还表示，它对该地区的厄立特里亚军队发动了无人机袭击。

paras.en: “Eritrea requests the UN Security Council to forcefully condemn Ethiopia’s deplorable declaration of war against Eritrea … and take the requisite deterrent measures,” Eritrea’s Saleh said in the letter on Saturday.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚总统萨利赫在周六的信中表示：“厄立特里亚请求联合国安理会强烈谴责埃塞俄比亚对厄立特里亚宣战的可悲行为……并采取必要的威慑措施。”

paras.en: He said Ethiopia’s action would cause “huge devastation to the peoples of both countries and destabilise the whole region”.
paras.zh: 他表示，埃塞俄比亚的行动将“给两国人民造成巨大破坏，并破坏整个地区的稳定”。

paras.en: Ethiopian Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos on Friday accused Eritrea of “a blatant act of aggression that engages Ethiopia’s inherent right to self-defence”.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚外交部长吉迪恩·蒂莫特沃斯周五指责厄立特里亚“公然进行侵略行为，侵犯了埃塞俄比亚固有的自卫权”。

paras.en: Timothewos invoked Ethiopia’s right to self-defence under Article 51 of the UN Charter, but he did not specify what measures the country was taking.
paras.zh: 蒂莫特沃斯援引了《联合国宪章》第五十一条规定的埃塞俄比亚自卫权，但他没有具体说明该国正在采取哪些措施。

paras.en: Faisal Roble, a Horn of Africa specialist, believes both sides are “preparing for the last phase of an open conflict”.
paras.zh: 非洲之角专家费萨尔·罗布尔认为，双方都在“为公开冲突的最后阶段做准备”。

paras.en: “There is really no doubt that both of them are inching towards an open conflict,” he told Al Jazeera from the Kenyan capital, Nairobi.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，他们两人都在慢慢走向公开冲突，”他在肯尼亚首都内罗毕告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “Whatever they write to the United Nations, it is just posturing and making sure that they have some sort of international support on their side,” the analyst added.
paras.zh: 这位分析师补充道：“无论他们向联合国写什么，都只是摆出姿态，确保他们得到某种国际支持。”

paras.en: In his letter, Saleh called Ethiopia’s actions “deceitful attempts to rationalise its brazen acts of war”, claiming that they were “hollow in substance”.
paras.zh: 萨利赫在信中称埃塞俄比亚的行为是“为其无耻的战争行为合理化的欺骗性尝试”，并声称这些行为“实质上是空洞的”。

paras.en: Eritrean Information Minister Yemane Gebremeskel accused Ethiopia on Friday of pursuing aggression against Eritrea through its demands for sovereign access to the Red Sea. Writing on X, he did not explicitly confirm or deny the reported troop crossings.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚新闻部长耶马内·格布雷梅斯克尔周五指责埃塞俄比亚通过要求获得红海主权来对厄立特里亚进行侵略。他在《X》上撰文，没有明确证实或否认有关部队越境的报道。

paras.en: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy reiterated on Monday that Ethiopia must have access to the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚总理阿比周一重申，埃塞俄比亚必须拥有通往红海的通道。

paras.en: Eritrea gained independence from Ethiopia in 1993, and they fought a deadly border war from 1998 to 2000.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚于1993年从埃塞俄比亚独立，两国在1998年至2000年间爆发了一场致命的边境战争。

paras.en: Relations improved after Abiy came to power in 2018, but have soured again in recent years.
paras.zh: 2018 年阿比上台后，两国关系有所改善，但近年来再次恶化。

paras.en: Landlocked Ethiopia has repeatedly insisted that it has a right to direct sea access, which Eritrea interprets as a threat to invade and seize its port at Assab.
paras.zh: 内陆埃塞俄比亚一再坚称其有权直接出海，厄立特里亚将其解释为入侵和夺取其阿萨布港口的威胁。

paras.en: TPLF fighters battled Ethiopian government forces, then backed by Eritrea, in a devastating 2020-2022 war.
paras.zh: TPLF 战士在 2020 年至 2022 年的一场毁灭性战争中与当时得到厄立特里亚支持的埃塞俄比亚政府军作战。

articles.title: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
paras.zh: 随着对莫迪和选举负责人的愤怒加剧，印度镇压青年抗议活动

paras.en: NEW DELHI — Indian authorities deployed a sweeping security crackdown across New Delhi and detained thousands of protesters Saturday as India's youth "Cockroach" movement sought to intensify a nationwide campaign against a contentious voter list revision that has fueled anger at Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Hindu nationalist government and election authorities.
paras.zh: 新德里——周六，印度当局在新德里实施了全面的安全镇压，并拘留了数千名抗议者，因为印度青年“蟑螂”运动试图加强全国范围内的运动，反对有争议的选民名单修改，这一修改激起了人们对总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的印度教民族主义政府和选举当局的愤怒。

paras.en: Police moved to break up the demonstration before it could begin, intercepting demonstrators on their way to Jantar Mantar, the designated protest site in the heart of India's capital, chasing off some and detaining many others. Some were dragged away before being bundled into police vehicles and taken to temporary detention centers. Several "Cockroach" movement leaders, opposition lawmakers and student activists were detained before arriving, effectively crippling the protest ahead of its start.
paras.zh: 警方在示威活动开始前采取行动，在前往印度首都市中心指定抗议地点简塔·曼塔天文台的途中拦截示威者，赶走了一些人，并拘留了许多人。一些人被拖走，然后被塞进警车并送往临时拘留中心。几名“蟑螂”运动领导人、反对派议员和学生活动人士在抵达之前被拘留，有效地在抗议活动开始之前削弱了抗议活动的力量。

paras.en: The crackdown extended beyond the protest venue, with police stopping buses, cars and other vehicles at checkpoints on routes into the capital and searching for demonstrators. Jantar Mantar was barricaded, while anti-riot vehicles equipped with tear gas launchers were stationed along key routes. Restrictions on mobile internet and access to parts of the city added to the hurdles facing protesters.
paras.zh: 镇压行动超出了抗议场地范围，警方在通往首都的检查站拦截了公共汽车、汽车和其他车辆，并搜寻示威者。简塔·曼塔天文台被设置了路障，而配备催泪瓦斯发射器的防暴车则驻扎在主要路线上。对移动互联网和进入城市部分地区的限制增加了抗议者面临的障碍。

paras.en: Police said Friday they had denied permission for the protest because the request was submitted late.
paras.zh: 警方周五表示，他们已拒绝批准抗议活动，因为请求提交较晚。

paras.en: Sambit Patra, a spokesperson for Modi's party, dismissed the demonstrators as "anarchic elements."
paras.zh: 莫迪政党发言人桑比特·帕特拉 (Sambit Patra) 将示威者斥为“无政府分子”。

paras.en: "Their flop show has been completely demolished," Patra said.
paras.zh: “他们的失败表演已经被彻底摧毁，”帕特拉说。

paras.en: The scale of the crackdown underscored the authorities' determination to disrupt a fast-growing protest campaign that has mobilized thousands of young people, drawn opposition support and intensified scrutiny of Modi. The protests also come at a politically sensitive time, months after demonstrations led by the "Cockroach" movement over exam paper leaks forced Modi's education minister to resign in July.
paras.zh: 镇压的规模凸显了当局破坏快速增长的抗议活动的决心，该活动动员了数千名年轻人，吸引了反对派的支持，并加强了对莫迪的审查。这次抗议活动也是在政治敏感时期发生的，几个月前，“蟑螂”运动因试卷泄露引发的示威活动迫使莫迪的教育部长于 7 月辞职。

paras.en: Police detain leaders and tighten grip around protest site
paras.zh: 警方拘留领导人并加强对抗议现场的控制

paras.en: Leaders of the "Cockroach" movement Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, who were expected to be at the forefront of the protest, were detained after arriving at Delhi airport from Mumbai on Saturday. A video shared by the "Cockroach Janta Party" on X showed police boarding the aircraft and detaining the three men.
paras.zh: “蟑螂”运动领导人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke)、绍拉夫·达斯 (Saurav Das) 和阿舒托什·兰卡 (Ashutosh Ranka) 预计将成为抗议活动的最前线，但周六从孟买抵达德里机场后被捕。 “蟑螂党”在 X 上分享的一段视频显示，警察登上飞机并拘留了三名男子。

paras.en: "The pre-planned interception by Delhi Police aims to cripple the leadership of today's peaceful demonstrations before they even reach the protest site," the movement said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该运动在一份声明中表示：“德里警方预先计划的拦截旨在削弱今天和平示威活动的领导层，甚至在他们到达抗议地点之前。”

paras.en: Loudspeakers around the protest site warned that gatherings of five or more people were banned in parts of New Delhi, as authorities imposed sweeping security restrictions rarely seen in the capital. Journalists also faced restrictions in some areas, with police briefly detaining some of them.
paras.zh: 抗议地点周围的扩音器警告说，新德里部分地区禁止五人或五人以上的集会，因为当局实施了首都罕见的全面安全限制。记者在某些地区也面临限制，警方短暂拘留了其中一些人。

paras.en: Some protesters nevertheless broke through police cordons, chanting slogans against Modi and election authorities before being detained.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，一些抗议者还是冲破了警方的警戒线，在被拘留之前高呼反对莫迪和选举当局的口号。

paras.en: "We are a democracy, yet peaceful protests are being crushed by force. Shouldn't we fight for our rights," said Tanya Negi, a college student who traveled from Mumbai with two friends and arrived early Saturday. "Why is Modi afraid of India's young people?"
paras.zh: “我们是一个民主国家，但和平抗议正在被武力镇压。我们难道不应该为自己的权利而战吗？”与两个朋友从孟买出发并于周六早些时候抵达的大学生坦尼娅·内吉(Tanya Negi)说。 “莫迪为什么害怕印度年轻人？”

paras.en: The police response marked an extraordinary show of force in a capital where Modi's government has repeatedly sought to contain public dissent in the past. Under Modi, authorities have often used arrests and restrictions on public gatherings to contain demonstrations, raising questions about the space for protests in the world's largest democracy.
paras.zh: 警方的反应标志着首都首都的非同寻常的武力展示，莫迪政府过去曾多次试图遏制公众异议。在莫迪的领导下，当局经常利用逮捕和限制公众集会的方式来遏制示威活动，引发人们对这个世界上最大民主国家的抗议空间的质疑。

paras.en: The latest crackdown renewed criticism from opposition leaders, who accused the government of curbing dissent.
paras.zh: 最新的镇压行动再次遭到反对派领导人的批评，他们指责政府压制异见。

paras.en: "Is there a democracy in this country? A total siege over the city. Citizens are being driven out," opposition lawmaker John Brittas told The Associated Press. Brittas was later detained by police.
paras.zh: “这个国家有民主吗？对这座城市的全面围困。公民被赶出，”反对派议员约翰·布里塔斯告诉美联社。布里塔斯后来被警方拘留。

paras.en: India's voter list dispute raises election fairness concerns
paras.zh: 印度选民名单争议引发选举公平性担忧

paras.en: The protests center on India's Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision, which the opposition says has disenfranchised millions of eligible voters. Protesters demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and an end to the change, which has removed more than 130 million names from voter lists so far.
paras.zh: 抗议活动的焦点是印度选举委员会的特别密集修订，反对派称该修订剥夺了数百万合格选民的选举权。抗议者要求首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔(Gyanesh Kumar)辞职并结束这一变革，迄今为止，这一变革已从选民名单中删除了超过1.3亿人的名字。

paras.en: The Election Commission and the government reject allegations of voter manipulation, saying the revision is intended to eliminate duplicate and ineligible entries.
paras.zh: 选举委员会和政府否认操纵选民的指控，称修订旨在消除重复和不合格的条目。

paras.en: The dispute has become a rallying point for opposition parties seeking to challenge Modi's Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party.
paras.zh: 这场争端已成为寻求挑战莫迪领导的印度教民族主义印度人民党的反对党的集结点。

paras.en: Saturday's planned demonstration follows days of protests in the Indian capital where opposition lawmakers also stepped up their campaign, with Congress party leader Rahul Gandhi being briefly detained by police.
paras.zh: 周六计划举行的示威活动是在印度首都举行了数天的抗议活动之后举行的，反对派议员也加大了竞选力度，国大党领导人拉胡尔·甘地被警方短暂拘留。

paras.en: Gandhi and other opposition leaders have accused the commission of conducting the voter revision in a way that benefits Modi's party. The opposition says voters more likely to support its parties have been disproportionately affected by the removals, while supporters of the BJP have been spared or added to the lists.
paras.zh: 甘地和其他反对派领导人指责该委员会以有利于莫迪政党的方式进行选民修改。反对派表示，更有可能支持其政党的选民受到了不成比例的影响，而印度人民党的支持者则幸免于难或被添加到名单中。

paras.en: The commission and the government deny the allegations.
paras.zh: 该委员会和政府否认这些指控。

paras.en: India's youth movement broadens campaign against Modi
paras.zh: 印度青年运动扩大反对莫迪的运动

paras.en: For the "Cockroach" movement, the voter list dispute offers an opportunity to broaden its campaign.
paras.zh: 对于“蟑螂”运动来说，选民名单之争提供了扩大其竞选范围的机会。

paras.en: The movement began online in May and gained prominence through demonstrations, sit-ins and hunger strikes over alleged exam paper leaks. Those protests culminated in the resignation of Modi's education minister in July, a rare political setback for a prime minister who has maintained a firm hold on national power for more than 12 years.
paras.zh: 该运动于五月在网上开始，并通过示威、静坐和因涉嫌泄露试卷而进行的绝食而获得关注。这些抗议活动最终导致莫迪教育部长于 7 月辞职，这对于一位牢牢掌握国家权力 12 年多的总理来说是罕见的政治挫折。

paras.en: For Modi, the protests pose a challenge midway through his third term, though their political impact remains unclear. National elections are not due until 2029, but state elections next year in BJP-ruled Uttar Pradesh, India's most populous state, and Gujarat, Modi's home state, will test the party's standing.
paras.zh: 对于莫迪来说，抗议活动在他第三任期中期构成了挑战，尽管其政治影响尚不清楚。全国选举要到 2029 年才会举行，但明年在印度人口最多的印度人民党统治的北方邦和莫迪的家乡古吉拉特邦举行的州选举将考验该党的地位。

articles.title: Photos: What a year of ceasefire in Gaza looks like
articles.author: Anas Baba

paras.en: NPR's Anas Baba captures one year of ceasefire in Gaza : The Picture ShowIt has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.
paras.zh: NPR 的阿纳斯·巴巴 (Anas Baba) 捕捉加沙停火一年：图片展示 自哈马斯释放剩余的以色列人质以及特朗普总统承诺结束战争以来已经一年了，但巴勒斯坦人表示，过去 12 个月的停火只是名义上的。

paras.en: A Palestinian mother mourns her son, who was killed in an Israeli airstrike just over a month into the ceasefire, at Al-Shifa Hospital, in Gaza City, on Nov. 20, 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月 20 日，一名巴勒斯坦母亲在加沙市的希法医院哀悼她的儿子，她的儿子在停火仅一个多月后就在以色列空袭中丧生。

paras.en: Editor's note: This story contains graphic images of violence and death.
paras.zh: 编者注：这个故事包含暴力和死亡的生动图像。

paras.en: GAZA STRIP — President Donald Trump promised an end to Israel's war in Gaza after he pushed Israel to agree to a ceasefire and Hamas to release remaining Israeli hostages. The deal came into effect on Oct. 10, 2025.
paras.zh: 加沙地带——唐纳德·特朗普总统在敦促以色列同意停火并敦促哈马斯释放剩余的以色列人质后，承诺结束以色列在加沙的战争。该交易于2025年10月10日生效。

paras.en: A year later, however, there's still no international peacekeeping force in Gaza as promised and no reconstruction. Instead, Israel's military has expanded its control to roughly 70% of Gaza, squeezing more than 2 million Palestinians near the sea's edge.
paras.zh: 然而一年后，加沙仍然没有按照承诺派驻国际维和部队，也没有进行重建工作。相反，以色列军方已将其控制范围扩大到约 70% 的加沙地带，将超过 200 万巴勒斯坦人挤在海边。

paras.en: Israel has also continued targeting Hamas throughout the ceasefire. Those attacks have killed more than 1,400 Palestinians this past year, nearly 500 of them women and children, according to Gaza's Health Ministry.
paras.zh: 以色列还在停火期间继续针对哈马斯。据加沙卫生部称，去年这些袭击已造成 1,400 多名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中近 500 名妇女和儿童。

paras.en: Although the bombings have not stopped, they have slowed down during the ceasefire.
paras.zh: 虽然爆炸事件并未停止，但在停火期间已经放缓了速度。

paras.en: That has given people in Gaza a chance to recover from what U.N.-backed experts declared was a famine in the north of the territory last year. More food is now entering, reversing starvation across Gaza.
paras.zh: 这使加沙人民有机会从联合国支持的专家去年宣布的该领土北部的饥荒中恢复过来。更多食物正在进入，扭转了加沙各地的饥饿局面。

paras.en: NPR's reporter in Gaza, Anas Baba, has been capturing moments of respite and continuous grief over the past 12 months of the ceasefire. Below are a selection of his photos.
paras.zh: NPR 驻加沙记者阿纳斯·巴巴 (Anas Baba) 一直在捕捉过去 12 个月停火期间的喘息时刻和持续的悲伤时刻。以下是他的照片精选。

paras.en: Palestinians returned to the ruins of Gaza City after Israeli forces withdrew and ended their ground operation on the first day of the ceasefire, on Oct. 10, 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月 10 日，停火第一天，以色列军队撤出并结束地面行动后，巴勒斯坦人返回加沙城废墟。

paras.en: In Khan Younis, families greet Palestinian prisoners who were freed in exchange for Israeli hostages on Oct. 13, 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月 13 日，在汗尤尼斯，家人迎接以以色列人质换取释放的巴勒斯坦囚犯。

paras.en: At Al-Shifa Hospital on Oct. 23, 2025, Joud Al-Angar, 12, and his younger cousin are covered in dime-sized scabs after they were wounded by a piece of shrapnel from an Israeli munition. They found it in the rubble and thought it was coal they could use to help their family cook dinner.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月 23 日，在 Al-Shifa 医院，12 岁的 Joud Al-Angar 和他的表弟被以色列弹药的弹片击伤，浑身都是硬币大小的痂。他们在废墟中发现了它，并认为这是可以用来帮助家人做饭的煤炭。

paras.en: The bodies of multiple people, including children, are covered in shrouds at a morgue at Al-Shifa Hospital on Nov. 20, 2025, after Israeli airstrikes targeted homes and tents.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月 20 日，以色列对房屋和帐篷进行空袭后，希法医院太平间里包括儿童在内的多人尸体被裹尸布覆盖。

paras.en: People inspect the aftermath of a deadly Israeli airstrike that destroyed a home in Gaza City six weeks into the ceasefire on Nov. 20, 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月 20 日停火六周后，人们在检查以色列致命空袭的后果，这场空袭摧毁了加沙城的一所房屋。

paras.en: A father and his son wade through flooded streets in Gaza City after picking up humanitarian aid on Nov. 25, 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月 25 日，一对父子在领取人道主义援助物资后涉水穿过加沙城被洪水淹没的街道。

paras.en: Children wear virtual reality headsets as part of a TechMed Gaza initiative that aims to help provide children with psychosocial support for trauma, in Al-Zuweida, Gaza, on Dec. 10, 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月 10 日，加沙 Al-Zuweida，儿童佩戴虚拟现实耳机，这是 TechMed Gaza 计划的一部分，该计划旨在帮助为儿童提供针对创伤的社会心理支持。

paras.en: Saqer Al-Ankah holds his dying 10-year-old granddaughter, Bayan, in his arms at Baptist Hospital in Gaza City on Dec. 10, 2025, after she was shot in her tent by Israeli troops who occupy northeast Gaza.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月 10 日，在加沙城浸信会医院，Saqer Al-Ankah 怀里抱着垂死的 10 岁孙女巴扬 (Bayan)，此前她在帐篷里被占领加沙东北部的以色列军队开枪射杀。

paras.en: Makeshift tents like these in Gaza City on Dec. 11, 2025, offer little protection from the winter cold, but the U.N. says roughly 1.5 million people have only these for shelter after Israeli airstrikes destroyed nearly all the buildings in the war.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月 11 日，加沙城的这些临时帐篷几乎无法抵御冬季寒冷，但联合国表示，在以色列空袭摧毁了战争中几乎所有建筑物后，大约 150 万人只有这些帐篷可以避难。

paras.en: Raed el-Ghazawi and his children stand in a tent in Gaza City on Dec. 11, 2025. The family of five says the tent is freezing cold and damp from winter rainstorms.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月 11 日，拉德·加扎维 (Raed el-Ghazawi) 和他的孩子们站在加沙城的一个帐篷里。这个五口之家表示，由于冬季暴雨，帐篷又冷又湿。

paras.en: On Dec. 17, 2025, Palestinian Christian children decorate a Christmas tree inside the Holy Family Church in Gaza City for the first time since the beginning of the war.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月 17 日，巴勒斯坦基督教儿童在加沙城圣家堂内装饰圣诞树，这是自战争开始以来的首次。

paras.en: Fresh produce returns to Gaza City's streets on Dec. 23, 2025, after U.N.-backed experts declared a famine there amid Israeli restrictions on aid during the war.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月 23 日，由于以色列在战争期间限制援助，联合国支持的专家宣布加沙城发生饥荒，新鲜农产品于 2025 年 12 月 23 日重返加沙城街道。

paras.en: Patients sit in a clinic run by Doctors Without Borders in Gaza City on Dec. 31, 2025, a day before Israel banned more than 40 international aid organizations from bringing in staff or aid to Gaza.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月 31 日，病人坐在加沙城无国界医生组织经营的诊所里，就在前一天，以色列禁止 40 多个国际援助组织向加沙引进工作人员或提供援助。

paras.en: Palestinian female artists gather at the beach in Gaza City for the first time since the war began to paint as a form of therapy, on Feb. 12, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 12 日，自战争开始以绘画作为一种治疗形式以来，巴勒斯坦女艺术家首次聚集在加沙城的海滩。

paras.en: Palestinian rescue workers begin the work of retrieving corpses from under the rubble of homes bombed by Israel during the war in Beit Lahia, Gaza, on Feb. 16, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 16 日，巴勒斯坦救援人员开始在加沙拜特拉希亚战争期间从被以色列轰炸的房屋废墟下打捞尸体。

paras.en: The skeleton of Shawqi Abu Naser, 60, is retrieved from under the rubble on Feb. 16, 2026, more than a year after an Israeli airstrike killed 132 people from the same family in Beit Lahia.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 16 日，60 岁的肖奇·阿布·纳赛尔 (Shawqi Abu Naser) 的遗骸被从废墟下打捞出来，一年多前，以色列的一次空袭导致拜特拉希亚同一家庭的 132 人死亡。

paras.en: A mother from the Abu Nasr family sits by her son's body in Beit Lahia on Feb. 17, 2026. The body was retrieved from under the rubble more than a year after 132 people were killed in a single Israeli airstrike on the family home.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 17 日，拜特拉希亚，阿布·纳斯尔 (Abu Nasr) 一家的一位母亲坐在儿子的尸体旁。一年多前，以色列对阿布·纳斯尔家的一次空袭造成 132 人死亡，尸体从废墟下被打捞出来。

paras.en: Palestinians gather in an open space in Gaza City for early morning prayers that mark the end of the Muslim holy month of Ramadan on March 20, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月 20 日，巴勒斯坦人聚集在加沙城的一个空地上进行清晨祈祷，标志着穆斯林斋月的结束。

paras.en: A child smiles next to a man dressed as a clown on the first day of Eid al-Fitr, celebrations that mark the end of Ramadan fasting, in Gaza City on March 20, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月 20 日，加沙城，开斋节第一天，标志着斋月禁食结束的庆祝活动，一名儿童在一名打扮成小丑的男子旁边微笑。

paras.en: A Palestinian boy shakes hands with Hamas militants on the first day of Eid al-Fitr, following the end of the Muslim holy month of Ramadan, in Gaza City on March 20, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月 20 日，在加沙城，穆斯林斋月结束后的开斋节第一天，一名巴勒斯坦男孩与哈马斯武装分子握手。

paras.en: Palestinians stand next to boxes of U.N. food aid in an area that aid groups need Israeli permission to enter in Jabalia, Gaza, on April 18, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 18 日，加沙贾巴利亚，巴勒斯坦人站在联合国粮食援助箱旁边，援助组织需要获得以色列许可才能进入该地区。

paras.en: A yellow block placed by Israeli forces marks the expanding territory controlled by the military in Bureij, Gaza, on May 7, 2026. Palestinians are barred from entering the area.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 7 日，以色列军队在加沙布赖吉放置的黄色街区标志着军方控制的领土不断扩大。巴勒斯坦人被禁止进入该地区。

paras.en: Young Palestinian chess players gather at a coffee shop in Gaza City for the first tournament since the start of the war, on May 12, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 12 日，年轻的巴勒斯坦国际象棋棋手聚集在加沙城的一家咖啡店，参加战争爆发以来的首场比赛。

paras.en: A Palestinian child carries jugs of water as he passes by a mural of Spanish soccer star Lamine Yamal that is painted on the rubble of a home destroyed by Israeli airstrikes, in Al-Shati refugee camp, Gaza, on May 14, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 14 日，加沙沙蒂难民营，一名巴勒斯坦儿童提着水罐经过一幅西班牙足球明星拉明·亚马尔的壁画，这幅壁画画在被以色列空袭摧毁的房屋废墟上。

paras.en: A building burns after an Israeli airstrike killed Izz al-Din al-Haddad, the leader of the military wing of Hamas, his wife, his daughter and a neighbor in Gaza City on May 16, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 16 日，加沙城哈马斯军事组织领导人伊兹·丁·哈达德 (Izz al-Din al-Haddad) 及其妻子、女儿和邻居在以色列空袭中丧生，一栋建筑被烧毁。

paras.en: Children jump on a trampoline during the Eid holidays on May 31, 2026, in Beit Lahia, which the Israeli military had deemed an "orange zone." Aid organizations are restricted from entering the area.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 31 日开斋节期间，孩子们在拜特拉希亚的蹦床上跳跃，这里被以色列军方视为“橙色区域”。援助组织被限制进入该地区。

paras.en: A child looks into a burned car that was targeted in an Israeli airstrike on a busy street in Gaza City on June 22, 2026. A teenage girl who was going to find internet access to take her final exams was killed in the strike.
paras.zh: 2026 年 6 月 22 日，在加沙城一条繁忙的街道上，一名儿童正在查看一辆被以色列空袭袭击的被烧毁的汽车。一名准备上网参加期末考试的少女在空袭中丧生。

paras.en: A plume of smoke rises after an Israeli airstrike targeted a home in Gaza City nine months into the ceasefire on July 12, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 7 月 12 日，停火九个月后，以色列对加沙城的一处房屋发动空袭，升起滚滚浓烟。

paras.en: Thousands of displaced Palestinians gather under Egyptian flags amid the rubble in Gaza City for a public screening of Egypt's match against Argentina in the World Cup on July 7, 2026.
paras.zh: 数千名流离失所的巴勒斯坦人聚集在加沙城的废墟中，举着埃及国旗，公开观看 2026 年 7 月 7 日世界杯埃及对阵阿根廷的比赛。

paras.en: One-hundred corpses are wrapped in Palestinian flags in Gaza City on Aug. 4, 2026, after being retrieved from under the rubble of a building that was hit in an Israeli airstrike in October 2023.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月 4 日，加沙城有 100 具尸体被用巴勒斯坦国旗包裹，这些尸体是从 2023 年 10 月以色列空袭中被击中的一座建筑物废墟下打捞出来的。

paras.en: A Palestinian child whose brother was killed in an Israeli airstrike cries at the door of a morgue at Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City on Aug. 19, 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月 19 日，一名兄弟在以色列空袭中丧生的巴勒斯坦儿童在加沙城 Al-Shifa 医院太平间门口哭泣。

paras.en: Palestinian children form a chain for a global solidarity initiative called Swim With Gaza that raises money for swimming lessons in Khan Younis on Aug. 25, 2026.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦儿童组成了一个名为“与加沙一起游泳”的全球团结倡议链，该倡议为 2026 年 8 月 25 日在汗尤尼斯举办的游泳课程筹集资金。

paras.en: A child's toys are stained with blood in Gaza City on Sept. 1, 2026, following an Israeli operation to kidnap a Hamas security officer. His family was killed in Israeli airstrikes.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 1 日，以色列绑架一名哈马斯安全官员后，加沙城一名儿童的玩具沾满血迹。他的家人在以色列空袭中丧生。

articles.title: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
articles.author: Ruth Sherlock

paras.en: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
paras.zh: 美国和俄罗斯兜售柴油协议以缓解制裁并重新开放燃料流动

paras.en: Moscow and Washington tout a diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows, but few details leave questions on price impacts and U.S. policy, sparking anger from Ukraine and allies.
paras.zh: 莫斯科和华盛顿宣扬达成一项柴油协议，以缓解制裁并重新开放燃料流动，但几乎没有细节留下对价格影响和美国政策的疑问，引发了乌克兰及其盟友的愤怒。

paras.en: President Trump says the U.S. will begin to import Russian diesel to try to drive down gas prices before the midterm elections. The U.S. had banned Russian diesel to limit Russia's revenue amid the war in Ukraine. NPR's Russia correspondent Charles Maynes joins us from Moscow. Charles, thanks for being with us.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统表示，美国将开始进口俄罗斯柴油，试图在中期选举前压低汽油价格。在乌克兰战争期间，美国禁止进口俄罗斯柴油，以限制俄罗斯的收入。 NPR 俄罗斯记者查尔斯·梅恩斯从莫斯科加入我们。查尔斯，谢谢你和我们在一起。

paras.en: CHARLES MAYNES, BYLINE: Good morning, Scott.
paras.zh: 查尔斯·梅恩连线：早上好，斯科特。

paras.en: SIMON: And tell us, please, about the president's announcement. I gather it was on social media.
paras.zh: 西蒙：请告诉我们总统的声明。我猜这是在社交媒体上发生的。

paras.en: MAYNES: Yeah. That's right. Trump revealed the news on his Truth Social platform. He wrote that he'd had a highly successful discussion with President Vladimir Putin of Russia whereby Putin agreed to immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to the U.S. and global markets, with more to follow.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：是的。这是正确的。特朗普在他的“真相社交”平台上透露了这一消息。他写道，他与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了非常成功的讨论，普京同意立即向美国和全球市场供应超过 30 万吨柴油，随后还会供应更多柴油。

paras.en: Trump said this meant diesel prices for Americans and for the rest of the world would be coming down - in his words - in record numbers and fast. That was in all caps. And he said he did this with certain constituencies in mind, saying farmers, ranchers and truckers were his greatest priority. Those, of course, are some of the groups who have been unhappy about the rise in diesel prices and who Trump will need to turn out in the midterms if Republicans are going to hold the House, much less the Senate.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，这意味着美国和世界其他地区的柴油价格将以创纪录的速度下降——用他的话说。全部大写。他说，他这样做是考虑到了某些选民，农民、牧场主和卡车司机是他最优先考虑的对象。当然，这些人对柴油价格上涨感到不满，如果共和党想要控制众议院，特朗普就需要在中期选举中投票选出这些人，更不用说控制参议院了。

paras.en: SIMON: It is an election year. Politics might be driving U.S. economic policy abroad?
paras.zh: 西蒙：今年是选举年。政治可能正在推动美国的海外经济政策？

paras.en: MAYNES: That's right - at least for now. The U.S. formally placed sanctions on Russia - Russian diesel shortly after the Kremlin's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February of 2022. And it just took minutes after Trump's announcement for the Treasury Department to issue a six-month waiver to those trade restrictions.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：是的——至少现在是这样。 2022 年 2 月克里姆林宫全面入侵乌克兰后不久，美国正式对俄罗斯 - 俄罗斯柴油实施制裁。几分钟后，特朗普宣布财政部对这些贸易限制给予六个月的豁免。

paras.en: SIMON: Charles, how would a deal actually work?
paras.zh: 西蒙：查尔斯，交易实际上如何进行？

paras.en: MAYNES: Oddly enough, this requires Russia to first lift its own diesel export ban. The Kremlin put that restriction in place in response to gas shortages that have hit Russia over the summer due to sustained Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian energy facilities. That crisis has basically eased a bit. So this deal comes at a moment, really, when industry experts here were already calling for the lifting of this ban on exports to other parts of the world, saying Russia was basically losing out on profit. And this U.S. deal to lift sanctions certainly helps them do this - just quicker, maybe, than some thought.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：奇怪的是，这要求俄罗斯首先取消自己的柴油出口禁令。克里姆林宫实施这一限制是为了应对今年夏天由于乌克兰无人机对俄罗斯能源设施的持续袭击而造成俄罗斯天然气短缺。这场危机基本上已经缓解了一些。因此，这项协议达成之际，实际上，当这里的行业专家已经呼吁取消对世界其他地区的出口禁令时，称俄罗斯基本上正在损失利润。美国解除制裁的协议肯定有助于他们做到这一点 - 只是可能比一些人想象的更快。

paras.en: SIMON: And how are the leaders of Russia talking about the deal?
paras.zh: 西蒙：俄罗斯领导人如何谈论这笔交易？

paras.en: MAYNES: Well, the Kremlin issued a more general statement than Trump, saying it was ready to supply diesel to the U.S. and global markets, kind of full stop. But clearly, part of the story behind this deal is the warm relationship between Trump and Putin. A Kremlin adviser, Yuri Ushakov, later described to journalists the atmosphere of this call, saying Trump had wished Putin a happy birthday - Putin turned 74 this week and said, even, that neither side wanted to put down the phone despite taking a call for an hour and a half.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：克里姆林宫发表了比特朗普更笼统的声明，表示已准备好向美国和全球市场供应柴油，这算是一个句号。但显然，这笔交易背后的部分原因是特朗普和普京之间的友好关系。克里姆林宫顾问尤里·乌沙科夫后来向记者描述了这次通话的气氛，称特朗普祝普京生日快乐——普京本周满74岁了，他甚至表示，尽管接了一个半小时的电话，但双方都不想放下电话。

paras.en: MAYNES: Here's Ushakov saying he hoped Trump wouldn't mind if he quoted him, but that the U.S. president had told Putin he was ready to talk more today, more tonight or any day after. So these guys really seem to like each other.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：乌沙科夫表示，他希望特朗普不要介意他引用他的话，但美国总统已告诉普京，他准备在今天、今晚或以后的任何一天发表更多讲话。所以这些家伙看起来真的很喜欢对方。

paras.en: SIMON: And how much will importing Russian oil actually affect prices in the U.S.?
paras.zh: 西蒙：进口俄罗斯石油实际上会对美国的价格产生多大影响？

paras.en: MAYNES: Well, the Russian contribution to the global diesel needs in the short term isn't that much. And industry experts say, actually, it isn't likely to have the immediate impact that Trump says or is promising for diesel prices at the pump. How that impacts voters' decisions in November, of course, we'll have to see.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：嗯，短期内俄罗斯对全球柴油需求的贡献并不大。行业专家表示，实际上，这不太可能像特朗普所说或承诺的柴油价格那样产生立竿见影的影响。当然，这对十一月选民的决定有何影响，我们拭目以待。

paras.en: But the other interest here for Trump is Ukraine. You know, Trump has actually blamed Ukraine for driving up prices at the pump through its attacks on Russian energy facilities, even though most experts would say that while that may be a factor, the real cause has been Iran's blockage of the Strait of Hormuz. Be that as it may, Trump has been pressuring Ukraine to unilaterally halt its attacks on Russia to help with these gas prices, something Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has thus far refused to do without a reciprocal move by Moscow.
paras.zh: 但特朗普的另一个兴趣是乌克兰。你知道，特朗普实际上指责乌克兰通过袭击俄罗斯能源设施推高了油价，尽管大多数专家会说，虽然这可能是一个因素，但真正的原因是伊朗封锁霍尔木兹海峡。尽管如此，特朗普一直在向乌克兰施压，要求其单方面停止对俄罗斯的攻击，以帮助控制天然气价格，而乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基迄今为止拒绝在莫斯科采取互惠行动的情况下这样做。

paras.en: SIMON: How has President Zelenskyy reacted to news that Russia and the U.S. are striking this deal?
paras.zh: 西蒙：泽连斯基总统对俄罗斯和美国达成这项协议的消息有何反应？

paras.en: MAYNES: Well, he clearly doesn't like it. He said that the White House's decision prolongs the war by replenishing Russia's war chest. Here's Zelenskyy speaking in a voice message to reporters last night.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：嗯，他显然不喜欢这样。他说，白宫的决定通过补充俄罗斯的战争资金而延长了战争。这是泽伦斯基昨晚向记者发出的语音信息。

paras.en: PRESIDENT VOLODYMYR ZELENSKYY: (Speaking Ukrainian).
paras.zh: 总统沃洛德米尔·泽连斯基：（用乌克兰语）。

paras.en: MAYNES: So here Zelenskyy says the deal means more money for this war and more money to inflict suffering on Ukrainians, adding it only feeds Putin's ability to keep fighting. You know, and left unsaid, this deal gives Trump even more incentive to pressure Kyiv to halt its attacks on Russian energy, even as Putin continues his attacks on Ukrainian civilian infrastructure - you know, on homes, on heating, electrical power stations - as we enter into the winter months with Ukraine's air defenses depleted.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：泽伦斯基在这里表示，这项协议意味着为这场战争提供更多资金，也为给乌克兰人民带来更多资金，并补充说这只会增强普京继续战斗的能力。你知道，而且没有说出来，这项协议让特朗普更有动力向基辅施压，要求其停止对俄罗斯能源的攻击，尽管普京继续攻击乌克兰民用基础设施——你知道，攻击房屋、供暖、发电站——因为我们进入了乌克兰防空系统耗尽的冬季。

paras.en: SIMON: NPR's Russia correspondent Charles Maynes. Thanks so much.
paras.zh: 西蒙：美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 俄罗斯记者查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes)。非常感谢。
