articles.title: Poland: Lifeline for Ukrainian refugees confronts donor fatigue and online abuse as anti-Ukrainian sentiment grows

paras.en: Hours after Vladimir Putin announced his "special military operation" in Ukraine on February 24, 2022, Russian troops began attacking Kyiv's Antonov Airport close to the home of Nastya Podorozhnya's family.
paras.zh: 2022 年 2 月 24 日，弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 宣布在乌克兰实施“特别军事行动”数小时后，俄罗斯军队开始袭击靠近娜斯佳·波多罗日尼亚 (Nastya Podorozhnya) 家人的基辅安东诺夫机场。

paras.en: Nastya was 24 at the time and living in Krakow in neighboring Poland, having recently graduated from the city's Jagiellonian University.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚当时 24 岁，住在邻国波兰的克拉科夫，最近刚从该市的雅盖隆大学毕业。

paras.en: Alarmed by the reports coming out of Ukraine and fearful of what was to come, Nastya rushed back to Ukraine two days before the invasion to be with her family and help her sister and her three children cross the border to safety in Poland.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚对来自乌克兰的报道感到震惊，并对即将发生的事情感到恐惧，在入侵前两天赶回乌克兰与家人团聚，帮助她的妹妹和三个孩子越过边境到达波兰的安全地带。

paras.en: Nastya realized she could use her experience of living in Poland — how to get a doctor's appointment or simply buy a tram ticket — to help the many women and children arriving in the country from Ukraine.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚意识到她可以利用自己在波兰的生活经验——如何预约医生或简单地购买电车票——来帮助许多从乌克兰抵达该国的妇女和儿童。

paras.en: Poles were offering help and food at the border, but some people sought to take advantage of the vulnerable arrivals.
paras.zh: 波兰人在边境提供帮助和食物，但有些人试图利用弱势群体。

paras.en: "I spoke to activists engaged in anti-human trafficking and they said what was happening at the border in the first weeks after the invasion was like Christmas, Easter and birthdays rolled into one for traffickers because people were so easily trusting the volunteers," Nastya told DW in a two-bedroom apartment in central Krakow her organization uses to provide shelter to vulnerable women refugees escaping domestic abuse or trafficking.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚在克拉科夫市中心的一套两居室公寓里告诉德国之声：“我与从事反人口贩运活动的活动人士交谈，他们说入侵后头几周在边境发生的事情就像贩运者的圣诞节、复活节和生日一样，因为人们很容易信任志愿者。”

paras.en: Named Martynka, after Nastya's youngest niece, the organization also runs a hotline. It has received more than 5,000 requests for help since March 2022 and now gets about a hundred every month.
paras.zh: 该组织以娜斯佳最小的侄女的名字命名为“马丁卡”，还开通了一条热线电话。自 2022 年 3 月以来，它已收到 5,000 多个帮助请求，现在每个月大约收到 100 个。

paras.en: Her small team provides psychological and moral support in four languages as well as legal assistance and counselling.
paras.zh: 她的小团队以四种语言提供心理和道德支持以及法律援助和咨询。

paras.en: "One of the very young women who lived with us for a long time was drugged by her boyfriend who she met as a teenager when she escaped the full-scale invasion and after years of relationship she found out that he has been drugging her and selling sex with her to other people" she said.
paras.zh: “其中一位长期与我们住在一起的非常年轻的女性被她的男友下药，她是在十几岁时逃离全面入侵时认识的，经过多年的关系，她发现他一直在给她下药，并向其他人卖淫。”她说。

paras.en: Nastya said she was motivated to help partly because of a traumatic experience of her own. While studying in Krakow, a Ukrainian man tried to rape her outside of her dormitory.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚说，她之所以愿意提供帮助，部分原因是她自己的一次创伤经历。在克拉科夫学习期间，一名乌克兰男子试图在宿舍外强奸她。

paras.en: After a long and difficult legal process, during which police detained the suspect before releasing him, he was eventually found guilty of violating Nastya's bodily autonomy and given a restraining order.
paras.zh: 经过漫长而艰难的法律程序，警方拘留了嫌疑人，然后将其释放，最终他被判犯有侵犯纳斯佳身体自主权罪，并被授予限制令。

paras.en: "This terrible, traumatic experience not only gave me horrible PTSD, which later on sort of helped me be empathetic and understand survivors with PTSD, but also it put me through the system of justice and how survivors are being treated," she added.
paras.zh: “这次可怕的创伤经历不仅给我带来了可怕的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD），这在后来帮助我产生了同理心并理解了创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）幸存者，而且还让我了解了司法系统以及幸存者如何受到对待，”她补充道。

paras.en: Since 2022, around 100 women and children have found shelter in the apartment. Her team's work relies largely on donations from international organizations.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，约有 100 名妇女和儿童在该公寓找到了庇护所。她的团队的工作很大程度上依赖于国际组织的捐款。

paras.en: But cuts to USAID have led to increased competition for grants, while donor fatigue has forced the team to cut its one-to-one therapy sessions.
paras.zh: 但美国国际开发署的削减导致了赠款竞争的加剧，而捐助者的疲劳也迫使该团队减少了一对一的治疗疗程。

paras.en: "Ukraine is not in the headlines anymore," says Nastya. "The international attention has moved elsewhere. For all of summer 2026 we have been running a very challenging fundraising campaign. It is so hard to convince people to donate to a Ukrainian organization right now. There is something called exhaustion, donor exhaustion, fundraising exhaustion."
paras.zh: “乌克兰不再成为头条新闻，”纳斯蒂亚说。 “国际社会的注意力已经转移到其他地方。2026 年整个夏天，我们一直在开展一场非常具有挑战性的筹款活动。现在很难说服人们向乌克兰组织捐款。有一种叫做耗尽、捐助者耗尽、筹款耗尽的现象。”

paras.en: The UNHCR's acting representative for Poland, Czechia and Slovakia, Jun Shirato, confirmed the difficult situation in the aid sector.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署驻波兰、捷克和斯洛伐克的代理代表白户淳（Jun Shirato）证实了援助部门的困难处境。

paras.en: Speaking to DW in Warsaw, she said that funding cuts last year have forced UNHCR to scale back its staff in Poland by two thirds, from 120 at its peak in the months after the invasion to 40 now. The UNHCR has now closed three of its regional offices opened in Krakow, Lublin and Rzeszow after Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Its sole remaining office in Poland is in Warsaw.
paras.zh: 她在华沙接受德国之声采访时表示，去年的资金削减迫使难民署在波兰的工作人员人数减少了三分之二，从入侵后几个月最高峰的120人减少到现在的40人。俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，联合国难民署现已关闭在克拉科夫、卢布林和热舒夫设立的三个地区办事处。它在波兰仅存的唯一办事处位于华沙。

paras.en: Nastya's fundraising efforts increasingly meet with online abuse, too.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚的筹款活动也越来越多地遭遇网络谩骂。

paras.en: Attitudes toward Ukrainians in Poland have changed. In the months after the invasion, many Poles opened their homes to refugees, including Nastya's sister and her daughters.
paras.zh: 波兰对乌克兰人的态度发生了变化。入侵后的几个月里，许多波兰人向难民开放了家园，其中包括娜斯佳的姐姐和她的女儿们。

paras.en: The situation is now very different. Earlier this year, new rules restricting access to child benefits and free healthcare for refugees who don't work were introduced.
paras.zh: 现在的情况已经大不相同了。今年早些时候，出台了限制不工作难民获得儿童福利和免费医疗的新规定。

paras.en: In the first half of this year, reports of hate crimes committed against Ukrainians in Poland rose by a third according to Polish police statistics.
paras.zh: 根据波兰警方的统计数据，今年上半年，波兰境内针对乌克兰人的仇恨犯罪报告增加了三分之一。

paras.en: At the same time, historical disputes between Poland and Ukraine, have resurfaced, fueling further hostility toward the Ukrainian community, which accounts for more than three quarters of all foreigners living in Poland.
paras.zh: 与此同时，波兰和乌克兰之间的历史争端再次浮出水面，进一步加剧了对乌克兰社区的敌意，乌克兰社区占居住在波兰的外国人总数的四分之三以上。

paras.en: In May, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's decision to name a military unit after the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA), which took part in the murder of tens of thousands of Poles during the World War II, triggered outrage in Poland.
paras.zh: 今年5月，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基决定以乌克兰起义军（UPA）的名字命名一支军事部队，该部队在二战期间参与了杀害数万名波兰人的行动，引发了波兰的愤怒。

paras.en: Polish President Karol Nawrocki stripped Zelenskyy of Poland's highest state honor, the Order of the White Eagle.
paras.zh: 波兰总统卡罗尔·纳罗基剥夺了泽伦斯基的波兰最高国家荣誉——白鹰勋章。

paras.en: While Poles focus on the UPA's massacre of Polish citizens, many Ukrainians view the UPA and nationalist leaders like Stepan Bandera as heroes because they fought against the Soviet occupation after the war.
paras.zh: 虽然波兰人关注统一进步联盟对波兰公民的屠杀，但许多乌克兰人将统一进步联盟和斯捷潘·班德拉这样的民族主义领导人视为英雄，因为他们在战后反抗苏联的占领。

paras.en: "This week we are supporting a family of Ukrainians whose car was completely destroyed. No windows left in the car and with spray paint someone wrote 'Bandera people go back where you came from,'" said Nastya, adding, "I think it is so devastating and I've recorded a video about it. We have hundreds of comments there, of people wishing me death, wishing me to go back where I came from. It is very tough emotionally."
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚说：“本周我们正在支持一个乌克兰家庭，他们的汽车被完全摧毁。车上没有窗户，有人用喷漆写着‘班德拉人回到你来的地方’。”她补充道，“我认为这真是毁灭性的，我录制了一个关于它的视频。我们有数百条评论，人们希望我死，希望我回到我来的地方。这在情感上非常艰难。”

paras.en: Nastya said the hostility is also driven by Russia using online bots to stoke tensions between Poles and Ukrainians.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚表示，俄罗斯利用在线机器人加剧波兰人和乌克兰人之间的紧张关系也是造成这种敌意的原因。

paras.en: "They do not want us to be together, or to remember who our common enemy is. They don't want Ukrainian refugees to integrate or feel welcome," she said.
paras.zh: “他们不希望我们在一起，也不希望我们记住我们共同的敌人是谁。他们不希望乌克兰难民融入社会或感到受欢迎，”她说。

paras.en: Despite the strain, Nastya remains optimistic that she and her team can continue their work.
paras.zh: 尽管压力很大，纳斯蒂亚仍然乐观地认为她和她的团队可以继续他们的工作。

paras.en: "For some reason I am — and this is the weirdest thing. I love my job so much. I want to do this beautiful thing. I would easily send my mother, my sister, my best friend to Martynka for support. I know there are few organizations that could provide such wonderful help."
paras.zh: “出于某种原因，我是——这是最奇怪的事情。我非常热爱我的工作。我想做这件美丽的事情。我会很容易地把我的母亲、我的妹妹、我最好的朋友送到马丁卡那里寻求支持。我知道很少有组织能够提供如此出色的帮助。”

paras.en: If you or someone you know have experienced any kind of gender-based violence, the website lila.help lists trustworthy helplines and NGOs that offer support in almost every country in the world.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人经历过任何形式的性别暴力，lila.help 网站列出了值得信赖的帮助热线和非政府组织，它们在世界上几乎每个国家/地区提供支持。

articles.title: Is China seeking to restrict Taiwan's cultural presence?

paras.en: When Taiwaneseauthor Yang Shuang-zi's "Taiwan Travelogue" won the 2026 International Booker Prize, it marked a historic breakthrough on the global stage. But behind the triumph lay a sharp geopolitical reality.
paras.zh: 台湾作家杨双子的《台湾游记》荣获2026年国际布克奖，标志着在全球舞台上的历史性突破。但胜利的背后却隐藏着尖锐的地缘政治现实。

paras.en: On stage, Lin King, who translated the book into English, gave voice to the anxiety looming over Taiwan, where she spent a large part of her childhood.
paras.zh: 在舞台上，将这本书翻译成英文的林金表达了她在台湾度过的大部分童年时光所笼罩的焦虑情绪。

paras.en: "In 2022, when Russia invaded Ukraine, I made the explicit decision that rather than translating Sinophone works indiscriminately, I would only translate writing from Taiwan for the foreseeable future. I will continue to do so until the day comes that my homeland's sovereignty is no longer a provocation or a punchline — until no English speaker feels comfortable saying to me, 'I really should come visit you in Taiwan while it still exists.'" she said in her acceptance speech.
paras.zh: “2022年，当俄罗斯入侵乌克兰时，我做出了明确的决定，在可预见的未来，我不会不加区别地翻译华语作品，而是只翻译台湾的作品。我将继续这样做，直到我祖国的主权不再是挑衅或笑话的那一天——直到没有一个说英语的人愿意对我说，‘我真的应该在台湾还存在的时候来拜访你。’”她在获奖感言中说道。

paras.en: "Taiwan Travelogue" follows a young Japanese writer visiting Japanese-colonized Taiwan in May 1938 on an official government-sponsored lecture tour. As she and her Taiwanese interpreter explore local street food together, a subtle intimacy unfolds between them. The narrative centers Taiwan's history rather than Beijing's preferred "Greater China" framework.
paras.zh: 《台湾游记》讲述了一位年轻的日本作家于 1938 年 5 月在政府资助的官方巡回演讲中访问日本殖民地台湾的故事。当她和她的台湾翻译一起探索当地街头美食时，他们之间展开了微妙的亲密关系。叙事以台湾历史为中心，而不是北京偏爱的“大中华”框架。

paras.en: "Literature and politics are directly connected," Yang told DW. "Politics determines the allocation of resources, and the allocation of resources determines which works get pulled out, held up high and defined as 'good literature.' The idea that politics can just be kept out of it doesn't exist."
paras.zh: “文学和政治是直接相关的，”杨告诉德国之声。 “政治决定资源配置，资源配置决定哪些作品被拔出、被高举、被定义为‘好文学’。认为政治可以被排除在外的想法并不存在。”

paras.en: A few days after the 2026 International Booker Prize was announced, China's Taiwan Affairs Office reacted by saying the following: "Writers from both sides of the Taiwan Strait should firmly uphold a national standpoint, respect historical facts, and squarely face the immense suffering inflicted upon the Chinese people ... by Japan's war of aggression and fascism."
paras.zh: 2026年国际布克奖公布几天后，中国国台办回应称：“海峡两岸作家应坚定民族立场，尊重历史事实，正视日本侵略战争和法西斯战争给中国人民带来的巨大苦难。”

paras.en: "From China's perspective, they do not want to see Taiwan's voice gain prominence." Yang said.
paras.zh: “从中国的角度来看，他们不希望看到台湾的声音受到重视。”杨说。

paras.en: Her book demonstrates that Taiwanese culture is shaped by multiple historical strands — including Indigenous, Japanese colonial and local Han influences, rather than being merely a "branch of Chinese culture."
paras.zh: 她的书表明，台湾文化是由多种历史因素塑造的，包括原住民、日本殖民和当地汉族的影响，而不仅仅是“中华文化的一个分支”。

paras.en: During Yang's German book tour this October, an event at the Literaturhaus in the southern German city of Munich sparked controversy when the writer's interpreter significantly shortened certain statements concerning Taiwan, China, history and politics. The interpreter later admitted that there had been oversights and shortcomings in the translation but denied deliberately deleting content due to their political stance or the situation in Taiwan.
paras.zh: 今年十月杨洁篪的德国售书活动期间，德国南部城市慕尼黑文学馆举行的一次活动引发了争议，当时这位作家的翻译大幅缩短了有关台湾、中国、历史和政治的某些陈述。该翻译后来承认翻译存在疏忽和缺陷，但否认因政治立场或台湾局势而故意删除内容。

paras.en: Beijing claims Taiwan as a Chinese province and has long threatened to use force to bring the island under its control. Taiwan's democratically elected president has rejected Beijing's assertion that its laws apply to Taiwan.
paras.zh: 北京声称台湾是中国的一个省，并长期以来威胁要使用武力将该岛置于其控制之下。台湾民选总统拒绝了北京关于其法律适用于台湾的说法。

paras.en: Since 1949, Taiwan has functioned with de facto independence, maintaining its own government, military, and legal systems while facing ongoing military pressure from Beijing.
paras.zh: 自 1949 年以来，台湾一直以事实上的独立运作，维持自己的政府、军事和法律体系，同时面临来自北京的持续军事压力。

paras.en: China's monitoring of Taiwanese international engagement reaches far further than words over a literature prize.
paras.zh: 中国对台湾国际参与的监控远远超出了文学奖的言论。

paras.en: "The target of suppression and harassment primarily include outspoken individuals, exiled activists, diaspora community organizers, alongside their family members and close affiliates back home, " said said Dr. Yan-ho Lai, a senior fellow of Georgetown Center for Asian Law. "From the PRC's (People's Republic of China) eyes, these groups are a threat to regime security, as they are able to amplify the dissenting voices and alternative stories of China to the West."
paras.zh: 乔治敦亚洲法律中心高级研究员赖彦浩博士说：“镇压和骚扰的目标主要包括直言不讳的个人、流亡活动人士、侨民社区组织者，以及他们在国内的家人和关系密切的人。” “从中华人民共和国的角度来看，这些团体对政权安全构成威胁，因为他们能够向西方放大中国的异议声音和另类故事。”

paras.en: In April this year, Taiwanese barista Lin Shao-hsing, also known as Bala, won the 2026 World Latte Art Championship in the United States. Soon after, all mention of Taiwan as it related to Bala's win was removed from the official World Coffee Championships website.
paras.zh: 今年4月，台湾咖啡师林绍兴（又名巴拉）在美国获得2026年世界拉花艺术锦标赛冠军。不久之后，世界咖啡锦标赛官方网站上删除了所有与巴拉获胜有关的台湾内容。

paras.en: It now says that Bala was representing "the competition body of Chinese Taipei," a term often used in international contests, such as the Olympics, to refer to Taiwan, but almost never used in Taiwan itself.
paras.zh: 现在它说巴拉代表“中华台北的比赛机构”，这个词经常在奥运会等国际比赛中用来指代台湾，但在台湾本土几乎从未使用过。

paras.en: According to a 2026 poll by National Chengchi University's Election Study Center, the vast majority of people in Taiwan identify as "Taiwanese," while only 2.5% identify as Chinese.
paras.zh: 根据国立政治大学选举研究中心2026年的民意调查，绝大多数台湾人认为自己是“台湾人”，只有2.5%的人认为自己是中国人。

paras.en: In 2024, China allegedly planned to stage a "car collision" during Taiwanese Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim's visit to the Czech capiutal Prague. Czech intelligence officials told local media that the incident had been part of a much larger and escalatory plan by Chinese diplomats and intelligence officers working out of the Chinese embassy in Prague.
paras.zh: 据称，2024年，中国计划在台湾副总统萧美琴访问捷克首都布拉格期间制造“车祸”。捷克情报官员告诉当地媒体，该事件是中国驻布拉格大使馆外交官和情报官员一项规模更大、升级计划的一部分。

paras.en: In early October this year, the FBI said authorities arrested a woman in California for allegedly spying on the son of Taiwan's president. According to the US Department of Justice, the woman had traveled to Seattle in 2025 under instructions from Beijing to monitor the Taiwanese president's son and his family, capturing photos, video footage, and license plate information.
paras.zh: 今年10月初，美国联邦调查局表示，当局在加州逮捕了一名涉嫌监视台湾总统之子的女子。据美国司法部称，该女子于 2025 年按照北京的指示前往西雅图监视台湾总统的儿子及其家人，拍摄照片、视频片段和车牌信息。

paras.en: During a press conference on October 6, China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs said it "consistently opposes the hype surrounding so-called 'Chinese spies' and the smearing and vilification of China."
paras.zh: 中国外交部在10月6日的记者会上表示，“一贯反对炒作所谓‘中国间谍’，反对对中国的抹黑污蔑”。

paras.en: "It reflects the ambiguity and limitation of international law, that the PRC using soft power to restrict the visibility of Taiwan may not directly fall into international law arena, as Taiwan is not recognized by international bodies as a sovereign state party." said Dr. Lai.
paras.zh: “这反映了国际法的模糊性和局限性，中华人民共和国利用软实力限制台湾的可见性可能不会直接落入国际法舞台，因为台湾没有被国际机构承认为主权国家。”赖博士说。

articles.title: Schools crisis in France: Investment fails to inspire confidence

paras.en: Rats in the toilets, leaking roofs, broken heating systems: Cellphone videos filmed by French schoolchildren and circulating on social media bear witness to the dilapidated infrastructure in many educational institutions across France.
paras.zh: 厕所里的老鼠、屋顶漏水、供暖系统损坏：法国学童拍摄并在社交媒体上流传的手机视频见证了法国许多教育机构破旧的基础设施。

paras.en: At the Lycee Paul Eluard in the Parisian suburb of Saint-Denis, a center of the current protests, young people have reported that there are vermin in the building, and say burst pipes are a regular occurrence. In nearby Pantin, pupils complained that windows couldn't be opened, even when temperatures soared to 40 degrees Celsius (over 104 degrees Fahrenheit) in summer.
paras.zh: 在巴黎郊区圣但尼的保罗·艾吕雅中学（当前抗议活动的中心），年轻人报告说，大楼里有害虫，水管爆裂是常事。在附近的庞坦，学生抱怨说，即使夏天气温飙升至 40 摄氏度（超过 104 华氏度），窗户也打不开。

paras.en: Pupils also complain of overcrowded classrooms and frequently cancelled lessons.
paras.zh: 学生们还抱怨教室过于拥挤，课程经常被取消。

paras.en: The protests, which have erupted all over the country, show no sign of coming to an end.
paras.zh: 全国各地爆发的抗议活动没有任何结束的迹象。

paras.en: Yet, by EU standards, France invests a substantial amount in its education system — 6.7% of its GDP. The fact that this investment has not translated into a better learning environment may be partly attributable to the way responsibilities are divided.
paras.zh: 然而，按照欧盟标准，法国在教育系统上投入了大量资金——占 GDP 的 6.7%。这项投资并未转化为更好的学习环境，部分原因可能是责任划分方式。

paras.en: The central government in Paris mainly deals with paying teachers, and setting national curricula. But the responsibility for maintaining school buildings lies with France's various levels of local government. For elementary schools, the administration responsible is the municipality; for "colleges" (lower secondary schools, ages 11–15) it is the wider department, and for lycees (upper secondary schools, ages 15–18) it is the region.
paras.zh: 巴黎中央政府主要负责支付教师工资和制定国家课程。但维护校舍的责任在于法国各级地方政府。对于小学，负责的行政部门是市政府；对于“学院”（初中，11-15 岁）来说，它是更广泛的部门，对于中学（高中，15-18 岁）来说，它是地区。

paras.en: Depending on the region, the local authorities have different financial possibilities at their disposal, and must plan renovation projects themselves. Progress on making improvements is often very slow as a result. In addition, more than two-thirds of their budget is already allocated to staffing costs and pension payments, leaving relatively little room for investment.
paras.zh: 根据地区的不同，地方当局有不同的财政可能性，并且必须自行规划改造项目。因此，改进的进展往往非常缓慢。此外，其预算的三分之二以上已分配给员工成本和养老金支付，投资空间相对较小。

paras.en: Over 80% of elementary school buildings in France are more than 50 years old. An estimated 10 to 20% of all school buildings are considered to be in serious need of renovation. In many instances, politicians have been trying to address the problem. Ile-de-France, which covers Paris and the region surrounding it, approved a 10-year program of renovation and expansion for the period 2017 to 2027 at a cost of €6.6 billion ($7.4 billion).
paras.zh: 法国80%以上的小学建筑都有50年以上的历史。据估计，所有校舍中有 10% 至 20% 急需翻修。在许多情况下，政客们一直在努力解决这个问题。法兰西岛涵盖巴黎及其周边地区，批准了一项为期 10 年的改造和扩建计划，从 2017 年到 2027 年，耗资 66 亿欧元（74 亿美元）。

paras.en: According to the local authorities, two-thirds of upper secondary pupils now attend a new school, or one that has been renovated. But even after mold has been removed and roofs repaired, it is still rare for buildings to have effective protection against the summer heat. It is also a bitter irony that some buildings newly constructed at considerable expense, or renovated just a few years earlier, have been damaged in the recent protests.
paras.zh: 据地方当局称，三分之二的高中生现在在一所新学校或一所经过翻修的学校就读。但即使在霉菌被清除、屋顶被修复之后，能够有效抵御夏季炎热的建筑物仍然很少见。具有讽刺意味的是，一些耗资巨大的新建建筑或几年前刚刚翻新的建筑在最近的抗议活动中遭到破坏。

paras.en: Imbalances are also evident in ongoing education expenditure. While France invests a comparatively large amount in upper secondary education, according to OECD calculations Paris spends less per primary school pupil than the average for industrialized countries. Education researchers emphasize that it is precisely these early years that lay the foundation for subsequent academic success.
paras.zh: 持续教育支出的不平衡也很明显。尽管法国在高中教育方面的投资相对较多，但根据经合组织的计算，巴黎在每个小学生身上的支出低于工业化国家的平均水平。教育研究人员强调，正是这些早年为后来的学业成功奠定了基础。

paras.en: The governments put in place by French President Emmanuel Macron have attempted to address this imbalance. Since 2017, class sizes in the first years of primary school have been halved in socially disadvantaged areas, and around 16,000 additional teaching posts created.
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙组建的政府试图解决这种不平衡问题。 2017年以来，贫困地区小学一年级班级规模减半，新增教师岗位约1.6万个。

paras.en: Amid the ongoing protests, the government has said it now intends to recruit more than 3,000 supply teachers at short notice. French Education Minister Edouard Geffray announced that software would be used to identify schools that are in a particularly difficult situation.
paras.zh: 在持续不断的抗议活动中，政府表示现在打算在短时间内招聘 3,000 多名代课教师。法国教育部长爱德华·格弗雷 (Edouard Geffray) 宣布，将使用软件来识别处境特别困难的学校。

paras.en: These announcements are the government's first concrete response to the demands of the students, who have been demonstrating for almost two weeks now, calling for better facilities in secondary schools, more supply teachers and greater investment in the education system generally.
paras.zh: 这些公告是政府对学生要求的首次具体回应，学生们已经示威了近两周，呼吁改善中学设施、增加代课教师以及加大对教育系统的投资。

paras.en: The latest scores for the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development’s (OECD) program for international student assessment (Pisa), which were published in September, illustrate the scale of the problems in the education system. According to the results, more than one in three 15-year-olds in France no longer achieve a basic level of competence in mathematics, for example.
paras.zh: 经济合作与发展组织 (OECD) 国际学生评估计划 (PISA) 于 9 月份发布的最新分数显示了教育系统问题的严重程度。例如，根据结果，超过三分之一的法国 15 岁青少年不再具备基本的数学能力。

paras.en: Macron's reform of the upper secondary education system has also been criticized. The abolition of academic streaming in favor of specialist subjects selected by the individual was meant to give pupils greater freedom of choice. However, the large number of possible subject combinations make it difficult to timetable lessons. Students complain that they have too many free periods and longer school days.
paras.zh: 马克龙的高中教育制度改革也受到批评。废除学术分流，转而选择个人选择的专业科目，旨在给予学生更大的选择自由。然而，大量可能的科目组合使得课程安排变得困难。学生们抱怨他们有太多的空闲时间和更长的上课时间。

paras.en: The problems also extend to universities. A lecturer at a Paris university described a seminar attended by 50 students — so many that they have to fetch chairs from other rooms or sit on the floor. So far, she said, the university administration had done nothing about it.
paras.zh: 这些问题也延伸到了大学。巴黎一所大学的讲师描述了一次有 50 名学生参加的研讨会——人数太多，以至于他们不得不从其他房间拿椅子或坐在地板上。她说，到目前为止，大学管理部门还没有采取任何行动。

paras.en: Compared with pupils in other EU countries, French schoolchildren have a high number of teaching hours per school year — on paper, at least. But the French Court of Accounts recorded that 9% of lessons at state colleges were cancelled in the 2023–24 school year. A study from the school year 2024–25 suggests that only around 12% of lessons cancelled at short notice are covered by other teachers.
paras.zh: 与其他欧盟国家的学生相比，法国学童每学年的教学时间很高——至少在纸面上是这样。但法国审计法院记录称，2023-24 学年州立大学 9% 的课程被取消。 2024-25 学年的一项研究表明，在临时通知取消的课程中，只有约 12% 是由其他教师承担的。

paras.en: The relatively low salaries of French teachers compared to those in neighboring countries are also a problem. OECD data shows that after 15 years in the profession teachers at lower secondary schools in France only earn about half as much as their German counterparts.
paras.zh: 与邻国相比，法国教师的工资相对较低也是一个问题。经合组织的数据显示，从业 15 年后，法国初中教师的收入仅为德国同行的一半左右。

paras.en: France takes pride in its republican model of education, which is supposed to provide all children with equal opportunities, irrespective of their background. In reality, academic success in France is much more dependent on parents' socioeconomic circumstances than in many other countries. This is also apparent in that children from poorer families are far more likely to be affected by the cancellation of lessons.
paras.zh: 法国对其共和教育模式感到自豪，这种模式应该为所有儿童提供平等的机会，无论其背景如何。事实上，与许多其他国家相比，法国的学业成功更多地取决于父母的社会经济环境。这也很明显，因为来自贫困家庭的孩子更有可能受到课程取消的影响。

paras.en: The government's financial room for maneuver is currently restricted by the country's precarious budgetary situation. Although the draft budget for 2027 includes an additional €1.2 billion for the Ministry of Education, there are also plans to cut teaching posts, on the grounds that pupil numbers are falling.
paras.zh: 目前，政府的财政回旋余地受到国家不稳定的预算状况的限制。尽管2027年预算草案包括为教育部追加12亿欧元，但由于学生人数下降，也计划削减教师职位。

paras.en: Protests in the run-up to the presidential election
paras.zh: 总统选举前夕的抗议活动

paras.en: It's not just videos of dilapidated school buildings that are circulating on social media. As the discontent has spread, there is also footage of demonstrations where people carry placards with political slogans that have little to do with education policy. Some videos show burning barricades and clashes with the police, which faces accusations of usingdisproportionate force.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上流传的不仅仅是破旧校舍的视频。随着不满情绪的蔓延，还有一些示威活动的镜头，人们举着写有与教育政策无关的政治口号的标语牌。一些视频显示路障被焚烧，并与警察发生冲突，警方被指控过度使用武力。

paras.en: Some members of the far-left France Unbowed (LFI) party have associated themselves with the protesting students. Lawmakers have appeared at school blockades and shared related videos. The government has accused LFI of deliberately exploiting young people's anger for political purposes, an allegation that the party rejects.
paras.zh: 极左翼法国不屈党（LFI）的一些成员与抗议学生联系在一起。立法者出现在学校封锁现场并分享相关视频。政府指责 LFI 故意利用年轻人的愤怒来达到政治目的，但该党否认了这一指控。

paras.en: With the French presidential election just six months away, the protests over the crisis in education are evolving into a power struggle.
paras.zh: 距离法国总统大选仅剩六个月，针对教育危机的抗议活动正在演变成一场权力斗争。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Israel’s economy prospers despite years of war, but prices worry voters

paras.en: After three years of Israel’s multi-front war in the Middle East, it would be no surprise if this month’s Knesset elections were taking place against the backdrop of an economy in dire straits.
paras.zh: 以色列在中东进行了三年多战线战争后，如果本月的议会选举是在经济陷入困境的背景下举行，也就不足为奇了。

paras.en: Instead, Israel’s economy is – by many measures – flourishing.
paras.zh: 相反，从许多方面来看，以色列的经济正在蓬勃发展。

paras.en: After slowing sharply in the initial aftermath of the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attacks and Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, Israel has rebounded to become one of the fastest-growing advanced economies in recent years.
paras.zh: 在哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击和以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争之后，以色列的经济增长最初急剧放缓，但后来已经反弹，成为近年来增长最快的发达经济体之一。

paras.en: Gross domestic product (GDP) grew 2.9 percent in 2025, picking up from a 1 percent expansion in 2024, and 3.2 percent in the first half of this year, according to government figures.
paras.zh: 根据政府数据，2025 年国内生产总值 (GDP) 增长 2.9%，高于 2024 年 1% 的增速，今年上半年增长 3.2%。

paras.en: The Bank of Israel has forecast 4 percent growth for the whole of 2026 and 5.5 percent growth in 2027 – projections that far exceed the outlooks for major economies such as the United States, United Kingdom, France, Canada, and Japan.
paras.zh: 以色列央行预计 2026 年全年经济增长 4%，2027 年增长 5.5%，这一预测远远超出美国、英国、法国、加拿大和日本等主要经济体的预期。

paras.en: Over the past three years, the shekel has strengthened against the US dollar, hitting a three-decade high in May, and Israel’s stock market has surged, with the benchmark TA-125 up more than 110 percent.
paras.zh: 过去三年来，谢克尔兑美元汇率不断走强，5月份触及三年来新高，以色列股市飙升，基准TA-125上涨超过110%。

paras.en: Meanwhile, unemployment stands at 2.8 percent, while inflation is modest at 1.5 percent.
paras.zh: 与此同时，失业率为 2.8%，而通胀率为 1.5%。

paras.en: Against this relatively rosy economic backdrop, campaigning for the October 27 election has been dominated by national security, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, leader of the right-wing Likud party, and retired general Gadi Eisenkot, head of the centrist Yashar, each claiming to be most qualified to keep Israelis safe.
paras.zh: 在相对乐观的经济背景下，10月27日选举的竞选活动主要以国家安全为主导，右翼利库德集团领导人、总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡和中间派亚沙尔党主席、退役将军加迪·艾森科特都声称自己最有资格保护以色列人的安全。

paras.en: Driving Israel’s striking economic resilience has been a booming tech sector largely insulated from its conflicts spanning Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Iraq, Iran and Yemen.
paras.zh: 推动以色列惊人经济恢复力的是蓬勃发展的科技行业，该行业在很大程度上不受加沙、黎巴嫩、叙利亚、伊拉克、伊朗和也门冲突的影响。

paras.en: Despite being on a war footing since October 2023, Israel has attracted record levels of investment in tech, the driver of about one-fifth of economic activity, amid the frenetic global rollout of artificial intelligence (AI).
paras.zh: 尽管自 2023 年 10 月以来一直处于战争状态，但随着人工智能 (AI) 在全球的疯狂推广，以色列吸引了创纪录水平的科技投资，科技投资约占经济活动的五分之一。

paras.en: Total direct foreign investment hit a record $26.2bn last year, up 78 percent from 2024, led by US tech giants Alphabet and Palo Alto Networks’ record-breaking acquisitions of Israeli cybersecurity firms Wiz and CyberArk, respectively.
paras.zh: 去年，外国直接投资总额达到创纪录的 262 亿美元，比 2024 年增长 78%，其中美国科技巨头 Alphabet 和 Palo Alto Networks 分别破纪录地收购了以色列网络安全公司 Wiz 和 Cyber​​Ark。

paras.en: Foreign capital has continued to flood into the country this year, with inflows reaching a quarterly record of $14.1bn in the January-March period, according to government figures.
paras.zh: 政府数据显示，今年外国资本继续涌入该国，1月至3月期间流入量达到季度纪录的141亿美元。

paras.en: Along with prospering from the global AI boom, Israel’s tech scene has benefitted from its close ties to the local defence sector, which has ramped up orders from hundreds of startups supplying everything from radar systems to communications platforms and anti-drone technology.
paras.zh: 随着全球人工智能热潮的繁荣，以色列的科技界也受益于其与当地国防部门的密切联系，该部门增加了数百家初创公司的订单，这些初创公司供应从雷达系统到通信平台和反无人机技术等各种产品。

paras.en: While Israel’s economy has bounced back in part due to robust employment and wage growth, its resilience is primarily an “export-driven story that reflects strong global technology demand, particularly in areas where Israel – and multinational firms operating from Israel – is globally competitive, such as cybersecurity and artificial intelligence,” said Keren Uziyel, a senior analyst for the Middle East and Africa at the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU).
paras.zh: 经济学人智库（EIU）中东和非洲高级分析师克伦·乌齐耶尔（Keren Uziyel）表示，虽然以色列经济反弹的部分原因是强劲的就业和工资增长，但其韧性主要是“出口驱动的故事，反映了强劲的全球技术需求，特别是在以色列以及在以色列运营的跨国公司具有全球竞争力的领域，例如网络安全和人工智能”。

paras.en: “Interest in Israel’s technology goods and services is driving high levels of FDI and venture capital fundraising, and boosting the capital markets, which in turn is having significant wealth effects and boosting government revenue,” Uziyel told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 乌齐耶尔告诉半岛电视台：“对以色列技术产品和服务的兴趣正在推动高水平的外国直接投资和风险资本融资，并推动资本市场的发展，这反过来又产生了显着的财富效应并增加了政府收入。”

paras.en: But Israel’s military campaigns have come at an enormous cost to the public purse.
paras.zh: 但以色列的军事行动让公共财政付出了巨大的代价。

paras.en: In March, the Bank of Israel estimated that Israel’s war costs to date had reached approximately 350 billion shekels ($114.6bn) – a figure not including the then recently-launched Iran war.
paras.zh: 3月份，以色列央行估计，迄今为止以色列的战争成本已达到约3500亿谢克尔（1146亿美元）——这一数字不包括当时最近发动的伊朗战争。

paras.en: Military expenditures are on track to rise substantially in the coming years as Israeli leaders double down on “national security”.
paras.zh: 随着以色列领导人加倍重视“国家安全”，军事支出在未来几年有望大幅增加。

paras.en: Netanyahu, whose right-wing coalition has cast security as “the foundation of everything else”, has pushed to raise the annual defence budget to 183 billion shekels ($60bn), equivalent to roughly 9 percent of GDP.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼联盟将安全视为“一切的基础”，并推动将年度国防预算提高到 1,830 亿谢克尔（600 亿美元），相当于 GDP 的约 9%。

paras.en: If passed, the budget would raise military spending by two and a half times what it was before October 7.
paras.zh: 如果该预算获得通过，军费开支将比 10 月 7 日之前增加两倍半。

paras.en: Outgoing opposition leader Yair Lapid has backed an expanded defence budget, but has clashed with Netanyahu about how to fund it.
paras.zh: 即将离任的反对派领导人亚伊尔·拉皮德支持扩大国防预算，但与内塔尼亚胡在如何为其提供资金方面发生冲突。

paras.en: Though security has dominated the run-up to the election, opinion polling suggests that Israelis also view the economy as a key concern.
paras.zh: 尽管安全问题在选举前夕占据主导地位，但民意调查显示，以色列人也将经济视为一个关键问题。

paras.en: In an opinion poll released by the Israel Democracy Institute last month, 38 percent of Jewish Israelis and 46 percent of Palestinian citizens of Israel – who make up about 20 percent of the population – chose the economy and the cost of living as the most important or second-most important election issue.
paras.zh: 以色列民主研究所上个月发布的一项民意调查显示，38%的犹太以色列人和46%的以色列巴勒斯坦公民（约占以色列人口的20%）选择经济和生活成本作为最重要或第二重要的选举问题。

paras.en: Israel’s high cost of living, in particular, has long been a source of public discontent.
paras.zh: 尤其是以色列高昂的生活成本长期以来一直是公众不满的根源。

paras.en: Israel has for years ranked among the most expensive countries in the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), a dynamic economists attribute to the country’s limited trade relations with its neighbours and cumbersome regulations.
paras.zh: 以色列多年来一直位居经济合作与发展组织（OECD）最昂贵的国家之列，经济学家将这一动态归因于该国与邻国的有限贸易关系和繁琐的监管。

paras.en: Though Israel’s overall rate of inflation has been modest, food prices have risen at a faster pace, increasing 8 percent between the start of 2024 and mid-2026, according to consumer advocacy group Lobby 99.
paras.zh: 根据消费者权益倡导组织 Lobby 99 的数据，尽管以色列的总体通胀率较低，但食品价格上涨速度更快，从 2024 年初到 2026 年中期上涨了 8%。

paras.en: “People are worried about the economy but not so much about the macroeconomic situation, more so on their personal perspectives, especially cost of living,” Ayal Kimhi, vice president of the Shoresh Institution for Socioeconomic Research in Tel Aviv, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫肖雷什社会经济研究所副所长阿亚尔·金希（Ayal Kimhi）告诉半岛电视台：“人们担心经济，但不太担心宏观经济形势，更担心他们的个人观点，尤其是生活成本。”

paras.en: “However, the security situation dominates the public discourse for obvious reasons, so I do not think the economy will play a major role in the vote,” Kimhi said.
paras.zh: “然而，由于显而易见的原因，安全局势主导了公众讨论，因此我认为经济不会在投票中发挥重要作用，”金希说。

paras.en: “Some parties do not even bother presenting a vision or an agenda,” he added.
paras.zh: “有些政党甚至懒得提出愿景或议程，”他补充道。

paras.en: “Other parties do not differ much about economic issues.”
paras.zh: “其他政党在经济问题上没有太大分歧。”

paras.en: While Israel’s headline economic figures are impressive, they come with caveats attached.
paras.zh: 虽然以色列的总体经济数据令人印象深刻，但也有一些警告。

paras.en: Economists note that while Israel’s economy has grown much faster than its peers, GDP has been boosted in part by the country’s usually high population growth, which has averaged nearly 2 percent over the past decade.
paras.zh: 经济学家指出，虽然以色列的经济增长速度远远快于其他国家，但该国GDP的增长在一定程度上得益于该国通常较高的人口增长率，过去十年平均增长率接近2%。

paras.en: Israel’s growth trajectory has also taken a hit despite the expansion, with the Bank of Israel estimating an accumulated loss of output through the end of 2025 equivalent to 8.6 percent of annual GDP.
paras.zh: 尽管经济扩张，但以色列的增长轨迹也受到了打击，以色列央行估计，到 2025 年底，累计产出损失相当于年度 GDP 的 8.6%。

paras.en: Joseph Zeira, a professor of economics at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, said the country’s economic performance has “not been great at all” considering that growth has consistently lagged the pre-conflict trend since late 2023.
paras.zh: 耶路撒冷希伯来大学经济学教授约瑟夫·泽拉表示，考虑到自 2023 年底以来增长一直落后于冲突前的趋势，该国的经济表现“一点也不出色”。

paras.en: “Actual living standards depend on the area,” Zeira told Al Jazeera, adding that Israelis are grappling with “higher prices, or rather lower real wages and incomes”, and deteriorating public services.
paras.zh: “实际生活水平取决于该地区，”泽拉告诉半岛电视台，并补充说以色列人正在努力应对“更高的价格，或者更确切地说更低的实际工资和收入”以及不断恶化的公共服务。

paras.en: “The only improvement is some decline in housing prices due to a vast wave of construction in recent years,” he said.
paras.zh: “唯一的改善是，由于近年来的大规模建设浪潮，房价有所下降，”他说。

paras.en: The long-term health of Israel’s public finances is another concern.
paras.zh: 以色列公共财政的长期健康状况是另一个令人担忧的问题。

paras.en: While Israel’s debt-to-GDP ratio of about 68 is far below that of peers such as the US, the UK, France, and Italy, the gap between government revenue and spending has grown rapidly over the past three years.
paras.zh: 尽管以色列的债务与GDP之比约为68，远低于美国、英国、法国和意大利等国家，但政府收入与支出之间的差距在过去三年中迅速扩大。

paras.en: In its latest annual report, the Bank of Israel said it was “essential” for the government to “restore orderly budgetary processes” and implement “credible measures” to reduce the public debt.
paras.zh: 以色列央行在最新的年度报告中表示，政府“恢复有序的预算流程”并实施“可信措施”来减少公共债务“至关重要”。

paras.en: Other long-term challenges include boosting labour participation among ultra-Orthodox Jewish men – whose refusal to do military service has become a major election issue – and Arab women (among Palestinian citizens of Israel), both of whom are employed at much lower rates than the general population.
paras.zh: 其他长期挑战包括提高极端正统犹太男性（他们拒绝服兵役已成为一个主要选举问题）和阿拉伯女性（以色列的巴勒斯坦公民）的劳动参与率，两者的就业率都远低于一般人口。

paras.en: “The cost of the military campaigns and mobilisation has severely strained public finances,” Omer Moav, a professor of economics at the University of Warwick and at Reichman University, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 华威大学和赖希曼大学经济学教授奥马尔·莫阿夫告诉半岛电视台：“军事行动和动员的成本使公共财政严重紧张。”

paras.en: “Deficits and national debt have expanded significantly, making current spending trajectories unsustainable without fiscal consolidation,” Moav said.
paras.zh: 莫阿夫表示：“赤字和国债大幅扩大，如果不进行财政整顿，当前的支出轨迹将难以为继。”

paras.en: “The next government is facing a huge challenge.”
paras.zh: “下一届政府面临着巨大的挑战。”

paras.en: Regardless of who prevails in the election, economists say, Israel’s economic prospects will in large part hinge on whether conflict in the region escalates or subsides.
paras.zh: 经济学家表示，无论谁在选举中获胜，以色列的经济前景在很大程度上取决于该地区的冲突是升级还是平息。

paras.en: “We expect growth to reach around 4 percent in 2026 and to exceed this level in 2027,” said Uziyel, the EIU analyst.
paras.zh: EIU 分析师 Uziyel 表示：“我们预计 2026 年增长率将达到 4% 左右，并在 2027 年超过这一水平。”

paras.en: “However, significant downside risks to growth remain should conflicts in Gaza, Iran, or on the Lebanon front resume.”
paras.zh: “然而，如果加沙、伊朗或黎巴嫩前线的冲突重新爆发，经济增长面临的重大下行风险仍然存在。”

paras.en: “The outlook depends greatly on the security situation,” said Kimhi of the Shoresh Institution for Socioeconomic Research.
paras.zh: “前景在很大程度上取决于安全局势，”肖雷什社会经济研究所的金希说。

paras.en: “If we are able to put an end to the war and reduce military spending, the future could be bright.”
paras.zh: “如果我们能够结束战争并减少军费开支，未来将会是光明的。”

articles.title: US hosts ‘productive’ trilateral talks to end Russia-Ukraine war

paras.en: United States, Ukrainian and European officials have met in Miami, Florida, to discuss a proposal for ending the Russia-Ukraine war, US envoy Steve Witkoff said in a statement posted to X.
paras.zh: 美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫在发给 X 的一份声明中表示，美国、乌克兰和欧洲官员在佛罗里达州迈阿密会面，讨论结束俄罗斯-乌克兰战争的提议。

paras.en: Witkoff said on Friday that “constructive discussions” tackled “potential avenues to de-escalate and conclude the war with Russia ahead of winter and advance efforts toward a durable and lasting peace”.
paras.zh: 威特科夫周五表示，“建设性讨论”解决了“在冬季之前缓和并结束与俄罗斯的战争并推进实现持久和平的努力的潜在途径”。

paras.en: Witkoff said the meeting included “the E3, the European Commission, Ukraine and NATO”.
paras.zh: 维特科夫表示，此次会议包括“欧洲三国、欧盟委员会、乌克兰和北约”。

paras.en: The discussions covered energy resilience, grain exports, security guarantees and “longer-term arrangements for Ukraine’s and Europe’s security to prevent future conflict”, Witkoff said.
paras.zh: 维特科夫表示，讨论内容涵盖能源弹性、粮食出口、安全保障以及“为乌克兰和欧洲安全防止未来冲突的长期安排”。

paras.en: He also noted the “productive” talks discussed “Ukraine’s post-war reconstruction and economic prosperity, including EU accession”.
paras.zh: 他还指出，“富有成效”的会谈讨论了“乌克兰的战后重建和经济繁荣，包括加入欧盟”。

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Thursday the conflict had reached a dangerous “stalemate”, with the failure to reach a negotiated settlement raising the risk of further escalation.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥周四表示，冲突已陷入危险的“僵局”，未能通过谈判达成解决方案增加了冲突进一步升级的风险。

paras.en: “The other way that stalemates end is through escalation,” Rubio told reporters, warning that the conflict could spread to neighbouring NATO countries.
paras.zh: 卢比奥告诉记者：“结束僵局的另一种方式是升级。”他警告说，冲突可能会蔓延到邻近的北约国家。

paras.en: Earlier on Friday, Russian President Vladimir Putin told US President Donald Trump that the resumption of talks with Ukraine is unlikely, citing drone attacks on Moscow during parliamentary elections last month.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京告诉美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，不太可能恢复与乌克兰的谈判，理由是上个月议会选举期间莫斯科遭到无人机袭击。

paras.en: The renewed diplomacy comes against a backdrop of deadly Russian attacks, including a strike on civilian buses in eastern Ukraine that killed 33 people. Authorities said the attack was the single deadliest attack this year.
paras.zh: 新的外交是在俄罗斯发生致命袭击的背景下进行的，其中包括对乌克兰东部民用巴士的袭击，造成 33 人死亡。当局表示，这次袭击是今年最致命的一次袭击。

paras.en: The ongoing talks have been overshadowed by the US-Russia diesel deal on Friday. Trump blamed Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries for surging diesel prices.
paras.zh: 周五的美俄柴油协议给正在进行的谈判蒙上了阴影。特朗普将柴油价格飙升归咎于乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击。

paras.en: The deal was criticised by US lawmakers, Zelenskyy and European allies.
paras.zh: 该协议遭到美国议员、泽伦斯基和欧洲盟友的批评。

paras.en: Zelenskyy called the agreement a “gift to Putin”. Hours after the deal, a Ukrainian drone hit a Russian fuel site.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基称该协议是“给普京的礼物”。协议达成数小时后，一架乌克兰无人机袭击了俄罗斯的一个加油站。

paras.en: The Miami meeting follows visits to Moscow and Kyiv last month by Witkoff and Jared Kushner, as Washington seeks to revive negotiations that have yielded little progress.
paras.zh: 迈阿密会议是在威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳上个月访问莫斯科和基辅之后举行的，华盛顿寻求重启几乎没有取得进展的谈判。

articles.title: India protest live: Police detain Cockroach leaders, New Delhi in lockdown

paras.en: India protest live: Police detain Cockroach leaders, New Delhi in lockdown
paras.zh: 印度现场抗议：警方拘留蟑螂头目，新德里处于封锁状态

paras.en: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and other leaders detained before protest to demand election chief’s resignation.
paras.zh: 蟑螂简塔党创始人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 和其他领导人在抗议要求选举负责人辞职之前被拘留。

paras.en: Police in the Indian capital have detained the founder of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), Abhijeet Dipke, before a protest called by the youth movement demanding the resignation of the chief election commissioner over alleged voter list fraud.
paras.zh: 印度首都蟑螂简塔党 (CJP) 创始人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 被警方拘留，青年运动发起抗议，要求首席选举专员因涉嫌选民名单欺诈而辞职。

paras.en: Thousands of security forces have been deployed and travel and telecoms links suspended as New Delhi is in a virtual lockdown to stop the youth protest.
paras.zh: 为了阻止青年抗议活动，新德里实际上处于封锁状态，因此部署了数千名安全部队，并暂停了旅行和电信联系。

articles.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
paras.zh: 特朗普表示美国将从俄罗斯购买柴油，缓解莫斯科在中期选举前降低价格的压力

paras.en: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump said he has struck a deal to obtain diesel from Russia, a stunning reversal of years of U.S. pressure on Moscow over its war with Ukraine and an attempt to address high fuel prices ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.
paras.zh: 华盛顿（美联社）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他已达成协议，从俄罗斯获取柴油，这是美国多年来因乌克兰战争向莫斯科施压的惊人逆转，也是美国中期选举前解决高油价问题的尝试。

paras.en: Trump said on social media on Friday that he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call in which he was expected to discuss a suspected case of plague in Russia. Instead, Trump announced that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel, followed by an additional 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons "immediately thereafter." Russia will deliver an additional 3 million tons "within a short period of time" after that, he wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普周五在社交媒体上表示，他与俄罗斯总统普京在电话中达成了协议，预计他将在电话中讨论俄罗斯疑似鼠疫病例。相反，特朗普宣布俄罗斯将立即供应超过30万吨柴油，随后在11月额外供应50万吨，“此后立即”供应100万吨。他写道，此后俄罗斯将“在短时间内”额外交付300万吨。

paras.en: Trump's shocking announcement comes after he signed a sweeping Russia sanctions law last month that aimed at clamping down on Russia's energy revenues, among other areas, that fuel its war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月签署了一项全面的俄罗斯制裁法，旨在限制俄罗斯的能源收入以及其他助长其对乌克兰战争的领域，随后特朗普发布了这一令人震惊的声明。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called it, "a weak decision, unfortunately, a weak decision by strong partners," according to a statement released by the Ukrainian Embassy in Washington.
paras.zh: 根据乌克兰驻华盛顿大使馆发布的一份声明，乌克兰总统泽连斯基称其为“不幸的是，这是一个软弱的决定，是强大合作伙伴做出的软弱决定”。

paras.en: Trump's announced the deal as his envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner were meeting with Ukrainian officials to discuss a proposal to try to end the Russia-Ukraine war.
paras.zh: 特朗普宣布这项协议之际，他的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和女婿贾里德·库什纳正在与乌克兰官员会面，讨论试图结束俄罗斯-乌克兰战争的提议。

paras.en: "I believe our team is simply being used as a smokescreen. And that is certainly not fair. It is certainly not how partners should treat each other," Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: “我认为我们的团队只是被用作烟幕弹。这当然不公平。这当然不是合作伙伴应该如何对待彼此，”泽伦斯基说。

paras.en: Trump's move casts doubt on the likelihood of the White House imposing sanctions on Russia this month, given that a bipartisan law passed by Congress directs the administration to target the top importers of Russian oil and gas.
paras.zh: 鉴于国会通过的两党法律指示政府针对俄罗斯石油和天然气的最大进口商，特朗普的举动让人怀疑白宫本月对俄罗斯实施制裁的可能性。

paras.en: Trump, in his announcement, did not address the sanctions or Russia's war but said, "Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority."
paras.zh: 特朗普在声明中没有提及制裁或俄罗斯战争，但表示，“为美国人，特别是我们伟大的农民、牧场主和卡车司机降低价格，是我的首要任务。”

paras.en: Washington and Moscow offer few details on deal
paras.zh: 华盛顿和莫斯科提供的交易细节很少

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to questions about who was paying for the diesel from Russia and when the fuel being supplied under the agreement would become available. It also did not clarify whether subsequent supplies of Russian diesel set to come next month would be supplied prior to Election Day on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应有关谁支付俄罗斯柴油费用以及协议规定的燃料何时供应的问题。它还没有澄清下个月供应的俄罗斯柴油是否会在 11 月 3 日选举日之前供应。

paras.en: Gas prices globally have surged as the war in Iran upends the energy sector. While diesel futures prices dipped on Friday's news, the national average price per gallon of diesel in the U.S. was still $6.23, according to AAA, after hitting a record $6.52 on Sept. 22.
paras.zh: 随着伊朗战争颠覆能源行业，全球天然气价格飙升。虽然柴油期货价格因周五的消息而下跌，但根据 AAA 的数据，美国每加仑柴油的全国平均价格在 9 月 22 日触及创纪录的 6.52 美元后仍为 6.23 美元。

paras.en: A statement from Putin, released by the Kremlin on Friday, said that during their call he and Trump dedicated "significant attention to the prospects of resolving the Ukrainian crisis" and also discussed "the situation around Iran and various aspects of bilateral relations."
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周五发布的普京声明称，他和特朗普在通话中“高度关注解决乌克兰危机的前景”，并讨论了“伊朗周边局势和双边关系的各个方面”。

paras.en: Russia "confirmed its readiness to supply oil and oil products to the American and global markets," Putin said. "I am confident that this will have a positive impact on the entire global economy."
paras.zh: 普京表示，俄罗斯“确认愿意向美国和全球市场供应石油和石油产品”。 “我相信这将对整个全球经济产生积极影响。”

paras.en: The two leaders agreed to continue contacts, Putin said in the statement.
paras.zh: 普京在声明中表示，两国领导人同意继续接触。

paras.en: Trump and Putin's deal draws immediate backlash
paras.zh: 特朗普和普京的协议立即引起强烈反对

paras.en: Zelenskyy, in a lengthy post online reacting to the deal, said Russia would repay it "with further terror and perfidy." He cast it as an investment in the war, allowing it to be prolonged.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在网上发表了一篇长文对该协议作出反应，称俄罗斯将“以进一步的恐怖和背信弃义”来报复。他将其视为对战争的投资，让战争得以延长。

paras.en: "It plays into Russia's hands — allowing it to kill more, wage war for longer, have even less respect for America, and inflict even greater losses and damage on the world," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这正中俄罗斯的下怀——让它杀人更多，战争时间更长，对美国的尊重更少，给世界造成更大的损失和损害。”

paras.en: Rep. Don Beyer, the senior House Democrat on the Joint Economic Committee, called Trump's announcement "infuriating."
paras.zh: 众议院联合经济委员会资深民主党众议员唐·拜尔 (Don Beyer) 称特朗普的声明“令人愤怒”。

paras.en: "This is what we warned anyone who would listen: Trump isn't the slightest bit trustworthy when it comes to Russia," Beyer said in a statement on X. "Giving him expanded tariff powers in hopes he would use them to help Ukraine was a mistake. Now he's lifting sanctions on Russian fossil fuels."
paras.zh: 拜尔在 X 网站的一份声明中表示：“这就是我们警告任何愿意倾听的人的警告：特朗普在俄罗斯问题上一点也不值得信任。给予他更大的关税权力，希望他能利用这些权力来帮助乌克兰，这是一个错误。现在他正在取消对俄罗斯化石燃料的制裁。”

paras.en: The law Trump signed last month envisions sanctions on Russian officials, banks and a shadow fleet of tankers and bans all new U.S. investment in Russia and the handling of sovereign debt.
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月签署的法律设想对俄罗斯官员、银行和影子油轮舰队实施制裁，并禁止美国在俄罗斯的所有新投资和处理主权债务。

paras.en: It also directed Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on the top five importers of Russian oil or natural gas, with an exception for countries that import less than 15% of Russia's natural gas exports and have taken significant steps to reduce those imports.
paras.zh: 它还指示特朗普对俄罗斯石油或天然气的前五名进口国征收高达100%的关税，但进口量低于俄罗斯天然气出口量15%并已采取重大措施减少进口的国家除外。

paras.en: The U.S. has not imported Russian oil or gas since 2022, when the Biden administration banned them because of Moscow's invasion of Ukraine, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration.
paras.zh: 据美国能源情报署称，自 2022 年拜登政府因莫斯科入侵乌克兰而禁止进口俄罗斯石油或天然气以来，美国就不再进口俄罗斯石油或天然气。

paras.en: Treasury Department moves to ease diesel sanctions for six months
paras.zh: 财政部采取行动放松柴油制裁六个月

paras.en: Shortly after Trump made the announcement, the Treasury Department said it was immediately issuing a temporary license allowing Russian diesel to be supplied to the global market.
paras.zh: 特朗普宣布这一消息后不久，美国财政部表示将立即颁发临时许可证，允许俄罗斯柴油向全球市场供应。

paras.en: This is the latest in several licenses the U.S. Treasury has issued regarding Russian fuel shipments since the start of the Iran war earlier this year. But it is the first such license to ease sanctions on diesel for a period lasting longer than the standard 30-day window since the start of the Ukraine war.
paras.zh: 这是自今年早些时候伊朗战争爆发以来，美国财政部就俄罗斯燃料运输颁发的几项许可证中的最新一份。但这是自乌克兰战争爆发以来第一个放宽对柴油制裁的许可证，其持续时间超过标准的 30 天窗口。

paras.en: The new so-called general license means U.S. sanctions will not apply until April 2027 on deliveries of Russian diesel that has been loaded onto tankers as of Friday. The department extended similar easing of sanctions in March and April even though Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had ruled out such a move earlier in the year.
paras.zh: 新的所谓通用许可证意味着美国的制裁要到 2027 年 4 月才会适用于截至周五已装载到油轮上的俄罗斯柴油。尽管财政部长斯科特·贝森特（Scott Bessent）今年早些时候排除了采取此类举措的可能性，但该部门在 3 月和 4 月延长了类似的放松制裁措施。

paras.en: The extensions continue to underscore how the fallout from the Iran war has boosted Moscow's ability to profit from its energy exports, which had been restrained by the U.S. and other allies since the invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这些延期继续凸显出伊朗战争的影响如何增强了莫斯科从能源出口中获利的能力，自入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯的能源出口一直受到美国和其他盟国的限制。

paras.en: Russia, once a major exporter of diesel, has banned exports since July as it has struggled to meet demand inside the country because of Ukraine's repeated attacks on Russian oil refineries. The International Energy Agency says Russian diesel output has fallen by about 30%.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯曾经是柴油主要出口国，由于乌克兰多次袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，俄罗斯难以满足国内需求，自7月以来已禁止出口。国际能源署表示，俄罗斯柴油产量已下降约30%。

paras.en: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak told state news agency Tass that Russia is "immediately starting to lift restrictions on diesel exports ahead of schedule." He said that Moscow could start supplies to the U.S. already in October, and that Russia's domestic market will be "fully supplied" with diesel, as well.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯副总理亚历山大·诺瓦克对国家通讯社塔斯社表示，俄罗斯“立即开始提前取消对柴油出口的限制”。他表示，莫斯科可能已于十月份开始向美国供应柴油，俄罗斯国内市场也将“充分供应”柴油。

articles.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
articles.author: Kate Bartlett

paras.en: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
paras.zh: 南非人权律师纳维·皮莱荣获诺贝尔和平奖

paras.en: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.
paras.zh: 南非人权律师纳维·皮莱因其毕生捍卫人权和国际法而荣获 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: A South African lawyer who began her career defending Nelson Mandela and fighting apartheid has been awarded this year's Nobel Peace Prize. At 85, Navi Pillay is being recognized for a lifetime defending human rights and strengthening international law, which the Nobel Committee says is now under threat. The announcement came just hours before the Trump administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, an institution that the president has long criticized and where Pillay used to work. Kate Bartlett in Johannesburg has more.
paras.zh: 一位南非律师因捍卫纳尔逊·曼德拉和反对种族隔离而开始了她的职业生涯，她被授予今年的诺贝尔和平奖。 85 岁高龄的纳维·皮莱因终生捍卫人权和加强国际法而受到表彰，诺贝尔委员会表示，国际法目前正受到威胁。这一消息是在特朗普政府对国际刑事法院实施制裁前几个小时宣布的。国际刑事法院是总统长期以来批评的机构，也是皮莱曾经工作过的机构。约翰内斯堡的凯特·巴特利特 (Kate Bartlett) 还有更多。

paras.en: KATE BARTLETT, BYLINE: Last year's Nobel Peace Prize winner, Venezuelan opposition politician Maria Corina Machado, famously gave her prize to President Trump, who has often said he deserves to win it.
paras.zh: 凯特·巴特利特连线：去年的诺贝尔和平奖获得者、委内瑞拉反对派政治家玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多将她的和平奖颁给了特朗普总统，而特朗普总统经常表示他理应获奖。

paras.en: BARTLETT: This year's winner, Navi Pillay, joked she could follow suit.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：今年的获胜者纳维·皮莱开玩笑说她可以效仿。

paras.en: BARTLETT: But all jokes aside, Nobel Committee Chair Jorgen Watne Frydnes said Pillay had been awarded the prize for her major role in establishing the global legal order, which he said was now under attack.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：抛开所有笑话不谈，诺贝尔委员会主席约尔根·瓦特纳·弗里德内斯表示，皮莱因在建立全球法律秩序方面发挥的重要作用而获奖，他说全球法律秩序现在正受到攻击。

paras.en: JORGEN WATNE FRYDNES: The institutions that uphold international law is under tremendous pressure, sanctions and attack in the world we are living in with more conflicts in - than in a long time.
paras.zh: JORGEN WATNE FRYDNES：在我们生活的世界中，维护国际法的机构面临着巨大的压力、制裁和攻击，这个世界的冲突数量比以往任何时候都多。

paras.en: BARTLETT: Fittingly for a woman who's dedicated her life to bringing war criminals to justice, Pillay learned she had won while attending a conference in Nuremberg, Germany, where top Nazis were tried after the Holocaust. In remarks to the press, she echoed the Nobel Committee's warning about threats to the legal order.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：对于一位毕生致力于将战犯绳之以法的女性来说，皮莱是在参加德国纽伦堡的一次会议时得知自己赢得了胜利，纳粹高层在大屠杀后在那里受到了审判。在向新闻界发表的讲话中，她呼应了诺贝尔委员会关于法律秩序受到威胁的警告。

paras.en: PILLAY: This worsening reality is particularly visible with the attacks on the International Criminal Court.
paras.zh: 皮莱：这种日益恶化的现实在国际刑事法院遭受的袭击中尤为明显。

paras.en: BARTLETT: Hours after her remarks, in an announcement that had been long anticipated, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the U.S. was imposing sanctions on the war crimes tribunal in the Hague, calling it a rogue court.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：在她发表讲话数小时后，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在一份期待已久的声明中表示，美国正在对海牙战争罪法庭实施制裁，称其为流氓法庭。

paras.en: MARCO RUBIO: America never joined the court. We don't need that court, and we don't want it.
paras.zh: 马可·卢比奥：美国从未加入过法庭。我们不需要那个法庭，我们也不想要它。

paras.en: BARTLETT: President Trump has long railed against the ICC, which has issued arrest warrants for Russia's Vladimir Putin related to the invasion of Ukraine and Israel's prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu over the war in Gaza. Netanyahu slammed Pillay's Peace Prize win in a statement on Friday because she recently oversaw a U.N. Commission report that concluded Israel had committed genocide in Gaza, a charge Israel denies. Netanyahu said the Nobel committee had, quote, "lost its moral compass." But her home country, South Africa, applauded Pillay's milestone.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：特朗普总统长期以来一直指责国际刑事法院，该国际刑事法院已对与入侵乌克兰有关的俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和因加沙战争而对以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡发出了逮捕令。内塔尼亚胡在周五的一份声明中猛烈抨击皮莱获得和平奖，因为她最近监督了联合国委员会的一份报告，该报告得出的结论是以色列在加沙实施了种族灭绝，但以色列否认了这一指控。内塔尼亚胡表示，诺贝尔委员会“失去了道德指南针”。但她的祖国南非对皮莱的里程碑表示赞赏。

paras.en: ROELF MEYER: Congratulations to her because it's - she is the fifth South African to receive the Nobel Prize and the first woman.
paras.zh: ROELF MEYER：祝贺她，因为她是第五位获得诺贝尔奖的南非人，也是第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性。

paras.en: BARTLETT: South Africa's new ambassador to Washington, Roelf Meyer, was among those celebrating the achievement. Pillay joins fellow South African laureates Albert Lutuli and Archbishop Desmond Tutu, as well as Nelson Mandela and F.W. de Klerk, who shared the prize in 1993 for their role in ending apartheid.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：南非新任驻华盛顿大使罗尔夫·迈耶 (Roelf Meyer) 是庆祝这一成就的人之一。皮莱与南非获奖者阿尔伯特·卢图利 (Albert Lutuli) 和大主教德斯蒙德·图图 (Desmond Tutu) 以及纳尔逊·曼德拉 (Nelson Mandela) 和 F.W. 德克勒克 (F.W. de Klerk) 一起获奖，他们于 1993 年因在结束种族隔离方面的贡献而分享了这一奖项。

paras.en: MEYER: We are - South Africans are very, very proud of her. Navi Pillay made us very proud.
paras.zh: 迈耶：我们——南非人为她感到非常非常自豪。纳维·皮莱让我们感到非常自豪。

paras.en: BARTLETT: Meyer told NPR she was a product of the South African legal order that was established at the start of democracy following the end of apartheid. But Pillay's award comes amid a diplomatic low point between the U.S. and South Africa. President Trump has falsely accused the government of persecuting its white minority and criticized its genocide case against Israel. Kate Bartlett, NPR News, Johannesburg.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：迈耶告诉美国国家公共广播电台，她是南非法律秩序的产物，该秩序是在种族隔离结束后民主开始时建立的。但皮莱的获奖正值美国和南非之间的外交低谷之际。特朗普总统错误地指责政府迫害白人少数群体，并批评其针对以色列的种族灭绝案。凯特·巴特利特，美国国家公共广播电台新闻，约翰内斯堡。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Trump brings Mike Tyson on stage at Syracuse rally, jokes that he is Bruce Blakeman's personal security

paras.en: President Donald Trump was in his home state of New York, this time in Syracuse, to campaign for Bruce Blakeman, the Republican candidate for the state's gubernatorial election.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在他的家乡纽约州，这次是在锡拉丘兹，为共和党候选人布鲁斯·布莱克曼竞选该州州长选举。

paras.en: Trump though had a special guest in Mike Tyson, who visited the White House earlier in the day and took the trip to Syracuse on Air Force One alongside Trump.
paras.zh: 不过，特朗普有一位特邀嘉宾迈克·泰森，他当天早些时候访问了白宫，并与特朗普一起乘坐空军一号前往锡拉丘兹。

paras.en: While Trump was campaigning for Blakeman, he shouted Tyson and his physical stature out.
paras.zh: 当特朗普为布莱克曼竞选时，他大喊泰森和他的身材。

paras.en: "I see somebody in the audience that I will never fight, I promise. But I remember when Mike [Tyson] was in his prime, when he was the heavyweight champion of the world. He’d stand in the corner and his people would all be holding him back. He wanted to kill whoever it was," Trump said. He was a very dangerous person actually, and he was one of the greatest fighters in history."
paras.zh: “我看到观众中有人说我永远不会战斗，我保证。但我记得当迈克（泰森）处于巅峰时期，当时他是世界重量级冠军。他站在角落里，他的人民都会阻止他。他想杀死无论是谁，”特朗普说。实际上他是一个非常危险的人，他是历史上最伟大的战士之一。”

paras.en: Trump then cracked a joke that Tyson was there to protect Blakeman.
paras.zh: 特朗普随后开玩笑说泰森是为了保护布莱克曼。

paras.en: "I see him standing right next to Bruce Blakeman. Bruce wants a little protection, he’s got the right guy. Bruce knows who to stand near," Trump said.
paras.zh: “我看到他就站在布鲁斯·布莱克曼旁边。布鲁斯想要一点保护，他找到了合适的人选。布鲁斯知道该站在谁附近，”特朗普说。

paras.en: "Thank you very much. I'm just happy to be here with my president, President Trump, and there's no way in the world I would ever be here if it wasn't for a president like Donald Trump. Thank you," Tyson said.
paras.zh: “非常感谢。我很高兴能和我的总统特朗普总统在一起，如果没有像唐纳德·特朗普这样的总统，我不可能在这里。谢谢你，”泰森说。

paras.en: "I watched him get in the ring many times. He was a scary guy. I think he looks better now than he did 30 years ago," Trump said when Tyson left the stage. "What the hell are you doing, Mike?"
paras.zh: “我多次看过他上擂台。他是一个可怕的家伙。我认为他现在看起来比 30 年前更好，”泰森离开舞台时特朗普说道。 “你到底在做什么，迈克？”

paras.en: Trump and Tyson were also joined by New York Yankees president Randy Levine, two days after the Bombers were swept in the American League Division Series. Trump made mention of the postseason loss, but joked that it didn't matter, because "he's won so much, it's not going to matter."
paras.zh: 纽约洋基队主席兰迪·莱文也加入了特朗普和泰森的行列，两天前，纽约洋基队在美国联盟分区系列赛中被横扫。特朗普提到了季后赛失利，但开玩笑说这并不重要，因为“他赢了这么多，这并不重要。”

paras.en: Blakeman will be vying to take Kathy Hochul out of office. Hochul has been the state's governor since August 2021.
paras.zh: 布莱克曼将力争将凯西·霍赫尔赶下台。 Hochul 自 2021 年 8 月起担任该州州长。

paras.en: Trump made the trip before he was originally slated to attend Saturday's Alabama-Georgia game in Tuscaloosa, but Hurricane Isaias ruined those plans, the White House announced Friday.
paras.zh: 白宫周五宣布，特朗普原本计划参加周六在塔斯卡卢萨举行的阿拉巴马州与佐治亚州的比赛，但飓风伊萨亚斯破坏了这些计划。

articles.title: An NYC Curse: Rangers top goalie dragged off ice as New York sports nightmare deepens

paras.en: The New York Rangers could be in a tough spot after star goaltender Igor Shesterkin exited Friday night's game with what appeared to be a lower-body injury and needed to be helped off the ice.
paras.zh: 明星守门员伊戈尔·谢斯特金因下半身受伤退出比赛并需要帮助离开冰场后，纽约游骑兵队可能陷入困境。

paras.en: The Rangers have been off to a hot start this season and came into Friday night's game against the Washington Capitals leading the Eastern Conference.
paras.zh: 流浪者队本赛季开局火热，并在周五晚上对阵东部联盟领先的华盛顿首都队的比赛中。

paras.en: The 2021-22 Vezina Trophy winner came into the night with a 3-1 record on the year along with a solid .926 save percentage and 1.75 goals against average.
paras.zh: 这位 2021-22 赛季维齐纳奖杯得主以 3 胜 1 负的战绩、稳定的 0.926 扑救率和 1.75 个平均进球数进入当晚。

paras.en: As if that wasn't good enough, he also scored a goal back on Oct. 1.
paras.zh: 好像这还不够好，他还在 10 月 1 日打进了一球。

paras.en: But in the second period on Friday night, with the game tied at 1-1, Shesterkin found himself way out of position during a net-mouth scramble. He slid across the crease to the far post, but appeared to jam his right leg awkwardly against the post.
paras.zh: 但在周五晚上的第二节比赛中，双方战成1-1平，谢斯特金发现自己在网口争夺中完全失去了位置。他滑过折痕到达远门柱，但似乎将右腿笨拙地卡在了门柱上。

paras.en: Shesterkin was clearly in a lot of pain and needed to be helped off the ice by his teammates. It looked like he was unable to put weight on his right leg.
paras.zh: 谢斯特金显然非常痛苦，需要队友的帮助离开冰面。看起来他无法将重量放在右腿上。

paras.en: It was confirmed later in the game that he would not return.
paras.zh: 比赛后来证实他不会回来。

paras.en: Dylan Garand entered the game in relief, but had only four NHL games on his resume.
paras.zh: 迪伦·加兰德如释重负地进入了比赛，但他的履历上只打了四场 NHL 比赛。

paras.en: If you're a hockey fan, you know that losing Shesterkin for any period of time is a big problem for the Blueshirts.
paras.zh: 如果你是一名冰球迷，你就会知道，在任何一段时间内失去谢斯特金对于蓝衫队来说都是一个大问题。

paras.en: If you're not a hockey fan, just look at Rangers fans' faces when Shesterkin went down.
paras.zh: 如果你不是冰球迷，只要看看谢斯特金倒下时流浪者队球迷的表情就知道了。

paras.en: The team will be hoping it's not as bad as it looked, but it did start a discussion on social media: did the New York Knicks curse the rest of the city's teams?
paras.zh: 球队希望事情没有看起来那么糟糕，但它确实在社交媒体上引发了一场讨论：纽约尼克斯队是否诅咒了该市的其他球队？

paras.en: Because since the Knicks won an NBA title, injuries have befallen Yankees star Aaron Judge and Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart.
paras.zh: 因为自从尼克斯队夺得NBA总冠军以来，洋基队球星亚伦·贾奇和巨人队四分卫杰克森·达特都遭遇了伤病。

paras.en: Now, they could be adding Shesterkin to that list of key players who went down with injury.
paras.zh: 现在，他们可能会将谢斯特金添加到因伤缺阵的关键球员名单中。

paras.en: Of course, they'll take it one step at a time, and while Garand played pretty well after coming into the game, Boone Jenner was able to sneak one past him late in the second, and that proved to be the game-winner.
paras.zh: 当然，他们会一步一个脚印，虽然加兰德在上场后打得相当不错，但布恩·詹纳在第二节后期偷偷超越了他，事实证明这是比赛的胜利者。

articles.title: Trump rallies New York crowd for Republican Bruce Blakeman's bid to replace Gov. Kathy Hochul

paras.en: President Donald Trump returned to his home state of New York on Friday night, showcasing America's "New Golden Age" and promising to help Republican gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman flip the Empire State red as the GOP makes its final push toward November's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，唐纳德·特朗普总统返回家乡纽约州，展示了美国的“新黄金时代”，并承诺帮助共和党州长候选人布鲁斯·布莱克曼在共和党为 11 月中期选举做最后的努力之际，帮助共和党州长候选人布鲁斯·布莱克曼将纽约州变成红色。

paras.en: Trump rallied supporters in Syracuse with a sweeping celebration of his administration's economic and immigration agenda, pledging to help New Yorkers secure lower taxes, cheaper energy and safer streets by electing Republicans up and down the ballot.
paras.zh: 特朗普在锡拉丘兹集结支持者，大规模庆祝其政府的经济和移民议程，承诺通过在选票上选举共和党人来帮助纽约人获得更低的税收、更便宜的能源和更安全的街道。

paras.en: "We're in the Golden Age of America," Trump told the crowd, urging supporters to deliver the same enthusiasm that powered his presidential campaigns.
paras.zh: “我们正处于美国的黄金时代，”特朗普对人群说道，并敦促支持者表现出与他的总统竞选活动相同的热情。

paras.en: "Please pretend I'm on the freaking ballot," Trump urged. "And in a really, in a certain way, I am on the ballot because they can take away everything that we, that we got."
paras.zh: “请假装我参加了该死的选票，”特朗普敦促道。 “在某种程度上，我参与了选票，因为他们可以夺走我们所拥有的一切。”

paras.en: The president took Blakeman's challenge to Democrat Gov. Kathy Hochul as the centerpiece of the rally, promising direct support from Washington if elected.
paras.zh: 总统将布莱克曼对民主党州长凯西·霍赫尔的挑战作为集会的核心，并承诺如果当选将得到华盛顿的直接支持。

paras.en: "[Blakeman will] save this state. He'll turn the state around and I'll help him from the White House," Trump said. "I'll be helping him for governor."
paras.zh: “（布莱克曼）将拯救这个州。他将扭转这个州的局面，我将在白宫帮助他，”特朗普说。 “我会帮助他竞选州长。”

paras.en: Trump blasted Hochul over New York's taxes, utility bills and public safety, arguing that Blakeman could unleash the state's economic potential by embracing domestic energy production and cutting costs for families.
paras.zh: 特朗普就纽约的税收、公用事业账单和公共安全问题抨击了霍赫尔，认为布莱克曼可以通过支持国内能源生产和削减家庭成本来释放该州的经济潜力。

paras.en: The president also hailed his administration's economic agenda as proof of what Trump described as a remarkable national turnaround.
paras.zh: 总统还称赞他的政府的经济议程证明了特朗普所称的全国非凡的转变。

paras.en: He singled out Micron's planned $100 billion semiconductor complex in central New York, a project the company says is expected to generate 50,000 jobs across the state, including 9,000 directly with Micron.
paras.zh: 他特别提到了美光科技计划在纽约市中心投资 1000 亿美元的半导体综合体，该公司表示，该项目预计将为全州创造 50,000 个就业岗位，其中包括直接与美光科技合作的 9,000 个就业岗位。

paras.en: "This will soon be the home to the largest semiconductor manufacturing facility ever built in the Western Hemisphere," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示：“这里很快将成为西半球有史以来最大的半导体制造工厂的所在地。”

paras.en: Blakeman joined Trump onstage and echoed the president's message of a Republican resurgence, promising to cut taxes and utility bills, focus on public safety and make New York more attractive to both businesses and families.
paras.zh: 布莱克曼与特朗普一起上台，呼应了总统关于共和党复兴的信息，承诺削减税收和水电费，关注公共安全，并使纽约对企业和家庭更具吸引力。

paras.en: "We have to create good jobs, good benefits to keep our young people here," Blakeman said. "We gotta look at business not as the enemy, but as a partner."
paras.zh: 布莱克曼说：“我们必须创造良好的就业机会和良好的福利，才能让我们的年轻人留在这里。” “我们不能将企业视为敌人，而是视为合作伙伴。”

paras.en: Trump also threw his support behind Republican congressional candidates Kailee Buller, who is challenging Democrat Rep. John Mannion in New York's 22nd District, and Anthony Constantino, who is running for the state's open 21st District seat, pledging to help Republicans compete for both seats.
paras.zh: 特朗普还支持共和党国会候选人凯莉·布勒(Kailee Buller)和安东尼·康斯坦丁(Anthony Constantino)，凯莉·布勒正在纽约第22选区挑战民主党众议员约翰·曼尼恩，安东尼·康斯坦丁正在竞选该州第21选区的空缺席位，并承诺帮助共和党争夺这两个席位。

paras.en: The rally also notably featured a brief but memorable on-stage appearance by legendary former heavyweight boxing champion Mike Tyson, whom Trump invited up before the crowd.
paras.zh: 这次集会还特别邀请了传奇的前重量级拳击冠军迈克·泰森在舞台上短暂但令人难忘的亮相，特朗普在人群面前邀请了他。

paras.en: "I'm just happy to be up here with my president, President Trump," Tyson said. "And, there's no way in the world I would ever be here if it wasn't for a president like Donald Trump. Thank you. Thank you very much."
paras.zh: “我很高兴能和我的总统特朗普总统一起站在这里，”泰森说。 “而且，如果没有像唐纳德·特朗普这样的总统，我根本不可能站在这里。谢谢你。非常感谢你。”

paras.en: Trump responded with a laugh, recalling Tyson's notorious reputation.
paras.zh: 特朗普回想起泰森臭名昭著的名声，笑着回应。

paras.en: "I don't want to fight him," Trump joked, before complimenting the former champion. "You look good. Mike. What the h— are you doing?"
paras.zh: “我不想和他战斗，”特朗普开玩笑说，然后称赞了这位前冠军。 “你看起来不错。迈克。你到底在做什么？”

paras.en: With Election Day approaching, the president returned to his core message that Republicans need Trump supporters to make a roaring showing at the ballot box.
paras.zh: 随着选举日的临近，总统回到了他的核心信息，即共和党人需要特朗普的支持者在投票箱上表现出色。

paras.en: "We're going to elect a Republican House and Republican Senate," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我们将选出共和党众议院和共和党参议院。”

articles.title: Three men found guilty of murders of Australian surfer brothers and US friend in Mexico
articles.author: Graham Readfearn and Agence France-Press

paras.en: The parents of Australian surfing brothers murdered in Mexico have said “no outcome can ever undo this tragedy” after three men were convicted of the 2024 killings.
paras.zh: 在三名男子被判犯有 2024 年谋杀案后，在墨西哥被谋杀的澳大利亚冲浪兄弟的父母表示，“任何结果都无法挽回这场悲剧”。

paras.en: Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, aged 30 and 33 respectively, and their friend Carter Rhoad, 30, were on a surfing trip to Mexico’s Pacific coast when they were shot dead in Baja California state in a suspected robbery.
paras.zh: 分别30岁和33岁的澳大利亚兄弟杰克·罗宾逊和卡勒姆·罗宾逊以及他们30岁的朋友卡特·罗德在前往墨西哥太平洋海岸冲浪时在下加利福尼亚州因涉嫌抢劫被枪杀。

paras.en: The deaths of the trio sparked an outpouring of grief and condemnation in Australia and the United States.
paras.zh: 三人的死亡在澳大利亚和美国引发了巨大的悲痛和谴责。

paras.en: Jesus Gerardo – known as “El Kekas” – was accused of leading the attack. His surname has not been disclosed for legal reasons. He and two other defendants, Irineo Francisco and Angel Jesus, were found guilty on Friday local time.
paras.zh: 耶稣·赫拉多（Jesus Gerardo）——被称为“El Kekas”——被指控领导了这次袭击。出于法律原因，他的姓氏尚未公开。他和另外两名被告伊里内奥·弗朗西斯科（Irineo Francisco）和安吉尔·耶稣（Angel Jesus）于当地时间周五被判有罪。

paras.en: The judge ruled the three Mexican defendants acted with premeditation.
paras.zh: 法官裁定三名墨西哥被告有预谋。

paras.en: Martin and Debra Robinson, the brothers’ parents, travelled from Australia to the port city of Ensenada for the trial, which began on 7 September.
paras.zh: 兄弟俩的父母马丁·罗宾逊 (Martin Robinson) 和黛布拉·罗宾逊 (Debra Robinson) 从澳大利亚前往港口城市恩塞纳达 (Ensenada) 参加 9 月 7 日开始的审判。

paras.en: “They took our sons from our lives forever,” said Debra Robinson, who testified on the final day of the trial. “What hurts us most is that, in their final hours, they were treated with such cruelty.”
paras.zh: “他们永远夺走了我们的儿子，”在审判的最后一天作证的黛布拉·罗宾逊说。 “最让我们伤心的是，在他们生命的最后几个小时，他们受到了如此残酷的对待。”

paras.en: She burst into tears when the guilty verdict was pronounced.
paras.zh: 当宣判有罪时，她泪流满面。

paras.en: Speaking outside the court after the verdict, Martin Robinson thanked family and friends for their support, and also thanked the judge, court staff, the Australian embassy in Mexico and the Australian federal police.
paras.zh: 判决后，马丁·罗宾逊在法庭外发表讲话，感谢家人和朋友的支持，也感谢法官、法庭工作人员、澳大利亚驻墨西哥大使馆和澳大利亚联邦警察。

paras.en: He said: “No outcome can ever undo this tragedy, but we hope today marks an important step towards justice and allows us to continue honouring their lives and the extraordinary young men they were. They will never be forgotten.”
paras.zh: 他说：“任何结果都无法挽回这场悲剧，但我们希望今天标志着迈向正义的重要一步，让我们能够继续尊重他们的生命和他们非凡的年轻人。他们永远不会被忘记。”

paras.en: Debra Robinson said: “I don’t feel any different today as I did yesterday or I will tomorrow, because … Callum and Jake are not here. A verdict is a good thing, but it doesn’t bring them back.”
paras.zh: 黛布拉·罗宾逊说：“我今天和昨天没有感觉有什么不同，明天也不会，因为……卡勒姆和杰克不在这里。判决是一件好事，但并不能让他们回来。”

paras.en: She said she had no feelings towards the three guilty men. “I have tried to hold on to the memory of my children, my sons, and I try really not to think about them. And I don’t actually want them to have any notoriety. We don’t actually really speak their names. They’re not part of our grief really.”
paras.zh: 她说她对这三名有罪的男子没有感情。 “我试图保留对我的孩子、我的儿子们的记忆，我真的试着不去想他们。我实际上并不希望他们有任何恶名。我们实际上并没有真正说出他们的名字。他们真的不是我们悲伤的一部分。”

paras.en: Martin Robinson said a foundation in their sons’ names would carry on their legacy.
paras.zh: 马丁·罗宾逊表示，以他们儿子的名字命名的基金会将继承他们的遗产。

paras.en: The Callum and Jake Robinson Foundation aims to “help people live bigger, shine brighter and love harder in their honour”.
paras.zh: 卡勒姆和杰克·罗宾逊基金会的目标是“帮助人们生活得更美好、更耀眼、更努力地去爱，以纪念他们”。

paras.en: Rhoad’s mother, Page, and his fiance, Natalie Weirtz, also participated in the hearing in a video call from the United States.
paras.zh: 罗德的母亲佩奇和未婚夫娜塔莉·韦尔茨也从美国通过视频电话参加了听证会。

paras.en: “The accused are guilty and must be punished so that no other family suffers the same pain,” Weirtz said. “Since Carter’s death, I feel paranoid and isolated.”
paras.zh: 韦尔茨说：“被告有罪，必须受到惩罚，以免其他家庭遭受同样的痛苦。” “自从卡特去世后，我感到偏执和孤立。”

paras.en: The prosecution requested 210 years’ imprisonment for each of the accused, though the maximum sentence in Baja California is 60 years.
paras.zh: 检方要求对每名被告判处 210 年监禁，但下加利福尼亚州的最高刑期为 60 年。

paras.en: The surfers were camping in a remote beachside area when they were attacked in April 2024. Their bodies were found in a clifftop shaft, with gunshot wounds to their heads.
paras.zh: 2024 年 4 月，冲浪者在一个偏远的海滨地区露营时遭到袭击。他们的尸体在悬崖顶部的竖井中被发现，头部有枪伤。

paras.en: In November 2025, Ary Gisell Silva, the then-girlfriend of the main defendant, was sentenced to two decades in prison after admitting that she instigated the robbery.
paras.zh: 2025年11月，主被告时任女友阿里·吉塞尔·席尔瓦在承认自己煽动抢劫后，被判处二十年监禁。

paras.en: Baja California is one of Mexico’s most violent states, plagued by organised crime and drug trafficking, although cartel activity does not usually affect tourists. Other foreign visitors have, however, been targeted in criminal attacks on Mexico’s Pacific coast.
paras.zh: 下加利福尼亚州是墨西哥暴力最严重的州之一，深受有组织犯罪和毒品贩运的困扰，尽管卡特尔活动通常不会影响游客。然而，其他外国游客也成为墨西哥太平洋沿岸犯罪袭击的目标。

paras.en: Two Australian surfers, Dean Lucas and Adam Coleman, were killed in 2015 while travelling through the north-western state of Sinaloa. Their bodies were later burned.
paras.zh: 2015 年，两名澳大利亚冲浪运动员迪恩·卢卡斯 (Dean Lucas) 和亚当·科尔曼 (Adam Coleman) 在穿越西北部锡那罗亚州时丧生。他们的尸体后来被烧毁。

articles.title: Trump fumes over Nobel peace prize snub and criticizes Norway
articles.author: Robert Mackey

paras.en: Donald Trump complained Friday about not winning the Nobel peace prize for 2026, a year in which he started a war with Iran.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 周五抱怨自己未能获得 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖，这一年他与伊朗发动了战争。

paras.en: At what was supposed to be a rally for other Republican candidates in Syracuse, New York, the US president devoted a long portion of his speech airing his grievances with the Nobel committee.
paras.zh: 在纽约锡拉丘兹举行的其他共和党候选人集会上，这位美国总统用了很长一段演讲表达了他对诺贝尔委员会的不满。

paras.en: “The United States of America, represented by me as your president, should have received the Nobel peace prize, but didn’t. And this is an indelible stain on the country of Norway, and those people that made such a disgraceful and embarrassing decision,” Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“以我为总统的美利坚合众国本应获得诺贝尔和平奖，但没有。这是挪威国家以及那些做出如此可耻和尴尬决定的人不可磨灭的污点。”

paras.en: “The Nobel peace prize has been forever discredited by a handful of radical ideologues who are anti-democracy and really enemies of civilization,” Trump went on. “We will not forget, Norway, that you didn’t give this prize.”
paras.zh: 特朗普继续说道：“诺贝尔和平奖已经被少数反民主、真正是文明之敌的激进理论家永远抹黑了。” “挪威，我们不会忘记这个奖项不是你颁发的。”

paras.en: Trump also recited a list of wars he claims to have settled, some of which were not wars and some that are still not settled, before adding: “I’m about to settle or win two more: Iran and Russia-Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 特朗普还列举了他声称已经解决的战争清单，其中一些不是战争，还有一些尚未解决，然后补充道：“我即将解决或赢得另外两场战争：伊朗和俄罗斯-乌克兰。”

paras.en: Trump said he would be ending both wars “quickly”.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他将“迅速”结束这两场战争。

paras.en: “I will tell you what,” he added, darkly. “Iran will be very quick one way or the other: that they give us everything or they don’t exist any longer.”
paras.zh: “我会告诉你什么，”他阴沉地补充道。 “无论从哪方面来看，伊朗都会很快采取行动：他们会向我们提供一切，否则他们将不再存在。”

paras.en: “Additionally, I stopped Iran from having a nuclear weapon and blowing up the entire Middle East and ultimately far beyond the Middle East, including Europe, perhaps the US and I saved more lives than anyone in history,” Trump claimed, despite the fact that US intelligence agencies reported to Congress in 2025 that Iran had actually suspended its pursuit of nuclear weapons in 2003.
paras.zh: 特朗普声称，“此外，我阻止了伊朗拥有核武器并炸毁了整个中东，最终远远超出了中东，包括欧洲，也许还有美国，我比历史上任何人都拯救了更多的生命，”尽管美国情报机构于 2025 年向国会报告称，伊朗实际上已于 2003 年暂停了对核武器的追求。

paras.en: “Despite all of this and all of these unbelievable accomplishments, the Nobel prize was given out today to a liberal person who works at the United Nations, who nobody has ever heard of,” Trump said of Navi Pillay, the South African former UN human rights chief who chaired the UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza.
paras.zh: “尽管取得了所有这些以及所有这些令人难以置信的成就，诺贝尔奖今天还是颁发给了一位在联合国工作的自由派人士，没有人听说过他，”特朗普谈到南非前联合国人权事务负责人纳维·皮莱时说，他担任联合国委员会主席，该委员会得出了以色列在加沙犯下种族灭绝罪的结论。

articles.title: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die
articles.author: Shaun Walker

paras.en: Shortly after 1am one night in April 2019, a CIA officer on a work trip to London was jolted awake in his hotel room by the most intense head pain he had ever experienced. His body was soaked with sweat and he felt like his eyes were spinning in their sockets. He manoeuvred his way out of bed, hoping to make it to the bathroom to vomit, but found his sense of balance had deserted him. Eventually, he fell back into a fitful, shallow sleep.
paras.zh: 2019 年 4 月的一天晚上凌晨 1 点刚过，一名前往伦敦出差的中央情报局官员在酒店房间里被他经历过的最剧烈的头痛惊醒。他的全身都被汗水浸湿了，他感觉自己的眼睛在眼眶里打转。他从床上爬起来，希望能去卫生间呕吐，但发现平衡感已经消失。最终，他又陷入了断断续续的浅睡。

paras.en: The next day, arriving at the work meeting he had travelled for, the officer found he could not remember the names of colleagues in the room, people he knew well. As the meeting got under way, he could barely follow the discussion. Initially, he chalked it up to a terrible – if rather odd – case of food poisoning. But over subsequent weeks, worrying symptoms persisted: brain fog, loss of balance and increasingly harsh tinnitus.
paras.zh: 第二天，当他到达他去参加的工作会议时，这名官员发现他记不起房间里同事的名字，而这些人都是他熟悉的人。随着会议的进行，他几乎无法跟上讨论的内容。最初，他将其归咎于一起可怕的（尽管相当奇怪的）食物中毒事件。但在接下来的几周里，令人担忧的症状持续存在：脑雾、失去平衡和越来越刺耳的耳鸣。

paras.en: By September, he had started to feel better and was on another work trip, this time to Poland. Asleep in his Warsaw hotel room, he was again woken by terrifying head pain, even worse than in London. He later described the sensation as “someone standing over me with a baseball bat and just repeatedly hitting me on the head”. It was a nine or 10 on the pain scale, he felt, worse than anything he could remember.
paras.zh: 到了九月，他开始感觉好多了，并开始另一次出差，这次是去波兰。他在华沙酒店的房间里睡着了，再次被可怕的头痛惊醒，甚至比在伦敦更严重。他后来将这种感觉描述为“有人拿着棒球棒站在我身边，不断地击打我的头”。他感觉疼痛等级是九到十，比他记忆中的任何事情都要糟糕。

paras.en: Two hours later, the same feeling returned, and he started to suspect that what was happening might not be an internal process but rather some external attack. He dragged himself off the bed and curled up on the floor, where the intense pain subsided somewhat. That was the last time he had the “attack” sensation, but he went on to suffer chronic nerve pain, fatigue and other severe health problems for years.
