articles.title: Here’s a look at the Nobel Prizes for science
articles.author: Nikk Ogasa

paras.en: It’s Nobels season — that time of the year when we find out which groundbreaking, paradigm-shifting, world-changing achievements beat out the rest to win what is arguably the most prestigious award on Earth.
paras.zh: 现在是诺贝尔奖季——一年中的这个时候，我们会找出哪些突破性、范式转变、改变世界的成就击败其他成就，赢得可以说是地球上最负盛名的奖项。

paras.en: From a light switch for the brain to the discovery of an ultra-elusive subatomic particle hailing from beyond our solar system to a solution to one of the most enduring puzzles in all of organic chemistry, the researchers behind this year’s scientific prizes each revolutionized the ways that scientists understand the world around them.
paras.zh: 从大脑的光开关到发现来自太阳系之外的极其难以捉摸的亚原子粒子，再到解决有机化学中最持久的难题之一，今年科学奖项背后的研究人员都彻底改变了科学家理解周围世界的方式。

paras.en: Take a look at the science behind each of this year’s awards.
paras.zh: 看看今年每个奖项背后的科学原理。

paras.en: A galaxy of nearly 90 billion neurons exists within a single human brain. But unlike stars in the void, neurons communicate with one another via some 100 trillion connections, allowing the human mind to learn, adapt and interact with its surroundings.
paras.zh: 一个人脑内存在一个由近 900 亿个神经元组成的星系。但与虚空中的星星不同的是，神经元通过约 100 万亿个连接相互通信，使人类思维能够学习、适应周围环境并与之互动。

paras.en: For scientists to understand how individual actions arise from such complexity, they needed a tool to directly link neural circuits to specific behaviors, said Abdel El Manira, a neuroscientist at the Karolinska Institute in Stockholm. “Neuroscientists dreamed of a neuronal switch, a tool to turn specific neurons on or off with great precision,” El Manira said during the Oct. 5 announcement of this year’s prize in physiology or medicine by the Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institute.
paras.zh: 斯德哥尔摩卡罗林斯卡研究所的神经科学家阿卜杜勒·埃尔·马尼拉 (Abdel El Manira) 表示，为了让科学家了解个体行为如何从如此复杂的情况中产生，他们需要一种工具将神经回路与特定行为直接联系起来。 “神经科学家梦想有一个神经元开关，一种能够非常精确地打开或关闭特定神经元的工具，”埃尔·马尼拉在卡罗林斯卡学院诺贝尔大会 10 月 5 日宣布今年的生理学或医学奖时说道。

paras.en: Enter the bright idea that won. It’s a technology called optogenetics, which involves using light to precisely activate specific cells, like neurons, and watch how behavior changes. For their foundational contributions to optogenetics, biophysicists Peter Hegemann of Humboldt University in Berlin and Georg Nagel, of the Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg in Germany, and neuroscientist Karl Deisseroth of Stanford University shared this year’s prize.
paras.zh: 输入获胜的好主意。这是一种称为光遗传学的技术，涉及利用光精确激活特定细胞（例如神经元），并观察行为如何变化。柏林洪堡大学的生物物理学家 Peter Hegemann 和德国维尔茨堡朱利叶斯·马克西米利安大学的 Georg Nagel 以及斯坦福大学的神经科学家 Karl Deisseroth 分享了今年的奖项，以表彰他们对光遗传学的基础性贡献。

paras.en: The prize winners’ story starts in an unlikely place: the eye spot of a single celled green alga called Chlamydomonas. In the early 2000s, Hegemann, then at the Max Planck Institute for Biochemistry in Martinsreid, Germany, and Nagel, at the Max Planck Institute for Biophysics in Frankfurt, discovered a unique protein in the alga’s eye spot. When illuminated, the protein generated an electrical impulse, enabling the organism to move. Further research revealed that when the protein, called channelrhodopsin, was exposed to light, it opened like a pore, allowing positively charged ions to flow into a cell, generating the electrical impulse. “They had just discovered the switch neuroscientists had long dreamed of,” El Manira said.
paras.zh: 获奖者的故事始于一个意想不到的地方：一种称为衣藻的单细胞绿藻的眼点。 2000 年代初，当时在德国马丁斯里德马克斯普朗克生物化学研究所工作的赫格曼和在法兰克福马克斯普朗克生物物理研究所工作的内格尔在藻类的眼斑中发现了一种独特的蛋白质。当光照时，蛋白质产生电脉冲，使生物体能够移动。进一步的研究表明，当这种称为通道视紫红质的蛋白质暴露在光下时，它会像孔一样打开，允许带正电的离子流入细胞，产生电脉冲。 “他们刚刚发现了神经科学家梦寐以求的转变，”埃尔马尼拉说。

paras.en: Building on the Hegemann and Nagel’s work, Deisseroth began testing whether channelrhodopsin could be used to activate brain cells. He and his colleagues first inserted the gene for channelrhodopsin into cultures of rat nerve cells and found that the cells reacted to light instantaneously. They then introduced the gene into nerve cells in the brains of living mice, along with optical fibers fed through the rodents’ skulls. By beaming blue light through the fibers, the researchers were able to control the movements of the rodents’ whiskers. This technology gave researchers the ability to test the links between certain brain circuits and behaviors.
paras.zh: 在 Hegemann 和 Nagel 的工作基础上，Deisseroth 开始测试视紫红质通道蛋白是否可用于激活脑细胞。他和他的同事首先将视紫红质通道蛋白基因插入大鼠神经细胞培养物中，发现细胞对光立即做出反应。然后，他们将该基因引入活体小鼠大脑的神经细胞中，同时将光纤引入啮齿类动物的头骨中。通过通过纤维发射蓝光，研究人员能够控制啮齿动物胡须的运动。这项技术使研究人员能够测试某些大脑回路和行为之间的联系。

paras.en: “The technology, which soon became known as optogenetics, transformed neuroscience,” El Manira said. In addition to exposing the inner workings of healthy brains, he noted, “it has also helped reveal how brain circuits are disrupted, with implications for conditions such as blindness, depression and dementia.”
paras.zh: “这项技术很快被称为光遗传学，它改变了神经科学，”埃尔马尼拉说。他指出，除了揭示健康大脑的内部运作之外，“它还有助于揭示大脑回路如何被破坏，从而对失明、抑郁和痴呆等疾病产生影响。”

paras.en: For example, the technology has been used improve vision in some patients with retinitis pigmentosa, a disease that degrades light-sensing cells in the retina. It’s also helping researchers investigate the role that a person’s heart plays in how they experience and interact with their surroundings.
paras.zh: 例如，该技术已用于改善一些患有色素性视网膜炎的患者的视力，这种疾病会降低视网膜中的光敏细胞的功能。它还帮助研究人员调查一个人的心脏在他们如何体验和与周围环境互动中所扮演的角色。

paras.en: At the South Pole, there exists a block of ice unlike any other on Earth. Buried deep beneath the surface of the Antarctic ice sheet, a cubic kilometer of ice is threaded with thousands of beadlike sensors. Known as the IceCube Neutrino Observatory, this immense instrument enables researchers to detect the most elusive particle in the universe — the neutrino.
paras.zh: 在南极，存在着一块不同于地球上任何其他冰块的冰块。深埋在南极冰盖表面下方，一立方公里的冰上布满了数千个珠状传感器。这个巨大的仪器被称为冰立方中微子观测站，使研究人员能够探测宇宙中最难以捉摸的粒子——中微子。

paras.en: Detecting neutrinos from beyond our solar system had been a goal of scientists for decades, as that could help understand where and how the universe accelerates particles to extraordinary energies.
paras.zh: 几十年来，探测太阳系以外的中微子一直是科学家的目标，因为这可以帮助了解宇宙在何处以及如何将粒子加速到非凡的能量。

paras.en: The researcher who led the creation of the Antarctic observatory, physicist Francis Halzen of the University of Wisconsin–Madison, received this year’s Nobel Prize in physics. Halzen was awarded “for his decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin,” Mark Pearce, a physicist and chair of the Nobel committee for physics, during the Oct. 6 announcement by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.
paras.zh: 领导创建南极天文台的研究人员、威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的物理学家弗朗西斯·哈尔岑获得了今年的诺贝尔物理学奖。诺贝尔物理学委员会主席、物理学家马克·皮尔斯在瑞典皇家科学院于 10 月 6 日宣布的颁奖仪式上，哈尔岑“因其对冰立方中微子观测站和发现天体物理起源的高能中微子的决定性贡献”而获奖。

paras.en: Neutrinos are subatomic particles that are chargeless, incredibly small and so ethereal that they often pass through objects without interacting. In fact, billions of neutrinos pass through each of us every second, most of which are formed by nuclear fusion reactions in the sun. But some of these ghostly particles were thought to have originated much farther away, in high-energy particle collisions so distant as to lie beyond the limits of observations. Because neutrinos are not deflected by magnetic fields and rarely interact with matter, the detection of a high-energy neutrino’s trajectory could enable the identification of its distant source. An instrument capable of that task could therefore open a new window into the cosmos.
paras.zh: 中微子是亚原子粒子，不带电荷，非常小，而且如此飘逸，以至于它们经常穿过物体而不发生相互作用。事实上，每秒有数十亿个中微子穿过我们每个人，其中大部分是由太阳的核聚变反应形成的。但其中一些幽灵般的粒子被认为起源于更远的地方，是在高能粒子碰撞中产生的，距离如此之远，超出了观测的范围。由于中微子不会被磁场偏转，并且很少与物质相互作用，因此检测高能中微子的轨迹可以识别其遥远的来源。因此，能够完成这项任务的仪器可以打开一扇通向宇宙的新窗口。

paras.en: In the 1980s, Halzen realized that the South Pole was an ideal location for detecting the rare flashes of light that are generated when neutrinos collide with atomic nuclei. Ice deep inside the Antarctic ice sheet presented a large, transparent medium plunged in darkness, in a spot free from earthquakes and biological interference. It was the perfect stage for a neutrino lightshow.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代，哈尔岑意识到南极是探测中微子与原子核碰撞时产生的罕见闪光的理想地点。南极冰盖深处的冰呈现出一个巨大的、透明的介质，沉浸在黑暗中，没有地震和生物干扰。这是中微子灯光秀的完美舞台。

paras.en: Halzen’s vision was realized in 2011, when IceCube completed construction. “The biggest risk we took is that nobody knew whether a kilometer-field detector was actually large enough to discover neutrinos beyond our atmosphere from the universe,” Halzen said in a phone call during the announcement ceremony. “It only took us two years to detect them.”
paras.zh: Halzen 的愿景于 2011 年实现，当时 IceCube 竣工。哈尔岑在宣布仪式上的电话中说：“我们冒的最大风险是，没有人知道千米级探测器是否真的足够大，足以发现宇宙大气层之外的中微子。” “我们只花了两年时间就发现了它们。”

paras.en: And the discoveries didn’t end there. In 2018, researchers using IceCube data reported that they had traced a neutrino back to the brilliant core of a distant galaxy, called a blazar, thereby identifying a source for the energetic particles for the first time. And in 2023, researchers used a decade of IceCube data to produce the first map of the Milky Way using anything besides light, simultaneously reporting the first evidence of high-energy neutrinos hailing from within the galaxy.
paras.zh: 发现并没有就此结束。 2018年，研究人员使用IceCube数据报告说，他们已经将中微子追溯到遥远星系（称为耀变体）的明亮核心，从而首次确定了高能粒子的来源。 2023 年，研究人员利用十年来的 IceCube 数据绘制了第一张银河系地图，同时还报告了来自银河系内部高能中微子的第一个证据。

paras.en: Plans for a global network of neutrino detectors are now in motion. So scientists will soon be even better equipped to pinpoint and demystify the distant cosmic accelerators that launch the mysterious particles across the vast reaches of space.
paras.zh: 全球中微子探测器网络的计划现已启动。因此，科学家们很快就会有更好的装备来精确定位和揭开遥远宇宙加速器的神秘面纱，这些加速器在广阔的太空中发射神秘粒子。

paras.en: In nature, the building blocks of life exhibit a striking pattern. Many can exist in two versions that are mirrored images of one another, much like your right and left hand. Such molecules are said to be chiral. However, they overwhelmingly occur as just one of these chiral forms — for instance, amino acids are nearly always left-handed.
paras.zh: 在自然界中，生命的组成部分表现出惊人的模式。许多可以存在两个版本，彼此互为镜像，就像你的右手和左手一样。此类分子被认为是手性的。然而，它们绝大多数只是作为这些手性形式之一出现——例如，氨基酸几乎总是左旋的。

paras.en: This uniformity, known as homochirality, had long puzzled scientists. When chemists first attempted to produce chiral molecules in the lab, they ended up with even proportions of right- and left-handed molecules, or enantiomers.
paras.zh: 这种一致性被称为同手性，长期以来一直困扰着科学家。当化学家第一次尝试在实验室中生产手性分子时，他们最终得到了均匀比例的右旋分子和左旋分子或对映体。

paras.en: “It is this puzzle that this year’s laureates have solved,” Heiner Linke, chair of the Nobel Committee for Chemistry said during the Oct. 7 Nobel Prize in chemistry announcement by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.
paras.zh: “今年的获奖者已经解决了这个难题，”诺贝尔化学委员会主席海纳·林克在瑞典皇家科学院于 10 月 7 日宣布诺贝尔化学奖时说道。

paras.en: Henri Kagan, of the Université Paris-Saclay, and Kenso Soai, of the Tokyo University of Science, split the prize for discoveries leading “to a chemical reaction that spontaneously, without the involvement of other chiral molecules, creates only one mirror image,” said Linke, a physicist at Lund University in Sweden. “This is the first time this had happened since the processes that led to the chirality of life billions of years ago.”
paras.zh: 瑞典隆德大学的物理学家林克说，巴黎萨克雷大学的亨利·卡根和东京理科大学的 Kenso Soai 平分了“一种化学反应的发现，这种化学反应在没有其他手性分子参与的情况下自发地只产生一个镜像”。 “自数十亿年前导致生命手性的过程以来，这是第一次发生这种情况。”

paras.en: Putting aside the laureates’ impact on one of organic chemistry’s greatest mysteries, their research has immensely benefitted the development of pharmaceuticals. So many active drug molecules are chiral, and one enantiomer of a drug might have the desired therapeutic effect while its other might have no effect or even be harmful, Linke said.
paras.zh: 抛开获奖者对有机化学最大谜团之一的影响不谈，他们的研究极大地有益于药物的开发。 Linke说，许多活性药物分子都是手性的，药物的一种对映体可能具有所需的治疗效果，而另一种对映体可能没有效果甚至有害。

paras.en: A notorious example of such harm occurred in the 1950s, when thousands of babies with severe birth defects were born to women who had taken a sedative called thalidomide. It was later revealed that one of thalidomide’s enantiomers was the source of the birth defects. Even making the drug with only the “safe” orientation didn’t solve the problem: It could switch handedness in the body.
paras.zh: 这种伤害的一个臭名昭著的例子发生在 20 世纪 50 年代，当时服用沙利度胺镇静剂的妇女生下了数千名患有严重先天缺陷的婴儿。后来发现，沙利度胺的一种对映体是出生缺陷的根源。即使仅以“安全”方向制造药物也无法解决问题：它可以改变体内的利手习惯。

paras.en: In 1986, Kagan and his colleagues became the first to report chemical reactions that produced specific enantiomers in proportions far exceeding what chemists previously assumed was possible using catalysts.
paras.zh: 1986 年，卡根和他的同事成为第一个报告产生特定对映异构体的化学反应，其比例远远超过化学家之前假设的使用催化剂的可能性。

paras.en: Nine years later, Soai and his colleagues reported that they had figured out how to make a chiral catalyst that could, in turn, be used to form itself. That allowed them to perform reactions that resulted in products made almost entirely of one enantiomer. “This is not the final answer,” Soai said of his groundbreaking work on chirality, while calling into the ceremony from Japan. Speaking to future generations, he said “the study of chirality should be more and more developed.”
paras.zh: 九年后，索艾和他的同事报告说，他们已经找到了制造手性催化剂的方法，而这种催化剂又可以用来形成自身。这使得他们能够进行反应，产生几乎完全由一种对映体制成的产品。 “这不是最终的答案，”Soai 在日本参加仪式时谈到他在手性方面的开创性工作。他对后代说：“手性研究应该越来越发展。”

paras.en: Even so, as Nobel committee member Peter Somfai, a chemist at Lund University in Sweden, said during the ceremony: “This is probably the coolest experiment in organic chemistry.”
paras.zh: 即便如此，正如诺贝尔委员会成员、瑞典隆德大学化学家 Peter Somfai 在颁奖典礼上所说：“这可能是有机化学领域最酷的实验。”

articles.title: How the Grand Canyon could have lost 1 billion years of geologic history
articles.author: Lucas Van Wyk Joel

paras.en: In the Grand Canyon, rock layers preserve a relatively continuous record of Earth’s geologic history going back about 2 billion years. But between 520 million and 1.8 billion years, the record is noticeably empty. It’s as if someone broke into a museum and made off with almost an entire wing’s worth of rocks, and sorting out “whodunnit” is one of the coldest cases in all geology.
paras.zh: 在大峡谷中，岩层保存着相对连续的地球地质历史记录，可以追溯到大约 20 亿年前。但在 5.2 亿年到 18 亿年之间，记录明显是空的。这就好像有人闯入博物馆并偷走了几乎整个展区的岩石，而整理“侦探小说”是所有地质学中最冷的案件之一。

paras.en: Now, scientists studying the Grand Canyon’s rocks say that a gigantic Earth-spanning cliff —with a global glaciation as its accomplice — could be to blame for the heist.
paras.zh: 现在，研究大峡谷岩石的科学家表示，一个巨大的横跨地球的悬崖——全球冰川是它的同谋——可能是这次抢劫的罪魁祸首。

paras.en: The giant cliff started forming about 800 million years ago as an ancient supercontinent called Rodinia split apart, Thomas Gernon, an earth scientist at the University of Southampton in England, and colleagues report August 17 in Geology. Forces like rain and ice weathered and eroded the rock and, like waves at the beach steadily erasing one layer of sand after another, deleted a billion years of Earth’s history.
paras.zh: 英国南安普顿大学地球科学家 Thomas Gernon 及其同事于 8 月 17 日在《地质学》杂志上报道称，大约 8 亿年前，当一块名为罗迪尼亚 (Rodinia) 的古老超级大陆分裂时，巨大的悬崖开始形成。雨水和冰等力量风化并侵蚀了岩石，就像海滩上的海浪不断地抹去一层又一层的沙子一样，抹去了地球十亿年的历史。

paras.en: The group used computer models to simulate how ancient Earth evolved over hundreds of millions of years. They watched as the cliff — known as an escarpment — formed around the time in Earth’s history when rocks in the region vanished.
paras.zh: 该小组使用计算机模型来模拟古代地球数亿年的演化过程。他们目睹了悬崖——被称为悬崖——是在地球历史上该地区岩石消失的那段时间形成的。

paras.en: The escarpment most likely extended across much of a continent called Laurentia, the ancient precursor to North America. It stretched from what was to become Alaska all the way to Arizona and would have been about one to two kilometers high.
paras.zh: 悬崖很可能横跨劳伦西亚大陆的大部分地区，劳伦西亚大陆是北美的古代前身。它从后来的阿拉斯加一直延伸到亚利桑那州，高约一到两公里。

paras.en: Some 65 million years ago, the Great Escarpment of Laurentia would have stretched across much of North America, including the spot that would one day become the Grand Canyon and the site of an enduring geologic mystery. The escarpment itself is thought to have formed around 800 million years ago.
paras.zh: 大约 6500 万年前，劳伦西亚大悬崖横跨北美大部分地区，其中包括有一天成为大峡谷的地方和一个持久的地质谜团所在。据认为，悬崖本身形成于大约 8 亿年前。

paras.en: “No study has previously suggested the existence of a continental-scale escarpment in the Grand Canyon region. Our study shows it’s a plausible, straightforward explanation for the immense erosion that took place in the Grand Canyon,” Gernon says. Such an immense cliff created steep slopes that were ideal places for the elements to loosen and make off with exposed rock.
paras.zh: “之前没有研究表明大峡谷地区存在大陆级悬崖。我们的研究表明，这是对大峡谷发生的巨大侵蚀的一个合理而直接的解释，”格农说。如此巨大的悬崖形成了陡峭的斜坡，是自然元素松动并剥落裸露岩石的理想场所。

paras.en: And the escarpment had a lot of help when it came to its disappearing act: ice, lots and lots of ice. The theft of the rocks coincided with an extreme period of glaciation called Snowball Earth. Massive ice sheets formed and may have extended all the way from the poles to equatorial latitudes. As the ice expanded, it would have eroded great quantities of rock, helping create the gap in the record.
paras.zh: 悬崖在消失过程中得到了很多帮助：冰，很多很多的冰。岩石失窃恰逢被称为“雪球地球”的极端冰川期。巨大的冰盖形成，并可能从两极一直延伸到赤道纬度。随着冰层的扩张，它会侵蚀大量的岩石，从而造成了记录上的差距。

paras.en: And the escarpment, due to its high elevation, would have created ideal conditions for Snowball Earth glaciers and ice sheets to form. In a separate study published in Science, Gernon and a team explained how an escarpment created by tectonic activity was responsible for the formation of the East Antarctic Ice Sheet starting some 34 million years ago. “The exposed rocky peaks of the escarpment would have acted as glacier factories,” Gernon says.
paras.zh: 由于悬崖海拔较高，为雪球地球冰川和冰盖的形成创造了理想的条件。在《科学》杂志上发表的另一项研究中，Gernon 和他的团队解释了约 3400 万年前由构造活动形成的悬崖如何导致东南极冰盖的形成。 “悬崖上裸露的岩石山峰可以充当冰川工厂，”格农说。

paras.en: It remains unclear, however, whether the erosion that erased the rocks occurred before, during or after the Snowball Earth glaciations. “That’s the real hole that needs filling: pinning down the erosion history in space and time, continent by continent, precisely enough,” Gernon says.
paras.zh: 然而，目前尚不清楚消除岩石的侵蚀是否发生在雪球地球冰川作用之前、期间或之后。格农说：“这才是真正需要填补的漏洞：准确地确定各个大陆在空间和时间上的侵蚀历史。”

paras.en: Linking the disappearance of the rocks to verified events in Earth’s history such as the breakup of Rodinia bolsters the case, says Alan Collins, a geologist at Adelaide University in Australia who was not involved in the new study. Not only that, but Gernon’s team points to modern-day examples where similar erosive processes are at work, including a similar escarpment in Antarctica as well as one in South Africa.
paras.zh: 未参与这项新研究的澳大利亚阿德莱德大学地质学家艾伦·柯林斯 (Alan Collins) 表示，将岩石的消失与地球历史上已证实的事件（例如罗迪尼亚的分裂）联系起来，支持了这一论点。不仅如此，格农的团队还指出了类似侵蚀过程正在发挥作用的现代例子，包括南极洲和南非的类似悬崖。

paras.en: Maybe not quite case closed yet, but “I find this very convincing,” Collins says.
paras.zh: 也许案件尚未完全结束，但“我发现这非常有说服力，”柯林斯说。

articles.title: Secret of Orange Cats Finally Revealed After 60-Year Search
articles.author: Tessa Koumoundouros

paras.en: If you've ever lived with an orange cat, you already know they're built different. It turns out, genetically speaking, they really are.
paras.zh: 如果您曾经和橙色的猫一起生活过，您就会知道它们的体格不同。事实证明，从基因角度来说，它们确实如此。

paras.en: Orange fur is one of the most recognizable traits in the feline world, and one of the most stubborn mysteries in cat genetics.
paras.zh: 橙色皮毛是猫科动物世界中最容易识别的特征之一，也是猫遗传学中最顽固的谜团之一。

paras.en: Unlike most coat colors in mammals, it doesn't follow the usual rules of inheritance – and for more than 60 years, the exact gene responsible stayed hidden.
paras.zh: 与哺乳动物的大多数毛色不同，它不遵循通常的遗传规则——60多年来，确切的基因一直被隐藏。

paras.en: Two independent teams of researchers found any fiery-hued fuzz on our beloved clawed floofs is likely the result of a missing segment of DNA in a non-protein-coding part of the cat's genome.
paras.zh: 两个独立的研究小组发现，我们心爱的爪毛上的任何火红色绒毛很可能是猫基因组非蛋白质编码部分 DNA 片段缺失的结果。

paras.en: "It's been a genetic mystery, a conundrum," Stanford University geneticist Greg Barsh told Sara Reardon at Science in 2024, when the findings were first shared in preprint studies.
paras.zh: 2024 年，斯坦福大学遗传学家格雷格·巴什 (Greg Barsh) 在《科学》杂志上对萨拉·里尔登 (Sara Reardon) 表示：“这是一个遗传之谜、一个难题。”当时，这些发现首次在预印本研究中分享。

paras.en: Barsh and his colleagues discovered cat skin cells from which orange fur sprouts express 13 times as much RNA from a gene called Arhgap36, compared with skin cells from cats with no orange hair.
paras.zh: Barsh 和他的同事发现，与没有橙色毛的猫的皮肤细胞相比，橙色毛芽的猫皮肤细胞表达的 Arhgap36 基因的 RNA 数量是其 13 倍。

paras.en: Expecting to find the protein-coding section of the over-productive Arhgap36 gene had mutated, the researchers were surprised to find it was the sequence preceding it that instead contained a deletion, presumably affecting the rest of the gene's expression.
paras.zh: 研究人员原本期望发现过度生产的 Arhgap36 基因的蛋白质编码部分发生了突变，但他们惊讶地发现它前面的序列反而包含了缺失，这可能会影响该基因其余部分的表达。

paras.en: The 5 kilobase deletion was present in every orange cat the researchers examined out of a database of 188 cats, which included 145 orange, 6 calico/tortoiseshell, and 37 nonorange cats.
paras.zh: 研究人员在包含 188 只猫的数据库中检查了每只橙色猫，其中包括 145 只橙色猫、6 只印花布/玳瑁猫和 37 只非橙色猫。

paras.en: One finding didn't come as a surprise. As long predicted, the mutated gene is located on the cat's X chromosome, explaining why the orange color appears so differently between the sexes. Most orange cats are male, while most female cats with some orange fur end up with patchworks of different colors.
paras.zh: 一项发现并不令人意外。正如长期以来的预测，突变基因位于猫的 X 染色体上，这解释了为什么两性之间橙色的颜色如此不同。大多数橙色猫都是雄性，而大多数有橙色皮毛的雌性猫最终都会有不同颜色的拼凑而成。

paras.en: "Taken together, these observations provide strong genetic and genomic evidence that the 5 kb deletion causes sex-linked orange," Barsh and team write in their paper.
paras.zh: “总而言之，这些观察结果提供了强有力的遗传和基因组证据，证明 5 kb 缺失导致了伴性橙色，”Barsh 和团队在他们的论文中写道。

paras.en: Ever since humans first co-habitated with cats nearly 10,000 years ago, it's been a curiosity that a black cat and an orange cat can be parents to an unexpected array of kitten colors.
paras.zh: 自从近一万年前人类首次与猫共居以来，人们一直好奇黑猫和橙色猫可能会生出一系列意想不到的小猫颜色。

paras.en: Male kittens from this pairing are mostly either orange or black, as might be expected. But female kittens can have a calico's patchwork of black, orange and white, or a tortoiseshell's marbling of orange scattered through black fur.
paras.zh: 正如预期的那样，这对配对的雄性小猫大多是橙色或黑色。但雌性小猫的身上可能有黑色、橙色和白色的印花布拼凑而成，或者黑色皮毛中散布着龟甲般的橙色大理石花纹。

paras.en: Both teams confirmed the mutation responsible for orange fur is on the X chromosome, which is why such clear differences in colored patterning can appear between the sexes.
paras.zh: 两个团队都证实，导致橙色皮毛的突变位于 X 染色体上，这就是为什么两性之间会出现如此明显的颜色图案差异。

paras.en: Unlike males that end up with just one copy of this mutation on their solitary X chromosome, females end up with two copies, one on each the X's they receive from each parent.
paras.zh: 与雄性最终在其唯一的 X 染色体上仅具有该突变的一个副本不同，雌性最终具有两个副本，每个 X 染色体上都有一个来自父母的 X 染色体。

paras.en: Mammals randomly inactivate one of the two X chromosomes in each of their cells to avoid expressing an excess of the chromosome's products. This leaves female orange kitties with an active orange mutation in some of their developing skin-cell tissues, right next to neighboring cells in which the X chromosome with the mutated gene is deactivated.
paras.zh: 哺乳动物随机地使每个细胞中的两条 X 染色体之一失活，以避免表达过量的染色体产物。这使得雌性橙色小猫的一些正在发育的皮肤细胞组织中出现了活跃的橙色突变，就在邻近细胞的旁边，其中带有突变基因的 X 染色体被停用。

paras.en: On rare occasions that both X chromosomes carry the mutation, the female grows into furry fireball as ginger as any male.
paras.zh: 在极少数情况下，两条 X 染色体都携带突变，雌性会像雄性一样长成毛茸茸的火球。

paras.en: Orange cats happen to have a hilarious reputation for not being the brightest of their species. Anecdotes aside, such links between kitty coloration and cognition are scientifically unsupported, with no obvious negative consequences from this mutation in health or mental wellbeing.
paras.zh: 橙色的猫恰好因为不是同类中最聪明的而享有盛誉。撇开轶事不谈，小猫的颜色和认知之间的这种联系在科学上是没有根据的，这种突变对健康或心理健康没有明显的负面影响。

paras.en: Arhgap36 is known to cause developmental problems in other animals when it is over- or under-functioning. But it seems that in orange cats, the gene is overexpressed only in developing and mature pigment cells called melanocytes.
paras.zh: 已知 Arhgap36 在功能过度或功能不足时会导致其他动物出现发育问题。但在橙色猫中，该基因似乎仅在发育和成熟的色素细胞（称为黑素细胞）中过度表达。

paras.en: "The difference between tortoiseshell and calico cats is the presence of an additional white spotting mutation in calico that affects the ability of developing melanocytes to survive as they migrate away from the neural crest, allowing melanocyte clones that do survive to expand in a larger body region," Barsh and colleagues explain.
paras.zh: Barsh 及其同事解释说：“玳瑁猫和三色猫之间的区别在于三色猫中存在额外的白斑突变，当黑色素细胞从神经嵴迁移出去时，这种突变会影响发育中的黑色素细胞的存活能力，从而使存活下来的黑色素细胞克隆能够在更大的身体区域中扩张。”

paras.en: The second study, led by Kyushu University geneticist Hidehiro Toh, also identified Arhgap36 as the orange cat fur gene. They found greater expression of this gene suppresses color pigment genes, shifting the dark brown to black eumelanin pigments to the reddish to yellow pheomelanin pigments.
paras.zh: 由九州大学遗传学家 Hidehiro Toh 领导的第二项研究也确定了 Arhgap36 是橙色猫毛皮基因。他们发现该基因的较高表达会抑制彩色色素基因，将深棕色至黑色的真黑素色素转变为微红色至黄色的褐黑素色素。

paras.en: Whatever's behind their fiery coats, orange cats are in good company.
paras.zh: 无论它们火热的皮毛背后是什么，橙色的猫都是很好的伙伴。

paras.en: A recent study spanning 93 countries found that nations with more cats tended to report higher levels of happiness overall – though as with any 93-country comparison, the researchers are the first to admit correlation isn't causation.
paras.zh: 最近一项涵盖 93 个国家的研究发现，拥有更多猫的国家总体幸福感更高——尽管与任何 93 个国家的比较一样，研究人员首先承认相关性并非因果关系。

paras.en: This research has been published in Current Biology, here and here.
paras.zh: 这项研究已发表在《当代生物学》上，此处和此处。

articles.title: After Almost Going Extinct, Giant Tortoises Now Outnumber People in The Seychelles
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Before human explorers came along, the Seychelles archipelago was a haven for animals.
paras.zh: 在人类探险家出现之前，塞舌尔群岛是动物的天堂。

paras.en: The islands' relatively peaceful history, prior to the Age of Exploration, is written into the DNA of the majestic Aldabra giant tortoises (Aldabrachelys gigantea).
paras.zh: 在大航海时代之前，这些岛屿相对和平的历史已被写入雄伟的阿尔达伯拉象龟（Aldabrachelys gigantea）的 DNA 中。

paras.en: Their chunky, armored shells provided them ample protection from any trouble they were likely to encounter on the isolated islands, though they had very few natural predators to contend with.
paras.zh: 它们厚实的装甲外壳为它们提供了充分的保护，使它们免受在孤岛上可能遇到的任何麻烦，尽管它们几乎没有天敌可以应对。

paras.en: Ample food supply and little predation enabled them to reach famously ripe old ages, and all without much need for speed or aggression.
paras.zh: 充足的食物供应和很少的捕食使它们能够达到众所周知的晚年，而且不需要太多的速度或攻击性。

paras.en: Then, in the 15th century, European explorers started showing up. And sailors. And even pirates, apparently.
paras.zh: 然后，在 15 世纪，欧洲探险家开始出现。还有水手。显然，甚至还有海盗。

paras.en: On their way across the vast seas, this island full of giant, slow-moving tortoises was easy pickings for food.
paras.zh: 在穿越浩瀚大海的途中，这个岛上到处都是巨大的、行动缓慢的乌龟，很容易就能找到食物。

paras.en: With each new boatload of seafarers, the Aldabra giant tortoise population dwindled. By the 19th century, fewer than a thousand tortoises remained on Aldabra Atoll.
paras.zh: 随着每船新海员的增加，亚达伯拉象龟的数量就会减少。到了 19 世纪，阿尔达布拉环礁上的陆龟数量已不足千只。

paras.en: But you wouldn't know it, looking at the island's tortoise population today.
paras.zh: 但看看今天岛上的陆龟数量，你就不会知道这一点。

paras.en: Recent surveys of the Aldabra Atoll have revealed the species has reached record-high numbers following decades of protection, outnumbering the Seychelles' human population for the first time in centuries.
paras.zh: 最近对阿尔达布拉环礁的调查显示，经过数十年的保护，该物种的数量已达到历史新高，几个世纪以来首次超过塞舌尔的人口数量。

paras.en: The results of the atoll-wide population study have been published in Ecology and Evolution.
paras.zh: 全环礁人口研究的结果已发表在《生态与进化》杂志上。

paras.en: "More than 180,000 giant tortoises roaming freely on our atoll is proof of what long-term commitment to conservation can achieve," says conservation biologist Frauke Fleischer-Dogley, CEO of the Seychelles Islands Foundation and an author on the paper.
paras.zh: “超过 180,000 只巨龟在我们的环礁上自由漫步，证明了长期致力于保护可以取得的成果，”保护生物学家、塞舌尔群岛基金会首席执行官、该论文的作者之一弗劳克·弗莱舍-多格利 (Frauke Fleischer-Dogley) 说道。

paras.en: "This is wonderful news for Seychelles, for the world, and for everyone who has worked to protect Aldabra."
paras.zh: “这对于塞舌尔、全世界以及所有致力于保护阿尔达布拉的人来说都是一个好消息。”

paras.en: It's the first time the population's numbers have been rigorously surveyed since the 1990s. In 1981, Aldabra became a strict nature reserve to support the tortoises' recovery; in 1982, it was named a UNESCO site.
paras.zh: 这是自 20 世纪 90 年代以来首次对人口数量进行严格调查。 1981年，阿尔达伯拉成为严格的自然保护区，以支持陆龟的恢复； 1982年，它被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产。

paras.en: "Aldabra's giant tortoise monitoring program is one of the longest-running in the region, but the atoll's dense vegetation makes counting tortoises genuinely difficult in places," says island biologist Nancy Bunbury.
paras.zh: “阿尔达伯拉的巨型陆龟监测计划是该地区运行时间最长的计划之一，但环礁茂密的植被使得在某些地方统计陆龟数量确实很困难，”岛屿生物学家南希·班伯里说。

paras.en: "By modeling what we didn't see, as well as what we did, we've produced the most reliable baseline yet for this iconic Seychelles species, establishing a benchmark we can use to track the population for decades to come."
paras.zh: “通过对我们没有看到的以及我们看到的进行建模，我们为这个标志性的塞舌尔物种提供了迄今为止最可靠的基线，建立了一个我们可以用来追踪未来几十年种群数量的基准。”

paras.en: Perhaps unsurprisingly, the tortoises were recorded flocking at the atoll's 'tortoise turf', open grasslands that are maintained by the reptiles' constant munching.
paras.zh: 也许并不令人意外的是，据记录，这些陆龟在环礁的“陆龟草皮”上成群结队，这是一片开阔的草地，靠爬行动物的不断咀嚼维持着。

paras.en: The tortoises may be safe from hungry sailors for now, but many other threats still remain.
paras.zh: 目前，这些乌龟可能不会受到饥饿水手的伤害，但许多其他威胁仍然存在。

paras.en: The atoll is vulnerable to sea level rise and drought, as human fossil fuel use continues to change the global climate at an unprecedented rate.
paras.zh: 由于人类化石燃料的使用继续以前所未有的速度改变全球气候，该环礁很容易受到海平面上升和干旱的影响。

paras.en: Meanwhile, feral cats and black rats still abound on the atoll, preying on the tortoises' eggs and hatchlings.
paras.zh: 与此同时，野猫和黑鼠在环礁上仍然大量存在，捕食陆龟的蛋和幼龟。

paras.en: "It's important to remember that the numbers provide a baseline – not an endpoint," says ecologist Dave Hudson of the University of Exeter in the UK.
paras.zh: 英国埃克塞特大学的生态学家戴夫·哈德森说：“重要的是要记住，这些数字提供的是基线，而不是终点。”

paras.en: "Hopefully we have provided the conservation managers the evidence they need to track future change and act early as the tortoises face increasing pressures from climate change, drought and invasive species."
paras.zh: “希望我们能够为保护管理者提供他们所需的证据，以跟踪未来的变化，并在陆龟面临气候变化、干旱和入侵物种日益增加的压力时尽早采取行动。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Ecology and Evolution.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《生态与进化》杂志上。

articles.title: Scientists Find a Strange Chemical Loop That May Have Helped Life Get Started
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: Space rocks like Bennu contain key genetic ingredients such as sugar, which they delivered in explosive fashion to provide early Earth with another source of life-friendly materials.
paras.zh: 像贝努这样的太空岩石含有糖等关键遗传成分，它们以爆炸的方式释放这些成分，为早期地球提供了另一种适合生命的材料来源。

paras.en: Ribose is one such bio-essential sugar, some of which may have arrived from space before terrestrial processes could start making it.
paras.zh: 核糖就是这样一种生物必需糖，其中一些可能是在陆地过程开始制造之前从太空到达的。

paras.en: It's the R in RNA, ribonucleic acid, physically comprising its backbone, while a modified version lends skeletal structure to DNA, deoxyribonucleic acid.
paras.zh: 它是 RNA（核糖核酸）中的 R，物理上构成了其主链，而修改后的版本则为 DNA（脱氧核糖核酸）提供了骨架结构。

paras.en: DNA is more famous, but while it stays snugly secure in our cells' nuclei, the single-stranded, callous-palmed RNA travels to the body's job sites to share genomic data, build proteins, and regulate gene activity.
paras.zh: DNA 更为出名，但尽管它牢牢地固定在我们的细胞核中，但单链、冷酷无情的 RNA 却会前往人体的工作部位，共享基因组数据、构建蛋白质并调节基因活性。

paras.en: But there's a problem: ribose is fragile. Somewhat like table sugar, heat and other factors turn it into caramel – not the delicious stuff, but a tar-like "brown goop."
paras.zh: 但有一个问题：核糖很脆弱。有点像食糖，热量和其他因素将其变成焦糖——不是美味的东西，而是焦油状的“棕色粘稠物”。

paras.en: This is not ideal, even though we humans comprise (and create) many goop-like substances ourselves.
paras.zh: 尽管我们人类自己构成（并创造）了许多类似粘稠物质的物质，但这并不理想。

paras.en: Yet this may present a problem no longer: life scientists have reported a potential breakthrough in the geochemical puzzle that aims to explain how chemistry became biology, and life arose from the muck.
paras.zh: 然而，这可能不再是一个问题：生命科学家报告了地球化学难题的潜在突破，旨在解释化学如何成为生物学，以及生命如何从淤泥中产生。

paras.en: According to a new study in Scientific Reports, astrobiologists and chemists from the University of New South Wales in Australia found ancient ribose may have been kept from caramelizing by an unassuming elemental agent – one that ribose itself helped keep available.
paras.zh: 根据《科学报告》中的一项新研究，澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的天体生物学家和化学家发现，一种不起眼的元素剂可能阻止了古代核糖的焦糖化——核糖本身有助于保持这种元素的可用性。

paras.en: That element was the metalloid boron, which also provided a hint of long-evaporated water on Mars.
paras.zh: 这种元素就是准金属硼，它也提供了火星上长期蒸发的水的暗示。

paras.en: When ribose and boron compounds meet, they form complexes.
paras.zh: 当核糖和硼化合物相遇时，它们形成复合物。

paras.en: But the availability of boron is also fragile. It can be pulled from the water and locked away in rocks – and therefore made useless for burgeoning lifeforms – by things like calcium.
paras.zh: 但硼的供应也很脆弱。它可以被钙等物质从水中拉出来并锁在岩石中，因此对新兴的生命形式毫无用处。

paras.en: Accordingly, many studies over the past two decades have explored various ribose-boron interaction scenarios.
paras.zh: 因此，过去二十年的许多研究探索了各种核糖-硼相互作用场景。

paras.en: But, based on their methods, some of these "experiments may therefore not reflect realistic early Earth environments," the researchers note.
paras.zh: 但是，研究人员指出，根据他们的方法，其中一些“实验可能因此无法反映现实的早期地球环境”。

paras.en: So, alongside standard lab-grade borax, they used common 'real-world' boron-containing minerals: kernite, colemanite, and ulexite – which also contain either sodium, calcium, or both – to test how boron dissolves into water based on what kind of mineral it comes from.
paras.zh: 因此，除了标准实验室级硼砂之外，他们还使用了常见的“现实世界”含硼矿物：核沸石、硬硼酸钙石和钠硼解石（也含有钠、钙或两者），根据硼来自的矿物类型来测试硼如何溶解到水中。

paras.en: They did so without and with the inclusion of ribose, with the former condition acting as a control.
paras.zh: 他们在不添加核糖和添加核糖的情况下进行了实验，并以前一种条件作为对照。

paras.en: Lo and behold, the addition of ribose changed the interaction between boron and calcium in a vital way.
paras.zh: 你瞧，核糖的添加极大地改变了硼和钙之间的相互作用。

paras.en: While calcium would sequester boron in stubbornly insoluble rocks, turning this tandem into a chemical love triangle by introducing ribose provides the solubility solution.
paras.zh: 虽然钙会将硼隔离在顽固不溶的岩石中，但通过引入核糖将这种串联转变为化学三角恋提供了溶解度解决方案。

paras.en: The ribose helped pull boron from its rocky prison into water across all four minerals that the researchers used – and it was especially effective for those containing calcium.
paras.zh: 核糖帮助将硼从岩石监狱中拉入研究人员使用的所有四种矿物质中的水中，并且对于含钙的矿物质尤其有效。

paras.en: The team then repeated the experiment using a piece of "puffy evaporative crust" collected from the high-altitude Puga hydrothermal system in Ladakh, India, for a chemical early Earth analog.
paras.zh: 然后，研究小组使用从印度拉达克高海拔普加热液系统收集的一块“蓬松的蒸发地壳”重复了该实验，作为早期地球的化学模拟。

paras.en: When they dunked this substance in water, without ribose, a certain amount of boron was released. When they then added ribose, the amount of boron released into the water increased by approximately 60 percent.
paras.zh: 当他们将这种物质浸入不含核糖的水中时，会释放出一定量的硼。当他们添加核糖时，释放到水中的硼量增加了大约 60%。

paras.en: Then the researchers explored whether degraded ribose could improve boron solubility.
paras.zh: 然后研究人员探索了降解的核糖是否可以提高硼的溶解度。

paras.en: After they 'caramelized' their ribose through heat and alkalinity, or chemically, they found only a slight increase in the absolute amount of dissolved boron in the solution.
paras.zh: 在通过热量和碱度或化学方法将核糖“焦糖化”后，他们发现溶液中溶解的硼的绝对量仅略有增加。

paras.en: Although dissolved boron concentration from colemanite increased by 50 percent with the addition of caramelized ribose, that was a much smaller boost than fresh ribose gave the same mineral (about 3.5 times more boron), suggesting that fresh ribose is best.
paras.zh: 尽管添加焦糖核糖后，硬硼酸钙石中溶解的硼浓度增加了 50%，但与新鲜核糖产生的相同矿物质相比（硼含量增加约 3.5 倍），其增幅要小得多，这表明新鲜核糖是最好的。

paras.en: Finally, the researchers similarly tested sucrose and glucose, finding that they can improve boron solubility but not as much as ribose. This is likely because the molecular geometry of ribose is especially well suited to forming stable complexes with boron.
paras.zh: 最后，研究人员同样测试了蔗糖和葡萄糖，发现它们可以提高硼的溶解度，但不如核糖。这可能是因为核糖的分子几何形状特别适合与硼形成稳定的复合物。

paras.en: So, the researchers propose the following loop.
paras.zh: 因此，研究人员提出了以下循环。

paras.en: Ribose pulls and protects boron, which then protects ribose. So more ribose could lead to more dissolved boron, which could then help more ribose survive, setting the stage for the RNA World Hypothesis and, eventually, us.
paras.zh: 核糖拉动并保护硼，硼随后保护核糖。因此，更多的核糖可能会导致更多的溶解硼，从而帮助更多的核糖生存，为 RNA 世界假说以及最终的我们奠定基础。

paras.en: But wait a second. The study also presents an intriguing nuance: boron compounds are double-edged swords. They can stabilize existing ribose, but in excess they actually inhibit ribose from forming in the first place.
paras.zh: 但等一下。该研究还提出了一个有趣的细微差别：硼化合物是双刃剑。它们可以稳定现有的核糖，但过量时它们实际上会抑制核糖的形成。

paras.en: In this context, calcium suddenly becomes a villain-turned-hero: It may have kept boron levels low, so ribose could form, and then the aforementioned loop possibly took over.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，钙突然变成了反派英雄：它可能使硼水平保持在较低水平，因此可以形成核糖，然后上述循环可能会接管。

paras.en: Finally, shifting pH levels, as may be common in hot spring systems, may have helped liberate ribose from the boron, allowing it to undergo other reactions, like, again, us.
paras.zh: 最后，pH值的变化（在温泉系统中可能很常见）可能有助于从硼中释放核糖，使其能够进行其他反应，就像我们一样。

paras.en: So this work shows the value of using natural mineral samples, rather than pure, synthetic materials, even though the latter help maintain control and reduce experimental complexity.
paras.zh: 因此，这项工作展示了使用天然矿物样品而不是纯合成材料的价值，尽管后者有助于保持控制并降低实验复杂性。

paras.en: As a result, we come full (or semi) circle to Carl Sagan's quote about us all being star-stuff – specifically, space sugar.
paras.zh: 结果，我们绕了一圈（或半圈）卡尔·萨根关于我们都是明星的名言——特别是太空糖。

paras.en: Sure, our susceptibility to sugar's soothing sweetness introduces many health effects. But maybe it also provided the physical fulcrum that helped us exist and attempt to enjoy it in moderation.
paras.zh: 当然，我们对糖的舒缓甜味的敏感性会带来许多健康影响。但也许它也提供了帮助我们生存并尝试适度享受它的物理支点。

paras.en: The research has been published in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学报告》上。

articles.title: Bacteria turn a virus’ own weapon against it

paras.en: Bacteria turn a virusâ own weapon against it
paras.zh: 细菌利用病毒自身的武器来对抗它

paras.en: - Researchers have uncovered a new way bacteria detect viral attacks: a virus-produced enzyme cuts a bacterial sensor protein, triggering a self-destructing immune response. The discovery could lead to more effective phage therapies against antibiotic-resistant bacteria and provide insight into ancient immune mechanisms shared with humans.
paras.zh: - 研究人员发现了细菌检测病毒攻击的新方法：病毒产生的酶切割细菌传感器蛋白，引发自毁免疫反应。这一发现可能会导致针对抗生素耐药细菌的更有效的噬菌体疗法，并提供对人类共享的古老免疫机制的深入了解。

paras.en: Scientists searching for new ways to treat bacterial infections are increasingly turning to viruses known as bacteriophages (phages). These viruses specifically target bacteria, allowing them to kill harmful microbes without damaging human cells. They can also attack bacteria that have developed resistance to antibiotics.
paras.zh: 寻找治疗细菌感染新方法的科学家越来越多地转向称为噬菌体的病毒。这些病毒专门针对细菌，使它们能够杀死有害微生物而不损害人体细胞。它们还可以攻击对抗生素产生耐药性的细菌。

paras.en: Phage therapy, however, faces a major obstacle. Bacteria are not defenseless against viruses. They have evolved their own immune systems, and understanding those defenses could help scientists develop therapeutic phages that are better able to overcome them.
paras.zh: 然而，噬菌体疗法面临着重大障碍。细菌对病毒并非毫无防御能力。它们进化出了自己的免疫系统，了解这些防御系统可以帮助科学家开发出能够更好地克服这些防御系统的治疗性噬菌体。

paras.en: New research has now identified an important way bacteria recognize a viral attack. Scientists found that a viral enzyme cuts a crucial sensor molecule inside the bacterial cell. That damage serves as an alarm, activating an immune response. The discovery could ultimately help researchers develop more effective phage therapies capable of avoiding bacterial immune defenses.
paras.zh: 新的研究现在已经确定了细菌识别病毒攻击的一种重要方式。科学家发现，病毒酶会切割细菌细胞内的关键传感器分子。这种损害就像一个警报，激活免疫反应。这一发现最终可以帮助研究人员开发出更有效的噬菌体疗法，能够避免细菌免疫防御。

paras.en: "This is one of the most common forms of bacterial immunity, so when we finally figured it out, it was a total eureka moment," says Sam Hobbs, PhD, assistant professor of biochemistry at University of Utah Health and the first author on a paper describing the research.
paras.zh: “这是最常见的细菌免疫形式之一，所以当我们最终弄清楚它时，我们彻底灵光一现，”犹他健康大学生物化学助理教授、描述这项研究的论文的第一作者萨姆·霍布斯博士说。

paras.en: The study focused on a bacterial immune system called CBASS. When activated, CBASS can trigger an extreme "last resort" response in which an infected bacterium kills itself before the invading virus has a chance to spread to nearby cells.
paras.zh: 该研究的重点是一种名为 CBASS 的细菌免疫系统。当被激活时，CBASS 可以触发极端的“最后手段”反应，即受感染的细菌在入侵的病毒有机会传播到附近的细胞之前杀死自己。

paras.en: Because activating this defense is fatal to the bacterium, the system must be able to recognize a genuine viral threat with great precision.
paras.zh: 由于激活这种防御对于细菌来说是致命的，因此系统必须能够非常精确地识别真正的病毒威胁。

paras.en: Hobbs and his colleagues found that this detection process relies on something the virus itself needs. Certain phages produce an enzyme that becomes the signal that alerts the bacterium to the attack.
paras.zh: 霍布斯和他的同事发现，这种检测过程依赖于病毒本身所需的东西。某些噬菌体会产生一种酶，这种酶会成为警告细菌受到攻击的信号。

paras.en: "Certain kinds of phages have a protein called a protease, which degrades other proteins," he explains. "We found that the protease from the phage actually acts directly on the host protein, and that is the signal that turns on the whole signaling pathway."
paras.zh: “某些噬菌体含有一种称为蛋白酶的蛋白质，它可以降解其他蛋白质，”他解释道。 “我们发现来自噬菌体的蛋白酶实际上直接作用于宿主蛋白，这就是打开整个信号通路的信号。”

paras.en: This form of virus detection is notably different from related antiviral immune systems. Some of those pathways recognize viral genetic material directly. In CBASS, the trigger instead comes from the activity of a viral protein acting on a protein belonging to the bacterial host.
paras.zh: 这种形式的病毒检测与相关的抗病毒免疫系统明显不同。其中一些途径直接识别病毒遗传物质。在 CBASS 中，触发因素来自病毒蛋白作用于细菌宿主蛋白的活性。

paras.en: "This is a totally new mechanism for how these host proteins are activated," Hobbs says. "I never would have guessed that this was the way it was going to work."
paras.zh: “这是如何激活这些宿主蛋白的全新机制，”霍布斯说。 “我从来没有想到这就是它的运作方式。”

paras.en: The finding not only sheds light on how bacteria defend themselves from phages, but could also have implications for understanding immunity in humans.
paras.zh: 这一发现不仅揭示了细菌如何防御噬菌体，而且还可能对理解人类的免疫力产生影响。

paras.en: CBASS is related to an immune pathway found in people, suggesting that aspects of this antiviral defense have survived across an enormous span of evolutionary history. The connection indicates that the pathway dates back at least to the common ancestor shared by bacteria and humans.
paras.zh: CBASS 与人类体内发现的免疫途径有关，这表明这种抗病毒防御的某些方面在漫长的进化历史中一直存在。这种联系表明该途径至少可以追溯到细菌和人类的共同祖先。

paras.en: An Ancient Immune System With Human Connections
paras.zh: 与人类有联系的古老免疫系统

paras.en: Bacteria also give researchers a useful experimental system for investigating fundamental questions about immunity. Their rapid life cycles allow scientists to study immune processes quickly, then test what they learn in biological models that are more closely related to humans.
paras.zh: 细菌还为研究人员提供了一个有用的实验系统，用于研究有关免疫的基本问题。它们快速的生命周期使科学家能够快速研究免疫过程，然后在与人类更密切相关的生物模型中测试它们学到的东西。

paras.en: "The fact that these systems are conserved between bacteria and humans suggests that they've been maintained in these different organisms for that entire evolutionary trajectory," Hobbs says. "The cells are telling us that this is a really important pathway because they've maintained it for billions of years. It's incredibly fascinating, and it's a cool window into what's important in maintaining the ability to fight viruses."
paras.zh: 霍布斯说：“这些系统在细菌和人类之间是保守的，这一事实表明它们在整个进化轨迹中一直保留在这些不同的生物体中。” “细胞告诉我们，这是一条非常重要的途径，因为它们已经维持了数十亿年。它非常令人着迷，而且它是了解维持抗病毒能力的重要因素的一个很酷的窗口。”

paras.en: This research is published in Science as "Phage proteases activate CBASS antiphage immunity."
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《科学》杂志上，标题为“噬菌体蛋白酶激活 CBASS 抗噬菌体免疫”。

paras.en: This work was supported by the Pew Biomedical Scholars program, the Burroughs Wellcome Fund, the G. Harold and Leila Y. Mathers Foundation, the Cancer Research Institute (CRI3996), the Parker Institute for Cancer Immunotherapy, the Massachusetts Consortium on Pathogen Readiness, and the National Institute of General Medical Sciences of the National Institutes of Health (1DP2GM146250-01). Content is solely the responsibility of the authors and does not necessarily represent the official views of the National Institutes of Health.
paras.zh: 这项工作得到了皮尤生物医学学者计划、Burroughs Wellcome 基金、G. Harold 和 Leila Y. Mathers 基金会、癌症研究所 (CRI3996)、帕克癌症免疫治疗研究所、马萨诸塞州病原体准备联盟和美国国立卫生研究院国家普通医学科学研究所 (1DP2GM146250-01) 的支持。内容完全由作者负责，并不一定代表美国国立卫生研究院的官方观点。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Utah Health. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由犹他大学健康中心提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Scientists find hidden materials that could improve batteries and solar fuels

paras.en: Scientists find hidden materials that could improve batteries and solar fuels
paras.zh: 科学家发现可以改善电池和太阳能燃料的隐藏材料

paras.en: - Scientists have uncovered a hidden world of âin-betweenâ materials that briefly form as chemical ingredients are heated, revealing structures that conventional methods can miss. Among the discoveries is a previously unknown form of bismuth vanadate, a material widely studied for using sunlight to help produce clean hydrogen. The new version has a different atomic structure and interacts with light in a strikingly different way, potentially opening new possibilities for solar fuels, catalysts, and electronics.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了一个隐藏的“中间”材料世界，这些材料在化学成分被加热时短暂形成，揭示了传统方法可能忽略的结构。这些发现之一是一种以前未知的钒酸铋，这种材料被广泛研究用于利用阳光来帮助生产清洁的氢气。新版本具有不同的原子结构，并以截然不同的方式与光相互作用，可能为太阳能燃料、催化剂和电子产品开辟新的可能性。

paras.en: Researchers have uncovered previously unknown materials by closely following what happens as molecular precursors break apart and transform during heating. Among the discoveries is a new form of a well-studied clean energy material.
paras.zh: 研究人员通过密切关注分子前体在加热过程中分解和转变时发生的情况，发现了以前未知的材料。这些发现之一是一种经过充分研究的清洁能源材料的新形式。

paras.en: The research, published in Nature Communications, focuses on intermediate phases that appear while molecules are being converted into solid materials. These temporary stages are often overlooked because scientists typically concentrate on the final product. By capturing and studying them, the researchers found a possible route to materials that are difficult or impossible to obtain through conventional synthesis.
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《自然通讯》上，重点关注分子转化为固体材料时出现的中间相。这些临时阶段经常被忽视，因为科学家通常专注于最终产品。通过捕获和研究它们，研究人员找到了一条可能的途径来获得通过传统合成很难或不可能获得的材料。

paras.en: Dr. Sebastian Pike, Department of Chemistry, University of Warwick, said: "When materials are made by heating, scientists usually focus on the final product, the 'B' that results from 'A.' But this study shows that there are many fascinating stages in between 'A' and 'B,' and these hidden steps, could be just as important.
paras.zh: 华威大学化学系的塞巴斯蒂安·派克博士说：“当通过加热制造材料时，科学家通常关注最终产品，即由‘A’产生的‘B’。但这项研究表明，“A”和“B”之间有许多令人着迷的阶段，而这些隐藏的步骤可能同样重要。

paras.en: "We didn't know exactly what we would find going in, but we were confident there would be something interesting and unknown in the intermediate phases. We were thrilled to discover that some of these could have practical uses, even from the very first experiments."
paras.zh: “我们并不确切地知道会发现什么，但我们相信在中间阶段会出现一些有趣且未知的东西。我们很高兴发现其中一些可以具有实际用途，即使从最初的实验开始也是如此。”

paras.en: The researchers began with specially designed 'single-source precursors', molecules containing all the elements needed to create a material. They then monitored how those molecules changed as temperatures increased.
paras.zh: 研究人员从专门设计的“单一来源前体”开始，这些分子含有制造材料所需的所有元素。然后他们监测这些分子随着温度升高如何变化。

paras.en: This approach exposed several previously unknown material phases. One was a new, kinetically stabilized form of bismuth vanadate (BiVO4), which the researchers named β-BiVO4.
paras.zh: 这种方法暴露了几个以前未知的材料相。其中之一是一种新的动力学稳定形式的钒酸铋 (BiVO4)，研究人员将其命名为 β-BiVO4。

paras.en: BiVO4 has attracted attention in clean energy research because of its useful "band gap" (the energy it needs to absorb sunlight and drive chemical reactions). Its properties allow it to absorb sunlight effectively while still supplying enough energy to split water and generate clean hydrogen fuel.
paras.zh: BiVO4因其有用的“带隙”（吸收阳光和驱动化学反应所需的能量）而在清洁能源研究中引起了关注。它的特性使其能够有效吸收阳光，同时仍然提供足够的能量来分解水并产生清洁的氢燃料。

paras.en: The newly identified β-BiVO4 has an atomic arrangement that differs from known forms of the material. It also has a significantly larger band gap, which changes the way it interacts with light.
paras.zh: 新发现的 β-BiVO4 具有与已知形式的材料不同的原子排列。它还具有明显更大的带隙，这改变了它与光相互作用的方式。

paras.en: Those differences could give researchers new ways to adjust materials for use in solar fuel production, catalysis, and electronics.
paras.zh: 这些差异可能为研究人员提供新的方法来调整用于太阳能燃料生产、催化和电子产品的材料。

paras.en: The newly discovered intermediate phases may also have uses beyond solar energy. Another hidden material identified during the experiments was able to store large amounts of lithium, raising the possibility that it could contribute to next-generation battery technologies.
paras.zh: 新发现的中间相可能还有太阳能以外的用途。实验期间发现的另一种隐藏材料能够储存大量锂，这提高了它为下一代电池技术做出贡献的可能性。

paras.en: Dr. Dominik Kubicki, School of Chemistry, University of Birmingham, said: "What's exciting is that these 'in-between' materials aren't just stepping stones -- they can have useful properties in their own right. By understanding and controlling how they form, we can start to design better materials for batteries, catalysis, and solar energy."
paras.zh: 伯明翰大学化学学院的 Dominik Ku​​bicki 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，这些‘中间’材料不仅仅是垫脚石，它们本身就具有有用的特性。通过了解和控制它们的形成方式，我们可以开始为电池、催化和太阳能设计更好的材料。”

paras.en: To observe these normally hidden states, the researchers combined several state-of-the-art techniques, including solid-state NMR spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, and pair distribution function analysis.
paras.zh: 为了观察这些通常隐藏的状态，研究人员结合了几种最先进的技术，包括固态核磁共振波谱、X射线衍射和对分布函数分析。

paras.en: Their results also showed that the precursor selected at the beginning of the process, along with the way that precursor decomposes, can strongly influence which materials form. By controlling those factors, researchers may be able to produce structures that are difficult to obtain using standard heating methods.
paras.zh: 他们的结果还表明，在过程开始时选择的前体以及前体的分解方式可以强烈影响材料的形成。通过控制这些因素，研究人员也许能够生产出使用标准加热方法难以获得的结构。

paras.en: The findings suggest that temporary stages in material formation could represent a largely unexplored source of useful compounds. Instead of treating intermediate structures only as brief steps on the way to a final material, scientists may be able to deliberately create and stabilize them for practical applications.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，材料形成的临时阶段可能代表了很大程度上未经探索的有用化合物的来源。科学家们可能能够故意创建并稳定它们以用于实际应用，而不是仅仅将中间结构视为最终材料的简单步骤。

paras.en: Dr. Pike concluded: "We only studied a few precursors here, but this work points to a broader opportunity in materials science. By carefully controlling temperature, precursor chemistry, and reaction pathways, there may be many more "hidden" but extremely useful materials to be found."
paras.zh: 派克博士总结道：“我们在这里只研究了一些前体，但这项工作为材料科学指出了更广泛的机会。通过仔细控制温度、前体化学和反应途径，可能会发现更多‘隐藏’但极其有用的材料。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Warwick. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由华威大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Only one workout helped older adults lose fat and keep muscle

paras.en: Only one workout helped older adults lose fat and keep muscle
paras.zh: 只有一项锻炼可以帮助老年人减脂并保持肌肉

paras.en: - A six-month study suggests that high-intensity interval training (HIIT) may offer older adults a powerful advantage: losing body fat while keeping their muscle. Unlike moderate-intensity workouts, which led to a small loss of lean muscle, HIIT preserved it while also improving body composition around the waist.
paras.zh: - 一项为期六个月的研究表明，高强度间歇训练 (HIIT) 可能为老年人提供强大的优势：在保持肌肉的同时减少体内脂肪。与会导致少量肌肉流失的中等强度锻炼不同，HIIT 可以在保留肌肉的同时改善腰部的身体成分。

paras.en: Losing body fat is one thing. Losing fat while keeping the muscle that helps you stay strong and active is another, especially as you get older. Research suggests that one particular type of exercise may have an advantage when it comes to achieving both goals.
paras.zh: 减少体内脂肪是一回事。减掉脂肪的同时保持有助于保持强壮和活跃的肌肉是另一回事，尤其是随着年龄的增长。研究表明，一种特定类型的锻炼可能在实现这两个目标方面具有优势。

paras.en: High-intensity interval training (HIIT), which involves alternating short bursts of demanding exercise with easier recovery periods, may be especially helpful for older adults who want to reduce fat without sacrificing lean muscle.
paras.zh: 高强度间歇训练 (HIIT) 包括交替进行短时间的高强度运动和较容易的恢复期，对于想要在不牺牲肌肉的情况下减少脂肪的老年人可能特别有帮助。

paras.en: In a study published in Maturitas, researchers from the University of the Sunshine Coast compared three different exercise intensities. Although participants across the groups experienced modest fat loss, HIIT stood out for its ability to reduce fat while maintaining lean tissue.
paras.zh: 在《成熟》杂志上发表的一项研究中，阳光海岸大学的研究人员比较了三种不同的运动强度。尽管各组的参与者都经历了适度的减脂，但 HIIT 因其在减少脂肪的同时保持瘦肉组织的能力而脱颖而出。

paras.en: "We found that high, medium and low intensity exercises all led to modest fat loss but only HIIT retained lean muscle," said lead author and exercise physiologist Dr. Grace Rose of the University of the Sunshine Coast.
paras.zh: “我们发现，高、中、低强度的锻炼都会导致适度的脂肪减少，但只有 HIIT 保留了瘦肌肉，”阳光海岸大学的主要作者、运动生理学家 Grace Rose 博士说。

paras.en: The results highlight an important distinction in healthy aging: losing weight is not necessarily the same as improving body composition.
paras.zh: 结果凸显了健康老龄化的一个重要区别：减肥并不一定等于改善身体成分。

paras.en: Six Months of Exercise Revealed a Key Difference
paras.zh: 六个月的锻炼揭示了一个关键的区别

paras.en: The Australian research team investigated how workout intensity affects body composition, meaning the proportions of fat, muscle and other tissues that make up the body.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚研究小组调查了锻炼强度如何影响身体成分，即构成身体的脂肪、肌肉和其他组织的比例。

paras.en: A total of 123 healthy older adults from the Greater Brisbane region participated in the trial. Their average age was 72, and their average body mass index was approximately 26kg/m2, which the researchers described as normal for adults over 65.
paras.zh: 来自大布里斯班地区的总共 123 名健康老年人参加了试验。他们的平均年龄为 72 岁，平均体重指数约为 26kg/m2，研究人员称这对于 65 岁以上的成年人来说是正常的。

paras.en: Participants completed three supervised gym sessions each week for six months. Each session lasted 45 minutes, and participants were assigned to high-intensity intervals, moderate-intensity exercise, or a low-intensity comparison group.
paras.zh: 参与者在六个月内每周完成三场有人监督的健身课程。每次训练持续 45 分钟，参与者被分配到高强度间歇组、中等强度运动组或低强度对照组。

paras.en: To track changes, researchers measured body composition at the beginning of the study, after three months, and again at six months. They used a specialized scanning technique that estimates fat and lean tissue throughout the body.
paras.zh: 为了追踪变化，研究人员在研究开始时、三个月后和六个月后再次测量了身体成分。他们使用一种专门的扫描技术来估计全身的脂肪和瘦肉组织。

paras.en: The findings revealed that exercise intensity made a difference.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，运动强度会产生影响。

paras.en: Both high- and moderate-intensity training significantly reduced fat mass, with larger improvements than those seen in the low-intensity group. However, the two more demanding approaches differed in their effects on lean tissue.
paras.zh: 高强度和中等强度训练均显着减少了脂肪量，并且比低强度训练组的改善幅度更大。然而，这两种要求更高的方法对瘦肉组织的影响有所不同。

paras.en: "While moderate training reduced fat mass, it also caused a small decline in lean muscle," Rose said.
paras.zh: “虽然适度的训练减少了脂肪量，但它也导致了瘦肌肉的小幅下降，”罗斯说。

paras.en: Participants performing HIIT, meanwhile, reduced fat without experiencing the same decline in lean mass.
paras.zh: 与此同时，进行 HIIT 的参与者减少了脂肪，但瘦体重却没有出现同样的下降。

paras.en: This could be particularly valuable later in life, when maintaining muscle becomes increasingly important for physical independence. Strong muscles help people climb stairs, get out of chairs, maintain balance, and carry out everyday activities.
paras.zh: 这在以后的生活中尤其有价值，因为保持肌肉对于身体独立变得越来越重要。强壮的肌肉可以帮助人们爬楼梯、离开椅子、保持平衡并进行日常活动。

paras.en: One important distinction is that the scans measured lean tissue rather than muscle strength directly. Lean mass includes muscle but also other tissues and water, so changes in these measurements do not necessarily translate into equivalent changes in strength.
paras.zh: 一个重要的区别是扫描测量的是瘦组织而不是直接测量肌肉力量。瘦体重包括肌肉，还包括其他组织和水，因此这些测量值的变化不一定会转化为力量的等效变化。

paras.en: High-Intensity Exercise Also Reduced Abdominal Fat
paras.zh: 高强度运动也能减少腹部脂肪

paras.en: The researchers found another potentially important benefit involving fat stored around the middle of the body.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了另一个潜在的重要好处，涉及身体中部周围储存的脂肪。

paras.en: "Both high and moderate intensities improved the composition of weight carried around the middle. Further analysis is needed of the low intensity results."
paras.zh: “高强度和中等强度都改善了中部的重量构成。需要对低强度结果进行进一步分析。”

paras.en: The original study found improvements in visceral adipose tissue among both the high and moderate intensity groups.
paras.zh: 最初的研究发现高强度组和中等强度组的内脏脂肪组织都有所改善。

paras.en: Visceral fat is different from the fat that sits directly beneath the skin. It accumulates deeper in the abdomen, surrounding internal organs such as the liver and intestines.
paras.zh: 内脏脂肪与直接位于皮肤下方的脂肪不同。它积聚在腹部深处，围绕肝脏和肠道等内脏器官。

paras.en: Excessive amounts of this fat have been linked to insulin resistance, cardiovascular disease, and other metabolic problems.
paras.zh: 过量的这种脂肪与胰岛素抵抗、心血管疾病和其他代谢问题有关。

paras.en: According to Rose, these findings matter because body composition can influence the development and progression of chronic diseases as people age.
paras.zh: 罗斯认为，这些发现很重要，因为随着人们年龄的增长，身体成分会影响慢性疾病的发生和进展。

paras.en: While body weight and body mass index provide useful general information, they do not reveal how much fat or muscle a person carries, or where that fat is stored.
paras.zh: 虽然体重和体重指数提供了有用的一般信息，但它们并不能揭示一个人携带多少脂肪或肌肉，或者脂肪储存在哪里。

paras.en: Someone who loses fat while maintaining muscle may experience a more favorable change in body composition than someone who loses a similar amount of weight along with valuable lean tissue.
paras.zh: 在保持肌肉的同时减掉脂肪的人可能会比在失去同等重量的同时减少宝贵的瘦肉组织的人经历更有利的身体成分变化。

paras.en: Still, the original researchers emphasized that the improvements were relatively small. They cautioned that the differences were not clearly clinically meaningful when compared with lower intensity exercise, particularly after accounting for measurement uncertainty.
paras.zh: 不过，最初的研究人员强调，改进相对较小。他们警告说，与较低强度的运动相比，这些差异没有明显的临床意义，特别是在考虑了测量不确定性之后。

paras.en: Why HIIT May Help Aging Muscles Stay Strong
paras.zh: 为什么 HIIT 可以帮助衰老的肌肉保持强壮

paras.en: One possible explanation for HIIT's advantage lies in the way it challenges the body.
paras.zh: HIIT 优势的一种可能解释在于它挑战身体的方式。

paras.en: Rather than exercising at the same pace throughout a workout, HIIT repeatedly pushes the cardiovascular system and working muscles through periods of intense effort, followed by easier activity.
paras.zh: HIIT 并不是在整个锻炼过程中以相同的速度进行锻炼，而是反复推动心血管系统和工作肌肉经历剧烈运动阶段，然后进行轻松的活动。

paras.en: University of the Sunshine Coast Associate Professor of Physiology and study co-author Mia Schaumberg explained how the training worked.
paras.zh: 阳光海岸大学生理学副教授兼研究合著者米娅·绍姆伯格解释了训练的运作方式。

paras.en: "High-intensity training in this study involved repeated short bursts, or intervals, of very hard exercise -- where breathing is heavy and conversation is difficult -- alternated with easier recovery periods.
paras.zh: “这项研究中的高强度训练包括重复短时间爆发或间歇性的非常艰苦的运动——呼吸沉重、谈话困难——与更容易的恢复期交替。

paras.en: "HIIT likely works better because it puts more stress on the muscles, giving the body a stronger signal to keep muscle tissue rather than lose it."
paras.zh: “HIIT 可能效果更好，因为它会给肌肉带来更大的压力，给身体发出更强的信号来保留肌肉组织而不是失去它。”

paras.en: This explanation is consistent with the idea that muscles adapt to the demands placed on them. When exercise provides a sufficiently challenging stimulus, the body has more reason to maintain the tissues needed to perform that activity.
paras.zh: 这种解释与肌肉适应对它们的要求的观点是一致的。当运动提供足够具有挑战性的刺激时，身体就有更多理由维持执行该活动所需的组织。

paras.en: Muscle preservation is especially important because aging is often accompanied by a gradual decline in muscle mass and strength. In more advanced cases, this can contribute to sarcopenia, a condition characterized by reduced muscle strength and quantity that can interfere with mobility and independence.
paras.zh: 肌肉的保存尤为重要，因为衰老往往伴随着肌肉质量和力量的逐渐下降。在更严重的病例中，这可能会导致肌肉减少症，这种疾病的特征是肌肉力量和数量减少，从而影响活动能力和独立性。

paras.en: Schaumberg said the original research could help people make more informed decisions about exercise and healthy aging.
paras.zh: 绍姆伯格表示，最初的研究可以帮助人们在运动和健康老龄化方面做出更明智的决定。

paras.en: When the university publicized the findings in early 2026, she also highlighted their relevance to people setting fitness goals.
paras.zh: 当该大学于 2026 年初公布研究结果时，她还强调了这些研究结果与人们设定健身目标的相关性。

paras.en: "With the festive season now behind most of us and New Year's resolutions in full swing, this research can help inform people's plans for healthy aging in 2026," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“随着我们大多数人的节日已经过去，新年决心也如火如荼地进行，这项研究可以帮助人们制定 2026 年健康老龄化计划。”

paras.en: The research involved collaborators from UniSC's Healthy Ageing Research Cluster and The University of Queensland.
paras.zh: 这项研究涉及南卡罗来纳大学健康老龄化研究集群和昆士兰大学的合作者。

paras.en: More Recent Studies Reveal Additional Benefits of HIIT
paras.zh: 最近的研究揭示了 HIIT 的其他好处

paras.en: Research published in 2026 has provided further insight into how HIIT affects older adults, although it also suggests that intense workouts are not necessarily superior in every situation.
paras.zh: 2026 年发表的研究进一步深入了解了 HIIT 对老年人的影响，尽管它也表明高强度锻炼并不一定在任何情况下都更有效。

paras.en: One 2026 study, published in Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise, investigated whether older adults could benefit from completing HIIT at home with remote supervision.
paras.zh: 2026 年发表在《运动与锻炼医学与科学》杂志上的一项研究调查了老年人在远程监督下在家完成 HIIT 是否可以受益。

paras.en: The study involved 20 adults aged 61 to 74 who exercised using a specialized machine that let them work their arms and legs without bearing their body weight.
paras.zh: 这项研究涉及 20 名年龄在 61 岁至 74 岁之间的成年人，他们使用专门的机器进行锻炼，让他们在不承受体重的情况下锻炼手臂和腿部。

paras.en: After eight weeks of training, participants had lost an average of approximately 1.4 kilograms, or about 3 pounds, of fat mass. Their aerobic fitness also improved substantially.
paras.zh: 经过 8 周的训练，参与者平均减少了约 1.4 公斤（约 3 磅）的脂肪量。他们的有氧运动能力也显着提高。

paras.en: Participants completed 96 percent of their scheduled workouts, and the researchers reported no exercise-related adverse events.
paras.zh: 参与者完成了 96% 的预定锻炼，研究人员报告没有与锻炼相关的不良事件。

paras.en: Although the trial was small, its findings suggest that appropriately supervised HIIT programs may offer benefits outside a conventional gym.
paras.zh: 尽管试验规模较小，但其结果表明，适当监督的 HIIT 项目可能会在传统健身房之外带来好处。

paras.en: Another 2026 randomized trial, published in The Journals of Gerontology, Series A: Biological Sciences and Medical Sciences, compared HIIT with continuous moderate-intensity exercise in older adults living with HIV.
paras.zh: 另一项 2026 年随机试验发表在《老年学杂志 A 系列：生物科学和医学科学》上，对感染艾滋病毒的老年人进行 HIIT 与持续中等强度运动的比较。

paras.en: In that study, participants completed 16 weeks of exercise, with both groups also performing resistance training.
paras.zh: 在该研究中，参与者完成了 16 周的锻炼，两组还进行了阻力训练。

paras.en: Unlike the original Australian study, both exercise groups experienced reductions in fat and increases in lean mass. The researchers found no statistically significant difference between the two groups in those body composition changes.
paras.zh: 与最初的澳大利亚研究不同，两个运动组的脂肪都减少了，瘦体重也增加了。研究人员发现，两组之间的身体成分变化没有统计学上的显着差异。

paras.en: These results suggest that workout intensity is not the only factor that matters. Resistance training, which challenges muscles through weights or other forms of resistance, may also help preserve or increase lean tissue.
paras.zh: 这些结果表明锻炼强度并不是唯一重要的因素。阻力训练通过重量或其他形式的阻力来挑战肌肉，也可能有助于保留或增加瘦肉组织。

paras.en: The populations and training programs differed, so the findings should not be treated as a direct contradiction of the Australian results.
paras.zh: 人口和培训计划不同，因此研究结果不应被视为与澳大利亚结果的直接矛盾。

paras.en: Is HIIT Really the Best Exercise for Older Adults?
paras.zh: HIIT真的是老年人最好的运动吗？

paras.en: A broader scientific review published in the Journal of Clinical Medicine in August 2026 offers additional perspective.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月在《临床医学杂志》上发表的更广泛的科学评论提供了更多观点。

paras.en: Researchers examined 25 reports involving approximately 2,818 participants to assess how HIIT and other forms of interval training affect older adults.
paras.zh: 研究人员审查了涉及约 2,818 名参与者的 25 份报告，以评估 HIIT 和其他形式的间歇训练对老年人的影响。

paras.en: The most consistent benefits involved cardiovascular fitness, including improvements in the body's ability to use oxygen during exercise.
paras.zh: 最一致的好处涉及心血管健康，包括提高身体在运动过程中利用氧气的能力。

paras.en: Some studies also reported improvements in physical function and metabolic health. However, the review did not establish that HIIT was consistently better than moderate-intensity exercise.
paras.zh: 一些研究还报告了身体机能和代谢健康的改善。然而，审查并未证明 HIIT 始终优于中等强度运动。

paras.en: The researchers noted that differences between exercise programs, participant characteristics, and study methods made it difficult to identify a single optimal training approach.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，锻炼计划、参与者特征和研究方法之间的差异使得很难确定单一的最佳训练方法。

paras.en: Taken together, the findings suggest that HIIT can be a useful tool for healthy aging, but it is not the only way to improve fitness or protect muscle.
paras.zh: 总而言之，研究结果表明 HIIT 可以成为健康老龄化的有用工具，但它并不是改善健康或保护肌肉的唯一方法。

paras.en: For adults over 65, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recommends a combination of aerobic exercise, muscle strengthening activities, and exercises that improve balance.
paras.zh: 对于 65 岁以上的成年人，疾病控制和预防中心建议将有氧运动、肌肉强化活动和改善平衡的运动结合起来。

paras.en: Higher intensity workouts may be appropriate for some older adults, but people who are inactive or have medical conditions may benefit from gradually building up their fitness and seeking guidance before beginning a demanding program.
paras.zh: 较高强度的锻炼可能适合一些老年人，但不爱运动或患有健康问题的人可能会受益于逐渐增强体质并在开始要求较高的计划之前寻求指导。

paras.en: The central message from the Australian study remains compelling: what happens to muscle during fat loss may be just as important as the amount of weight someone loses.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚研究的中心信息仍然引人注目：减脂过程中肌肉发生的变化可能与减掉的体重一样重要。

paras.en: HIIT showed promise because it helped participants reduce body fat while maintaining lean tissue. Combined with newer findings, the research reinforces the value of exercise programs that support not just a lower number on the scale, but also the strength, fitness, and physical function needed for healthy aging.
paras.zh: HIIT 表现出了希望，因为它可以帮助参与者减少体内脂肪，同时保持瘦肉组织。结合最新的研究结果，该研究强化了锻炼计划的价值，这些锻炼计划不仅支持较低的数值，而且还支持健康衰老所需的力量、健身和身体机能。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of the Sunshine Coast. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由阳光海岸大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Grace Rose, Emily Hume, Daniel Blackmore, Jules Mitchell, Samuel Belford, Tina Skinner, Maryam Ziaei, Stephan Riek, Perry Bartlett, Mia Schaumberg.
