articles.title: If AI cannot be trusted in a classroom, why should it be trusted in orbit?
articles.author: Qurat-Ul-Ain Shabbir

paras.en: On September 9, 2026, Evan Hubinger, Anthropic’s alignment science lead, said on social media that he personally believed there was a greater than 10% chance that artificial intelligence could kill all of humanity within the next decade. He was responding to Jacob Coxon, a researcher who had just resigned from Anthropic after working on pretraining at both that company and OpenAI, and who wrote in his own resignation thread that “the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.” Hubinger did not walk the claim back. He confirmed it, while noting that the danger he had in mind was not today’s models but a future superintelligence for which the industry does not yet have a solved alignment plan.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 9 日，Anthropic 的对齐科学负责人 Evan Hubinger 在社交媒体上表示，他个人认为人工智能在未来十年内杀死全人类的可能性超过 10%。他是在回应雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon)，这位研究员在 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 从事预训练工作后刚刚从 Anthropic 辞职，他在自己的辞职帖子中写道，“构建人工智能的人们真诚地相信，到本世纪末，它可能会杀死我们所有人。”胡宾格没有收回索赔。他证实了这一点，同时指出，他想到的危险不是今天的模型，而是未来的超级智能，而业界尚未制定出解决的协调计划。

paras.en: Coming from the safety lead at one of the two or three companies most responsible for the technology’s current trajectory, this was not a fringe warning. It was, in effect, an admission from inside the room.
paras.zh: 来自对当前技术发展轨迹负有最大责任的两三家公司之一的安全主管，这并不是一个边缘警告。实际上，这是房间内部的承认。

paras.en: The exchange was framed almost entirely around AI in the abstract: chatbots, agents, the eventual arrival of self-improving systems. But the domain where this risk is least abstract and most immediate is not a hypothetical future superintelligence. It is the set of systems already being integrated into nuclear early warning satellites, missile-tracking constellations and the command and control architecture that decides, in minutes, whether a detected launch is real. If a company’s own safety researchers are willing to say on the record that current AI development carries a double-digit chance of civilizational catastrophe, the question that follows is not academic: What happens when systems built by that same industry, with that same acknowledged uncertainty, are the ones watching for nuclear launches from orbit and feeding what they see directly into the decision loop of nuclear-armed states?
paras.zh: 这场交流几乎完全围绕抽象的人工智能展开：聊天机器人、代理、自我改进系统的最终到来。但这种风险最不抽象、最直接的领域并不是假设的未来超级智能。这套系统已经集成到核预警卫星、导弹跟踪星座以及指挥和控制架构中，可以在几分钟内决定检测到的发射是否真实。如果一家公司自己的安全研究人员愿意公开表示，当前的人工智能发展带来文明灾难的可能性达到两位数，那么接下来的问题就不是学术问题了：当同一行业构建的系统具有同样公认的不确定性时，如果那些在轨道上监视核发射并将其看到的信息直接反馈到核武器国家的决策循环中，会发生什么？

paras.en: The nuclear-space nexus is where AI safety debate stops being abstract
paras.zh: 核与太空的联系是人工智能安全争论不再抽象的地方

paras.en: This is the nuclear space nexus, and it is where the abstract AI safety debate stops being abstract.
paras.zh: 这就是核空间的联系，也是抽象人工智能安全争论不再抽象的地方。

paras.en: The mechanism runs through space architecture itself. Satellite constellations, orbital processing units and ground relay stations are the physical layer that decides what a nuclear armed state believes is happening in the world. The AI systems currently doing that work are narrow, frozen weight models, convolutional networks for image classification, sensor fusion algorithms for combining radar and satellite feeds, nothing resembling the self improving superintelligence Coxon and Hubinger were warning about. That distinction is precisely what makes the space layer worth examining rather than dismissing.
paras.zh: 这一机制贯穿于空间建筑本身。卫星星座、轨道处理单元和地面中继站是决定核武器国家认为世界上正在发生什么的物理层。目前从事这项工作的人工智能系统是狭窄的、冻结重量的模型、用于图像分类的卷积网络、用于结合雷达和卫星馈送的传感器融合算法，与考克森和胡宾格警告的自我改进的超级智能完全不同。正是这种区别使得空间层值得研究而不是忽视。

paras.en: For decades, that layer worked on a simple “bent pipe” model: satellites captured raw infrared and radar data and beamed it down to Earth for human analysts to interpret. That model is being replaced. Modern space architecture is shifting toward onboard edge AI, with computer vision models embedded directly into satellite payloads deciding, in orbit, what counts as a missile plume before a human ever sees the raw image. At the same time, the shift from a handful of large geostationary satellites to proliferated low Earth orbit constellations of thousands of smaller satellites means no human team can parse the feeds directly. Data fusion platforms now do that work, aggregating radar, imagery and signals intelligence into a single real time track. Even a narrow, well tested model compresses the time available for human judgment, since the entire argument for automating this layer is that orbital and hypersonic threats move faster than people can react to.
paras.zh: 几十年来，该层工作在一个简单的“弯管”模型上：卫星捕获原始红外和雷达数据，并将其传送到地球供人类分析人员解释。该模型正在被替换。现代太空架构正在向机载边缘人工智能转变，计算机视觉模型直接嵌入卫星有效载荷中，在人类看到原始图像之前，在轨道上决定什么算作导弹羽流。与此同时，从少数大型对地静止卫星到由数千颗小型卫星组成的激增的近地轨道星座的转变意味着没有人类团队可以直接解析馈送。数据融合平台现在可以完成这项工作，将雷达、图像和信号情报聚合到一个实时轨道中。即使是一个经过严格测试的狭窄模型也会压缩人类判断的时间，因为自动化这一层的整个论点是轨道和高超音速威胁的移动速度比人们的反应速度要快。

paras.en: And while today’s systems are not the unaligned frontier models Coxon feared, they still introduce a structural risk: the same edge processing and data fusion architecture being built now is the substrate that a future self improving system, if one ever gained access to military networks, would inherit and exploit. A false positive in this setting is not a chatbot hallucination. It is a satellite misreading a solar flare or a glint of debris as a missile plume, and passing that reading up a chain of command that may have only minutes to decide whether to believe it.
paras.zh: 虽然今天的系统并不是 Coxon 所担心的不统一的前沿模型，但它们仍然引入了结构性风险：现在正在构建的相同边缘处理和数据融合架构是未来自我改进系统（如果能够访问军事网络）将继承和利用的基础。这种情况下的误报并不是聊天机器人的幻觉。它是一颗卫星将太阳耀斑或闪烁的碎片误读为导弹羽流，并将读取的信息传递给指挥链，而指挥链可能只有几分钟的时间来决定是否相信它。

paras.en: A useful, if unlikely, point of comparison arrived days apart from the Hubinger exchange. On September 2, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced a one-year moratorium on generative AI for public school students through eighth grade, affecting nearly 600,000 children and disabling AI functions in dozens of previously approved classroom programs. The justification was not that the technology does not work. It was that the city could not yet be confident it belonged in a setting where the cost of getting it wrong, a child’s developing capacity to think for herself, was too important to risk on a technology still being evaluated.
paras.zh: 一个有用的（即使不太可能）比较点在 Hubinger 交易所发生几天后就出现了。 9 月 2 日，纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 宣布，公立学校八年级学生暂停使用生成式人工智能一年，这影响了近 60 万名儿童，并在数十个之前批准的课堂项目中禁用了人工智能功能。理由并不是该技术不起作用。问题是，这座城市还不能确信自己属于这样一种环境，在这种环境中，犯错的代价，即孩子独立思考能力的发展，太重要了，不能冒险冒险一项仍在评估的技术。

paras.en: “Children need teachers and human connection in order to learn and in order to grow,” Mamdani said. “We hold an obligation to do the same” when it comes to AI’s role in that development.
paras.zh: “孩子们需要老师和人际关系才能学习和成长，”马姆达尼说。当谈到人工智能在这一发展中的作用时，“我们有义务做同样的事情”。

paras.en: It is worth sitting with the asymmetry this produces. New York City possesses centralized, enforceable authority over what software runs on its own school-issued devices, and used that authority to pause AI in a setting where the downside of error is developmental, not existential. Nuclear-armed states, by contrast, are integrating comparable AI systems into early warning and command infrastructure where the downside of error is civilizational, and there is no equivalent central authority capable of imposing a comparable pause. If the mere possibility of AI eroding a child’s critical thinking was sufficient grounds for New York City to disable the technology outright pending further study, the far larger and more immediate possibility of AI misreading a satellite feed and compressing a nuclear decision to seconds deserves at least the same precautionary instinct, applied to the domain where a mistake cannot be undone.
paras.zh: 值得坐视由此产生的不对称性。纽约市对在自己学校发行的设备上运行哪些软件拥有集中的、可执行的权力，并利用该权力在错误的负面影响是发展而不是存在的环境中暂停人工智能。相比之下，拥有核武器的国家正在将类似的人工智能系统集成到早期预警和指挥基础设施中，其中错误的负面影响是文明的，而且没有同等的中央机构能够实施类似的暂停。如果人工智能侵蚀儿童批判性思维的可能性足以让纽约市有充分理由在进一步研究之前彻底禁用该技术，那么人工智能误读卫星信号并将核决策压缩到几秒钟的更大、更直接的可能性至少值得同样的预防本能，应用于错误无法挽回的领域。

paras.en: The honest complication is that a school district and the international nuclear order are not remotely comparable in their capacity to act on that instinct. A ban is enforceable when one authority controls the devices in question; it is close to unenforceable when the object being restricted is software that can be updated remotely over an encrypted satellite uplink, and when no state trusts another enough to grant the kind of intrusive access that verifying compliance would require. This is precisely the gap that existing international efforts are now trying, with limited success, to close.
paras.zh: 老实说，复杂之处在于，学区和国际核秩序根据这种本能采取行动的能力根本无法相提并论。当一个机构控制相关设备时，禁令即可强制执行；当受到限制的对象是可以通过加密卫星上行链路远程更新的软件，并且没有一个国家足够信任另一个国家以授予验证合规性所需的侵入性访问权限时，它几乎无法执行。这正是现有国际努力正在试图弥补的差距，但成效有限。

paras.en: International bodies efforts to establish global norms regarding AI and nuclear command
paras.zh: 国际机构努力建立有关人工智能和核指挥的全球规范

paras.en: The most direct attempt sits at the United Nations. On December 1, 2025, the General Assembly adopted Resolution A/RES/80/23 on the risks of integrating artificial intelligence into nuclear command, control, and communications, passing 118 to 9 with 44 abstentions. The resolution calls on states to adopt and publish national policies affirming that AI-enabled NC3 systems will remain under human control and will not be capable of autonomously initiating a nuclear launch decision. That it passed with broad support is meaningful. That nine states voted against it, and that France, a nuclear power that itself insists human control must be preserved at every critical stage of a launch decision, was reportedly among them, says something sharper about how far declaratory consensus is from binding practice.
paras.zh: 最直接的尝试来自于联合国。 2025年12月1日，大会以118票对9票、44票弃权通过了关于将人工智能纳入核指挥、控制和通信的风险的A/RES/80/23号决议。该决议呼吁各国通过并公布国家政策，确认人工智能支持的 NC3 系统将继续处于人类控制之下，并且无法自主发起核发射决定。它得到广泛支持的通过是有意义的。据报道，九个国家投了反对票，而法国这个核大国本身就坚持在发射决定的每个关键阶段都必须保留人类控制，这更清楚地表明了宣言性共识与具有约束力的实践之间的差距。

paras.en: Alongside the UN process, the Summit on Responsible AI in the Military Domain, known as REAIM, has become the closest thing to a running multilateral forum on this question. Its third summit was held in A Coruña, Spain, on February 4 and 5, following earlier summits in The Hague in 2023 and Seoul in 2024. It was explicitly framed as an attempt to move from declared principles to “concrete, practical and realistic steps.” That framing was itself a quiet admission that the first two summits had not managed the transition. The 2026 outcome document was endorsed by only 39 states, down from more than 60 in 2024, a decline several analysts have linked to deteriorating relations among the major AI and nuclear powers rather than to any narrowing of the underlying risk.
paras.zh: 除了联合国进程之外，军事领域负责任人工智能峰会（REAIM）已成为该问题最接近正在运行的多边论坛的机构。第三次峰会于 2 月 4 日至 5 日在西班牙拉科鲁尼亚举行，之前曾于 2023 年在海牙和 2024 年在首尔举行过峰会。这次峰会被明确定位为从宣布的原则转向“具体、实际和现实的步骤”的尝试。这一框架本身就是在悄悄承认前两次峰会未能成功实现过渡。 2026 年成果文件仅获得 39 个国家的认可，低于 2024 年的 60 多个国家，一些分析人士认为，这一下降与主要人工智能国家和核大国之间关系的恶化有关，而不是与潜在风险的任何缩小有关。

paras.en: What both processes share is the same structural weakness: They are norm-setting exercises operating in a domain where the thing being regulated, software, cannot be counted, inspected or verified the way a missile silo can. A state can comply with the letter of a resolution on human control while still deploying an AI system that filters, prioritizes and frames the sensor data a human ultimately sees, shaping the decision long before a human formally makes it. The requirement that a person retain final authority does very little if that person’s picture of reality has already been constructed by a model no outside party can audit.
paras.zh: 这两个流程都有一个相同的结构性弱点：它们是在一个领域内进行的规范制定活动，在该领域中，被监管的东西（软件）无法像导弹发射井那样进行计数、检查或验证。一个国家可以遵守关于人类控制的决议的字面意思，同时仍然部署人工智能系统，对人类最终看到的传感器数据进行过滤、优先排序和框架，从而在人类正式做出决定之前很久就做出决定。如果一个人的现实图景已经由外部各方无法审计的模型构建而成，那么要求一个人保留最终权威的要求就没有什么作用。

paras.en: How independent research bodies evaluate these UN blueprints
paras.zh: 独立研究机构如何评估这些联合国蓝图

paras.en: Independent research bodies evaluating these blueprints have converged on a similar diagnosis. In an assessment of the UNGA resolution published shortly after its adoption, the Observer Research Foundation concluded that the measure signals a genuine and broadly shared anxiety among states, but that it remains constrained by exactly the fault lines one would expect: the divide between nuclear and non-nuclear states, the reluctance of major nuclear powers to accept binding restrictions on capabilities they consider central to deterrence and the fact that the resolution’s core language, human control and oversight, was never defined with enough technical precision to be verified rather than merely declared. The same critique applies to REAIM’s outcome documents, which rely on states to describe their own compliance rather than submitting to any external check. Both processes are, in the assessment of the researchers who study them, aspirational rather than enforceable, useful for establishing that a problem is taken seriously, but not yet capable of constraining the behavior of the states whose behavior actually matters.
paras.zh: 评估这些蓝图的独立研究机构已得出类似的诊断。观察家研究基金会在联合国大会决议通过后不久发表的一份评估报告中得出结论，该措施标志着各国之间真正和广泛共同的焦虑，但它仍然受到人们所期望的断层线的限制：核国家与无核国家之间的分歧，主要核大国不愿接受对其认为对威慑至关重要的能力的有约束力的限制，以及该决议的核心语言，即人类控制和监督，从来没有以足够的技术精确度进行定义，而只是宣布。同样的批评也适用于 REAIM 的结果文件，该文件依赖于各州描述自己的合规性，而不是提交给任何外部检查。根据研究人员的评估，这两个过程都是理想的而非可执行的，有助于确定问题得到认真对待，但尚不能限制其行为真正重要的国家的行为。

paras.en: This is, in effect, the diplomatic community’s answer to the technical impossibility of a blanket prohibition. Recognizing this, the UN General Assembly and allied processes have instead pursued a narrower, more realistic strategy: isolating AI from specific, high-consequence use cases, nuclear launch authority chief among them, rather than attempting to regulate military AI as a single undifferentiated category. Resolution A/RES/80/23 is itself an example of this approach in practice. It does not ban AI from space or defence systems generally; it targets one function, the initiation of a nuclear launch decision and insists that function alone remain exclusively human. The strategy is sound in principle. Its weakness, as the evaluations above make clear, is that use-case segregation only works if the boundary between an isolated function and the surrounding system can actually be verified.
paras.zh: 实际上，这是外交界对全面禁止在技术上不可能的问题的回答。认识到这一点，联合国大会和相关进程转而追求一种更狭隘、更现实的战略：将人工智能与具体的、后果严重的用例（其中最主要的是核发射授权）隔离开来，而不是试图将军事人工智能作为一个单一的、无差别的类别进行监管。 A/RES/80/23 号决议本身就是这种方法在实践中的一个例子。它并不普遍禁止人工智能进入太空或防御系统；它针对一项功能，即发起核发射决定，并坚持认为这一功能完全是人类的。该战略原则上是合理的。正如上面的评估所表明的那样，它的弱点是用例隔离只有在隔离功能与周围系统之间的边界实际上可以得到验证的情况下才有效。

paras.en: None of this means the underlying comparison to Mamdani’s classroom ban should be read too literally. What it usefully exposes is the gap between the precautionary standard a single city was willing to apply to a developmental risk and the precautionary standard the international system has so far been able to apply to an existential one. The nuclear order, by contrast, continues to integrate AI into its most sensitive systems while the very researchers building the underlying technology are, in public, on the record, unable to rule out a double-digit chance of civilizational catastrophe. The core policy question this raises is not whether AI can be kept out of nuclear command systems entirely.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着与马姆达尼课堂禁令的潜在比较应该过于字面解读。它有效地揭示了单个城市愿意应用于发展风险的预防标准与国际体系迄今为止能够应用于生存风险的预防标准之间的差距。相比之下，核秩序继续将人工智能整合到其最敏感的系统中，而构建底层技术的研究人员在公开场合却无法排除文明灾难的两位数可能性。这引发的核心政策问题不是人工智能是否可以完全排除在核指挥系统之外。

paras.en: It is whether the international community can move from resolutions that describe the danger, and use-case boundaries that sound precise on paper, to verification mechanisms that actually constrain it, before the gap between declared principle and deployed practice is tested by a false alarm instead of a vote count.
paras.zh: 问题在于国际社会能否在通过虚假警报而不是计票来检验所宣布的原则与部署的实践之间的差距之前，从描述危险的决议和纸面上听起来精确的用例边界转向实际限制危险的核查机制。

articles.title: NaviGate successfully demonstrates onboard precise orbit determination aboard D-Orbit’s ION Satellite Carrier
articles.author: NaviGate

paras.en: ROME, 30/09/2026 – NaviGate, an Italian space technology company spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, has successfully completed the in-orbit demonstration (IoD) of NaviCode Caravel, its autonomous onboard precise orbit determination software, aboard an ION Satellite Carrier operated by D-Orbit. During the demonstration, NaviCode Caravel ran directly on the satellite’s onboard computer, computing the spacecraft’s position in real time using only the raw data of the GNSS receiver already onboard, with no additional hardware.
paras.zh: 罗马，2026 年 9 月 30 日 – NaviGate 是一家从罗马第一大学衍生出来的意大利空间技术公司，在 D-Orbit 运营的 ION 卫星运载器上成功完成了 NaviCode Caravel（其自主机载精确定轨软件）的在轨演示 (IoD)。在演示过程中，NaviCode Caravel 直接在卫星的机载计算机上运行，​​仅使用卫星上已有的 GNSS 接收器的原始数据实时计算航天器的位置，无需额外的硬件。

paras.en: Today, knowing precisely where a satellite is remains largely a ground-based activity: operators rely on dedicated infrastructure, specialized flight dynamics teams, and repeated ground contacts to accurately reconstruct and predict the orbit of each spacecraft. As constellations grow in size and missions become more responsive, this approach turns into a bottleneck in terms of cost, workload, and reaction time. NaviCode Caravel moves precise orbit determination onboard: a software-only product that transforms the raw measurements of the GNSS receiver a satellite already carries into high-accuracy, real-time knowledge of its own position, available directly where operational decisions are made. Beyond determining where the satellite is now, Caravel can also predict where it will be, together with a measure of how reliable that prediction is, giving the spacecraft the forward-looking awareness it needs to anticipate upcoming events, such as ground station contacts or payload operations, and manage them autonomously onboard.
paras.zh: 如今，准确了解卫星的位置在很大程度上仍然是一项地面活动：运营商依靠专用基础设施、专门的飞行动力学团队以及反复的地面接触来准确重建和预测每个航天器的轨道。随着星座规模的扩大和任务的响应速度越来越快，这种方法在成本、工作量和反应时间方面变成了瓶颈。 NaviCode Caravel 实现机载精确轨道确定：这是一款纯软件产品，可将卫星已携带的 GNSS 接收器的原始测量结果转换为对其自身位置的高精度、实时了解，可直接在做出操作决策时使用。除了确定卫星现在的位置之外，Caravel 还可以预测它将在哪里，并衡量该预测的可靠性，从而为航天器提供预测即将发生的事件（例如地面站接触或有效载荷操作）所需的前瞻性意识，并在船上自主管理它们。

paras.en: The demonstration was carried out through D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service and structured in two phases. NaviCode Caravel was first validated on the ground on an engineering model replicating the in-orbit computing environment. The application was then uploaded to an ION Satellite Carrier already in orbit and executed onboard, processing real flight telemetry from the spacecraft’s GNSS receiver across multiple runs.
paras.zh: 该演示是通过 D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务进行的，并分为两个阶段。 NaviCode Caravel 首先在复制在轨计算环境的工程模型上进行了地面验证。然后，该应用程序被上传到已在轨道上的 ION 卫星载体并在机上执行，在多次运行中处理来自航天器 GNSS 接收器的真实飞行遥测数据。

paras.en: The software executed nominally onboard and in real time without anomalies. Onboard positioning reached a best-case formal uncertainty of 5.2 cm, with mean values in the decimeter range across the runs, using GPS-only measurements. NaviGate then verified the onboard solutions on the ground, proving them consistent with the reference orbits reconstructed through classical ground-based precise orbit determination performed with GODOT, the European Space Agency’s flight dynamics software. NaviCode Caravel is also designed to process multi-constellation GNSS data and correction services such as SBAS and Galileo HAS, enabling even higher accuracy in operational deployments.
paras.zh: 该软件名义上在船上实时执行，没有出现异常。使用仅 GPS 测量，机载定位的最佳情况形式不确定度达到 5.2 厘米，整个运行的平均值在分米范围内。随后，NaviGate 在地面验证了机载解决方案，证明它们与通过欧洲航天局飞行动力学软件 GODOT 执行的经典地面精确轨道确定重建的参考轨道一致。 NaviCode Caravel 还设计用于处理多星座 GNSS 数据和校正服务，例如 SBAS 和 Galileo HAS，从而在操作部署中实现更高的准确性。

paras.en: “Satellites still depend heavily on the ground to know exactly where they are and where they will be. NaviCode Caravel changes that: it is a software product that lets a satellite compute its own position with high accuracy, in real time, using the GNSS receiver it already carries, with no new hardware,” said Andrea Sesta, Chief Technology Officer and Co-founder at NaviGate. “Seeing it run in orbit without a single anomaly, and produce solutions consistent with the reference orbits computed on the ground, is the validation we were working toward, and a real milestone for the whole NaviGate team. D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service was key to getting there quickly: we developed and tested our application on the ground in the same containerized environment used in orbit, iterated fast, and flew on real flight data within months, which is exactly what a company like ours needs to bring a flight-proven product to market.”
paras.zh: NaviGate 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrea Sesta 表示：“卫星仍然严重依赖地面来准确了解它们所在的位置和将要到达的位置。NaviCode Caravel 改变了这一点：它是一款软件产品，可以让卫星使用其已携带的 GNSS 接收器实时高精度地计算自己的位置，而无需新硬件。” “看到它在轨道上运行而没有出现任何异常，并生成与地面计算的参考轨道一致的解决方案，是我们正在努力实现的验证，也是整个 NaviGate 团队的一个真正的里程碑。D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务是快速实现这一目标的关键：我们在轨道上使用的相同容器化环境中在地面上开发和测试了我们的应用程序，快速迭代，并在几个月内根据真实的飞行数据进行了飞行，这正是像我们这样的公司将经过飞行验证的产品推向市场。”

paras.en: “With five networked Intelligence Nodes in orbit, we can give customers access to space infrastructure that is already up and running. For NaviGate, that means testing their precise orbit determination algorithms ingesting raw GNSS measurements and attitude telemetry in real time from D-Orbit’s ION platform, in-situ directly on-board, with no satellite to develop or launch. It’s a practical way to move from simulation to real flight data in less time and at lower cost,” said Viney Jean-Francois Dhiri, Head of Growth, Sales and Marketing of the Space Cloud Business Unit at D-Orbit.
paras.zh: “通过在轨的五个网络智能节点，我们可以让客户访问已经启动并运行的空间基础设施。对于 NaviGate 来说，这意味着测试他们的精确定轨算法，从 D-Orbit 的 ION 平台实时获取原始 GNSS 测量数据和姿态遥测数据，直接在原位机载，无需开发或发射卫星。这是一种在更短的时间内、以更低的成本从模拟转向真实飞行数据的实用方法，”Viney Jean-Francois 说道。 Dhiri，D-Orbit 太空云业务部增长、销售和营销主管。

paras.en: Caravel is the first release of the NaviCode fleet: subsequent versions will extend these capabilities to multi-sensor resilient navigation and to autonomous maneuver planning for large constellations. NaviCode Caravel was also selected as a winner of the CASSINI Challenges 2026, the European Union’s space entrepreneurship competition run by the EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA).
paras.zh: Caravel 是 NaviCode 舰队的第一个版本：后续版本将把这些功能扩展到多传感器弹性导航和大型星座的自主机动规划。 NaviCode Caravel 还被选为 2026 年 CASSINI 挑战赛的获胜者，这是由欧盟太空计划署 (EUSPA) 主办的欧盟太空创业竞赛。

paras.en: The in-orbit demonstration is the culminating milestone of the proof-of-concept program funded by Galaxia, the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures, which backed NaviGate from its earliest stage. NaviGate was founded by researchers who developed deep expertise in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination through their work on ESA and NASA missions, and originated as a spin-off of Sapienza University of Rome.
paras.zh: 这次在轨演示是概念验证项目的最终里程碑，该项目由 Galaxia 资助，Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持，Obloo Ventures 从最初阶段就支持 NaviGate。 NaviGate 的创始人是罗马第一大学的附属机构，他们通过在欧洲航天局 (ESA) 和美国宇航局 (NASA) 任务中的工作，在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面积累了深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: Following the demonstration, NaviGate is engaging constellation operators and mission integrators for the first pilot deployments. NaviCode Caravel addresses concrete needs across the market: reducing the ground workload and infrastructure required for precise orbit determination in constellation operations, enhancing onboard image processing for Earth observation missions, supporting PNT constellations, and improving orbit knowledge for launch vehicles and orbital transfer applications, with further applications across other mission types and orbital regimes.
paras.zh: 演示结束后，NaviGate 正在与星座运营商和任务集成商合作进行首次试点部署。 NaviCode Caravel 满足整个市场的具体需求：减少星座运行中精确定轨所需的地面工作量和基础设施、增强地球观测任务的机载图像处理、支持 PNT 星座、改善运载火箭和轨道转移应用的轨道知识，以及在其他任务类型和轨道制度中的进一步应用。

paras.en: Spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, NaviGate S.r.l. is an Italian space technology startup founded by researchers with extensive experience in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination across ESA and NASA missions including Juno, Cassini, Veritas, BepiColombo, and JUICE, and initiatives such as ESA Moonlight and Marconi constellations. The company develops NaviCode, a modular, data-agnostic software platform that enables satellites and constellations to perform precise orbit determination, orbit prediction, and autonomous maneuvering without continuous ground intervention, leveraging GNSS, radiometric, optical, and other navigation measurements. NaviGate was incorporated in 2026 and is backed by Galaxia, Italy’s national technology transfer hub for aerospace, and supported by the ESA BIC Lazio incubation program.
paras.zh: NaviGate S.r.l. 是从罗马第一大学分离出来的。是一家意大利空间技术初创公司，由在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面拥有丰富经验的研究人员创立，这些研究人员参与了欧空局和美国宇航局的任务，包括朱诺号、卡西尼号、Veritas、BepiColombo 和 JUICE，以及​​欧空局月光和马可尼星座等计划。该公司开发了 NaviCode，这是一个与数据无关的模块化软件平台，使卫星和星座能够利用 GNSS、辐射、光学和其他导航测量来执行精确的定轨、轨道预测和自主操纵，而无需持续的地面干预。 NaviGate 成立于 2026 年，得到意大利国家航空航天技术转移中心 Galaxia 的支持，并得到 ESA BIC Lazio 孵化计划的支持。

paras.en: More information on www.navigate-space.com
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 www.navigate-space.com

paras.en: D-Orbit develops space logistics systems for orbital transportation, hosted payload operations, and in-orbit data processing. Its ION Satellite Carrier is an orbital transfer vehicle (OTV) used for satellite deployment and hosted payload operations; since 2020 it has flown 23 missions and carried 240+ payloads, including hosted payloads and satellites deployed in orbit. The company also provides space cloud services based on onboard computing for in-orbit data processing and is developing GEA, a servicing spacecraft intended to support autonomous rendezvous, inspection, and refueling, as well as NOX, a synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) Earth observation satellite.
paras.zh: D-Orbit 开发用于轨道运输、托管有效载荷操作和在轨数据处理的空间物流系统。其ION卫星载体是一种轨道传输运载工具（OTV），用于卫星部署和托管有效载荷操作；自 2020 年以来，它已执行 23 次飞行任务，携带 240 多个有效载荷，包括托管有效载荷和部署在轨道上的卫星。该公司还提供基于机载计算的空间云服务，用于在轨数据处理，并正在开发 GEA（一种旨在支持自主交会、检查和加油的服务航天器）以及 NOX（一颗合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 地球观测卫星）。

paras.en: Galaxia is the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace, powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures. Its mission is to promote the development of startups conceived within research laboratories specialized in the aerospace sector. The scientific promoters of Galaxia are Politecnico di Torino and Sapienza University of Rome, together with other leading Italian universities, including the University of Padua and Politecnico di Bari. NEVA SGR, the venture capital company of the Intesa Sanpaolo Group, and Compagnia di San Paolo Foundation are investors in the initiative. Obloo Ventures acts as the entrepreneurial partner and co-investor of the hub, managing the scouting, investment execution and portfolio monitoring. Along with Lazio Innova and the I3P Incubator of the Politecnico di Torino, Obloo Ventures also coordinates the business creation program, dedicated to startups originating from academic research and selected by the hub for seed investments.
paras.zh: Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持。其使命是促进航空航天领域专门研究实验室内构思的初创企业的发展。 Galaxia 的科学推动者是都灵理工大学和罗马第一大学，以及其他意大利领先大学，包括帕多瓦大学和巴里理工大学。 Intesa Sanpaolo 集团的风险投资公司 NEVA SGR 和 Compagnia di San Paolo 基金会是该计划的投资者。 Obloo Ventures 是该中心的创业合作伙伴和联合投资者，负责管理搜寻、投资执行和投资组合监控。 Obloo Ventures 与 Lazio Innova 和都灵理工大学的 I3P 孵化器一起协调企业创建计划，致力于源自学术研究并由种子投资中心选择的初创企业。

paras.en: More information on https://galaxia.vc/it/
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 https://galaxia.vc/it/

articles.title: Galileo Space Is Building Satellites That Turn Signals Into Answers in Orbit
articles.author: Galileo Space

paras.en: Galileo Space is building satellites designed to turn signals into answers in orbit. Modern defense and commercial operations need fast answers about what is happening and where. Existing systems can leave segmented data crawling through processing for hours or days. FPV drones and moving radars must be detected and tracked quickly. Ballistic missile launch plume detection can provide critical early warning. Interference disrupting navigation frequencies or crucial satcom links must be detected and traced to its source. A ship lost at sea may still broadcast a distress signal. A tumbling satellite may lose contact with the ground while still emitting signals that help locate it. Rescue crews may have only hours to find someone before nightfall.
paras.zh: 伽利略航天公司正在建造旨在将信号转化为轨道上答案的卫星。现代国防和商业运营需要快速了解正在发生的事情和地点。现有系统可能会让分段数据在处理过程中爬行数小时或数天。 FPV 无人机和移动雷达必须被快速检测和跟踪。弹道导弹发射羽流检测可以提供关键的早期预警。必须检测干扰导航频率或关键卫星通信链路的干扰并追踪其来源。在海上失踪的船只仍可能会发出求救信号。翻滚的卫星可能会与地面失去联系，但仍会发出有助于定位卫星的信号。救援人员可能只有几个小时的时间才能在夜幕降临之前找到人。

paras.en: The solution combines innovative sensors with AI fusion at the edge to generate actionable reports directly in orbit. The system is designed to operate fully autonomously for weeks, selecting and carrying out its own sensing tasks. It identifies threats, geolocates signals and delivers actionable intelligence to operators within minutes, not hours or days. The mission is to give defense teams the early warning they need to survive and commercial operators the answers they need to act.
paras.zh: 该解决方案将创新传感器与边缘人工智能融合相结合，直接在轨道上生成可操作的报告。该系统设计为完全自主运行数周，选择并执行自己的传感任务。它可以在几分钟（而不是几小时或几天）内识别威胁、对信号进行地理定位并向操作员提供可采取行动的情报。其使命是为防御团队提供生存所需的早期预警，并为商业运营商提供采取行动所需的答案。

paras.en: Working side by side with government stakeholders, the team has developed a deep understanding of operational needs and critical capability gaps. The company is in the final stages of securing its first government contract. Its first demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch in Q4 of 2027 to prove its capabilities in orbit and open the door to a potential Phase III government contract. Galileo has also deepened relationships with commercial companies that need near live data, creating a path to early revenue alongside its defense business.
paras.zh: 该团队与政府利益相关者并肩工作，对运营需求和关键能力差距有了深入的了解。该公司正处于获得第一份政府合同的最后阶段。其第一颗示范卫星计划于 2027 年第四季度发射，以证明其在轨能力，并为潜在的第三阶段政府合同打开大门。伽利略还加深了与需要近乎实时数据的商业公司的关系，为其国防业务创造了一条早期收入的途径。

paras.en: Galileo was selected for a16z speedrun as one of 80 companies chosen from 30,000 applicants.
paras.zh: Galileo 是从 30,000 名申请者中选出的 80 家公司之一，被选为 a16z speedrun 项目的一员。

paras.en: CEO: Brings a decade of experience in national security space and military systems at Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin. Led testing in orbit for protected military communications satellites and consulted for the U.S. Space Force on acquiring new technology. Combines spacecraft engineering expertise with deep knowledge of defense missions, government procurement and what operators need.
paras.zh: 首席执行官：在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司和洛克希德·马丁公司拥有十年的国家安全空间和军事系统经验。领导受保护的军用通信卫星在轨测试，并就获取新技术为美国太空军提供咨询。将航天器工程专业知识与国防任务、政府采购和运营商需求的深入了解相结合。

paras.en: CSO: Was responsible for building machine learning systems for Google, YouTube and Amazon’s Prime Video. Brings expertise in AI, software infrastructure and building systems at global scale. Now leads Galileo’s satellite software, bringing that experience into orbit to turn complex sensor data into clear intelligence that operators can act on.
paras.zh: CSO：负责为谷歌、YouTube 和亚马逊的 Prime Video 构建机器学习系统。在全球范围内带来人工智能、软件基础设施和建筑系统方面的专业知识。现在领导伽利略的卫星软件，将这种经验带入轨道，将复杂的传感器数据转化为操作员可以采取行动的清晰情报。

paras.en: CTO: Designed, tested and delivered all RF radios for SpaceX Starship flights, owning the radios through Flight 10, including first booster catch at the tower. Introduced Starship’s first integrated Starlink phased array antenna and RTK GPS receiver hardware that helped guide the booster back to the tower. Previously worked on electronic warfare for a Navy jammer missile at Raytheon and designed high power RF amplifiers for the Navy and Ka band block upconverters for the Army at two startups.
paras.zh: 首席技术官：为 SpaceX 星舰飞行设计、测试并交付了所有 RF 无线电设备，并拥有 10 号航班的无线电设备，包括塔上的第一个助推器捕获器。推出 Starship 首款集成 Starlink 相控阵天线和 RTK GPS 接收器硬件，帮助引导助推器返回塔楼。此前曾在雷神公司从事海军干扰导弹的电子战工作，并在两家初创公司为海军设计高功率射频放大器，为陆军设计 Ka 频段上变频器。

paras.en: Visit our website: https://galileo-space.com
paras.zh: 访问我们的网站：https://galileo-space.com

articles.title: Cosmic House of Mirrors
articles.author: HQ Web Team

paras.en: Galaxies warp and multiply as if in a house of mirrors in this image from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope released on Sept. 29, 2026.
paras.zh: 在美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜于 2026 年 9 月 29 日发布的这张图像中，星系扭曲和倍增，就像在镜子房子里一样。

paras.en: The brilliant golden galaxies seen here are part of a galaxy cluster called MACS J0454.1-0300. The orange galaxies bunched together on one side of the image, however, are not actually part of the cluster, but rather galaxies much farther away whose light has been bent and magnified by gravitational lensing. This phenomenon occurs when the enormous mass of a foreground object such as a galaxy cluster bends and magnifies the light from a more distant object in the background.
paras.zh: 这里看到的明亮的金色星系是名为 MACS J0454.1-0300 的星系团的一部分。然而，聚集在图像一侧的橙色星系实际上并不是星团的一部分，而是距离更远的星系，其光线已被引力透镜弯曲和放大。当前景物体（例如星系团）的巨大质量弯曲并放大背景中更远物体的光时，就会发生这种现象。

paras.en: Image credit: ESA/Webb, NASA & CSA, L. Furtak, S. Fujimoto
paras.zh: 图片来源：ESA/Webb、NASA 和 CSA、L. Furtak、S. Fujimoto

articles.title: NASA Demonstrates Next-Generation Heat Shield Technologies
articles.author: Tara Friesen

paras.en: NASA is testing heat shields that can keep astronauts safe as they return from missions to the Moon and Mars in an unusual way: by taking out the trash.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在测试隔热罩，当宇航员完成月球和火星任务返回时，该隔热罩可以以一种不寻常的方式保证宇航员的安全：清除垃圾。

paras.en: When Northrop Grumman 24th cargo resupply mission for NASA undocked from the International Space Station, it carried a fleet of 12 small, experimental capsules designed to test the next generation of thermal protection materials that could serve as the foundation for future heat shields.
paras.zh: 当诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司为 NASA 执行的第 24 次货物补给任务从国际空间站脱离时，它搭载了由 12 个小型实验舱组成的舰队，旨在测试下一代热防护材料，这些材料可以作为未来隔热罩的基础。

paras.en: The experiment, called the Kentucky Reentry Probe Experiment (KREPE-3), is the third in a series of low-cost, high-impact missions that use the final moments of the cargo spacecraft’s lifespan to gather valuable data.
paras.zh: 该实验被称为肯塔基再入探测器实验（KREPE-3），是一系列低成本、高影响力任务中的第三次，这些任务利用货运飞船寿命的最后时刻来收集有价值的数据。

paras.en: The experiment is a collaboration among the University of Kentucky, the state of Kentucky, NASA’s Established Program to Stimulate Competitive Research (EPSCoR), several NASA centers, and other federal and commercial partners.
paras.zh: 该实验是肯塔基大学、肯塔基州、NASA 刺激竞争性研究既定计划 (EPSCoR)、NASA 的几个中心以及其他联邦和商业合作伙伴之间的合作。

paras.en: “KREPE-3 is a great example of the goals of NASA’s EPSCoR program,” said David Berger, EPSCoR program manager at NASA’s Headquarters in Washington. “We are supporting the next generation of scientists and engineers as they develop unique projects that benefit their education and NASA’s mission goals.”
paras.zh: “KREPE-3 是 NASA EPSCoR 计划目标的一个很好的例子，”NASA 华盛顿总部 EPSCoR 项目经理 David Berger 说。 “我们正在支持下一代科学家和工程师开发独特的项目，这有利于他们的教育和 NASA 的任务目标。”

paras.en: Before the mission’s Cygnus XL spacecraft departed the station, astronauts packed it with waste and activated the 12 small capsules carried inside. Designed by University of Kentucky students, the capsules include sensors that will measure temperature, pressure, motion, magnetic field, and light during re-entry.
paras.zh: 在此次任务的 Cygnus XL 航天器离开空间站之前，宇航员将其装满废物并启动了内部的 12 个小太空舱。这些太空舱由肯塔基大学的学生设计，包括传感器，可在重返大气层期间测量温度、压力、运动、磁场和光线。

paras.en: As the vehicle harmlessly breaks apart in Earth’s atmosphere on its planned route, the capsules will eject and begin collecting data on how each set of experimental heat shield materials performs. Satellite signals will transfer live data to researchers, offering insights into how larger heat shields could protect future cargo or crew.
paras.zh: 当飞行器按计划路线在地球大气层中无害分解时，太空舱将弹出并开始收集有关每组实验隔热材料性能的数据。卫星信号将向研究人员传输实时数据，从而深入了解更大的隔热罩如何保护未来的货物或船员。

paras.en: “It’s a smart way to get flight data on materials that are still in development,” said Keith Peterson, a materials engineer at NASA’s Ames Research Center in California’s Silicon Valley. “We’re essentially hitching a ride on a vehicle that’s already coming back to Earth.”
paras.zh: “这是一种获取仍在开发的材料飞行数据的明智方法，”加州硅谷 NASA 艾姆斯研究中心的材料工程师基思·彼得森 (Keith Peterson) 说。 “我们实际上是在搭一辆已经返回地球的交通工具。”

paras.en: The capsules will carry a variety of thermal protective components, including proven technology such as the ceramic tile material used on the space shuttle. Others will test new options, such as a 3D-printed heat shield from the Additive Manufacturing of Thermal Protective Systems project developed at NASA Johnson and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
paras.zh: 太空舱将携带各种热防护组件，包括经过验证的技术，例如航天飞机上使用的瓷砖材料。其他人将测试新选项，例如 NASA 约翰逊和橡树岭国家实验室开发的热防护系统增材制造项目的 3D 打印隔热罩。

paras.en: Researchers at NASA Ames are contributing several materials to KREPE-3, including two capsules that will fly a next-generation family of protective coverings known as Materials Engineered for Re-entry using Innovative Needling Operations (MERINO). Made from layers of carbon and phenolic fibers stitched together like felt, the materials are more flexible, faster to produce, and less expensive than traditional protective substances – making them promising candidates for Mars missions. Thanks to Mars’ thinner atmosphere, missions to land on the Red Planet involve lower heat loads and allow for lighter protection.
paras.zh: NASA 艾姆斯研究人员正在为 KREPE-3 提供多种材料，其中包括两个太空舱，它们将飞行下一代防护覆盖物系列，称为使用创新针刺操作再入工程工程材料 (MERINO)。这些材料由碳纤维和酚醛纤维层像毛毡一样缝合在一起制成，比传统的保护材料更灵活、生产速度更快，而且成本更低，使其成为火星任务的有希望的候选材料。由于火星的大气层较稀薄，登陆这颗红色星球的任务涉及较低的热负荷并允许较轻的保护。

paras.en: A third capsule will combine those protective coverings with other elements. The Kentucky Instrumented Conical Hypersonic Experiment will utilize a dual-cone shape. It combines a tungsten tip attached to a cone layered with carbon and hear-resistant plastic fibers, and an aft cone wrapped in MERINO. This unique design will validate computer models against real-world data.
paras.zh: 第三个胶囊将把这些保护层与其他元素结合起来。肯塔基州仪表圆锥高超音速实验将采用双圆锥形状。它结合了一个钨尖端，该尖端连接到一个覆盖有碳纤维和隔音塑料纤维的锥体上，以及一个包裹着美利奴羊毛的尾部锥体。这种独特的设计将根据真实世界的数据验证计算机模型。

paras.en: Another capsule is shaped like the protective aeroshell that will protect NASA’s upcoming mission, Dragonfly, as it arrives at Saturn’s moon, Titan, and will test the dynamic stability of the design. It is covered in Phenolic Impregnated Carbon Ablator, a material developed at NASA Ames that has applications for commercial vehicles and flew on NASA’s Stardust, Mars Science Laboratory, and Mars 2020 missions.
paras.zh: 另一个太空舱的形状像保护性航空壳，它将在美国宇航局即将到来的任务“蜻蜓”抵达土星的卫星泰坦时保护它，并将测试设计的动态稳定性。它覆盖有酚醛浸渍碳烧蚀剂，这是一种由 NASA 艾姆斯研究中心开发的材料，可应用于商用车辆，并在 NASA 的星尘号、火星科学实验室和火星 2020 任务中飞行。

paras.en: One capsule will test a deployable heat shield called Adaptable Deployable Entry and Placement Technology, which is shaped like an umbrella to increase surface area and slow descent. At full scale, Adaptable Deployable Entry design could be folded, making it ideal for deploying payloads that are larger than the rockets that launch them into flight.
paras.zh: 一个太空舱将测试一种称为“适应性可展开进入和放置技术”的可展开隔热罩，该技术的形状像一把伞，以增加表面积并减缓下降速度。在全尺寸下，适应性可部署入口设计可以折叠，使其非常适合部署比将其发射升空的火箭更大的有效载荷。

paras.en: While some capsules are testing new materials to carry missions to Mars, others are testing new shapes and designs that will further research and understanding of computer modeling and sensor design — technologies that could open doors to another generation of re-entry design innovation.
paras.zh: 虽然一些太空舱正在测试新材料以执行火星任务，但其他太空舱正在测试新的形状和设计，这将进一步研究和理解计算机建模和传感器设计，这些技术可能为新一代重返设计创新打开大门。

paras.en: Additional capsules developed by domestic and international partners will test a variety of known and new materials, including a heat flux sensor developed at the University of Stuttgart in Germany, that will help researchers measure how heat moves across a surface during re-entry.
paras.zh: 国内和国际合作伙伴开发的其他胶囊将测试各种已知和新材料，包括德国斯图加特大学开发的热通量传感器，该传感器将帮助研究人员测量重返大气层期间热量如何在表面上移动。

paras.en: “We’re pushing the boundaries of what heat shields can do,” said Peterson. “And we’re testing them in a way that’s fast, affordable, and incredibly effective.”
paras.zh: “我们正在突破隔热罩的功能界限，”彼得森说。 “我们正在以一种快速、经济且极其有效的方式测试它们。”

articles.title: NASA Seeks US Industry Plans for Commercial Space Stations
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit. On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 正在进一步推进美国在太空领域的领导地位，迈向未来商业空间站在近地轨道上处于领先地位的未来。周五，该机构发布了最终的征求建议书，邀请业界提交下一代商业空间站的计划。

paras.en: “In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “We will continue to need a place to conduct research, develop technologies, train crews, and prepare for missions to the Moon and Mars. Commercial space stations may provide that capability while creating new opportunities for American industry and allowing NASA to concentrate more of our resources on the near-impossible missions ahead.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示：“根据总统的国家太空政策，美国宇航局致力于在国际空间站退役后很长一段时间内维持美国在近地轨道上的持续存在。” “我们将继续需要一个地方来进行研究、开发技术、培训人员以及为月球和火星任务做准备。商业空间站可以提供这种能力，同时为美国工业创造新的机会，并使美国宇航局能够将更多的资源集中在未来几乎不可能的任务上。”

paras.en: Building on the agency’s Ignition event earlier this year, NASA regularly has engaged with private industry to shape the agency’s future direction in low Earth orbit. This included publishing two Requests for Information in March to gather industry’s perspective on low Earth orbit destinations and transportation. The agency also published a draft Request for Proposals in July, followed by an industry day and one-on-one meetings that allowed interested companies to review and comment on the planned acquisition approach.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候该机构的点火事件的基础上，美国宇航局定期与私营企业合作，以塑造该机构在近地轨道的未来方向。其中包括在三月份发布两份信息请求，以收集业界对低地球轨道目的地和运输的看法。该机构还在 7 月份发布了征求建议书草案，随后举行了行业日和一对一会议，让感兴趣的公司对计划中的收购方式进行审查和评论。

paras.en: “We’ve made it clear that NASA will never give up its presence in low Earth orbit,” said Isaacman. “Since Ignition, we have spent a lot of time listening to industry and working through what it will take to make this transition successful. The opportunity is significant, but the economics ultimately have to work. We want to see credible plans, strong technical execution, and companies prepared to invest in destinations that can serve NASA while developing additional customers and markets of their own.”
paras.zh: “我们已经明确表示，美国宇航局永远不会放弃其在近地轨道的存在，”艾萨克曼说。 “自 Ignition 以来，我们花了很多时间倾听业界的声音，并研究如何使这一转变成功。机会是巨大的，但经济最终必须发挥作用。我们希望看到可靠的计划、强大的技术执行力以及准备投资可以为 NASA 服务的目的地的公司，同时开发更多自己的客户和市场。”

paras.en: Proposals are due Tuesday, Dec. 8, with contract awards expected in spring 2027.
paras.zh: 提案将于 12 月 8 日星期二提交，合同预计将于 2027 年春季授予。

paras.en: Under the solicitation, NASA outlines requirements for companies interested in designing, building, testing, certifying, and operating commercial low Earth orbit destinations capable of providing end-to-end destination and transportation services for human spaceflight use.
paras.zh: 根据招标，美国宇航局概述了对设计、建造、测试、认证和运营商业近地轨道目的地感兴趣的公司的要求，这些目的地能够为载人航天用途提供端到端目的地和运输服务。

paras.en: NASA intends to award firm-fixed-price, multi-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contracts supporting development, certification, and services for continued low Earth orbit research and exploration. This will allow NASA to select two or more contractors through early development, followed by a competitive task order for final design, test, and evaluation, as well as certification and services from one or more contractors.
paras.zh: NASA 打算授予固定价格、多次授予、无限期交付/无限数量的合同，支持持续低地球轨道研究和探索的开发、认证和服务。这将使美国宇航局能够通过早期开发选择两个或更多承包商，然后为最终设计、测试和评估以及一个或多个承包商的认证和服务提供竞争性任务订单。

paras.en: Learn more about NASA’s missions on the agency’s website:
paras.zh: 在该机构的网站上了解有关 NASA 任务的更多信息：

paras.en: george.c.alderman@nasa.gov / joshua.a.finch@nasa.gov
paras.zh: george.c.alderman@nasa.gov / joshua.a.finch@nasa.gov

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Yemen has fallen back into full-scale war, warns UN envoy

paras.en: Security Council LIVE: Yemen has fallen back into full-scale war, warns UN envoy
paras.zh: 安理会直播：联合国特使警告也门已重新陷入全面战争

paras.en: The Security Council met to discuss the crisis in Yemen Friday, where a Houthi offensive launched in September has sharply escalated the 12-year-long war for control of the country and spillover from the US-Iran war has provoked a new displacement crisis. Live coverage below and for full meetings updates, go here.
paras.zh: 安理会周五开会讨论也门危机。胡塞武装9月发起的攻势使长达12年的对该国控制权的战争急剧升级，而美伊战争的溢出效应又引发了新的流离失所危机。下面的实时报道和完整的会议更新，请访问此处。

paras.en: - Cross-border missile and drone strikes on Saudi airports and energy infrastructure have continued this week, while Government forces say they have recaptured the port city of Mocha
paras.zh: - 本周，针对沙特机场和能源基础设施的跨境导弹和无人机袭击仍在继续，而政府军表示，他们已经夺回了港口城市摩卡

paras.en: - Fighting between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi-backed Government forces is intensifying around Taiz, and more than 200,000 people have been displaced
paras.zh: - 伊朗支持的胡塞武装和沙特支持的政府军在塔伊兹周围的战斗愈演愈烈，超过20万人流离失所

paras.en: - Aid agencies warn of surging cholera cases, rising child casualties and deepening hunger
paras.zh: - 援助机构警告霍乱病例激增、儿童伤亡增加和饥饿加剧

paras.en: - Diplomatic efforts to prevent a wider regional conflict, including threats to Red Sea shipping, are also expected to feature
paras.zh: - 旨在防止更广泛的地区冲突（包括对红海航运的威胁）的外交努力预计也将成为重点

articles.title: Amid heartache of Nepal flooding disaster, fear remains

paras.en: Amid heartache of Nepal flooding disaster, fear remains
paras.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾令人心痛，恐惧依然存在

paras.en: Six weeks after Nepal’s deadly flooding disaster, communities are still struggling to rebuild their lives, but they will need sustained help as global warming increases the risk of another Himalayan catastrophe, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）周五表示，尼泊尔致命洪水灾难发生六周后，社区仍在努力重建生活，但随着全球变暖增加了另一场喜马拉雅灾难的风险，他们将需要持续的帮助。

paras.en: At least 1,400 people were killed, including 84 children, and nearly 5,300 people are still missing, after a mountain of glacial ice and rock collapsed into the Bhotekoshi, Upper Trishuli and Narayani-Gandak rivers in late August, unleashing a massive torrent that washed away bridges and homes.
paras.zh: 8月下旬，一座冰川和岩石山崩塌进入博特科希河、上特里苏利河和纳拉亚尼-甘达克河，引发巨大洪流​​，冲毁桥梁和房屋，造成至少 1,400 人死亡，其中包括 84 名儿童，近 5,300 人仍然失踪。

paras.en: In an update from Kathmandu, UNICEF spokesperson James Elder highlighted the traumatic experience of 16-year-old Sahara, who he met this week at a technical training supported by the agency. “Her mum was swept away by the floods and killed. Through tears, Sahara told me, ‘It's not nice to live without a mum.’”
paras.zh: 在加德满都发来的最新消息中，联合国儿童基金会发言人詹姆斯·埃尔德强调了 16 岁撒哈拉的痛苦经历，他本周在该机构支持的技术培训中认识了撒哈拉。 “她的妈妈被洪水冲走并丧生。撒哈拉流着泪告诉我，‘没有妈妈的生活并不好。’”

paras.en: Today, areas of impacted towns and villages “look like war zones”, Mr. Elder stressed, while access to some communities in Rasuwa remains difficult.
paras.zh: 艾德先生强调，如今，受影响的城镇和村庄地区“看起来就像战区”，而进入拉苏瓦的一些社区仍然很困难。

paras.en: “They continue to receive airlifted relief supplies in the most isolated areas,” said Caroline Holt, Director for Disasters, Climate and Crises at the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC). “In the hardest-hit locations, families face disrupted markets, higher transport costs and shortages of essential goods as roads and communications are gradually restored.”
paras.zh: 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会（IFRC）灾害、气候和危机部主任卡罗琳·霍尔特表示：“他们继续在最偏远的地区接收空运的救援物资。” “在受灾最严重的地区，随着道路和通讯逐渐恢复，家庭面临着市场混乱、运输成本上升和必需品短缺的问题。”

paras.en: "Unless the world acts to reduce climate risks, we will keep returning to the same valleys after the next flood and after the next landslide, and yet again find children paying the highest price. This is true in Nepal, across Asia, across the Pacific and around the world," James Elder - UNICEF
paras.zh: “除非世界采取行动减少气候风险，否则我们将在下一次洪水和下一次山体滑坡之后继续回到同样的山谷，并再次发现儿童付出最高的代价。这在尼泊尔、亚洲、太平洋和世界各地都是如此，”詹姆斯·埃尔德 - 联合国儿童基金会

paras.en: The IFRC official stressed the urgent need to support those impacted by the disaster.
paras.zh: 红十字与红新月联会官员强调，迫切需要为受灾难影响的人们提供支持。

paras.en: “People need more than assistance to survive, they need confidence in their future, they need to know where they live, how they will earn an income and when their children can return to school,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“人们需要的不仅仅是生存援助，他们还需要对自己的未来充满信心，他们需要知道自己住在哪里、如何赚取收入以及孩子何时可以重返学校。”

paras.en: Among those requiring urgent assistance are Shushila and her husband, Jivan, after floodwater more than two metres high surged through their home, destroying their tailor’s shop and tea store.
paras.zh: 两米多高的洪水冲过他们的家，摧毁了他们的裁缝店和茶店，舒希拉和她的丈夫吉万也是需要紧急援助的人。

paras.en: “They escaped with the clothes they were wearing, and nothing else," Mr. Elder said. "Shushila told me, ‘Maybe it would have been better if we weren't able to escape.’ That is the stress and trauma brought on by inaction elsewhere in the world,” Mr. Elder noted, adding that UNICEF has supported Shushila and Jivan’s family with cash assistance. “With so many needs, how did they prioritize their spending? On their children; books, stationery and clothes."
paras.zh: “他们只带着身上穿的衣服逃跑了，什么也没带，”埃尔德先生说。 “舒什拉告诉我，‘如果我们无法逃脱，也许情况会更好。’这就是世界其他地方不作为所带来的压力和创伤，”埃尔德先生指出。他补充说，联合国儿童基金会已向舒什拉和吉万的家人提供现金援助。 “有如此多的需求，他们如何优先考虑支出？在孩子上；书籍、文具和衣服。”

paras.en: International support for vulnerable countries, including Nepal, that are on the front line of climate change is critical, as the Himalayas warm “about twice as fast as the global average”, Mr. Elder said.
paras.zh: 艾德表示，国际社会对尼泊尔等处于气候变化前线的脆弱国家的支持至关重要，因为喜马拉雅山脉的变暖速度“大约是全球平均水平的两倍”。

paras.en: Noting that Nepal produces only 0.1 per cent of global greenhouse emissions, the UNICEF spokesperson welcomed declarations of support from States parties to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) “to avert, minimize and address loss and damage. But for countries like Nepal, those commitments have to quickly translate into support that reaches affected families on the ground,” he said, ahead of this year’s UNFCCC summit (COP31) in Antalya, Turkïye, from 9-20 November.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会发言人指出，尼泊尔的温室气体排放量仅占全球的0.1%，他欢迎《联合国气候变化框架公约》(UNFCCC)缔约国宣布支持“避免、尽量减少和解决损失和损害。但对于像尼泊尔这样的国家来说，这些承诺必须迅速转化为对当地受影响家庭的支持，”他在今年11月9日至20日于土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国气候变化框架公约峰会(COP31)之前表示。

paras.en: "Unless the world acts to reduce climate risks, we will keep returning to the same valleys after the next flood and after the next landslide, and yet again find children paying the highest price. This is true in Nepal, across Asia, across the Pacific and around the world," said Mr. Elder.
paras.zh: “除非世界采取行动减少气候风险，否则我们将在下一次洪水和下一次山体滑坡之后再次回到同样的山谷，并再次发现儿童付出最高的代价。这在尼泊尔、整个亚洲、整个太平洋和世界各地都是如此，”埃尔德先生说。

articles.title: ‘Serious blow’: Guterres condemns new US sanctions on International Criminal Court

paras.en: ‘Serious blow’: Guterres condemns new US sanctions on International Criminal Court
paras.zh: “严重打击”：古特雷斯谴责美国对国际刑事法院的新制裁

paras.en: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) as an institution, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio vowing on Friday to “dismantle the ICC, brick by brick” unless it ends what Washington regards as a “threat” to its citizens.
paras.zh: 美国已对国际刑事法院（ICC）这一机构实施制裁，国务卿马可·鲁比奥周五誓言要“一砖一瓦地解散国际刑事法院”，除非它结束华盛顿所认为的对其公民的“威胁”。

paras.en: The court hit back forcefully, calling the step unprecedented, following sanction measures by the US already in place against 13 judges and prosecutors.
paras.zh: 在美国对 13 名法官和检察官实施制裁措施后，法院强烈回击，称这一举措史无前例。

paras.en: The ICC described the measure as “an assault on the rule of law and on the very foundations of the international legal order”.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院将该措施描述为“对法治和国际法律秩序基础的攻击”。

paras.en: The designation, the court said, is aimed at disrupting its operations and “intimidating those who work for or cooperate with the court”. But, it will not be deterred.
paras.zh: 法院表示，这一指定旨在扰乱其运作并“恐吓为法院工作或与法院合作的人”。但是，它不会被阻止。

paras.en: “The court will continue to fully discharge its mandate, with independence and impartiality, acting only on the basis of the law and the evidence for the sake of the countless victims of grave crimes,” said ICC President Tomoko Akane.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院主席茜智子表示：“法院将继续以独立和公正的态度充分履行其职责，仅以法律和证据为基础，为无数严重犯罪受害者着想。”

paras.en: Yet, the court acknowledged that it cannot stand alone.
paras.zh: 然而，法院承认它不能独立存在。

paras.en: “Its fate now rests also in the hands of the States that created it,” the statement said, adding that the Rome Statute’s promise “is only as strong as the resolve of those who made it”.
paras.zh: 声明称：“它的命运现在也掌握在创建它的国家手中。”并补充说，《罗马规约》的承诺“只有制定者的决心才强大”。

paras.en: “No one should be punished for serving the cause of justice. History will judge this moment,” it concluded.
paras.zh: “任何人都不应该因为为正义事业服务而受到惩罚。历史将在这一刻做出判断，”它总结道。

paras.en: Announcing the sanctions, Mr. Rubio said the US would “ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate”.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在宣布制裁时表示，美国将“禁止与这个流氓法院进行交易，切断其资源并削弱其运作能力”。

paras.en: “America never joined the court. We don’t need it. And we don’t want it,” he added.
paras.zh: “美国从未加入过法庭。我们不需要它。我们也不想要它，”他补充道。

paras.en: Mr. Rubio said the door to diplomacy remained open, but he issued a stark warning. “Either the ICC will end its threats, or we will end the ICC,” he said, adding that Washington expected allies to “rein in the court”.
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，外交大门仍然敞开，但他发出了严厉警告。他说：“要么国际刑事法院结束其威胁，要么我们就结束国际刑事法院。”他补充说，华盛顿希望盟友“控制法院”。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres strongly criticised the US decision, according to his spokesperson, Stéphane Dujarric.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯的发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克表示，他强烈批评美国的决定。

paras.en: The UN chief condemned the new sanctions against the court “as an institution”.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长谴责对法院“作为一个机构”的新制裁。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres was “deeply alarmed” by the expected impact on the court’s “continued ability to perform its important mandates” and called the sanctions “a serious blow to our collective pursuit of international criminal justice, of which the ICC is a key pillar”.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生对国际刑事法院“持续履行其重要职责的能力”所受到的预期影响“深感震惊”，并称制裁“对我们对国际刑事司法的集体追求造成了严重打击，而国际刑事法院是国际刑事司法的关键支柱”。

paras.en: He reiterated his “unwavering support for the independence of the court and its officials” and called on all States to uphold their commitments under international law.
paras.zh: 他重申“坚定不移地支持法院及其官员的独立性”，并呼吁所有国家恪守其对国际法的承诺。

paras.en: The UN remains committed to cooperating with the ICC under the relationship agreement approved by the General Assembly on 13 September 2004, the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说，联合国仍然致力于根据联合国大会 2004 年 9 月 13 日批准的关系协议与国际刑事法院进行合作。

paras.en: Independent UN human rights experts warned separately that the US sanctions were a “brash attempt” to dismantle a collective international legal system to hold perpetrators of the gravest crimes to account.
paras.zh: 联合国独立人权专家分别警告说，美国的制裁是一次“鲁莽的尝试”，目的是瓦解集体国际法律体系，以追究最严重罪行的肇事者的责任。

paras.en: They called on States committed to the rule of law to stand together in defence of the court and its independence.
paras.zh: 他们呼吁致力于法治的国家共同捍卫法院及其独立性。

paras.en: “Sanctioning the institution entrusted with delivering justice for the gravest international crimes is an assault on the foundations of international accountability and rule of law,” the experts said.
paras.zh: 专家们表示：“制裁负责为最严重的国际罪行伸张正义的机构是对国际责任和法治基础的攻击。”

paras.en: “No State should place itself beyond the reach of the law by intimidating the court established to enforce it and attempting to dismantle it.”
paras.zh: “任何国家都不应通过恐吓为执行法律而设立的法院并试图废除法律而将自己置于法律的管辖范围之外。”

paras.en: The UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts – who are not employed by the UN and receive no salary for their work – added that the attack “directly injures the victims of atrocities and their advocates, who rely on the ICC for justice, accountability and reparation”.
paras.zh: 联合国人权理事会任命的专家——他们不受联合国雇用，工作也没有工资——补充说，这次袭击“直接伤害​​了暴行的受害者及其支持者，他们依靠国际刑事法院寻求正义、问责和赔偿”。

articles.title: O'Neill: Decision to stay at Celtic didn't take long

paras.en: Celtic manager Martin O'Neill says decision to stay at Scottish Premiership champions 'didn't take long'
paras.zh: 凯尔特人队主教练马丁·奥尼尔表示，留在苏格兰超级联赛冠军的决定“并没有花很长时间”

paras.en: Celtic lost three consecutive games before the international break, including twice to Rangers; Martin O'Neill said he would consider his future after the defeats but has decided to remain in charge; watch Motherwell vs Celtic on Sunday, live on Sky Sports from 11am
paras.zh: 凯尔特人队在国际比赛日之前连续输掉三场比赛，其中两次输给流浪者队；马丁·奥尼尔表示，他会在失败后考虑自己的未来，但已决定继续负责。周日上午 11 点起，天空体育将直播马瑟韦尔对阵凯尔特人的比赛

paras.en: Martin O'Neill said it would have been "poor" to walk out on Celtic as he explained it "did not take long" for him to rediscover his drive to lead the team following a brief period of uncertainty about his future.
paras.zh: 马丁·奥尼尔表示，离开凯尔特人队是“很糟糕的”，因为他解释说，在经历了短暂的未来不确定期后，“没过多久”他就重新发现了领导球队的动力。

paras.en: In a downbeat post-match interview following the 1-0 defeat at home to Rangers in the last game prior to the international break, the 74-year-old said: "It's not the first time I've been questioned about my managerial time. I'll have a look at it. I will reflect and see."
paras.zh: 在国际比赛日之前的最后一场比赛中，在主场0-1输给流浪者队之后，这位74岁的老人在接受悲观的赛后采访时表示：“这不是我第一次被质疑我的执教时间。我会考虑一下。我会反思并看看。”

paras.en: After O'Neill confirmed this week he was remaining as manager, he expanded on his decision to stay in Friday's press conference ahead of Sunday's trip to Motherwell, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 在奥尼尔本周确认他将继续担任主教练后，他在周日前往马瑟韦尔之前的周五新闻发布会上进一步阐述了自己留在天空体育的决定。

paras.en: "It didn't take that long in all honesty," he said. "There was an international break. It gives you time to reflect.
paras.zh: “老实说，并没有花那么长时间，”他说。 “有一个国际比赛日。这给了你反思的时间。

paras.en: "I was obviously disappointed with the week we had. There's a long season ahead and it didn't take me long to make my mind up to continue, as long as the club wanted me and I was happy to do it.
paras.zh: “我显然对我们度过的这一周感到失望。接下来的赛季还很漫长，我很快就下定决心要继续下去，只要俱乐部需要我，我也很乐意这样做。”

paras.en: "Leaving at this particular stage would have been poor. Had there been no international break, I probably wouldn't even have said what I said."
paras.zh: “在这个特定阶段离开会很糟糕。如果没有国际比赛日，我什至可能不会说出我所说的话。”

paras.en: Despite losing their last three games in all competitions before the break, Celtic remain two points clear of Rangers at the top of the Premiership.
paras.zh: 尽管在休息前的所有比赛中都输掉了最后三场比赛，凯尔特人队仍然领先英超榜首流浪者队两分。

paras.en: "The main driver is to try and win the league again, that's really it," O'Neill said. "My two spells last year in charge for 23 league games, we were able to pull it off. I know it's in the past but because it's in the recent past, it gives you that spur to want to go and do it.
paras.zh: “主要的驱动力是尝试再次赢得联盟，就是这样，”奥尼尔说。 “去年我两次执教23场联赛，我们成功了。我知道那已经是过去式了，但因为那是不久前的事，所以它会激励你去做这件事。”

paras.en: "We've a full season ahead, remarkably. It sounds hard to believe but we're actually still in front in the league at this minute. I was reminded, until Rangers beat us in the league, we had won the previous 13 games in the league.
paras.zh: “引人注目的是，我们还有一个完整的赛季。这听起来令人难以置信，但我们实际上仍然在联盟中处于领先地位。有人提醒我，在流浪者队在联盟中击败我们之前，我们已经赢得了联盟之前的 13 场比赛。

paras.en: "I have belief in the team and I think our focus should be to try and win the league."
paras.zh: “我对球队有信心，我认为我们的重点应该是努力赢得联赛。”

paras.en: O'Neill revealed Jota, who has been sidelined for almost 18 months with a cruciate ligament injury, has "every possibility" of being in the squad on Sunday after "training with us now for some considerable time" and then playing in a friendly against Falkirk.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔透露，因十字韧带受伤已经缺席近18个月的若塔在“与我们一起训练了相当长的一段时间”之后“完全有可能”在周日进入球队，然后参加了与福尔柯克的友谊赛。

paras.en: Chelsea left-back Landon Emenalo, who agreed a loan move to Celtic at the end of the summer transfer window, will belatedly join up with the Hoops squad after recovering from injury. "I think with a little bit of luck he's coming up tomorrow and he'll start with us next week," said O'Neill.
paras.zh: 切尔西左后卫兰登·埃梅纳洛同意在夏季转会窗口结束时租借到凯尔特人队，他将在伤愈后加入篮球队。 “我想如果运气好的话他明天就会上场，下周他就会和我们一起首发，”奥尼尔说。

paras.en: O'Neill: Rift between club and supporters 'really sad'
paras.zh: 奥尼尔：俱乐部和球迷之间的裂痕“非常悲伤”

paras.en: O'Neill also expressed sadness over the widening rift between Celtic supporters and club after the Green Brigade announced a boycott of upcoming Scottish Cup and Europa League matches.
paras.zh: 在绿旅宣布抵制即将举行的苏格兰杯和欧联杯比赛后，奥尼尔还对凯尔特人球迷与俱乐部之间日益扩大的裂痕表示悲伤。

paras.en: The ultras group released a statement on Friday hitting out at the "naked contempt" they feel the board have for them after being irked that "the conduct of the Green Brigade" was alluded to in a club statement condemning the tennis-ball protest against major shareholder Dermot Desmond at the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship at St Andrews last weekend.
paras.zh: 上周末在圣安德鲁斯举行的阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯锦标赛上，俱乐部声明谴责了针对大股东德莫特·德斯蒙德的网球抗议，该极端组织周五发表声明，猛烈抨击了董事会对他们的“赤裸裸的蔑视”。

paras.en: "Under the influence of Dermot Desmond, a dark cloud lingers over our club creating an increasingly unsustainable environment," read a lengthy post from the Green Brigade.
paras.zh: “在德莫特·德斯蒙德的影响下，乌云笼罩着我们的俱乐部，创造了一个越来越不可持续的环境，”绿色旅在一篇长文中写道。

paras.en: "The board's latest irrational statement at the behest of Desmond represents another attack on supporters.
paras.zh: “董事会应德斯蒙德的要求发表的最新非理性声明是对支持者的又一次攻击。

paras.en: "It explicitly attaches our group to an action which we are not responsible for, although we commend those who are.
paras.zh: “它明确地将我们的团队与我们不承担责任的行动联系起来，尽管我们赞扬那些负有责任的人。

paras.en: "It is further demonstration, if needed, of the utter disdain they have for our group. It is clear notice of another ban, be that imminently or for another manufactured incident like times before."
paras.zh: “如果需要的话，这进一步表明了他们对我们组织的彻底蔑视。这显然是另一项禁令的通知，无论是迫在眉睫的禁令还是像以前那样的另一起人为事件。”

paras.en: Outlining their intention to stay away from certain matches, the statement continued: "Achieving meaningful change requires some level of sacrifice.
paras.zh: 声明概述了他们不参加某些比赛的意图，并继续说道：“实现有意义的改变需要一定程度的牺牲。

paras.en: "We will not attend the remaining Europa League home ties nor any Scottish Cup tie at home, away or at Hampden. We will review this position at the end of the season or earlier should adequate progress be made."
paras.zh: “我们不会参加剩余的欧罗巴联赛主场比赛，也不会参加任何主场、客场或汉普顿的苏格兰杯比赛。如果取得足够进展，我们将在赛季末或更早时审查这一立场。”

paras.en: Former striker Chris Sutton said earlier this week that "Celtic at this moment in time is a bit of a cesspit".
paras.zh: 前前锋克里斯·萨顿本周早些时候表示，“凯尔特人此时此刻有点像一个粪坑”。

paras.en: O'Neill, who helped the Hoops navigate a turbulent season to win the double last season, said: "I came into the situation this time last year and it seems to be going back to that again. I don't agree at all with what happened up at St Andrews."
paras.zh: 奥尼尔上赛季帮助篮球队度过了一个动荡的赛季并赢得了双冠王，他说：“去年这个时候我就遇到了这种情况，而且似乎又会回到那种情况。我完全不同意圣安德鲁斯发生的事情。”

paras.en: Reacting to the Green Brigade's boycott, O'Neill said: "I think it's a really sad situation if that's the case. It is sad but we went through it last season.
paras.zh: 在回应绿色旅的抵制时，奥尼尔说：“我认为如果是这样的话，这真是一个令人悲伤的情况。这很悲伤，但我们上赛季就经历过这种情况。”

paras.en: "What I will say is that when the club came together, I can remember the days of having 80,000 people in Seville without an arrest. That's Celtic to me.
paras.zh: “我要说的是，当俱乐部合并时，我还记得塞维利亚有 8 万人没有被捕的日子。对我来说，这就是凯尔特人。

paras.en: "But at the end of it all, it is a sad situation. All I do know is that when the club were together towards the end of the season, I genuinely felt we were unbeatable.
paras.zh: “但归根结底，这是一个悲伤的情况。我所知道的是，当俱乐部在赛季末团结在一起时，我真的觉得我们是不可战胜的。

paras.en: "We have to try and win some football matches maybe to get some togetherness here."
paras.zh: “我们必须努力赢得一些足球比赛，也许才能在这里团结起来。”

articles.title: Hope hundred fires West Indies to record win over India in second T20

paras.en: India vs West Indies: Shai Hope hits unbeaten 102 in Windies' highest successful T20 run chase
paras.zh: 印度 vs 西印度群岛：Shai Hope 在 Windies 最高成功 T20 追逐赛中打出不败的 102 杆

paras.en: Shai Hope hits unbeaten 102 off only 45 balls as West Indies beat India in their highest successful Twenty20 run chase; Hope smashes nine sixes and six fours as West Indies storm to 252-4 in reply to India's 249-5 to win by six wickets with nine balls to spare
paras.zh: 谢·霍普 (Shai Hope) 仅用 45 个球就打出了 102 分不败战绩，帮助西印度群岛队 (West Indies) 在 20 场追逐赛中击败印度队 (India)，这是他们最成功的 Twenty20 跑动追逐战；霍普 (Hope) 击碎了 9 个六分球和 6 个四分球，西印度群岛队以 252-4 猛攻，回应印度队的 249-5，以六个三柱门获胜，还剩 9 个球

paras.en: Shai Hope struck a century as West Indies completed their highest successful chase in T20 internationals, overhauling a target of 250 to beat India by six wickets in Ranchi and level the five-match series at 1-1.
paras.zh: 谢·霍普 (Shai Hope) 实现了一个世纪的跨越，西印度群岛队在 T20 国际赛中完成了他们在 T20 国际赛中最成功的追击，超越了 250 场比赛的目标，在兰契以 6 个三柱门的优势击败了印度队，并将五场比赛的系列赛战成 1-1 平。

paras.en: The visitors were also recording the second-highest successful run chase in men's T20 international history, surpassed only by South Africa's pursuit of 259 against West Indies in 2023.
paras.zh: 客队还创下了男子 T20 国际历史上第二高的追跑成功率，仅次于南非队在 2023 年对阵西印度群岛队时取得的 259 分。

paras.en: Chasing the daunting target, West Indies were rocked early when pace bowler Mayank Yadav removed Kamil Pooran and Shimron Hetmyer with successive deliveries in the opening over before dismissing Rovman Powell for 24.
paras.zh: 为了追逐这个令人畏惧的目标，西印度群岛队很早就震惊了，速度投球手梅扬克·亚达夫(Mayank Yadav)在开场就连续投球淘汰了卡米尔·普兰(Kamil Pooran)和西姆龙·海特迈尔(Shimron Hetmyer)，然后将罗夫曼·鲍威尔(Rovman Powell)罚下24分。

paras.en: - Scorecard: West Indies vs India: Second T20
paras.zh: - 记分卡：西印度群岛 vs 印度：第二个 T20

paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或与 NOW 签订无合同

paras.en: - Listen to latest episode of the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast
paras.zh: - 收听天空体育板球播客的最新一集

paras.en: "When you chase here in India, you always give yourself a chance. You always think you're in the game, regardless of what score is on the board," Hope said.
paras.zh: “当你在印度追逐时，你总是给自己一个机会。你总是认为自己在比赛中，无论棋盘上的分数是多少，”霍普说。

paras.en: "But five for two was always going to be challenging."
paras.zh: “但二人五人总是充满挑战。”

paras.en: Skipper Hope and Sherfane Rutherford turned the match on its head with a blistering 120-run partnership for the fourth wicket.
paras.zh: 斯基普·霍普 (Skipper Hope) 和谢尔凡·卢瑟福 (Sherfane Rutherford) 在第四个边门上联手打出 120 分，扭转了比赛的局面。

paras.en: Rutherford survived on 38 when Yadav spilled a straightforward chance at short fine leg and capitalised on the reprieve, hammering 84 off 37 balls before falling to Kuldeep Yadav.
paras.zh: 卢瑟福在第 38 场比赛中幸存下来，当时亚达夫在短腿上错失了一个直接的机会，并利用缓刑，在 37 个球中轰出 84 个球，然后输给了库尔迪普·亚达夫。

paras.en: Hope was unfazed, anchoring the chase while maintaining the required rate, and combined with Romario Shepherd to guide West Indies home with nine balls to spare. Hope remained unbeaten on 102 from 45 deliveries.
paras.zh: 霍普并没有受到影响，在保持要求的速度的同时锁定了追击，并与罗马里奥·谢泼德一起带领西印度群岛队以九个剩余球回家。 Hope 在 45 次交付中保持了 102 次不败。

paras.en: "When we got that partnership there, we just got some more impetus in the innings," Hope said.
paras.zh: “当我们在那里建立伙伴关系时，我们在局中获得了更多动力，”霍普说。

paras.en: "Then obviously Sherfane came and did what he did, played really well with the bat, and just gave us that spark that we needed to get over the line."
paras.zh: “然后显然谢尔凡来了，做了他所做的事情，球棒打得非常好，给了我们冲线所需的火花。”

paras.en: Earlier, Sanju Samson's 41-ball 82 underpinned India's total after he and Abhishek Sharma raced to 42 in less than four overs for the opening wicket.
paras.zh: 早些时候，桑朱·萨姆森 (Sanju Samson) 和阿布舍克·夏尔马 (Abhishek Sharma) 在开场三柱门不到 4 个回合的时间内打出 42 球，打出 41 球 82 杆的成绩，奠定了印度队的总成绩。

paras.en: Roston Chase halted the early surge by dismissing Sharma and later removed Ishan Kishan for 43 and Shivam Dube, while Shamar Springer struck with the key wicket of Samson.
paras.zh: 罗斯顿·蔡斯（Roston Chase）通过解雇夏尔马（Sharma）阻止了早期的激增，随后将伊尚·基尚（Ishan Kishan）换下为43和希瓦姆·杜贝（Shivam Dube），而沙玛尔·斯普林格（Shamar Springer）则用萨姆森（Samson）的关键三柱门击球。

paras.en: India accelerated again late on through Shreyas Iyer and Tilak Varma, who put on 83 runs from 32 balls, with Iyer making 40 before falling off the penultimate delivery as the hosts finished on 249-5.
paras.zh: 印度队在最后时刻再次加速，Shreyas Iyer 和 Tilak Varma 32 个球打出 83 分，其中 Iyer 拿下 40 分，但在倒数第二个投球中落败，主队以 249-5 结束比赛。

paras.en: The teams meet again in the third T20 in Indore on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，两队将在印多尔举行的第三场 T20 比赛中再次相遇。

articles.title: What to know about pneumonic plague after woman in Russia dies from mysterious illness
articles.author: Erika Edwards

paras.en: The death of a 28-year-old woman who worked in an anti-plague laboratory in Russia is raising concerns about what caused her illness.
paras.zh: 一名在俄罗斯抗鼠疫实验室工作的 28 岁女性的死亡引发了人们对她患病原因的担忧。

paras.en: The woman died Friday, according to the World Health Organization, with no cause of death confirmed. A Russian official said the woman died of pneumonia of “undetermined” origin and didn’t link her death to her work at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，这名妇女于周五死亡，死因尚未得到证实。一名俄罗斯官员表示，这名妇女死于“不明原因”的肺炎，并没有将她的死亡与她在西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的工作联系起来。

paras.en: Darya Shipilova, 28, was identified by her mother and Russian media outlets as the lab worker.
paras.zh: 28 岁的达莉亚·希皮洛娃 (Darya Shipilova) 被她的母亲和俄罗斯媒体确认为实验室工作人员。

paras.en: According to media reports, a second employee at the lab has developed pneumonia of undetermined cause, although that case hasn’t yet been verified, officials with the World Health Organization said at a briefing Wednesday.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织官员在周三的新闻发布会上表示，据媒体报道，该实验室的另一名员工患有不明原因肺炎，尽管该病例尚未得到证实。

paras.en: On Thursday, Russia’s consumer and health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, denied there was a second case.
paras.zh: 周四，俄罗斯消费者和健康监管机构 Rospotrebnadzor 否认存在第二例病例。

paras.en: Dr. Maria Van Kerkhove, director of the WHO’s Epidemic and Pandemic Management Department, said during the Wednesday briefing that the agency is seeking information from the Russian Health Ministry about tests that have been conducted, the results of the laboratory tests and any further analysis.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织流行病和大流行病管理司司长玛丽亚·范·科霍夫博士在周三的新闻发布会上表示，该机构正在向俄罗斯卫生部寻求有关已进行的检测、实验室检测结果以及任何进一步分析的信息。

paras.en: That questioning “will continue until we get the answers that we actually need to 1, understand the situation, and 2, to understand the risk that it poses not only for Russia but for everyone else,” Kerkhove said.
paras.zh: 科霍夫说，这种质疑“将持续下去，直到我们得到我们实际上需要的答案：1、了解情况，2、了解它不仅对俄罗斯而且对其他所有人构成的风险”。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said on X that it is monitoring “reports of a suspected case of pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region of Russia that resulted in a death,” the circumstances of which “remain unconfirmed.”
paras.zh: 周二，美国疾病控制与预防中心 X 表示，正在监测“俄罗斯伊尔库茨克地区疑似肺鼠疫病例并导致死亡的报告”，该病例的情况“尚未得到证实”。

paras.en: “At this time, there is no indication of a broader threat to the United States, but CDC and our interagency partners are prepared and will continue to monitor the situation closely,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“目前没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁，但疾病预防控制中心和我们的跨机构合作伙伴已做好准备，并将继续密切监测局势。”

paras.en: Key details aren’t known, including whether the woman was infected with plague at all and, if so, whether it was naturally occurring plague or bacteria studied in the lab. Scientists also don’t know how quickly her illness progressed and how she was treated.
paras.zh: 关键细节尚不清楚，包括该妇女是否感染了鼠疫，如果感染了，是自然发生的鼠疫还是实验室研究的细菌。科学家们也不知道她的病情进展有多快以及她是如何接受治疗的。

paras.en: Nearly 200 people who came into contact with the woman have been under precautionary medical observation, according to Russian media.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯媒体报道，近200名与该女子有过接触的人已接受预防性医学观察。

paras.en: Rospotrebnadzor reported that monitoring of all the woman’s contacts had concluded on Oct. 8. “No health issues related to infectious disease were detected,” the watchdog group said.
paras.zh: Rospotrebnadzor 报告称，对这名妇女所有接触者的监测已于 10 月 8 日结束。该监督组织表示，“没有发现与传染病相关的健康问题”。

paras.en: Earlier in the week, Dr. Ashish Jha, the former White House Covid response coordinator, said in an interview, “If there were weapons programs, biological weapons programs in these labs, that would be much more concerning to me.”
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，前白宫新冠疫情应对协调员阿什什·贾博士在接受采访时表示，“如果这些实验室有武器计划、生物武器计划，那我会更担心。”

paras.en: “We need to understand that now,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们现在需要了解这一点，”他补充道。

paras.en: Lisa Morici, a microbiologist and immunologist at the Tulane University School of Medicine, said, “Maybe it’s going to come out that she died from something unrelated and it was just a coincidence” that she worked in an anti-plague lab.
paras.zh: 杜兰大学医学院微生物学家和免疫学家丽莎·莫里奇 (Lisa Morici) 表示，“也许最终会发现她死于无关的疾病，而她在抗鼠疫实验室工作只是一个巧合”。

paras.en: The mysterious situation is still unfolding. But here’s what we know about the pneumonic plague, how it spreads and how dangerous it is.
paras.zh: 神秘的情况仍在不断展开。但以下是我们对肺鼠疫的了解、它的传播方式以及它的危险性。

paras.en: Plague is an infection caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria. Known as the “Black Death” during the 14th century, plague triggered several global pandemics over centuries before the discovery of antibiotics.
paras.zh: 鼠疫是由鼠疫耶尔森菌引起的感染。鼠疫在 14 世纪被称为“黑死病”，在抗生素发现之前的几个世纪里，鼠疫引发了数次全球流行病。

paras.en: It presents in three main forms: bubonic, pneumonic and septicemic, according to the World Health Organization. All three are caused by Yersinia pestis, but they occur in different parts of the body.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，它主要表现为三种形式：腺鼠疫、肺炎和败血症。这三种病毒都是由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起的，但它们发生在身体的不同部位。

paras.en: Bubonic is the most common form, Morici said. It is primarily transmitted through bites of infected fleas or direct contact with infected rodents, which can cause painful, swollen lumps in the lymph nodes. It is usually not contagious.
paras.zh: 莫里奇说，腺鼠疫是最常见的形式。它主要通过受感染的跳蚤叮咬或直接接触受感染的啮齿动物传播，这可能会导致淋巴结疼痛、肿块。它通常不具有传染性。

paras.en: Left untreated, however, it can spread to the lungs and become pneumonic plague, which can pass from person to person through respiratory droplets, Morici said.
paras.zh: 然而，莫里奇说，如果不及时治疗，它可能会传播到肺部并成为肺鼠疫，并可以通过呼吸道飞沫在人与人之间传播。

paras.en: Septicemic plague occurs when the bacteria grow and spread in the blood.
paras.zh: 当细菌在血液中生长和传播时，就会发生败血性鼠疫。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague can spread through the air when an infected person or animal coughs or sneezes.
paras.zh: 当感染者或动物咳嗽或打喷嚏时，肺鼠疫可以通过空气传播。

paras.en: The respiratory droplets don’t travel very far, maybe 3 to 6 feet, said Dr. Dave Wagner, director of the Pathogen and Microbiome Institute at Northern Arizona University. “They drop to the ground pretty quickly.”
paras.zh: 北亚利桑那大学病原体和微生物研究所所长戴夫·瓦格纳博士说，呼吸道飞沫不会传播很远，可能是 3 到 6 英尺。 “它们很快就会掉到地上。”

paras.en: It’s the rarest form of the disease, according to the WHO.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，这是这种疾病中最罕见的一种。

paras.en: Dr. William Schaffer, an infectious diseases expert at Vanderbilt University Medical Center, said close contacts are most at risk. Pneumonic plague isn’t something that spreads “distantly across a room, but to face-to-face contacts,” he said.
paras.zh: 范德比尔特大学医学中心传染病专家威廉·谢弗博士表示，密切接触者面临的风险最大。他说，肺鼠疫并不是“在一个房间里远距离传播，而是通过面对面的接触”。

paras.en: Morici said, “It’s highly unlikely for most people to get the pneumonic form of the disease.”
paras.zh: 莫里奇说：“对于大多数人来说，患上这种疾病的肺炎形式的可能性极小。”

paras.en: Covid, for example, spreads like wildfire through the air, traveling beyond 6 feet.
paras.zh: 例如，新冠病毒就像野火一样在空气中传播，传播范围超过 6 英尺。

paras.en: “It’s nothing like the Covid-19 pandemic,” she said.
paras.zh: “这与 Covid-19 大流行完全不同，”她说。

paras.en: While pneumonic plague is the rarest form of the disease, it’s also the deadliest.
paras.zh: 虽然肺鼠疫是这种疾病中最罕见的形式，但它也是最致命的。

paras.en: “It’s the one that’s so frightening because it can kill so quickly,” Morici said.
paras.zh: 莫里奇说：“它之所以如此可怕，是因为它能如此迅速地致人死亡。”

paras.en: It progresses remarkably fast, Wagner said. Symptoms typically appear within one to two days of exposure, and patients require treatment within 48 hours of showing symptoms to prevent fatal complications. Symptoms can include shortness of breath and coughing or blood in the phlegm.
paras.zh: 瓦格纳说，它的进展非常快。症状通常会在接触后一到两天内出现，患者需要在出现症状后 48 小时内接受治疗，以防止致命的并发症。症状可能包括呼吸短促、咳嗽或痰中带血。

paras.en: Because of how rapidly it attacks the respiratory system, public health experts consider this strain the likeliest candidate for a biological attack, according to Morici.
paras.zh: 莫里奇表示，由于它攻击呼吸系统的速度如此之快，公共卫生专家认为这种菌株最有可能遭受生物攻击。

paras.en: People with pneumonic plague are often quarantined, she said. Healthcare workers will often wear personal protective equipment, such as N95 masks, or even full-body suits in case of accidental exposure.
paras.zh: 她说，患有肺鼠疫的人经常被隔离。医护人员通常会穿戴个人防护装备，例如 N95 口罩，甚至穿着全身防护服，以防意外接触。

paras.en: “We’re using the strictest levels of biocontainment,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们正在使用最严格的生物防护水平，”她说。

paras.en: Antibiotics are highly effective against plague, including pneumonic plague.
paras.zh: 抗生素对鼠疫（包括肺鼠疫）非常有效。

paras.en: “This is why we don’t have big plague outbreaks anymore,” Wagner said.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我们不再爆发大规模鼠疫，”瓦格纳说。

paras.en: Are experts worried about a potential plague outbreak?
paras.zh: 专家们是否担心潜在的鼠疫爆发？

paras.en: Schaffner said there’s no evidence to suggest that the plague bacteria are evolving in a way to become resistant to antibiotics. “We will not turn 2026 into the Middle Ages, where the Black Death caused vast amounts of death throughout Europe. That will not happen.”
paras.zh: 沙夫纳说，没有证据表明鼠疫细菌正在进化以对抗生素产生抗药性。 “我们不会把 2026 年变成中世纪，黑死病在整个欧洲造成大量死亡。这种情况不会发生。”

paras.en: Wagner said he has no reason to believe this suspected case of plague is “going to take off and spread.”
paras.zh: 瓦格纳表示，他没有理由相信这起疑似鼠疫病例会“迅速蔓延”。

paras.en: “The plague that we have today is the same plague that was the scourge of humanity for so long during great pandemics,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们今天遇到的瘟疫与大流行期间长期以来对人类造成的祸害是同一种瘟疫。”

paras.en: About seven cases of plague are reported in the U.S. each year, according to the CDC. Most occur in rural parts of the Southwest, including Arizona, California, Colorado and New Mexico. Those are areas where Yersinia pestis bacteria naturally circulate among wild rodents like prairie dogs and their fleas.
paras.zh: 据疾病预防控制中心称，美国每年报告大约七例鼠疫病例。大多数发生在西南部的农村地区，包括亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州、科罗拉多州和新墨西哥州。这些地区是鼠疫耶尔森氏菌在草原土拨鼠及其跳蚤等野生啮齿动物中自然传播的地区。

paras.en: Most people are treated quickly with antibiotics and recover. Deaths from plague in the U.S. are rare, but they do happen.
paras.zh: 大多数人很快就能接受抗生素治疗并康复。在美国，鼠疫造成的死亡很少见，但确实发生过。

paras.en: In July 2025, a man in Arizona died of pneumonic plague after he was exposed to sick cats. Within a week, the man went to an emergency department with shallow breathing, a fast heart rate, chest pain and a dry cough. Despite getting antibiotics and oxygen, the man died within eight hours of his admission to the hospital. Testing later showed he had pneumonic plague.
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月，亚利桑那州一名男子在接触病猫后死于肺鼠疫。一周内，该男子因呼吸浅、心率快、胸痛和干咳而被送往急诊室。尽管接受了抗生素和氧气治疗，该男子还是在入院后八小时内死亡。后来的测试显示他患有肺鼠疫。

articles.title: Navi Pillay, who led U.N. panel that found Israel committed genocide in Gaza, wins Nobel Peace Prize
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: The Nobel Peace Prize was awarded Friday to the South African legal pioneer Navanethem “Navi” Pillay for defending international law and institutions in a world in which increasingly “might overtakes right.”
paras.zh: 周五，诺贝尔和平奖被授予南非法律先驱纳瓦尼特姆·“纳维”·皮莱 (Navanethem “Navi” Pillay)，以表彰他在一个日益“强权压倒权利”的世界中捍卫国际法和机构的行为。

paras.en: Pillay, 85, has a decadeslong career that spans defending Nelson Mandela and standing up against the racist apartheid regime in South Africa, to leading a United Nations commission that concluded Israel committed genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.
paras.zh: 85 岁的皮莱拥有数十年的职业生涯，从捍卫纳尔逊·曼德拉、挺身反对南非的种族主义种族隔离政权，到领导一个联合国委员会，得出以色列对加沙巴勒斯坦人实施种族灭绝的结论。
