paras.en: “Navi Pillay is one of the great defenders of international legal principles in our time,” said Jørgen Watne Frydnes, chair of the Norwegian Nobel Committee.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔委员会主席约尔根·沃特纳·弗里德内斯 (Jørgen Watne Frydnes) 表示：“纳维·皮莱是我们这个时代国际法律原则的伟大捍卫者之一。”

paras.en: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay
paras.zh: 诺贝尔和平奖授予纳维·皮莱

paras.en: Frydnes contrasted Pillay’s work with the wider international “shift towards power politics,” in which “international law is under tremendous pressure, and its institutions are under attack.”
paras.zh: 弗里德尼斯将皮莱的工作与更广泛的国际“向强权政治的转变”进行了对比，其中“国际法承受着巨大的压力，其机构受到攻击”。

paras.en: Her “distinguished career reminds us of the need to support, fortify and expand the global rule of law,” he said. “Navi Pillay’s commitment to justice and human dignity is a source of hope and inspiration to all who seek to bring about a more peaceful world.”
paras.zh: 他说，她“杰出的职业生涯提醒我们有必要支持、加强和扩大全球法治”。 “纳维·皮莱对正义和人类尊严的承诺是所有寻求建立一个更加和平世界的人的希望和灵感的源泉。”

paras.en: That was a reference to President Donald Trump’s long-standing ambitions to win the Nobel Peace Prize, and the offer by last year’s winner, Maria Corina Machado, to share it with him as she sought support for her efforts in Venezuela.
paras.zh: 这指的是唐纳德·特朗普总统长期以来赢得诺贝尔和平奖的雄心，以及去年的获奖者玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多在为委内瑞拉的努力寻求支持时提出与他分享这一雄心。

paras.en: “Everybody asks me: ‘When are you going to stop? When are you going to stop?’” Pillay said, adding that despite turning 85 last month, she had no intention of doing so.
paras.zh: “每个人都问我：‘你什么时候要停下来？你什么时候要停下来？’”皮莱说，并补充说，尽管上个月她已经 85 岁了，但她无意这样做。

paras.en: “The last thing I did was the report on Gaza, namely what’s happening there is genocide,” she said.
paras.zh: “我做的最后一件事是关于加沙的报道，即那里正在发生的种族灭绝，”她说。

paras.en: “One of the main reactions to that report was paying tribute to me for my courage,” she added. “But why would you need courage to speak the truth? You interpret the law and you look at all the facts.”
paras.zh: “对该报告的主要反应之一是赞扬我的勇气，”她补充道。 “但是为什么你需要勇气说实话呢？你解释法律并审视所有事实。”

paras.en: In later more formal remarks accepting the prize, she dedicated the award to “all of the survivors of international crimes,” warning against efforts “which attempt to weaken international criminal justice” which “risk returning us to a world in which power, rather than law, determines whose suffering matters.”
paras.zh: 在后来更正式的获奖感言中，她将这一奖项献给了“所有国际罪行的幸存者”，并警告不要“试图削弱国际刑事司法”，因为这种行为“有可能让我们回到一个由权力而非法律决定谁的痛苦才是重要的世界”。

paras.en: Among her many positions, Pillay previously served as a judge on the International Criminal Court, a frequent focus of ire for the Trump administration. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced fresh sanctions on the body on Friday, hours after the prize was announced.
paras.zh: 皮莱曾担任过众多职务，其中包括国际刑事法院法官，这经常是特朗普政府愤怒的焦点。周五，在奖项宣布几小时后，国务卿马可·卢比奥宣布对该机构实施新的制裁。

paras.en: “We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate,” Rubio said in a statement, threatening to continue a campaign “to dismantle the ICC, brick by brick.”
paras.zh: 卢比奥在一份声明中表示：“我们将禁止与这个流氓法院进行交易，切断他们的资源并削弱其运作能力。”他威胁要继续开展“一砖一瓦地解散国际刑事法院”的运动。

paras.en: Agnès Callamard, secretary general of Amnesty International, was with Pillay in Germany and among the first people to congratulate her on the prize.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织秘书长阿涅斯·卡拉马尔 (Agnès Callamard) 与皮莱一起在德国，也是第一批祝贺她获奖的人之一。

paras.en: “This could not be a better choice at a time of attacks against international justice,” Callamard told NBC News. “She is a former ICC judge at a time when the U.S. administration is seeking to destroy the ICC,” she said, praising her work leading the U.N. commission “which found that Israel committed the crime of genocide at a time when many states are trying to defend and protect Israel’s actions.”
paras.zh: 卡拉马德告诉 NBC 新闻：“在国际正义受到攻击之际，这可能是一个更好的选择。”她说：“在美国政府寻求摧毁国际刑事法院的时候，她是前国际刑事法院法官。”她赞扬了她领导联合国委员会的工作，“该委员会发现以色列犯下了种族灭绝罪，而此时许多国家都在试图捍卫和保护以色列的行为。”

paras.en: The ICC condemned the new U.S. sanctions Friday, and separately praised Pillay’s win as “an important recognition of the vital role that international justice plays as a cornerstone of lasting peace.”
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院周五谴责美国的新制裁，并单独称赞皮莱的胜利“是对国际正义作为持久和平基石所发挥的重要作用的重要认可”。

paras.en: Pillay was not among those speculated to be front-runners, who included Yulia Navalnaya, the widow of anti-Kremlin figure Alexei Navalny, Ugandan climate activist Vanessa Nakate, and Mykola Kuleba, who founded an organization to rescue Ukrainian children abducted and forcibly taken to Russia.
paras.zh: 皮莱并不在被认为是领先者之列，其中包括反克里姆林宫人物阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的遗孀尤利娅·纳瓦尔纳亚、乌干达气候活动家凡妮莎·纳卡特和米科拉·库莱巴，后者成立了一个组织来营救被绑架并强行带到俄罗斯的乌克兰儿童。

paras.en: The Norwegian Nobel Institute said it had has registered a total of 287 candidates for this year’s peace prize, with politicians, international judges and professors among those who can put names forward. The committee that decides the winner is composed of five members appointed by the Norwegian Parliament.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔研究所表示，已登记了今年和平奖的总共287名候选人，其中包括政界人士、国际法官和教授。决定获胜者的委员会由挪威议会任命的五名成员组成。

paras.en: The leaders of Israel, Pakistan and Cambodia all said they nominated Trump for the prize, though he said this week he didn’t think he would win.
paras.zh: 以色列、巴基斯坦和柬埔寨领导人均表示，他们提名特朗普获奖，但特朗普本周表示，他认为自己不会获胜。

paras.en: “I don’t know what their decision is going to be,” Trump told reporters in the Oval Office Wednesday. “They have a reputation for maybe not giving it to people like me.”
paras.zh: “我不知道他们会做出什么决定，”特朗普周三在椭圆形办公室对记者说。 “他们以可能不会把它提供给像我这样的人而闻名。”

paras.en: Trump did not congratulate Pillay on Friday. Instead, on Truth Social, he reposted a message from another user that said the Nobel committee had “shamed itself beyond repair and demeaned the once great Nobel Peace Prize,” describing Pillay as “an unabashed hater of America and Israel.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周五没有向皮莱表示祝贺。相反，他在《Truth Social》上转发了另一位用户的消息，称诺贝尔委员会“使自己蒙羞至无可挽回，贬低了曾经伟大的诺贝尔和平奖”，并将皮莱描述为“毫不掩饰的美国和以色列仇恨者”。

articles.title: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to discuss ‘new’ peace plan with Ukrainian delegation, sources say
articles.author: Garrett Haake

paras.en: Ukrainian negotiators heading to the United States for a new round of talks to end the war with Russia will discuss a comprehensive new plan to help break the ongoing impasse in the conflict, a senior administration official told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一名高级政府官员告诉 NBC 新闻，乌克兰谈判代表前往美国进行新一轮结束与俄罗斯战争的谈判，他们将讨论一项全面的新计划，以帮助打破冲突中持续的僵局。

paras.en: The talks starting Friday and led by special envoy Steve Witkoff and President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner are the latest attempt to negotiate a settlement amid intensifying deadly aerial attacks on both sides of the border.
paras.zh: 此次会谈将于周五开始，由特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳主持，这是在边境两侧致命空袭加剧之际谈判达成解决方案的最新尝试。

paras.en: The discussions will center on “a new, unified proposal that is focused on all aspects of the conflict to try to end the war,” the senior administration official said Thursday evening.
paras.zh: 这位高级政府官员周四晚表示，讨论将集中在“一项新的、统一的提案，重点关注冲突的各个方面，以试图结束战争”。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian delegation will travel to the U.S. for two days of negotiations, and include Rustem Umerov, the head of the country’s Foreign Intelligence Service, and Kyrylo Budanov, who heads the office of the president.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基总统表示，乌克兰代表团将前往美国进行为期两天的谈判，成员包括该国对外情报局局长鲁斯泰姆·乌梅罗夫和总统办公室主任凯里洛·布达诺夫。

paras.en: Zelenskyy acknowledged a possible new phase in the negotiations.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基承认谈判可能进入新阶段。

paras.en: “We see on the part of the United States of America, an intensification of talks and meetings,” he told reporters, without mentioning any new proposals. “I myself have spoken with the American side three times in recent days, and I hope for a good result from our negotiators’ meeting.”
paras.zh: “我们看到美利坚合众国方面正在加强会谈和会议，”他对记者表示，但没有提及任何新提议。 “我本人这几天已与美方进行了3次通话，希望我们的谈判能取得好结果。”

paras.en: Trump had vowed to swiftly end the conflict that began when Russia launched a full-scale invasion in February 2022. Despite numerous meetings and talks to broker a ceasefire since he took office, the two sides have been locked in a stalemate over the industrial region of Donbas in Ukraine’s east.
paras.zh: 特朗普发誓要迅速结束2022年2月俄罗斯发动全面入侵时引发的冲突。尽管自他上任以来为促成停火举行了多次会议和会谈，但双方在乌克兰东部顿巴斯工业区问题上陷入僵局。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has said that he wants to seize the entire region, parts of which Kyiv’s forces still hold. Zelenskyy has ruled out ceding this territory, arguing that Putin could use it as a base to again attack Ukraine. Russia currently occupies about one-fifth of Ukraine’s territory.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，他希望占领整个地区，其中部分地区仍由基辅军队控制。泽连斯基排除了放弃这片领土的可能性，认为普京可能会利用它作为再次攻击乌克兰的基地。俄罗斯目前占据乌克兰约五分之一的领土。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned Thursday that stalemates are “very dangerous” because they either end in a negotiated settlement or escalation. In the context of Ukraine, that “could wind up being a sabotage campaign in neighboring countries that are members of NATO,” he said.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周四警告说，僵局“非常危险”，因为要么以谈判解决，要么升级。他说，就乌克兰而言，这“最终可能成为对北约邻国的破坏活动”。

paras.en: European leaders are growing increasingly concerned about Russia escalating and expanding the conflict onto the continent.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人越来越担心俄罗斯将冲突升级并扩大到欧洲大陆。

paras.en: “In the end, we do not believe that there is a military solution to this conflict, to this war. We think this war needs to end in a negotiated settlement,” Rubio said. “The sooner, the better.”
paras.zh: “最终，我们不认为这场冲突、这场战争有军事解决方案。我们认为这场战争需要通过谈判解决，”卢比奥说。 “越早越好。”

paras.en: In separate comments to the Greek newspaper Kathimerini, Rubio said “there don’t seem to be prospects of a negotiated settlement” on peace in Ukraine right now. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov responded by saying he agreed with Rubio’s assessment, the Russian state news agency Tass reported.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在向希腊报纸 Kathimerini 发表单独评论时表示，目前乌克兰和平问题“似乎没有通过谈判达成解决方案的前景”。据俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社报道，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫回应称，他同意卢比奥的评估。

paras.en: The U.S. diplomatic efforts to end the war were revived last month when Witkoff and Kushner traveled to Moscow and, for the first time, Kyiv. No major breakthroughs were announced.
paras.zh: 上个月，威特科夫和库什纳前往莫斯科，并首次前往基辅，美国恢复了结束战争的外交努力。没有宣布重大突破。

paras.en: The White House has previously repeated some of Putin’s hard-line demands and tried to push Kyiv for concessions.
paras.zh: 白宫此前曾多次重申普京的一些强硬要求，并试图迫使基辅做出让步。

paras.en: Putin explained the invasion by saying Russia was trying to demilitarize Ukraine and overthrow Kyiv’s government, which he said is driven by “Nazi ideology” — a common Kremlin propaganda line.
paras.zh: 普京在解释这次入侵时表示，俄罗斯试图使乌克兰非军事化并推翻基辅政府，他说基辅政府的驱动力是“纳粹意识形态”——这是克里姆林宫的共同宣传路线。

paras.en: What was supposed to be a swift military operation to topple Zelenskyy and replace him with a pro-Kremlin government quickly foundered, leaving the capture of Donbas as Putin’s only option to claim a significant victory in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 原本旨在推翻泽伦斯基并以亲克里姆林宫政府取而代之的迅速军事行动很快就失败了，夺取顿巴斯成为普京在乌克兰取得重大胜利的唯一选择。

articles.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon's messages about Jesse Baird before alleged murders
articles.author: Millie  Roberts and Jamie McKinnell

paras.en: Ten months before he was allegedly killed, Jesse Baird said he was not in a relationship with Beau Lamarre-Condon.
paras.zh: 杰西·贝尔德据称在被杀前十个月表示，他与博·拉马尔-康登没有恋爱关系。

paras.en: "Beau and I see each other from time to time however we aren't 'seeing' each other or in a relationship," Mr Baird wrote in an Instagram message in April 2023.
paras.zh: “博和我时常见面，但我们并没有‘见面’，也没有建立关系，”贝尔德先生在 2023 年 4 月的 Instagram 消息中写道。

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon, accused of his murder, had taken a photo of the exchange after going "through [Mr Baird's] phone" while staying over.
paras.zh: 被指控谋杀的拉马尔-康登先生在过夜时“通过[贝尔德先生的]手机”拍下了这次交流的照片。

paras.en: He forwarded the image to his colleague and friend, Senior Constable Nicole Harvell.
paras.zh: 他将这张照片转发给了他的同事兼朋友、高级警员妮可·哈维尔(Nicole Harvell)。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: Argh idk if I'm being stupid or not or I'm wasting my time
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：我不知道我是否愚蠢或者我在浪费时间

paras.en: Ms Harvell replied to him in the morning.
paras.zh: 哈维尔女士早上回复了他。

paras.en: Nicole Harvell: … he told him he's not seeing you. Well of course he's seeing you. That was a massive lie
paras.zh: Nicole Harvell：……他告诉他他没有见到你。嗯，他当然在见你。那是一个弥天大谎

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon has pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder, accused of shooting Mr Baird and his new boyfriend, Luke Davies, using a police pistol in February 2024.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登先生对两项谋杀罪名不认罪，被指控于 2024 年 2 月使用警用手枪射杀贝尔德先生和他的新男友卢克戴维斯。

paras.en: The former police officer's lawyers have indicated an argument of self-defence, telling jurors that separate struggles inside Mr Baird's Paddington home in Sydney resulted in two tragic deaths.
paras.zh: 这位前警官的律师提出了自卫论据，并告诉陪审员，贝尔德先生位于悉尼帕丁顿的家中发生的单独斗争导致了两人悲惨死亡。

paras.en: The Crown said Mr Lamarre-Condon developed an "obsessive and jealous infatuation" with Mr Baird after the end of a somewhat casual romance, and had allegedly stalked him in the months prior.
paras.zh: 官方称，在一段随意的恋情结束后，拉马尔-康登对贝尔德产生了一种“痴迷和嫉妒的迷恋”，并据称在几个月前跟踪了他。

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon's lawyer said it was not disputed his client "did some stupid things, such as looking through the phone of Jesse Baird, deleting contacts of other men, and deleting text messages".
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登的律师表示，毫无争议的是，他的当事人“做了一些愚蠢的事情，比如查看杰西·贝尔德的手机、删除其他男子的联系方式，以及删除短信”。

paras.en: Ms Harvell is the latest of a number of witnesses whose communications with the defendant have been tendered as evidence.
paras.zh: 哈维尔女士是众多证人中最新的一位，他们与被告的通讯已被作为证据。

paras.en: They are being asked in court what he told them of his connection with Mr Baird at various points.
paras.zh: 他们在法庭上被问到他在不同时刻告诉他们他与贝尔德先生的关系。

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon confided in Ms Harvell from March 2023 about what she dubbed the "Jesse saga".
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登先生从 2023 年 3 月起向哈维尔女士吐露了她所谓的“杰西传奇”。

paras.en: His messages with her paint a picture of how the accused perceived the on-again-off-again relationship, his insecurities about Mr Baird seeing other people, and his online surveillance in the lead-up to the alleged double murder.
paras.zh: 他与她的信息描绘了被告如何看待这种时断时续的关系、他对贝尔德先生与其他人见面的不安全感，以及他在涉嫌双重谋杀前的在线监控。

paras.en: The jury has heard Mr Lamarre-Condon met Mr Baird in 2022, but there was a "disconnect" between what each saw as the nature of the relationship and where it was going.
paras.zh: 陪审团听说拉马尔-康登先生于 2022 年会见了贝尔德先生，但双方对这段关系的本质和发展方向之间存在“脱节”。

paras.en: Mr Baird regarded it as "somewhat casual", while the defendant was "infatuated", the prosecutor has said.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，贝尔德先生认为这“有点随意”，而被告则“着迷”。

paras.en: In March 2023, Ms Harvell and Mr Lamarre-Condon discussed how Mr Baird seeing another man left him feeling "triggered", and he was checking Mr Baird's Instagram followers.
paras.zh: 2023 年 3 月，哈维尔女士和拉马尔-康登先生讨论了贝尔德先生看到另一个男人如何让他感到“被触发”，他正在查看贝尔德先生的 Instagram 粉丝。

paras.en: In the weeks that followed, he described the pair going on dates, a getaway with a dog, and spending Easter together.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几周里，他描述了两人约会、带着狗度假以及一起度过复活节。

paras.en: There were two apparent break-ups between the pair, according to the evidence so far; first in April 2023 and another later that year in November.
paras.zh: 根据迄今为止的证据，两人之间有过两次明显的分手；第一次是在 2023 年 4 月，另一次是在当年 11 月。

paras.en: On April 17, Mr Lamarre-Condon addressed what he had recently seen on Mr Baird's phone.
paras.zh: 4 月 17 日，拉马尔-康登先生谈到了他最近在贝尔德先生手机上看到的内容。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: Ending it with him this arvo
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：今年arvo 就和他一起结束吧

paras.en: Nicole Harvell: … Are you going to tell him about the messages you saw?
paras.zh: 妮可·哈维尔：……你会告诉他你看到的消息吗？

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: … Yeah I'll tell him about the messages but I might tell a semi white lie and not say I went through his phone 😅
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：……是的，我会告诉他这些消息，但我可能会撒一个半善意的谎言，不会说我翻了他的手机😅

paras.en: Ms Harvell told the court Mr Lamarre-Condon knew Mr Baird's phone passcode.
paras.zh: 哈维尔女士告诉法庭，拉马尔-康登先生知道贝尔德先生的电话密码。

paras.en: She said at that point, Mr Lamarre-Condon had spoken to her about it not being an exclusive relationship, and said he "came across to me as paranoid" about Mr Baird's interest in him.
paras.zh: 她说，当时拉马尔-康登先生曾与她谈论过这并不是一种排他性关系，并表示他对贝尔德先生对他的兴趣“给我的印象是偏执”。

paras.en: Ms Harvell recalled being told it was the accused who ended the "so-called relationship", partially because he had seen an unfamiliar pair of underwear in Mr Baird's room.
paras.zh: 哈维尔女士回忆说，她被告知是被告结束了“所谓的关系”，部分原因是他在贝尔德先生的房间里看到了一条陌生的内衣。

paras.en: She told the court he was initially "satisfied" with his decision, but later became "quite fixated".
paras.zh: 她告诉法庭，他最初对自己的决定感到“满意”，但后来变得“相当固执”。

paras.en: Via text, Mr Lamarre-Condon questioned if Mr Baird had muted his Instagram stories to "get over me" and checked what he was listening to on Spotify in May.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登通过短信质疑贝尔德是否为了“忘记我”而将他的 Instagram 故事静音，并检查了他 5 月份在 Spotify 上收听的内容。

paras.en: In October, Mr Lamarre-Condon announced Mr Baird would accompany him on a holiday.
paras.zh: 十月，拉马尔-康登先生宣布贝尔德先生将陪伴他度假。

paras.en: Nicole Harvell: … But still not in a relationship?
paras.zh: 妮可·哈维尔：……但还没有恋爱关系？

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: Well no, but I'm actually really happy with it rn.
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：嗯，不，但我实际上对此非常满意。

paras.en: Come November, a month out from the flight, Mr Lamarre-Condon said they were no longer seeing each other.
paras.zh: 十一月份，距离航班起飞还有一个月，拉马尔-康登先生说他们不再见面了。

paras.en: This second apparent break-up was attributed in court to the defendant's targeted use of Instagram stories to discourage romantic rivals, and his alleged interference with Mr Baird's phone by blocking contacts.
paras.zh: 第二次明显的分手在法庭上被归咎于被告有针对性地使用 Instagram 故事来阻止浪漫的竞争对手，以及他涉嫌通过阻止联系人来干扰贝尔德先生的手机。

paras.en: Ms Harvell said in an attempt to get other men to "back off", Mr Lamarre-Condon uploaded a generic photo of flowers, making it visible only to certain accounts through the app's 'close friends' function.
paras.zh: 哈维尔女士表示，为了让其他男人“退后一步”，拉马尔-康登先生上传了一张通用的鲜花照片，并使其仅对某些帐户通过应用程序的“亲密朋友”功能可见。

paras.en: Mr Baird was not able to view that post, but someone who did sent him a screenshot.
paras.zh: 贝尔德先生无法查看该帖子，但有人给他发送了一张屏幕截图。

paras.en: He confronted the accused, asking via text: "What's this about?"
paras.zh: 他与被告对峙，通过短信询问：“这是怎么回事？”

paras.en: Ms Harvell said Mr Lamarre-Condon, in "damage control", paid $160 for a florist to replicate the bouquet and asked his mother, Coleen Lamarre, to pose for the photo and write a note herself.
paras.zh: 哈维尔女士说，拉马尔-康登先生出于“损害控制”的考虑，支付了 160 美元请花店复制花束，并要求他的母亲科琳·拉马尔 (Coleen Lamarre) 摆姿势拍照并亲自写一张便条。

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon sent Mr Baird a series of messages asking him to call or "chat in person", saying he was "confused" and he did not "understand why this [the flowers] is an issue", a screenshot sent to Ms Harvell showed.
paras.zh: 发送给哈维尔女士的截图显示，拉马尔-康登先生向贝尔德先生发送了一系列消息，要求他打电话或“亲自聊天”，称他“很困惑”，并且他不“明白为什么这（鲜花）是一个问题”。

paras.en: He then shared an 888-word draft to her of a message he wanted to send to Mr Baird on November 16.
paras.zh: 然后，他向她分享了一份 888 字的草稿，内容是他想在 11 月 16 日发送给贝尔德先生的信息。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: … You feel as if I possibly blocked someone on your Instagram, as I was with you this morning, which would be a massive betrayal of your trust …
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：……你感觉好像我可能在你的 Instagram 上屏蔽了某人，就像我今天早上和你在一起一样，这将是对你信任的巨大背叛……

paras.en: … When I re-entered this situation with you, I even said to you I want to live in the moment with you and I don't want to know about anything or anybody else …
paras.zh: ......当我重新进入和你在一起的这种情况时，我什至对你说我想和你一起活在当下，我不想知道任何事情或任何人......

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon said Mr Baird had mentioned a "few examples" of concern brought to his attention, including the "flower situation".
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登先生表示，贝尔德先生提到了引起他注意的“几个例子”，其中包括“花卉情况”。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: … Where I honestly didn't do that, you not believing my word after never giving you a reason not too …
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：……老实说，我没有这样做，你在从来没有给你一个理由之后就不相信我的话……

paras.en: I'm sure you would feel gutted/hurt not knowing how to prove your innocence …
paras.zh: 我相信你会因为不知道如何证明自己的清白而感到内疚/受伤......

paras.en: The next day, Ms Harvell told the accused she was "torn" whether it would be worth him telling Mr Baird about blocking a man he had been casually seeing.
paras.zh: 第二天，哈维尔女士告诉被告，她“左右为难”是否值得他告诉贝尔德先生关于阻止他偶然见到的一名男子的事情。

paras.en: Nicole Harvell: One part of me would say come clean but the other part says no after that long message
paras.zh: 妮可·哈维尔：我的一部分会说实话实说，但另一部分在这条长信息之后拒绝了

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon then sent Ms Harvell a screenshot of a follow-up message to Mr Baird saying "after sleeping on it I really want to take ownership of something".
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登先生随后向哈维尔女士发送了一张给贝尔德先生的后续消息的屏幕截图，上面写着“在睡过之后，我真的想拥有一些东西”。

paras.en: About six hours later, the accused said Mr Baird had blocked him on social media.
paras.zh: 大约六个小时后，被告表示贝尔德先生在社交媒体上屏蔽了他。

paras.en: On the morning of November 18, Ms Harvell touched base with Mr Lamarre-Condon.
paras.zh: 11 月 18 日上午，Harvell 女士与 Lamarre-Condon 先生见面。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: I'm so in the wrong though and it sucks!
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：不过我错了，这太糟糕了！

paras.en: Nicole Harvell: … He caused you to do this. Honestly. He was the biggest mind f**k
paras.zh: 妮可·哈维尔：……他让你这么做的。诚实地。他是最大的头脑

paras.en: About 11:35am, he sent a text to Ms Harvell, sharing another message intended for Mr Baird.
paras.zh: 上午 11 点 35 分左右，他给哈维尔女士发了一条短信，分享了另一条发给贝尔德先生的信息。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: After seeing you today in paddington, it just reaffirms everything my gut was telling me, along with you just blocking me on Instagram — you're a manipulative player
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：今天在帕丁顿见到你之后，这再次证实了我的直觉告诉我的一切，还有你刚刚在 Instagram 上屏蔽了我——你是一个善于操纵的玩家

paras.en: … You lead me on to believe from the very start that this could be a possible relationship
paras.zh: ......你让我从一开始就相信这可能是一种可能的关系

paras.en: … Then when I finally walked away from this … you send me a lovely text message saying you're so sorry for all the hurt you've caused, wished you were ready for a relationship because I'm everything you want on paper …
paras.zh: ......然后，当我最终离开这一切......你给我发了一条可爱的短信，说你对你造成的所有伤害感到非常抱歉，希望你已经准备好建立关系，因为我是你在纸上想要的一切......

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon said the "cherry on top" was making "one mistake" about the blocking.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登先生表示，“上面的樱桃”在封锁方面犯了“一个错误”。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: Yes I didn't initially own it but at the end of the day I said I need to do what's right and apologise to you and be honest …
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：是的，最初我并不拥有它，但最终我说我需要做正确的事情并向你道歉并诚实......

paras.en: … The difference between you and I is I never did anything intentionally to hurt you …
paras.zh: ……你我之间的区别在于，我从来没有做过任何故意伤害你的事情……

paras.en: Nicole Harvell: … That message was the most satisfying thing I've ever read
paras.zh: 妮可·哈维尔：……那条信息是我读过的最令人满意的事情

paras.en: On November 19, one day later, Mr Lamarre-Condon sent Ms Harvell photos of Mr Baird in the Blue Mountains taken from a website used to anonymously watch Instagram stories.
paras.zh: 11 月 19 日，一天后，拉马尔-康登先生向哈维尔女士发送了贝尔德先生在蓝山的照片，这些照片取自一个用于匿名观看 Instagram 故事的网站。

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: Appreciate you seriously though! Xx
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：不过我还是非常感谢你！ xx

paras.en: Nicole Harvell: You too ❤️. I feel like I've been there from the start of this Jesse saga as understand it all xx
paras.zh: 妮可·哈维尔：你也是❤️。我觉得我从杰西传奇开始就一直在那里，因为我理解这一切xx

paras.en: After discussing photos of Mr Baird with Ms Harvell, the accused said:
paras.zh: 在与哈维尔女士讨论贝尔德先生的照片后，被告说：

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon: I need to let it go and keep reminding myself it was for the best x
paras.zh: Beau Lamarre-Condon：我需要放手并不断提醒自己这是最好的 x

paras.en: Among the final messages between the workmates, Mr Lamarre-Condon wished her a safe flight on February 18, 2024.
paras.zh: 在工友之间的最后信息中，拉马尔-康登先生祝愿她在 2024 年 2 月 18 日飞行安全。

paras.en: The next day, he is alleged to have murdered Mr Baird and Mr Davies, before taking part in what the Crown has described as a calculated cover-up over several days.
paras.zh: 第二天，他被指控谋杀了贝尔德先生和戴维斯先生，然后参与了检察官所说的几天来精心策划的掩盖行动。

paras.en: His friend saw media articles about the couple's disappearance, which named the accused.
paras.zh: 他的朋友看到​​了有关这对夫妇失踪的媒体文章，其中提到了被告的名字。

paras.en: There was no reply from Mr Lamarre-Condon, who the Crown says handed himself into a police station the following day.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登先生没有回复，官方称他第二天就到警察局自首了。

paras.en: Reporting: Millie Roberts and Jamie McKinnell
paras.zh: 报道：米莉·罗伯茨和杰米·麦金内尔

articles.title: How Firmus, the biggest IPO in three decades, fell over
articles.author: Nassim Khadem and Katie Silver

paras.en: It was supposed to be the second biggest stock float in Australian history.
paras.zh: 这本来应该是澳大利亚历史上第二大的股票流通。

paras.en: Sydney-based AI startup Firmus Technologies was close to listing on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) at a $43.7 billion market capitalisation.
paras.zh: 总部位于悉尼的人工智能初创公司 Firmus Technologies 即将在澳大利亚证券交易所 (ASX) 上市，市值达 437 亿美元。

paras.en: It would have been the biggest IPO since Telstra listed in 1997.
paras.zh: 这将是自 1997 年 Telstra 上市以来最大规模的 IPO。

paras.en: The company, founded in 2019 by Oliver Curtis, Tim Rosenfield and Jonathan Levee, had planned to raise about $7 billion by going public.
paras.zh: 该公司由 Oliver Curtis、Tim Rosenfield 和 Jonathan Levee 于 2019 年创立，原计划通过上市筹集约 70 亿美元。

paras.en: The intention was to list and then borrow more to build data centres across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.
paras.zh: 其目的是列出并借用更多资金在澳大利亚、新加坡、马来西亚和印度尼西亚建立数据中心。

paras.en: By Wednesday night the IPO plans began to unravel and reports emerged that bankers were considering lowering the share price and valuation towards $30 billion.
paras.zh: 到周三晚上，IPO 计划开始瓦解，有报道称银行家正在考虑将股价和估值降低至 300 亿美元。

paras.en: On Thursday morning, as Firmus scrambled to try and save the IPO from failing, it withdrew from appearing at a federal parliamentary inquiry into AI.
paras.zh: 周四上午，当 Firmus 竭尽全力挽救 IPO 失败之际，它退出了联邦议会对人工智能的调查。

paras.en: By Friday the founder's grand plans had fallen apart and the float was pulled.
paras.zh: 到周五，创始人的宏伟计划已经分崩离析，花车也被取消了。

paras.en: Despite being backed by global AI giant Nvidia, investors had grown anxious.
paras.zh: 尽管得到了全球人工智能巨头英伟达的支持，投资者还是变得焦虑起来。

paras.en: Firmus had previously said it secured $US2 billion in commitments from investors, including Nvidia and Blackstone.
paras.zh: Firmus 此前曾表示，它已获得包括 Nvidia 和 Blackstone 在内的投资者 20 亿美元的承诺。

paras.en: Other potential investors felt the company's share price offer was overpriced, some felt there was not enough detailed information in the IPO prospectus, and many were spooked that the rapid growth of AI and data centres would soon stop.
paras.zh: 其他潜在投资者认为该公司的股价报价过高，一些人认为 IPO 招股说明书中没有足够的详细信息，许多人担心人工智能和数据中心的快速增长很快就会停止。

paras.en: The founders are now hoping to pursue further private funding and Firmus will attempt to list on the Nasdaq next year.
paras.zh: 创始人现在希望寻求进一步的私人融资，Firmus 将尝试明年在纳斯达克上市。

paras.en: A mixture of factors led to the float's demise, including the high per-share price offer, which by Thursday had reportedly fallen from $11 to $8.25.
paras.zh: 多种因素导致了此次上市的失败，其中包括每股报价过高，据报道，截至周四，该报价已从 11 美元跌至 8.25 美元。

paras.en: The company was being given a similar valuation to Woolworths, according to Morningstar senior market strategist Lochlan Holloway.
paras.zh: 晨星公司高级市场策略师 Lochlan Holloway 表示，该公司的估值与 Woolworths 类似。

paras.en: "The economics look good now and the growth is very fast now, but what that looks like again in five or 10 years is the big question mark," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“现在经济看起来不错，增长也很快，但五年或十年后情况会怎样，还是一个很大的问号。”

paras.en: Commentators say fears of an AI bubble, set against a backdrop of mounting concerns from politicians and the community about the rapid rise of data centres, also played a part.
paras.zh: 评论人士表示，在政界人士和社区对数据中心迅速崛起的担忧日益加剧的背景下，对人工智能泡沫的担忧也起到了一定作用。

paras.en: "Firmus ran into a wall of AI anxiety right at the time that they had planned to list," Philip Wohl from Reliance Investment Research said.
paras.zh: 信实投资研究公司 (Reliance Investment Research) 的菲利普·沃尔 (Philip Wohl) 表示：“Firmus 在计划上市时就遇到了人工智能焦虑之墙。”

paras.en: And then there was some angst over Mr Curtis's colourful past. He served a year in jail in 2016-17 for insider trading before co-founding Firmus as a bitcoin mining company in 2019.
paras.zh: 然后，人们对柯蒂斯先生丰富多彩的过去感到有些焦虑。他于 2016-17 年度因内幕交易入狱一年，随后于 2019 年与他人共同创立了比特币挖矿公司 Firmus。

paras.en: Mr Wohl said Firmus's assertion that it was market volatility that prevented it listing at its desired price was "a euphemistic way of describing exactly what happened".
paras.zh: 沃尔表示，菲尔穆斯声称是市场波动导致其无法按预期价格上市，这是“准确描述所发生情况的委婉方式”。

paras.en: "The market is more uncertain now when it comes to AI hardware and, given the perhaps aggressive pricing that they were targeting, they really didn't see the demand," he said.
paras.zh: “现在就人工智能硬件而言，市场更加不确定，考虑到他们的目标定价可能激进，他们确实没有看到需求，”他说。

paras.en: 'They do have to come back to the market'
paras.zh: “他们确实必须回到市场”

paras.en: Ten Cap Investment co-founder and lead portfolio manager Jun Bei Liu said the IPO was overpriced, but thought a second attempt was on the cards.
paras.zh: Ten Cap Investment 联合创始人兼首席投资组合经理 Jun Bei Liu 表示，此次 IPO 定价过高，但认为可能会进行第二次尝试。

paras.en: "The valuation for the company was way too high to start with," she said.
paras.zh: “该公司的估值一开始就太高了，”她说。

paras.en: "It is almost three times what the valuation was when they raised money just a few months ago.
paras.zh: “这几乎是几个月前他们筹集资金时估值的三倍。

paras.en: "At some stage they do have to come back to the market simply, because it's a very capital intensive business. It requires listed shares."
paras.zh: “在某个阶段，他们确实必须回到市场，因为这是一项资本密集型业务。它需要上市股票。”

paras.en: Floodline Research founder Anna Wu said the founders should have tried to list in the United States in the first place because the Nasdaq was a bigger and more accepting market than the ASX for emerging tech.
paras.zh: Floodline Research 创始人 Anna Wu 表示，创始人应该首先尝试在美国上市，因为纳斯达克对于新兴科技来说是一个比澳大利亚证券交易所更大、更容易接受的市场。

paras.en: "The downside is much tougher competition and as an Australian company Firmus may struggle to attract the same attention and valuation as its US peers," she said.
paras.zh: 她表示：“缺点是竞争更加激烈，作为一家澳大利亚公司，Firmus 可能很难吸引与美国同行相同的关注和估值。”

paras.en: The Nasdaq has recently hit record highs and is up 43 per cent in the past year, but Australia's tech sector has faltered by comparison.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克指数最近创下历史新高，在过去一年中上涨了 43%，但相比之下，澳大利亚的科技行业却步履蹒跚。

paras.en: The ASX All Technology Index, which tracks the share prices of 42 tech-linked stocks on the ASX, has dropped almost 18 per cent this year, including 9 per cent in September alone.
paras.zh: 跟踪 ASX 42 只科技相关股票股价的 ASX 全科技指数今年已下跌近 18%，其中仅 9 月份就下跌了 9%。

paras.en: In part that is because Australian technology listings are more heavily skewed towards software companies, which have been sold off in the so-called SaaSpocalypse as investors worry that AI will undercut their business models.
paras.zh: 部分原因是澳大利亚科技上市公司更倾向于软件公司，这些公司在所谓的 SaaS 末日中被抛售，因为投资者担心人工智能会削弱他们的商业模式。

paras.en: Investors were also questioning whether Australia had the energy infrastructure energy to support data centres.
paras.zh: 投资者还质疑澳大利亚是否拥有支持数据中心的能源基础设施能源。

paras.en: "We're in a slightly different regime now for AI in terms of its life cycle," Ms Wu said.
paras.zh: “就人工智能的生命周期而言，我们现在处于一个略有不同的状态，”吴女士说。

paras.en: "It's no longer 2023, where everything's about big ideas and anything with AI in the name would go past any valuation test."
paras.zh: “现在不再是 2023 年，那时一切都是伟大的想法，任何带有人工智能的名字都会通过任何估值测试。”

paras.en: She said the lack of details on the Firmus IPO and concerns about Mr Curtis's criminal past also weighed on some investors.
paras.zh: 她表示，Firmus 首次公开募股的细节缺乏以及对柯蒂斯先生犯罪历史的担忧也给一些投资者带来了压力。

paras.en: "That creates more ambiguity," she said.
paras.zh: “这造成了更多的歧义，”她说。

paras.en: "So when the market gets hit by oil anxiety every second day, and when investors are facing a much higher capital cost, that would actually drive the question on the valuation.
paras.zh: “因此，当市场每隔一天受到石油焦虑的打击，当投资者面临更高的资本成本时，这实际上会引发对估值的质疑。

paras.en: "It probably sends the sentiment signal to the broader community that right now — an IPO is not a free lunch anymore."
paras.zh: “这可能向更广泛的社区发出这样的情绪信号：IPO 不再是免费的午餐。”

paras.en: Nvidia was contacted for comment about its position on Firmus after the IPO flop.
paras.zh: 在 IPO 失败后，我们联系了 Nvidia，请其就其对 Firmus 的立场发表评论。

paras.en: Ms Wu said Firmus was likely tap the AI giant for a greater investment.
paras.zh: 吴女士表示，Firmus 可能会向这家人工智能巨头寻求更大的投资。

paras.en: Nvidia already has a 7.2 per cent stake in Firmus and has reportedly been providing funding as well as selling Firmus its chips.
paras.zh: Nvidia 已经持有 Firmus 7.2% 的股份，据报道一直在提供资金并向 Firmus 出售其芯片。

paras.en: "Nvidia … is going around the world buying anything that it thinks is going to take over in the local market," Ms Wu said.
paras.zh: “英伟达……正在世界各地购买任何它认为能够占领当地市场的产品，”吴女士说。

paras.en: Mr Holloway said the investment made sense as Firmus data centres got "their chips out there."
paras.zh: 霍洛韦表示，这项投资是有意义的，因为 Firmus 数据中心已经有了“他们的芯片”。

paras.en: For customers such as Meta and OpenAi, partnering with companies like Firmus can be the only option to access these chips.
paras.zh: 对于 Meta 和 OpenAi 等客户来说，与 Firmus 等公司合作可能是获得这些芯片的唯一选择。

paras.en: "There is a very, very short supply of Nvidia's high-quality chips and a lot of demand for AI model training," Mr Holloway said.
paras.zh: 霍洛韦表示：“英伟达的高质量芯片供应非常非常短缺，而对人工智能模型训练的需求却很大。”

paras.en: "If you had access to those chips, which Firmus did with its partnership with Nvidia, you can basically name your price."
paras.zh: “如果你能够获得这些芯片（Firmus 与 Nvidia 合作做到了这一点），你基本上就可以说出你的价格。”

paras.en: Ms Wu said the backing of Nvidia was still on the cards.
paras.zh: 吴女士表示，英伟达的支持仍然是可能的。

paras.en: "Nvidia's long-term partnership with Firmus is an endorsement … but also, it's a move towards expanding in the Australia-Pacific region and trying to integrate with the local infrastructure provider."
paras.zh: “Nvidia 与 Firmus 的长期合作伙伴关系是一种认可……而且，这是在澳大利亚太平洋地区扩张并试图与当地基础设施提供商整合的举措。”

paras.en: Mr Curtis and his publicist wife Roxy Jacenko opened up a Singapore office two years ago, sparking intrigue from the Australian expat population.
paras.zh: 柯蒂斯先生和他的公关妻子 Roxy Jacenko 两年前在新加坡开设了办事处，引起了澳大利亚侨民的兴趣。

paras.en: But IPOs in Australia are notoriously challenging to get right.
paras.zh: 但众所周知，澳大利亚的首次公开募股很难顺利进行。

paras.en: Mr Holloway said the IPO uncertainty had led more companies in Australia to put off listing.
paras.zh: 霍洛韦表示，首次公开募股的不确定性导致更多澳大利亚公司推迟上市。

paras.en: "We've seen the number of IPOs on the ASX fall considerably in the last few years," he said.
paras.zh: “过去几年，我们看到澳大利亚证券交易所的首次公开募股数量大幅下降，”他说。

paras.en: Rather than "floating in public markets, remaining in private hands is becoming much easier" because a surplus of private cash.
paras.zh: 由于私人现金过剩，“留在私人手中变得更加容易”，而不是“在公开市场上流通”。

paras.en: But analysts say IPOs being delayed or pulled is likely to become more common.
paras.zh: 但分析师表示，IPO 被推迟或取消的情况可能会变得更加普遍。

paras.en: Firmus's website said it had two sites operational in Australia and Singapore, and that five were "under development".
paras.zh: Firmus 的网站称，该公司在澳大利亚和新加坡有两个运营站点，另外五个站点“正在开发中”。

paras.en: "There were just too many unknowns here and it required too much optimism for investors to take that leap of faith with Firmus," Mr Wohl said.
paras.zh: 沃尔表示：“这里存在太多的未知因素，投资者需要有太多的乐观情绪才能对菲尔穆斯抱有信心。”

articles.title: Live: Matildas take on world number three Germany in friendly
articles.author: Marnie Vinall

paras.en: Matildas live: Australia takes on Germany in international football friendly
paras.zh: 玛蒂尔达斯直播：澳大利亚在国际足球友谊赛中迎战德国

paras.en: The Matildas take on world number three Germany to open the October International window, as preparations continue for the fast-approaching Women's World Cup 2027.
paras.zh: 玛蒂尔达队将迎战世界排名第三的德国队，开启十月国际比赛窗口，同时为即将到来的 2027 年女足世界杯做准备。

paras.en: Australia is without gun Mary Fowler, while Tori Tumeth, Courtney Newbon and Hana Lowry hope for a debut in Karlsruhe.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚没有枪手玛丽·福勒，而托里·图梅斯、考特尼·纽邦和哈娜·洛瑞则希望在卡尔斯鲁厄首次亮相。

paras.en: Follow all the action in our live blog below.
paras.zh: 请关注下面我们实时博客中的所有操作。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: Matildas and Germany underway at Wildpark Stadium in Karlsruhe.
paras.zh: 《玛蒂尔达斯》和《德国队》在卡尔斯鲁厄野生公园体育场进行。

paras.en: If you're awake and with me, please leave a comment at any time. Let's chat Tillies.
paras.zh: 如果你醒着并和我在一起，请随时发表评论。我们来聊聊蒂莉丝吧。

paras.en: An important clash as Australia, currently ranked world No.15, up against the high calibre of Germany, world ranked No.3.
paras.zh: 这是一场重要的交锋，目前世界排名第15位的澳大利亚队将对阵世界排名第3位的高水平德国队。

paras.en: All roads lead to the Women's World Cup in Brazil next year. It's Australia's first friendly since June.
paras.zh: 条条大路通向明年巴西女足世界杯。这是澳大利亚自六月以来的第一场友谊赛。

paras.en: Firstly, yes, it's called a 'friendly' but that doesn't mean these upcoming matches against Germany today and Haiti on Wednesday should be treated lightly.
paras.zh: 首先，是的，这被称为“友谊赛”，但这并不意味着今天即将对阵德国和周三对阵海地的比赛应该被轻视。

paras.en: These clashes are extremely important preparation for the 2027 Women's World Cup. Both teams have already qualified for the tournament, meaning all focus is on getting ready for it.
paras.zh: 这些冲突是2027年女足世界杯极其重要的备战工作。两支球队都已经获得了比赛资格，这意味着所有的注意力都集中在为比赛做好准备上。

paras.en: For the Matildas, a lot of attention is on younger talent. Hoping to debut in these matches is uncapped trio Tori Tumeth, Courtney Newbon and Hana Lowry - all called up for the first time to the squad.
paras.zh: 对于玛蒂尔达夫妇来说，年轻人才受到了很多关注。希望在这些比赛中首次亮相的是未代表国家队出场的三人组托里·图梅斯 (Tori Tumeth)、考特尼·纽邦 (Courtney Newbon) 和哈娜·洛瑞 (Hana Lowry)，他们都是首次入选球队。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in-form Charli Grant, Alexia Apostolakis and Daniela Galic will be hoping to get some more national minutes under their belts.
paras.zh: 与此同时，状态良好的查莉·格兰特、亚历克西娅·阿波斯托拉基斯和丹妮拉·加利奇希望能获得更多的国家队出场时间。

paras.en: Alanna Kennedy and Charlize Rule are unavailable due to injury, while Kyra Cooney-Cross and Mary Fowler are also out.
paras.zh: 阿兰娜·肯尼迪和查理兹·鲁尔因伤缺席，凯拉·库尼·克罗斯和玛丽·福勒也缺席。

paras.en: Germany will be without captain Giulia Gwinn and key player Vivien Endemann, who have been replaced by Sarai Linder and Nicole Anyomi.
paras.zh: 德国队队长朱利亚·格温（Giulia Gwinn）和关键球员维维安·恩德曼（Vivien Endemann）将缺席，由萨莱·林德（Sarai Linder）和妮可·安奥米（Nicole Anyomi）取代。

paras.en: Matildas star Mary Fowler made the decision to miss the upcoming friendlies, against Germany today and Haiti on Wednesday, for personal circumstances.
paras.zh: 由于个人原因，《玛蒂尔达》球星玛丽·福勒决定缺席即将举行的今天对阵德国和周三对阵海地的友谊赛。

paras.en: Fowler is reportedly back in Sydney visiting her partner, Penrith Panthers NRL star Nathan Cleary, as he recovers from a career-threatening broken leg. These are presumably the unexplained “personal circumstances”, but nothing is confirmed.
paras.zh: 据报道，福勒正在返回悉尼探望她的伴侣、彭里斯黑豹队 NRL 球星内森·克利里 (Nathan Cleary)，他正在从威胁职业生涯的断腿中恢复过来。这些大概是无法解释的“个人情况”，但没有得到证实。

paras.en: Who's awake and ready for some Matildas action? Get the kettle on.
paras.zh: 谁已经醒来并准备好参加玛蒂尔达的行动了？把水壶打开。

paras.en: Australia take on Germany to open the FIFA International Window at Wildpark Stadium in Karlsruche, with kick off at 5:30am AEST.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队与德国队将在卡尔斯鲁什 Wildpark 体育场迎战德国队，比赛将于澳大利亚东部标准时间上午 5:30 开球。

articles.title: The U.S. plans to livestream an execution. Here's how that compares to global practice

paras.en: The U.S. plans to livestream an execution. Here's how that compares to global practice
paras.zh: 美国计划直播执行死刑。这是与全球实践的比较

paras.en: Experts say it would mark the 1st known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution
paras.zh: 专家表示，这将标志着第一次已知的合法处决广播或直播

paras.en: The U.S. military plans to livestream the Dec. 3 execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people and injuring 32 others in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.
paras.zh: 美国军方计划直播 12 月 3 日行刑队对尼达尔·哈桑 (Nidal Hasan) 的处决，这位前陆军精神病学家因在 2009 年胡德堡枪击事件中杀死 13 人、打伤 32 人而被定罪。

paras.en: He's due to become the first person executed by firing squad by the U.S. military since 1945.
paras.zh: 他将成为自 1945 年以来第一位被美军行刑队处决的人。

paras.en: Hasan, a former U.S. army officer, walked into a medical building where soldiers were getting checkups, shouted Allahu akbar — Arabic for "God is greater" — and opened fire with a laser-sighted handgun.
paras.zh: 前美国军官哈桑走进一栋士兵正在接受检查的医疗大楼，高喊“Allahu akbar”（阿拉伯语，意为“上帝更伟大”），并用激光瞄准手枪开火。

paras.en: For about nine decades, executions in the U.S. have been private affairs, often shrouded in secrecy. If carried out as planned, death penalty experts said it would mark the first known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution.
paras.zh: 大约九十年来，美国的处决一直是私人事务，常常处于保密状态。死刑专家表示，如果按计划进行，这将标志着首次已知的合法处决广播或直播。

paras.en: Executions are generally conducted behind prison walls, and internet platforms and governments have spent years trying to limit the circulation of violent execution footage.
paras.zh: 处决通常在监狱高墙内进行，互联网平台和政府多年来一直试图限制暴力处决镜头的传播。

paras.en: How does the Pentagon's stunning announcement that his execution will be livestreamed compares to global practice, and to the history of U.S. public executions?
paras.zh: 五角大楼令人震惊地宣布将对他的处决进行现场直播，这与全球实践以及美国公开处决的历史相比如何？

paras.en: Will this be the first livestreamed lawful execution?
paras.zh: 这会是第一次直播合法执行死刑吗？

paras.en: Death penalty experts consulted by Reuters said they were unaware of any previous lawful execution that had been livestreamed or broadcast to a public audience.
paras.zh: 路透社咨询的死刑专家表示，他们不知道之前有任何向公众直播或广播的合法处决。

paras.en: Execution footage has occasionally emerged after the event. The hanging of former Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein in 2006, for example, was seen around the world after official and unofficial recordings circulated online and through broadcasters, though it was not shown live.
paras.zh: 事件发生后偶尔会出现行刑镜头。例如，2006 年伊拉克前领导人萨达姆·侯赛因 (Saddam Hussein) 被绞死的场面在网上和广播公司传播的官方和非官方录音后在世界各地都能看到，尽管并未进行现场直播。

paras.en: Broadcasts and livestreams today are common for court proceedings, parliamentary debates and other state functions, but not for judicial executions.
paras.zh: 如今，广播和直播在法庭诉讼、议会辩论和其他国家职能中很常见，但在司法处决中却并不常见。

paras.en: How unusual is this compared with modern execution practices?
paras.zh: 与现代执行实践相比，这有多不寻常？

paras.en: Public executions have become rare worldwide, with most countries that retain the death penalty carrying out executions away from public view.
paras.zh: 公开处决在世界范围内已经很少见，大多数保留死刑的国家都是在远离公众视野的情况下执行死刑的。

paras.en: According to Amnesty International, public executions recorded in recent years have largely been concentrated in Iran and Taliban-run Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 据国际特赦组织称，近年来公开处决的记录主要集中在伊朗和塔利班控制的阿富汗。

paras.en: The execution would also be notable in the United States. Public executions largely disappeared during the 20th century, and death penalty experts cited by Reuters said the last legally sanctioned public execution took place in 1936.
paras.zh: 此次处决在美国也将引起关注。公开处决在20世纪基本上消失了，路透社援引死刑专家的话说，最后一次受到法律认可的公开处决发生在1936年。

paras.en: Hasan's execution would be the first carried out by firing squad by the U.S. military since the 1945 execution of Eddie Slovik, who was convicted of desertion during the Second World War.
paras.zh: 哈桑的处决将是自 1945 年处决埃迪·斯洛维克（Eddie Slovik）以来，美军行刑队首次执行的处决，埃迪·斯洛维克在第二次世界大战期间被判逃兵罪。

paras.en: Nidal Hasan, charged with killing 13 people and wounding 31 in a November 2009 shooting spree at Fort Hood, is pictured in an undated handout photo obtained by Reuters on June 29, 2012. (Bell County Sheriff's Office/Handout/Reuters)
paras.zh: 尼达尔·哈桑 (Nidal Hasan) 被控在 2009 年 11 月胡德堡的枪击事件中杀死 13 人，打伤 31 人，照片出现在路透社 2012 年 6 月 29 日获得的一张未注明日期的讲义照片中。（贝尔县治安官办公室/讲义/路透社）

paras.en: The internet has transformed execution imagery from a local event into content capable of reaching global audiences within minutes.
paras.zh: 互联网已将本地事件的执行图像转变为能够在几分钟内到达全球受众的内容。

paras.en: Militant groups such as Islamic State became notorious for producing professionally edited execution videos that were distributed online as propaganda and recruitment tools.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰国等激进组织因制作专业编辑的处决视频而臭名昭著，这些视频在网上作为宣传和招募工具传播。

paras.en: Criminal organizations, including Mexican drug cartels, have also circulated violent footage to intimidate rivals and project power.
paras.zh: 包括墨西哥贩毒集团在内的犯罪组织也传播暴力镜头来恐吓竞争对手和投射权力。

paras.en: The ability of users to rapidly copy, repost and redistribute content has made it more difficult for governments and technology companies to control the spread of such material.
paras.zh: 用户快速复制、转发和重新分发内容的能力使政府和科技公司更难控制此类材料的传播。

paras.en: The UN human rights office on Friday said the planned livestreaming would violate the absolute prohibition on torture and amount to a form of public execution.
paras.zh: 联合国人权办公室周五表示，计划中的直播将违反绝对禁止酷刑的规定，相当于公开处决的一种形式。

paras.en: "Public executions constitute a form of cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment," Shabia Mantoo, spokesperson for the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, told reporters in Geneva.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员发言人沙比亚·曼图在日内瓦对记者表示：“公开处决构成了一种残忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚。”

paras.en: Amnesty International's U.K. CEO Kerry Moscogiuri said Friday that the U.S. plans are a "grave step," considering that the death pentalty is already "so inhumane."
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织英国首席执行官克里·莫斯科吉里周五表示，考虑到死刑已经“如此不人道”，美国的计划是“严重的一步”。

paras.en: "To create some kind of theatre around the State taking someone's life is barbaric and deeply shocking," she told Reuters.
paras.zh: 她告诉路透社：“在国家周围创建某种剧院来夺取某人的生命是野蛮且令人深感震惊的。”

paras.en: - Pentagon says firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed
paras.zh: - 五角大楼称行刑队对胡德堡枪手的处决将进行直播

paras.en: - What happened in Tennessee's failed execution of Christa Pike and what comes next?
paras.zh: - 田纳西州对克里斯塔·派克的处决失败发生了什么？接下来会发生什么？

paras.en: Governments and technology companies have generally moved in the opposite direction, attempting to reduce rather than expand access to graphic execution footage.
paras.zh: 政府和科技公司通常朝着相反的方向前进，试图减少而不是扩大对图形执行镜头的访问。

paras.en: Major social media platforms have spent years removing execution videos linked to extremist organizations and other violent groups.
paras.zh: 主要社交媒体平台多年来一直删除与极端组织和其他暴力团体有关的处决视频。

paras.en: One of the first public governmental reactions came from New Zealand, whose chief censor said authorities would have little practical ability to prevent residents from accessing a livestream while it was taking place.
paras.zh: 第一个公共政府反应来自新西兰，该国首席审查员表示，当局几乎没有实际能力阻止居民在直播时观看直播。

paras.en: Livestreams pose particular challenges for platforms because footage can be viewed, copied and redistributed before moderation systems can intervene.
paras.zh: 直播给平台带来了特殊的挑战，因为在审核系统干预之前，可以查看、复制和重新分发视频片段。

paras.en: Even countries that still conduct public executions have often restricted filming and broadcast rights. Saudi Arabia historically carried out public executions before spectators, but recording them was prohibited and such public executions had largely ceased by 2019.
paras.zh: 即使仍然进行公开处决的国家也常常限制拍摄和转播权。沙特阿拉伯历来在观众面前进行公开处决，但禁止记录，而且到 2019 年此类公开处决已基本停止。

paras.en: Did the U.S. use to do public executions?
paras.zh: 美国过去有公开处决吗？

paras.en: The livestreamed execution is reminiscent of a bygone period in America’s history in which public executions were seen as deterrents to crime as well as popular ceremonies, said Michael L. Radelet, professor emeritus at the University of Colorado Boulder, who has done extensive research on executions.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校名誉教授迈克尔·L·拉德莱特(Michael L. Radelet)对处决进行了广泛的研究，他说，现场直播的处决让人回想起美国历史上的一个过去时期，当时公开处决被视为对犯罪和流行仪式的威慑。

paras.en: Parents and teachers would often bring children along to teach them a lesson. The events would sometimes feature a choir, a preacher giving an "execution sermon" and the condemned, who was typically a man being hanged, giving a long speech to the crowd.
paras.zh: 家长和老师经常带着孩子来给他们上课。这些活动有时会有唱诗班、牧师进行“处决布道”，而被判刑的人（通常是被绞死的人）向人群发表长篇演讲。

paras.en: The 1936 hanging in Kentucky of Rainey Bethea is often considered the last public execution in the country, said Radelet.
paras.zh: 拉德莱特说，1936 年在肯塔基州对雷尼·贝西娅执行绞刑通常被认为是该国最后一次公开处决。

paras.en: Bethea was a Black man who reportedly confessed to the rape and killing of a 70-year-old white woman, but was never charged with murder, according to the Death Penalty Information Center. Thousands of people attended the event, which was held in a parking lot so the courthouse lawn wouldn’t be damaged by the crowd, according to the centre.
paras.zh: 据死刑信息中心称，贝西娅是一名黑人男子，据报道承认强奸并杀害了一名 70 岁白人妇女，但从未被指控犯有谋杀罪。据该中心称，有数千人参加了这次活动，活动在停车场举行，这样法院草坪就不会被人群破坏。

paras.en: As NPR points out, the last time the U.S. military executed someone by firing squad was in 1945, when Private Eddie Slovik was shot for desertion in France.
paras.zh: NPR 指出，美军上一次用行刑队处决某人是在 1945 年，当时二等兵埃迪·斯洛维克因逃兵在法国被枪杀。

paras.en: A United States Army Specialist prays near a makeshift memorial for victims of the shootings at Fort Hood Army post in Fort Hood. (Jessica Rinaldi/Reuters)
paras.zh: 一名美国陆军专家在胡德堡胡德堡陆军哨所的枪击受害者临时纪念碑附近祈祷。 （杰西卡·里纳尔迪/路透社）

articles.title: Trump administration hits International Criminal Court with sweeping sanctions

paras.en: Trump administration hits International Criminal Court with sweeping sanctions
paras.zh: 特朗普政府对国际刑事法院实施全面制裁

paras.en: ICC denounces the move as an 'assault on the rule of law'
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院谴责此举是“对法治的攻击”

paras.en: The Trump administration has imposed sweeping new sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) as part of its campaign to dismantle the tribunal over investigations into the United States and its allies, including Israel.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府对国际刑事法院（ICC）实施了全面的新制裁，作为其解散该法庭的行动的一部分，因为该法庭对美国及其包括以色列在内的盟友进行了调查。

paras.en: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the sanctions on Friday, after the Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to South African prosecutor Navi Pillay, a former judge at the ICC and other international courts.
paras.zh: 在诺贝尔和平奖授予南非检察官、国际刑事法院和其他国际法院前法官纳维·皮莱后，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周五宣布了制裁措施。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump has coveted that prize for himself. The move, however, long predated the Nobel Prize announcement.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本人也渴望获得这一奖项。然而，此举早在诺贝尔奖宣布之前就已发生。

paras.en: "We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate against us," Rubio said in a video address posted to social media. "The United States and the American people are not subject to the jurisdiction of this fake ICC."
paras.zh: 卢比奥在社交媒体上发布的视频地址中表示：“我们将禁止与这个流氓法院进行交易，切断他们的资源，削弱其针对我们开展行动的能力。” “美国和美国人民不受这个假国际刑事法院的管辖。”

paras.en: The sanctions cut the court off from U.S.-based financial services, technology companies and even using U.S. dollars. They set a six-month timeline for U.S. companies and individuals that have business with the court to wind that business down.
paras.zh: 这些制裁切断了法院与美国金融服务、科技公司甚至使用美元的联系。他们为与法院有业务往来的美国公司和个人设定了六个月的期限来结束业务。

paras.en: The ICC denounced the step as an attack on the rule of law and the foundations of international order — themes that Rubio had appeared to embrace only two days ago in a speech in front of the Acropolis in Athens.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院谴责这一举措是对法治和国际秩序基础的攻击——卢比奥两天前在雅典卫城前的演讲中似乎也谈到了这一主题。

paras.en: It called on its 125 member states to take action to defend it.
paras.zh: 它呼吁 125 个成员国采取行动捍卫它。

paras.en: "It is an attempt to obstruct the course of justice and to prevent the court from doing what it was created to do," the court said in a statement. "It is an assault on the rule of law and on the very foundations of the international legal order which strikes at the simple principle that no one stands above the law."
paras.zh: 法院在一份声明中表示：“这是企图妨碍司法公正，并阻止法院履行其创建职责。” “这是对法治和国际法律秩序基础的攻击，侵犯了任何人都不能凌驾于法律之上的简单原则。”

paras.en: ICC President Tomoko Akane, a citizen of U.S. ally Japan, said the court would "continue to fully discharge its mandate, with independence and impartiality, acting only on the basis of the law and the evidence, for the sake of the countless victims of grave crimes."
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院主席、美国盟友日本公民赤根智子表示，国际刑事法院将“继续独立、公正地全面履行其职责，仅根据法律和证据行事，为无数严重犯罪受害者着想”。

paras.en: She also appealed to other ICC members for support. "This is not just about defending a single institution, but about safeguarding the international order grounded upon the rule of law."
paras.zh: 她还呼吁其他国际刑事法院成员的支持。 “这不仅仅是为了捍卫一个机构，而是为了维护以法治为基础的国际秩序。”

paras.en: The Trump administration has long been hostile to the court, founded in 2002 to prosecute war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide, and has previously imposed sanctions on its prosecutors and judges. Friday's move would go much farther, by potentially punishing companies that provide services to the court itself.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府长期以来对该法院怀有敌意，该法院成立于2002年，旨在起诉战争罪、反人类罪和种族灭绝罪，此前还对其检察官和法官实施了制裁。周五的举措将走得更远，可能会惩罚向法院本身提供服务的公司。

paras.en: Rights groups also denounced the sanctions.
paras.zh: 人权组织也谴责了制裁。

paras.en: "This existential attack must fail," said Erika Guevara Rosas, an Amnesty International senior director. "States must take concrete action to resist the imposition of these measures and actively protect the court."
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织高级主任埃里卡·格瓦拉·罗萨斯表示：“这场关乎生存的攻击必须失败。” “各国必须采取具体行动抵制这些措施的实施，并积极保护法院。”

paras.en: The court's host country of the Netherlands has been preparing for weeks for the move. One possible measure to mitigate sanctions is the EU blocking statute, which could be used to protect European court staff by preventing European companies from complying with the U.S. measures.
paras.zh: 法院的东道国荷兰已经为此举做好了数周的准备。减轻制裁的一项可能措施是欧盟封锁法规，该法规可用于通过阻止欧洲公司遵守美国的措施来保护欧洲法院工作人员。

paras.en: - Analysis Netanyahu is flying freely over Canada as his international arrest warrant remains in place
paras.zh: - 分析内塔尼亚胡正在加拿大上空自由飞行，因为他的国际逮捕令仍然有效

paras.en: - The Trump administration sanctioned ICC judges. A Canadian judge is fighting back
paras.zh: - 特朗普政府制裁国际刑事法院法官。加拿大法官正在反击

paras.en: Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen has called the blocking statute the "nuclear option" in countering possible sanctions, but said the Netherlands has been in talks with the European Commission to ensure that if it is necessary, it can be quickly enacted.
paras.zh: 荷兰外交部长汤姆·贝伦德森称封锁法规是应对可能制裁的“核选项”，但表示荷兰一直在与欧盟委员会进行谈判，以确保如果有必要，可以迅速颁布该法规。

paras.en: In a joint statement, Canada, Denmark, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom expressed strong disagreement with the U.S. sanctions.
paras.zh: 加拿大、丹麦、德国、法国、意大利、日本、荷兰和英国在一份联合声明中对美国的制裁表示强烈反对。

paras.en: "We will continue to work together to support the court's vital work, uphold the rules-based international system and advance accountability," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“我们将继续共同努力，支持法院的重要工作，维护基于规则的国际体系并推进问责制。”

paras.en: "If put into effect, these sanctions will have a significant impact on the court's work, its dedicated staff and their families. They work every day to bring those accused of the most serious international crimes to justice and to support their victims."
paras.zh: “如果实施，这些制裁将对法院的工作、其敬业的工作人员及其家人产生重大影响。他们每天都在努力将那些被指控犯有最严重国际罪行的人绳之以法，并支持他们的受害者。”

paras.en: Rubio calls on allies to join in on sanctions
paras.zh: 卢比奥呼吁盟友加入制裁

paras.en: Rubio said U.S. allies should join in the U.S. actions. "If they do not, the United States will continue its campaign to dismantle the ICC, piece by piece, until Americans are threatened no longer," he said.
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，美国的盟友应该加入美国的行动。他说：“如果他们不这样做，美国将继续逐步拆除国际刑事法院，直到美国人不再受到威胁。”

paras.en: A number of countries have withdrawn from the court this year, including Venezuela and Chad. The South Pacific island nation of Naoero was the most recent to announce it would quit.
paras.zh: 今年，包括委内瑞拉和乍得在内的一些国家已退出该法院。南太平洋岛国纳奥罗是最近宣布退出的国家。

paras.en: Rubio said both Republicans and Democrats have deep reservations about the court, which was established to prosecute war crimes and crimes against humanity that might not otherwise be handled by the parties involved.
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，共和党人和民主党人都对该法院抱有深深的保留，该法院的设立是为了起诉战争罪和反人类罪，否则有关各方可能不会处理这些罪。

paras.en: But he said that only Trump was willing to move against the court.
paras.zh: 但他表示，只有特朗普愿意对法院采取行动。

paras.en: "Both parties agree on this, but only President Trump has the resolve to take the action needed to end this threat once and for all," Rubio said. "Either the ICC will end its threats, or we will end the ICC."
paras.zh: 卢比奥说：“双方都同意这一点，但只有特朗普总统有决心采取必要行动，一劳永逸地结束这一威胁。” “要么国际刑事法院结束其威胁，要么我们就结束国际刑事法院。”

articles.title: This rare David Bowie self-portrait is going up for auction
articles.author: Griffin Jaeger

paras.en: This rare David Bowie self-portrait is going up for auction
paras.zh: 这幅罕见的大卫·鲍伊自画像即将拍卖

paras.en: The handprinted 1996 piece is estimated to go for about $60K to $100K
paras.zh: 这件 1996 年的手绘作品估计售价约为 6 万至 10 万美元

paras.en: Turn and face the strange: Ch-ch-changes could be coming to your living room wall. A rare signed David Bowie self-portrait is going up for auction and it's even got his handprints — though it'll cost you a pretty penny.
paras.zh: 转身面对陌生的事物：你的客厅墙壁可能会发生变化。一幅罕见的大卫·鲍伊签名自画像即将拍卖，甚至还留有他的手印——不过这要花不少钱。

paras.en: The piece, made by the singer in 1996, is going to the market for the first time as part of Sotheby’s Modern British and Irish Art Day Auction on Oct. 15.
paras.zh: 这件作品由这位歌手于 1996 年创作，将于 10 月 15 日作为苏富比现代英国和爱尔兰艺术日拍卖会的一部分首次进入市场。

paras.en: It's estimated to sell for between £35,000 to £55,000 (roughly $66,000 Cdn to $104,000 Cdn).
Bowie originally gifted the painting to his St Ives gallerist. Now, after three decades of being in a private collection, the work is on public view in London ahead of its upcoming auction.
paras.zh: 鲍伊最初将这幅画作为礼物送给了他的圣艾夫斯画廊。现在，在私人收藏三十年后，这件作品在即将举行的拍卖之前在伦敦公开亮相。

paras.en: It's part of a series of eight large-scale portraits he made in the mid-1990s, this one being the most expressive of the group.
paras.zh: 这是他在 20 世纪 90 年代中期创作的八幅大型肖像画系列中的一部分，这幅肖像画是这组作品中最具表现力的一幅。

paras.en: "This self-portrait captures David Bowie at his most creative and self-reflective. His direct gaze and handprints pressed onto the composition create an unusually personal connection to the artist," wrote Sotheby's senior specialist Jen Hardie in a press release.
paras.zh: 苏富比高级专家珍·哈迪 (Jen Hardie) 在一份新闻稿中写道：“这幅自画像捕捉了大卫·鲍伊 (David Bowie) 最具创造力和自我反思的一面。他的直视目光和压在构图上的手印与艺术家建立了一种不同寻常的个人联系。”

paras.en: "Bold and richly coloured, it demonstrates the strength of Bowie's painting practice in the 1990s and offers a rare opportunity to encounter him not as a musician or cultural icon, but as an artist in his own right."
paras.zh: “它大胆且色彩丰富，展示了鲍伊在 20 世纪 90 年代绘画实践的实力，并提供了一个难得的机会来认识他，而不是作为音乐家或文化偶像，而是作为一名艺术家。”

paras.en: In case it doesn't end up on your living room wall, have a look at it here.
paras.zh: 如果它没有出现在您客厅的墙上，请在这里看看。

paras.en: This self portrait, made by David Bowie in 1996 is going to the market for the first time as part of Sotheby’s Modern British and Irish Art Day Auction on Oct. 15. (Courtesy Sotheby's)
paras.zh: 这幅大卫·鲍伊于 1996 年创作的自画像将于 10 月 15 日作为苏富比现代英国和爱尔兰艺术日拍卖会的一部分首次进入市场。（由苏富比提供）

paras.en: In the painting, which was done on paper, the musician, actor and performer stares directly at the viewer, emphasizing his famously uneven sized pupils — one was larger than the other, creating the impression of differently coloured irises.
paras.zh: 在这幅纸上画作中，音乐家、演员和表演者直视观众，强调了他著名的瞳孔大小不均匀——一个比另一个大，给人一种虹膜颜色不同的印象。

paras.en: And of course, the handprints Bowie pressed himself on either side of the painting's lower third are an especially intimate touch.
paras.zh: 当然，鲍伊压在画作下三分之一两侧的手印是一种特别亲密的接触。

paras.en: So if you’ve ever wanted a literally hands-on piece of Starman history, now’s your chance.
paras.zh: 因此，如果您想亲身体验 Starman 的历史，那么现在机会来了。

articles.title: US imposes sanctions aiming to 'dismantle' International Criminal Court

paras.en: US President Donald Trump's administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) on Friday, hours after one of its former judges won the Nobel Peace Prize.
paras.zh: 周五，在国际刑事法院一名前法官获得诺贝尔和平奖数小时后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府对国际刑事法院实施制裁。

paras.en: This comes as the US has in recent months made no bones about pursuing what Secretary of State Marco Rubio has called a "sweeping campaign to dismantle the threat posed by the International Criminal Court."
paras.zh: 近几个月来，美国毫不掩饰地推行国务卿马可·鲁比奥所说的“消除国际刑事法院构成的威胁的全面行动”。

paras.en: The United States and Israel had both strongly opposed the court's arrest warrants for top Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列都强烈反对法院对包括总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在内的以色列高级官员发出逮捕令。

paras.en: Since 2020 and the back end of Trump's first term, the US had also opposed investigations into military actions in Afghanistan that "deprioritize" alleged US wrongdoings, focusing on the Taliban, but can nevertheless include them.
paras.zh: 自2020年和特朗普第一任期末期以来，美国还反对对阿富汗军事行动进行调查，这些行动“不优先考虑”所谓的美国不当行为，重点关注塔利班，但仍然可以将其包括在内。

paras.en: What did the State Department say about the ICC sanctions?
paras.zh: 国务院对国际刑事法院的制裁有何评论？

paras.en: "President Trump will never allow the International Court to prosecute Americans," Rubio said in a statement.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在一份声明中表示：“特朗普总统永远不会允许国际法院起诉美国人。”

paras.en: "That is why, today, the United States is sanctioning the International Criminal Court. We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate," he said.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么今天美国制裁国际刑事法院。我们将禁止与这个流氓法院进行交易，切断他们的资源并削弱其运作能力，”他说。

paras.en: Rubio said that both US political parties had long agreed that the ICC should not have jurisdiction over US citizens, but said "only President Trump" resolved to take action.
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，美国两党长期以来都认为国际刑事法院不应对美国公民拥有管辖权，但表示“只有特朗普总统”决心采取行动。

paras.en: "Either the ICC will end its threats, or we will end the ICC. We expect our allies, many of whom are part of the ICC and that rely on American servicemembers for their defense, to rein in the court," Rubio said. "If they do not, the United States will continue its campaign to dismantle the ICC, brick by brick, until Americans are threatened no longer."
paras.zh: 卢比奥说：“要么国际刑事法院结束其威胁，要么我们结束国际刑事法院。我们希望我们的盟友能够控制法院，其中许多都是国际刑事法院的一部分，并且依靠美国军人进行辩护。” “如果他们不这样做，美国将继续一砖一瓦地拆除国际刑事法院，直到美国人不再受到威胁。”

paras.en: The ICC said the US sanctions aimed to obstruct an independent international court supported by more than half of the UN's members.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院表示，美国的制裁旨在阻碍由半数以上联合国会员国支持的独立国际法院成立。

paras.en: "The court will continue to fully discharge its mandate, with independence and impartiality, acting only on the basis of the law and the evidence, for the sake of the countless victims of grave crimes," said ICC President Tomoko Akane, who already faces US sanctions.
paras.zh: 已经面临美国制裁的国际刑事法院主席赤根友子表示：“法院将继续以独立和公正的态度充分履行其职责，仅在法律和证据的基础上行事，为了无数严重犯罪的受害者。”

paras.en: The ICC called the Rome Statute, which underpins membership of the court, a "collective promise" that the most serious international crimes must not go unpunished.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院称《罗马规约》是国际法院成员资格的基础，是一项“集体承诺”，即最严重的国际罪行决不能逍遥法外。

paras.en: "That promise is only as strong as the resolve of those who made it," the court said. It appealed to members to take "concrete actions" to ensure the court would still have the necessary means to continue its work.
paras.zh: 法院表示：“这一承诺的坚定程度取决于承诺者的决心。”它呼吁成员采取“具体行动”，以确保法院仍有必要的手段继续其工作。

paras.en: "No one should be punished for serving the cause of justice," it said. "History will judge this moment. Future generations, and above all the victims of mass atrocities, will ask how we responded when an insitution created to protect them came under attack."
paras.zh: “任何人都不应该因为为正义事业服务而受到惩罚，”它说。 “历史将评判这一刻。子孙后代，尤其是大规模暴行的受害者，将会问，当为保护他们而创建的机构受到攻击时，我们如何应对。”

paras.en: What did other countries say about the US sanctions?
paras.zh: 其他国家对美国制裁有何评论？

paras.en: A collection of US allies that are full members of the ICC including Germany issued a joint statement reaffirming their "continued and unwavering support for the independence, impartiality, and integrity of the ICC."
paras.zh: 包括德国在内的一系列作为国际刑事法院正式成员的美国盟友发表联合声明，重申他们“继续坚定不移地支持国际刑事法院的独立性、公正性和完整性”。

paras.en: "As committed supporters of the ICC we regret and strongly disagree with the announcement of sanctions to be imposed upon the Court by the United States," the governments of Canada, Denmark, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands and the UK said.
paras.zh: 加拿大、丹麦、德国、法国、意大利、日本、荷兰和英国政府表示：“作为国际刑事法院的坚定支持者，我们对美国宣布对国际刑事法院实施制裁感到遗憾并强烈反对。”

paras.en: They said that, despite the ICC's best efforts to prepare and mitigate their effect, the sanctions "will have a significant impact on the Court's work, its dedicated staff and their families."
paras.zh: 他们表示，尽管国际刑事法院尽了最大努力准备和减轻其影响，但制裁“将对法院的工作、其敬业的工作人员及其家人产生重大影响”。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu thanked the US government for its "leadership" in issuing the sanctions.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡感谢美国政府在实施制裁方面的“领导作用”。

paras.en: "The ICC is not a court. It is a political body that poses a mortal threat to law abiding democracies worldwide and to the very idea of national sovereignty," he said.
paras.zh: “国际刑事法院不是法院。它是一个政治机构，对全世界守法的民主国家和国家主权理念构成致命威胁，”他说。

paras.en: Sanctions announced shortly after former ICC judge's Nobel Peace Prize
paras.zh: 前国际刑事法院法官获得诺贝尔和平奖后不久宣布制裁

paras.en: The State Department released the announcement a few hours after the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Navi Pillay, who was an ICC judge from 2003 to 2012.
paras.zh: 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖授予 2003 年至 2012 年担任国际刑事法院法官的纳维·皮莱 (Navi Pillay) 几小时后，国务院发布了这一消息。

paras.en: Last year Trump repeatedly complained that he should have won the accolade for promoting world peace, prompting Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado to present him with her trophy as a gift.
paras.zh: 去年，特朗普多次抱怨他应该因促进世界和平而获得这一荣誉，促使委内瑞拉反对派领导人玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多将奖杯作为礼物送给他。

paras.en: Without naming names, the Nobel Committee clearly referenced US sanctions against the ICC when announcing Pillay as this year's laureate.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会在宣布皮莱为今年的获奖者时，没有点名，但明确提到了美国对国际刑事法院的制裁。

paras.en: "The Norwegian Nobel Committee wants to remind the world that the rule of law national and international — underpins the system we have set up to ensure peace and resolve conflicts non-violently," the Committee wrote.
paras.zh: “挪威诺贝尔委员会希望提醒世界，国内和国际法治是我们为确保和平和非暴力解决冲突而建立的体系的基础，”委员会写道。

paras.en: It said judges like Pillay "guard the thin red line between order and chaos," but lamented that "today ... these same judges are sanctioned, and their institutions are attacked."
paras.zh: 报告称，像皮莱这样的法官“守卫着秩序与混乱之间的细细红线”，但遗憾的是“今天......同样是这些法官受到制裁，他们的机构受到攻击。”

paras.en: The International Criminal Court is an intergovernmental organization and international tribunal based in the Dutch city of The Hague.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院是一个政府间组织和国际法庭，总部设在荷兰海牙市。

paras.en: It's the only permanent international court with the theoretical jurisdiction to prosecute individuals for international crimes like genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes and illegal aggression.
paras.zh: 它是唯一一个理论上有权起诉犯有种族灭绝罪、反人类罪、战争罪和非法侵略等国际罪行的个人的常设国际法院。

paras.en: The ICC was established in 2002 and is governed by the Rome Statute.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院成立于 2002 年，受《罗马规约》管辖。

paras.en: More than half the countries in the world, 125 in total, are full parties to the Rome Statute, having signed and ratified it.
paras.zh: 世界上超过一半的国家（总共 125 个）已签署并批准了《罗马规约》，成为该规约的正式缔约方。

paras.en: Several of the world's most significant powers, including China, India, Israel, Russia and the United States, do not recognize the court's jurisdiction and are not parties to the statute.
paras.zh: 世界上几个最重要的国家，包括中国、印度、以色列、俄罗斯和美国，都不承认该法院的管辖权，也不是该规约的缔约方。

paras.en: A grey area, however, remains since the court accepts challenges from ratified members against individuals from countries that do not recognize it.
paras.zh: 然而，由于法院接受已批准成员对来自不承认法院的国家的个人提出的质疑，因此灰色地带仍然存在。

paras.en: That is why high-profile arrest warrants against Russian officials, including President Vladimir Putin, and Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, have been issued in recent years — following respective complaints from Ukrainians and Palestinians.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么近年来在乌克兰人和巴勒斯坦人分别提出投诉后，对俄罗斯官员（包括总统弗拉基米尔·普京）和以色列官员（包括总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡）发出了高调的逮捕令。

paras.en: What were the prior signs of Trump administration pressure on the ICC?
paras.zh: 特朗普政府向国际刑事法院施压之前有哪些迹象？

paras.en: The US has been increasingly critical of the ICC during Trump's second term.
paras.zh: 在特朗普第二任期内，美国对国际刑事法院的批评越来越多。

paras.en: Rubio has often led the charge. In July, he wrote an op-ed for the Wall Street Journal saying, "America never agreed to a world tribunal that can override our own courts and the Constitution."
paras.zh: 卢比奥经常带头冲锋。 7月，他为《华尔街日报》撰写了一篇专栏文章，称“美国从未同意建立一个可以凌驾于我们自己的法院和宪法之上的世界法庭。”

paras.en: He argued it was possible for US "soldiers, police officers, Border Patrol agents and elected leaders" to be "dragged before an international court" and tried by judges "from random countries across the globe."
paras.zh: 他认为，美国“士兵、警察、边境巡逻人员和民选领导人”有可能被“拖到国际法庭上”并由“来自全球随机国家的法官”进行审判。

paras.en: Just over a week later, on July 25, Venezuela's new administration — transformed after the US abduction of Nicolas Maduro in January — announced that it planned to withdraw from the Rome Statute and the ICC.
paras.zh: 仅仅一周多后，即 7 月 25 日，委内瑞拉新政府（在美国 1 月份绑架尼古拉斯·马杜罗后发生转变）宣布计划退出《罗马规约》和国际刑事法院。

paras.en: A few days later, the military junta in Chad announced that it was withdrawing from the ICC following a US request.
paras.zh: 几天后，乍得军政府宣布应美国要求退出国际刑事法院。

paras.en: The recent sexual misconduct scandal surrounding the ICC's chief prosecutor Karim Khan, who was dismissed in July, provided more ammunition the US could aim at the court.
paras.zh: 最近发生的有关国际刑事法院首席检察官卡里姆·汗（Karim Khan）的性行为不端丑闻为美国针对该法院提供了更多弹药。卡里姆·汗于 7 月被解职。

paras.en: In August, the US imposed sanctions on the ICC's president, Japanese judge Tomoko Akane, and Abdoulaye Seye, a Senegalese trial lawyer at the court.
paras.zh: 8月，美国对国际刑事法院院长、日本法官茜智子和该法院塞内加尔出庭律师阿卜杜拉耶·塞耶实施制裁。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Macron and Steinmeier struggle to revive Franco-German ties

paras.en: The German delegation passed through Paris without being hindered by the student strikes taking place on the streets of Paris. The motorcades moved through the French capital without disruption. Around the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees, however, traffic was at a standstill for hours. Due to the high-profile visit, the streets were cordoned off over a wide area.
paras.zh: 德国代表团途经巴黎，没有受到巴黎街头学生罢课的阻碍。车队顺利穿过法国首都。然而，凯旋门和香榭丽舍大街周围的交通停滞了几个小时。由于这次访问的高调，街道被大面积封锁。

paras.en: Emmanuel Macron had decided on a special gesture to send off Frank-Walter Steinmeier, his German guest: The military honors took place under the Arc de Triomphe. And so, early in the morning, the German national anthem rang out in the heart of Paris — amid sunshine and bitter cold.
paras.zh: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙决定以一种特殊的姿态来送别他的德国客人弗兰克·瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔：军事仪式在凯旋门下举行。于是，清晨，在阳光明媚和严寒中，德国国歌在巴黎市中心响起。

paras.en: It was a generous gesture of friendship and symbolism, yet it seemed to be from a bygone era. In both countries, populists on the political fringes are gaining support. In Germany, the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) ranks first in nationwide polls. In France, Emmanuel Macron could soon be succeeded by either Jean-Luc Melenchon of the far left or Marine Le Pen of the far right.
paras.zh: 这是一种慷慨的友谊和象征意义的举动，但它似乎来自一个过去的时代。在这两个国家，政治边缘的民粹主义者正在获得支持。在德国，极右翼的德国另类选择党（AfD）在全国民意调查中排名第一。在法国，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙很快就会被极左翼的让-吕克·梅朗雄或极右翼的马琳·勒庞接替。

paras.en: Added to this is an economic crisis that threatens prosperity. Unresolved issues of social justice are driving younger generations into the streets. At the same time, social media is increasingly becoming a tool of disinformation and "accelerating doubts about democracy," Macron said in Paris.
paras.zh: 除此之外，还有威胁繁荣的经济危机。尚未解决的社会正义问题正促使年轻一代走上街头。与此同时，马克龙在巴黎表示，社交媒体日益成为散布虚假信息和“加速对民主的怀疑”的工具。

paras.en: While the AfD may soon form its first state government in Saxony-Anhalt, President Steinmeier remained confident. He insisted that Germany would continue to "play a leading role in Europe" in the future and that Germans would remain good Europeans. But he did not say where he drew this certainty from. Questions from journalists were not permitted at the joint press conference at the Elysee Palace.
paras.zh: 尽管德国选择党可能很快就会在萨克森-安哈尔特州组建第一个州政府，但施泰因迈尔总统仍然充满信心。他坚称，德国未来将继续“在欧洲发挥领导作用”，德国人仍将是优秀的欧洲人。但他没有透露他从哪里得出这种确定性。在爱丽舍宫举行的联合新闻发布会上不允许记者提问。

paras.en: Political scientist Jacob Ross isn't surprised by this. Both Macron and Steinmeier lack a "genuine agenda for Germany, France, and Europe." Both represent political systems that "seek to respond to 21st-century crises with 20th-century solutions," said the expert on German-French relations at the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP).
paras.zh: 政治学家雅各布·罗斯对此并不感到惊讶。马克龙和施泰因迈尔都缺乏“德国、法国和欧洲的真正议程”。德国外交关系委员会（DGAP）的德法关系专家表示，两者都代表了“寻求用20世纪的解决方案应对21世纪危机”的政治制度。

paras.en: Even though Steinmeier and Macron have different political styles, Ross sees parallels — especially where their policies have failed. One example of this is strategic foreign policy issues, such as dealing with Russia. "For a long time, they pursued a policy based on integrating Russia into Europe, and then both were overwhelmed by the events of 2022 and had to adjust their course," said Ross. Since then, both have merely reacted to current affairs, according to the political scientist.
paras.zh: 尽管施泰因迈尔和马克龙有不同的政治风格，但罗斯看到了相似之处——尤其是在他们的政策失败的地方。其中一个例子是战略外交政策问题，例如与俄罗斯打交道。罗斯表示：“长期以来，他们奉行将俄罗斯融入欧洲的政策，然后双方都被 2022 年发生的事件压垮，不得不调整路线。”这位政治学家表示，从那时起，两人都只是对时事做出反应。

paras.en: Emmanuel Macron has made some bold moves for Europe, but without support from Berlin, says Ross. Germany's political leadership has long reacted with caution to proposals from Paris.
paras.zh: 罗斯表示，马克龙为欧洲采取了一些大胆的举措，但没有得到柏林的支持。德国政治领导层长期以来一直对巴黎的提议做出谨慎反应。

paras.en: A joint initiative that both countries recently promoted to the European Commission is aimed at combating unfair competition. Countries that gain an advantage through unfair practices should face strict European measures.
paras.zh: 两国最近向欧盟委员会提出了一项旨在打击不公平竞争的联合倡议。通过不公平做法获得优势的国家应该面临严格的欧洲措施。

paras.en: Macron joined German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in speaking out in favor of this. Although China was not explicitly named, the initiative is seen to be primarily aimed at that country. Beijing uses enormous subsidies to support its companies, whose products flood the European market, while European firms continue to face barriers when trying to access the Chinese market.
paras.zh: 马克龙与德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨一起公开表示支持这一点。尽管没有明确点名中国，但该倡议似乎主要针对该国。北京利用巨额补贴来支持其产品涌入欧洲市场的企业，而欧洲企业在试图进入中国市场时仍然面临障碍。

paras.en: Germany and France have also long sought greater cooperation in the defense sector. Yet major joint defense projects are making little progress. When the planned joint fighter jet, the FCAS, fell through in June, officials emphasized ongoing cooperation on the future MGCS main battle tank. And yet differences on this became apparent during the state visit.
paras.zh: 德国和法国长期以来也一直寻求在国防领域加强合作。然而，重大联合防御项目进展甚微。当计划中的联合战斗机 FCAS 在 6 月份落空时，官员们强调了在未来 MGCS 主战坦克方面正在进行的合作。然而，在国事访问期间，这一点上的分歧变得明显。

paras.en: As German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius arrived in Paris, French Chief of the General Staff Fabien Mandon stated during a hearing in the French National Assembly that Germany had decided to withdraw from the tank project. A day later, Mandon clarified that he had expressed himself ambiguously. But some observers believe that such misunderstandings are a sign of dissatisfaction on both sides — below the political level — regarding cooperation with the other partner.
paras.zh: 当德国国防部长鲍里斯·皮斯托利斯抵达巴黎时，法国总参谋长法比安·曼东在法国国民议会听证会上表示，德国已决定退出坦克项目。一天后，曼登澄清说他的表达含糊不清。但一些观察家认为，这种误解是双方对与对方合作的不满的表现——在政治层面以下。

paras.en: It is this political level that often ends up having to set the record straight in such cases. This time was no exception: Pistorius firmly refuted the claim that the project was on the verge of being scrapped. "The MGCS project is not over; it is not dead; it has not been terminated by anyone — quite the contrary. It is a core project of Franco-German cooperation on land systems," said the German defense minister.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，正是这种政治层面最终不得不澄清事实。这次也不例外：皮斯托利斯坚决驳斥了该项目濒临废弃的说法。德国国防部长表示：“MGCS 项目没有结束；它没有消亡；它没有被任何人终止——恰恰相反。它是法德陆地系统合作的核心项目。”

paras.en: The focus is primarily on digital information processing in combat, as well as unmanned and automated systems. Germany and France would continue their cooperation, Pistorius insisted, and MGCS is an important future project for both countries and their armed forces.
paras.zh: 重点主要是战斗中的数字信息处理以及无人和自动化系统。皮斯托里斯坚称，德国和法国将继续合作，MGCS对于两国及其武装部队来说是一个重要的未来项目。

paras.en: On Friday, the presidents of France and Germany visited several facilities near Bordeaux that are closely linked to space exploration and nuclear deterrence. These include ArianeGroup, a Franco-German company that, among other things, manufactures the nuclear-capable M51 missiles for French nuclear submarines. The itinerary also included visits to startups that are looking far into the future.
paras.zh: 周五，法国和德国总统参观了波尔多附近的几个与太空探索和核威慑密切相关的设施。其中包括阿丽亚娜集团（ArianeGroup），这是一家法德公司，除其他外，该公司为法国核潜艇生产可携带核弹头的 M51 导弹。行程还包括参观展望未来的初创公司。

paras.en: It was unofficially reported during the visit that this focus of the trip was a personal priority for Macron. The French president has long spoken of a European dimension to France's nuclear deterrent. Considering announcements from the US saying it would reduce its commitment to Europe, his views are gaining increasing traction.
paras.zh: 访问期间的非正式报道称，此行的重点是马克龙个人的优先事项。法国总统长期以来一直谈到法国核威慑力量的欧洲层面。考虑到美国宣布将减少对欧洲的承诺，他的观点越来越受到关注。

paras.en: As early as 2020, Macron proposed a strategic dialogue on the role of French nuclear weapons in European security. Several countries, including Germany, have since expressed interest. Now, further steps are being considered. The focus is on what Macron once called "forward deterrence," such as joint military exercises and visits to strategically important locations. A permanent deployment of French nuclear weapons in other countries remains off the table. Furthermore, according to French nuclear doctrine, France always retains sole decision-making authority over the use of its nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 早在2020年，马克龙就提出就法国核武器在欧洲安全中的作用进行战略对话。此后，包括德国在内的多个国家表达了兴趣。现在，正在考虑采取进一步措施。重点是马克龙曾经所说的“前沿威慑”，例如联合军事演习和访问具有重要战略意义的地点。法国在其他国家永久部署核武器的可能性仍然不大。此外，根据法国的核学说，法国始终保留对其核武器使用的唯一决策权。

paras.en: Steinmeier's two-day state visit to France ended on Friday afternoon. So far, there has been little sign of new momentum in Franco-German relations. This makes it all the more urgent for the successors to the two presidents to develop a shared vision for the future of the relationship between the two countries starting next year.
paras.zh: 施泰因迈尔对法国为期两天的国事访问于周五下午结束。到目前为止，法德关系还没有出现新势头的迹象。这使得两国总统的继任者更加迫切地需要为明年开始的两国关系的未来制定共同愿景。

paras.en: Macron and Steinmeier will step down from their posts almost simultaneously in 2027 after ten years in office. The state visit to France thus also served as a final joint meeting, marked by some ceremonial farewells.
paras.zh: 马克龙和施泰因迈尔将在任职十年后于 2027 年几乎同时卸任。因此，对法国的国事访问也是最后一次联席会议，并举行了一些仪式性的告别仪式。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Eritrean troops in Ethiopia raise fears of a regional war

paras.en: Various sources have confirmed the presence of Eritrean armed forces in Ethiopia. An AFP report quoted a foreign security source, speaking on condition of anonymity, as estimating that 5,000 to 8,000 Eritrean soldiers were present in the northenmost state of Ethiopia, Tigray.
paras.zh: 各种消息来源已证实厄立特里亚武装部队在埃塞俄比亚的存在。法新社报道援引一位不愿透露姓名的外国安全消息人士的话说，估计埃塞俄比亚最北部的提格雷州有5,000至8,000名厄立特里亚士兵。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ethiopia and Eritrea have ramped up their war talk.
paras.zh: 与此同时，埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚加剧了战争言论。

paras.en: According to Reuters, the government of Ethiopia has written to the UN Security Council, calling for the immediate withdrawal of Eritrean troops from its territory.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，埃塞俄比亚政府已致函联合国安理会，呼吁厄立特里亚军队立即撤出其领土。

paras.en: In the letter, dated Oct. 8, Ethiopian Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos said the presence of Eritrean troops in Ethiopia left "no option but to defend itself against Eritrea,"
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚外交部长吉迪恩·蒂莫特沃斯在 10 月 8 日的信中表示，厄立特里亚军队在埃塞俄比亚的存在让“别无选择，只能保卫自己，对抗厄立特里亚”。
