paras.en: in a post on X on October 7, Eritrean Minister of Information Yemane Meskel had accused Ethiopia of "incessantly beating the drums of war."
paras.zh: 10月7日，厄立特里亚新闻部长耶马内·梅斯克尔在X网站上发帖指责埃塞俄比亚“不断敲响战鼓”。

paras.en: Two days later, he wrote in Tigrinya, a working language of Eritrea and the main language of Tigray, that "the sovereign state of Eritrea is bound by blood and law." adding "woe to those who touch it."
paras.zh: 两天后，他用厄立特里亚的工作语言、提格雷的主要语言提格里尼亚语写道，“厄立特里亚主权国家受到血缘和法律的约束”。加上“触摸它的人有祸了”。

paras.en: This comes as the regional conflict in Tigray has deteriorated rapidly in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 近几周来，提格雷地区冲突迅速恶化。

paras.en: Some experts have suggested that Ethiopia may have intentionally triggered the escalation. Just last week, it expelled diplomats from Egypt and Eritrea, causing the latter to sever diplomatic ties altogether.
paras.zh: 一些专家认为，埃塞俄比亚可能是故意引发事态升级的。就在上周，它驱逐了埃及和厄立特里亚的外交官，导致后者完全断绝了外交关系。

paras.en: On Monday, when Abiy Ahmed was sworn in for another five years as Ethiopian prime minister, he stated that access to the sea was a priority. The statement fueled fresh speculation that he intends to take Eritrea's strategic port of Assab by force and prompted fierce reactions from the Eritrean side.
paras.zh: 周一，当阿比·艾哈迈德宣誓就任埃塞俄比亚总理五年后，他表示出海是当务之急。这一声明引发了新的猜测，即他打算用武力夺取厄立特里亚的战略港口阿萨布，并引发厄立特里亚方面的激烈反应。

paras.en: Abiy's internal opposition: Tsimdo and the Alliance for Survival
paras.zh: 阿比的内部反对派：齐姆多和生存联盟

paras.en: While the Ethiopian National Defence Forces (ENDF), aided by the Tigray Peace Force milita, have made significant advances and notably recaptured the Tigray federal state capital of Mekelle, opposition to Ethiopia has found new formats for collaboration.
paras.zh: 尽管埃塞俄比亚国防军（ENDF）在提格雷和平部队民兵的协助下取得了重大进展，特别是重新夺回了提格雷联邦州首府默克莱，但埃塞俄比亚的反对派却找到了新的合作形式。

paras.en: One is the Tsimdo movement, named after a Tigrinya term that loosely translates as "engagement."
paras.zh: 其中之一是 Tsimdo 运动，以提格里尼亚语命名，大致可翻译为“参与”。

paras.en: "The Tsimdo concept initially surfaced through cross-border peace initiatives involving activists, religious figures, and local communities in the Tigray and Eritrea border villages in 2025," Dr. Jalale Getachew Birru, senior East Africa analyst with the US-based conflict monitor ACLED, told DW.
paras.zh: 美国冲突监测机构 ACLED 东非高级分析师贾拉勒·格塔丘·比鲁 (Jalale Getachew Birru) 博士告诉德国之声：“Tsimdo 概念最初是通过 2025 年提格雷和厄立特里亚边境村庄的活动人士、宗教人士和当地社区参与的跨境和平倡议浮出水面的。”

paras.en: It has since undergone several reconfigurations and now encompasses diverse groups within Ethiopia, mostly defined along ethnic lines and with long-standing grievances against the federal government.
paras.zh: 此后，它经历了几次重组，现在涵盖了埃塞俄比亚境内的不同群体，这些群体大多是按照种族界限定义的，并且对联邦政府有着长期的不满。

paras.en: The Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival, or simply Alliance for Survival, that was proclaimed in September, stems from this movement. According to Jalale, the alliance aims at removing the current government and initiating a constitutional dialogue.
paras.zh: 9月宣布成立的埃塞俄比亚人民力量生存联盟，或简称生存联盟，就是源于这一运动。贾拉勒表示，该联盟的目标是推翻现任政府并启动宪法对话。

paras.en: The new alliance says a lot about the long history of unresolved conflict in Ethiopia, said Abdurahman Sayed, an analyst at the Horn of Africa Centre for Regional Integration.
paras.zh: 非洲之角区域一体化中心分析师阿卜杜拉赫曼·赛义德表示，新联盟充分说明了埃塞俄比亚长期未解决的冲突。

paras.en: "The fighting inside Ethiopia has never stopped," Sayed told DW.
paras.zh: 赛义德告诉德国之声：“埃塞俄比亚境内的战斗从未停止过。”

paras.en: "With the Oromo Liberation Army, it's been going on for decades, with the Amhara, it's been going on for the last three years, at least. With the Tigrayans, the Pretoria agreement about three years ago was just a cessation of hostility that would have led to some kind of sustainable peace by addressing the root causes of the conflict — but it failed to do that, so they're back to the conflict situation now."
paras.zh: “对奥罗莫解放军来说，这种情况已经持续了几十年，对阿姆哈拉人来说，至少在过去三年里一直在进行。对提格雷人来说，大约三年前的比勒陀利亚协议只是停止敌对行动，本可以通过解决冲突的根源来实现某种可持续的和平——但它未能做到这一点，所以他们现在又回到了冲突局势。”

paras.en: However, of the seven groups in the alliance, ACLED data shows that only three were involved in recent fighting: The Tigrayan Defence Forces (TDF), the Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM), and a fairly recently formed ethnic Afar group called Ugugumo.
paras.zh: 然而，在该联盟的七个团体中，ACLED 数据显示，只有三个团体参与了最近的战斗：提格雷国防军 (TDF)、阿姆哈拉法诺民族运动 (AFNM) 和最近成立的阿法尔族团体乌古古莫 (Ugugumo)。

paras.en: Joint declaration by Sudan, Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia
paras.zh: 苏丹、埃及、厄立特里亚、索马里联合声明

paras.en: The success of the Alliance for Survival would depend in large part on the support they get through external actors, according to ACLED. Those could include neighboring Sudan, Egypt, Eritrea, and Somalia.
paras.zh: ACLED 表示，生存联盟的成功在很大程度上取决于他们通过外部参与者获得的支持。这些国家可能包括邻国苏丹、埃及、厄立特里亚和索马里。

paras.en: "All these four countries have grievances against Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government," Sayed said.
paras.zh: “这四个国家都对总理阿比·艾哈迈德政府心存不满，”赛义德说。

paras.en: "The Egyptians have issues with the Nile River and how it should be administered, including the dams that are already there and those planned to be built around the Nile River. The Sudanese also have their own concerns that Ethiopians are supporting the [Rapid Support Forces] militia, which is fighting the Sudanese army."
paras.zh: “埃及人对尼罗河以及如何管理它存在问题，包括已经在那里的水坝和计划在尼罗河周围建造的水坝。苏丹人也担心埃塞俄比亚人支持与苏丹军队作战的[快速支援部队]民兵。”

paras.en: In the case of Somalia, the issue of sea access has sparked tensions. Landlocked Ethiopia has negotiated access to the port of Berbera in Somaliland . In 2024, it signed a memorandum of understanding with the breakaway region, causing uproar in Somalia, which considers the deal a violation of its national sovereignty. Turkish mediation was needed to calm things down.
paras.zh: 就索马里而言，出海通道问题引发了紧张局势。内陆埃塞俄比亚已就进入索马里兰柏培拉港进行了谈判。 2024年，它与分裂地区签署了一份谅解备忘录，在索马里引起轩然大波，索马里认为该协议侵犯了其国家主权。需要土耳其的调解来平息事态。

paras.en: "So all those neighboring countries have their own concerns and they feel this threat that is coming from Ethiopia needs to be tackled collectively."
paras.zh: “因此，所有这些邻国都有自己的担忧，他们认为来自埃塞俄比亚的威胁需要集体应对。”

paras.en: On October 4, the leaders of the four countries issued a joint declarationthat didn't mention Ethiopia but seemed to send a strong signal. The leaders stressed the importance of international law, "particularly respect for the sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity of the states of the region."
paras.zh: 10月4日，四国领导人发表联合声明，虽然没有提及埃塞俄比亚，但似乎发出了强烈信号。领导人强调国际法的重要性，“特别是尊重该地区国家的主权、独立和领土完整”。

paras.en: And they maintained that "the governance of the Red Sea is the exclusive responsibility of the littoral states."
paras.zh: 他们认为“红海的治理是沿岸国家的专属责任”。

paras.en: Although the leaders of Sudan, Egypt, Eritrea and Somalia vowed to promote "peaceful solutions to conflicts," the reality on the ground may prove otherwise.
paras.zh: 尽管苏丹、埃及、厄立特里亚和索马里领导人誓言要推动“和平解决冲突”，但实际情况可能并非如此。

articles.title: ‘A Ceuta-style surge is possible’: Border tensions on NATO’s eastern flank

paras.en: Masked and armed men attempted to cross into Latvia from Belarus alongside 20 undocumented migrants on Monday.
paras.zh: 周一，蒙面武装人员试图与 20 名无证移民一起从白俄罗斯越境进入拉脱维亚。

paras.en: “The (masked) escorts of the illegal migrants, who were located on the Belarusian side, were armed, issued threats to … soldiers, and also actively urged and drove the migrant group toward Latvia,” Janis Dombrava, Latvia’s interior minister, said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 拉脱维亚内政部长贾尼斯·多姆布拉瓦 (Janis Dombrava) 周二表示：“位于白俄罗斯一侧的非法移民的（蒙面）护送人员携带武器，向……士兵发出威胁，并积极敦促并驱使移民团体前往拉脱维亚。”

paras.en: Later, masked men managed to enter Latvia, destroying an electrical box and stealing surveillance cameras before returning to Belarus – an act of sabotage orchestrated by the country, according to Latvian officials. It was not clear if the second incident involved the same masked men as the first.
paras.zh: 后来，蒙面男子设法进入拉脱维亚，摧毁了一个电箱并偷走了监控摄像头，然后返回白俄罗斯——据拉脱维亚官员称，这是该国精心策划的破坏行为。目前尚不清楚第二起事件是否与第一起事件涉及同一名蒙面男子。

paras.en: “Unlike many previous incidents, this time the provocation was particularly demonstrative and aggressive,” said Dombrava.
paras.zh: “与之前的许多事件不同，这次的挑衅尤其具有示范性和攻击性，”多姆布拉瓦说。

paras.en: Since 2021, Belarus, Russia’s ally, has used migration as a tool to destabilise NATO’s eastern flank. It shares borders with Russia, Ukraine, Poland, Lithuania and Latvia – the latter considered Europe’s weakest link.
paras.zh: 自2021年以来，俄罗斯的盟友白俄罗斯一直利用移民作为破坏北约东翼稳定的工具。它与俄罗斯、乌克兰、波兰、立陶宛和拉脱维亚接壤——后者被认为是欧洲最薄弱的一环。

paras.en: “The crisis at the EU [European Union] border with Belarus has been ongoing for five years. The situation in Latvia has been deteriorating since May of this year,” Bartosz Chmielewski, Baltics expert from the Poland-based Centre for Eastern Studies told Al Jazeera. “There has been a steady rise in border violations and the number of people crossing.”
paras.zh: “欧盟与白俄罗斯边境的危机已经持续了五年。自今年五月以来，拉脱维亚的局势一直在恶化，”波兰东方研究中心的波罗的海问题专家巴托什·赫米勒夫斯基告诉半岛电视台。 “侵犯边境的行为和越境人数不断增加。”

paras.en: In September and October, “the number of border violations has already reached 12,000, a level equal to the total for the entire previous year”, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，9月和10月，“侵犯边境的事件已达到12,000起，相当于去年全年的总数”​​。

paras.en: According to Olevs Nikers, the Latvian president of the Baltic Security Foundation, “A Ceuta-style surge is physically possible, and we should plan for it.”
paras.zh: 波罗的海安全基金会拉脱维亚主席奥列夫斯·尼克斯表示，“休达式的增兵实际上是可能的，我们应该为此做好计划。”

paras.en: He was referring to the recent crossing of tens of thousands of people from Morocco to Spain.
paras.zh: 他指的是最近有数万人从摩洛哥越境前往西班牙。

paras.en: “But sustained low-level pressure may be the more effective strategy. It creates exhaustion, budget pressure and friction between allies. Poland’s renewed controls on its border with Lithuania are already an example of this.”
paras.zh: “但持续的低水平压力可能是更有效的策略。它会造成疲惫、预算压力和盟友之间的摩擦。波兰对其与立陶宛边境的重新控制就是一个例子。”

paras.en: He noted that Lithuania’s border with Belarus is four times longer than Latvia’s 173km (107 miles), yet pressure has been concentrated in Latvia.
paras.zh: 他指出，立陶宛与白俄罗斯的边界比拉脱维亚的173公里（107英里）长四倍，但压力主要集中在拉脱维亚。

paras.en: “This looks less like spontaneous migration than a deliberate instrument, adjusted to test the neighbour perceived as most vulnerable,” Nikers said.
paras.zh: 尼克斯说：“这看起来不像是自发的移民，而是一种故意的工具，旨在测试被视为最脆弱的邻居。”

paras.en: Any migration pressure from Belarus may cause bureaucratic chaos. Latvia, with a population of 1.8 million, would struggle with the reception, processing and providing medical aid to potential asylum seekers, he said.
paras.zh: 来自白俄罗斯的任何移民压力都可能导致官僚混乱。他说，拉脱维亚拥有 180 万人口，在接待、处理和向潜在寻求庇护者提供医疗援助方面将面临困难。

paras.en: According to the Polish Border Guard, in 2021, almost 40,000 people tried to cross the border from Belarus. Thousands more crossings of undocumented people were never recorded.
paras.zh: 据波兰边防卫队称，2021年，近4万人试图从白俄罗斯越境。还有数以千计的无证人员过境从未被记录下来。

paras.en: Before Russia’s war in Ukraine began in 2022, Belarus built a system – including travel agencies, plane connections and visa programmes – encouraging migrants seeking a better life to cross into the European Union from the east. The scheme targeted people from the Global South, or Latin America, Africa and much of Asia.
paras.zh: 在 2022 年俄罗斯乌克兰战争开始之前，白俄罗斯建立了一个系统——包括旅行社、飞机联运和签证计划——鼓励寻求更好生活的移民从东部进入欧盟。该计划针对的是来自南半球、拉丁美洲、非洲和亚洲大部分地区的人们。

paras.en: According to experts, the system has since been dismantled, but Belarus is still pressing migration when it can.
paras.zh: 据专家称，该系统已被废除，但白俄罗斯仍在尽可能地推动移民。

paras.en: “A sudden influx of several thousand people into Latgale in winter would become a humanitarian and political problem before it became a border-security problem,” Nikers added.
paras.zh: 尼克斯补充道：“冬季数千人突然涌入拉特盖尔，在成为边境安全问题之前，将成为人道主义和政治问题。”

paras.en: Out of all of NATO’s eastern flank countries, Latvia seems the least prepared for provocations coming from the east.
paras.zh: 在所有北约东翼国家中，拉脱维亚似乎对来自东部的挑衅准备最不充分。

paras.en: “Until now, Latvia remained on the sidelines, as the pressure was primarily focused on Poland and Lithuania. Now it finds itself in the spotlight, partly because it is unprepared, its border infrastructure is inadequate, and the resources of the border guard – even with military support – are dwindling,” Chmielewski said.
paras.zh: “到目前为止，拉脱维亚仍然处于观望状态，因为压力主要集中在波兰和立陶宛。现在它发现自己成为了众人瞩目的焦点，部分原因是它没有做好准备，边境基础设施不足，而且边防部队的资源——即使有军事支持——也在减少，”赫米莱夫斯基说。

paras.en: “Latvia struggles to execute major infrastructure projects … It shares the shortest border with Belarus, but has been unable to complete the necessary infrastructure there; this is due both to the challenging terrain and the state’s limited operational capacity.”
paras.zh: “拉脱维亚在执行重大基础设施项目方面举步维艰……它与白俄罗斯的边界最短，但一直无法在那里完成必要的基础设施；这是由于地形具有挑战性，而且该国的运营能力有限。”

paras.en: Other experts said the migration pressure from Belarus might be a response to recent political developments in Latvia.
paras.zh: 其他专家表示，白俄罗斯的移民压力可能是对拉脱维亚最近政治事态发展的回应。

paras.en: “The elections in Latvia were won by a coalition led by [Prime Minister] Andris Kulbergs, which seeks to maintain sanctions against Belarus. So Belarus uses both carrots and sticks to show it can destabilise the situation in the Baltics,” said Marta Jaroszewicz, assistant professor at the University of Warsaw’s Centre of Migration Research.
paras.zh: “拉脱维亚的选举是由[总理]安德里斯·库尔伯格斯领导的联盟赢得的，该联盟寻求维持对白俄罗斯的制裁。因此，白俄罗斯使用胡萝卜加大棒来表明它可以破坏波罗的海地区的局势稳定，”华沙大学移民研究中心助理教授玛尔塔·雅罗斯谢维奇说。

paras.en: “For the past year, there have been periodic releases of Belarusian political prisoners, a process supported by the US administration. Belarus’s goal is the lifting of sanctions and the ability to transport its raw materials via Baltic ports, including through Poland. The objective is, in fact, the normalisation of trade.”
paras.zh: “过去一年，白俄罗斯政治犯定期获释，这一进程得到了美国政府的支持。白俄罗斯的目标是解除制裁，并能够通过包括波兰在内的波罗的海港口运输其原材料。事实上，其目标是贸易正常化。”

paras.en: Russian and Belarusian pressure on the EU has also changed over the years as migration pressure is only one of the tactics employed. Others include disinformation, arson, the recruitment of local citizens and GPS jamming, according to Nikers.
paras.zh: 多年来，俄罗斯和白俄罗斯对欧盟的压力也发生了变化，因为移民压力只是所采用的策略之一。据 Nikers 称，其他行为包括虚假信息、纵火、招募当地公民和干扰 GPS。

paras.en: He said that “2026 is increasingly about airspace and infrastructure. The most important change is that Russia has moved from targeting what we believe to targeting what we depend on: cables, grids, navigation and airspace. It is also increasingly operating below the Article 5 threshold.”
paras.zh: 他说，“2026年越来越关注空域和基础设施。最重要的变化是，俄罗斯已经从瞄准我们认为的目标转向瞄准我们依赖的目标：电缆、电网、导航和空域。它的运作也越来越低于第5条的门槛。”

paras.en: Established in the aftermath of World War II, NATO’s collective defence commitment, Article 5, was designed to ensure mutual protection among member states in response to the perceived threat of Soviet expansion, particularly in Eastern Europe during the early stages of the Cold War.
paras.zh: 北约的集体防御承诺（第五条）成立于二战后，旨在确保成员国之间相互保护，以应对苏联扩张的威胁，特别是冷战初期在东欧的威胁。

paras.en: “This is an attempt at intimidation by Russia. And what deters Russia from aggressive actions on the eastern flank is the solidarity of European nations,” Chmielewski said. “That is what Russia fears most: that should it stage a more brazen provocation, solidarity will stretch from Lisbon to Stockholm, and the European Union will act as a united front.”
paras.zh: “这是俄罗斯的恐吓企图。阻止俄罗斯在东翼采取侵略行动的是欧洲国家的团结，”赫米莱夫斯基说。 “这就是俄罗斯最担心的：如果它发动更加明目张胆的挑衅，从里斯本到斯德哥尔摩都会团结一致，欧盟也会形成统一战线。”

articles.title: DHS defends ICE shooting in NYC, says officers believed they were in danger

paras.en: The United States Department of Homeland Security has defended Immigration and Customs Enforcement’s (ICE) shooting of a man in New York City while his child was present. Federal officials used the incident to criticise sanctuary-city policies that limit cooperation with federal immigration authorities.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部为移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 在纽约市枪杀一名男子时其孩子在场的事件进行了辩护。联邦官员利用这一事件批评限制与联邦移民当局合作的庇护城市政策。

paras.en: New York officials have condemned the shooting and have called for ICE to end its operations in the city.
paras.zh: 纽约官员谴责了这起枪击事件，并呼吁 ICE 停止在该市的行动。

paras.en: The shooting took place on Thursday afternoon when ICE officers attempted to arrest a man identified by New York City police as Oscar Belgal.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在周四下午，当时 ICE 官员试图逮捕一名纽约市警方确认为奥斯卡·贝尔加尔 (Oscar Belgal) 的男子。

paras.en: Homeland Security officials gave their account of the incident on Friday during a news conference, saying that Belgal refused to exit his car when approached by officers and then accelerated, striking two ICE vehicles.
paras.zh: 国土安全部官员在周五的新闻发布会上描述了这一事件，称贝尔加尔在警察接近时拒绝下车，然后加速，撞上了两辆 ICE 车辆。

paras.en: They said officers then opened fire, grazing Belgal’s neck while his five-year-old child was in the back seat.
paras.zh: 他们说，警察随后开枪，擦伤了贝尔加尔的脖子，当时他五岁的孩子就坐在后座上。

paras.en: According to Homeland Security officials, Belgal received first aid and was taken to hospital before being transferred to a secure detention facility outside New York state. They did not disclose where Belgal is being held.
paras.zh: 据国土安全部官员称，贝尔加尔接受了急救并被送往医院，然后被转移到纽约州以外的一个安全拘留设施。他们没有透露贝尔加尔被关押的地点。

paras.en: Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Secretary Markwayne Mullin said that the agents did not know the child was inside the vehicle when they fired.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部 (DHS) 部长马克韦恩·穆林 (Markwayne Mullin) 表示，特工开枪时并不知道孩子就在车内。

paras.en: ICE senior official Marcos Charles said agents had attempted to arrest Belgal as part of an investigation into suspected gang involvement in an earlier shooting of a US Customs and Border Protection officer.
paras.zh: ICE 高级官员马科斯·查尔斯 (Marcos Charles) 表示，作为对涉嫌参与早些时候枪杀一名美国海关和边境保护局官员的犯罪团伙的调查的一部分，特工人员曾试图逮捕贝尔加尔。

paras.en: According to US officials, Belgal is an undocumented migrant from the Dominican Republic who had previously evaded arrest and received a five-year sentence for grand larceny in April 2025.
paras.zh: 据美国官员称，贝尔加尔是一名来自多米尼加共和国的无证移民，此前曾逃避逮捕，并于 2025 年 4 月因重大盗窃罪被判处五年徒刑。

paras.en: “[Belgal] was a thug,” Mullin said at the Friday news conference. “The absolute worst of the worst.”
paras.zh: “[比利时]是一个暴徒，”穆林在周五的新闻发布会上说。 “绝对是最糟糕中的最糟糕。”

paras.en: Mullin confirmed that officers were wearing body cameras but the footage has not been made public. New York City police released bodycam footage on Friday of police officers on the scene who had responded to a 911 call about the incident.
paras.zh: 马林证实，警察佩戴了随身摄像机，但录像尚未公开。纽约市警方周五公布了现场警察的随身摄像机镜头，这些警察接到了有关该事件的 911 电话。

paras.en: In other violent incidents involving federal immigration officers, video evidence has contradicted initial accounts from ICE and Homeland Security officials, including in Minneapolis, where footage of the fatal shootings of Alex Pretti and Renee Good challenged federal officials’ descriptions of the encounters.
paras.zh: 在涉及联邦移民官员的其他暴力事件中，视频证据与 ICE 和国土安全部官员的最初说法相矛盾，其中包括在明尼阿波利斯，亚历克斯·普雷蒂 (Alex Pretti) 和蕾妮·古德 (Renee Good) 被枪杀的镜头对联邦官员对遭遇的描述提出了质疑。

paras.en: The latest shooting prompted protests on Thursday night in the Bronx, where the shooting took place, with demonstrators condemning ICE and calling for the agency to be abolished. Tensions rose after NYPD officers clashed with some of the protesters.
paras.zh: 最近的枪击事件周四晚上在枪击事件发生地布朗克斯引发了抗议活动，示威者谴责 ICE 并呼吁废除该机构。纽约警察局官员与一些抗议者发生冲突后，紧张局势加剧。

paras.en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani condemned the shooting and said he had called US President Donald Trump to demand an end to ICE enforcement in the city.
paras.zh: 纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼谴责了这起枪击事件，并表示他已致电美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，要求 ICE 停止在该市的执法。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters late on Thursday at the scene of the shooting, Mamdani said he had tried unsuccessfully to secure Belgal’s release in phone calls with Trump and Mullin.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼周四晚间在枪击现场对记者表示，他曾在与特朗普和穆林的电话中试图确保贝尔加尔获释，但没有成功。

paras.en: “These actions are making the city less safe,” Mamdani said. “ICE is rotten to its core.”
paras.zh: “这些行为使城市变得不那么安全，”马姆达尼说。 “ICE 的核心已经腐烂了。”

paras.en: Mullin accused Mamdani of prioritising politics over public safety and said Trump had offered to transfer Belgal to New York police custody if they pursued charges. Mullin said Mamdani refused this offer.
paras.zh: 穆林指责马姆达尼将政治置于公共安全之上，并表示特朗普已提出，如果他们提出指控，将把贝尔加尔移交给纽约警方拘留。穆林说，马姆达尼拒绝了这一提议。

articles.title: Drone strike kills 30 people in Sudan’s Blue Nile region

paras.en: At least 30 displaced people, including women and children, have been killed and dozens of others have been wounded following a drone attack in southeastern Sudan.
paras.zh: 苏丹东南部发生无人机袭击事件，造成至少 30 名流离失所者死亡，其中包括妇女和儿童，数十人受伤。

paras.en: The governor of Wad al-Mahi province told Al Jazeera on Friday that a drone belonging to the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) targeted the centre of the province, killing 26 women and four children.
paras.zh: 瓦德马希省省长周五告诉半岛电视台，准军事快速支援部队 (RSF) 的一架无人机袭击了该省中部，造成 26 名妇女和 4 名儿童死亡。

paras.en: Governor Mahjoub Al-Sheikh described the attack as “cowardly”. He said the drone was launched from “inside Ethiopia”, according to the AFP news agency.
paras.zh: 省长马赫朱布·谢赫称这次袭击是“懦弱的”。据法新社报道，他说这架无人机是从“埃塞俄比亚境内”发射的。

paras.en: Al Jazeera Arabic’s Sudan correspondent, Wadah Al-Tahir, explained that the attack was the latest in a wave of drone strikes targeting the Blue Nile region and this time Wad al-Mahi province near the city of Damazin was struck.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台阿拉伯语驻苏丹记者瓦达赫·塔希尔解释说，这次袭击是针对青尼罗河地区的无人机袭击浪潮中的最新一起，这次袭击的是达马津市附近的瓦德马希省。

paras.en: Friday’s attack was just outside a displacement camp, near an informal gold mining site, where women earn a daily wage using chemicals and their bare hands to clear gold nuggets from the earth extracted by men.
paras.zh: 周五的袭击发生在一个流离失所者营地外，靠近一个非正式的金矿开采点，在那里，妇女们靠使用化学品和徒手从男人开采的土地中清除金块来赚取日薪。

paras.en: The latest frontline in the war between the Sudanese army and the RSF is the border region with Ethiopia, which is facing its own internal conflict that threatens to escalate.
paras.zh: 苏丹军队与无国界部队之间战争的最新前线是与埃塞俄比亚的边境地区，该地区正面临着可能升级的内部冲突。

paras.en: Sudan has repeatedly accused Ethiopia of harbouring RSF fighters and bases – Ethiopia has denied the allegations.
paras.zh: 苏丹多次指责埃塞俄比亚窝藏无国界支援部队战士和基地，但埃塞俄比亚否认了这些指控。

paras.en: Local sources say the porous border between the two countries is a key supply line for the paramilitary and its allies, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，当地消息人士称，两国之间漏洞百出的边境是准军事组织及其盟友的关键补给线。

paras.en: The RSF launched its offensive towards Damazin but the advance could put the army in a bind, forcing it to defend territory on both the Blue Nile front and in the Kordofan region, where a year of deadly drone strikes has left the two sides deadlocked.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织向达马津发起攻势，但这一进展可能会让军队陷入困境，迫使其保卫青尼罗河前线和科尔多凡地区的领土，一年来致命的无人机袭击使双方陷入僵局。

paras.en: Aid workers estimate that Sudan’s civil war has killed more than 200,000 people since it started in April 2023, creating one of the world’s largest hunger and displacement crises.
paras.zh: 援助人员估计，自 2023 年 4 月爆发以来，苏丹内战已造成超过 20 万人死亡，造成了世界上最严重的饥饿和流离失所危机之一。

paras.en: Nearly 100,000 people have been displaced in Blue Nile state this year alone, according to United Nations figures.
paras.zh: 据联合国数据显示，仅今年青尼罗州就有近 10 万人流离失所。

articles.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
articles.author: Emmet Livingstone

paras.en: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
paras.zh: 南非人权律师纳维·皮莱荣获诺贝尔和平奖

paras.en: Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, a leading South African jurist and former U.N. human rights chief, won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday for her lifetime commitment to international law.
paras.zh: 南非著名法学家、前联合国人权事务负责人纳瓦尼特姆·“纳维”·皮莱 (Navanethem "Navi" Pillay) 因她一生对国际法的贡献而获得诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: At a ceremony in Oslo, Norwegian Nobel Committee Chair Jørgen Watne Frydnes called Pillay "one of the most courageous and important legal experts of our time."
paras.zh: 在奥斯陆举行的颁奖典礼上，挪威诺贝尔委员会主席约尔根·沃特纳·弗里德内斯 (Jørgen Watne Frydnes) 称皮莱为“我们这个时代最勇敢、最重要的法律专家之一”。

paras.en: "There is a thread to her involvement in standing and supporting Nelson Mandela and the prisoners of Robben Island, to her being a key to all the major international court cases of our time," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“她参与维护和支持纳尔逊·曼德拉和罗本岛囚犯，这与她成为我们这个时代所有重大国际法庭案件的关键人物有关。”

paras.en: The 85-year-old was attending a conference in Nuremberg, Germany, when she received the news.
paras.zh: 这位85岁的老人得知这一消息时正在德国纽伦堡参加一个会议。

paras.en: At a news conference, Pillay said she was deeply honored and dedicated the prize to "all of the survivors of international crimes" and "defenders of international justice."
paras.zh: 皮莱在新闻发布会上表示，她深感荣幸，并将该奖项献给“所有国际罪行的幸存者”和“国际正义的捍卫者”。

paras.en: "We are living through an era when international law and human rights are under significant political attack," she added.
paras.zh: “我们生活在一个国际法和人权受到严重政治攻击的时代，”她补充道。

paras.en: Hours after her win, the United States issued new sanctions on the International Criminal Court, which the Trump administration has warned it is working to dismantle.
paras.zh: 她获胜数小时后，美国对国际刑事法院实施了新的制裁，特朗普政府警告称，正在努力废除该制裁。

paras.en: From defending South African activists to U.N. human rights chief
paras.zh: 从捍卫南非活动人士到联合国人权事务负责人

paras.en: Born in Durban in 1941, Pillay — who is a South African of Indian-Tamil descent — became the first woman of color to open a legal practice in her home province of Natal. She defended anti-apartheid activists, beginning a career studded with lasting achievements.
paras.zh: 皮莱 1941 年出生于德班，拥有印度泰米尔血统的南非人，成为第一位在家乡纳塔尔省开设律师事务所的有色人种女性。她为反种族隔离活动人士辩护，开启了她取得持久成就的职业生涯。

paras.en: In 1973, she successfully sued the government to establish that political prisoners on South Africa's infamous Robben Island, including Mandela, had the right to legal representation.
paras.zh: 1973年，她成功起诉政府，规定南非臭名昭著的罗本岛上的政治犯，包括曼德拉，有权获得法律代表。

paras.en: A year after apartheid ended in 1994, Pillay became a high court judge in South Africa in 1995. She was shortly appointed to the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, where she presided over a landmark case that established that rape and sexual assault could constitute acts of genocide.
paras.zh: 1994 年种族隔离结束一年后，皮莱于 1995 年成为南非高等法院法官。她很快被任命为卢旺达问题国际刑事法庭法官，在那里她主持了一起具有里程碑意义的案件，该案件确定强奸和性侵犯可能构成种族灭绝行为。

paras.en: Pillay later served as a judge at the International Criminal Court from 2003 to 2012, as well as the U.N. high commissioner for human rights from 2008 to 2014.
paras.zh: 皮莱后来于 2003 年至 2012 年担任国际刑事法院法官，并于 2008 年至 2014 年担任联合国人权事务高级专员。

paras.en: She led a U.N. commission report describing Israel's actions as genocide
paras.zh: 她领导的联合国委员会报告将以色列的行为描述为种族灭绝

paras.en: Pillay was applauded by colleagues while in Nuremberg after receiving the news of her Nobel win.
paras.zh: 皮莱在纽伦堡得知获得诺贝尔奖的消息后受到同事们的鼓掌。

paras.en: The winner of last year's Nobel Peace Prize, Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado, gifted Trump the physical gold medal she received in January. The Nobel Committee reacted to Machado's move by saying the prize cannot be transferred to others.
paras.zh: 去年诺贝尔和平奖获得者、委内瑞拉反对派领导人玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多将她一月份获得的实体金质奖章送给了特朗普。诺贝尔委员会对马查多的举动作出反应，称该奖项不能转让给其他人。

paras.en: Pillay referred to her recent work as chair of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, which concluded in 2025 that Israel had committed genocide in Gaza. Israeli leaders strongly reject the accusation.
paras.zh: 皮莱提到了她最近担任巴勒斯坦被占领土独立国际调查委员会主席的工作，该委员会于 2025 年得出结论，以色列在加沙犯下了种族灭绝罪。以色列领导人强烈否认这一指控。

paras.en: In response to the Nobel prize decision, Israel's Foreign Ministry posted on X that it rewarded "anti-Israel hatred." It added: "Joseph Goebbels is certainly applauding from hell."
paras.zh: 作为对诺贝尔奖决定的回应，以色列外交部在X上发帖称，它奖励的是“反以色列的仇恨”。它补充道：“约瑟夫·戈培尔无疑在地狱里鼓掌。”

paras.en: Others, including South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, U.N. High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk, as well as human rights advocates, praised the move to award Pillay the prize.
paras.zh: 其他人，包括南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨、联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克以及人权倡导者，都对授予皮莱奖项的举动表示赞赏。

paras.en: "Congratulations to her, she's the fifth South African to achieve the Nobel Prize," South Africa's new ambassador to Washington, Roelf Meyer, told NPR.
paras.zh: “祝贺她，她是第五位获得诺贝尔奖的南非人，”南非新任驻华盛顿大使罗尔夫·迈耶 (Roelf Meyer) 告诉美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR)。

paras.en: Pillay joins anti-apartheid luminaries Chief Albert Luthuli, Archbishop Desmond Tutu, President Nelson Mandela in winning the award, as well as former President F.W. de Klerk. But Meyer noted she is the first woman. "We as South Africans are very, very proud of her."
paras.zh: 皮莱与反种族隔离杰出人士阿尔伯特·卢图利酋长、德斯蒙德·图图大主教、纳尔逊·曼德拉总统以及前总统德克勒克一起获奖。但迈耶指出她是第一位女性。 “作为南非人，我们为她感到非常非常自豪。”

paras.en: Meyer also said she exemplified South Africa's constitutional legal system — which was established at the start of the nation's democracy, following the end of apartheid.
paras.zh: 迈耶还表示，她是南非宪法法律体系的典范，该体系是在种族隔离结束后国家民主开始时建立的。

paras.en: But Pillay's award comes amid a diplomatic low-point between the U.S. and South Africa.
paras.zh: 但皮莱的获奖之际正值美国和南非之间的外交低谷。

paras.en: President Trump has falsely accused the government of persecuting South Africa's white minority. The U.S. has also criticized South Africa's genocide case against Israel brought before the International Court of Justice.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统错误地指责政府迫害南非白人少数群体。美国还批评南非向国际法院提起的针对以色列的种族灭绝案。

paras.en: U.S. pressure on International Criminal Court
paras.zh: 美国向国际刑事法院施压

paras.en: Although the Trump administration has not yet publicly commented on Pillay's win, its sweeping sanctions against the International Criminal Court have sent a signal.
paras.zh: 尽管特朗普政府尚未公开评论皮莱的胜诉，但其对国际刑事法院的全面制裁已经发出了信号。

paras.en: "We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate," Rubio said in a statement announcing the sanctions.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在宣布制裁的声明中表示：“我们将禁止与这个流氓法院进行交易，切断他们的资源并削弱其运作能力。”

paras.en: The U.S. had already sanctioned senior officials of the court, including half of its judges and its former chief prosecutor, piling significant pressure on the institution.
paras.zh: 美国已经制裁了该法院的高级官员，包括一半的法官和前首席检察官，给该机构带来了巨大压力。

paras.en: The sanctions are connected to investigations into U.S. military personnel in Afghanistan, as well as arrest warrants issued for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant for alleged war crimes in Gaza.
paras.zh: 这些制裁与对驻阿富汗美军人员的调查以及对以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和前国防部长约夫·加兰特因涉嫌在加沙犯下战争罪而发出的逮捕令有关。

paras.en: Neither the U.S. nor Israel is a member of the International Criminal Court, but the Trump administration has argued that the court threatens U.S. sovereignty.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列都不是国际刑事法院的成员，但特朗普政府辩称该法院威胁到美国的主权。

paras.en: The Norwegian Nobel Committee said that continued attacks on the rule of law and its institutions had influenced its decisions.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔委员会表示，对法治及其机构的持续攻击影响了其决定。

paras.en: "This is a message that international law and its institutions are the cornerstone of a more peaceful world," Jørgen Watne Frydnes said.
paras.zh: 约尔根·沃特纳·弗里德内斯说：“这传达了一个信息，即国际法及其机构是更加和平的世界的基石。”

paras.en: The news of Pillay's win will surely be seen as a blow to President Trump, who has long coveted the Nobel Peace Prize. He told reporters on Wednesday he believed he deserved it.
paras.zh: 皮莱获奖的消息肯定会被视为对觊觎诺贝尔和平奖已久的特朗普总统的打击。他周三告诉记者，他相信这是他应得的。

paras.en: "I settled eight wars," Trump said, while admitting that the Nobel Prize Committee had "a reputation for maybe not giving it to people like me."
paras.zh: “我解决了八场战争，”特朗普说，同时承认诺贝尔奖委员会“因可能不把奖颁给像我这样的人而闻名”。

paras.en: This year's Nobel Peace Prize attracted 287 nominations, including individuals and organizations. The award carries prize money of 12 million Swedish kronor, approximately $1.2 million. The 2026 prize marks the 125th anniversary of the Nobel Peace Prize, first awarded in 1901.
paras.zh: 今年的诺贝尔和平奖吸引了 287 项提名，其中包括个人和组织。该奖项的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗，约合 120 万美元。 2026 年的奖项标志着诺贝尔和平奖诞生 125 周年，该奖于 1901 年首次颁发。

paras.en: Kate Bartlett contributed reporting from Johannesburg; Michele Kelemen contributed from Washington.
paras.zh: 凯特·巴特利特 (Kate Bartlett) 贡献了来自约翰内斯堡的报道；米歇尔·凯莱门 (Michele Kelemen) 来自华盛顿。

articles.title: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
paras.zh: 特朗普表示美国不会在中期选举前攻击伊朗。而且，ICE 特工在纽约开枪射杀了一名男子

paras.en: Hurricane Isaias is set to make landfall on the northern Gulf Coast as early as tonight, marking the first hurricane of the Atlantic season. The National Hurricane Center warns of potentially dangerous winds over 100 miles per hour and life-threatening storm surges of five to seven feet. People along the coastlines of Mississippi, Alabama and northwest Florida are preparing for impact.
paras.zh: 飓风伊萨亚斯最早将于今晚在墨西哥湾北部海岸登陆，这是大西洋季节的第一场飓风。国家飓风中心警告称，可能存在时速超过 100 英里的危险大风和 5 至 7 英尺的危及生命的风暴潮。密西西比州、阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达州西北部海岸线的人们正在为撞击做好准备。

paras.en: - 🎧 Highways are busy with both people fleeing the region and emergency crews deploying to the coast, NPR's Debbie Elliot tells Up First. States are pre-staging personnel and emergency supplies — such as generators, food and water — for distribution during power outages and the cleanup process. Elliot says October feels late for the first hurricane of the season, and that this prominent El Niño weather pattern has led many to believe they have escaped the worst. Forecasters predict serious weather across the southeast, including potential flash flooding and tornadoes. But they say they expect the storm to move through quickly and lose its tropical strength.
paras.zh: - NPR 的黛比·埃利奥特 (Debbie Elliot) 告诉 Up First，高速公路上挤满了逃离该地区的人们和部署到海岸的应急人员。各州正在预先部署人员和应急物资，例如发电机、食物和水，以便在停电和清理过程中分发。埃利奥特说，十月对于本季的第一场飓风来说已经很晚了，而这种突出的厄尔尼诺天气模式让许多人相信他们已经摆脱了最糟糕的情况。预报员预测东南部将出现严重天气，包括潜在的山洪和龙卷风。但他们表示，预计风暴将迅速移动并失去其热带强度。

paras.en: Ukraine has launched a new offensive against Russian invaders that employs advanced technology. Operation Vivaldi involves Ukrainian soldiers using electronic warfare and aerial drones to blind Russian reconnaissance and eliminate their firepower and supply routes. They then deploy unmanned land robots to weaken Russian positions. Ukrainians say they have reclaimed around 68 square miles — an area about three times the size of Manhattan.
paras.zh: 乌克兰利用先进技术对俄罗斯入侵者发动了新的攻势。维瓦尔第行动涉及乌克兰士兵使用电子战和无人机来蒙蔽俄罗斯侦察并消除其火力和补给路线。然后他们部署无人陆地机器人来削弱俄罗斯的阵地。乌克兰人表示，他们已经开垦了约 68 平方英里的土地，面积约为曼哈顿面积的三倍。

paras.en: - 🎧 This operation is significant because it is unfolding in the Donbas region that Russia has sought to control since 2014, NPR's Joanna Kakissis says. Despite occupying much of the area, Russia demands Ukraine cede the rest in any peace deal, which Ukraine has rejected. Operation Vivaldi demonstrates that a complete Russian takeover of Donbas is not inevitable, and Ukrainian forces can still achieve breakthroughs in a battlefield dense with drones, Kakissis says. Russia continues its attacks on Ukrainian cities, especially in the east. A recent strike on a public bus in Kramatorsk, one of the last Ukrainian-held cities, killed at least 30 people and injured many others, according to local authorities.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的乔安娜·卡基西斯 (Joanna Kakissis) 表示，此次行动意义重大，因为它正在俄罗斯自 2014 年以来一直寻求控制的顿巴斯地区展开。尽管占领了该地区的大部分地区，俄罗斯仍要求乌克兰在任何和平协议中放弃其余地区，但乌克兰拒绝了这一要求。卡基西斯说，维瓦尔第行动表明，俄罗斯完全接管顿巴斯并非不可避免，乌克兰军队仍然可以在无人机密集的战场上取得突破。俄罗斯继续袭击乌克兰城市，特别是东部城市。据地方当局称，克拉马托尔斯克是乌克兰最后控制的城市之一，最近一辆公共汽车发生罢工，造成至少 30 人死亡，多人受伤。

paras.en: President Trump announced on social media that the U.S. will not attack Iran before the midterm elections on Nov. 3. He is aiming to counter reports suggesting the White House is considering airstrikes against Iran before election day.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统在社交媒体上宣布，美国不会在11月3日中期选举之前攻击伊朗。他的目的是反驳有关白宫考虑在选举日之前对伊朗进行空袭的报道。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump's announcement is a bit surprising because ideally, he wouldn't want to make those kinds of promises during a war, NPR's Domenico Montanaro says. He adds that the president's post signals his awareness that the conflict has been politically bad for his party ahead of elections. More strikes and deeper involvement in the conflict are a tough sell to the American public, including his own base. Despite promising to avoid foreign entanglements, Trump has argued that the prolonged, unpopular war is necessary to prevent Iran from having a nuclear weapon.
paras.zh: - 🎧 特朗普的声明有点令人惊讶，因为理想情况下，他不想在战争期间做出此类承诺，NPR 的多梅尼科·蒙塔纳罗表示。他补充说，总统的帖子表明他意识到选举前的冲突在政治上对他的政党不利。对于包括他自己的支持者在内的美国公众来说，更多的罢工和更深入地参与冲突是很难接受的。尽管承诺避免卷入外国事务，特朗普仍辩称，为了防止伊朗拥有核武器，这场旷日持久、不受欢迎的战争是必要的。

paras.en: At least one U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer fired seven rounds during an immigration enforcement operation in New York City yesterday. The officer struck a 28-year-old immigrant from the Dominican Republic in the neck, according to NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch. The man, identified by Tisch as Oscar Belgal, was shot below his left ear and arrived at NewYork-Presbyterian Allen Hospital in stable condition. A 5-year-old boy, believed to be Belgal's son, was inside Belgal's vehicle during the incident. Police later located the child safe and in the care of a family member. The Department of Homeland Security confirmed that Belgal was the target of the operation, but did not explain why the officer fired his weapon. (via Gothamist)
paras.zh: 昨天，至少一名美国移民和海关执法人员在纽约市的一次移民执法行动中开了七枪。纽约市警察局局长杰西卡·蒂施 (Jessica Tisch) 表示，这名警察击中了一名来自多米尼加共和国的 28 岁移民的颈部。蒂什确认这名男子名叫奥斯卡·贝尔加尔（Oscar Belgal），他左耳以下中弹，被送往纽约长老会艾伦医院，情况稳定。事件发生时，一名 5 岁男孩在 Belgal 的车内，据信是 Belgal 的儿子。警方随后安全找到了孩子，并由一名家庭成员照顾。美国国土安全部证实贝尔加尔是这次行动的目标，但没有解释这名警官开枪的原因。 （来自哥谭主义者）

paras.en: Check out what NPR is watching, reading and listening to this weekend:
paras.zh: 看看 NPR 本周末正在观看、阅读和收听的节目：

paras.en: 🍿 Movies: Oscar-winning documentarian Alex Gibney spent four years researching tech billionaire Elon Musk by reviewing extensive documents and interviewing people close to him. The nearly four-hour film, Musk, is in theaters today ahead of its HBO release.
paras.zh: 🍿 电影：奥斯卡获奖纪录片导演亚历克斯·吉布尼 (Alex Gibney) 花了四年时间研究科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk)，查阅了大量文件并采访了与他关系密切的人。这部时长近四个小时的电影《马斯克》今天在 HBO 上映前已在影院上映。

paras.en: 📺 TV: Netflix's East of Eden, starring Florence Pugh, offers an epic retelling of an American classic that provides a fresh perspective, Pop Culture Happy Hour says.
paras.zh: 📺 电视：流行文化欢乐时光表示，Netflix 的《伊甸之东》由弗洛伦斯·普 (Florence Pugh) 主演，以全新的视角重新讲述了一部美国经典之作。

paras.en: 📚 Books: It's time to say goodbye to beach reads and welcome cozy autumn books. NPR's Book of the Day host Andrew Limbong shares 10 exciting books coming this fall, featuring titles from Barbara Kingsolver, Chad Harbach, Jasmine Guillory and more.
paras.zh: 📚 书籍：是时候告别海滩阅读，迎来舒适的秋季书籍了。 NPR 每日一书主持人安德鲁·林邦 (Andrew Limbong) 分享了今年秋季即将推出的 10 本令人兴奋的书籍，其中包括芭芭拉·金索尔弗 (Barbara Kingsolver)、查德·哈巴赫 (Chad Harbach)、茉莉花·盖尔利 (Jasmine Guillory) 等人的作品。

paras.en: 🎵 Music: Troye Sivan's She's The Best explores darker feelings with a mix of gloom and bright, bombastic moments, all while continuing to honor the legacy of queer dance floors in his music videos, NPR Music's Isabella Gomez Sarmiento says.
paras.zh: 🎵 音乐：NPR Music 的伊莎贝拉·戈麦斯·萨米恩托 (Isabella Gomez Sarmiento) 表示，特洛伊·希文 (Troye Sivan) 的《She's The Best》探索了黑暗的情感，混合了阴郁和明亮、夸张的时刻，同时继续在他的音乐视频中向酷儿舞池的传统致敬。

paras.en: 🎭 Theater: In the Broadway play School Girls; or, the African Mean Girls Play, the ladies at Aburi Girls' Boarding School navigate difficult lessons through their friendships, conflicts and the upcoming Miss Ghana 1986 beauty pageant. Playwright Jocelyn Bioh and director Whitney White join It's Been A Minute host Brittany Luse to discuss the story's significance.
paras.zh: 🎭 剧院：在百老汇演出《女学生》；或者，《非洲贱女孩戏剧》中，阿布里女子寄宿学校的女士们通过她们的友谊、冲突和即将到来的 1986 年加纳小姐选美比赛来应对艰难的课程。剧作家乔斯林·比奥和导演惠特尼·怀特与《It's Been A Minute》主持人布列塔尼·卢斯一起讨论这个故事的意义。

paras.en: - The Norwegian Nobel Committee has awarded this year's Nobel Peace Prize to human rights lawyer Navanethem "Navi" Pillay. Pillay, who has served as the U.N. human rights chief and a judge on the International Court of Justice, was recognized for her contributions to international justice.
paras.zh: - 挪威诺贝尔委员会将今年的诺贝尔和平奖授予人权律师纳瓦尼特姆·“纳维”·皮莱。皮莱曾担任联合国人权事务主管和国际法院法官，因其对国际正义的贡献而受到认可。

paras.en: - Three astronauts and a cosmonaut from NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 mission have returned to Earth after an almost eight-month trip to the International Space Station, where they conducted spacewalks, science experiments and research.
paras.zh: - 来自 NASA SpaceX Crew-12 任务的三名宇航员和一名宇航员在国际空间站进行了近八个月的太空行走、科学实验和研究后返回地球。

paras.en: - New research reveals surprising similarities in the gut microbiomes of Tanzanian hunter-gatherers and Bolivian horticulturalists, suggesting that their microbial kinship dates back long before human migration separated their ancestors.
paras.zh: - 新的研究揭示了坦桑尼亚狩猎采集者和玻利维亚园艺学家的肠道微生物组惊人的相似性，这表明他们的微生物亲缘关系可以追溯到人类迁徙将他们的祖先分开之前很久。

articles.title: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
articles.author: Gabrielle Emanuel

paras.en: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在报告实验室工作人员死亡事件时遵守规则吗？

paras.en: A 28-year-old woman died in Russia last week and, since then, speculations about the case have ricocheted around the globe.
paras.zh: 上周，一名 28 岁女性在俄罗斯死亡，此后，有关此案的猜测在全球范围内广泛流传。

paras.en: The woman was a lab technician at a Russian research institute that studies the plague. As unverified rumors have circulated that she may have contracted the disease from a lab leak, President Trump, the World Health Organization and other leaders are asking for more information.
paras.zh: 这名妇女是俄罗斯一家研究鼠疫的研究所的实验室技术员。由于未经证实的传言称她可能因实验室泄漏而感染了这种疾病，特朗普总统、世界卫生组织和其他领导人正在要求提供更多信息。

paras.en: Russia has insisted this is not a health emergency and stated that its health authorities have not found dangerous pathogens in any of the deceased woman's contacts.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯坚称这不是突发卫生事件，并表示其卫生当局尚未在死者的任何接触者中发现危险病原体。

paras.en: But there are still far more questions than answers.
paras.zh: 但问题仍然多于答案。

paras.en: That uncertainty has global leaders and health experts turning to a law that obligates countries, including Russia, to share exactly this type of information. It's called the International Health Regulations or IHR.
paras.zh: 这种不确定性促使全球领导人和卫生专家求助于一项法律，该法律要求包括俄罗斯在内的各国有义务共享此类信息。它被称为《国际卫生条例》或 IHR。

paras.en: On Wednesday, at a WHO press conference, Director General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus invoked IHR as the best way to determine current situation in Russia and determine the appropriate response.
paras.zh: 周三，在世卫组织新闻发布会上，总干事谭德塞援引《国际卫生条例》作为确定俄罗斯当前局势并确定适当应对措施的最佳方式。

paras.en: "We don't yet have the full picture of this event," he said. "Timely, complete and transparent information sharing under the international regulations is essential to clarify conflicting reports and enable an accurate assessment of potential public health risks."
paras.zh: “我们还没有全面了解这一事件，”他说。 “根据国际法规及时、完整和透明的信息共享对于澄清相互矛盾的报告并准确评估潜在的公共卫生风险至关重要。”

paras.en: Here are the key things to know about the IHR and how it applies in today's world.
paras.zh: 以下是有关《国际卫生条例》及其在当今世界如何应用的关键知识。

paras.en: This law requires countries to share health information that could have international implications. It goes way back to the 1850s with cholera outbreaks in Europe, which led to the creation of guidelines for sharing disease information.
paras.zh: 该法律要求各国共享可能产生国际影响的健康信息。这可以追溯到 1850 年代，当时欧洲爆发了霍乱，从而制定了共享疾病信息的指南。

paras.en: "That's very, very long for international law," says Alexandra Phelan, an associate professor at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health and senior scholar at the Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security. "Look at the negotiation documents and they're debating: Is cholera caused by a bacteria or miasma [a bad smell]? Like we're really right in the middle of germ theory."
paras.zh: “这对于国际法来说是非常非常长的，”约翰·霍普金斯大学布隆伯格公共卫生学院副教授、约翰·霍普金斯大学健康安全中心的高级学者亚历山德拉·费兰说。 “看看谈判文件，他们正在争论：霍乱是由细菌还是瘴气（难闻的气味）引起的？就像我们真的处于细菌理论的中间一样。”

paras.en: Then, when WHO was founded in 1948, these regulations — then called the International Sanitary Regulations — were adopted. That was one of the organization's first moves. The law has since been amended and updated, most notably after the SARS or Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome outbreak in 2003 and most recently due to COVID-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: 随后，1948 年世界卫生组织成立时，这些法规（当时称为《国际卫生条例》）获得通过。这是该组织的首批举措之一。此后，该法律进行了修订和更新，尤其是在 2003 年 SARS 或严重急性呼吸系统综合症爆发之后，以及最近由于 COVID-19 大流行而导致的法律。

paras.en: A country is supposed to notify WHO if the health event has the potential to cause an international health emergency.
paras.zh: 如果卫生事件有可能导致国际卫生紧急情况，一个国家应该通知世界卫生组织。

paras.en: Today, IHR is among the most widely ratified international treaties, with 197 signatories including the U.S. and Russia. (Even though the Trump administration says it has withdrawn from WHO, the U.S. is still bound by the IHR with the exception of some recent amendments.)
paras.zh: 如今，《国际卫生条例》是获得最广泛批准的国际条约之一，有 197 个签署国，其中包括美国和俄罗斯。 （尽管特朗普政府表示已退出世卫组织，但除最近的一些修正案外，美国仍然受到《国际卫生条例》的约束。）

paras.en: One of the core obligations in the law "is that parties or states must notify WHO within 24 hours of detecting a [serious health] event," explains Phelan.
paras.zh: 费兰解释说，该法律的核心义务之一“是各方或国家必须在发现[严重健康]事件后 24 小时内通知世界卫生组织”。

paras.en: Some events – like a case of smallpox or a new type of influenza — should immediately trigger a notification. For other situations, a checklist helps a country assess whether notification is needed.
paras.zh: 某些事件（例如天花或新型流感病例）应立即触发通知。对于其他情况，清单可以帮助国家评估是否需要通知。

paras.en: Each year, she says, WHO receives thousands of notifications from all over the world and most turn out to be nothing.
paras.zh: 她说，世卫组织每年都会收到来自世界各地的数千份通知，但大多数都没有结果。

paras.en: Some people fear the Russian woman — who died Oct. 2 — had pneumonic plague. That's one of the diseases "explicitly listed" under IHR, says Phelan, as something to assess and notify the WHO.
paras.zh: 有些人担心这位 10 月 2 日去世的俄罗斯妇女患有肺鼠疫。费兰说，这是《国际卫生条例》“明确列出”的疾病之一，需要评估并通知世界卫生组织。

paras.en: However, Russia did not notify WHO about this woman's death. Instead, WHO learned about it through media reports and then, on Oct. 3, went to Russia seeking verification and additional information.
paras.zh: 不过，俄罗斯并未将这名妇女的死亡通知世界卫生组织。相反，世卫组织通过媒体报道了解到这一情况，然后于 10 月 3 日前往俄罗斯寻求核实和更多信息。

paras.en: "Russia's response, firstly, was delayed," says Phelan. "But also it wasn't comprehensive."
paras.zh: “首先，俄罗斯的反应被推迟了，”费兰说。 “但它也不全面。”

paras.en: It took Russia several days to respond. On Oct. 6, health officials told WHO there were no cases of plague in the region and that the woman was hospitalized with severe pneumonia of unknown origin before she died. They also explained that health authorities had placed about 200 contacts in quarantine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯花了几天时间才做出回应。 10月6日，卫生官员告诉世卫组织，该地区没有鼠疫病例，该妇女死前因不明原因的严重肺炎住院。他们还解释说，卫生当局已对约 200 名接触者进行了隔离。

paras.en: WHO asked Russia for more information, including about lab tests conducted, public health measures and the health status of the woman's contacts. However, as with many international laws, there's no mechanism to make countries comply with the law and share information.
paras.zh: 世卫组织要求俄罗斯提供更多信息，包括进行的实验室检测、公共卫生措施以及该妇女接触者的健康状况。然而，与许多国际法一样，没有任何机制可以让各国遵守法律并共享信息。

paras.en: Phelan says the next few days and weeks will be key in understanding how much information Russia is going to share. If they aren't fully transparent, she hopes pressure from other countries either convinces Russia to comply with IHR or, at least, helps keep up the norm of other countries respecting IHR and notifying WHO about future health events.
paras.zh: 费兰表示，接下来的几天和几周对于了解俄罗斯将分享多少信息至关重要。如果它们不完全透明，她希望来自其他国家的压力要么说服俄罗斯遵守《国际卫生条例》，要么至少有助于保持其他国家尊重《国际卫生条例》并向世卫组织通报未来卫生事件的规范。

paras.en: That kind of notification is critical if the world is to be ready to respond and contain future outbreaks, says Lawrence Gostin, who directs the WHO Center on Global Health Law and is a professor at Georgetown University.
paras.zh: 世卫组织全球卫生法中心主任、乔治城大学教授劳伦斯·戈斯汀表示，如果世界要做好应对和遏制未来疫情爆发的准备，这种通知至关重要。

paras.en: "This case shows the good, the bad and the ugly of the IHR," he says.
paras.zh: “这个案例展示了《国际卫生条例》的好处、坏处和丑陋之处，”他说。

paras.en: "Legally, this is the only thing that's holding Russia to account," Gostin explains. And yet, "you have countries that are hiding the ball."
paras.zh: “从法律上讲，这是唯一让俄罗斯承担责任的事情，”戈斯汀解释道。然而，“有些国家正在隐藏球。”

paras.en: He believes that the risk to the general population from the current situation in Russia is likely very low. But, for him, the fact that countries can disregard the IHR notification requirements is a "blaring siren about how unprepared we are" to quickly control health threats.
paras.zh: 他认为，俄罗斯目前的局势对普通民众造成的风险可能非常低。但对他来说，各国可以无视《国际卫生条例》通知要求的事实是“一个响亮的警报，表明我们在快速控制健康威胁方面没有做好准备”。

articles.title: Who is Navi Pillay? Nobel Peace Prize winner's UN record renews fierce antisemitism accusations

paras.en: The decision to award the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize to former U.N. human rights chief Navi Pillay sparked fierce backlash Friday from Jewish advocacy groups and U.N. watchdogs accusing the South African jurist of longstanding anti-Israel bias and defending antisemitic rhetoric.
paras.zh: 周五，将 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖授予前联合国人权事务高级专员纳维·皮莱的决定引发了犹太倡导团体和联合国监督机构的强烈反对，他们指责这位南非法学家长期存在反以色列偏见，并为反犹太主义言论辩护。

paras.en: The Norwegian Nobel Committee honored Pillay, 85, for her contributions to international law and efforts to hold perpetrators of war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide accountable.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔委员会向 85 岁的皮莱授予荣誉，表彰她对国际法的贡献以及追究战争罪、反人类罪和种族灭绝罪肇事者责任的努力。

paras.en: But her selection immediately reignited controversies surrounding her leadership of U.N. investigations into Israel, her defense of a fellow commissioner accused of antisemitism and positions she expressed before being appointed to investigate the Jewish state.
paras.zh: 但她的当选立即重新引发了围绕她在联合国以色列调查中的领导地位、她为一名被指控反犹太主义的专员同事的辩护以及她在被任命调查这个犹太国家之前所表达的立场的争议。

paras.en: "Navi Pillay is indeed a world leader – an individual at the forefront of the international spread of the poisonous forms of antisemitism that beset the 21st century," Anne Bayefsky, president of Human Rights Voices and director of the Touro Institute on Human Rights, told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 人权之声主席兼图罗人权研究所所长安妮·巴耶夫斯基 (Anne Bayefsky) 告诉福克斯数字新闻：“纳维·皮莱确实是一位世界领袖，是困扰 21 世纪的有毒反犹太主义国际传播的前沿人物。”

paras.en: Bayefsky accused Pillay of having "perfected the art of perverting legal and universal standards of human rights to demonize and delegitimize Jewish self-determination." "This award stands as a testament to human wrongs," she added.
paras.zh: 巴耶夫斯基指责皮莱“完善了歪曲人权的法律和普遍标准的艺术，以妖魔化和剥夺犹太人自决的合法性”。 “这个奖项证明了人类的错误，”她补充道。

paras.en: The Nobel Committee offered a sharply different assessment of Pillay's legacy, praising her lifelong commitment to international justice and describing her career as an example of courage and integrity in defending the rule of law.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会对皮莱的遗产提出了截然不同的评估，赞扬她一生对国际正义的承诺，并将她的职业生涯描述为捍卫法治的勇气和正直的典范。

paras.en: Born in Durban, South Africa, in 1941, Pillay built her career challenging apartheid-era discrimination, becoming the first non-White woman appointed to South Africa's high court. She later served as a judge at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and the International Criminal Court.
paras.zh: 皮莱 1941 年出生于南非德班，她的职业生涯挑战了种族隔离时代的歧视，成为第一位被任命为南非高等法院法官的非白人女性。她后来担任卢旺达问题国际刑事法庭和国际刑事法院法官。

paras.en: From 2008 to 2014, she served as U.N. High Commissioner for Human Rights. In 2021, she was appointed to chair the U.N. Human Rights Council's open-ended Commission of Inquiry investigating alleged violations in Israel and the Palestinian territories.
paras.zh: 2008年至2014年，她担任联合国人权事务高级专员。 2021年，她被任命为联合国人权理事会不限成员名额调查委员会主席，调查以色列和巴勒斯坦领土上涉嫌侵犯人权的行为。

paras.en: In September 2025, the commission concluded that Israel had committed genocide in Gaza, a finding Israel rejected as politically motivated and biased. The commission's conclusion was not a ruling by an international court.
paras.zh: 2025 年 9 月，委员会得出结论，以色列在加沙犯下了种族灭绝罪，但以色列以出于政治动机和偏见为由拒绝接受这一调查结果。该委员会的结论不是国际法院的裁决。

paras.en: Geneva-based U.N. Watch condemned Friday's Nobel announcement, accusing Pillay of breaching the impartiality expected of international investigators.
paras.zh: 总部位于日内瓦的联合国观察组织谴责周五诺贝尔奖的宣布，指责皮莱违反了国际调查人员所期望的公正性。

paras.en: "We are shocked that the Nobel committee honored Navi Pillay," Executive Director Hillel Neuer said. "Her troubling record on antisemitism and gross breach of ethics in presiding over a notorious UN commission utterly disqualifies her from such an award."
paras.zh: “我们对诺贝尔委员会授予纳维·皮莱荣誉感到震惊，”执行董事希勒尔·诺伊尔说。 “她在反犹太主义方面的令人不安的记录以及在主持臭名昭著的联合国委员会时严重违反道德规范，完全使她失去了获得这一奖项的资格。”

paras.en: Neuer pointed to a June 2020 manifesto that Pillay signed calling on governments to "Sanction Apartheid Israel," along with a June 2021 letter urging President Joe Biden to punish Israel following its conflict with Hamas.
paras.zh: 诺伊尔指出，皮莱签署的 2020 年 6 月宣言呼吁各国政府“制裁种族隔离的以色列”，以及 2021 年 6 月的一封信，敦促总统乔·拜登在以色列与哈马斯发生冲突后惩罚以色列。

paras.en: U.N. Watch argued that the positions raised questions about her impartiality before she accepted the commission's chairmanship in July 2021.
paras.zh: 联合国观察认为，在她于 2021 年 7 月接受委员会主席职务之前，这些职位引发了人们对她公正性的质疑。

paras.en: U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres offered a sharply different assessment Friday, congratulating Pillay on the Nobel Peace Prize and praising her decades-long career in international justice, including her leadership of the U.N. investigation into Israel.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周五提出了截然不同的评估，祝贺皮莱获得诺贝尔和平奖，并赞扬她数十年的国际司法职业生涯，包括她在联合国调查以色列方面的领导。

paras.en: "For decades, she has been a champion of international law and human rights, and a steadfast, independent voice of justice amidst some of the most historic international legal cases of our time," Guterres said in a statement.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯在一份声明中说：“几十年来，她一直是国际法和人权的捍卫者，在我们这个时代一些最具历史意义的国际法律案件中坚定、独立地发出正义的声音。”

paras.en: Guterres highlighted her different roles including chairing the commission investigating Israel and the Palestinian territories, declaring that Pillay had demonstrated "that the force of law must prevail over the law of force and that defending human rights is the surest safeguard against injustice."
paras.zh: 古特雷斯强调了她的不同角色，包括主持调查以色列和巴勒斯坦领土的委员会，并宣称皮莱已经证明“法律的力量必须战胜武力，捍卫人权是防止不公正的最可靠的保障。”

paras.en: Another controversy erupted in 2022 when fellow commissioner Miloon Kothari suggested that social media criticism of the investigation was controlled by the "Jewish lobby" and questioned Israel's U.N. membership.
paras.zh: 2022 年，另一场争议爆发，当时委员委员米隆·科塔里 (Miloon Kothari) 表示，社交媒体对调查的批评是由“犹太游说团体”控制的，并对以色列的联合国会员资格提出质疑。

paras.en: The remarks were condemned by U.S. officials, including then-state department antisemitism envoy Deborah Lipstadt. Pillay defended Kothari, arguing his comments had been taken out of context. Kothari subsequently apologized, calling his language inappropriate and insensitive.
paras.zh: 这一言论遭到美国官员的谴责，其中包括时任国务院反犹太主义特使黛博拉·利普斯塔特。皮莱为科塔里辩护，认为他的言论被断章取义。科塔里随后道歉，称他的语言不恰当且麻木不仁。

paras.en: The controversy also reached Germany, where Berlin's mayor withdrew support for a planned event honoring Pillay in 2022, and the event was canceled, according to The Times of Israel.
paras.zh: 据《以色列时报》报道，这场争议还波及到了德国，德国柏林市长撤回了对计划于 2022 年举行的皮莱纪念活动的支持，该活动也被取消。

paras.en: Bayefsky also recalled the 2009 U.N. anti-racism conference in Geneva, when Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad delivered an inflammatory speech attacking Israel. While Western diplomats walked out, Pillay remained seated.
paras.zh: 巴耶夫斯基还回顾了2009年在日内瓦举行的联合国反种族主义会议，当时伊朗总统内贾德发表了攻击以色列的煽动性演讲。当西方外交官离开时，皮莱仍然坐着。

paras.en: However, Pillay subsequently condemned his address, saying she joined the secretary-general in "utterly deploring the speech," according to the U.N.'s official transcript.
paras.zh: 然而，根据联合国的官方记录，皮莱随后谴责了他的讲话，称她和秘书长一样“对这次讲话表示强烈谴责”。

paras.en: The Nobel Committee, meanwhile, defended Pillay's legacy, crediting her with strengthening international law at a time when the institutions responsible for enforcing it face increasing political pressure.
paras.zh: 与此同时，诺贝尔委员会为皮莱的遗产进行了辩护，称赞她在负责执行国际法的机构面临越来越大的政治压力之际加强了国际法。

paras.en: Pillay's selection highlights the divide between supporters who celebrate her contributions to international justice and critics who contend that her record on Israel undermines the universal human rights principles she championed.
paras.zh: 皮莱的当选突显了支持者和批评者之间的分歧，支持者赞扬她对国际正义的贡献，而批评者则认为她在以色列问题上的记录破坏了她所倡导的普遍人权原则。

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to Pillay for comment but didn’t receive one in time for publication.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字媒体联系了皮莱请其置评，但没有及时收到可以发表的评论。

articles.title: One type of sleep linked to dramatically lower risk of dementia, Parkinson's and 81 other diseases

paras.en: Not all stages of sleep are equal in terms of benefits for the brain.
paras.zh: 并非所有睡眠阶段对大脑的益处都是相同的。

paras.en: Greater amounts of rapid eye movement (REM) sleep were associated with lower risks of 83 diseases, including dementia, Parkinson’s disease and heart failure, new research has shown.
paras.zh: 新研究显示，更多的快速眼动 (REM) 睡眠时间与降低 83 种疾病的风险相关，包括痴呆症、帕金森病和心力衰竭。

paras.en: Additionally, greater amounts of deep sleep were associated with lower risks of seven conditions.
paras.zh: 此外，更多的深度睡眠与七种疾病的风险降低相关。

paras.en: That’s according to a study of 95,559 adults who wore wrist accelerometers continuously for seven consecutive days and nights. Researchers in China used deep-learning algorithms to analyze REM sleep, deep sleep, light sleep, total sleep duration, wakefulness after sleep onset and sleep irregularity.
paras.zh: 这是根据一项对 95,559 名连续 7 天七夜连续佩戴腕部加速度计的成年人进行的研究得出的。中国研究人员使用深度学习算法来分析快速眼动睡眠、深度睡眠、浅度睡眠、总睡眠时长、入睡后觉醒度以及睡眠不规律。

paras.en: They then looked at health records to assess associations with more than 1,000 diseases over a nearly nine-year follow-up period.
paras.zh: 然后，他们在近九年的随访期内查看了健康记录，以评估与 1000 多种疾病的关联。

paras.en: Greater REM sleep was associated with a significantly lower risk of several diseases, including Parkinson’s (80% lower relative risk), dementia (46% lower risk) and heart failure (26% lower risk).
paras.zh: 较多的快速眼动睡眠可显着降低多种疾病的风险，包括帕金森病（相对风险降低 80%）、痴呆症（风险降低 46%）和心力衰竭（风险降低 26%）。

paras.en: Greater deep sleep was associated with lower risks of seven conditions, including type 2 diabetes and major depressive disorder.
paras.zh: 深度睡眠时间越长与七种疾病的风险降低相关，包括 2 型糖尿病和重度抑郁症。

paras.en: Sleep duration was also found to be highly linked to disease outcome. Six to eight hours per night was found to be the "sweet spot" that was associated with the lowest risk for 69 diseases. In contrast, sleeping fewer than five hours per night was linked to an increased risk of 37 health conditions.
paras.zh: 还发现睡眠时间与疾病结果高度相关。研究发现，每晚睡六到八小时是“最佳时间”，与 69 种疾病的风险最低有关。相比之下，每晚睡眠少于 5 小时与 37 种健康状况的风险增加有关。

paras.en: The study also found that greater night-to-night sleep irregularity and more wakefulness during the night were associated with higher risks of several conditions, including anxiety and substance use disorders.
paras.zh: 研究还发现，夜间睡眠不规律和夜间清醒与焦虑和药物滥用等多种疾病的风险较高有关。

paras.en: The findings were published Sept. 17 in the journal PLOS Medicine.
paras.zh: 研究结果于 9 月 17 日发表在《PLOS Medicine》杂志上。

paras.en: "I think what is important is the total duration of sleep, and the percentage that REM takes up," Oki Ishikawa, M.D., pulmonary, critical care and sleep medicine expert at Northwell’s Northern Westchester Hospital, told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: “我认为重要的是睡眠的总持续时间，以及快速眼动睡眠所占的百分比，”诺斯韦尔北威彻斯特医院肺部、重症监护和睡眠医学专家 Oki Ishikawa 医学博士告诉福克斯数字新闻。

paras.en: "The average percentage of REM sleep in this study population was about 20%, and generally 20-25% is considered normal per sleep cycle."
paras.zh: “本研究人群中快速眼动睡眠的平均百分比约为 20%，一般每个睡眠周期 20-25% 被认为是正常的。”

paras.en: Ishikawa, who was not involved in the study, said he does not believe that a higher amount of REM sleep alone will not necessarily lower the risk.
paras.zh: 没有参与这项研究的石川表示，他不认为仅增加快速眼动睡眠时间就不一定会降低风险。

paras.en: "Normal sleep pattern and duration are associated with aspects like maintenance of good immune function and memory, so I think the important message here is to try and get a sufficient amount of sleep in general."
paras.zh: “正常的睡眠模式和持续时间与维持良好的免疫功能和记忆力等方面有关，因此我认为这里重要的信息是总体上尝试获得充足的睡眠。”

paras.en: Disrupted sleep may sometimes be an early warning sign of disease rather than simply a cause, according to Dr. Chelsie Rohrscheib, head sleep expert at Wesper, a sleep analysis company in New York.
paras.zh: 纽约睡眠分析公司 Wesper 的头部睡眠专家 Chelsie Rohrscheib 博士表示，睡眠中断有时可能是疾病的早期预警信号，而不仅仅是一个原因。

paras.en: "Conditions such as Parkinson’s disease, dementia and heart failure can begin affecting sleep years before they are diagnosed," Rohrscheib, who also was not involved in the research, told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: “帕金森病、痴呆症和心力衰竭等疾病可能在确诊前几年就开始影响睡眠，”罗尔沙伊布（也没有参与这项研究）告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。

paras.en: "At the same time, poor sleep may contribute to disease progression, so the relationship likely works both ways."
paras.zh: “与此同时，睡眠不佳可能会导致疾病进展，因此这种关系可能是双向的。”

paras.en: The researchers noted some limitations of the study. Because it was observational, it could only show an association and could not prove that increasing REM or deep sleep directly prevents disease.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出了该研究的一些局限性。由于它是观察性的，因此只能显示关联性，并不能证明增加快速眼动睡眠或深度睡眠可以直接预防疾病。

paras.en: "Sleep was measured for only one week using a wrist device, which is less accurate than a clinical sleep study for identifying sleep stages," Rohrscheib said.
paras.zh: Rohrscheib 说：“使用腕式设备仅测量了一周的睡眠，这不如用于确定睡眠阶段的临床睡眠研究准确。”

paras.en: "Some health information was collected years earlier, medications that can affect sleep were not fully considered, and some medical diagnoses may have been missed."
paras.zh: “一些健康信息是几年前收集的，没有充分考虑可能影响睡眠的药物，并且可能错过了一些医疗诊断。”

paras.en: As the participants were all from the UK Biobank, the study population was also less diverse and generally healthier than the overall population, so the findings may not apply equally to everyone, Rohrscheib noted.
paras.zh: Rohrscheib 指出，由于参与者全部​​来自英国生物银行，因此研究人群的多样性也较低，而且通常比总体人群更健康，因此研究结果可能并不同样适用于所有人。

paras.en: "Overall, changes in sleep may provide important clues about underlying health, but this study cannot determine whether poor sleep is a cause, an early symptom, or both," she concluded.
paras.zh: “总的来说，睡眠的变化可能提供有关潜在健康状况的重要线索，但这项研究无法确定睡眠不佳是一个原因、早期症状还是两者兼而有之，”她总结道。

paras.en: Rohrscheib also cautioned that while wrist-worn sleep trackers are generally good at estimating sleep stages, they are not 100% accurate.
paras.zh: Rohrscheib 还警告说，虽然腕戴式睡眠追踪器通常擅长估计睡眠阶段，但它们并不是 100% 准确。

paras.en: "Without a formal in-lab sleep study, it's impossible to know how much time the participants spent in REM and other sleep stages," she said.
paras.zh: “如果没有正式的实验室睡眠研究，就不可能知道参与者在快速眼动睡眠和其他睡眠阶段花费了多少时间，”她说。

paras.en: More research is needed to determine whether increasing REM or deep sleep can help prevent certain diseases, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，需要更多的研究来确定增加快速眼动睡眠或深度睡眠是否有助于预防某些疾病。

paras.en: "If you get about seven to nine hours of uninterrupted sleep, you most likely have the opportunity to cycle through REM in a sufficient way."
paras.zh: “如果你有大约七到九个小时不间断的睡眠，你很可能有机会以足够的方式进行快速眼动睡眠。”

paras.en: Future studies could also explore whether the relationship between sleep stages and disease risk varies by age, sex, overall health and other individual characteristics.
paras.zh: 未来的研究还可以探讨睡眠阶段与疾病风险之间的关系是否因年龄、性别、整体健康状况和其他个人特征而变化。

paras.en: Both experts recommended following general sleep hygiene practices, such as maintaining an optimal environment (dark, cool and quiet), keeping a consistent sleep schedule, and avoiding sleep-disrupting substances such as alcohol and caffeine.
paras.zh: 两位专家都建议遵循一般睡眠卫生习惯，例如保持最佳环境（黑暗、凉爽和安静）、保持一致的睡眠时间表以及避免酒精和咖啡因等干扰睡眠的物质。

paras.en: "If you have other sleep pathologies like sleep apnea … treating that would be a great way to optimize the amount of REM sleep," Ishikawa advised.
paras.zh: “如果您患有其他睡眠疾病，例如睡眠呼吸暂停……治疗这将是优化快速眼动睡眠时间的好方法，”石川建议。

paras.en: While it can be difficult to measure REM sleep without a wearable, he said the best gauge is whether one feels refreshed upon waking and doesn’t feel sleepy during the day.
paras.zh: 虽然在没有可穿戴设备的情况下很难测量快速眼动睡眠，但他说最好的衡量标准是一个人醒来后是否感觉神清气爽，白天是否感到困倦。

paras.en: "If you get about seven to nine hours of uninterrupted sleep, you most likely have the opportunity to cycle through REM in a sufficient way."
paras.zh: “如果你有大约七到九个小时不间断的睡眠，你很可能有机会以足够的方式进行快速眼动睡眠。”

articles.title: Dem scrambles to change tune on trans athletes as Trump targets past record: ‘Annie Trannie’

paras.en: A South Carolina Democrat running for U.S. Senate who previously opposed legislation restricting transgender athletes' participation in girls' sports is now emphasizing her opposition to biological males participating in female athletics as President Donald Trump targets her record ahead of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 一名竞选美国参议院的南卡罗来纳州民主党人此前反对限制变性运动员参加女子体育运动的立法，现在她强调反对生物学上的男性参加女子体育运动，因为唐纳德·特朗普总统在中期选举前瞄准了她的记录。

paras.en: Trump took aim at Annie Andrews, a pediatrician challenging Republican Sen. Darline Graham, in a series of Truth Social posts this week, dubbing her "Annie Trannie" and accusing her of supporting transgender policies that are out of step with South Carolina voters.
paras.zh: 特朗普本周在一系列《真相社会》帖子中将矛头指向挑战共和党参议员达林·格雷厄姆的儿科医生安妮·安德鲁斯，称她为“安妮·特兰妮”，并指责她支持与南卡罗来纳州选民不一致的变性政策。

paras.en: The president also shared an attack ad accusing Andrews of supporting biological males competing against female athletes. "Annie Andrews is for they/them, not for our values, not for South Carolina," the ad said.
paras.zh: 总统还分享了一则攻击广告，指责安德鲁斯支持生物学上的男性与女性运动员竞争。广告中写道：“安妮·安德鲁斯是为了他们/他们，不是为了我们的价值观，不是为了南卡罗来纳州。”

paras.en: But Andrews pushed back in an interview with Fox News Digital on Thursday, arguing that her positions have been misrepresented.
paras.zh: 但安德鲁斯周四在接受福克斯新闻数字采访时反驳说，她的立场被歪曲了。

paras.en: "I don't support biological men playing in women's sports and I don't support gender surgery on minors," Andrews said.
paras.zh: 安德鲁斯说：“我不支持生理上的男性参加女子运动，也不支持对未成年人进行性别手术。”

paras.en: Her comments stand in contrast to her public opposition to South Carolina's 2022 Save Women’s Sports Act, which restricted transgender athletes' participation in girls' and women's school sports. At the time, Andrews called the legislation "shameful" and "actively harmful," raising questions about how she reconciles her past opposition to the law with her current campaign position.
paras.zh: 她的言论与她公开反对南卡罗来纳州 2022 年《拯救妇女体育法案》形成鲜明对比，该法案限制跨性别运动员参与女童和女子学校运动。当时，安德鲁斯称这项立法“可耻”且“非常有害”，引发了人们对她如何将过去对该法的反对与目前的竞选立场相调和的疑问。

paras.en: As passed, the bill required interscholastic, intercollegiate, intramural and club teams sponsored by public schools and colleges to be designated as male or female-coded. It then closed women’s teams to male students and similarly closed men’s sports to women — unless the school did not have a designated women’s team. Private schools competing against public schools were required to follow the same rules.
paras.zh: 该法案通过后，要求公立学校和学院赞助的校际、校际、校内和俱乐部球队必须指定为男性或女性编码。然后，学校禁止男学生参加女子运动队，同样也禁止女性参加男子运动——除非学校没有指定的女子运动队。与公立学校竞争的私立学校必须遵循相同的规则。

paras.en: It also allowed students harmed by a violation to sue schools.
paras.zh: 它还允许因违规行为而受到伤害的学生起诉学校。

paras.en: Andrews’ social media post at the time garnered resurfaced attention as she launched her 2026 Senate bid, attracting pressure from Republicans.
paras.zh: 安德鲁斯当时在社交媒体上发布的帖子在她发起 2026 年参议员竞选时重新引起人们的关注，吸引了共和党的压力。

paras.en: "Annie "Trannie" Andrews is running against our wonderful Darline Graham for the Senate in South Carolina," Trump wrote in one post.
paras.zh: 特朗普在一篇帖子中写道：“安妮·安德鲁斯正在与我们出色的达林·格雷厄姆竞选南卡罗来纳州参议员。”

paras.en: "Annie Trannie is not, in particular, as it pertains to representing the Values of the Great People of South Carolina — She is in favor of Transgender for Everyone, Open Borders, Defunding the Police, High Taxes, a Weak Military, and will absolutely fight to take your guns away — In other words, she is against our Great Second Amendment! Trannie is not for South Carolina, and South Carolina must show, in the upcoming Election, that it is not for her," Trump added.
paras.zh: “安妮·特兰妮尤其不是，因为它涉及代表南卡罗来纳州伟大人民的价值观——她支持人人变性、开放边界、取消警察经费、高税收、弱军队，并且绝对会为夺走你的枪支而斗争——换句话说，她反对我们伟大的第二修正案！特兰妮不适合南卡罗来纳州，而南卡罗来纳州必须在即将到来的选举中表明，这不适合她，”特朗普补充道。

paras.en: In her interview with Fox New Digital, Andrews dismissed Trump's barb, calling it a distraction from the issues central to voters in South Carolina.
paras.zh: 在接受福克斯新数字频道采访时，安德鲁斯驳斥了特朗普的倒刺，称其分散了对南卡罗来纳州选民核心问题的注意力。

paras.en: "And in regards to the name-calling, if calling me names is going to lower gas and diesel prices here for so many hardworking South Carolinian families, if it’s going to lower grocery prices or somehow make healthcare more affordable then he can call me all the names he wants but I don’t think that’s a path to solution so I’m going to stay focused on what I can do to help folks in South Carolina," Andrews said.
paras.zh: 安德鲁斯说：“至于谩骂，如果谩骂我会降低南卡罗来纳州许多勤劳家庭的汽油和柴油价格，如果这会降低杂货价格或以某种方式让医疗保健变得更便宜，那么他可以随心所欲地谩骂我，但我不认为这是解决问题的途径，所以我将继续专注于我能做些什么来帮助南卡罗来纳州的人们。”

paras.en: Andrews did not immediately respond to additional requests for comment on whether her statements reflected a change in stance. She also did not expand on what had drawn criticism for the Save Women’s Sports Act.
paras.zh: 安德鲁斯没有立即回应关于她的言论是否反映立场变化的其他评论请求。她也没有详细说明《拯救妇女体育法案》招致批评的原因。

paras.en: At least one Republican onlooker, National Republican Senatorial Regional Press Secretary Nick Puglia, believes her remarks speaks poorly of the message she's presenting to voters.
paras.zh: 至少一位共和党旁观者、全国共和党参议员地区新闻秘书尼克·普利亚认为，她的言论并没有体现出她向选民传达的信息。

paras.en: "Annie Andrews' blatant lies show just how desperate she is and how little she thinks of South Carolinians. But nothing Andrews says or does will change her far-left record," Puglia said in a comment.
paras.zh: 普利亚在评论中说：“安妮·安德鲁斯公然的谎言表明她是多么绝望，以及她对南卡罗来纳州人的看法是多么渺小。但安德鲁斯所说或所做的一切都不会改变她的极左记录。”

paras.en: This isn't the first time Andrews has received Republican criticisms for what they view as retreats from trans policies. In 2022, Rep. Nancy Mace, R-S.C., called out Andrews for, in her view, trying to walk back her opposition to H. 4047, a bill that would "prohibit the performance of a medical procedure or the prescription or issuance of medication, upon or to a minor, that is intended to alter the appearance of the minor's gender or delay puberty, with exceptions; to create criminal penalties; and for other purposes."
paras.zh: 这并不是安德鲁斯第一次受到共和党人的批评，因为他们认为安德鲁斯在跨性别政策上的倒退。 2022 年，南卡罗来纳州共和党众议员南希·梅斯 (Nancy Mace) 呼吁安德鲁斯收回她对 H. 4047 的反对意见，该法案将“禁止对未成年人实施旨在改变未成年人性别或延迟青春期的医疗程序或处方或发放药物（例外情况除外）；设立刑事处罚；以及用于其他目的”。

paras.en: Andrews said she opposed the bill in a post to X, calling it "dangerous," only to later to say that she opposed trans procedures for minors.
paras.zh: 安德鲁斯表示，她在发给 X 的帖子中反对该法案，称其“危险”，但后来又表示她反对对未成年人进行变性手术。

paras.en: "She called the legislation to ban that kind of surgery dangerous. She called that legislation an attack on our youth. And it wasn't until we called her out on it that she decided that she's now not for something that she was very publicly in support of just last year. And so it's really hard to play hide and seek from your public comments, because once you tweet it, it's on their public record forever. And that's how we discovered it," Mace told Fox News Digital at the time.
paras.zh: “她称禁止这种手术的立法是危险的。她称这项立法是对我们年轻人的攻击。直到我们大声疾呼，她才决定不再支持去年她还公开支持的事情。因此，很难从公众评论中捉迷藏，因为一旦你在推特上发布了它，它就会永远记录在他们的公共记录中。这就是我们发现它的方式，”梅斯当时告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。

paras.en: Notably, she isn’t the only Democrat who in recent weeks has received attention for seeming shifts in her position over transgender policies. Fellow Democrats like Rep. Marcy Kaptur, D-Ohio, Rep. Don Davis, D-N.C., and Sarah Trone Garriott, a congressional candidate in Iowa, have all been forced to reiterate their positions as Republicans have highlighted their records on the subject.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，她并不是最近几周唯一一位因跨性别政策立场似乎发生转变而受到关注的民主党人。俄亥俄州民主党众议员马西·卡普图尔 (Marcy Kaptur)、北卡罗来纳州民主党众议员唐·戴维斯 (Don Davis) 和爱荷华州国会候选人莎拉·特隆·加里奥特 (Sarah Trone Garriott) 等民主党同僚都被迫重申自己的立场，因为共和党人强调了他们在这一问题上的记录。

paras.en: In Kaptur’s case, she described how she had "voted with Republicans to keep transgender ideology out of our schools" despite voting against a women’s sports bill. Similarly, Davis voted "present" on that same women’s bill while later claiming that women should have "safe and fair space" in sports. And Garriott, who cast a vote against a ban on biological men in women’s locker rooms, clarified her stance earlier this year, stating that "I oppose letting men in women’s locker rooms."
paras.zh: 在卡普图尔的案例中，她描述了她如何“与共和党人一起投票，将跨性别意识形态排除在我们的学校之外”，尽管她投票反对一项女子体育法案。同样，戴维斯对同一项女性法案投了“出席”票，随后又声称女性应该在体育运动中拥有“安全和公平的空间”。加里奥特投票反对禁止生身男性进入女性更衣室，她在今年早些时候澄清了自己的立场，表示“我反对让男性进入女性更衣室”。

paras.en: Those statements reflect broader trends in public opinion showing consensus on trans athlete policies.
paras.zh: 这些声明反映了公众舆论的更广泛趋势，显示了对跨性别运动员政策的共识。

paras.en: Recently, the Pew Research Center found in a Aug. 11 report that 73% of respondents were "not at all" or "not too" comfortable with "athletes competing on sports teams that do not match their sex at birth," compared to just 13% that replied that they were "extremely" or "very" comfortable with the idea. Similarly, 66% of participants said they would support laws or policies requiring trans athletes to compete on teams that match their biological sex compared to 15% who said they would oppose such policies.
paras.zh: 最近，皮尤研究中心在 8 月 11 日的一份报告中发现，73% 的受访者对“运动员参加与出生性别不匹配的运动队比赛”感到“一点也不”或“不太”舒服，而只有 13% 的人回答说他们对这个想法“非常”或“非常”舒服。同样，66% 的参与者表示他们会支持要求跨性别运动员参加与其生理性别相匹配的团队比赛的法律或政策，而 15% 的参与者表示他们会反对此类政策。

paras.en: With just four weeks left to address criticisms over her views, Andrews now heads to South Carolina’s general election on Nov. 3., having cleared the state's Democratic primary earlier this year in June.
paras.zh: 安德鲁斯在今年 6 月初通过了该州的民主党初选后，现在只剩下 4 周时间来回应对其观点的批评，现在她将前往 11 月 3 日举行的南卡罗来纳州大选。

articles.title: US imposes sanctions on ICC, hours after former judge Pillay wins Nobel peace prize – as it happened
articles.author: Jakub Krupa (now and earlier) and Martin Belam (earlier)

paras.en: Pillay dedicates award to 'survivors of international crimes'
paras.zh: 皮莱将奖项献给“国际罪行的幸存者”

paras.en: Navi Pillay has begun giving a press conference after the declaration that she has won this year’s Nobel Peace prize. She began by saying she dedicates the award to “survivors of international crimes”.
paras.zh: 纳维·皮莱在宣布获得今年的诺贝尔和平奖后开始举行新闻发布会。她首先表示，将该奖项献给“国际犯罪的幸存者”。

paras.en: She called on people to stand together in the defence of rule of law.
paras.zh: 她呼吁人们团结起来，捍卫法治。

paras.en: Her win was widely celebrated by senior judges and human right campaigners, who offered their congratulations (11:33, 12:06, 12:17, 12:21, 13:22, 15:25), including the president of the international court of justice, of which she is a former judge (12:58).
paras.zh: 她的胜利受到高级法官和人权活动人士的广泛庆祝，他们纷纷表示祝贺（11:33、12:06、12:17、12:21、13:22、15:25），其中包括她担任前法官的国际法院院长（12:58）。

paras.en: But Israel reacted angrily to the award, saying that “it’s the grotesque weaponisation of an award to legitimise anti-Israel hatred and prejudice” (13:52).
paras.zh: 但以色列对该奖项做出了愤怒的反应，称“这是一个荒诞的武器化奖项，旨在使反以色列的仇恨和偏见合法化”（13:52）。

paras.en: US president Donald Trump also reposted a critical comment saying the Nobel committee “shamed itself beyond repair and demeaned” the prize (16:06).
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普还转发了一条批评评论，称诺贝尔委员会“使自己蒙羞至无可挽回，并贬低了该奖项”(16:06)。

paras.en: Just hours after the announcement, which was explicitly meant as the Nobel Committee’s backing for the international court of justice, the US has imposed sanctions on the court(16:20).
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会明确表示对国际法院的支持，宣布这一消息几个小时后，美国就对该法院实施了制裁(16:20)。

paras.en: If you have any tips, comments or suggestions, email me at jakub.krupa@theguardian.com.
paras.zh: 如果您有任何提示、意见或建议，请发送电子邮件至 jakub.krupa@theguardian.com。

paras.en: I am also on Bluesky at @jakubkrupa.bsky.social and on X at @jakubkrupa.
paras.zh: 我还在 Bluesky 上@jakubkrupa.bsky.social 和 X 上@jakubkrupa。

paras.en: Why the EU is failing to act on growing public criticism of Israel? - analysis
paras.zh: 为什么欧盟未能对以色列日益增长的公众批评采取行动？ - 分析

paras.en: When the British government announced sweeping sanctions on trade with illegal Israeli settlements and condemned “ethnic cleansing” in the West Bank by state-backed “settler terrorists”, some EU diplomats hoped this dramatic shift in UK government policy towards Israel would have a galvanising effect on the rest of Europe. So far, it has not.
paras.zh: 当英国政府宣布对与以色列非法定居点的贸易实施全面制裁，并谴责国家支持的“定居者恐怖分子”在约旦河西岸进行“种族清洗”时，一些欧盟外交官希望英国政府对以色列政策的这一巨大转变将对欧洲其他国家产生激励作用。到目前为止，还没有。

paras.en: Although France and Canada joined the UK in pledging to ban goods from illegal settlements and impose sanctions on “those who facilitate them or profit from them”, there has not yet been a wider ripple effect.
paras.zh: 尽管法国和加拿大与英国一起承诺禁止非法定居点的货物，并对“为非法定居点提供便利或从中获利的人”实施制裁，但尚未产生更广泛的连锁反应。

paras.en: A meeting of EU foreign affairs ministers on Monday is likely to showcase the bloc’s stasis in policy towards Israel – a stalemate that is at odds with rising public criticism in Europe of Israel’s government.
paras.zh: 周一举行的欧盟外交部长会议可能会展示欧盟对以色列政策的停滞 — — 这种僵局与欧洲公众对以色列政府日益增长的批评相矛盾。

paras.en: A survey of 10 European countries, including Spain, France and Sweden, found large majorities of people had a negative opinion of Israel. Views had become more negative compared with the previous year, according to the Pew Research Center, mostly after the start of the US-Israeli war on Iran, which unleashed a new crisis in the Middle East and a global economic shock. In Poland, negative views jumped eight points to 70% of respondents, in Italy they increased by nine points to 75% and in Germany they also rose by nine points to 73%.
paras.zh: 一项针对西班牙、法国和瑞典等10个欧洲国家的调查发现，绝大多数人对以色列持负面看法。皮尤研究中心的数据显示，与前一年相比，人们的看法变得更加消极，这主要是在美以对伊朗的战争爆发之后，这场战争引发了中东新的危机和全球经济冲击。在波兰，受访者的负面看法上升了 8 个百分点，达到 70%；在意大利，这一数字上升了 9 个百分点，达到 75%；在德国，这一数字也上升了 9 个百分点，达到 73%。

paras.en: Israel is facing ever deeper isolation in the theatre of public opinion. Five countries chose to boycott the Eurovision song contest this year over Israel’s participation, after organisers declined to exclude it over its conduct in the Gaza war and rising violence in the West Bank. Organisers have now decided that broadcasters will no longer be eligible to host the song contest if their state is involved in an armed conflict or sensitive geopolitical situation.
paras.zh: 以色列在舆论舞台上面临着越来越严重的孤立。由于以色列在加沙战争中的行为以及约旦河西岸暴力事件不断升级，组织者拒绝将以色列排除在外，因此五个国家选择抵制今年的欧洲歌唱大赛。组织者现已决定，如果所在州卷入武装冲突或敏感的地缘政治局势，广播公司将不再有资格主办歌曲比赛。

paras.en: More than 74,000 people, including at least 21,200 children, have been killed in Gaza since Israel launched its war in retaliation for the Hamas attack of 7 October 2023, in which the terrorist group killed 1,209 people – including 36 children – and took 251 hostages, inflicting a nationwide trauma.
paras.zh: 自以色列为报复哈马斯 2023 年 10 月 7 日的袭击而发动战争以来，加沙已有超过 74,000 人被杀，其中包括至少 21,200 名儿童。该恐怖组织在这次袭击中杀害了 1,209 人，其中包括 36 名儿童，并劫持了 251 名人质，给全国造成了创伤。

paras.en: Gaza remains a humanitarian catastrophe, with people facing acute shortages of water, nutritious food and medical equipment and medicines, while contending with disease, unemployment, economic collapse and the threat of death or injury. Israel’s airstrikes continue: the death toll includes 1,400 Palestinians killed since a ceasefire was declared a year ago.
paras.zh: 加沙仍然是一场人道主义灾难，人们面临着水、营养食品、医疗设备和药品的严重短缺，同时还要与疾病、失业、经济崩溃和死亡或受伤的威胁作斗争。以色列的空袭仍在继续：自一年前宣布停火以来，死亡人数包括 1,400 名巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: The EU talks on the Middle East will focus on the conflicts in Iran and Yemen, but ministers will also discuss the situation in Gaza and the West Bank in the context of elections in Israel on 27 October and the first legislative elections in Palestine in 20 years, which are expected by late November.
paras.zh: 欧盟关于中东的会谈将重点讨论伊朗和也门的冲突，但部长们还将在10月27日以色列选举和预计在11月底举行巴勒斯坦20年来首次立法选举的背景下讨论加沙和西岸局势。

paras.en: The discussion is expected to expose familiar fault lines in the 27-member EU.One group of countries are vocal supporters of the Palestinian cause: Spain and Ireland were the first to call for a review of whether Israel’s conduct in the Gaza war was in breach of the human rights requirements of its association agreement with the EU, which covers the €68bn (£58bn) trade relationship, cooperation in research, environment and energy.
paras.zh: 此次讨论预计将暴露欧盟 27 个成员国中常见的断层线。有一组国家是巴勒斯坦事业的直言不讳的支持者：西班牙和爱尔兰率先呼吁对以色列在加沙战争中的行为是否违反其与欧盟的联合协议中的人权要求进行审查，该协议涵盖了 680 亿欧元（580 亿英镑）的贸易关系以及研究、环境和能源方面的合作。
