paras.en: A second group consistently opposes targeting Israel’s government: Germany and Austria are close allies for historical reasons, while Czechia and Italy are ideologically aligned with Benjamin Netanyahu’s administration.
paras.zh: 第二个群体一贯反对针对以色列政府：德国和奥地利由于历史原因是亲密盟友，而捷克和意大利在意识形态上与本杰明·内塔尼亚胡政府保持一致。

paras.en: Among a third, larger group of countries in the middle are several, such as France and the Netherlands, that are increasingly critical of the Netanyahu government’s conduct in Gaza and its plans to build the vast E1 settlement, which threatens to critically damage the two-state solution.
paras.zh: 第三个较大的中间国家群体包括法国和荷兰等几个国家，它们对内塔尼亚胡政府在加沙的行为及其修建大型E1定居点的计划越来越批评，这可能严重损害两国解决方案。

paras.en: President Pavel returns from holidays as Czechs go to polls
paras.zh: 捷克总统帕维尔度假归来，捷克人前往投票

paras.en: Czechs go to the polls on Friday at the start of two days of voting to fill one-third of the seats in Parliament’s upper house, the Senate, and elect local representatives, AP reported.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，捷克人将于周五在为期两天的投票开始时进行投票，以填补议会上院和参议院三分之一的席位，并选举地方代表。

paras.en: The elections are the first test for populist billionaire Andrej Babiš since he returned to power after a decisive victory in parliamentary elections in October 2025.
paras.zh: 这次选举是民粹主义亿万富翁安德烈·巴比什 (Andrej Babiš) 自 2025 年 10 月议会选举取得决定性胜利后重新掌权以来面临的首次考验。

paras.en: His centrist ANO (YES) movement hopes to make gains in the 81-seat Senate, which is controlled by pro-western opposition parties. Twenty-seven Senate seats are up for grabs in the two-round election, with runoffs scheduled for next week. First-round results are expected on Saturday.
paras.zh: 他的中间派 ANO (YES) 运动希望在由亲西方反对党控制的参议院 81 个席位中取得进展。两轮选举将争夺 27 个参议院席位，决选定于下周举行。第一轮结果预计将于周六公布。

paras.en: Babiš has formed a governing coalition with two small political groups whose agenda includes reducing support for Ukraine and rejecting some key European Union policies.
paras.zh: 巴比什与两个小政治团体组成了执政联盟，其议程包括减少对乌克兰的支持和拒绝一些关键的欧盟政策。

paras.en: Unlike the government, the opposition and president Petr Pavel remain firm supporters of Ukraine following Russia’s invasion.
paras.zh: 与政府不同的是，在俄罗斯入侵后，反对派和总统彼得·帕维尔仍然是乌克兰的坚定支持者。

paras.en: But Pavel – an avid biker – attracted a lot of attention in the build up to the vote as it emerged that he would miss the vote due to a long-planned motorcycle trip in Morocco. After days of relentless pressure, he eventually cut the holiday short and reported to vote, acknowledging his original “error” in scheduling.
paras.zh: 但帕维尔——一位狂热的自行车手——在投票前吸引了很多关注，因为他因长期计划的摩洛哥摩托车旅行而将错过投票。经过几天的持续压力，他最终缩短了假期并报告投票，承认自己最初在日程安排上的“错误”。

paras.en: “Some mistakes can be corrected relatively easily, others with more difficulty, and some cannot be corrected at all.
paras.zh: “有些错误相对容易纠正，有些错误则比较困难，有些错误根本无法纠正。

paras.en: Fortunately, a mistake in planning can be remedied by changing the plan. Admitting a mistake is not easy, but if a politician values people’s trust, he must prove it.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，计划中的错误可以通过改变计划来纠正。承认错误并不容易，但如果一个政治家重视人民的信任，他就必须证明这一点。

paras.en: I know what responsibility is and that any trust is hard to earn, but terribly easy and quick to lose. You pay for mistakes, and I have learned from this one of my own.”
paras.zh: 我知道什么是责任，也知道任何信任都很难赢得，但失去却非常容易且很快。你要为错误付出代价，我也从这次错误中吸取了教训。”

paras.en: EU grants temporary trade preferences to Armenia after Russian sanctions
paras.zh: 俄罗斯制裁后欧盟给予亚美尼亚临时贸易优惠

paras.en: The European Union is granting temporary trade preferences to Armenia following trade restrictions recently imposed by Russia.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯最近实施贸易限制后，欧盟向亚美尼亚提供临时贸易优惠。

paras.en: In a move which shows how flexible the EU can be, it said the temporary trade preferences “will help alleviate the difficult situation faced by Armenian producers and exporters and support the resilience of Armenia’s economy by facilitating access to the EU market.
paras.zh: 此举显示了欧盟的灵活性，它表示临时贸易优惠“将有助于缓解亚美尼亚生产商和出口商面临的困难局面，并通过促进亚美尼亚进入欧盟市场来支持亚美尼亚经济的弹性。

paras.en: The measures, which will enter into force tomorrow for a period of two years, temporarily allow 80% of Armenian exports to the EU, including almost all exports of fresh fruit, vegetables and flowers affected by the Russian measures, as well as over 91% of exports of beverages and spirits.
paras.zh: 这些措施将于明天生效，为期两年，暂时允许亚美尼亚向欧盟出口80%的产品，其中包括几乎所有受俄罗斯措施影响的新鲜水果、蔬菜和花卉出口，以及超过91%的饮料和烈酒出口。

paras.en: Armenia is not an accession state, but has been singled out for support as part of the EU a broader solidarity support package
paras.zh: 亚美尼亚不是加入国，但作为欧盟更广泛的团结支持计划的一部分，亚美尼亚被挑选出来提供支持

paras.en: Schröder's cosy encounter with Putin sparks outrage in Berlin
paras.zh: 施罗德与普京的亲密会面在柏林引发愤怒

paras.en: The Kremlin’s release of photos showing a cosy fireside encounter between former German chancellor Gerhard Schröder and Russian president Vladimir Putin on the occasion of Putin’s 74th birthday, reportedly at his home in Moscow, has sparked outrage in political Berlin.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发布的照片​​显示，德国前总理格哈德·施罗德与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在普京 74 岁生日之际在莫斯科的家中进行了温馨的炉边会面，此举引发了柏林政治界的愤怒。

paras.en: We understand that Schröder travelled to Moscow for his latest lucrative business role in Russia. In addition to his positions on the advisory boards of various gas companies – which he has retained, refusing to distance himself from Putin despite his punitive war on Ukraine – Schröder, 82, has now reportedly taken up a position as an advisory board member of the Russian retailer Globus, advising on strategy since September and drawing on his influence and extensive network of contacts.
paras.zh: 我们了解到，施罗德前往莫斯科是为了在俄罗斯担任最新的利润丰厚的商业职位。除了在多家天然气公司的顾问委员会中担任职务外（尽管他对乌克兰发动了惩罚性战争，他仍拒绝与普京保持距离，他仍然保留了这些职位），82 岁的施罗德现在据报道担任俄罗斯零售商 Globus 的顾问委员会成员，自 9 月以来一直在提供战略建议，并利用自己的影响力和广泛的人脉网络。

paras.en: The pictures, emphasing the political and personal alliance between the two men, jarred with many in Berlin.
paras.zh: 这些照片强调了两人之间的政治和个人联盟，引起了柏林许多人的不满。

paras.en: Schröder had said in early 2025 that he was too ill to attend a parliamentary inquiry committee into the construction of the Nord Stream 2 gas pipeline between Russia and Germany, citing “burnout”. This is the latest of numerous controversial trips Schröder has taken to Russia, even following the 2022 full invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 施罗德曾于 2025 年初表示，他因病重而无法参加议会调查委员会，以“精疲力竭”为由，对俄罗斯和德国之间的北溪 2 号天然气管道建设进行调查。这是施罗德多次有争议的俄罗斯之行中的最新一次，甚至在 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰之后也是如此。

paras.en: Katrin Göring-Eckardt of the Greens said she was appalled that Schröder had been “too sick” to attend a commission into the Nord Stream 2 pipeline in person, but was able to fly to Moscow. She called the revelation a “shame for Germany” and a “betrayal of Europe”.
paras.zh: 绿党的卡特琳·戈林-埃卡特 (Katrin Göring-Eckardt) 表示，令她感到震惊的是，施罗德“病得太重”，无法亲自参加北溪 2 号管道的调试，但却能够飞往莫斯科。她称这一消息是“德国的耻辱”和“对欧洲的背叛”。

paras.en: Marie-Agnes Strack-Zimmermann, who leads the European parliament’s Committee on Security and Defence called Schröder “Germany’s most brazen pensioner”.
paras.zh: 欧洲议会安全与防务委员会主席玛丽·艾格尼丝·斯特莱克·齐默尔曼称施罗德为“德国最厚颜无耻的养老金领取者”。

paras.en: According to the Kremlin, Putin only learned of Schröder’s presence in Moscow via media outlets, and invited him over to celebrate.
paras.zh: 据克里姆林宫称，普京只是通过媒体得知施罗德来到莫斯科，并邀请他过来庆祝。

paras.en: The two pictures posted by the Kremlin show the two pals in open-necked shirts and jackets – Putin unusually casual in blue jeans – warmly shaking hands in front of a blazing fire, a beaming Schröder placing his left hand on the small of Putin’s back. It’s the height of gemütlichkeit.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发布的两张照片显示，这两个朋友穿着开领衬衫和夹克——普京穿着蓝色牛仔裤，显得异常休闲——在熊熊的火焰前热情地握手，施罗德微笑着将左手放在普京的后背上。这是 gemütlichkeit 的高度。

paras.en: Mawkish fascination draws the eye to the Russian autocrat’s interior design of which we rarely get a glimpse: a traditional ceramic stove, miniature golden rocking horses dotted about the room, a gleaming samovar, soft furnishings in striking traditional patterns, colourful drapes, and intimate niches.
paras.zh: 令人伤感的魅力吸引了人们对这位俄罗斯独裁者的室内设计的关注，而我们很少能一睹其风采：传统的陶瓷炉、房间里点缀着的微型金色摇马、闪闪发光的茶炊、引人注目的传统图案的软家具、色彩缤纷的窗帘和私密的壁龛。

paras.en: These details, along with Putin’s almost shy, sheepish grin in the picture, belie the terror he has come to represent. The image is a PR coup for both, helping Putin prove that Russia is certainly not fully isolated, and showing Schröder’s complete indifference to the fact that his proximity to Putin has shattered his domestic reputation.
paras.zh: 这些细节，再加上普京在照片中几乎害羞、羞涩的笑容，掩盖了他所代表的恐怖。这张照片对双方来说都是公关妙招，帮助普京证明俄罗斯肯定没有完全孤立，并表明施罗德对他与普京的亲密关系破坏了他在国内的声誉这一事实完全漠不关心。

paras.en: (Schröder did eventually testify via video link to the Nord Stream committee in October 2025, where he staunchly defended the pipeline’s construction and the formation of the controversial Climate Protection Foundation but denied Russia had exerted undue pressure on either project or on him.)
paras.zh: （施罗德最终确实于 2025 年 10 月通过视频链接向北溪委员会作证，他坚定地为管道的建设和有争议的气候保护基金会的成立辩护，但否认俄罗斯对项目或他施加了不当压力。）

paras.en: US imposes sanctions on international criminal court, hours after former judge Pillay wins Nobel
paras.zh: 前法官皮莱获得诺贝尔奖数小时后，美国对国际刑事法院实施制裁

paras.en: US president Donald Trump’s administration imposed sanctions on the international criminal court on Friday, hours after one of its former judges won the Nobel Peace Prize, putting Washington on a diplomatic collision course with European allies, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府周五对国际刑事法院实施制裁，就在国际刑事法院一名前法官获得诺贝尔和平奖几个小时后，华盛顿与欧洲盟友陷入了外交冲突。

paras.en: The ICC’s deputy prosecutor, Nazhat Shameem Khan, condemned the sanctions and said they would not halt the tribunal’s work.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院副检察官纳扎特·沙米姆·汗 (Nazhat Shameem Khan) 谴责制裁措施，并表示制裁不会阻止法庭的工作。

paras.en: The Trump administration has long been hostile to the court and has previously imposed sanctions on its prosecutors and judges. Friday’s move would go far further, by potentially punishing companies that provide services to the court itself.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府长期以来对法院怀有敌意，此前曾对其检察官和法官实施制裁。周五的举措将走得更远，可能会惩罚向法院本身提供服务的公司。

paras.en: “President Trump will never allow the international criminal court to prosecute Americans,” secretary of state Marco Rubio said in a statement reviewed by Reuters ahead of the official announcement.
paras.zh: “特朗普总统永远不会允许国际刑事法庭起诉美国人，”国务卿马可·卢比奥在路透社审阅的官方声明之前的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: “That is why, today, the United States is sanctioning the international criminal court. We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate.”
paras.zh: “这就是为什么今天美国正在制裁国际刑事法院。我们将禁止与这个流氓法院进行交易，切断他们的资源并削弱其运作能力。”

paras.en: ICC Deputy Prosecutor Khan told Reuters the sanctions “must be condemned“.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院副检察官汗告诉路透社，制裁“必须受到谴责”。

paras.en: “The sanctions are intended to undermine the rule of law internationally and the work that an independent judicial institution is doing,” Khan said. “Our work will continue across all our situations, our investigations and our prosecutions.“
paras.zh: “制裁的目的是破坏国际法治以及独立司法机构正在开展的工作，”汗说。 “我们的工作将在所有情况、调查和起诉中继续进行。”

paras.en: Washington has long been angry over ICC arrest warrants issued for Israeli officials including prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and over a past investigation into actions of US soldiers in Afghanistan which the ICC has since closed.
paras.zh: 华盛顿长期以来一直对国际刑事法院对包括总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在内的以色列官员发出的逮捕令感到愤怒，并对过去对美国士兵在阿富汗的行动进行的调查感到愤怒，但国际刑事法院现已结束了这项调查。

paras.en: The court, founded in 2002 to prosecute war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide, counts 125 countries as member states, including all EU countries and all members of the Nato alliance apart from the United States and Turkey.
paras.zh: 该法院成立于2002年，旨在起诉战争罪、反人类罪和种族灭绝罪，其成员国有125个，其中包括所有欧盟国家以及除美国和土耳其之外的所有北约成员国。

paras.en: It has received strong public backing in the past from member countries including major US allies, and is based in the Netherlands, an EU and Nato member.
paras.zh: 该组织过去曾获得包括美国主要盟国在内的成员国的强烈公众支持，其总部设在欧盟和北约成员国荷兰。

paras.en: Navi Pillay, the South African jurist who won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday for her work in international criminal justice, served as a judge on the ICC’s Appeals Chamber from 2003-2008. In its citation, the prize committee said it had sought to “issue a reminder” at a time when “judges and institutions of international law are under political attack“.
paras.zh: 南非法学家纳维·皮莱 (Navi Pillay) 于 2003 年至 2008 年担任国际刑事法院上诉分庭法官，周五因其在国际刑事司法方面的工作而获得诺贝尔和平奖。颁奖委员会在颁奖词中表示，它试图在“法官和国际法机构受到政治攻击”之际“发出提醒”。

paras.en: Rubio said the sanctions had been structured to give the court and its member states an opportunity to address US concerns.
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，制裁措施的目的是让法院及其成员国有机会解决美国的担忧。

paras.en: He did not provide further details, but a senior state department official said the US Treasury would issue a set of licenses “to protect American interests“, an apparent reference to temporary exemptions to some sanctions.
paras.zh: 他没有提供更多细节，但国务院一名高级官员表示，美国财政部将颁发一系列许可证“以保护美国利益”，这显然是指暂时豁免某些制裁。

paras.en: US sanctions typically bar all US-based companies from any work with a sanctioned organisation, forcing banks to shut accounts, insurers to end coverage and software companies to halt cooperation.
paras.zh: 美国的制裁通常禁止所有美国公司与受制裁组织合作，迫使银行关闭账户、保险公司终止承保、软件公司停止合作。

paras.en: The Trump administration previously imposed targeted sanctions on court officials during his first term, which were rescinded under President Joe Biden. Washington announced new sanctions just days after Trump returned to office in January 2025.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府此前在其第一任期内对法院官员实施了有针对性的制裁，但在乔·拜登总统领导下取消了这些制裁。特朗普于 2025 年 1 月重返办公室几天后，华盛顿宣布了新的制裁措施。

paras.en: Court officials have been preparing for months for the prospect of sanctions on the court itself, shifting office computers from Microsoft software to open source equivalents and making new arrangements for banking and health insurance.
paras.zh: 几个月来，法院官员一直在为法院本身受到制裁的前景做准备，将办公计算机从微软软件转向开源软件，并对银行和健康保险做出新的安排。

paras.en: The court’s registrar Osvaldo Zavala Giler called earlier this week for the EU to be prepared to use a so-called “blocking mechanism” that lets it shield European countries from the extraterritorial effects of sanctions.
paras.zh: 法院书记官奥斯瓦尔多·萨瓦拉·吉勒本周早些时候呼吁欧盟准备使用所谓的“阻止机制”，以保护欧洲国家免受制裁的域外影响。

paras.en: Trump reposts comments that Nobel committee 'shamed itself beyond repair and demeaned' the prize
paras.zh: 特朗普转发诺贝尔奖委员会“羞辱自己无可挽回并贬低”诺贝尔奖的评论

paras.en: The US president, Donald Trump, who has long wanted to get the Nobel peace prize, is does not appear to be happy with today’s decision.
paras.zh: 一直想获得诺贝尔和平奖的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普似乎对今天的决定并不满意。

paras.en: He is yet to comment on it himself, but on Truth Social he reposted (or re-Truthed?) a comment saying that “the Nobel Committee shamed itself beyond repair and demeaned the once great Nobel Peace Prize by giving it to the UN’s Navi Pillay.”
paras.zh: 他本人尚未对此发表评论，但在《真相社会》上，他转发了（或重新真相化？）一条评论，称“诺贝尔委员会将其授予联合国的纳维·皮莱，使自己蒙羞至无可挽回，并贬低了曾经伟大的诺贝尔和平奖。”

paras.en: “Pillay is an unabashed hater of America and Israel. In her position she celebrated terrorists and rewarded Hamas. She conducted a phony “investigation” claiming to find that Israel committed genocide and urging prosecution. She has no credibility in any normal sphere and has never done a thing to foster peace. Just the opposite. But what could be expected from a committee that previously gave the once coveted peace prize to Yasser Arafat?
paras.zh: “皮莱是一个毫不掩饰的仇恨美国和以色列的人。在她的位置上，她庆祝恐怖分子并奖励哈马斯。她进行了虚假的“调查”，声称发现以色列犯下了种族灭绝罪并敦促起诉。她在任何正常领域都没有信誉，也从未做过任何促进和平的事情。恰恰相反。但是，对于一个先前将曾经令人垂涎的和平奖授予亚西尔·阿拉法特的委员会来说，我们还能指望什么呢？

paras.en: President Trump gave us the Abraham Accords, which the world said would be impossible and is now expanding them! He brought home the hostages when all seemed hopeless! He is making best efforts to end the Russia/Ukraine war, to stop Iran, the number one sponsor of international terrorism, and he is trying to rebuild Gaza despite the terrorists’ best efforts to control it. The list goes on and on. These are the kinds of things the Nobel Peace Prize was intended to recognize and reward!!!@realDonaldTrump.”
paras.zh: 特朗普总统给了我们《亚伯拉罕协议》，全世界都认为这是不可能的，但现在正在扩大这些协议！当一切看起来都毫无希望的时候，他把人质带回家了！他正在尽最大努力结束俄罗斯/乌克兰战争，制止国际恐怖主义的头号赞助者伊朗，并且尽管恐怖分子尽最大努力控制加沙，但他仍在努力重建加沙。这样的例子不胜枚举。这些就是诺贝尔和平奖旨在表彰和奖励的事物！！！@realDonaldTrump。”

paras.en: Pillay’s somewhat mocking comments on Trump (11:53) minutes after she got the award surely didn’t help him accept the verdict either.
paras.zh: 皮莱在获奖几分钟后对特朗普发表了一些嘲讽的评论（11:53），这显然也没有帮助他接受裁决。

paras.en: New EU-China deal could reduce sales of Chinese plug-in hybrids by 'several millions'
paras.zh: 新的欧盟-中国协议可能会使中国插电式混合动力车的销量减少“数百万”

paras.en: Maroš Šefčovič has just revealed that the deal with China could reduce sales of Chinese plug-in hybrid cars by “several million” in the next four years.
paras.zh: Maroš Šefčovič 刚刚透露，与中国的交易可能会使中国插电式混合动力汽车的销量在未来四年内减少“数百万”。

paras.en: “There are different techniques on how you can do these things,” he said without revealing the details.
paras.zh: “有不同的技术可以帮助你完成这些事情，”他说，但没有透露细节。

paras.en: He said he wanted to first present the plan to EU leaders – he will brief ambassadors on Sunday morning ahead of a leaders summit on Thursday.
paras.zh: 他表示，他希望首先向欧盟领导人介绍该计划——他将在周四的领导人峰会之前于周日上午向各国大使通报情况。

paras.en: EU reaches deal with China to 'moderate' sales of hybrid electric cars, Šefčovič says
paras.zh: 舍夫科维奇表示，欧盟与中国达成协议，“限制”混合动力汽车的销售

paras.en: The EU says it has reached a landmark deal with China to “moderate” sales of Chinese hybrid electric cars in the EU.
paras.zh: 欧盟表示，已与中国达成一项具有里程碑意义的协议，“限制”中国混合动力汽车在欧盟的销售。

paras.en: It is global first, EU’s trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič told reporters.
paras.zh: 欧盟贸易专员马罗什·塞夫科维奇 (Maroš Šefčovič) 告诉记者，这是全球首例。

paras.en: The deal “opens the prospect of cutting China’s export [of hybrids] by more than a half”.
paras.zh: 该协议“开启了将中国（混合动力车）出口削减一半以上的前景”。

paras.en: “It is the first time that China has accepted to moderate its exports without going through the prior” trade investigations, said Šefčovič at a press conference in Beijing just now.
paras.zh: 舍夫科维奇刚刚在北京举行的新闻发布会上表示，“这是中国首次同意在不经过事先”贸易调查的情况下限制出口。

paras.en: Šefčovič said the deal on hybrid cars was “very, very hard to accomplish these results”.
paras.zh: Šefčovič 表示，混合动力汽车交易“要取得这些成果非常非常困难”。

paras.en: “This is the result of very intense, work. And it reflects also the appreciation of the situation on both sides. The European car industry is under a lot of stress. And therefore this step was, absolutely crucial. But I think that what we agreed is fair, we, are working in a full compliance, with, WTO, methodology,” he has just told reporters.
paras.zh: “这是非常紧张工作的结果。这也反映了双方对形势的认识。欧洲汽车工业面临很大压力。因此这一步绝对至关重要。但我认为我们达成的协议是公平的，我们正在完全遵守世贸组织的方法，”他刚刚告诉记者。

paras.en: China reaches 'an understanding' with the EU to stop trade tensions
paras.zh: 中国与欧盟达成“谅解”以结束贸易紧张局势

paras.en: China has reached an “understanding” with the EU, to avert deterioration in trade tensions after two days of talks in Beijing, according to a Chinese statement.
paras.zh: 中国声明称，在北京举行为期两天的会谈后，中国已与欧盟达成“谅解”，以避免贸易紧张局势恶化。

paras.en: EU trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič is due to hold a press conference around 3pm CET, but China says the two sides have agreed a 16 point agreement allowing for a relaxation of restrictions on rare earth exports from China to the EU in return for concessions on electric vehicle exports.
paras.zh: 欧盟贸易专员马罗什·塞夫科维奇 (Maroš Šefčovič) 将于欧洲中部时间下午 3 点左右举行新闻发布会，但中国表示，双方已达成一项 16 点协议，允许放宽对中国向欧盟出口稀土的限制，以换取在电动汽车出口方面的让步。

paras.en: China is “willing... to continue facilitating the approval of export licenses for rare earths and permanent magnets destined for the EU”, a statement from the Chinese ministry of commerce has said following two days of talks in Beijing.
paras.zh: 在北京举行为期两天的会谈后，中国商务部发表声明称，中国“愿意……继续推动发往欧盟的稀土和永磁体出口许可证的审批”。

paras.en: While they acknowledged “differences” between them, the two sides were committed to maintaining trade and to hold a further meeting in March.
paras.zh: 虽然他们承认彼此之间存在“分歧”，但双方都致力于维持贸易并在三月份举行进一步会议。

paras.en: China said both sides would adhere to “procedures concerning company price undertakings” of hybrid cars, Beijing’s commerce ministry said, citing a joint statement, suggesting a deal to find minimum prices for hybrid cars exported to the EU.
paras.zh: 北京商务部援引联合声明称，中方表示双方将遵守混合动力汽车“企业价格承诺程序”，并建议达成协议，确定出口到欧盟的混合动力汽车的最低价格。

paras.en: The talks follow months of rising tensions between the 27-nation EU and the Asian powerhouse that threatened to escalate into a trade war.
paras.zh: 此次会谈之前，由 27 个国家组成的欧盟与亚洲强国之间的紧张关系持续数月不断升级，有可能升级为贸易战。

paras.en: Maroš Šefčovič said earlier in the day that the EU’s trade deficit with running at around £1bn a day (€1.18bn) every day was “unsustainable”.
paras.zh: Maroš Šefčovič 当天早些时候表示，欧盟每天约 10 亿英镑（11.8 亿欧元）的贸易逆差“不可持续”。

paras.en: Pillay 'has shown the force of law must prevail over the law of force,' UN's Guterres says
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯表示，皮莱“已经表明法律的效力必须高于武力”

paras.en: UN secretary general António Guterres is the latest to offer his congratulations to Pillay.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯最近向皮莱表示祝贺。

paras.en: “Warm congratulations to Navi Pillay on being awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.
paras.zh: “热烈祝贺纳维·皮莱荣获诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: From her work in South Africa defending Nelson Mandela & others, to her role as an international judge on cases relating to international crimes, including the genocide in Rwanda, to her tenure as High Commissioner for Human Rights, to chairing the @UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, she has shown that the force of law must prevail over the law of force and that defending human rights is the surest safeguard against injustice.
paras.zh: 从她在南非为纳尔逊·曼德拉等人辩护的工作，到她在卢旺达种族灭绝等国际罪行案件中担任国际法官，再到担任人权事务高级专员，再到担任@联合国巴勒斯坦被占领土独立国际调查委员会主席，她表明法律的力量必须战胜武力，捍卫人权是防止不公正的最可靠保障。

paras.en: Today’s prize is a tribute to all those working to uphold & defend international law, the rule of law & human rights, and secure peace, justice & human dignity.”
paras.zh: 今天的奖项是向所有致力于维护和捍卫国际法、法治和人权以及确保和平、正义和人类尊严的人们致敬。”

paras.en: Reuters is carrying a few more of Navi Pillay’s words upon her receipt of the Nobel peace prize. It quotes her warning that mounting political attacks on international law risked returning the world to a system in which “power rather than law determines whose suffering matters.”
paras.zh: 路透社转载了纳维·皮莱 (Navi Pillay) 获得诺贝尔和平奖时的几句话。报告援引她的警告称，对国际法日益增多的政治攻击有可能让世界回到“权力而非法律决定谁的苦难更重要”的体系。

paras.en: This award strengthens my conviction that we must stand together in defence of the rule of law, in defence of independent courts, and an international legal order based on principle.
paras.zh: 这个奖项坚定了我的信念，即我们必须共同捍卫法治、捍卫独立法院和基于原则的国际法律秩序。

paras.en: Navi Pillay has said that she hopes world leaders will take note of her award, and it will remind them that they have a legal obligation to uphold human rights. She said it was wrong that states where attacking the institute of the international criminal court.
paras.zh: 纳维·皮莱表示，她希望世界领导人能够注意到她的获奖，这将提醒他们有维护人权的法律义务。她说，攻击国际刑事法院机构的说法是错误的。

paras.en: Pillay dedicates award to 'survivors of international crimes'
paras.zh: 皮莱将奖项献给“国际罪行的幸存者”

paras.en: Navi Pillay has begun giving a press conference after the declaration that she has won this year’s Nobel Peace prize. She began by saying she dedicates the award to “survivors of international crimes”.
paras.zh: 纳维·皮莱在宣布获得今年的诺贝尔和平奖后开始举行新闻发布会。她首先表示，将该奖项献给“国际犯罪的幸存者”。

paras.en: She called on people to stand together in the defence of rule of law.
paras.zh: 她呼吁人们团结起来，捍卫法治。

paras.en: For what its worth, the Nobel Committee was also asked about the question of Gaza earlier – and said it was not taking a stance on whether Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.
paras.zh: 无论如何，诺贝尔委员会早些时候也被问及加沙问题，并表示不会就以色列是否在加沙实施种族灭绝表明立场。

paras.en: “It’s her report, the Commission’s report, and of course we have great faith in her professionalism, in her integrity, but that work is of a UN inquiry commission,” Jørgen Watne Frydnes, the chair of the Norwegian Nobel Committee, told AFP when asked to comment.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔委员会主席约尔根·沃特纳·弗里德内斯（Jørgen Watne Frydnes）在被要求置评时告诉法新社：“这是她的报告，委员会的报告，当然我们对她的专业精神和正直充满信心，但这项工作是联合国调查委员会的工作。”

paras.en: He said it was up to international courts to rule on the issue, stressing that the Nobel Committee “is not the court”.
paras.zh: 他表示，应由国际法庭对这个问题做出裁决，并强调诺贝尔委员会“不是法庭”。

articles.title: Pro-Kremlin Russian military blogger Mikhail Zvinchuk arrested in Montenegro
articles.author: Pjotr Sauer

paras.en: A leading pro-Kremlin Russian military blogger with reported ties to Russia’s intelligence services has been arrested in Montenegro, after warnings of attempts to destabilise the Balkan country, officials have said.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，一名据报道与俄罗斯情报部门有联系的亲克里姆林宫俄罗斯主要军事博客作者在黑山被捕，此前有人警告称，该博主试图破坏巴尔干国家的稳定。

paras.en: Mikhail Zvinchuk, the founder of the influential Rybar war blog, was detained on Friday alongside his wife and three other Russians by police and security agents in the Adriatic resort town of Risan, on suspicion of spreading Russian influence, local media reported.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，颇具影响力的 Rybar 战争博客创始人米哈伊尔·兹文丘克 (Mikhail Zvinchuk) 与他的妻子和其他三名俄罗斯人周五在亚得里亚海度假小镇里桑 (Risan) 一起被警察和安全人员拘留，罪名是涉嫌传播俄罗斯影响力。

paras.en: Montenegro’s prime minister, Milojko Spajić, confirmed Zvinchuk’s detention in a post on X, saying it followed warnings that the country would face attempts at destabilisation and hybrid warfare.
paras.zh: 黑山总理米洛伊科·斯帕吉奇 (Milojko Spajić) 在 X 上的一篇帖子中证实了兹文丘克被拘留的消息，称此前曾发出警告称该国将面临破坏稳定和混合战争的企图。

paras.en: The Montenegrin news outlet Vijesti reported later on Friday that Zvinchuk and the other detainees were to be expelled from the country on national security grounds.
paras.zh: 黑山新闻媒体 Vijesti 周五晚些时候报道称，兹文丘克和其他被拘留者将以国家安全为由被驱逐出该国。

paras.en: The Russian Telegram news channel Baza said officers detained Zvinchuk at the luxury Mövenpick hotel in Risan. It said the group was taken to Podgorica, Montenegro’s capital, for questioning and their phones and passports were confiscated.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯电报新闻频道 Baza 称，警方在里桑的瑞享豪华酒店拘留了兹文丘克。据称，这群人被带到黑山首都波德戈里察接受讯问，他们的手机和护照被没收。

paras.en: But Rybar’s activities extend well beyond Ukraine, with the channel promoting pro-Kremlin narratives in Africa and the Middle East. More recently, it has been accused of amplifying far-right narratives surrounding the migration crisis in Ceuta, a Spanish enclave in north Africa.
paras.zh: 但里巴尔的活动远远超出了乌克兰，该频道在非洲和中东宣传亲克里姆林宫的言论。最近，它被指控放大有关北非西班牙飞地休达移民危机的极右言论。

paras.en: “At the moment, the project team is in contact with Russia’s foreign ministry, which is working to resolve the situation. Since there were no violations of local legislation, we expect all detainees to be released,” the channel said on Telegram.
paras.zh: “目前，项目团队正在与俄罗斯外交部联系，后者正在努力解决这一问题。由于没有违反当地法律，我们预计所有被拘留者都会被释放，”该频道在 Telegram 上表示。

paras.en: Britain sanctioned Zvinchuk and Rybar in December 2025 over their role in spreading Kremlin propaganda and undermining support for Ukraine. The British government said Zvinchuk received funding from the Russian state-owned defence conglomerate Rostec, and worked with members of Russia’s intelligence services.
paras.zh: 英国于 2025 年 12 月对兹温丘克和里巴尔实施制裁，理由是他们在克里姆林宫的宣传和破坏对乌克兰的支持方面发挥了作用。英国政府表示，兹文丘克从俄罗斯国有国防集团 Rostec 获得资金，并与俄罗斯情报部门成员合作。

paras.en: The US has separately accused Zvinchuk of attempting to interfere in the 2024 presidential election, offering a reward of up to $10m for information about those involved.
paras.zh: 美国已单独指控兹文丘克试图干预 2024 年总统选举，并悬赏高达 1000 万美元，以提供有关涉案人员的信息。

paras.en: Days before his arrest, Zvinchuk boasted on social media that he had managed to enter Montenegro despite being subject to western sanctions and an entry ban. He mocked a border guard who, he said, had searched his belongings but failed to check his name against a database.
paras.zh: 被捕前几天，兹温丘克在社交媒体上吹嘘说，尽管受到西方制裁和入境禁令，他仍设法进入黑山。他嘲笑一名边防警卫，他说，这名边防警卫搜查了他的物品，但没有将他的名字与数据库进行核对。

paras.en: The Kremlin spokesperson, Dmitry Peskov, said Moscow was aware of Zvinchuk’s detention and would work to secure his release.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，莫斯科知道兹温丘克被拘留，并将努力确保他获释。

paras.en: Russia’s former president Dmitry Medvedev suggested Moscow could detain European and American citizens to use in prisoner exchanges to secure Zvinchuk’s release. “We will probably have to replenish our pool of prisoners for exchange with European and American idiots in order to get our own people back,” he wrote on social media.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯前总统德米特里·梅德韦杰夫表示，莫斯科可以拘留欧洲和美国公民，用于交换囚犯，以确保兹温丘克获释。他在社交媒体上写道：“我们可能不得不补充囚犯库，与欧洲和美国的白痴交换，才能让我们自己的人回来。”

paras.en: The arrest is likely to further strain relations between Montenegro and Russia, which have long been tense. In 2016, Montenegrin authorities accused Russian operatives of plotting with Serbian ultranationalists to stage a coup, allegations Moscow denied.
paras.zh: 这次逮捕可能会进一步加剧黑山和俄罗斯之间长期以来紧张的关系。 2016年，黑山当局指控俄罗斯特工与塞尔维亚极端民族主义者密谋发动政变，莫斯科否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Montenegro, which joined Nato in 2017 and is seeking membership of the EU, imposed sanctions on Russia after its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
paras.zh: 黑山于 2017 年加入北约，并正在寻求加入欧盟，并在 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰后对俄罗斯实施了制裁。

paras.en: The country recently approved plans to end visa-free travel for Russian citizens from 1 November, closing off a popular holiday destination for Russian tourists as it brings its visa policy into line with the EU.
paras.zh: 该国最近批准了从 11 月 1 日起终止对俄罗斯公民免签旅行的计划，关闭了俄罗斯游客的热门度假胜地，使其签证政策与欧盟保持一致。

articles.title: ICJ judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel peace prize for promoting international law
articles.author: Julian Borger and Rachel Savage

paras.en: The Nobel peace prize has been awarded to Navi Pillay, the South African former UN human rights chief who chaired the UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔和平奖被授予南非前联合国人权事务负责人纳维·皮莱，他担任联合国委员会主席，该委员会得出了以色列在加沙犯下种族灭绝罪的结论。

paras.en: The Norwegian Nobel committee said Pillay, who is serving as a judge at the international court of justice (ICJ), has “shown that legal measures can help prevent acts of war and violence”.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔委员会表示，担任国际法院（ICJ）法官的皮莱“表明法律措施可以帮助防止战争和暴力行为”。

paras.en: “Navi Pillay’s commitment to universal legal principles and her firm moral compass are constants in a long career,” the committee said, mentioning her early work defending Nelson Mandela under South Africa’s apartheid regime, serving on the international criminal tribunal, and then as the UN high commissioner for human rights, as well as chairing the UN independent international commission of inquiry on the occupied Palestinian territory.
paras.zh: 该委员会表示：“纳维·皮莱对普遍法律原则的承诺和她坚定的道德准则在她漫长的职业生涯中始终如一。”她提到了她在南非种族隔离政权下为纳尔逊·曼德拉辩护的早期工作，曾在国际刑事法庭任职，后来担任联合国人权事务高级专员，并担任联合国巴勒斯坦被占领土独立国际调查委员会主席。

paras.en: That commission concluded last year that the state of Israel was guilty of genocidal acts in Gaza “with the specific intent to destroy Palestinians in Gaza”, and said the country’s prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, its president, Isaac Herzog, and its former defence minister Yoav Gallant had “incited the commission of genocide”.
paras.zh: 该委员会去年得出结论，以色列国在加沙犯有种族灭绝行为，“其具体目的是消灭加沙的巴勒斯坦人”，并表示该国总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡、总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格和前国防部长约夫·加兰特“煽动了种族灭绝”。

paras.en: “It is clear that there is an intent to destroy the Palestinians in Gaza through acts that meet the criteria set forth in the genocide convention,” Pillay said on the publication of the commission’s findings in September last year.
paras.zh: 皮莱在去年 9 月公布该委员会的调查结果时表示：“很明显，他们意图通过符合《种族灭绝公约》规定标准的行为来消灭加沙的巴勒斯坦人。”

paras.en: Israel refused to cooperate with the commission, arguing it was biased, and rejected its report as “scandalous”. The Israeli foreign ministry reacted furiously to news of Pillay’s award on Friday.
paras.zh: 以色列拒绝与该委员会合作，认为该委员会存在偏见，并拒绝接受该委员会的报告，称其为“可耻的”。周五，以色列外交部对皮莱获奖的消息做出了愤怒的反应。

paras.en: “If there were an award for lies, hatred, and blood libels, Navi Pillay wouldn’t just be a contender. She’d be a frontrunner,” the ministry said on X, adding: “Awarding Pillay the Nobel Peace Prize isn’t a recognition of justice. It’s the grotesque weaponization of an award to legitimize anti-Israel hatred and prejudice.
paras.zh: “如果设立一个针对谎言、仇恨和血腥诽谤的奖项，纳维·皮莱将不仅仅是一个竞争者。她将成为领跑者，”该部在 X 上表示，并补充道：“授予皮莱诺贝尔和平奖并不是对正义的认可。这是一个怪异的武器化奖项，旨在使反以色列的仇恨和偏见合法化。”

paras.en: “Now that the Nobel commission has rewarded the biggest lie of the 21st century, Joseph Goebbels is certainly applauding from hell.”
paras.zh: “现在诺贝尔委员会奖励了 21 世纪最大的谎言，约瑟夫·戈培尔无疑在地狱里鼓掌。”

paras.en: In its statement, the Nobel committee said Pillay, 85, had “contributed to strengthen the institutions of international law”.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会在声明中表示，85 岁的皮莱“为加强国际法机构做出了贡献”。

paras.en: “Her independence, expertise and steadfastness have made her one of the most respected international jurists of our time,” the committee said.
paras.zh: 该委员会表示：“她的独立性、专业知识和坚定性使她成为我们这个时代最受尊敬的国际法学家之一。”

paras.en: “In awarding this year’s Nobel peace prize, the Norwegian Nobel committee wants to remind the world that the rule of law – national and international – underpins the system we have set up to ensure peace and resolve conflicts non-violently,” its statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“在颁发今年的诺贝尔和平奖时，挪威诺贝尔委员会希望提醒世界，国内和国际的法治是我们为确保和平和非暴力解决冲突而建立的体系的基础。”

paras.en: The committee said it had not been able to locate Pillay before its announcement on Friday morning. She was attending a meeting of human rights lawyers and jurists in Nuremberg, Germany, at the site of postwar war crimes trials of Nazi leaders, and heard the news from colleagues. She responded with disbelief.
paras.zh: 该委员会表示，在周五上午宣布这一消息之前，尚未找到皮莱的下落。她当时正在德国纽伦堡参加一场人权律师和法学家会议，会议地点是战后纳粹领导人的战争罪行审判地点，并从同事那里听到了这个消息。她难以置信地回应。

paras.en: “I don’t know about it so much. The question is: is it true? Being a lawyer and a judge, I still want to verify it,” she said.
paras.zh: “我对此不太了解。问题是：这是真的吗？作为一名律师和法官，我仍然想验证这一点，”她说。

paras.en: “The last thing I did was the report on Gaza naming what’s happening there as genocide,” Pillay added. “One of the main reactions to that report was people [complimented] me for my courage. You can imagine how surprised I was. Why would you need courage to speak the truth. You interpret the law. You look at all the facts, so it’s an impartial decision.”
paras.zh: “我做的最后一件事是关于加沙的报告，将那里正在发生的事情命名为种族灭绝，”皮莱补充道。 “对该报告的主要反应之一是人们[称赞]我的勇气。你可以想象我有多么惊讶。为什么你需要勇气说实话。你解释法律。你考虑了所有事实，所以这是一个公正的决定。”

paras.en: Pillay is currently overseeing a genocide case against Myanmar at the ICJ.
paras.zh: 皮莱目前正在国际法院审理针对缅甸的种族灭绝案件。

paras.en: The ICJ, a UN body, rules on disputes between states, while the international criminal court (ICC) investigates and prosecutes individuals accused of atrocities and other grave international crimes.
paras.zh: 国际法院是联合国机构，负责对国家之间的争端作出裁决，而国际刑事法院（ICC）则调查和起诉被控犯有暴行和其他严重国际罪行的个人。

paras.en: Hours after the announcement, the Trump administration unveiled broad new sanctions against the ICC, on which Pillay also once served. The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, said the measures were to ensure the court would never prosecute Americans.
paras.zh: 消息公布几小时后，特朗普政府对皮莱也曾任职过的国际刑事法院实施了广泛的新制裁。美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，这些措施是为了确保法院永远不会起诉美国人。

paras.en: The ICC has not charged any US nationals, and has previously pointed out that it is a court of last resort, unnecessary in the case of countries with effective legal systems. Last year, Donald Trump, who has long coveted the Nobel peace prize, imposed personal sanctions against ICC officials deemed to be involved in investigations of Americans or Israelis. The new sanctions target the court as an institution, blocking any ICC assets in the US and giving US companies and individuals six months to wind down any business with the court.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院没有对任何美国国民提出指控，并且此前曾指出，它是最后法院，对于拥有有效法律体系的国家来说是不必要的。去年，一直觊觎诺贝尔和平奖的唐纳德·特朗普对被认为参与调查美国人或以色列人的国际刑事法院官员实施个人制裁。新的制裁措施将法院作为一个机构，冻结国际刑事法院在美国的任何资产，并给予美国公司和个人六个月的时间来结束与法院的任何业务。

paras.en: The ICC said the sanctions were “an attempt to obstruct the course of justice and to prevent the court from doing what it was created to do”.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院表示，制裁是“试图妨碍司法公正，并阻止法院履行其职责”。

paras.en: “It is an assault on the rule of law and on the very foundations of the international legal order which strikes at the simple principle that no one stands above the law,” the court said in a statement.
paras.zh: 法院在一份声明中表示：“这是对法治和国际法律秩序基础的攻击，违背了任何人都不能凌驾于法律之上的简单原则。”

paras.en: Pillay’s award was welcomed by human rights activists and hailed in South Africa, home to four previous laureates. The country’s president, Cyril Ramaphosa, said: “Justice Pillay’s crowning as winner of the Nobel prize allows us to celebrate the progressive contributions she has made to strengthen peace, uphold human dignity and bring hope in South Africa and to peoples globally.”
paras.zh: 皮莱的奖项受到人权活动人士的欢迎，并在南非受到欢呼，南非是四位前获奖者的故乡。南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨 (Cyril Ramaphosa) 表示：“皮莱大法官荣获诺贝尔奖，让我们能够庆祝她为加强和平、维护人类尊严以及为南非和全球人民带来希望所做出的进步贡献。”

paras.en: Edwin Cameron, a retired South African constitutional court justice, said: “The award of the prize to Navi Pillay re-emphasises that the prize embodies an international aspiration to peace, and to respect and understanding across borders – and that leaders of great stature in our country – [Desmond] Tutu, Mandela, now Pillay – are recognised outside it, on the international stage.
paras.zh: 南非宪法法院退休法官埃德温·卡梅伦 (Edwin Cameron) 表示：“将该奖授予纳维·皮莱再次强调了该奖项体现了国际社会对和平、跨国界尊重和理解的渴望，而我们国家的杰出领导人——[德斯蒙德]图图、曼德拉，现在的皮莱——在国际舞台上得到了认可。

paras.en: “This may help reset our national debate on South Africa’s position in the region, and in Africa,” he said.
paras.zh: “这可能有助于重新启动我们关于南非在该地区和非洲的地位的全国辩论，”他说。

paras.en: Yasmin Sooka, a human rights lawyer and commissioner on both South Africa and Sierra Leone’s truth and reconciliation commissions, said Pillay “follows in the footsteps of Chief Albert Luthuli and Archbishop Desmond Tutu, carrying forward South Africa’s proud tradition of linking peace with justice and human dignity”.
paras.zh: 人权律师兼南非和塞拉利昂真相与和解委员会委员亚斯明·苏卡表示，皮莱“追随阿尔伯特·卢图利酋长和德斯蒙德·图图大主教的脚步，发扬南非将和平与正义和人类尊严联系起来的光荣传统”。

paras.en: “From defending apartheid’s most vulnerable to her pioneering role in the Akayesu judgment, she has transformed international justice. That judgment helped establish rape and sexual violence as weapons of war – a historic breakthrough that placed survivors’ experiences at the heart of international justice,” Sooka said.
paras.zh: “从捍卫种族隔离最弱势群体到她在阿卡耶苏判决中发挥的先锋作用，她改变了国际正义。该判决帮助将强奸和性暴力确立为战争武器——这是一项历史性突破，将幸存者的经历置于国际正义的核心，”苏卡说。

paras.en: In 1998, the international criminal tribunal for Rwanda found Jean-Paul Akayesu, a former mayor of Taba, guilty of genocide and crimes against humanity.
paras.zh: 1998年，卢旺达国际刑事法庭判定塔巴前市长让-保罗·阿卡耶苏犯有种族灭绝罪和反人类罪。

paras.en: “At the ICC, as UN high commissioner for human rights, and leading the inquiry that found Israel responsible for genocide in Gaza, she has brought unwavering integrity and courage to holding power accountable,” Sooka added.
paras.zh: 苏卡补充道：“在国际刑事法院，作为联合国人权事务高级专员，领导调查发现以色列应对加沙种族灭绝负责，她以坚定不移的正直和勇气追究当权者的责任。”

paras.en: Last year’s award of the peace prize to the Venezuelan opposition leader, María Corina Machado, drew widespread criticism because of her calls for US military intervention in her country. Machado heightened the controversy in January by handing her winner’s medal to Trump. The prize committee insisted that the honour of being a Nobel laureate could not be transferred.
paras.zh: 去年，委内瑞拉反对派领导人玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多获得和平奖，但由于她呼吁美国对委内瑞拉进行军事干预，而受到广泛批评。马查多在一月份将获胜者奖牌交给特朗普，加剧了争议。评奖委员会坚称诺贝尔奖获得者的荣誉不能转让。

articles.title: US immigration officials defend ICE agents who shot man in same car as child

paras.en: US immigration officials have defended the actions of officers who shot and wounded a man in his car in New York on Thursday while his five-year-old son was in the back seat.
paras.zh: 美国移民官员为周四在纽约开枪打伤一名男子的行为进行了辩护，当时这名男子五岁的儿子坐在后座上。

paras.en: Markwayne Mullin, the head of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), which runs the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), said officers fired their weapons while trying to arrest a man with a criminal history.
paras.zh: 负责管理移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 的国土安全部 (DHS) 负责人马克韦恩·穆林 (Markwayne Mullin) 表示，警察在试图逮捕一名有犯罪前科的男子时开枪。

paras.en: "We weren't aware the child was in the car," Mullin added at a news conference on Friday, arguing that it was the man, Oscar Belgal, who had put his child in danger. Belgal is now being held at a detention facility.
paras.zh: “我们不知道孩子在车里，”穆林在周五的新闻发布会上补充道，他辩称正是那个名叫奥斯卡·贝尔加尔的男子把他的孩子置于危险之中。贝尔加目前被关押在拘留所。

paras.en: The legal organisation representing Belgal told the BBC that lawyers had not yet been able to speak to him.
paras.zh: 代表贝尔加尔的法律组织告诉英国广播公司，律师尚未能与他交谈。

paras.en: The shooting happened in the residential neighbourhood of Marble Hill.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在大理石山住宅区。

paras.en: Marcos Charles, a top ICE official who was also at Friday's news conference, said agents used their vehicles to try and stop Belgal in his car but that he resisted orders to get out and instead accelerated, smashing into two ICE vehicles.
paras.zh: 出席周五新闻发布会的 ICE 高级官员马科斯·查尔斯 (Marcos Charles) 表示，特工人员使用车辆试图拦住 Belgal 的车，但他拒绝下车的命令，而是加速行驶，撞上了两辆 ICE 车辆。

paras.en: Charles said Belgal then "weaponised his vehicle and proceeded to accelerate going towards other officers", adding: "Our officers, using their training, and believing that their life and the life of their partners in the general public were in danger, used their training and fired weapons."
paras.zh: 查尔斯说，贝尔加尔随后“武装了他的车辆，并开始加速冲向其他警官”，并补充道：“我们的警官利用他们的训练，并相信他们和公众伙伴的生命处于危险之中，因此使用他们的训练并发射了武器。”

paras.en: The number of officers who fired their weapons is being investigated.
paras.zh: 正在调查开枪的警察人数。

paras.en: Charles said Belgal "was struck by one of the bullets or fragments superficially in the neck".
paras.zh: 查尔斯说，贝尔加尔“被一颗子弹或碎片击中颈部”。

paras.en: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who called what happened "unconscionable and incredibly serious", said ICE agents surrounded Belgal's car before opening fire.
paras.zh: 纽约市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 称所发生的事件“不合理且极其严重”，并表示 ICE 特工在开枪之前包围了贝尔加尔的汽车。

paras.en: "They wore construction vests and masks that concealed their faces. There is no reasonable way to identify them as ICE agents," Mamdani said. He confirmed that the child was unharmed.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼说：“他们穿着建筑背心，戴着遮住脸的面具。没有合理的方法可以识别他们是 ICE 特工。”他确认孩子没有受伤。

paras.en: Mullin said the officers identified themselves and were wearing body-worn cameras that were turned on during the incident.
paras.zh: 穆林说，这些警察表明了自己的身份，并佩戴了在事件发生期间打开的随身摄像头。

paras.en: Video of the shooting, including body camera footage, has not been made public but unverified videos on social media appear to align with Mamdani's comments.
paras.zh: 枪击事件的视频，包括随身摄像机的镜头，尚未公开，但社交媒体上未经证实的视频似乎与马姆达尼的评论一致。

paras.en: Body-worn camera footage released by the New York Police Department (NYPD) on Friday shows its officers arriving on scene and attempting to help Belgal after he has been shot. One ICE officer appears to be wearing a neon construction vest and carrying a large gun.
paras.zh: 纽约警察局 (NYPD) 周五公布的随身摄像机镜头显示，贝尔加尔中枪后，警察抵达现场并试图帮助他。一名 ICE 官员似乎穿着霓虹灯建筑背心并携带一把大枪。

paras.en: The NYPD officers then call for an ambulance and putting him in a police car to take him to hospital. They are later seen pulling Belgal from the vehicle and carrying him into the hospital.
paras.zh: 纽约警察局官员随后呼叫救护车并将他送上警车送往医院。后来有人看到他们将贝尔加尔从车上拉下来并把他带到医院。

paras.en: Mamdani said on Thursday that he had spoken to US President Donald Trump and Mullin for two hours but failed to negotiate Belgal's release.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼周四表示，他已与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和穆林进行了两个小时的交谈，但未能就释放贝尔加尔进行谈判。

paras.en: Mamdani said he would ask Trump, who has not yet commented publicly on the shooting, to end ICE enforcement actions in New York. Mullin has said he will not pause enforcement.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼表示，他将要求尚未就枪击事件公开发表评论的特朗普终止 ICE 在纽约的执法行动。穆林表示他不会暂停执法。

paras.en: The DHS said Belgal, 28, was from the Dominican Republic and had "a prior criminal conviction for grand larceny and multiple prior arrests for assault, robbery, possession of drugs and weapons possession".
paras.zh: 国土安全部表示，28 岁的贝尔加尔来自多米尼加共和国，“曾因重大盗窃罪被定罪，并因袭击、抢劫、持有毒品和武器而多次被捕”。

paras.en: Belgal was arrested by police officers in New York in December 2023 and released "a few days later", according to the DHS.
paras.zh: 据国土安全部称，贝尔加尔于 2023 年 12 月在纽约被警察逮捕，“几天后”被释放。

paras.en: New York City Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch said there was also still a pending case against Belgal for criminal sale of a controlled substance in 2025.
paras.zh: 纽约市警察局长杰西卡·蒂施 (Jessica Tisch) 表示，还有一起针对 Belgal 的 2025 年非法销售受控物质案件悬而未决。

paras.en: DHS has also alleged Belgal was associated with the Trinitarios, described by the US justice department as a transnational criminal group.
paras.zh: 国土安全部还指控 Belgal 与 Trinitarios 有关联，美国司法部将 Trinitarios 描述为跨国犯罪集团。

paras.en: Mullin said the DHS believed Belgal "has either indirect or direct knowledge" of a US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) officer shooting, "and that's why he became a target".
paras.zh: 马林表示，国土安全部认为贝尔加尔“间接或直接了解”美国海关和边境保护局（CBP）官员的枪击事件，“这就是他成为目标的原因”。

paras.en: Mamdani is not the only New York official to have criticised the incident. Governor Kathy Hochul said federal officials needed to provide answers quickly about what happened.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼并不是唯一批评这一事件的纽约官员。州长凯西·霍赫尔 (Kathy Hochul) 表示，联邦官员需要迅速就所发生的事情提供答案。

paras.en: "New Yorkers have witnessed far too many acts of violence by a rogue federal agency and untrained agents that operate with impunity," Hochul said, adding that she had spoken to Mullin and Trump as well.
paras.zh: 霍赫尔说：“纽约人目睹了太多流氓联邦机构和未经训练的特工实施的暴力行为，他们的行动却不受惩罚。”她补充说，她也与穆林和特朗普谈过。

paras.en: There have been several high-profile shootings involving ICE officers this year, including one that caused the death of Renee Good in Minneapolis in January.
paras.zh: 今年发生了多起涉及 ICE 官员的引人注目的枪击事件，其中包括一月份在明尼阿波利斯导致蕾妮·古德 (Renee Good) 死亡的枪击事件。

articles.title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize

paras.en: Former UN human rights chief and International Court of Justice judge Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize.
paras.zh: 前联合国人权事务高级专员、国际法院法官纳维·皮莱荣获 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: The South African judge was recognised "for her efforts to promote peace and international law", which paved the way for a "more comprehensive global legal order", the Nobel committee said.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会表示，这位南非法官“因促进和平和国际法的努力”而受到认可，这为“更全面的全球法律秩序”铺平了道路。

paras.en: Pillay, 85, has taken part in high-profile work considering allegations of human rights violations during a decades-long career, including in Rwanda, Myanmar and Gaza.
paras.zh: 85 岁的皮莱在数十年的职业生涯中参与了备受瞩目的审议侵犯人权指控的工作，其中包括在卢旺达、缅甸和加沙。

paras.en: Her early work included defending anti-apartheid activists in South Africa, and on Friday she became the country's fifth Peace Prize winner - following in the footsteps of Nelson Mandela and Archbishop Desmond Tutu.
paras.zh: 她的早期工作包括捍卫南非的反种族隔离活动人士，周五她成为该国第五位和平奖获得者——追随纳尔逊·曼德拉和德斯蒙德·图图大主教的脚步。

paras.en: Pillay's work had been "instrumental in ensuring that war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide are prosecuted", said the chair of the Norwegian Nobel Committee JÃ¸rgen Watne Frydnes.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔委员会主席耶尔根·沃特纳·弗里德内斯 (Jårgen Watne Frydnes) 表示，皮莱的工作“有助于确保战争罪、反人类罪和种族灭绝罪受到起诉”。

paras.en: "Navi Pillay's commitment to universal legal principles and her firm moral compass are constants in a long career," he said.
paras.zh: “纳维·皮莱对普遍法律原则的承诺和她坚定的道德准则是她漫长职业生涯中不变的，”他说。

paras.en: "At a time of existential challenges - including more wars and conflicts than the world has seen in a long time - international law is no longer just a supplement to peace and security. It is an absolute necessity."
paras.zh: “在面临生存挑战的时代——包括世界上长期以来从未见过的更多战争和冲突——国际法不再只是和平与安全的补充。它是绝对必要的。”

paras.en: Frydnes said the committee had not been able to notify Pillay that she had won in advance, "so my message to her would be 'if you see a Norwegian number calling, please pick up'".
paras.zh: 弗里德内斯表示，委员会无法提前通知皮莱她获胜，“所以我给她的信息是‘如果你看到挪威号码打来，请接听’”。

paras.en: Shortly afterwards, Pillay reacted to the news from Nuremberg's Palace of Justice by saying "it must be a joke" and thanked those who had gathered to applaud her.
paras.zh: 不久之后，皮莱对纽伦堡司法宫传来的消息做出回应，称“这一定是个笑话”，并对聚集在一起为她鼓掌的人们表示感谢。

paras.en: Pillay dedicated her award to "all the survivors of international crimes" and the practitioners of international justice "whose compassion and courage continue to ensure that impunity will not be allowed to reign".
paras.zh: 皮莱将她的奖项献给“所有国际罪行的幸存者”和国际正义的实践者，“他们的同情心和勇气继续确保不让有罪不罚的现象继续存在”。

paras.en: Navanethem "Navi" Pillay grew up in South Africa during apartheid as a bus driver's daughter in a poor Indian section of Durban.
paras.zh: 纳瓦尼特姆·“纳维”·皮莱 (Navanethem "Navi" Pillay) 在种族隔离时期的南非长大，她是德班贫困印度人区一名公交车司机的女儿。

paras.en: She went on to become the first woman to establish a law practice in Natal Province in 1967, and later the first non-white woman to be appointed to the country's high court.
paras.zh: 1967 年，她成为纳塔尔省第一位建立律师事务所的女性，后来又成为第一位被任命为该国高等法院法官的非白人女性。

paras.en: Pillay served as a judge on the UN-backed International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda - focused on the 1994 genocide in which 800,000 people were killed - including four years as its president. She was elected to the International Criminal Court (ICC) in 2003.
paras.zh: 皮莱曾担任联合国支持的卢旺达国际刑事法庭法官，该法庭主要审理 1994 年造成 80 万人死亡的种族灭绝事件，其中包括担任法庭庭长四年。 2003年，她当选为国际刑事法院（ICC）法官。

paras.en: From 2021-25, she chaired the UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory - a fact-finding body established by the UN Human Rights Council to investigate alleged violations of international law.
paras.zh: 2021-25 年间，她担任联合国巴勒斯坦被占领土独立国际调查委员会主席，该委员会是联合国人权理事会设立的实况调查机构，旨在调查涉嫌违反国际法的行为。

paras.en: The commission concluded that Israel had committed genocidal acts in Gaza and that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and his former defence minister Yoav Gallant, had "incited the commission of genocide" in their speeches and statements.
paras.zh: 该委员会的结论是，以色列在加沙实施了种族灭绝行为，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和前国防部长约夫·加兰特在他们的讲话和声明中“煽动了种族灭绝的实施”。

paras.en: The three-member expert panel did not speak officially for the UN and had no legal authority. Israel rejected its findings and accused the three members of the commission of serving as "Hamas proxies".
paras.zh: 这个三人专家小组不代表联合国正式发言，也不具有法律权威。以色列否认其调查结果，并指责该委员会的三名成员充当“哈马斯代理人”。

paras.en: The panel had previously concluded that Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups committed war crimes and other grave violations of international law on 7 October 2023, in which about 1,200 people were killed and another 251 taken hostage. The same report also accused Israel of war crimes.
paras.zh: 该小组此前得出结论，哈马斯和其他巴勒斯坦武装组织于 2023 年 10 月 7 日犯下战争罪和其他严重违反国际法的行为，造成约 1,200 人死亡，另有 251 人被劫持为人质。同一份报告还指责以色列犯有战争罪。

paras.en: Reacting to Pillay's award on Friday, Israel's Foreign Ministry said it represented a "grotesque weaponisation of an award to legitimise anti-Israel hatred and prejudice".
paras.zh: 以色列外交部周五对皮莱的裁决做出反应，表示这是“将裁决荒唐地武器化，使反以色列的仇恨和偏见合法化”。

paras.en: It said in a statement: "Her role in the relentless, politically motivated demonisation of Israel and promotion of the genoLIE speaks volumes."
paras.zh: 该组织在一份声明中表示：“她在出于政治动机的无情妖魔化以色列和推广基因组的过程中所扮演的角色意义重大。”

paras.en: US President Donald Trump, who has previously expressed a desire to receive the prize, reposted a statement on social media that said the Nobel committee had "demeaned" the award by giving it to someone it described as an "unabashed hater of America and Israel".
paras.zh: 此前曾表示希望获得该奖项的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上转发了一份声明，称诺贝尔委员会将奖项颁发给了一个“毫不掩饰地仇恨美国和以色列”的人，这是“贬低”了该奖项。

paras.en: The US later announced sweeping sanctions on the court, saying it wanted to restrict its resources and ability to operate. The ICC called the move an assault on the rule of law.
paras.zh: 美国随后宣布对该法院实施全面制裁，称其希望限制其资源和运作能力。国际刑事法院称此举是对法治的攻击。

paras.en: Nobel committee chair Frydnes said the organisation was not taking a position on whether the Israeli offensive in Gaza amounted to genocide by handing Pillay the peace prize. Asked about Pillay's UN commission on the matter, he replied her award had been given "for her whole work".
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会主席弗里德内斯表示，该组织并未就以色列对加沙的进攻是否构成种族灭绝表明立场，将和平奖授予皮莱。当被问及皮莱在此事上的联合国委员会时，他回答说，她的奖项是“因为她的整个工作”而颁发的。

paras.en: Pillay is currently a judge on the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in the case where Myanmar stands accused by The Gambia of genocide against the Rohingya people.
paras.zh: 皮莱目前是国际法院（ICJ）的法官，审理冈比亚指控缅甸对罗兴亚人进行种族灭绝的案件。

paras.en: Myanmar has denied deliberately trying to destroy the minority Muslim population, with a government representative telling the court in January that the allegation was "unsubstantiated".
paras.zh: 缅甸否认故意试图消灭少数穆斯林人口，一名政府代表在一月份告诉法庭，这一指控“未经证实”。

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Turk said Pillay's recognition was "a reaffirmation that human rights, the rule of law and justice, and accountability are fundamental to everything, to peace, to security, and prosperity".
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·特克表示，皮莱的认可“重申了人权、法治和正义以及问责制是一切事物、和平、安全和繁荣的基础”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, UN Secretary General AntÃ³nio Guterres said she had been "a steadfast, independent voice of justice amidst some of the most historic international legal cases of our time".
paras.zh: 与此同时，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示，她“在我们这个时代一些最具历史意义的国际法律案件中坚定、独立地发出了正义的声音”。

paras.en: South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa said she had been a "pioneering defence attorney for anti-apartheid activists" who had worked to "uphold human dignity and bring hope in South Africa and to peoples globally".
paras.zh: 南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨表示，她是“反种族隔离活动人士的先锋辩护律师”，致力于“维护人类尊严，为南非和全球人民带来希望”。

paras.en: Amnesty International secretary general AgnÃ¨s Callamard said she was with Pillay when she learned she had won - and called her an "inspired choice" for the award.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织秘书长阿格尼斯·卡拉马德表示，当她得知自己获奖时，她和皮莱在一起，并称她是该奖项的“鼓舞人心的选择”。

paras.en: "At a time when both international law and justice are under attack, when too many states attempt to hollow them out, her Nobel Peace Prize could not come at a better time," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“在国际法和正义都受到攻击、太多国家试图掏空它们的时候，她的诺贝尔和平奖来得正是时候。”

articles.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'

paras.en: The Trump administration has unveiled sweeping sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) in a significant acceleration of its attempt to "dismantle" what it sees as a "rogue" institution.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府公布了对国际刑事法院（ICC）的全面制裁，显着加速了其“瓦解”这个被其视为“流氓”机构的尝试。

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the measures - which include a ban on US entities making transactions with the ICC - were intended to "defend US sovereignty" and accused the court of seeking to prosecute Americans.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥表示，这些措施（包括禁止美国实体与国际刑事法院进行交易）旨在“捍卫美国主权”，并指责该法院试图起诉美国人。

paras.en: The ICC said the measures were an assault on the rule of law and the foundations of the international legal order.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院表示，这些措施是对法治和国际法律秩序基础的攻击。

paras.en: The announcement came just hours after former ICC judge Navi Pillay was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts to promote peace and international law.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布前几个小时，国际刑事法院前法官纳维·皮莱因其促进和平和国际法的努力而被授予 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: The US has already sanctioned 17 of the ICC's judges and officials, but this move sanctions the court itself as an institution and is intended to collapse its ability to operate financially.
paras.zh: 美国已经制裁了国际刑事法院的17名法官和官员，但此举制裁了国际刑事法院本身作为一个机构，并旨在削弱其财务运作能力。

paras.en: However, the US has provided a six month grace period before some of these latest sanctions kick in, meaning member states can keep paying for its operations - a move Washington says is to allow countries time to negotiate a "solution to address" US concerns.
paras.zh: 然而，在最新的一些制裁生效之前，美国提供了六个月的宽限期，这意味着成员国可以继续为其运营付费——华盛顿表示，此举是为了让各国有时间谈判“解决方案”，以解决美国的担忧。

paras.en: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres called the US decision "a serious blow to our collective pursuit of international criminal justice, of which the ICC is a key pillar".
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯称美国的决定“对我们集体追求国际刑事司法的严重打击，而国际刑事法院是国际刑事司法的关键支柱”。

paras.en: The UK joined Canada, Denmark, Germany, France, Italy, Japan and the Netherlands in reaffirming their "continued and unwavering support" for the ICC and said they "regret and strongly disagree with" the sanctions.
paras.zh: 英国与加拿大、丹麦、德国、法国、意大利、日本和荷兰一起重申对国际刑事法院的“持续和坚定支持”，并表示他们对制裁措施“感到遗憾并强烈反对”。

paras.en: They also praised the court's staff for their work bringing "those accused of the most serious international crimes to justice", as well as supporting victims.
paras.zh: 他们还赞扬了法院工作人员将“那些被控犯有最严重国际罪行的人绳之以法”以及为受害者提供支持的工作。

paras.en: The ICC was founded in 2002 to prosecute war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide, and counts 125 countries as member states. Several major countries remain outside the ICC, including the US, Russia, China, India and Israel.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院成立于 2002 年，旨在起诉战争罪、反人类罪和种族灭绝罪，现有 125 个成员国。几个主要国家仍处于国际刑事法院之外，包括美国、俄罗斯、中国、印度和以色列。

paras.en: The Trump administration argues the ICC is run by what it calls globalists who threaten American sovereignty.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府辩称，国际刑事法院是由威胁美国主权的全球主义者管理的。

paras.en: It is furious over a past investigation into actions of US soldiers in Afghanistan the court has since closed and by its arrest warrants for Israeli officials including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The new sanctions, however, do not say that those warrants must be withdrawn before the measures can be lifted.
paras.zh: 它对过去对美国士兵在阿富汗的行动进行的调查感到愤怒，该法院已关闭，并对包括总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在内的以色列官员发出逮捕令。然而，新的制裁并没有规定在解除措施之前必须撤回这些逮捕令。

paras.en: But Rubio said Trump would not allow the ICC to prosecute Americans, adding: "Either the ICC will end its threats, or we will end the ICC."
paras.zh: 但卢比奥表示，特朗普不会允许国际刑事法院起诉美国人，并补充道：“要么国际刑事法院结束其威胁，要么我们将结束国际刑事法院。”

paras.en: The US sanctions will stop US companies from providing goods or services to the ICC, such as banking or software.
paras.zh: 美国的制裁将阻止美国公司向国际刑事法院提供商品或服务，例如银行或软件。

paras.en: Rubio said Washington had delayed imposing the sanctions in the hope that the ICC and its member countries would address US concerns. He said the measures had been structured to allow other countries to negotiate a possible solution.
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，华盛顿推迟实施制裁，希望国际刑事法院及其成员国能够解决美国的担忧。他表示，这些措施的目的是让其他国家能够就可能的解决方案进行谈判。

paras.en: He also called on US allies that were ICC signatories, including the UK, to "rein in" the institution.
paras.zh: 他还呼吁包括英国在内的国际刑事法院签署国美国盟友“控制”该机构。

paras.en: The Netherlands, which hosts the court in The Hague and is also a Nato ally of the US, faces particular pressure. Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen has said the sanctions would seriously affect the court's ability to function.
paras.zh: 荷兰是海牙法院的所在地，也是美国的北约盟友，面临着特别的压力。荷兰外交部长汤姆·贝伦森（ Tom Berendsen ）表示，制裁将严重影响法院的运作能力。

paras.en: Netanyahu welcomed the sanctions, saying the ICC was "not a court" but a political body that threatened law-abiding democracies and "the very idea of national sovereignty".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡对制裁表示欢迎，称国际刑事法院“不是法院”，而是一个威胁守法民主国家和“国家主权理念”的政治机构。

paras.en: The ICC said that the sanctions were aimed at disrupting its work and intimidating those who co-operate with it - but that it "will not be deterred".
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院表示，制裁的目的是扰乱其工作并恐吓与其合作的人，但它“不会被吓倒”。

paras.en: It called the measures "an assault on the rule of law" and said no one should be punished for serving the cause of justice, adding: "History will judge this moment."
paras.zh: 它称这些措施是“对法治的攻击”，并表示任何人都不应该因为为正义事业服务而受到惩罚，并补充说：“历史将在这一刻做出判断。”

paras.en: This showdown potentially marks the gravest crisis in the court's 24-year history. Rather than targeting individual ICC judges and prosecutors, the US is now sanctioning the court itself.
paras.zh: 这场摊牌可能标志着法院 24 年历史上最严重的危机。美国现在不是针对个别国际刑事法院法官和检察官，而是制裁该法院本身。

articles.title: The central Pacific Ocean just broke a temperature record. Experts say it might signal a new kind of El Niño.
articles.author: Sascha Pare

paras.en: The sea surface temperature in a key section of the central equatorial Pacific Ocean has now surpassed all previous temperatures on record for this region, exceeding 86 degrees Fahrenheit (30 degrees Celsius) for the first time, according to preliminary data released Monday (Oct. 5).
paras.zh: 根据周一（10 月 5 日）公布的初步数据，赤道中部太平洋关键海域的海面温度现已超过该地区以往有记录的所有温度，首次超过 86 华氏度（30 摄氏度）。

paras.en: Specifically, these temperatures occurred in the Niño 3.4 region, located between 5 degrees north and 5 degrees south latitude, and 120 degrees west and 170 degrees west longitude. Researchers use this region to monitor the progression of El Niño, the warm phase of a multiyear natural climate pattern that's currently in full swing and steadily intensifying. But how significant is this new record, and could it be a harbinger of increasingly extreme El Niño events in the future?
paras.zh: 具体来说，这些气温发生在尼诺3.4区域，位于北纬5度和南纬5度、西经120度和西经170度之间。研究人员利用该地区来监测厄尔尼诺现象的进展，厄尔尼诺现象是多年自然气候模式的温暖阶段，目前正在全面展开并稳步加强。但这一新记录有多重要？它是否是未来日益极端的厄尔尼诺事件的预兆？

paras.en: At this time of the year, sea surface temperatures above 86 F are common in the western Pacific warm pool, a mass of water located northeast of Australia. But the Niño 3.4 region is nowhere near the warm pool and usually has much cooler temperatures. This latest data indicates "an exceptionally warm state for this part of the tropical Pacific," said Jin-Yi Yu, a professor of Earth system science at the University of California, Irvine.
paras.zh: 每年的这个时候，位于澳大利亚东北部的西太平洋暖池的海面温度通常高于 86 华氏度。但厄尔尼诺 3.4 地区距离暖水池很远，而且通常气温要低得多。加州大学欧文分校地球系统科学教授于金一表示，这一最新数据表明“热带太平洋的这一地区正处于异常温暖的状态”。

paras.en: "If the reported daily El Niño 3.4 temperature above 30°C is verified in the observational dataset, it would be an extraordinary record," Yu told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “如果厄尔尼诺3.4每日报告的气温高于30°C，在观测数据集中得到证实，那将是一个非凡的记录，”于在一封电子邮件中告诉Live Science。

paras.en: Other experts agreed. A Niño 3.4 sea surface temperature above 86 F is a "very significant" new record, Timothy Osborn, a professor of climate science and the director of the Climatic Research Unit at the University of East Anglia in the U.K., told Live Science in an email. Mat Collins, a professor of climate systems and the head of mathematics and statistics at the University of Exeter in the U.K., also called the temperature "very significant" in an email to Live Science.
paras.zh: 其他专家也表示同意。英国东安格利亚大学气候科学教授兼气候研究室主任蒂莫西·奥斯本（Timothy Osborn）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，尼诺3.4海面温度高于86华氏度是一个“非常重要”的新纪录。英国埃克塞特大学气候系统教授兼数学和统计学负责人马特·柯林斯(Mat Collins)在给《生活科学》的电子邮件中也称气温“非常重要”。

paras.en: But it's important to note that absolute temperature is not the standard way of measuring the strength of El Niño, Osborn said. Researchers usually assess El Niño intensity by comparing sea surface temperatures in the Niño 3.4 region with the average conditions there or with sea surface temperatures across the rest of the tropics, with the latter method removing a skew in the data caused by the climate-change-induced heating of oceans globally.
paras.zh: 但奥斯本说，值得注意的是，绝对温度并不是测量厄尔尼诺现象强度的标准方法。研究人员通常通过将厄尔尼诺3.4地区的海面温度与该地区的平均条件或其他热带地区的海面温度进行比较来评估厄尔尼诺现象的强度，后一种方法消除了由气候变化引起的全球海洋加热造成的数据偏差。

paras.en: "On those measures, the current event is already close to being the strongest [El Niño] on record and will likely soon exceed previous records given that the event is forecast to strengthen further," Osborn said. "For some measures, it is already record-breaking for the time of year."
paras.zh: 奥斯本说：“根据这些指标，当前的厄尔尼诺现象已经接近有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象，而且鉴于预计该现象将进一步加强，很可能很快就会超过之前的记录。” “就某些指标而言，这已经打破了今年同期的记录。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: El Niño events happen when warm water in the western tropical Pacific Ocean migrates eastward along the equator, toward South America. This boosts global temperatures, triggering heavy rainfall and floods in regions like East Africa, southern China, the southern U.S. and the Pacific coast of equatorial South America, while places such as Indonesia, the Philippines, southern Africa and northern South America experience drought.
paras.zh: 当西热带太平洋的暖水沿着赤道向东迁移到南美洲时，就会发生厄尔尼诺现象。这导致全球气温升高，在东非、中国南部、美国南部和南美洲赤道太平洋沿岸等地区引发强降雨和洪水，而印度尼西亚、菲律宾、非洲南部和南美洲北部等地区则出现干旱。

paras.en: "El Nino impacts are greatest across the tropics and in the lands around the Pacific Ocean," Osborn said. "An El Nino with record strength is very significant because it greatly disrupts the atmospheric circulation which controls the weather patterns including patterns of rainfall."
paras.zh: 奥斯本说：“厄尔尼诺现象对热带地区和太平洋沿岸地区的影响最为严重。” “创纪录强度的厄尔尼诺现象非常重要，因为它极大地扰乱了控制天气模式（包括降雨模式）的大气环流。”

paras.en: As of Oct. 6, the temperature anomaly in the Niño 3.4 region is 6 F (3.34 C) above average and rising. A typical El Niño increases Niño 3.4 temperatures by a maximum of 1.8 to 3.6 F (1 to 2 C) above average, so the current condition is "exceptionally large," Yu said. "This indicates that a very strong, or what is sometimes called a 'super,' El Niño is developing."
paras.zh: 截至 10 月 6 日，厄尔尼诺 3.4 地区的气温异常比平均水平高 6 华氏度（3.34 摄氏度），并且还在上升。典型的厄尔尼诺现象会使厄尔尼诺 3.4 的气温比平均温度高出最多 1.8 至 3.6 华氏度（1 至 2 摄氏度），因此目前的情况“异常严重”，Yu 说。 “这表明一种非常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，或者有时被称为‘超级’的厄尔尼诺现象正在发展。”

paras.en: This year's El Niño is being amplified by human-driven global warming, which has increased background ocean temperatures. As a result, it's likely that sea surface temperatures in the Niño 3.4 region will keep rising over the coming weeks and peak in November or December, before declining again in 2027, Collins said.
paras.zh: 今年的厄尔尼诺现象因人类导致的全球变暖而加剧，导致海洋背景温度升高。柯林斯表示，因此，尼诺 3.4 地区的海面温度可能会在未来几周内持续上升，并在 11 月或 12 月达到峰值，然后在 2027 年再次下降。

paras.en: "The Niño 3.4 anomaly is very likely to remain extremely large and may increase further," Yu said, echoing forecasters' suggestions that it could reach 7.2 F (4 C) by November.
paras.zh: Yu 说：“尼诺 3.4 异常现象很可能仍然非常大，并可能进一步增加。”这呼应了预报员的建议，即到 11 月，其温度可能达到 7.2 华氏度（4 摄氏度）。

paras.en: The world is on the brink of crossing a critical warming threshold, raising the question of whether the current conditions can be considered a new normal for future El Niños.
paras.zh: 世界正处于跨越临界变暖阈值的边缘，引发了一个问题：当前的情况是否可以被视为未来厄尔尼诺现象的新常态。

paras.en: While it's likely that future El Niños will be more extreme than past ones, on average, not every El Niño will be record-breaking and as dramatic as the one unfolding now, because these events tend to be very variable, Collins said.
paras.zh: 柯林斯说，虽然未来的厄尔尼诺现象可能会比过去更加极端，但平均而言，并不是每一次厄尔尼诺现象都会破纪录并且像现在发生的那样引人注目，因为这些事件往往变化很大。

paras.en: As climate change intensifies, the big worry is that certain regions will be primed for extreme conditions even before an El Niño strikes, Osborn said. For example, regions that are getting drier due to global warming could see catastrophic droughts if they overlap with areas that experience dryness during El Niño events. Likewise, places that are getting wetter could see worse deluges of rain and flooding if they coincide with areas with higher precipitation during El Niños. But that doesn't necessarily mean extreme El Niños are the new normal, he said.
paras.zh: 奥斯本说，随着气候变化加剧，人们最担心的是，即使在厄尔尼诺现象发生之前，某些地区也将面临极端条件。例如，由于全球变暖而变得更加干旱的地区，如果与厄尔尼诺事件期间经历干旱的地区重叠，可能会出现灾难性的干旱。同样，如果气候变得越来越潮湿的地区与厄尔尼诺现象期间降水量较高的地区同时发生，可能会出现更严重的降雨和洪水。但这并不一定意味着极端厄尔尼诺现象将成为新常态，他说。

paras.en: Instead, the location and duration of El Niño events may be transforming, Yu suggested. "In research by my group and collaborators, we have documented changes not only in El Niño intensity, but also in where the warming occurs and how long events persist," he said.

Yu and his colleagues helped to introduce the idea that we are seeing the emergence of two distinct types of El Niño: the eastern Pacific El Niño and the central Pacific El Niño. "Many El Niño events in the earlier observational record were dominated by warming in the eastern tropical Pacific, whereas Central Pacific El Niño events became much more prominent in recent decades," he explained, adding that El Niños have also been lasting longer.
paras.zh: 于和他的同事帮助介绍了这样一个想法，即我们正在看到两种不同类型的厄尔尼诺现象的出现：东太平洋厄尔尼诺和中太平洋厄尔尼诺。他解释说：“早期观测记录中的许多厄尔尼诺事件主要是由于东热带太平洋变暖所致，而中太平洋厄尔尼诺事件在近几十年来变得更加突出。”他补充说，厄尔尼诺现象的持续时间也更长。

paras.en: Global warming may be creating a new kind of El Niño by strengthening atmosphere-ocean interactions in the subtropical Pacific, Yu said. If these interactions combine with processes in the equatorial Pacific, where eastern Pacific El Niños emerge, they might trigger unusually strong events with extreme heating in the central Pacific.
paras.zh: 于说，全球变暖可能会通过加强副热带太平洋的大气-海洋相互作用而产生一种新型厄尔尼诺现象。如果这些相互作用与东太平洋厄尔尼诺现象出现的赤道太平洋的过程结合起来，它们可能会引发异常强烈的事件，导致中太平洋出现极端升温。

paras.en: "That provides a physical reason to take the possibility of more frequent extreme El Niño events in a warmer climate seriously," Yu said. "But I would distinguish that from saying that every El Niño will become progressively stronger."
paras.zh: 于说：“这提供了一个物理理由，让我们认真对待气候变暖时发生更频繁的极端厄尔尼诺事件的可能性。” “但我将这与每次厄尔尼诺现象都会变得越来越强的说法区分开来。”

paras.en: Sascha is a U.K.-based staff writer at Live Science. She holds a bachelor’s degree in biology from the University of Southampton in England and a master’s degree in science communication from Imperial College London. Her work has appeared in The Guardian and the health website Zoe. Besides writing, she enjoys playing tennis, bread-making and browsing second-hand shops for hidden gems.
paras.zh: Sascha 是 Live Science 驻英国的特约撰稿人。她拥有英国南安普顿大学生物学学士学位和伦敦帝国理工学院科学传播硕士学位。她的作品曾出现在《卫报》和健康网站 Zoe 上。除了写作之外，她还喜欢打网球、制作面包和逛二手店寻找隐藏的宝石。

articles.title: 'Freakish' discovery of 9 million-year-old capybara tooth supports idea that Atacama wasn't always a desert
articles.author: Damien Pine

paras.en: Researchers have discovered a roughly 9 million year old tooth belonging to a large, water-loving relative of modern day capybaras in the Atacama Desert of northern Chile. The fossilized molar adds to previous evidence suggesting that it's unlikely the Atacama, one of the driest places on Earth, was continuously dry for the last 40 million years.
paras.zh: 研究人员在智利北部阿塔卡马沙漠发现了一颗大约 900 万年前的牙齿，属于现代水豚的大型喜水近亲。这颗臼齿化石进一步证明，地球上最干旱的地方之一阿塔卡马不太可能在过去 4000 万年里持续干旱。

paras.en: The Atacama Desert, possibly the oldest desert on Earth, takes up the northern third of Chile. It's bounded by the Chilean Coast Range to the west, which blocks rain from the Pacific Ocean, and the enormous Andes to the east, which obstruct rain from the Atlantic Ocean. The driest part of the desert's hyperarid region gets less than 0.08 inches (2 mm) of rainfall a month.
paras.zh: 阿塔卡马沙漠可能是地球上最古老的沙漠，占据了智利北部的三分之一。它西边是智利海岸山脉，阻挡了来自太平洋的降雨，东边是巨大的安第斯山脉，阻挡了来自大西洋的降雨。沙漠极度干旱地区最干燥的地区每月降雨量不到 0.08 英寸（2 毫米）。

paras.en: Recent research estimates the Atacama's hyperarid core started forming between 47.8 million and 33.9 million years ago, in the Mid- to Late-Eocene, 20 million years before the Andes formed. It suggests the mountain ranges weren't the cause for the desert's aridification, and may have only intensified it.
paras.zh: 最近的研究估计，阿塔卡马的超级干旱核心开始形成于 4780 万年前至 3390 万年前，即始新世中晚期，比安第斯山脉形成早 2000 万年。这表明山脉并不是沙漠干旱化的原因，而且可能只会加剧干旱化。

paras.en: Capybaras (Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris) — the world's largest rodent — exclusively live close to stable freshwater sources and feed on plants that also require water to grow, so the discovery of an extinct capybara relative (Hydrochoerus Cardiatherium) tooth in the Atacama Desert is very strange.
paras.zh: 水豚 (Hydrochoerus Hydrochaeris) 是世界上最大的啮齿动物，它们专门生活在稳定的淡水源附近，以也需要水才能生长的植物为食，因此在阿塔卡马沙漠中发现已灭绝的水豚近亲 (Hydrochoerus Cardiatherium) 牙齿是非常奇怪的。

paras.en: "Finding a capybara tooth in a marine deposit in what today is one of the driest regions on Earth is just freakish," Priscilla Martinez, a geoscientist at the University of Arizona and co-author of a new paper describing the discovery, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那大学地球科学家、描述这一发现的新论文的合著者普里西拉·马丁内斯在一份声明中说：“在当今地球上最干旱的地区之一的海洋沉积物中发现水豚牙齿真是太奇怪了。”

paras.en: Capybaras are native to South America, although today, they are not found in Chile, where the tooth was unearthed, according to the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
paras.zh: 据国际自然保护联盟 (IUCN) 称，水豚原产于南美洲，但如今在出土水豚牙齿的智利却找不到它们的踪影。

paras.en: The tooth isn't the only clue that the Atacama was a wetter place in the late Miocene. Researchers found it in a layer holding the remains of a shallow marine environment that existed between 7 million and 10 million years ago, according to the statement. And they've also found microscopic pieces of plants, known as phytoliths, revealing that palm trees, grasses, gingers and other flowering plants grew there in what may have been a subtropical forest.
paras.zh: 这颗牙齿并不是证明阿塔卡马地区在中新世晚期是一个湿润地区的唯一线索。声明称，研究人员在 700 万至 1000 万年前存在的浅海环境遗迹层中发现了它。他们还发现了被称为植硅体的植物微观碎片，表明棕榈树、草、生姜和其他开花植物生长在可能是亚热带森林的地方。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: These findings and others are part of a growing body of evidence that the Atacama Desert was once wet enough for crocodiles and freshwater fish to thrive and palms to grow. The new study, published Sept. 5 in the journal Scientific Reports, shows that capybara relatives lived there as well during the late Miocene, which, because they are semiaquatic animals, is further evidence to support the hypothesis of a sporadically moist Atacama.
paras.zh: 这些发现和其他发现是越来越多证据的一部分，表明阿塔卡马沙漠曾经足够潮湿，适合鳄鱼和淡水鱼繁衍生息，也适合棕榈树生长。 9 月 5 日发表在《科学报告》杂志上的这项新研究表明，在中新世晚期，水豚的亲戚也生活在那里，因为它们是半水生动物，这进一步证明了阿塔卡马地区存在零星湿润的假说。

paras.en: The researchers aren't sure how exactly capybaras moved into the Atacama Desert. Although there were capybaras in South America at the time, the Andes created an 18,000-foot-high (5,500 meters) barrier between their current habitats and the site where the tooth was found. The researchers theorized that, instead of traversing the mountains, the ancient capybaras migrated along the western coast of South America, following wetlands, rivers and other water sources.
paras.zh: 研究人员不确定水豚究竟是如何进入阿塔卡马沙漠的。尽管当时南美洲也有水豚，但安第斯山脉在它们目前的栖息地和发现水豚牙齿的地点之间形成了一道 18,000 英尺高（5,500 米）的屏障。研究人员推测，古代水豚并没有穿越山脉，而是沿着湿地、河流和其他水源沿着南美洲西海岸迁徙。

paras.en: According to Samantha Hopkins, an Earth sciences professor at the University of Oregon who was not involved in the study, it's unlikely the tooth found its way to the site without capybaras living there.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈大学地球科学教授萨曼莎·霍普金斯（Samantha Hopkins）没有参与这项研究，她表示，如果没有水豚生活在那里，这颗牙齿不太可能到达该地点。

paras.en: "If you wanted to find a way that this capybara could be here while the Atacama was still as dry as it is today, you'd have a hard row to hoe," she told Live Science in an email, because the size of the tooth makes it hard to transport it long distances. The desert wind couldn't have blown it such a long way, and while large carcasses can float down waterways for miles, "if you're going to invoke a large enough waterway to do this, you've demonstrated that the Atacama wasn't as dry as it is today anyway."
paras.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“如果你想找到一种方法，在阿塔卡马仍然像今天这样干燥的时候，让这只水豚出现在这里，你将很难锄地，”她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，因为牙齿的大小使其很难长距离运输。沙漠风不可能把它吹这么远，虽然大型尸体可以沿着水道漂浮数英里，“如果你要调用足够大的水道来做到这一点，你就已经证明了阿塔卡马河无论如何也不像今天那么干燥。”

paras.en: Gutstein, C. S., Martinez, P. R., Carrapa, B., Clementz, M. T., Cherem, J. J., Cozzuol, M. A., Strömberg, C. a. E., Suárez, M. E., Chavarría, C. C., & Roux, J. P. L. (2026). Late Miocene capybara in the Atacama Desert reveals a wetter climate and a transcontinental dispersal pathway. Scientific Reports. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-67368-2
paras.zh: Gutstein, C. S.、Martinez, P. R.、Carrapa, B.、Clementz, M. T.、Cherem, J. J.、Cozzuol, M. A.、Strömberg, C. a. E.、Suárez, M. E.、Chavarría, C. C. 和 Roux, J. P. L. (2026)。阿塔卡马沙漠中中新世晚期的水豚揭示了更湿润的气候和跨大陆的扩散途径。科学报告。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-67368-2

paras.en: Damien Pine (he/him) is a freelance writer, artist, and former NASA engineer. He writes about science, physics, tech, art, and other topics with a focus on making complicated ideas accessible. He has a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Connecticut, and he gets really excited every time he sees a cat.
paras.zh: 达米恩·派恩（Damien Pine）（他/他）是一位自由作家、艺术家和前美国宇航局工程师。他撰写的文章涉及科学、物理、技术、艺术和其他主题，重点是让复杂的想法变得容易理解。他拥有康涅狄格大学机械工程学位，每次看到猫他都会非常兴奋。
