paras.en: Republicans currently have a slim majority in the House, holding 218 seats to the Democrats' 214. With less than a month until Election Day, an NPR analysis of both parties' campaigns highlights key races that will shape control of the House in 2027. The Cook Political Report lists 43 competitive districts, including 22 toss-ups. But both parties are pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into shaping a much larger electoral landscape.

- 🎧 Some districts that voted for Trump and a Democratic House representative, or vice versa, in 2024 are expected to be close again in the midterms. But NPR's Stephen Fowler says the political landscape has changed drastically since then. With an unpopular president, rising prices and strong anti-incumbency sentiments, many more districts are now competitive. The unpopularity of the current administration, particularly among Latino voters who supported Trump, could lead to new Republican-drawn districts electing Democrats. There's a massive amount of money involved in these campaigns; AdImpact reports half a billion dollars in House ads leading up to Election Day. Both parties are essentially throwing a huge amount of resources at the wall to see what sticks, Fowler says.

paras.en: The Davidson County Chancery Court in Nashville has ordered Tennessee prison officials to preserve all evidence related to the botched lethal injection of Christa Pike last week. This includes log books, medical waste and all communications from officials involved in the execution attempt. The court granted Pike's attorneys "liberal access" to her, requiring prison officials to respond to requests for in-person visits within two hours. Pike's attorneys said that she is now awake, speaking and receiving critical medical care after several days of unconsciousness.

paras.en: - ➡️ Meanwhile, Trump has approved the execution of a former U.S. Army psychiatrist by firing squad. Nidal Hasan killed 13 people in 2009 during a shooting at Fort Hood, Texas. This would mark the first U.S. military execution in more than 60 years and the first by firing squad since World War II. Secretary of the Army Adam Telle announced that Hasan will be executed at Fort Hood on Dec. 3. The Pentagon's decision, including the choice of firing squad, remains unclear, but some experts that NPR spoke with say it may relate to recent concerns over Pike's botched lethal injection.

paras.en: CNN, MS NOW and Politico are in federal court today to argue that Trump is infringing on their constitutional rights by blocking their access to the White House. The news outlets say that they have the right to determine how, what and where they can cover the president at any given time. A judge last month issued a temporary restraining order preventing the Trump administration from barring the outlets from the White House while the court considered the lawsuit.

- 🎧 NPR's David Folkenflik says the White House has inconsistently followed the judge's order, including not allowing CNN to do the work it typically does at smaller spaces, like Air Force One. Although the White House has the right to deny access to its grounds, once credentials are granted, they cannot be revoked for dissatisfaction with the speech. The White House has been saying these outlets report fake news and have cited national security concerns, referencing questions from the outlets about the bunker and areas below the East Wing's newly renovated ballroom.

paras.en: by Cooper Katz McKim, The Indicator from Planet Money associate producer
The cost of diesel fuel is breaking records left and right. The previous record was $5.85/gallon. A few weeks ago, it hit $6.53/gallon. If I drove a diesel car, I might stay home.

At the Indicator, we've been watching whether President Trump would try to lower prices by banning exports of diesel fuel. He did not do that, though he did make diesel cheaper by expanding the use of tax-exempt diesel for highway vehicles through the end of the year. Still, I wondered why diesel prices are so consistently higher than regular gas.
The answer: NO! Before 2004, diesel was actually cheaper. But step by step, the price got higher.
The first domino to fall: taxes. In 1993, the federal excise tax on diesel increased to 24.4 cents, 6 cents more than the regular gas tax.
Soon after, demand for diesel began to skyrocket. China and India were ramping up industrialization, agriculture and new infrastructure to new levels. The world saw diesel vehicles take off.
In the U.S., the last major domino to fall was air quality standards. In 2006, diesel fuel needed to have less sulfur, which required new — and more expensive — refining and distribution methods.

One lesson that stuck with me is how diesel is essential for the modern economy. It's needed in shipping, long-haul trucking, mining and backup generators. Whether the cost is high or low, the demand is there. Regular gasoline? Demand is a little squishier.

Are you feeling nervous about facing a high-stakes event, such as a race or a job interview? Well, get ready to face those challenges head-on with the help of psychologist Cindra Kamphoff, the author of The Confidence Habit: 7 Core Practices to Transform Self-Doubt into Self-Belief. She shared with Life Kit some of her creative strategies for managing fear and negativity to overcome anxiety and build confidence before, during and after big tasks.
- 🏃 Practice positive self-talk. Even small affirmations can boost your self-esteem. You can even write them on your arm to remind yourself during events like races.
- 🏃 Set a range of goals instead of aiming for one perfect outcome. This approach can help to reduce anxiety by lowering the pressure and encouraging you to focus on the present moment.

- 🏃 When negative thoughts creep in before your task, ask yourself: Is this thought true? Is it serving me? And what empowering statement can I replace it with? This approach pauses negativity and helps you refocus on the present.

- NPR's Diaa Hadid is sending greetings from the Lahore High Court in Pakistan for this week's installment of Far-Flung Postcards. She describes it as "a near-perfect example of British South Asian colonial architecture."
- Opal Lee, the Grandmother of Juneteenth, celebrated her 100th birthday at the future site of the National Juneteenth Museum in Texas. (via KERA)
- A remarkably intact fossil discovery has given scientists new evidence about when the ability to chew and swallow food emerged among mammals.

articles.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay

CORONADO, Calif. — After more than 10 months at sea, thousands of sailors Thursday poured out of the the USS Lincoln on San Diego Bay to thunderous cheers, streaming tears and emotional hugs, marking a homecoming that included new dads who met babies born while they were away on a historic deployment supporting the Iran war.

The reunion followed an emotional rollercoaster for families who described crying and losing sleep after hearing reports of supply shortages and deteriorating mental health among the crew during the deployment that spent a record 265 days of uninterrupted time at sea. Many said they only could communicate with family via the occasional email or rare WhatsApp calls.
Abel Ramirez, 20, was glad to have that all behind him. He walked off the carrier with a big grin, overjoyed that his first deployment was over.
"It feels amazing," he said while headed out to search for his parents who traveled from Texas. "There was a certain point when I never thought I would come off."
Cassity Garduque, 14, waved as her mom in her sailor uniform frantically waved back from the top deck after the ship docked at the pier.
"It feels really overwhelming," she said about being seeing her mom again. "She missed most of my seventh grade and my birthday."
She added that she's happy her mom won't be eating ramen almost every day and can celebrate with her now.

Capt. Daniel Keeler, the ship's commander, said most of the crew was on their first deployment and that the issues they faced were normal for such a long deployment, adding everyone had access to four meals a day.
"It's a floating city as you can see and at any moment there might be a clogged toilet," he said.
The Navy has downplayed problems on the carrier
The Navy initially downplayed any problems during the deployment, and President Donald Trump commented in August that the Lincoln's lengthy deployment was "not nearly long enough."
Navy leaders eventually acknowledged there were some issues aboard.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth flew out to the Lincoln on Wednesday to give the crew the Presidential Unit Citation, the highest honor a unit can receive.

Hegseth told the crew that "what makes the U.S. military and the U.S. Navy and all these sailors different is that you adapt and that you're resilient and you overcome — you finish the mission nonetheless."
Hegseth pushed back against what he said were efforts to turn the "Lincoln into some sort of a symbol, a symbol of dysfunction or a symbol of low morale or a symbol of a failed mission."
USS Lincoln crew looks forward to family and favorite meals

The Lincoln, which set a record for uninterrupted time at sea, is the second carrier to endure an unusually long deployment during the Iran war and to receive the Presidential Unit Citation afterward, typically reserved for significant achievement in combat.

The crew of the USS Gerald R. Ford returned in May from a 326-day deployment — the longest for an aircraft carrier in the past 50 years and a record in the post-Vietnam War era. The Lincoln's deployment of 322 days was just shy of that.

Among the first to depart the carrier at the naval base in Coronado were 64 fathers meeting their babies for the first time, the Navy said. With the airwing included, there were 122 new dads, Keeler said.
Waiting for the Lincoln to bring her husband home, sailor Kathy Monterrosa held her 6-month-old daughter, Sarahi, outfitted in a tiny blue and white sailor dress.
"She's our deployment baby," said Monterrosa, of Virginia Beach, Virginia.
It was tough to hear about the ship's conditions while she was pregnant, she said. "I was crying a lot and worried. I wasn't sure if he was OK or not," she said.
When she finally heard from her husband, he told her it was "pretty bad," but now she said she feels blessed to have her family home.
Sailor Steven Rivas beamed as he held is 7-month-old daughter.

"I couldn't grasp the reality of it," he said about coming home. He became overwhelmed as they pulled into the bay, "seeing everyone and knowing my family was waiting for me," Rivas said, his voice shaking as his eyes teared up.
Alma Solano Velez said her husband gave his family an extensive list of the foods he has been craving over the past 10 months: oxtail, barbecue chicken, broccoli and shrimp empanadas to name a few.
He had told his wife about "the lack of food and showers" on board and was looking forward to seeing their daughter, who turned 4 while he was away, she said.
The carrier left San Diego in November and arrived in the Middle East in January. U.S. and Israeli forces launched airstrikes against Iran on Feb. 28.
In August, acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao said the Lincoln maintained adequate food supplies, but because combat operations limited resupply opportunities, meal options were reduced for a short time.
After more than 10 months at sea, the Lincoln's crew got a stop in Thailand early last month on the way back from the Middle East.
Long deployments can tax service members
Extended naval deployments can wear on service members who are away from home for long periods and increase strain on the ship and its equipment.
The Navy told lawmakers that eight sailors attempted suicide during the record-setting deployment, though experts say that number is low in a strike group of 6,000 sailors over 10 months.

According to the citation that Hegseth read to the crew, the Lincoln and its strike group executed nearly 3,700 combat missions, launched 450 Tomahawk cruise missiles, shot down 77 one-way attack drones, sank 64 Iranian warships, and destroyed 21 anti-ship cruise missiles.
Another carrier, the usually Asia-based USS George Washington, relieved the Lincoln in the Middle East in August.

articles.title: Brian Schottenheimer now sits on hottest seat in NFL after Cowboys collapse against Buccaneers

paras.en: It’s official: Dallas Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer has the hottest seat in the NFL.

Schottenheimer was stumped on the sideline at AT&T Stadium on Thursday night as his squad fell 24-16 to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who entered the game 0-4 and started a rookie quarterback in his first career road game.

Jalon Daniels was quite efficient against a reeling Cowboys defense, which came into this game as the third-worst in the league in terms of yards allowed per game (389.5) and fifth-worst in points allowed (28). The defensive side of the ball was a problem during Schottenheimer’s inaugural season leading the Cowboys in 2025, and with 34-year-old Christian Parker as defensive coordinator, it’s more of the same in 2026.
The reason Schottenheimer’s seat is the hottest is because the man facing him on the opposite sideline came into Week 5 in that position first.

Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles is fighting for his job security after a brutal start to the season. Yes, his starting quarterback, Baker Mayfield, is out, but the Buccaneers did not look good before his injury. And since Tampa Bay couldn’t make the playoffs last season despite a red-hot start, Bowles needs to start stacking wins.

The state of Tampa Bay, and a Dallas victory over the Houston Texans in Week 4, led Vegas to mark the Cowboys as a clear-cut favorite at home. But Dak Prescott never felt comfortable like he did in Week 4, with Bowles drawing up his signature blitzes throughout the four quarters, and the Dallas defense continued to be passive.

Tampa Bay found itself down at halftime, 10-7, but shifty running back Bucky Irving changed the entire momentum of the contest when he sprinted 72 yards on the opening drive of the third quarter to set up an Emeka Egbuka touchdown. In just two plays, the Bucs went 86 yards and took the lead, shocking the sold-out crowd.

To make matters worse, the Cowboys would turn the ball over their next three possessions, leading to a lopsided game. Prescott threw an interception, and Daniels found Tez Johnson in busted coverage for a 64-yard catch-and-run. Irving scored his second touchdown of the game to further the Bucs’ lead, and Prescott wouldn’t even get the ball back after KaVontae Turpin fumbled the ensuing kickoff, which Tampa Bay recovered.
With a Chase McLaughlin field goal making it 24-10, the Cowboys felt desperate at the end of the third quarter, going for it on fourth down near midfield and failing to convert.

There was, however, some hope provided by a key stop from this lackluster defense. On fourth-and-goal from the one-yard line, Bowles decided to go for the kill shot, hoping to punch one into the end zone and make it a 31-10 game in the fourth quarter. But Sean Tucker, their short-yardage specialist in the backfield, was unable to punch it home.
From there, Schottenheimer put on his best play-calling hat and recognized that momentum was shifting toward Dallas despite the Buccaneers’ 99-yard drive. He and Prescott delivered.
George Pickens capped that 99-yard drive with a 17-yard touchdown catch, his first of the season, to make it a one score game after a two-point conversion failed.

The momentum continued, as the Buccaneers went three-and-out, and with ample time as well as timeouts, Prescott could go down the field and perhaps tie the game with a touchdown and two-point conversion. Instead, more disaster for the Cowboys in this primetime matchup, as tight end Jake Ferguson, usually as sure-handed as they come for Dallas, had a Prescott pass go right through his hands, hit his face mask and land in the arms of Buccaneers linebacker Alex Anzalone while in Tampa Bay territory.

paras.en: This time, Daniels and the Buccaneers’ offense didn’t squander the chance to put the Cowboys away, as Irving picked up the necessary first down to allow his rookie quarterback some victory kneels to end the game.

Sure, the Cowboys' record still reads 2-3 compared to the Buccaneers' 1-4. But Jerry Jones demands winning in Dallas, and this was a brutal loss for a coach already stirring speculation about whether he’s right for one of the most coveted jobs in the sport.
There’s still many games left to play, but it’s truly heating up for Schottenheimer after this one.

articles.title: Guardians force decisive ALDS Game 5 as White Sox miss chance to reach first ALCS since 2005

paras.en: With three of the four spots in the league championship series already clinched, Thursday night’s White Sox-Guardians matchup was the lone game on MLB’s postseason schedule. It gave Chicago an opportunity to end its long American League Championship Series drought.
Instead, the White Sox came up short, falling 9-5 in Game 4. A victory would have sent Chicago to the ALCS for the first time in more than two decades. The team’s last appearance came in 2005.
Cleveland’s two fifth-inning home runs powered the Guardians to their second straight win in the series and forced a decisive Game 5 on Saturday.
The White Sox started fast, building on their 1-0 lead when Sam Antonacci’s sacrifice fly in the third inning extended it to 2-0.
The Guardians quickly answered, with Patrick Bailey and José Ramírez hitting home runs in the top of the fifth inning.

Chicago answered in the bottom of the fifth. After Sam Antonacci was hit by a pitch, the White Sox rallied to tie the game at 3-3. A sacrifice fly by outfielder Brenton Doyle then put Chicago ahead 4-3.
That proved to be the White Sox’s final lead of the night.

Miguel Vargas’ solo home run to left field in the bottom of the ninth gave Chicago a chance to mount a comeback. The White Sox put two runners on base later in the inning but ultimately could not complete the rally.
Game 5 of the ALDS shifts back to Cleveland, with the first pitch scheduled for 8 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Mamdani demands Trump release illegal immigrant shot by ICE agent as protests erupt in the Bronx

paras.en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani demanded that President Donald Trump end all ICE enforcement in the state after a federal agent shot an illegal immigrant in the Bronx on Thursday, sparking protests and confrontations with law enforcement.
At a news conference late Thursday night, Mamdani condemned the shooting and said he spoke with Trump for about two hours following the incident.
Mamdani said he urged Trump to have the man released – an effort that was unsuccessful – and said New York City wants ICE agents out.
"All they do is terrorize this city," the mayor said of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
Mamdani also accused ICE of acting "with impunity" and spreading "chaos and terror" across the country, alleging that ICE has killed more people than it has saved.
"Today's shooting is only further devastating confirmation of what we have long known," the mayor said.
Mamdani also confirmed that the man who was shot has been transported out of the hospital by ICE agents.
New York Gov. Kathy Hochul also said she spoke to Trump and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin.

"Tonight, I spoke with President Trump and DHS Secretary Mullin about the shooting in Marble Hill," she said on X. "I expressed outrage on behalf of New Yorkers and urged them to halt ICE enforcement operations in New York. I also asked that any body camera footage of the shooting be released to the public so we can establish the facts and get to the truth."

ICE was attempting to arrest a wanted man from the Dominican Republic at around 4 p.m. on Thursday when an agent opened fire and wounded him, according to DHS, which did not provide details on what led to the shooting.

"ICE officers immediately rendered aid. The individual is alive and at a local hospital. The FBI and HSI are on the scene. The incident remains under investigation. More information will be shared as it becomes available," DHS said in a statement.

DHS said the man, who was described as an illegal immigrant, had a prior grand larceny conviction and previous arrests involving assault, robbery, drug possession and weapons possession. The agency also alleged that he had ties to the Trinitarios gang.

Later Thursday night, New York City Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch identified the man as a 28-year-old and said a 5-year-old boy believed to be his son was inside the vehicle with him during the shooting.

"Based on evidence collected at the scene, we know that at least one ICE agent discharged the seven rounds, striking the driver in the neck below his left ear," Tisch said, adding that the boy was not injured and is in the care of a family member.
The agency said the man was arrested by New York City police on Dec. 7, 2023, but was released several days later. DHS blamed New York City's sanctuary policies for his release.

Hundreds of demonstrators gathered outside NewYork-Presbyterian Allen Hospital, where the wounded man was being treated, and chanting "ICE off our streets" and "No justice, no peace." Protesters and police were seen shoving one another during the demonstration as officers began to set barricades, and some demonstrators threw water bottles at the officers.
"From Palestine to Mexico, all these walls have got to go," the group chanted.
Police made some arrests during the demonstration.
The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.title: Firmus pulls biggest ASX float since Telstra amid investor doubt about datacentre company
articles.author: Jonathan Barrett  and Josh Taylor

paras.en: Firmus Technologies has scrapped what was set to be Australia’s biggest company listing in decades after investor demand for its much-hyped AI datacentre business failed to materialise.
A Firmus spokesperson said the board decided that proceeding with the offer was no longer in the best interests of the company and its shareholders.
“Firmus will now pursue capital from the private markets and consider alternative public and private market options,” the spokesperson said on Friday morning.
“We will provide additional information to shareholders as those options progress.”
Firmus, with an anticipated $44bn valuation, was expected to be the biggest ASX listing since Telstra in 1997.
But it faced mounting scepticism over its huge valuation, and forecast earnings, for a company in its startup phase with just two, small operational sites.

Backed by chip maker Nvidia and Wall Street firms Blackstone, Jane Street and Coatue, Firmus’s backers believed they could raise billions of dollars by selling shares in a public float with the help of five brokers.
The lack of demand means Firmus will need to raise money from private investors to fund its plans to build liquid-cooled “AI factories” in Australia and across Asia.

The polished Firmus pitch started to unravel midweek after it became clear the company’s bankers had vastly overestimated demand in their bid to raise $7bn from investors ahead of listing on the ASX on 23 October.
This prompted discussions about a heavy reduction in the company’s proposed $11-a-share initial public offering, according to one investment manager briefed on the matter.
The company ultimately decided to withdraw its application to list on the ASX altogether.

Guardian Australia previously reported growing concern that early Firmus investors were going to use retail investors buying into the float as their “exit strategy”, leaving small investors exposed if the excitement dissipated.
The datacentre company’s troubles have already rattled other parts of the market, with shares in Firmus investor Maas Group plunging more than 20% on Thursday.
The anticipated financial worth of the founders – Oliver Curtis, his cousin Tim Rosenfield, and Curtis’s former brother-in-law Jonathan Levee – will also be greatly reduced.
‘Diverging’ mission blamed for CDC split

Veteran datacentre firm CDC this week ended what was touted as a $73bn deal with Firmus named Project Southgate, which was aimed at building sovereign, renewable-powered AI infrastructure and which claimed Nvidia as its first customer.

On Friday, appearing at the federal parliament’s joint standing committee on AI, CDC’s chief strategy officer, Dr Jack Dan, said the arrangements began when Firmus’s focus was “a lot more on Australia and creating sovereign AI capability in Australia.”

“Their business model has then since evolved and probably the most blunt way of putting it is we have a very clear business model and a very clear mission for our company,” he said. “And when things start diverging significantly from that, we continue to follow our core mission.”
The deal was first announced in October last year.
Dan said Firmus had a “very different approach to developing datacentres” and CDC is “very much about critical infrastructure, very significant resilience … essentially 100% availability.”

“That comes with a certain degree of assurance, a certain degree of rigor and a certain degree of process, which probably was or could have been construed as being a little bit too heavy for a more commercial type development.”

Earlier in the hearing, Dan observed that CDC had been around for nearly 20 years, and until last year, “no one really cared who CDC datacentres was” but now datacentres were front and centre of the national conversation.

articles.title: Sydney trader sacked for working from Singapore without permission wins unfair dismissal case
articles.author: Nino Bucci Courts and justice reporter

paras.en: A Sydney currency trader who was sacked for working from Singapore without approval has won an unfair dismissal case, but failed to be awarded compensation.
The Fair Work Commission ruled on Wednesday that Charles Graham had been unfairly dismissed by HIFX Australia, trading as Xe, in December last year.
Graham was sacked after his manager asked an IT worker to use his “FBI skills” and track the IP address on Graham’s laptop.

They discovered he was working from Singapore. It was also later discovered he had previously worked from Bali after telling his manager he was working from home because he had a plumber “coming around to sort out some recurring bathroom issues”.
Graham was sacked as Xe found he knew he had to get prior approval to work overseas and was to attend the office three times a week.
He said he had been holidaying in Singapore before his partner became ill with a bacterial infection, preventing him from returning to Australia.
He provided documentation, which he said showed his partner required medical treatment.
Graham had previously asked Xe if he could relocate to Singapore, but his request was denied.

Fair Work Commission commissioner Alana Matheson said that after the company sent an email to Graham advising him of its discovery on 17 November last year, the “tone … had clearly pivoted” by the following day, when he was told “there was a case to answer regarding alleged breaches of company policy”.
Over the following 10 days, a series of further email exchanges and a discussion between Xe managers took place.

Graham said in his written response to Xe that he travelled to Singapore for a holiday and that there was no relation to his previous request to relocate there, that the decision to reschedule the return flight to Australia was made over a weekend, and that as there was no expectation or precedent that he contacted his manager outside business hours, he could not inform them of this.

He said that when he did log on from Singapore rather than in Australia “he was bombarded with triaging hundreds of unread emails from his time off, fielding inbound calls and dealing with an eligible complaint from a high-value client”, and this took priority over telling his manager he was stuck overseas.

Among his other responses was that he only intended to spend a short amount of time overseas, he had not been told about specific policies regarding hybrid work, and that he had intended to let his manager know he was overseas as soon as practicable.

The company was not swayed and on 2 December last year sent him a termination letter that stated it had carefully reviewed his written submissions and found that he had not provided flight screenshots with his name, medical evidence that showed his partner was unable to travel, an adequate explanation for not telling his manager he was in Singapore, and had previously complied with “absence and approval processes”, demonstrating that he was familiar with them and had instead made “a conscious choice not to follow” them.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “Your conduct represents a serious breach of company policy, a failure to follow lawful and reasonable instructions, and an irreparable breakdown of trust and confidence,” it said in the letter.
Graham told the commission he worked remotely twice before November 2025: the previous year from Townsville, and in April and May 2025 from Bali. He had been employed by Xe for 20 months.
But his manager said she had not been aware he had ever worked remotely from overseas.

A Microsoft Teams message from Graham to his manager was included in evidence before the commission that detailed his claim he was working from home as he had a plumbing issue during one of the days he also told the commission he worked from Bali.
Matheson found that she was satisfied that the dismissal of Graham was unreasonable because while there was a valid reason for his dismissal, the process followed was procedurally unfair.
This was because Xe failed to fully raise the matters it was relying on in making the decision to dismiss Graham, Matheson said.
She found that reinstatement was inappropriate but also decided against awarding compensation.
This was, she said, in part because his misconduct contributed to the decision to dismiss him, and he was paid four weeks in lieu of notice.

articles.title: Virgin unveils its future cross-Channel train as it gears up to take on Eurostar
articles.author: Gwyn Topham Transport correspondent

paras.en: Flash interiors, fancy food and maybe even a bar: Virgin has unveiled a mock-up of its future cross-Channel train, with a pledge to create “something genuinely new”.
paras.zh: 闪光灯内饰、美食甚至酒吧：维珍推出了未来跨海峡列车的模型，并承诺创造“真正的新事物”。

paras.en: The group is planning to launch rail services from London to the continent in 2030, with Eurostar facing competition for the first time since the opening of the Channel tunnel.
paras.zh: 该集团计划在2030年推出从伦敦到非洲大陆的铁路服务，欧洲之星自英吉利海峡隧道开通以来首次面临竞争。

paras.en: Virgin has ordered 12 trains from the manufacturer Alstom, and will hope to outshine Eurostar on design and customer experience as it fits them out.
paras.zh: 维珍航空已从制造商阿尔斯通订购了12列火车，并希望在设计和客户体验方面超越欧洲之星。

paras.en: While Virgin’s last stab at reimagining UK train travel may have peaked with the talking toilet seat on its intercity services in 2013, it has said the future trains will be inspired from its airline, cruise and hotel arms.

Although details are being kept firmly under wraps, it said it would draw on Virgin Atlantic’s airport lounges, or Clubhouses, for “pre-departure and onboard social spaces” with “more flexibility to work, relax or socialise in style”. Food will be influenced by its cruise line menu and the design by its Virgin Hotels brand.

Josh Bayliss, the chief executive of Virgin Group, said: “Virgin has a proud history in UK rail. With our latest venture we are drawing on more than four decades of experience across travel and hospitality to create something genuinely new.

“We’re confident that more journeys between the UK and Europe will be made by train. We’re adding capacity for millions more international rail journeys each year, growing the market as a whole. We’re looking forward to seeing our distinctive red and black trains travelling across Europe.”
Virgin will also look to connect its rail and airline networks, potentially bringing passengers from France for Virgin Atlantic flights.

The Office of Rail and Road on Thursday published an agreement with Eurostar for Virgin to maintain its trains at the Temple Mills international depot in east London, with track access in the UK confirmed until at least 2040.

Italy’s state-owned Trenitalia is also expected to launch cross-Channel high-speed services. It already runs international trains as far as Paris and recently announced its own €2bn order for 19 new trains from Hitachi, some of which are expected to be based in France and run through the tunnel to London.

articles.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says

paras.en: The public will be able to watch the execution of a former US Army major by firing squad, US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has said.
paras.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯（ Pete Hegseth ）表示，公众将能够通过行刑队观看前美国陆军少校的处决。

paras.en: A Defense Department official told the BBC the execution of Nidal Hasan, who shot dead 13 unarmed US soldiers at Fort Hood in 2009, would be livestreamed.
paras.zh: 一名国防部官员告诉英国广播公司， 2009年在胡德堡枪杀13名手无寸铁的美国士兵的尼达尔·哈桑（ Nidal Hasan ）将被直播。

paras.en: It is believed it would be the first public execution in the US in almost a century. The decision to livestream it is "unprecedented in the modern era" and "on uncertain legal terrain," said John Mills, a lawyer who works with inmates sentenced to death.
paras.zh: 据信，这将是近一个世纪以来美国首次公开处决。与被判死刑的囚犯一起工作的律师约翰·米尔斯（ John Mills ）说，直播的决定“在现代是前所未有的” ，而且“法律环境不确定”。

paras.en: "We'll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it's public," Hegseth said.
paras.zh: “我们将确保人们能够观看它，它是公开的，” Hegseth说。

paras.en: "People need to understand that there's serious consequences for these types of things."
paras.zh: “人们需要明白，这类事情会产生严重后果。”

paras.en: The Pentagon announced earlier this week it would execute Hasan in the first military execution in more than 60 years.
paras.zh: 五角大楼本周早些时候宣布，它将在60多年来的第一次军事处决中处决哈桑。

paras.en: Hegseth said in an interview with conservative TV outlet Real America's Voice that Hasan is "gonna get a firing squad of soldiers. As it should be".
paras.zh: Hegseth在接受保守派电视台Real America's Voice的采访时说， Hasan “将得到一支行刑队。理应如此"。

paras.en: Asked if Hasan had made any final requests or reached out to President Donald Trump, Hegseth said: "Don't care. We'll see him on December 3rd."
paras.zh: 当被问及哈桑是否提出了任何最终要求或与唐纳德·特朗普总统联系时，赫格塞斯说： “不在乎。我们会在12月3日见到他。”

paras.en: A Pentagon spokesperson said on Monday that Trump had approved the defence secretary's recommendation. The BBC has asked White House whether Trump supports a livestreamed public execution.
paras.zh: 五角大楼发言人周一表示，特朗普已经批准了国防部长的建议。英国广播公司问白宫，特朗普是否支持直播公开处决。

paras.en: While there were more than 2,700 executions across 17 countries last year, only two countries carried them out publicly.
paras.zh: 虽然去年在17个国家有2700多人被处决，但只有两个国家公开执行。

paras.en: Eleven public executions were known to have been carried out in Iran in 2025, and another six in Afghanistan, according to Amnesty International.
paras.zh: 据大赦国际称，已知2025年在伊朗执行了11次公开处决，在阿富汗又执行了6次处决。

paras.en: The execution is scheduled to take place at Fort Hood in Texas on 3 December, the secretary of the US Army said on Tuesday. It will be the first military execution by firing squad since the end of World War Two.
paras.zh: 美国陆军部长周二表示，处决定于12月3日在德克萨斯州的胡德堡举行。这将是第二次世界大战结束以来首次由行刑队执行的军事处决。

paras.en: Hasan, a US Army psychiatrist from Virginia, has admitted fatally shooting 13 unarmed soldiers in a crowded medical building at Fort Hood in 2009.
paras.zh: 来自弗吉尼亚州的美国陆军精神病学家哈桑承认， 2009年在胡德堡一座拥挤的医疗大楼里， 13名手无寸铁的士兵被枪杀。

paras.en: At court he apologised for "any mistakes". He said during his court martial in 2013 that he believed he was protecting Muslims and the Taliban in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 在法庭上，他为“任何错误”道歉。他在2013年的军事法庭上说，他相信自己正在保护阿富汗的穆斯林和塔利班。

paras.en: A military execution requires approval from the US president, according to military law. It also requires appellate review, where a higher court inspects the decision, and a final judgement on its legality to move forward.
paras.zh: 根据军事法律，军事处决需要得到美国总统的批准。它还要求上诉复审，由上级法院检查决定，并对其合法性进行最终判决。

paras.en: The appellate process for Hasan is not over, Mills said, and he is likely to seek review of his conviction and sentence in federal court, which would likely stay the execution.
paras.zh: 米尔斯说，哈桑的上诉程序尚未结束，他可能会在联邦法院寻求对他的定罪和判决进行复审，这可能会延缓执行。

paras.en: As such, Mills said that he would be surprised if the execution happened.
paras.zh: 因此，米尔斯说，如果处决发生，他会感到惊讶。

paras.en: "Seeking to make it livestreamed, a firing squad execution, is little more than attention-seeking by the Trump administration and is unlikely to occur, much less deliver any semblance of justice," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说： “试图让它直播，一个行刑队执行，只不过是特朗普政府寻求注意力，不太可能发生，更不用说提供任何正义的外表了。”

paras.en: Eugene R Fidell, a visiting lecturer at Yale Law School, told the BBC it was a "really unfortunate decision".
paras.zh: 耶鲁大学法学院客座讲师尤金· R ·菲德尔（ Eugene R Fidell ）告诉英国广播公司，这是一个“非常不幸的决定”。

paras.en: "To livestream an execution is just so out of the Middle Ages. In a way, we are so past that as a society, at least I thought so until today," he said.
paras.zh: “直播处决是中世纪的事。在某种程度上，我们已经过去了，作为一个社会，至少直到今天我还是这么认为，”他说。

paras.en: Fidell said if Hasan pursued legal action, the "proceedings would last years" and "far longer than President Trump's term in the White House".
paras.zh: 菲德尔表示，如果哈桑采取法律行动， “诉讼程序将持续数年” ， “远远超过特朗普总统在白宫的任期”。

paras.en: Certain states require some form of public viewing of executions. Many states require journalists to be present, and the person due to be executed can invite people. Others also allow ordinary citizens to volunteer as witnesses.
paras.zh: 某些州要求某种形式的公众观看处决。许多州要求记者在场，即将被处决的人可以邀请他人。其他法律也允许普通公民自愿出庭作证。

paras.en: But "there hasn't ever been a livestreamed execution," says Deborah Denno, a law professor at Fordham University, who has studied US execution methods.
paras.zh: 但福特汉姆大学研究美国处决方法的法学教授黛博拉·丹诺（ Deborah Denno ）说： “从未有过直播处决。”

paras.en: A livestreamed execution would "force a level of transparency that we have probably never seen before in this country", she says.
paras.zh: 她说，直播执行将“迫使我们达到我们在这个国家可能从未见过的透明度”。

paras.en: "More than half of the country wants the death penalty - even though that's on the decline - an argument could be made that 'if you want the death penalty, then we are going to show you how it's conducted in this country'. And people would have to realise exactly what's happening in a way that many people ignore."
paras.zh: “这个国家有一半以上的人想要死刑--尽管死刑正在减少--可以说， '如果你想要死刑，那么我们将向你展示它是如何在这个国家实施的'。人们必须以许多人忽视的方式准确地意识到正在发生的事情。”

paras.en: Denno says there are important considerations for a livestream such as whether it would be age-restricted and whether it would contravene the policies of the online platform that hosts the viewing.
paras.zh: Denno说，直播有一些重要的考虑因素，例如它是否有年龄限制，以及它是否会违反主持观看的在线平台的政策。

paras.en: It is unclear where the livestream will be available. Most major social media platforms have rules that prohibit or restrict livestreaming explicit content.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚直播地点在哪里。大多数主要的社交媒体平台都有禁止或限制直播露骨内容的规定。

paras.en: Meta, which owns Instagram, Facebook and Threads, explicitly bans any live stream of capital punishment. TikTok has a similar ban. X, which has loosened content moderation since Elon Musk took over, says content showing a person's death will be removed "if we receive a request from their family or an authorized representative."
paras.zh: 拥有Instagram、Facebook和Threads的Meta明确禁止任何死刑直播。TikTok也有类似的禁令。自伊隆·马斯克（ Elon Musk ）接管以来， X放松了内容审核，他说， “如果我们收到他们的家人或授权代表的请求” ，显示某人死亡的内容将被删除。

paras.en: Truth Social, the social media platform owned by Trump, does not have a live-stream video feature for users.
paras.zh: 特朗普拥有的社交媒体平台Truth Social没有为用户提供直播视频功能。

paras.en: The countries with the highest number of executions last year were China, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the US, in that order, Amnesty International data shows.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织数据显示，去年处决人数最多的国家依次是中国、伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、也门和美国。

paras.en: The US government had not executed anyone for 17 years until the final year of Trump's first term as president, when it conducted a flurry of 13 executions. Upon returning to office Trump swiftly overturned predecessor Joe Biden's moratorium on federal executions.
paras.zh: 直到特朗普第一任总统任期的最后一年，美国政府才对任何人执行了17年的处决，当时它进行了13次处决。特朗普上任后，迅速推翻了前任乔·拜登(Joe Biden)暂停联邦死刑的决定。

paras.en: The last military execution in the country took place in 1961, when a US Army private was hanged after being convicted of raping an 11-year-old Austrian girl. The execution was authorised by then-President Dwight D Eisenhower and took place despite the victim's family asking his successor, John F Kennedy, for clemency.
paras.zh: 该国最后一次军事处决发生在1961年，当时一名美国陆军士兵因强奸一名11岁的奥地利女孩而被判处绞刑。处决由当时的总统德怀特· D ·艾森豪威尔授权，尽管受害者的家人要求他的继任者约翰· F ·肯尼迪宽大处理。

paras.en: The last military execution by firing squad took place in January 1945, when a young US Army deserter, Eddie Slovik, was shot during the final months of the World War Two.
paras.zh: 行刑队的最后一次军事处决发生在1945年1月，当时一名年轻的美国陆军逃兵埃迪·斯洛维克（ Eddie Slovik ）在第二次世界大战的最后几个月被枪杀。

paras.en: With additional reporting by Kwasi Gyamfi Asiedu and Kali Hays
paras.zh: 由Kwasi Gyamfi Asiedu和Kali Hays补充报道

articles.title: ICE agent shoots man in New York City

paras.en: A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent shot a man in the Bronx in New York City on Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四，一名美国移民和海关执法局（ ICE ）特工在纽约市布朗克斯区开枪打死了一名男子。

paras.en: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), which runs the agency, confirmed an ICE officer "discharged his weapon" during "a targeted enforcement operation... to arrest a criminal illegal alien".
paras.zh: 负责该机构的国土安全部（ DHS ）证实，一名ICE官员在“有针对性的执法行动......逮捕一名犯罪非法外国人”期间“开枪”。

paras.en: In a statement, it added the man was alive and at a local hospital.
paras.zh: 在一份声明中，它补充说，这名男子还活着，在当地一家医院。

paras.en: New York mayor Zohran Mamdani said it was an "unconscionable and incredibly serious situation".
paras.zh: 纽约市长Zohran Mamdani表示，这是一个“不合情理且极其严重的情况”。

paras.en: "Early reports indicate agents surrounded him and a five-year-old child in his car before firing multiple rounds. We believe the child was physically unharmed," he said.
paras.zh: “早期的报告显示，特工在他的车里包围了他和一个五岁的孩子，然后发射了多发子弹。我们相信孩子的身体没有受到伤害，”他说。

paras.en: The BBC has approached DHS for comment about Mamdani's remarks.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司已就Mamdani的言论与国土安全部联系以征求意见。

paras.en: Late on Thursday evening, New York Governor Kathy Hochul said she had spoken to President Donald Trump about the shooting and had expressed "outrage on behalf of New Yorkers".
paras.zh: 周四晚间，纽约州州长凯西·霍丘尔（ Kathy Hochul ）表示，她已与唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）总统就枪击事件进行了交谈，并表示“代表纽约人表示愤慨”。

paras.en: "I also asked that any body camera footage of the shooting be released to the public so we can establish the facts and get to the truth."
paras.zh: “我还要求向公众发布枪击事件的任何人体摄像头镜头，以便我们能够确定事实并了解真相。”

paras.en: Trump has not yet commented publicly on the shooting.
paras.zh: 特朗普尚未公开评论枪击事件。

paras.en: The DHS said the man, who has not been named by officials, was from the Dominican Republic and had "a prior criminal conviction for grand larceny, and multiple prior arrests for assault, robbery, possession of drugs, and weapons possession".
paras.zh: 国土安全部表示，这名男子来自多米尼加共和国， “先前因重大盗窃罪被定罪，先前因殴打，抢劫，持有毒品和持有武器而被捕”。

paras.en: He was arrested by police officers in New York in December 2023 and released "a few days later", according to the DHS statement.
paras.zh: 根据国土安全部的声明，他于2023年12月在纽约被警察逮捕， “几天后”被释放。

paras.en: It also claimed he was associated with the Trinitarios, described by the US justice department as a transnational criminal group.
paras.zh: 它还声称他与Trinitarios有关，被美国司法部描述为跨国犯罪集团。

paras.en: Mamdani, meanwhile, said he would ask Trump to end ICE enforcement actions in the city.
paras.zh: 与此同时，马姆达尼表示，他将要求特朗普结束ICE在该市的执法行动。

paras.en: "I will not stand by while ICE agents terrorise our communities," he wrote on X on Thursday evening.
paras.zh: “在ICE特工恐吓我们的社区时，我不会袖手旁观，”他在周四晚上在X上写道。

paras.en: New York, which is a Democratic stronghold, is one of several American cities that bars its police officers from assisting with federal immigration enforcement.
paras.zh: 纽约是民主党的据点，是美国几个禁止其警察协助联邦移民执法的城市之一。

paras.en: A group of protesters gathered at the scene on Thursday evening, chanting "we want justice" and "ICE off our streets now".
paras.zh: 周四晚上，一群抗议者聚集在现场，高呼“我们想要正义”和“我们的街道现在结冰”。

paras.en: There have been several high-profile shootings involving ICE officers this year, including one which caused the death of Renee Good in Minneapolis in January.
paras.zh: 今年发生了几起涉及ICE官员的高调枪击事件，其中包括1月份在明尼阿波利斯造成Renee Good死亡的事件。

articles.title: As freezing winter approaches, Kyiv residents look for shelter elsewhere

paras.en: As Russia's attacks on Ukraine's cities intensify and autumn's cooler temperatures hint at another tough winter to come, Ukrainians are wrestling with how to meet the twin challenges ahead: Russian drone and missile strikes and the biting cold.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯对乌克兰城市的袭击加剧，秋天的凉爽气温暗示着另一个艰难的冬天即将到来，乌克兰人正在努力应对未来的双重挑战：俄罗斯的无人机和导弹袭击以及严寒。

paras.en: "It was a very difficult winter last year in Kyiv," says mother of two Mariia Shostak, who is now packing her bags and leaving her small flat.
paras.zh: “去年在基辅度过了一个非常艰难的冬天，”两个孩子的母亲Mariia Shostak说，她现在正在收拾行李，离开她的小公寓。

paras.en: With prolonged periods of sub-zero temperatures and frequent power cuts brought about by Russia's attack on the country's power grid, last winter was one of the hardest so far.
paras.zh: 去年冬天是迄今为止最艰难的冬天之一，俄罗斯对电网的攻击导致零下气温持续时间延长，停电频繁。

paras.en: "There were some days and weeks that were unbearable. I started thinking I'm not going through another winter like this."
paras.zh: “有几天和几周是无法忍受的。我开始想，我不会再经历这样的冬天了。”

paras.en: Mariia is not even waiting for winter. Russia's latest assaults on the capital have forced her hand.
paras.zh: Mariia甚至没有等到冬天。俄罗斯最近对首都的袭击迫使她出手。

paras.en: "Everything changed in late August and the beginning of September, when Kyiv started being attacked around the clock," she said.
paras.zh: 她说： “8月下旬和9月初，当基辅开始受到全天候袭击时，一切都发生了变化。”

paras.en: "Earlier, the drones and missiles were intercepted somewhere on the outskirts. Now it was happening in the centre, right above our heads."
paras.zh: “早些时候，无人机和导弹在郊区的某个地方被拦截。现在它发生在中央，就在我们的头顶上。”

paras.en: After weeks of escalating Russian attacks, which by the end of September had included petrol stations, power plants and key bridges over the Dnipro river, Kyiv mayor Vitaly Klitschko said the city was facing a "very dramatic situation".
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科（ Vitaly Klitschko ）表示，在俄罗斯数周的袭击升级（截至9月底包括加油站、发电厂和第聂伯河上的关键桥梁）之后，该市正面临“非常严重的局势”。

paras.en: Mariia's children, four-year-old Artur and Kira, who's two, were both born after Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: Mariia的两个孩子，四岁的Artur和Kira ，都是在2022年俄罗斯全面入侵后出生的。

paras.en: Unwilling to subject them to another miserable, dangerous winter, she's taking them abroad. They plan to spend the winter in Hurghada, on Egypt's Red Sea coast. It's cheaper than Europe, Mariia explains, and warmer too.
paras.zh: 她不愿意让他们经历另一个痛苦、危险的冬天，她要把他们带到国外去。他们计划在埃及红海沿岸的赫尔格达过冬。Mariia解释说，它比欧洲便宜，也更温暖。

paras.en: "I don't feel safe in Ukraine in any way," she says.
paras.zh: 她说：「在乌克兰，我感觉不安全。」

paras.en: Polls show that many Ukrainians are feeling the same way, even if not everyone has yet made such a radical decision.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，许多乌克兰人也有同样的感受，即使不是每个人都做出了这样一个激进的决定。

paras.en: A September survey by the Gradus research company found that 40% of Ukrainians were considering relocating if living conditions continued to deteriorate; 35% said they would not move elsewhere, while 25% were undecided.
paras.zh: Gradus研究公司9月份的一项调查发现，如果生活条件持续恶化， 40%的乌克兰人正在考虑搬迁； 35%的人表示他们不会搬到其他地方， 25%的人尚未决定。

paras.en: "People are thinking about a combination of stress factors," Evgeniya Blyznyuk, Gradus's founder and CEO, told us. "Not just about electricity and blackouts like last winter. Russians are targeting big logistics centres, which means that the population is worrying about products, about food during the winter."
paras.zh: “人们正在考虑压力因素的组合，” Gradus的创始人兼首席执行官Evgeniya Blyznyuk告诉我们。“不仅仅是像去年冬天那样的电力和停电。俄罗斯人正在瞄准大型物流中心，这意味着人们在冬季担心产品和食物。”

paras.en: Russia's recent attacks on Kyiv's bridges, petrol stations and schools have increased the sense of danger and foreboding.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯最近对基辅桥梁、加油站和学校的袭击增加了人们的危险感和预感。

paras.en: For families with young children, the situation feels especially urgent.
paras.zh: 对于有年幼子女的家庭，情况尤为紧迫。

paras.en: Last winter, Iryna, who asked us not to use her surname, says her three-year-old daughter Polina found it hard to cope.
paras.zh: 去年冬天，要求我们不要使用她的姓氏的Iryna说，她三岁的女儿Polina发现很难应付。

paras.en: "Sometimes we didn't have heating for weeks and the temperature inside the apartment was zero or five degrees," she tells us. "So being here with a little child that is sick all the time was not OK."
paras.zh: 她告诉我们：「有时我们几个星期都没有暖气，公寓内的温度是零度或五度。」“所以和一个一直生病的小孩在一起是不对的。”

paras.en: The family's recent experiences have only compounded Polina's difficulties.
paras.zh: 这家人最近的经历只会加剧Polina的困难。

paras.en: "We had two missile attacks this year," Iryna says.
paras.zh: “我们今年有两次导弹袭击，” Iryna说。

paras.en: The first explosion, in early June, blew out several windows in the family's home on the north-western edge of Kyiv. A month later, after some of the damage had been repaired, a second blast, close to the foot of their 10-storey apartment block, propelled a wave of earth into the flat, forcing the family to move into temporary accommodation.
paras.zh: 第一次爆炸发生在6月初，炸毁了位于基辅西北部边缘的家中的几扇窗户。一个月后，在部分损坏得到修复后，第二次爆炸发生在他们10层公寓楼脚下，将一波泥土推入公寓，迫使家人搬进临时住所。

paras.en: Polina's health has deteriorated. She suffers from extreme anxiety, which has brought on bouts of incontinence, vomiting and uncontrollable shaking.
paras.zh: Polina的健康状况恶化了。她患有极度焦虑，这导致了尿失禁、呕吐和无法控制的颤抖。

paras.en: "Now we have this neurological problem with her so that's the reason we're thinking about leaving," Iryna says. "There are new symptoms after each shelling."
paras.zh: Iryna说： “现在我们和她有神经问题，这就是我们考虑离开的原因。” “每次炮击后都有新的症状。”

paras.en: Iryna, whose husband is in the army, has not yet decided where to go. Her work with an international NGO may allow her to work remotely from Poland.
paras.zh: 丈夫在军队服役的Iryna还没有决定去哪里。她在一个国际非政府组织的工作可能使她能够从波兰远程工作。

paras.en: "Our president says that it is better to leave Kyiv because this is target number one," she says.
paras.zh: “我们的总统说，最好离开基辅，因为这是第一个目标，”她说。

paras.en: For other Kyiv residents, the solution lies closer to home: in the vast open spaces of Ukraine's countryside.
paras.zh: 对于其他基辅居民来说，解决方案就在于离家更近的地方：乌克兰乡村广阔的开放空间。

paras.en: Olena Konoplia tells us she spent weeks looking for a suitable location before settling on a cottage in a rural community two hours outside the capital.
paras.zh: Olena Konoplia告诉我们，她花了几个星期的时间寻找合适的地点，然后在首都以外的一个乡村社区居住了两个小时。

paras.en: "I decided the better option will be a little village without any factories, any [warehouses] and any railway stations," Olena explains.
paras.zh: Olena解释说： “我认为更好的选择是一个小村庄，没有任何工厂、任何[仓库]和任何火车站。”

paras.en: "Everything that can be a Russian target."
paras.zh: “一切可能成为俄罗斯目标的东西。”

paras.en: On the day we visited, Olena was busy ferrying supplies to the house and supervising the installation of a new door.
paras.zh: 在我们参观的那天， Olena正忙着向房子运送用品，并监督新门的安装。

paras.en: In keeping with Ukrainian tradition, a priest has already been around to bless her new home.
paras.zh: 为了与乌克兰的传统保持一致，一位牧师已经开始为她的新家祝福。

paras.en: The cottage has gas-powered convection heaters, but in an adjacent barn a stack of firewood will help to keep Olena warm in the event of power cuts. She has already installed high-speed internet, necessary for her work at a Kyiv-based charitable foundation.
paras.zh: 小屋配有燃气对流加热器，但在相邻的谷仓中，一堆木柴将有助于在停电时保持Olena的温暖。她已经安装了高速互联网，这是她在基辅一家慈善基金会工作所必需的。

paras.en: At a time when air raid sirens sound constantly in Kyiv and explosions can be heard almost every day, the peace and quiet of the village is what Olena says she needs most.
paras.zh: 在基辅不断发出空袭警报，几乎每天都能听到爆炸声的时候，村庄的和平与安宁是Olena说她最需要的。

paras.en: "After several nights here, when I can sleep, just sleep, without any explosions, without any sirens, I feel better," she says. "I can work, write my articles, I feel good."
paras.zh: 她说： “在这里住了几个晚上，当我可以睡觉的时候，只是睡觉，没有任何爆炸，没有任何警笛声，我感觉好多了。” “我可以工作，写我的文章，我感觉很好。”

paras.en: Olena's elderly mother will soon be joining her.
paras.zh: Olena年迈的母亲很快就会加入她的行列。

paras.en: "She lives in a pretty dangerous district in Kyiv and it's harmful for her health," she explains.
paras.zh: 她解释说：「她住在基辅一个相当危险的地区，这对她的健康有害。」

paras.en: Of course, not everyone can afford a cottage in the countryside or a months-long trip abroad.
paras.zh: 当然，并非每个人都能负担得起乡村小屋或长达数月的国外之旅。

paras.en: Most Kyiv residents will do what they can to survive another tough winter in the capital, just as they have before.
paras.zh: 大多数基辅居民会像以前一样，尽一切努力在首都度过又一个艰难的冬天。

paras.en: The authorities are taking steps to prepare. Some of Kyiv's most vulnerable citizens â the elderly and women with young children â are being offered places in converted sanatoriums and rehabilitation centres in the city's forested outskirts.
paras.zh: 当局正在采取措施做好准备。基辅的一些最脆弱的公民--老年人和带着幼儿的妇女--正在城市森林郊区的改造疗养院和康复中心获得住宿。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a network of around 15 small-scale power plants has been constructed around the city over the past 18 months in an effort to shore up Kyiv's battered power grid.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在过去的18个月里，在该市周围建造了大约15个小型发电厂的网络，以支持基辅遭受重创的电网。

paras.en: The plants, constructed in fortified bunkers and protected from drone attack by huge steel cages, are each capable of providing electricity and heat to several hundred of the city's high-rise apartment blocks.
paras.zh: 这些工厂建在防御工事的掩体中，并防止无人机受到巨大的钢笼袭击，每个工厂都能够为该市数百个高层公寓楼提供电力和热力。

paras.en: But with energy companies already talking about scheduled power cuts and supermarkets experiencing periodic shortages of some goods, the pressures to leave are growing.
paras.zh: 但由于能源公司已经在谈论定期停电和超市经历一些商品的周期性短缺，离开的压力正在增加。

paras.en: Evgeniya Blyznyuk says she does not expect to see a mass exodus from the capital and says most people have yet to make up their minds, reluctant to jeopardise their jobs or take children out of school.
paras.zh: Evgeniya Blyznyuk说，她不希望看到大批人离开首都，并说大多数人还没有下定决心，不愿意危及他们的工作或让孩子辍学。

paras.en: "They will postpone it until conditions become really unliveable," she says.
paras.zh: 她说： “他们会把它推迟到条件变得非常不适宜居住的时候。”

articles.title: Would you trust AI to calculate your true 'biological age'?
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: Scientists have recently harnessed artificial intelligence (AI) to build "aging clocks" that aim to estimate a person's true biological age.
paras.zh: 科学家最近利用人工智能（AI）构建了“衰老时钟”，旨在估计一个人的真实生物年龄。

paras.en: While a person's chronological age reflects the number of years they've been alive, their biological age is intended to capture how well their bodily systems are functioning. The idea is that people with older biological ages have a higher risk of age-related diseases — such as cancer, heart disease or dementia — while younger biological ages come with less risk. Some aging clocks even aim to predict people's impending risk of death.
paras.zh: 一个人的实际年龄反映了他们的生存年数，而他们的生物年龄则旨在反映他们的身体系统的运作情况。这个想法是，生物年龄较大的人患与年龄相关的疾病（例如癌症、心脏病或痴呆）的风险较高，而生物年龄较小的人患年龄相关疾病的风险较低。一些老化时钟甚至旨在预测人们即将发生的死亡风险。

paras.en: - Sped-up 'biological aging' linked to worse memory
paras.zh: - 加速“生物衰老”与记忆力下降有关

paras.en: - Aging doesn't look the same for everyone at the molecular level — it's 'individualized and context-dependent'
paras.zh: - 在分子水平上，每个人的衰老看起来并不相同——它是“个体化且依赖于环境的”

paras.en: - 'We can identify these really early, before the clinical diagnosis': Epigenetic markers may help explain why Native Hawaiians are aging faster
paras.zh: -“我们可以在临床诊断之前尽早识别这些”：表观遗传标记可能有助于解释为什么夏威夷原住民衰老得更快

paras.en: Many aging clocks look at epigenetic markers, meaning chemical tags that bind DNA and change how genes activate, while others measure features such as the pace and pitch of people's voices. But some scientists say we don't know how to use these aging clocks yet, arguing that the tools are useful for studying aging at a population level but not for guiding individual health decisions.
paras.zh: 许多老化时钟着眼于表观遗传标记，即结合 DNA 并改变基因激活方式的化学标签，而其他时钟则测量人们声音的节奏和音调等特征。但一些科学家表示，我们还不知道如何使用这些衰老时钟，他们认为这些工具对于研究人口水平的衰老很有用，但不能用于指导个人健康决策。

paras.en: Others posit that the data the clocks are based on is too noisy, and thus, there's potential for drawing faulty conclusions about what they're measuring. They say, for example, that we don't know if the clocks are measuring the downstream effects of aging or its underlying causes. And in any case, we don't currently have any treatments to "wind back" the clocks.
paras.zh: 其他人则认为时钟所基于的数据噪音太大，因此有可能对他们所测量的内容得出错误的结论。例如，他们说，我们不知道时钟是否正在测量衰老的下游影响或其根本原因。无论如何，我们目前还没有任何治疗方法可以让时钟“倒转”。

paras.en: What do you think? Would you use these AI tools to measure your biological age? Let us know in the poll below, and explain your reasoning and additional thoughts about the technology in the comments.
paras.zh: 你怎么认为？您会使用这些人工智能工具来测量您的生物年龄吗？请在下面的民意调查中告诉我们，并在评论中解释您对该技术的推理和其他想法。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: The Milky Way is one galaxy — but it used to be thousands, new simulations reveal
articles.author: Sharmila Kuthunur

paras.en: Long before it became the luminous spiral galaxy we call home, the Milky Way was a sprawling, chaotic swarm of thousands of small galaxies, new research shows.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，早在银河系成为我们称之为家园的发光螺旋星系之前，银河系就是一个由数千个小星系组成的庞大、混乱的群。

paras.en: The findings suggest that in the first 2 billion years after the Big Bang, the region of the universe that would become our galaxy was littered with thousands of smaller galaxies of many sizes and shapes. Over time, these galaxies collided and merged into the single galaxy in which we reside today.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，在大爆炸后的最初 20 亿年里，后来成为我们星系的宇宙区域散布着数千个大小和形状各异的较小星系。随着时间的推移，这些星系碰撞并合并成我们今天居住的单一星系。

paras.en: "Looking at these results, it's very clear that the physics happening right after the Big Bang has direct impact on what we see today in the local universe," study co-author Harley Katz, an assistant professor of astronomy and astrophysics at the University of Chicago, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、芝加哥大学天文学和天体物理学助理教授哈利·卡茨在一份声明中说：“从这些结果来看，很明显，大爆炸后发生的物理现象对我们今天在当地宇宙中看到的现象有直接影响。”

paras.en: To understand more about the early universe, astronomers build sophisticated computer models that encode the laws of nature to see how the cosmos may have evolved. The new work, which is the result of three years of supercomputer simulations, is the most detailed tracing yet of how a galaxy like ours came to be. It also arrives just as astronomers need a stronger yardstick for what they're seeing in the early universe.
paras.zh: 为了更多地了解早期宇宙，天文学家建立了复杂的计算机模型，对自然法则进行编码，以了解宇宙可能如何演化。这项新工作是超级计算机三年模拟的结果，是迄今为止对像我们这样的星系是如何形成的最详细的追踪。它的到来恰逢天文学家需要一个更强的标准来衡量他们在早期宇宙中所看到的一切。

paras.en: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) can peer farther into the early universe than any previous telescope, and its discoveries have often defied computer models. For instance, JWST found surprisingly bright early galaxies and a mysterious new class of compact galaxies dubbed "Little Red Dots." These anomalies demonstrate that current computer models need an update to handle the complex physics of the early universe, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）可以比任何以前的望远镜更深入地观察早期宇宙，并且它的发现常常违背计算机模型。例如，JWST 发现了令人惊讶的明亮早期星系和一类被称为“小红点”的神秘新型致密星系。研究人员表示，这些异常现象表明，当前的计算机模型需要更新才能处理早期宇宙的复杂物理现象。

paras.en: To bridge that gap, the scientists built a new suite of supercomputer simulations they call Megatron. By tracing ancient gas, starlight and chemistry from 180 million years to 2 billion years after the Big Bang, Megatron predicts the distinct light signatures of its virtual galaxies, according to the statement. Because JWST collects the same type of spectral data across a similar span of cosmic time, scientists can directly cross-reference the simulation against real observations to pinpoint what the old models are missing, the team said.
paras.zh: 为了弥补这一差距，科学家们构建了一套新的超级计算机模拟系统，他们称之为威震天。声明称，通过追踪大爆炸后 1.8 亿年至 20 亿年的古代气体、星光和化学物质，威震天预测了其虚拟星系的独特光特征。研究小组表示，由于 JWST 在相似的宇宙时间跨度内收集相同类型的光谱数据，因此科学家可以直接将模拟与实际观测结果交叉引用，以查明旧模型缺失的内容。

paras.en: The simulation also tracks how the universe's first stars formed, died and forged the essential elements that make life as we know it possible. By comparing the simulation with JWST observations of early galaxies and with the chemical traces left in ancient stars, scientists can better understand how those first stars enriched their surroundings, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 该模拟还追踪了宇宙中第一批恒星的形成、死亡以及形成使我们所知的生命成为可能的基本元素的过程。研究人员表示，通过将模拟结果与《JWST》对早期星系的观测以及古代恒星中留下的化学痕迹进行比较，科学家们可以更好地了解这些第一代恒星是如何丰富其周围环境的。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Together, these complementary observations allow us to test competing models of the first stars in ways that weren't previously possible," study co-author Martin Rey, a theoretical astrophysicist at the University of Bath in the U.K., said in a separate statement.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、英国巴斯大学理论天体物理学家马丁·雷伊在另一份声明中表示：“这些互补的观测结果使我们能够以以前不可能的方式测试第一批恒星的竞争模型。”

paras.en: The scientists detailed their findings in one of the six papers the Megatron collaboration published Sept. 30 in The Open Journal of Astrophysics.
paras.zh: 科学家们在威震天合作组织于 9 月 30 日在《开放天体物理学杂志》上发表的六篇论文中的一篇中详细介绍了他们的发现。

paras.en: The team's simulation begins 180 million years after the Big Bang, when the universe is devoid of stars and galaxies and holds only pristine gas. As the next 2 billion years pass,, the model captures how the very first stars light up the dark universe and kick off "cosmic dawn," eventually culminating in those stars' violent deaths. As they die, the stars spread newly forged heavy elements such as carbon, oxygen and iron into the surrounding gas, laying the building blocks for future stars and planets.
paras.zh: 该团队的模拟始于大爆炸后 1.8 亿年，当时的宇宙没有恒星和星系，只含有原始气体。随着接下来的 20 亿年过去，该模型捕捉到了第一批恒星如何照亮黑暗的宇宙并开启“宇宙黎明”，最终导致这些恒星的暴力死亡。当恒星死亡时，它们会将碳、氧和铁等新锻造的重元素扩散到周围的气体中，为未来的恒星和行星奠定基础。

paras.en: The simulation ends 2 billion years after the Big Bang, but the Milky Way's mergers continued long after this point, and scientists are still discovering traces of the small galaxies that have joined it. The most recent massive merger, with the Sagittarius dwarf galaxy, began more than 6 billion years ago and is still unfolding.
paras.zh: 模拟在大爆炸后 20 亿年结束，但银河系的合并在此之后持续了很长一段时间，科学家们仍在发现加入它的小星系的踪迹。最近一次与人马座矮星系的大规模合并始于 60 亿多年前，并且仍在进行中。

paras.en: The simulation results help scientists understand how certain physics parameters impact the early universe, and better match up JWST's observations with computer models. But it also highlights areas that need further study.
paras.zh: 模拟结果帮助科学家了解某些物理参数如何影响早期宇宙，并更好地将 JWST 的观测结果与计算机模型相匹配。但它也强调了需要进一步研究的领域。

paras.en: "But there are also things we're not getting right, which is interesting too — what are the parts we're still missing?" Katz said in the statement. "That can lead you into new directions and new questions."
paras.zh: “但也有一些事情我们做得不对，这也很有趣——我们还缺少哪些部分？”卡茨在声明中说道。 “这可以引导你进入新的方向和新的问题。”

paras.en: Megatron team members in the U.K. are now developing the next generation of simulations, backed by dedicated time on the country's supercomputers. Those simulations will include more complex physics, such as active black holes, which JWST has revealed to be surprisingly common in the early universe, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 英国威震天团队成员目前正在开发下一代模拟，并在该国超级计算机上投入了大量时间。研究人员表示，这些模拟将包括更复杂的物理现象，例如活跃的黑洞，JWST 发现黑洞在早期宇宙中出奇地常见。

paras.en: Katz, Harley, Martin Rey, Corentin Cadiou, Oscar Agertz, Jeremy Blaizot, Alex J. Cameron, Nicholas Choustikov, et al. 2026. "MEGATRON: Reproducing the Diversity of High-Redshift Galaxy Spectra with Cosmological Radiation Hydrodynamics Simulations." The Open Journal of Astrophysics 9 (September). https://doi.org/10.33232/001c.169643.
paras.zh: Katz、Harley、Martin Rey、Corentin Cadiou、Oscar Agertz、Jeremy Blaizot、Alex J. Cameron、Nicholas Choustikov 等。 2026.“威震天：通过宇宙辐射流体动力学模拟再现高红移星系光谱的多样性。” 《天体物理学开放杂志》9（九月）。 https://doi.org/10.33232/001c.169643。

paras.en: How well do you know our home galaxy? Find out with our Milky Way quiz!
paras.zh: 你对我们的家乡银河系了解多少？通过我们的银河系测验找出答案！

paras.en: Sharmila Kuthunur is an independent space journalist based in Bengaluru, India. Her work has also appeared in Scientific American, Science, Astronomy and Space.com, among other publications. She holds a master's degree in journalism from Northeastern University in Boston. Follow her on BlueSky @skuthunur.bsky.social
paras.zh: Sharmila Kuthunur 是一位驻印度班加罗尔的独立太空记者。她的作品还发表在《科学美国人》、《科学》、《天文学》和《Space.com》等出版物上。她拥有波士顿东北大学新闻学硕士学位。在 BlueSky @skuthunur.bsky.social 上关注她

articles.title: James Webb telescope pinpoints the most distant 'fast radio burst' ever seen
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

paras.en: Astronomers have detected the most distant burst of radio signals ever seen: an explosion that's emitting waves of energy from more than 10 billion light-years away.
paras.zh: 天文学家探测到了有史以来最遥远的无线电信号爆发：从超过 100 亿光年之外发射出能量波的爆炸。

paras.en: The event, named FRB 20240304B, is known as a fast radio burst (FRB). Astronomers have detected thousands of FRBs before this. But because these events last only milliseconds, they are extremely difficult to study and their origin stories remain unclear.
paras.zh: 该事件名为 FRB 20240304B，被称为快速射电暴 (FRB)。在此之前，天文学家已经检测到了数千个快速射电暴。但由于这些事件仅持续几毫秒，因此研究它们极其困难，而且它们的起源故事仍不清楚。

paras.en: In this case, however, astronomers managed to use a radio telescope array and the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) to chart the event, with JWST narrowing down the precise host galaxy that FRB 20240304B came from. The study, published Thursday (Oct. 8) in the journal Science , sheds more light on a time when the universe was only about 3 billion years old, showing that FRBs arose early in our cosmos' history. The detection more than doubles the previous distance record for FRBs.
paras.zh: 然而，在这种情况下，天文学家设法使用射电望远镜阵列和詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 绘制了该事件的图表，JWST 缩小了 FRB 20240304B 所在星系的精确范围。这项研究于周四（10 月 8 日）发表在《科学》杂志上，进一步揭示了宇宙仅约 30 亿年的历史，表明快速射电暴在宇宙历史的早期就出现了。这次探测到的快速射电暴距离记录增加了一倍多。

paras.en: The JWST played an instrumental role in the discovery, study co-author Themiya Nanayakkara, a senior lecturer at the Sydney Institute for Astronomy, told Live Science in an email. The email was written in collaboration with study first author Manisha Caleb, a senior lecturer in astrophysics at the same university.
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、悉尼天文学研究所的高级讲师 Themiya Nanayakkara 在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》，JWST 在这一发现中发挥了重要作用。该电子邮件是与该研究的第一作者、同一所大学的天体物理学高级讲师 Manisha Caleb 合作撰写的。

paras.en: For example, JWST's observations showed that the host galaxy was smaller than expected, was "metal-poor" (had few elements besides hydrogen and helium), and was forming a lot of stars. These characteristics could offer new clues about the environments in which FRBs arise, giving more information about the mysterious events. Researchers suggest that this FRB may have been linked to a magnetar, a highly magnetic star core left after a supernova.
paras.zh: 例如，JWST 的观测表明，宿主星系比预期要小，“贫金属”（除了氢和氦之外几乎没有元素），并且正在形成大量恒星。这些特征可以提供有关快速射电暴出现环境的新线索，从而提供有关神秘事件的更多信息。研究人员认为，这个快速射电暴可能与磁星有关，磁星是超新星爆发后留下的高磁性星核。

paras.en: Zooming in with the James Webb telescope
paras.zh: 用詹姆斯·韦伯望远镜放大

paras.en: The ancient FRB was initially detected with MeerKAT, an array of 64 radio telescopes in South Africa. Nanayakkara said MeerKAT revealed "both the detection of the fast radio burst and, importantly, a very precise position on the sky."
paras.zh: 古老的 FRB 最初是通过 MeerKAT 探测到的，MeerKAT 是南非的一个由 64 台射电望远镜组成的阵列。 Nanayakkara 表示，MeerKAT 揭示了“快速射电爆发的探测，以及重要的是，天空中非常精确的位置。”

paras.en: The researchers knew the FRB was far away because of the large dispersion of the radio signal, but initial searches with powerful ground-based telescopes, "saw essentially nothing; it looked like empty sky," the researchers told Live Science. "The most likely explanation was that the galaxy was simply too faint to be detected in those observations. That is where JWST became transformative."
paras.zh: 研究人员知道，由于无线电信号的分散性很大，FRB 距离很远，但使用强大的地面望远镜进行的初步搜索，“基本上什么也没看到；它看起来就像空荡荡的天空，”研究人员告诉《生活科学》。 “最可能的解释是，该星系太微弱，无法在这些观测中检测到。这就是 JWST 发生变革的地方。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The science team successfully got time on JWST with a program called Director’s Discretionary Time, which is aimed at time-sensitive observations. The researchers started by using JWST's Near Infrared Camera to trace the radio signal and take a very deep image of the target region.
paras.zh: 科学团队通过名为“主任自由裁量时间”的项目成功获得了 JWST 的时间，该项目旨在进行时间敏感的观测。研究人员首先使用 JWST 的近红外相机追踪无线电信号，并拍摄目标区域的深度图像。

paras.en: "Suddenly, there it was: a very faint galaxy almost exactly where we expected the host of the FRB to be," Nanayakkara said. The researchers then used JWST's Near Infrared Spectrograph to obtain a spectrum (wavelengths of light broken into different chemical signatures), which showed hydrogen and oxygen.
paras.zh: 纳纳亚卡拉说：“突然间，它就出现了：一个非常微弱的星系，几乎就在我们预期的快速射电暴宿主所在的位置。”然后，研究人员使用 JWST 的近红外光谱仪获得了光谱（分解为不同化学特征的光波长），其中显示了氢和氧。

paras.en: "These spectral features act like fingerprints: because we know the wavelengths at which they are produced in the laboratory, we can measure how much they have been shifted by the expansion of the universe," Nanayakkara explained. "That gave us a very precise redshift of about 2.15. We are therefore seeing this galaxy as it was when the universe was only around three billion years old, so roughly one-fifth of its current age."
paras.zh: “这些光谱特征就像指纹：因为我们知道它们在实验室中产生的波长，所以我们可以测量它们因宇宙膨胀而移动了多少，”纳纳亚卡拉解释道。 “这给我们带来了大约 2.15 的非常精确的红移。因此，我们看到的这个星系就像宇宙年龄只有 30 亿岁左右时的样子，大约是现在年龄的五分之一。”

paras.en: Because the host galaxy is fairly young, it supports the idea that at least some FRBs are generated by magnetars, which are more likely to appear in spry galaxies where intense star formation is occurring, the team said.
paras.zh: 研究小组表示，由于宿主星系相当年轻，它支持了这样的观点，即至少有一些快速射电暴是由磁星产生的，磁星更有可能出现在正在发生强烈恒星形成的活跃星系中。

paras.en: The team plans to continue hunting for FRBs with JWST.
paras.zh: 该团队计划继续与 JWST 一起寻找快速射电暴。

paras.en: "We do not know what the sources will be yet," Nanayakkara said, as that depends on what pops up in the sky and is spotted by ground-based radio telescopes. "Once our radio telescopes find and localize a suitable new source, we can trigger the JWST observations. So it is quite exciting, because we really have no idea what we will find when we combine the power of these two types of telescopes."
paras.zh: 纳纳亚卡拉说：“我们还不知道来源是什么，”因为这取决于天空中突然出现并被地面射电望远镜发现的东西。 “一旦我们的射电望远镜找到并定位了合适的新光源，我们就可以触发 JWST 观测。所以这非常令人兴奋，因为我们真的不知道当我们结合这两种类型的望远镜的力量时会发现什么。”

paras.en: Elizabeth Howell was staff reporter at Space.com between 2022 and 2024 and a regular contributor to Live Science and Space.com between 2012 and 2022. Elizabeth's reporting includes multiple exclusives with the White House, speaking several times with the International Space Station, witnessing five human spaceflight launches on two continents, flying parabolic, working inside a spacesuit, and participating in a simulated Mars mission. Her latest book, "Why Am I Taller?" (ECW Press, 2022) is co-written with astronaut Dave Williams.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白·豪厄尔 (Elizabeth Howell) 于 2022 年至 2024 年间担任 Space.com 的特约记者，并于 2012 年至 2022 年间为 Live Science 和 Space.com 定期撰稿。伊丽莎白的报道包括白宫的多项独家报道、与国际空间站的多次对话、见证了在两大洲的五次载人航天发射、抛物线飞行、在宇航服内工作以及参与模拟火星任务。她的最新书《为什么我更高？》 （ECW Press，2022 年）与宇航员戴夫·威廉姆斯 (Dave Williams) 共同撰写。
