articles.title: Canadian Poet Anne Carson Brings Ancient Wisdom to Modern Audiences. Now, She's a Nobel Laureate in Literature

paras.en: Anne Carson has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature for her genre-bending works that range from poetry and ancient Greek translations to collaborations with dancers and musicians.
paras.zh: 安妮·卡森 (Anne Carson) 因其跨流派的作品荣获 2026 年诺贝尔文学奖，作品涵盖诗歌、古希腊语翻译以及与舞蹈家和音乐家的合作。

paras.en: The Swedish Academy recognized the 76-year-old Canadian poet, essayist and translator on October 8 for “her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature.”
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日，瑞典学院表彰了这位 76 岁的加拿大诗人、散文家和翻译家，表彰她“大胆而富有创造力的作品，与古典传统进行有趣的对话，为当代文学创造了新的形式”。

paras.en: Throughout her career, Carson has repeatedly taken texts and ideas from the ancient world and made them feel contemporary, using unconventional forms and a modern voice to probe enduring questions about love, loss, desire and identity.
paras.zh: 在她的整个职业生涯中，卡森不断地从古代世界汲取文本和思想，并让它们具有当代感，使用非传统的形式和现代的声音来探讨有关爱、失落、欲望和身份的持久问题。

paras.en: The Nobel Committee for Literature praised Carson’s boundary-defying approach, which has led “to playful and ironic works that move not only between classical and modern poetry but also between different genres and art forms,” chair Anders Olsson said during the award announcement.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔文学委员会主席安德斯·奥尔森（Anders Olsson）在颁奖典礼上表示，赞扬了卡森打破界限的创作方式，这种创作方式“带来了“俏皮而讽刺的作品，不仅在古典诗歌和现代诗歌之间游走，而且在不同流派和艺术形式之间游走”。

paras.en: Mark Carney, Canada’s prime minister, also complimented Carson’s unique style, saying in a statement that by “drawing on ancient traditions with bold imagination and originality,” Carson had “reimagined the classics with wit, imagination and a style entirely her own.”
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼也对卡森的独特风格表示赞赏，他在一份声明中表示，卡森“以大胆的想象力和独创性借鉴了古老的传统”，“用智慧、想象力和完全属于她自己的风格重新塑造了经典”。

paras.en: Carney adds, “She has brought ancient stories to new audiences and transformed the way we think about literature.”
paras.zh: 卡尼补充道：“她将古老的故事带给了新的受众，并改变了我们对文学的思考方式。”

paras.en: Carson’s 1986 debut book-length essay, Eros the Bittersweet, examined the pleasure and pain of desire in ancient Greek literature, while “The Glass Essay,” a long, lyrical poem published in 1995, explored the aftermath of unrequited love and grief.
paras.zh: 卡森 1986 年的处女作《苦乐参半的厄洛斯》探讨了古希腊文学中欲望的快乐和痛苦，而 1995 年出版的长篇抒情诗《玻璃散文》则探讨了单相思和悲伤的后果。

paras.en: The author brought a similarly inventive approach to Autobiography of Red, her 1998 verse novel that transformed the myth of Heracles and the giant Geryon into a coming-of-age story about a gay teenager and his heartbreaking romance. The book has sold nearly 100,000 copies in the United States, according to its publisher. Red Doc>, published in 2013, resumes the story, following the now-middle-aged characters on a road trip.
paras.zh: 作者在她 1998 年的诗体小说《红色自传》中采用了类似的创造性方法，将赫拉克勒斯和巨人革律翁的神话转变为一个关于同性恋青少年和他令人心碎的浪漫的成长故事。据出版商称，这本书在美国已售出近 10 万册。 2013 年出版的《红色文档》继续讲述了这个故事，讲述了中年人物的公路旅行。

paras.en: Carson’s work has continued to move freely between poetry, prose, myth and biography. Men in the Off Hours, a 2000 collection of poetry and prose, won Canada’s inaugural Griffin Poetry Prize, while the performance piece Norma Jeane Baker of Troy brought together the stories of two women separated by thousands of years: Marilyn Monroe and Helen of Troy.
paras.zh: 卡森的作品继续在诗歌、散文、神话和传记之间自由游走。 2000 年出版的诗歌和散文集《男人在下班时间》赢得了加拿大首届格里芬诗歌奖，而表演作品《特洛伊的诺玛·珍妮·贝克》汇集了两个相隔数千年的女人的故事：玛丽莲·梦露和特洛伊的海伦。

paras.en: Carson’s 2024 poetry collection, Wrong Norma, a finalist for a National Book Award, ranged from compositions about her father to pieces about snow and Roget’s Thesaurus. The subjects had no obvious connection. “That’s why I’ve called them ‘wrong,’” the poet told the Nation’s Emily Wilson in 2024.
paras.zh: 卡森的 2024 年诗集《错误的诺玛》入围了国家图书奖的决赛，内容涵盖了从有关她父亲的作品到有关雪和罗杰同义词库的作品。受试者之间没有明显的联系。 “这就是为什么我称他们‘错误’，”这位诗人在 2024 年告诉《国家报》的艾米丽·威尔逊。

paras.en: Over the years, Carson has “moved closer to bizarreness for the sake of bizarreness,” Daisy Fried wrote in a 2013 review of Red Doc> for the New York Times. “But she still pulls it off, mainly because the impulse behind it is mischief. ‘Can I get away with this?’ she seems to ask. And she does—because it’s fun. She’s having fun.”
paras.zh: 黛西·弗里德 (Daisy Fried) 在 2013 年为《纽约时报》撰写的《红色文档》评论中写道，这些年来，卡森“为了离奇而离奇”。 “但她仍然成功了，主要是因为背后的冲动是恶作剧。她似乎在问‘我能逃脱惩罚吗？’她确实这么做了——因为这很有趣。她玩得很开心。”

paras.en: Carson has also translated and reimagined foundational works of ancient Greek literature, including fragments by the poet Sappho in If Not, Winter; Sophocles’ plays Electra and Antigone; and Euripides’ The Bacchae. The Nobel Committee praised these translations as “independent works in their own right.”
paras.zh: 卡森还翻译和重新构思了古希腊文学的基础作品，包括诗人萨福在《如果不是，冬天》中的片段；索福克勒斯的戏剧《厄勒克特拉》和《安提戈涅》；和欧里庇得斯的《酒神》。诺贝尔委员会称赞这些翻译是“本身就是独立的作品”。

paras.en: Born in Toronto in 1950, Carson discovered ancient Greek texts in high school and quickly became fascinated with the language.
paras.zh: 卡森 1950 年出生于多伦多，在高中时发现了古希腊文本，并很快对这门语言着迷。

paras.en: “[It] seems different than other languages,” Carson told NPR’s Scott Simon in 2016. “It seems, somehow, more original, more like being in the morning of language. And that’s partly because the words are new. Those people are inventing ways of thinking about stuff, but also because we have thousands of years of building the words into other things, using their words to build out our words.”
paras.zh: 2016 年，卡森对 NPR 的斯科特·西蒙 (Scott Simon) 表示：“[它]似乎与其他语言有所不同。”“不知何故，它似​​乎更具原创性，更像是处于语言的早晨。部分原因是这些单词是新的。这些人正在发明思考事物的方式，但也因为我们有数千年的时间将单词构建到其他事物中，用他们的单词来构建我们的单词。”

paras.en: Carson studied at the University of Toronto, then taught classics at the University of Calgary and McGill University while establishing herself as a writer. As her career blossomed, Carson also held positions at the University of Michigan, Princeton University, Cornell University and New York University.
paras.zh: 卡森在多伦多大学学习，然后在卡尔加里大学和麦吉尔大学教授古典文学，同时确立了自己的作家地位。随着她的职业生涯蓬勃发展，卡森还在密歇根大学、普林斯顿大学、康奈尔大学和纽约大学担任过职务。

paras.en: In 2024, Carson, who rarely shares much about her personal life, revealed that she had been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease and had taken up boxing to help manage the condition.
paras.zh: 2024 年，很少透露太多个人生活的卡森透露，她被诊断出患有帕金森病，并开始练习拳击来帮助控制病情。

paras.en: “When I try to produce a complicated movement like a one-two-four-five combination in boxing (left jab, right cross, right hook, left uppercut), I can feel the neurons in my brain struggling and striving,” Carson wrote in an essay for the London Review of Books. “Yes, I can feel it.”
paras.zh: 卡森在《伦敦书评》的一篇文章中写道：“当我尝试做出一个复杂的动作，比如拳击中的一二四五组合（左刺拳、右交叉、右勾拳、左上勾拳）时，我能感觉到大脑中的神经元在挣扎和努力。” “是的，我能感觉到。”

paras.en: Carson and her partner, visual artist Robert Currie, live part-time in Iceland, where they gained citizenship in 2022. “She means a lot to the scene here,” Ragnar Kjartansson, a multidisciplinary Icelandic artist, tells the New York Times’ Alex Marshall. “She’s a force, and everyone’s really happy.”
paras.zh: 卡森和她的伴侣、视觉艺术家罗伯特·柯里 (Robert Currie) 在冰岛兼职生活，并于 2022 年获得了冰岛公民身份。“她对这里的场景意义重大，”多学科冰岛艺术家拉格纳·基贾坦森 (Ragnar Kjartansson) 告诉《纽约时报》的亚历克斯·马歇尔 (Alex Marshall)。 “她是一股力量，每个人都很高兴。”

paras.en: When Ingrid Carlberg, the Swedish Academy’s secretary, called Carson to deliver the good news, the poet said she was in Iceland “listening to the wind.”
paras.zh: 当瑞典学院秘书英格丽德·卡尔伯格打电话给卡森传达这个好消息时，诗人说她正在冰岛“听风”。

paras.en: “She was taken by surprise but very happy,” Carlberg said during a livestream of the award announcement.
paras.zh: “她很惊讶，但也很高兴，”卡尔伯格在颁奖典礼的直播中说道。

paras.en: Later, in a telephone interview with the Nobel Prize’s outreach team, Carson reiterated that winning the award “seems a little insane. I think you’re all insane.”
paras.zh: 后来，在接受诺贝尔奖外展团队的电话采访时，卡森重申，获奖“似乎有点疯狂。我认为你们都疯了。”

paras.en: The Nobel committees are announcing the winners of their six award categories this month, starting with the prize in physiology or medicine on October 5 and ending with the economics prize on October 12. Each award comes with a cash prize of 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million).
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会将于本月公布六个奖项类别的获奖者，从 10 月 5 日的生理学或医学奖开始，到 10 月 12 日的经济学奖结束。每个奖项都附带 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元）的现金奖励。

articles.title: Margaret Hamilton, a Pioneering Software Engineer Who Made the First Human Moon Landing Possible, Dies at 90

paras.en: Software engineering pioneer Margaret Hamilton died on September 30 at age 90, leaving behind a trailblazing legacy of problem-solving and entrepreneurship that paved the way for a new branch of computer science and engineering.
paras.zh: 软件工程先驱玛格丽特·汉密尔顿 (Margaret Hamilton) 于 9 月 30 日去世，享年 90 岁，留下了解决问题和创业精神的开拓性遗产，为计算机科学和工程的新分支铺平了道路。

paras.en: Hamilton is best known for her major contributions to the Apollo missions. Her work famously resolved a computer issue that enabled NASA’s Apollo 11 mission to put humans on the moon for the first time.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿因其对阿波罗任务的重大贡献而闻名。她的工作以解决计算机问题而闻名，使 NASA 的阿波罗 11 号任务首次将人类送上月球。

paras.en: “Her coding foresight and prowess really made that mission a success,” Andrew Meade McGee, curator of computing at Smithsonian’s National Air and Space Museum, tells Smithsonian magazine. Her impact goes far beyond the lunar landing, though, and has had long-lasting effects, he adds. “She created the logical software basis for many of the critical systems we use to maintain our infrastructure today, and that silently power today’s modern aerospace world.”
paras.zh: 史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆计算机部馆长安德鲁·米德·麦吉 (Andrew Meade McGee) 告诉《史密森尼》杂志：“她的编码远见和卓越能力确实使该任务取得了成功。”不过，他补充说，她的影响远远超出了登月，并且产生了持久的影响。 “她为我们今天用来维护基础设施的许多关键系统创建了逻辑软件基础，​​并默默地为当今的现代航空航天世界提供动力。”

paras.en: Hamilton was not widely recognized outside of computing and aerospace circles until about 20 years ago, and in 2016, she received the Presidential Medal of Freedom, McGee says. “A generation of coders and young women in STEM came to see her as a pioneer.”
paras.zh: 麦吉说，直到大约 20 年前，汉密尔顿才在计算机和航空航天界之外得到广泛认可，2016 年，她获得了总统自由勋章。 “一代程序员和 STEM 领域的年轻女性将她视为先驱。”

paras.en: Hamilton was born in Paoli, Indiana, in 1936. After earning her bachelor’s degree in mathematics from Earlham College in 1958, she and her husband moved to Massachusetts. Hamilton started working on weather prediction software at MIT with Edward N. Lorenz, the meteorologist who founded chaos theory. This position marked the beginning of her computer programming journey.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿 1936 年出生于印第安纳州保利。1958 年从厄勒姆学院获得数学学士学位后，她和丈夫搬到了马萨诸塞州。汉密尔顿开始在麻省理工学院与创立混沌理论的气象学家爱德华·N·洛伦茨一起研究天气预报软件。这个职位标志着她计算机编程之旅的开始。

paras.en: In 1965, she joined the Instrumentation Lab at MIT, which was tasked with developing the onboard flight software for the Apollo program, with the goal of sending humans to the moon.
paras.zh: 1965 年，她加入了麻省理工学院的仪器实验室，该实验室的任务是为阿波罗计划开发机载飞行软件，目标是将人类送上月球。

paras.en: “I was attracted both by the sheer idea and the fact that it had never been done before. I was the first programmer to join and the first woman they hired,” Hamilton told the Guardian’s Zoë Corbyn in 2019. “Male engineers were already working on the project, but they were hardware engineers, and it wasn’t their thing. I had [software writing] as my background. I think [the lab] just figured that I could handle the unknown.”
paras.zh: “我被这个纯粹的想法和以前从未做过的事实所吸引。我是第一个加入的程序员，也是他们雇用的第一个女性，”汉密尔顿在 2019 年告诉《卫报》的佐伊·科尔宾。“男性工程师已经参与了这个项目，但他们是硬件工程师，这不是他们的事。我有[软件编写]作为我的背景。我认为[实验室]只是认为我可以处理未知的事情。”

paras.en: Hamilton eventually became the lead of the team creating the on-board flight software for the crewed missions and then assistant director in charge of the Command and Service Module team.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿最终成为为载人任务创建机载飞行软件的团队的领导者，然后成为负责指挥和服务模块团队的助理主任。

paras.en: Her signature work in the field was “defensive” programming—computer programs capable of predicting or fixing issues by themselves—and “priority-driven” software. The approach played a major role in the first human moon landing in July 1969. Shortly before the landing module was supposed to reach the lunar surface, alarms sounded from the onboard computer. A fault in a hardware switch had caused the computer to overload, threatening the success of the mission.
paras.zh: 她在该领域的标志性工作是“防御性”编程（能够自行预测或解决问题的计算机程序）和“优先级驱动”软件。这种方法在 1969 年 7 月人类首次登月中发挥了重要作用。就在登陆舱预计到达月球表面之前不久，机载计算机发出了警报。硬件开关故障导致计算机过载，威胁到任务的成功。

paras.en: Thankfully, Hamilton and her colleagues’ priority-driven software turned off unnecessary background tasks to make room for top-priority tasks, and the mission was able to carry on. “I was not concentrating on the mission per se, I was concentrating on the software,” she explained in an interview with Makers in 2017. “All of a sudden, it was like everything you did on Apollo to that point in time, it just all happened in front of you. People say that before they’re no longer here, they see their life. I could see the Apollo life. Just, my god, look what happened. We did it. It worked.”
paras.zh: 值得庆幸的是，汉密尔顿和她的同事的优先级驱动软件关闭了不必要的后台任务，为最优先的任务腾出空间，任务得以继续进行。 “我并没有专注于任务本身，我专注于软件，”她在 2017 年接受 Makers 采访时解释道，“突然之间，就像你在阿波罗上所做的一切一样，一切都发生在你的面前。人们说，在他们离开这里之前，他们看到了自己的生活。我可以看到阿波罗的生活。天啊，看看发生了什么。我们做到了。它成功了。”

paras.en: No issues were ever found in any of the Apollo guidance software overseen by Hamilton, according to the Wall Street Journal’s Robert Lee Hotz. What’s more, Hamilton popularized the term software engineering.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》的罗伯特·李·霍茨称，汉密尔顿监督的阿波罗制导软件中从未发现任何问题。更重要的是，汉密尔顿普及了软件工程这个术语。

paras.en: “I fought to bring the software legitimacy so that it—and those building it—would be given its due respect, and thus I began to use the term ‘software engineering’ to distinguish it from hardware and other kinds of engineering, yet treat each type of engineering as part of the overall systems engineering process,” Hamilton told El Pais’ Javier Pedreira in 2017, per a translation cited by MIT. “When I first started using this phrase, it was considered to be quite amusing.”
paras.zh: 根据麻省理工学院引用的翻译，汉密尔顿在 2017 年告诉《国家报》的哈维尔·佩德雷拉：“我努力争取软件的合法性，以便它以及构建它的人得到应有的尊重，因此我开始使用‘软件工程’这个术语来将其与硬件和其他类型的工程区分开来，同时将每种类型的工程视为整个系统工程过程的一部分。” “当我第一次开始使用这个短语时，我觉得它很有趣。”

paras.en: In 1976, Hamilton founded the software company Higher Order Software. A decade later, she founded her second software company, Hamilton Technologies. She is an author of more than 130 publications, according to MIT.
paras.zh: 1976年，汉密尔顿创立了软件公司Higher Order Software。十年后，她创立了第二家软件公司 Hamilton Technologies。据麻省理工学院称，她是 130 多篇出版物的作者。

paras.en: In 2003, she was honored with a NASA Exceptional Space Act Award for her scientific and technical contributions. Hamilton also won the Computer History Museum Fellow Award in 2017 and the Intrepid Lifetime Achievement Award in 2019, and she was inducted into the National Aviation Hall of Fame in 2022. The Smithsonian’s National Air and Space Museum awarded her the 2025 Michael Collins Trophy for lifetime achievement.
paras.zh: 2003年，她因其科学和技术贡献而被授予美国宇航局杰出太空法案奖。汉密尔顿还于 2017 年获得计算机历史博物馆研究员奖，于 2019 年获得无畏终身成就奖，并于 2022 年入选国家航空名人堂。史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆向她颁发了 2025 年迈克尔·柯林斯终身成就奖。

paras.en: Hamilton was even immortalized in Lego’s now-retired Women of NASA set. She is survived by three siblings, her daughter, son-in-law, two grandsons and four great-grandchildren.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿甚至在乐高现已退役的美国宇航局女性套装中永垂不朽。她身后留下了三个兄弟姐妹、女儿、女婿、两个孙子和四个曾孙。

articles.title: J.M.W. Turner Painted This Breathtaking Roman Landscape Nearly 200 Years Ago. If You Look Closely, You Can Still See His Fingerprints

paras.en: When J.M.W. Turner landed a commission to paint Rome in the early 19th century, his patron gave him specific instructions: He was to capture the city authentically, showing modern life beside the ancient ruins. The piece should be “‘a copy,’ not an ideal picture,” according to an early Turner biographer, and the artist was “particularly anxious to comply.”
paras.zh: 当 J.M.W.透纳在十九世纪初期接到了描绘罗马的委托，他的赞助人给了他具体的指示：他要真实地捕捉这座城市，在古代废墟旁边展示现代生活。根据特纳早期传记作者的说法，这幅作品应该是“‘复制品’，而不是一幅理想的画作”，而这位艺术家“特别渴望遵守”。

paras.en: The patron, Hugh Andrew Johnstone Munro of Novar, kept Rome, From Mount Aventine for the rest of his life. After he died, the painting was purchased by Archibald Primrose, who would later become the British prime minister. It remained with his descendants until 2014, when it sold for $47.4 million, becoming the most expensive Turner ever auctioned.
paras.zh: 赞助人诺瓦尔的休·安德鲁·约翰斯通·门罗在他的余生中将罗马从阿文丁山保留了下来。他去世后，这幅画被后来成为英国首相的阿奇博尔德·普里姆罗斯购买。这幅画一直由他的后代保管，直到 2014 年，它以 4740 万美元的价格售出，成为特纳拍卖史上最昂贵的作品。

paras.en: Now, it’s up for grabs once again. On December 9, the landscape will appear at a much-anticipated Sotheby’s auction, where it’s expected to fetch a record-breaking $66 million. Accounting for inflation, this estimate is about 15 percent higher than the 2014 price.
paras.zh: 现在，它再次可供争夺。 12 月 9 日，这幅景观将出现在备受期待的苏富比拍卖会上，预计将拍出破纪录的 6600 万美元成交价。考虑到通货膨胀因素，这一估计比 2014 年的价格高出约 15%。

paras.en: “As an artist, Turner is at his best when working with a subject that has close personal meaning, and no subject could be closer to his heart than Rome,” Julian Gascoigne, a senior director at Sotheby’s, writes in an essay. “In all my years in the art world, few other works have appeared that are as exceptional as this.”
paras.zh: “作为一名艺术家，特纳在处理具有密切个人意义的主题时处于最佳状态，没有哪个主题比罗马更贴近他的内心，”苏富比高级总监朱利安·加斯科因在一篇文章中写道。 “在我从事艺术界的这些年里，很少有其他作品能像这件作品一样出色。”

paras.en: Nearly 200 years later, the canvas still bears evidence of the Romantic artist’s energetic handiwork: Small hairs from his brush and marks from his palette knife are visible. Viewers can even make out some of his fingerprints. The painting will be sold in its original frame, and it’s one of only two late Turners that remain unlined.
paras.zh: 近 200 年后，画布上仍然保留着这位浪漫主义艺术家充满活力的手工作品的证据：画笔上的细小毛发和调色刀上的痕迹清晰可见。观众甚至可以辨认出他的一些指纹。这幅画将以其原始画框出售，它是特纳已故的仅有的两幅未加衬里的画作之一。

paras.en: - “Lining” is a treatment that involves attaching new fabric to the back of a painting to support its original canvas. This process can also cause damage, and it’s been the subject of extensive debate among conservators.
paras.zh: - “衬里”是一种将新织物附着在画作背面以支撑其原始画布的处理方法。这个过程也会造成损害，这一直是保护者广泛争论的话题。

paras.en: - “Lining is a major treatment, which should only be carried out when absolutely necessary,” according to Royal Museums Greenwich. “The 1974 Greenwich Lining Conference sought to broker an international agreement on how and when to carry out the process.”
paras.zh: - 格林威治皇家博物馆表示，“衬里是一项主要处理措施，只有在绝对必要时才应进行”。 “1974 年格林威治衬里会议寻求就如何以及何时进行这一过程达成一项国际协议。”

paras.en: Ahead of the auction, the painting went on display in Rome for a few days last week. It will now travel to London, Hong Kong and New York. Mario Tavella, chairman of Sotheby’s Europe, tells Agence France-Presse that he hopes the piece will find its way to a museum “where it could be admired by everyone.”
paras.zh: 在拍卖之前，这幅画上周在罗马展出了几天。它现在将前往伦敦、香港和纽约。苏富比欧洲区主席马里奥·塔维拉 (Mario Tavella) 告诉法新社，他希望这件作品能够进入博物馆，“让每个人都能欣赏到它”。

paras.en: Born in London in 1775, Turner started painting as a boy, and his father proudly displayed his creations in the barbershop where he worked. He was accepted into the Royal Academy at age 14, and he studied paintings and sculptures by famous Italian artists years before he traveled to the country. With time, “his works became more and more expressive,” per the Ashmolean Museum, “with some bordering on abstract as form, and detail became secondary to the mood of the scene.” Today, the so-called painter of light is known for his sweeping landscapes and dramatic colors.
paras.zh: 特纳 1775 年出生于伦敦，小时候就开始绘画，他的父亲在他工作的理发店自豪地展示了他的创作。他 14 岁时被皇家艺术学院录取，在前往意大利旅行之前的几年里，他学习了意大利著名艺术家的绘画和雕塑。随着时间的推移，“他的作品变得越来越富有表现力，”阿什莫林博物馆表示，“有些作品在形式上接近于抽象，而细节对于场景的情绪来说变得次要。”如今，这位所谓的光画家以其广阔的风景和戏剧性的色彩而闻名。

paras.en: “Turner was revolutionary. He broke down the formal structure of the painting and moved toward forms that are looser and more abstract,” Gascoigne tells Artnet’s Richard Whiddington. “It’s a new vision of what painting can be and how we should perceive the painted image.”
paras.zh: “特纳是革命性的。他打破了绘画的形式结构，转向更宽松、更抽象的形式，”加斯科因告诉 Artnet 的理查德·惠丁顿。 “这是关于绘画是什么以及我们应该如何感知绘画图像的新愿景。”

paras.en: Experts aren’t sure exactly when Munro commissioned Rome, From Mount Aventine. According to a statement from Sotheby’s, Turner started working on the painting in the late 1820s, when he traveled to the city and completed five detailed studies. He later finished the scene in London. The landscape shows the Tiber River flowing through the bustling city, which is lit by brilliant yellow sunshine. Turner added a priest and a young girl in the foreground beneath a towering umbrella pine.
paras.zh: 专家们不确定芒罗何时委托《罗马，从阿文丁山》建造。根据苏富比的一份声明，特纳于 1820 年代末开始创作这幅画，当时他前往这座城市并完成了五项详细的研究。后来他在伦敦完成了这一场景。景观展示了台伯河流经繁华的城市，被灿烂的黄色阳光照亮。特纳在前景中一棵高耸的伞松下添加了一名牧师和一名年轻女孩。

paras.en: In 1836, the painting went on view at the Royal Academy, where it sparked heated disagreements. “There was a group of critics who did not ‘get’ him, who thought his coloring was crude and sloppy and didn’t understand his fascination with light and atmosphere,” Gascoigne tells the London Times’ Tom Kington. “Others, however, saw him as a revolutionary genius.”
paras.zh: 1836年，这幅画在皇家学院展出，引发了激烈的争论。加斯科因告诉《伦敦时报》的汤姆·金顿：“有一群评论家没有‘理解’他，认为他的色彩粗糙、草率，不理解他对光线和氛围的迷恋。” “然而，其他人则认为他是一位革命天才。”

articles.title: The New Alexa Tablets Feel Like a Blueprint for an Amazon Phone
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu

paras.en: Is Amazon making a smartphone? A Reuters report from earlier this year revealed details about a device codenamed Transformer under development, with Amazon's Alexa+ AI assistant as the focus of the experience.
paras.zh: 亚马逊正在生产智能手机吗？路透社今年早些时候的一篇报道透露了正在开发的代号为 Transformer 的设备的详细信息，其中亚马逊的 Alexa+ AI 助手是体验的重点。

paras.en: With Amazon announcing a complete rebrand of its tablet line on Thursday—killing the cheap Fire Tablets and replacing them with premium Alexa Tablets that finally run Android with access to the Google Play Store—we now have a blueprint for what an Android-powered Amazon phone could look like.
paras.zh: 周四，亚马逊宣布对其平板电脑产品线进行彻底的品牌重塑——淘汰廉价的 Fire 平板电脑，代之以优质的 Alexa 平板电脑，最终运行 Android 并可访问 Google Play 商店——我们现在对 Android 驱动的亚马逊手机的外观有了一个蓝图。

paras.en: Amazon's souped-up Alexa+ assistant is front and center on the tablets. There's a persistent “Ask Alexa” widget on the home screen that lets you call on the assistant to ask it questions—you can say “Alexa” to trigger it, too. But Alexa+ now finally has what Amazon calls On-Screen Intelligence. Like Google's Gemini on Android phones or Apple's Siri on iPhones, which can read your screen and answer contextual questions, Alexa now has the same functionality (if you opt in).
paras.zh: 亚马逊增强版 Alexa+ 助手位于平板电脑的前端和中心位置。主屏幕上有一个持续存在的“询问 Alexa”小部件，可让您呼叫助手向其提问 - 您也可以说“Alexa”来触发它。但 Alexa+ 现在终于拥有了亚马逊所说的屏幕智能。就像 Android 手机上的 Google Gemini 或 iPhone 上的 Apple Siri 一样，Alexa 可以读取您的屏幕并回答上下文问题，Alexa 现在也具有相同的功能（如果您选择加入）。

paras.en: That can be for simple things like summarizing a web page, but it can be used for more complex tasks. Watching a YouTube video about a new product? Ask Alexa whether the product is on Amazon, and if so, add it to your Amazon shopping cart. Perusing an Infatuation article about new restaurants in your area? Ask Alexa to highlight the ones closest to your office.
paras.zh: 这可以用于简单的事情，例如总结网页，但它也可以用于更复杂的任务。观看有关新产品的 YouTube 视频？询问 Alexa 该产品是否在亚马逊上，如果是，请将其添加到您的亚马逊购物车。正在阅读一篇有关您所在地区新餐厅的《迷恋》文章吗？让 Alexa 突出显示距离您办公室最近的那些。

paras.en: Alexa also supports “live sessions,” just like Gemini Live or ChatGPT's Voice Mode—it lets you have a free-form back-and-forth conversation with the assistant. Maybe you're focused on a DIY project and want Alexa to spell out instructions slowly at your own pace. It also supports visual intelligence: Point the tablet's camera at anything, and Alexa can identify the object and offer helpful advice. Got a water leak? Point the camera and ask Alexa how to fix it.
paras.zh: Alexa 还支持“实时会话”，就像 Gemini Live 或 ChatGPT 的语音模式一样，它可以让您与助手进行自由形式的来回对话。也许您专注于 DIY 项目，并希望 Alexa 按照您自己的节奏慢慢拼出说明。它还支持视觉智能：将平板电脑的摄像头对准任何物体，Alexa 就可以识别该物体并提供有用的建议。有漏水吗？将相机对准并询问 Alexa 如何修复它。

paras.en: These are completely new experiences for Alexa. Amazon's vice president of devices, Kevin Keith, tells WIRED the company “didn't really have the right product to be able to use” these capabilities, but that's now solved with its Android tablets.
paras.zh: 这些对于 Alexa 来说都是全新的体验。亚马逊设备副总裁凯文·基思 (Kevin Keith) 告诉《连线》杂志，该公司“并没有真正拥有能够使用这些功能的合适产品”，但现在通过其 Android 平板电脑解决了这个问题。

paras.en: But these features would fit right in on a smartphone, where they’d perhaps be even more useful. When I mentioned this to Keith, he laughed and said: “We have nothing to share on that. Interesting idea.”
paras.zh: 但这些功能非常适合智能手机，也许会更有用。当我向基思提到这一点时，他笑着说：“我们对此没有什么可分享的。有趣的想法。”

paras.en: Amazon notoriously tried to make a smartphone in 2014—the Fire Phone—a massive flop discontinued shortly after launch due to a limited app ecosystem, dismal sales, and an over-reliance on gimmicky features. (Even its designer recently said he was embarrassed by it.) That may partly be why Amazon is retiring the “Fire” branding and killing its budget tablets. People may forget the disaster and won't be reminded of the “Fire Phone” name when the company eventually introduces a new handset.
paras.zh: 众所周知，亚马逊曾在 2014 年尝试生产一款智能手机——Fire Phone，但由于应用生态系统有限、销量惨淡以及过度依赖噱头功能，该公司在推出后不久就停产了。 （就连它的设计师最近也表示他对此感到尴尬。）这可能是亚马逊退役“Fire”品牌并取消其廉价平板电脑的部分原因。当该公司最终推出一款新手机时，人们可能会忘记这场灾难，也不会想起“Fire Phone”这个名字。

paras.en: Switching its tablets over to Google's Android (rather than the forked version the Fire tablets ran) and adding the Google Play Store is a silent admission that it's hard to thrive without a healthy app ecosystem. It also sets the phone up for success, as it won't feel app-limited out of the gate like the original Fire Phone.
paras.zh: 将其平板电脑切换到 Google 的 Android（而不是 Fire 平板电脑运行的分叉版本）并添加 Google Play 商店，无声地承认，如果没有健康的应用生态系统，它就很难蓬勃发展。它还为这款手机的成功奠定了基础，因为它不会像最初的 Fire Phone 那样受到应用程序的限制。

paras.en: Alexa+ is right now a paid service that requires an Alexa+ subscription or Amazon Prime. However, Amazon says anyone with its new Alexa tablet gets Alexa+ for free, and this would likely also be the case with an Amazon phone. Amazon’s devices, after all, are vehicles used to drive users to buy stuff on Amazon.com. A 2022 Pew Research Center survey showed that 76 percent of Americans purchase products using a smartphone. It makes sense that Amazon would want more direct control over the hardware people use to make those purchases, especially if it paints Alexa as a helpful assistant that can shop for you.
paras.zh: Alexa+ 目前是一项付费服务​​，需要 Alexa+ 订阅或 Amazon Prime。然而，亚马逊表示，任何拥有新款 Alexa 平板电脑的人都可以免费获得 Alexa+，亚马逊手机也可能出现这种情况。毕竟，亚马逊的设备是用来驱动用户在 Amazon.com 上购买商品的工具。皮尤研究中心 2022 年的一项调查显示，76% 的美国人使用智能手机购买产品。亚马逊希望对人们用于购物的硬件进行更直接的控制，这是有道理的，特别是如果它将 Alexa 描绘成一个可以为你购物的有用助手。

paras.en: Recently, Amazon has been on a mission to make its hardware more premium. This crusade seems to have ramped up after Microsoft Surface creator Panos Panay joined the company as head of Devices & Services in 2023. These upscaling efforts include the slew of Echo speakers it introduced in 2025, which saw marked price increases over their predecessors thanks to upgraded hardware. The Kindles announced at the start of October now come in sleek aluminum variants and are thinner and lighter than ever. The latest Alexa Tablets are more powerful, made from aluminum, and feel very iPad-esque.
paras.zh: 最近，亚马逊的使命是让其硬件变得更加优质。在 Microsoft Surface 创始人 Panos Panay 于 2023 年加入该公司担任设备和服务主管后，这场改革似乎愈演愈烈。这些升级努力包括 2025 年推出的大量 Echo 扬声器，由于硬件升级，其价格较前代产品显着上涨。十月初发布的 Kindle 现在采用时尚的铝制版本，并且比以往更薄、更轻。最新的 Alexa 平板电脑功能更强大，由铝制成，感觉非常像 iPad。

paras.en: Panay spent his final few years at Microsoft on the failed Microsoft Duo folding smartphone. When it launched, he was adamant it wasn't a phone but rather a productivity-focused device that belonged in a new category.
paras.zh: Panay 在微软的最后几年是在失败的 Microsoft Duo 折叠智能手机上度过的。当它推出时，他坚称这不是一部手机，而是一款专注于生产力的设备，属于一个新类别。

paras.en: The Reuters report suggests Amazon's phone may feature an “AI interface,” what the industry often refers to as a generative user interface, that eliminates the need for traditional app stores. It could be that when Panay eventually steps on a stage to reveal an Amazon “Alexa” Phone, he'll once again claim it's not a phone, but a helpful AI assistant in your pocket that conforms to your demands—marking a clear departure from every other Android slab on the market.
paras.zh: 路透社报道称，亚马逊的手机可能配备“人工智能界面”，业界通常将其称为生成式用户界面，从而消除对传统应用商店的需求。当 Panay 最终登上舞台展示亚马逊“Alexa”手机时，他可能会再次声称这不是一部手机，而是一个可以满足您需求的口袋里有用的人工智能助手，这标志着与市场上所有其他 Android 平板的明显区别。

paras.en: The smartphone market is in a bit of a predicament right now. Devices are getting more expensive because of the memory crisis, shipments have declined for several quarters in a row, and the duopoly in the US market between Samsung and Apple makes it hard for other players to break through. Established smartphone companies have given up and left the market, like OnePlus this summer or HMD last year.
paras.zh: 智能手机市场目前正陷入困境。由于内存危机，设备价格变得越来越贵，出货量连续几个季度下降，而三星和苹果在美国市场的双寡头垄断使得其他厂商难以突破。老牌智能手机公司已经放弃并退出市场，比如今年夏天的 OnePlus 或去年的 HMD。

paras.en: There isn't much choice left in for American buyers. However, an Amazon phone, made by a company that isn't based in China and backed by Amazon's retail dominance, could quickly swallow the slice of the pie Motorola and Google are fighting over.
paras.zh: 美国买家没有太多选择。然而，由一家总部不在中国的公司制造并得到亚马逊零售主导地位支持的亚马逊手机可能会迅速吞下摩托罗拉和谷歌正在争夺的份额。

articles.title: Amazon Alexa Tablet 12 Pro, Alexa Tablet 11, Alexa Tablet 8: Specs, Features, Price
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu

paras.en: The era of Amazon's Fire tablets—cheap slate computers ranging from $60 to $280—is over.
paras.zh: 亚马逊 Fire 平板电脑（价格从 60 美元到 280 美元不等的廉价平板电脑）的时代已经结束。

paras.en: All of the Fire tablets are being replaced by the all-aluminum Amazon Alexa Tablet. These tablets will, in a first for Amazon, run official Android and have full access to the Google Play Store. The lack of proper app support was always a sticking point for the Fire tablets, which ran a custom version of Android and had a much more limited app library.
paras.zh: 所有 Fire 平板电脑都将被全铝制 Amazon Alexa 平板电脑取代。这些平板电脑将是亚马逊首次运行官方 Android 系统，并可以完全访问 Google Play 商店。缺乏适当的应用程序支持始终是 Fire 平板电脑的一个症结所在，因为它运行的是自定义版本的 Android，并且应用程序库更加有限。

paras.en: The new Alexa Tablet series comes in three models: the Alexa Tablet 12 Pro ($500), Alexa Tablet 11 ($330), and Alexa Tablet 8 ($230), with the numbers corresponding to the display size. Amazon is also offering kids' editions of the latter two devices at the same prices. These include bumper cases for extra protection, a one-year, worry-free guarantee to replace the device if it breaks, and a year of Amazon Kids+ service to fill the tablet with age-appropriate content.
paras.zh: 全新 Alexa Tablet 系列共有三种型号：Alexa Tablet 12 Pro（500 美元）、Alexa Tablet 11（330 美元）和 Alexa Tablet 8（230 美元），数字与显示屏尺寸相对应。亚马逊还以相同的价格提供后两种设备的儿童版。其中包括提供额外保护的保险杠保护套、设备损坏时可更换的一年无忧保证，以及一年的 Amazon Kids+ 服务，可在平板电脑中填充适合年龄的内容。

paras.en: As for Fire tablets, Amazon says it will stop shipping the devices in the next month or two. It will support them for four years from the last ship date. Amazon is committing to at least four years of software updates for the new Alexa tablets, which will launch with Android 16 and will receive Android 17 early in 2027. Preorders for the new Alexa Tablets are open now, and they'll begin shipping on October 14.
paras.zh: 至于 Fire 平板电脑，亚马逊表示将在未来一两个月内停止发货。自上次发货之日起，它将为他们提供四年的支持。亚马逊承诺为新款 Alexa 平板电脑提供至少四年的软件更新，该平板电脑将随 Android 16 一起推出，并将于 2027 年初接收 Android 17。新款 Alexa 平板电脑的预订现已开放，将于 10 月 14 日开始发货。

paras.en: The experience is largely the same on all three tablets, with aluminum builds designed to mimic the new aluminum Kindles. The MediaTek Dimensity 8189 chip powers the two smaller tablets, whereas the 12-inch device gets a little more power from the MediaTek Dimensity 8400.
paras.zh: 这三款平板电脑的体验基本相同，采用铝制机身，旨在模仿新款铝制 Kindle。联发科技天玑 8189 芯片为两款较小的平板电脑提供动力，而 12 英寸设备则从联发科技天玑 8400 获得更多的动力。

paras.en: The Alexa Tablet 12 Pro is the outlier of the trio, as it's the only one with two display variants: a standard 12-inch LCD screen or a 12-inch Nanomatte display with anti-glare and anti-reflective properties. Upgrade to the Nanomatte—starting at $550—for a matte, paperlike look and feel. With a peak brightness of 500 nits, it should still be bright enough to view in sunlight.
paras.zh: Alexa Tablet 12 Pro 是这三款产品中的佼佼者，因为它是唯一一款具有两种显示屏变体的产品：标准 12 英寸 LCD 屏幕或具有防眩光和防反射特性的 12 英寸 Nanomatte 显示屏。升级到 Nanomatte（起价 550 美元），获得哑光、纸张般的外观和感觉。峰值亮度为 500 尼特，在阳光下仍应足够明亮。

paras.en: Amazon says it developed this screen in partnership with Corning (the company that makes most of the glass that protects smartphone displays). It's similar to the matte displays found on devices like TCL's Nxtpaper series, though Amazon's vice president of devices, Kevin Keith, says the hexagon-shaped imprint on the Nanomatte display can push out vivid colors and crisp blacks while still retaining those matte properties.
paras.zh: 亚马逊表示，它与康宁公司（该公司生产大部分保护智能手机显示屏的玻璃）合作开发了这款屏幕。它与 TCL Nxtpaper 系列等设备上的磨砂显示屏类似，不过亚马逊设备副总裁凯文·基思 (Kevin Keith) 表示 Nanomatte 显示屏上的六边形印记可以呈现鲜艳的色彩和清晰的黑色，同时仍然保留这些磨砂特性。

paras.en: The screen also offers a “really good” writing experience, according to Keith. He says the same engineers who worked on the Kindle Scribe worked with Corning to get that paperlike feel. The screen works with Amazon's new Alexa Tablet Pro Pen ($90), which has 4,096 levels of pressure sensitivity, plus tilt detection. The pen can magnetically dock to the top of the slate for charging and pairing. Amazon also sells a Pro Keyboard ($150) for the Alexa Tablet 12 Pro, which attaches to the device via the pogo pins on the bottom edge—no Bluetooth needed.
paras.zh: 基思表示，该屏幕还提供了“非常好的”书写体验。他说，开发 Kindle Scribe 的工程师与康宁公司合作，获得了纸张般的感觉。该屏幕可与亚马逊新款 Alexa Tablet Pro Pen（90 美元）配合使用，该笔具有 4,096 级压力灵敏度以及倾斜检测功能。该笔可以磁性地停靠在平板电脑的顶部进行充电和配对。亚马逊还销售适用于 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro 的专业键盘（150 美元），它通过底部边缘的弹簧针连接到设备，无需蓝牙。

paras.en: Now that Android has recently gained multiwindowing features, attaching the keyboard turns the largest Alexa tablet into a productivity machine: split apps across the screen, resize them into various windows, and “save” several desktop arrangements so you can pick up where you left off.
paras.zh: 现在 Android 最近获得了多窗口功能，连接键盘可以将最大的 Alexa 平板电脑变成生产力机器：在屏幕上拆分应用程序，将其调整为不同的窗口大小，并“保存”多个桌面排列，以便您可以从上次中断的地方继续。

paras.en: For the kids’ versions of the Alexa Tablet 11 and Alexa Tablet 8, Amazon says the software is still Android with a heavily customized interface for kid-friendly content and built-in parental controls. Keith says one in five kids in the US has an Amazon tablet, so it'll be interesting to see how that changes now that these devices start at a higher price.
paras.zh: 对于儿童版的 Alexa Tablet 11 和 Alexa Tablet 8，亚马逊表示该软件仍然是 Android 系统，具有针对儿童友好内容和内置家长控制的高度定制界面。基思说，美国五分之一的孩子拥有亚马逊平板电脑，因此，随着这些设备的起价更高，看看这种情况如何变化将会很有趣。

paras.en: It may look and feel like Android, but Amazon has tweaked the interface to make these Alexa Tablets feel like Amazon hardware.
paras.zh: 它可能看起来和感觉像 Android，但亚马逊已经调整了界面，使这些 Alexa 平板电脑感觉像亚马逊硬件。

paras.en: The top-left corner of the home screen features a persistent widget called the Dynamic Tab. This scrollable widget lets you dive into Amazon content you may have been consuming on another device—say, if you were reading on your Kindle, watching a movie on Prime Video on your iPhone, or snapped some photos and you want to view them on Amazon Photos.
paras.zh: 主屏幕的左上角有一个名为“动态选项卡”的持久小部件。这个可滚动的小部件可让您深入了解您可能在其他设备上消费过的亚马逊内容，例如，如果您在 Kindle 上阅读，在 iPhone 上通过 Prime Video 观看电影，或者拍摄了一些照片并且想要在亚马逊照片上查看它们。

paras.en: Swipe right, and instead of Google's Discover feed, you're instead greeted with Amazon's For You experience. Amazon's Fire tablets were a vehicle to put Amazon content in front of your eyeballs, and that hasn't changed with the Alexa Tablets. Again, you can continue consuming content here, with tabs for movies and TV, games, and Kindle. There's also a news feed, and you can tap Alexa prompts for more information on a story.
paras.zh: 向右滑动，您会看到亚马逊的 For You 体验，而不是 Google 的 Discover feed。亚马逊的 Fire 平板电脑是将亚马逊内容呈现在您眼前的工具，而 Alexa 平板电脑也没有改变这一点。同样，您可以继续在此处消费内容，包括电影和电视、游戏和 Kindle 选项卡。还有新闻源，您可以点击 Alexa 提示来获取有关故事的更多信息。

paras.en: Uniquely, opening the Kindle app triggers “Kindle mode,” which disables all notifications, turns on the blue light filter, and extends battery life to 20 hours (less on the smaller tablets). You can also choose one of three display treatments in this mode: subtle warmth with natural color, a softened paper tone, or monochrome. There's even a fun page-turn effect that mimics turning a page in a book. As soon as you exit the app, notifications turn back on, and the screen returns to normal. Annotations you make with the stylus will sync with Kindle apps on pen-supported devices, like the Kindle Scribe.
paras.zh: 独特的是，打开 Kindle 应用程序会触发“Kindle 模式”，该模式会禁用所有通知，打开蓝光过滤器，并将电池续航时间延长至 20 小时（较小的平板电脑上的续航时间会缩短）。您还可以在此模式下选择三种显示处理之一：自然色彩的微妙温暖、柔和的纸张色调或单色。甚至还有一个有趣的翻页效果，模仿在书中翻页。一旦退出应用程序，通知就会重新打开，屏幕也会恢复正常。您使用手写笔所做的注释将与支持笔的设备（例如 Kindle Scribe）上的 Kindle 应用程序同步。

paras.en: In the bottom-right corner, a persistent “Ask Alexa” chat box lets you call up the virtual assistant immediately. You can also trigger it by saying, “Alexa,” just like an Echo device. It can control your smart home devices, but the marquee addition is Alexa's On-Screen Intelligence. It's opt-in—with an on-screen indicator whenever it's active—allowing the assistant to see what you're looking at and answer contextual questions.
paras.zh: 在右下角，持续存在的“询问 Alexa”聊天框可让您立即呼叫虚拟助理。您还可以通过说“Alexa”来触发它，就像 Echo 设备一样。它可以控制您的智能家居设备，但最引人注目的是 Alexa 的屏幕智能。它是选择加入的——只要它处于活动状态，屏幕上就会有一个指示器——允许助手看到你正在看的内容并回答上下文问题。

paras.en: For example, if you're traveling to a new city and are looking at a guide filled with restaurant recommendations, you can ask Alexa, “Which of these is closest to my hotel?” and it can filter the list. Got a schedule for your kid's soccer games? Bring up Alexa and ask it to add all the events to your calendar.
paras.zh: 例如，如果您要去一个新城市旅行并正在查看包含餐厅推荐的指南，您可以询问 Alexa：“其中哪一个距离我的酒店最近？”并且它可以过滤列表。有您孩子足球比赛的时间表吗？打开 Alexa 并要求它将所有事件添加到您的日历中。

paras.en: Alexa+ also supports live sessions—much like Google's Gemini Live or ChatGPT's Voice Mode, you can have a real-time back-and-forth conversation with the assistant without speaking the wake word at every turn. Watching a TikTok and wondering whether a product in the video is available on Amazon? Naturally, you can ask Alexa, and the assistant can even add it to your shopping cart.
paras.zh: Alexa+ 还支持实时会话，就像 Google 的 Gemini Live 或 ChatGPT 的语音模式一样，您可以与助手进行实时来回对话，而无需每次都说出唤醒词。观看 TikTok 并想知道视频中的产品是否在亚马逊上有售？当然，你可以询问 Alexa，助手甚至可以将其添加到你的购物车中。

paras.en: The hardware may finally have the look and feel of other premium Android tablets, but these slates are still built to keep you hooked on Amazon's retail empire.
paras.zh: 硬件最终可能会具有其他优质 Android 平板电脑的外观和感觉，但这些平板电脑仍然是为了让您着迷于亚马逊的零售帝国。

paras.en: The Mac Mini has been sold out for the majority of this year due to the rapid escalation of interest in using them as local, agentic AI machines. paras.zh: Apple AirPods Max 2 是任何拥有 iPhone、MacBook 和其他 Apple 产品的人的最佳入耳式耳机。它们拥有市面上所有耳机中最好的音质、降噪和通透模式。它们价格昂贵，但比标价低 120 美元，使它们更符合索尼和 Bose 的选择。-Harry Rabinowitz

The Nothing Headphone (1) are an excellent, stylish pair of over-ear headphones with great sound and even better battery life: up to 35 hours with noise-canceling on or 80 hours with it off. The headphones have tactile controls on each earcup I personally love—things like a volume wheel, Bluetooth pairing button, on-off switch, and media control paddle. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 这些耳机在活动期间降价至 189 美元，但仍以 199 美元的价格出售，相当于优惠了 100 美元。 Nothing Headphone (1) 是一款出色、时尚的包耳式耳机，具有出色的音质和更长的电池寿命：开启降噪功能时长达 35 小时，关闭降噪功能时长达 80 小时。这款耳机的每个耳罩上都有我个人喜欢的触觉控制装置，例如音量轮、蓝牙配对按钮、开关和媒体控制拨片。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: This isn’t as good a deal as last Prime Day, but it’s still the second-lowest price I’ve seen for Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro all year. They are some of the best wireless earbuds you can get if you own an Android phone, particularly a Samsung one. The noise-canceling is great for canceling out low drones and office chatter, but the transparency might be the real standout—it sounds incredibly natural. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 这虽然不像去年 Prime Day 那样划算，但仍然是我见过的三星 Galaxy Buds 4 Pro 全年第二低的价格。如果您拥有 Android 手机，尤其是三星手机，它们是您可以获得的最好的无线耳机之一。降噪功能非常适合消除低沉的嗡嗡声和办公室的嘈杂声，但透明度可能是真正的亮点——听起来非常自然。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: Bose recently launched a new version of these earbuds, hence these 2024 originals being deeply discounted, matching the lowest price I’ve ever seen. They’re my top pick for premium, comfortable, great-sounding open earbuds—their only downside was price, but 33 percent off solves this problem. Despite years of newer options, I still occasionally grab these for a quick run or bike ride. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: Bose 最近推出了这些耳塞的新版本，因此这些 2024 年原装耳机大幅折扣，达到了我见过的最低价格。它们是我首选的优质、舒适、音质出色的开放式耳塞——它们唯一的缺点是价格，但 33% 的折扣解决了这个问题。尽管多年来有了新的选择，我仍然偶尔会抓住这些来快速跑步或骑自行车。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: We see this deal for our favorite workout earbuds pretty regularly, but they only ever get about $20 cheaper, so it's still a solid option if you're in the market. The Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 play well with iOS and Android, have punchy sound, and feature the option for both transparency mode and active noise canceling. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: 我们经常看到我们最喜欢的运动耳机的促销活动，但它们只便宜 20 美元左右，所以如果你在市场上，它仍然是一个不错的选择。 Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 在 iOS 和 Android 上运行良好，声音强劲，并具有透明模式和主动降噪选项。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: Tilt-Pan-Zoom webcams like the Obsbot Tiny 3 are so much more than just a webcam for video calls. The gimbal gives the camera a huge range of motion, letting you dramatically expand what you can shoot compared to a standard webcam. It’s ideal for streamers, content creators, podcasters, and online educators—or really anyone who wants to show more of their room on video. On top of that, it also has tons of interesting AI features to play with. This is a rare discount on this top-shelf webcam, too. —Luke Larsen
paras.zh: 像 Obsbot Tiny 3 这样的倾斜-平移-缩放网络摄像头不仅仅是用于视频通话的网络摄像头。与标准网络摄像头相比，万向节为相机提供了巨大的运动范围，让您可以极大地扩展您的拍摄范围。它非常适合主播、内容创作者、播客和在线教育工作者，或者任何想要在视频中展示更多房间的人。最重要的是，它还有大量有趣的人工智能功能可供使用。对于这款顶级网络摄像头来说，这也是难得的折扣。 ——卢克·拉森

paras.en: If you're bummed that there's no Kindle under $100 during Prime Day anymore, I have a solution for you. The Xteink X4 Pro Pocket E-Reader is a tiny e-reader with just a 4.3-inch display that fits in the palm of your hand (or your pocket!) It's easy to use, and you can send web pages and articles to it easily through the app. It doesn't have a built-in store, though, so it's harder to get ebooks onto it. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 如果您对 Prime Day 期间没有 100 美元以下的 Kindle 感到沮丧，我有一个解决方案。 Xteink X4 Pro 袖珍电子阅读器是一款微型电子阅读器，只有 4.3 英寸显示屏，适合放在手掌（或口袋！），使用方便，您可以通过应用程序轻松向其发送网页和文章。不过，它没有内置商店，因此很难在上面获取电子书。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: This dipped down to $417 for a two-pack during the sale, but it's still discounted at a decent $432 today. Ready to upgrade your home network to enjoy the speedy delights of Wi-Fi 7? The Netgear Orbi 770 Series is easy to set up and use, delivers rock-solid, reliable performance, and offers expansive coverage. Currently topping our best mesh routers, this is the sweet spot in Netgear’s lineup, and I think it’s an ideal mesh system for most homes right now. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 在促销期间，两件装的价格跌至 417 美元，但今天仍然有 432 美元的折扣。准备好升级您的家庭网络以享受 Wi-Fi 7 的快速乐趣了吗？ Netgear Orbi 770 系列易于设置和使用，提供坚如磐石、可靠的性能，并提供广泛的覆盖范围。目前，它是我们最好的网状路由器中的佼佼者，是 Netgear 产品线中的最佳点，我认为它是目前大多数家庭的理想网状系统。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: Currently top of our best Wi-Fi routers guide, this router will cover most homes and apartments up to around 2,000 square feet, with fast and reliable connectivity. It’s only dual-band, so you miss out on the 6-GHz band, but you get all the other advantages of Wi-Fi 7. It also has a generous array of ports and comes with free security software and parental controls. Support for VPN service, separate IoT or guest networks, and AiMesh rounds out an excellent device. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 目前，这款路由器是我们最佳 Wi-Fi 路由器指南的首选，它将覆盖大多数家庭和公寓，面积不超过 2,000 平方英尺，并具有快速可靠的连接。它只是双频，因此您会错过 6 GHz 频段，但您可以获得 Wi-Fi 7 的所有其他优势。它还拥有大量端口，并配备免费的安全软件和家长控制。支持 VPN 服务、独立的 IoT 或访客网络以及 AiMesh，是一款出色的设备。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: This soundbar plus subwoofer is a fantastic way to upgrade your TV audio system for a reasonable price, especially at 25 percent off. The Polk Signa S4 is one of our favorite soundbars for that very reason: It’s simple, easy to use, sounds great, and doesn’t cost an arm and a leg. Sure, it doesn’t have more advanced features like Wi-Fi connectivity, voice assistant support, or multi-speaker surround sound. But if you’re coming from built-in TV speakers, this is a great first upgrade. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 这款条形音箱加低音炮是以合理的价格升级您的电视音频系统的绝佳方式，尤其是 25% 的折扣。 Polk Signa S4 是我们最喜欢的条形音箱之一，原因如下：它简单、易于使用、听起来很棒，而且价格低廉。当然，它没有 Wi-Fi 连接、语音助手支持或多扬声器环绕声等更高级的功能。但如果您使用的是内置电视扬声器，那么这是一次很棒的首次升级。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: Don't let its small size fool you—this tiny portable Bluetooth speaker can get seriously loud. Weighing in at half a pound, its one of the best travel speakers because of its small size and its IP68 dust and water resistance rating. —Harry Rabinowitz
paras.zh: 不要让它的小尺寸欺骗了您——这款微型便携式蓝牙扬声器的声音可能非常大。它的重量仅为半磅，因其尺寸小且具有 IP68 防尘防水等级而成为最好的旅行扬声器之一。 ——哈里·拉比诺维茨

paras.en: Some of the best Samsung phones are still on sale. If you want an Android phone with real power, but prefer something that’s not too big, the Samsung Galaxy S26 is tough to beat. It’s fast, has a bright and sharp screen, a reliable triple-camera system, and good battery life. You also get seven years of software support, and the base model has jumped to 256 GB of storage. This has been cheaper, but with prices on the rise across the market, I’m not sure when it will dip again. This is still a decent discount. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 一些最好的三星手机仍在销售。如果您想要一款功能强大的 Android 手机，但又喜欢不太大的手机，那么三星 Galaxy S26 是您的最佳选择。它速度快、屏幕明亮、锐利、可靠的三摄像头系统以及良好的电池续航时间。您还可以获得七年的软件支持，基本型号的存储空间已跃升至 256 GB。这已经更便宜了，但随着市场价格的上涨，我不确定什么时候会再次下跌。这还是一个不错的折扣。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: It dropped down to $734 during the event, but at $750, this is still a good discount on a relatively new phone. The Google Pixel 11 is the value sweet spot in Google’s new lineup, especially with this hefty discount. It combines a great camera, strong battery life, and solid performance with Qi2 25W support and slick contextual AI features. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 活动期间它跌至 734 美元，但 750 美元的价格对于一款相对较新的手机来说仍然是一个不错的折扣。谷歌 Pixel 11 是谷歌新产品系列中性价比最高的一款，尤其是在如此大的折扣下。它结合了出色的摄像头、强大的电池续航时间、稳定的性能以及 Qi2 25W 支持和流畅的上下文 AI 功能。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: If you demand the most powerful phone Samsung makes, you’re an Ultra kind of person. Only the S26 Ultra has Samsung’s fancy Privacy Display, and it’s a big screen at 6.9 inches. You also get the biggest battery, the most versatile quad-lens camera system, and the largest vapor chamber to keep things cool, even when you’re hardcore gaming. This beast of a phone can do it all. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 如果您需要三星生产的最强大的手机，那么您就是 Ultra 类型的人。只有 S26 Ultra 拥有三星精美的隐私显示屏，而且是 6.9 英寸的大屏幕。您还可以获得最大的电池、最通用的四镜头相机系统和最大的均热板，即使您在玩硬核游戏时也能保持凉爽。这款手机怪兽可以做到这一切。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: Arlo ticks all the boxes with crisp 2K video, a wide 160-degree field of view, two-way audio, and direct Wi-Fi connection, and the Pro 6 tops our best outdoor security cameras guide. The Arlo app is swift to load, offers rich notifications, and supports two-factor authentication and biometric login, so you can log in with your fingerprint or face, phone permitting. The catch is a pricey, but crucial, subscription ($10 per month or $96 a year for a single camera, $20 per month or $216 a year for unlimited cameras) for subject recognition, smart alerts, and cloud storage. —Simon Hill
paras.zh: Arlo 凭借清晰的 2K 视频、宽广的 160 度视野、双向音频和直接 Wi-Fi 连接满足了所有要求，Pro 6 在我们的最佳户外安全摄像头指南中名列前茅。 Arlo app 加载速度快，提供丰富的通知，并支持两步身份验证和生物识别登录，因此您可以在手机允许的情况下使用指纹或面部登录。问题是昂贵但至关重要的订阅服务（单个摄像头每月 10 美元或每年 96 美元，无限摄像头每月 20 美元或每年 216 美元），用于主题识别、智能警报和云存储。 ——西蒙·希尔

paras.en: My all-time favorite robot vacuum is often on sale, but this is the lowest the price it ever goes (and used to only go as low as $800, so don't miss it!) The Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal uses a UV light to spot stains and spills on your floor and will go back to scrub them away after doing its regular clean. It's the smartest one I've tried in 2026 by a long shot, and little announcements from the base station make it easy to know when the vacuum is just cleaning versus handling stains. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 我一直以来最喜欢的机器人真空吸尘器经常打折，但这是它有史以来的最低价格（以前只低至 800 美元，所以不要错过它！） Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal 使用紫外线来发现地板上的污渍和溢出物，并在定期清洁后返回将它们擦掉。这是我在 2026 年尝试过的最聪明的一款，基站发出的小通知让我很容易知道吸尘器何时只是在清洁，什么时候在处理污渍。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: I've always been happy with a Dreame vacuum, and former WIRED reviewer Adrienne So confirmed the Dreame X50 Ultra is a great model. It has 20,000 Pa of suction, double-roll brushes, side wands for edge cleaning, and a large-capacity docking station. She also really liked the built-in AI that can identify dirty areas in your home. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 我一直对 Dreame 吸尘器很满意，《连线》前评论员 Adrienne So 证实 Dreame X50 Ultra 是一款很棒的型号。它具有 20,000 Pa 吸力、双滚刷、边缘清洁侧棒和大容量扩展坞。她还非常喜欢内置的人工智能，可以识别家里的肮脏区域。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: Dyson's newest, most powerful vacuum not only packs 315 air watts of power, two vacuum heads, plus the option to add on the new Submarine 2.0 mop head, but is on sale for Prime Day. It's powerful and useful, and has some nice quality of life upgrades with more built-in crevice tools, easier separation of the pieces, and a compressor in the dust bin. It's expensive, but has a nice little discount for Prime Day if you've had your eye on it. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 戴森最新、最强大的吸尘器不仅配备 315 瓦功率、两个吸尘器头，还可以选择添加新的 Submarine 2.0 拖把头，而且在 Prime Day 促销。它功能强大且有用，并且通过更多的内置缝隙工具、更容易的碎片分离以及垃圾箱中的压缩机，对生活质量进行了一些不错的升级。它很贵，但如果你留意的话，在黄金日有一个不错的小折扣。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: This is a solid deal on the best automatic latte and cappuccino maker we've tested. The Rivelia is user-friendly and easy to use, and it even has a built-in milk frother in addition to the grinder. We also like the touchscreen display and consistently tasty results. —Louryn Strampe
paras.zh: 对于我们测试过的最好的自动拿铁和卡布奇诺咖啡机来说，这是一笔划算的交易。 Rivelia 用户友好且易于使用，除了研磨机之外，它甚至还配有内置奶泡器。我们还喜欢触摸屏显示屏和始终如一的美味结果。 ——卢琳·斯特兰普

paras.en: An affordable OLED TV is rare, but this newly launched model from Sony is an exception during this sale. It's Sony's entry-level OLED TV, and while it might have fewer bells and whistles than the Sony Bravia 8 II, it's far easier on your wallet and still delivers a rich picture with deep black tones and excellent color contrast. It also has Google Gemini built in, which you can use to control the picture, change settings, flip inputs, and ask about obscure sci-fi movies from the ’70s. —John Brandon
paras.zh: 价格实惠的 OLED 电视很少见，但索尼新推出的这款电视在本次促销中是个例外。它是索尼的入门级 OLED 电视，虽然它可能比索尼 Bravia 8 II 少了一些花哨的功能，但它更便宜，而且仍然提供具有深黑色调和出色色彩对比度的丰富图像。它还内置了 Google Gemini，您可以用它来控制图像、更改设置、翻转输入以及询问 70 年代晦涩的科幻电影。 ——约翰·布兰登

paras.en: This screen-free play stage and speaker for kids is enormous fun. Simply slot one of the wooden cartridges in the top and pop wooden character pieces on the circular soundstage, divided into four sections, to change the audio it plays. This basic functionality allows for a clever variety of themed add-on packs, including classical music and a cooking game.
paras.zh: 这个无屏幕的儿童游戏舞台和扬声器非常有趣。只需将其中一个木制唱头插入顶部，然后在圆形音场上弹出木制角色部件（分为四个部分），即可更改其播放的音频。这一基本功能允许巧妙地添加各种主题附加包，包括古典音乐和烹饪游戏。

paras.en: The Star Wars Smart Play Throne Room Duel and A-Wing set recreates the iconic final lightsaber battle in Star Wars: Return of the Jedi, as Emperor Palpatine sits on his throne, watching Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker fight. You also get an A-Wing to fly around, some imperial guards, and Smart Bricks that play sound effects and a version of “The Imperial March.” —Simon Hill
paras.zh: 星球大战智能游戏王座决斗和 A 翼套装重现了《星球大战：绝地归来》中标志性的最终光剑战斗，帕尔帕廷皇帝坐在王座上，观看达斯·维德和卢克·天行者战斗。你还可以得到一个可以飞来飞去的 A 翼、一些帝国卫兵、可以播放音效的智能砖块以及一个版本的“帝国进行曲”。 ——西蒙·希尔
